bibl.title: Cāvuṇḍarāyapurāṇaṁ (Triṣaṣṭilakṣaṇa Mahāpurāṇaṁ)
bibl.note: Edition of Kulkarni, 1975 (details to be filled in), 455 pp. Pages 1-207 and 247-288 (and most of 208-246) are read from the first scan (cāvuṇḍarāyapurāṇam-ed_kulkarni-1975.pdf, 1-bit); pages 289-453 and the pages of 208-288 named in cavundarayapurana-all/source.tsv are read from the second, clearer scan (kulkarni-new_scan.pdf). The book's page numbers equal the page numbers of the first scan up to about p. 316 and the page numbers printed in the book throughout; pages without a printed number are marked type="unprinted".

listWit.witness: first reading of the page images (a Claude subagent, record format of docs/ocr/pipeline.md)
second, independent reading of the same page images

projectDesc.p: Transliteration is ISO-15919 with ṟ (ಱ) and ḻ (ೞ) kept apart from r and ḷ, and e/o short, ē/ō long. Anusvāra before a stop is written with the nasal of the stop's class (ṅ ñ ṇ n m), as in the other texts of this project; elsewhere ṁ.

The text is not proofread. Where the two readings of the page images differ, both are kept: app type="ocr" with the first reading as lem (wit="#run1") and the second as rdg (wit="#run2"); a letter one reading marked as doubtful and the other reading confirms is unclear. Letters printed in round brackets in the text (variant readings of the editor's manuscripts) are kept as printed.

Structure: div type="section" = a purāṇa or a story as headed in the print (its head type="section" is the name given in the workspace structure file, the printed headings follow as head type="main" or "sub"); lg = a verse (n the number printed, repaired where the print or the readings are wrong: see numbers-report.txt of the workspace; unnumbered stanzas have none); l = a printed line; p = a prose passage, begun in the print by the abbreviation va॥ (label), with lb at the beginning of every printed line (a line break inside a word is not marked as such: the readings do not say).

div.head: ādipurāṇaṁ
triṣaṣṭi lakṣaṇa mahāpurāṇaṁ

lg.l: kta samādhāna pividhānadiṁ muḍipi muktisthānamuṁmaṁ muñce sā

div.p:
gadya ॥ antu guṇamaṇi vibhūṣaṇaruṁ, śīḷāḷaṅkāraruṁ,
jagatpavitra cāritraruṁ, vijita duritārātisēnarumenisidajitasēna
bhaṭṭārakare gurugaḷāge, gaṅgakuḷācaḷa śikhara śēkhararuṁ, gaṅga cūḍā
maṇiyuṁ jagadēkavīraruṁ, dharmānurāganumenisidava noḷomba
kuḷāntaka dēvane tanage paramasvāmiyāge, jagatpavitra brahmakṣatra
vaṁśamāge,

lg.l: chathaladiṁ rājaytayyanoḷtaḷtaṟiva bhujabalaṁ rājanaṁ koṇḍa vīraṁ
neladindaṁ tāne gōvindanana vīrade beṅkoṇḍa ballāḷtanaṁ maṁ

div.p:
va॥intenisi negaḻdalda samyaktvaratnākaraṁ śrīmaccāvuṇḍa
rājaṁ.

va॥kalyāṇārthiyappātaṁ vivakṣitamappavastuvaṁ pēḻvaḷvavarggaḷuḷuṁ
munnamāptāgamavaktr̥ kathe śrōtr̥vembivaṁ pēḻvaḷvavaroḷ

modalāptanemboṁ aṣṭādaśadōṣarahitanappoṁ, yeraḍaneya
āgamavembudu āptamukhavinirgatamuṁ, pūrvāpara virōdharahita
muṁ saptabhaṅgi samāliṅgitamuṁ, syādvādōpalakṣitamuṁ, yathā
vasthita samastavastusvarūpa nirūpaṇamumappudu, mūṟaneya vaktr̥
vemboṁ, pravayaskanuṁ, vapuṣmantanuṁ, ānuṁarōganuṁ bahu śrutanuṁ
pragalbhanuṁ, mēdhāviyuṁ, nirūpakriyā pravr̥ttanuṁ cāritravantanu
mendaṣṭaguṇasamanvitanakkuṁ; alli pravayaskanemboṁ, ativr̥ddhanu
matibāḷakanumallade samatikrānta daśavarṣanumanatikrānta saptati
saṁvatsaranumakkuṁ; vapuṣmantanemboṁ, na hīna pañcēndriyanuṁ,
kalyāṇa śarīranuṁ, śatrujanamanōhāri hitamitāsandigdha madhura
vacananumakkuṁ; arōganemboṁ vāta pittaślēṣma sannipātavyādhi
virahita śarīranakkuṁ, bahuśrutanemboṁ dvādaśāṅga caturdaśa pūrva
prakīrṇakādhyayanaṅgaḷoḷu granthārtha kuśalanappoṁ; pragalbhanemboṁ,
dēvāsura manuṣya sabheyoḷnirbhayanuṁ unnamita lalāṭanumumagadgada
kaṇṭhanumāgi tatvapratipādana samarthanappoṁ, mēdhāviyembonnavagra
(hēhā) hīhūvāyiyadhāraṇāguṇayuktanappoṁ, nirūpakriyā pravr̥tta
nembonānentu tatvajñānādedenenna pordiva janaṅgaḷuminte tatvajñarakkendu
khyāti bhōjana pānōpakaraṇa pūjegaḷanapēkṣisade tatvōpadēśaṅgeyvoṁ,

cāritravantanemboṁ jinapati matagatamuṁ kālamuṁ bhāvamuṁ prakr̥ta
muri tīrthamuṁ phalamuvenmendu kaḍege saptāṅgamumakkuṁ.

avaṟoḷu dravyamembudu jīvājīvāsrava saṁvara nirjara
bandha mōkṣamemba tatvamanuḷḷudu, kṣētramembudu, trailōkyakāla
mavamumatītānāgata vartamānātmaka tribhēdamuṁ, suṣamaduṣṣamādi
ṣaḍbhāgamanuḷḷudu, bhāvamembudu karmaṅgaḷakṣayadinupaśamadiṁ
kṣāyōpaśamadinappātmana paryāyaṁ, prakr̥tiyembudu jinapati
carita phaḷamembudu tatvajñāna aydaneya śrōtr̥ vembudu, jaṭāsiṁha
nandyācāryana, “pr̥jñāḷicchāḷī niruhiṣiṣamāṁsa śuṣa svabhāvā, pāvārjāra
kaṅkamasakādi jaḷūka tulyā, sacchidra kumbha paśu sarpaviḷōka
mānāṁ tēsāntre śrāvakābhavati caturdaśatāśā bhavanti”. antu praśastā praśastātma
kamappa caturdaśa vikalpamuṁ, mattaṁ praśastātmaka śrōtr̥dhiṣṭhāna
nakkuṁ, kaḷahaṁsasamanuṁ pr̥thaktanumūnyastanemboṁ dharma śravamaṇa
samayadoḷu parītyamr̥pyutarasakkara vyāpāraṁ, vividhārtha saḷiḷaka
pātamatiyuṁ,puṇyapāpajña triguptiguptanuṁ,tridaṇḍa triśalyarahitanuṁ,
catuḥkaṣāyamuktamathananuṁ, caturvidhabandha viśēṣajñanuṁ, caturvidha vikatha
viratanuṁ, caturvidha satkathā niratanuṁ, pañcasamiti samimētanuṁ, niruddha
pañcāśravanuṁ, ṣaṭkāya saṁyutanuṁ,apagata saptabhayanuṁ, aṣṭama
damamupētanuṁ, navavidha brahmacaryārjitanuṁ, parigr̥hītadaśavidha śravamaṇa
dharmanuṁ, viniścitaityaikādaśōpāsakasthānanuṁ, dvādaśavidha tapōni
yuktanuṁ,trayōdaśavidha kriyātatparanuṁ, ācāra prajñāpti vyavahāra
dr̥ṣṭivādavapēśakanuṁ, vēda vēdāntādhyayana śabdāgamārtha vēdiyuṁ,
paravādi darpapātana pariṇatanuṁ, aṣṭādaśa sahasra śīlavibhūṣitanuṁ,
catura sīti lakṣaṇaguṇa ratnabhūṣaṇanumakkuṁ, nālkaneyu katheyembu
dumu dravyamuṁ kṣētra anasyanya manaskanemboṁ pravaṇēnbompañcēndriyuya viṣaya
doḷnirvavartita manaskaṁ, anukūlanembōnemboṁ, hiṁsānr̥tastēyā
brahma parigraha krōdhamānamāyālōbhadoḷu parahitaṁ, anālasya
nemboṁ sthityadaiśēntrēndrādi nirnirīkṣaṇa jr̥mbha vivarjitaṁ, śraddhāḷu
vemboṁ dharmaśravaṇa nirūpadiṁ rōmāñca kañcukita śarīranuṁ,
vigaḷitānandāśru jalanuṁ, laḷanuṁlāṭa taṭaghaṭita mukuḷita karakamaḷanuṁ,
pravaktr̥vacana pārāpārāvagāhana pariṇatamativiśēṣanuṁ, kathaka
mukhavanaja vinihita vilōcananumappoṁ, adhikāriyemboṁ, bhūprabombhrū

lalāṭa nayana nāsāpuṭōṣṭhaśirōdara kara caraṇadhara vikāra virahitanuṁ,
sabhāhr̥dayahāri praśnanuṁ, pravaktr̥ manōgatābhiprāyanu
mappoṁ, abdhibdirasamanemboṁ maṟugimadanentu tōṭigeyyadeyyde,
tanna manōbhilaṣitamapparthamaṁ kēḷdu kaikoḷgumante jinōpadiṣṭa
tatvagrahaṇa buddhiyiṁ nirūpyamāṇavapparthamaṁ kēḷdu manadoḷ
aṟaṟisuvoṁ,kaḷahaṁsanemboṁ haṁsanentu pāluṁ nīruṁ verasidavalli nīrire
pālane pīggumante vaktr̥dōṣadindamāda vacana dōṣamumartha
dōṣamuṁmumaṁ kaikoḷḷade jinōpadiṣṭa tattvātvārthamane kaikoḷvoṁ,
pr̥thakkanemboṁ, vaktr̥ rāga dvēṣa vaśagatanā dharmārtha vyākhyānamaṁ
viparītamāgi pēḻiyumavaṁdaṁ yathāvasthita dharmasvarūpamaṁ
kaikoḷvoṁ, madhyasthanemboṁ, vastu vicāramoḷ vaṇavaktr̥ pēḻva guṇa
dōṣaṅgaḷoḷu dōṣamaṁ koṇḍesade pattuviṭṭu guṇamane
kaikoḷvoṁ, śrōtratr̥vīpēḻda daśaguṇa samanvitanāgirdaṣṭavidha karmamaṁ
kēḻdumadāvuvendaḍe,

satpraṇīttrajītamuṁ, samānamuṁ, nirūpādānamuṁ, niranvēṣamuṁ,
duṣkaścaramuṁ, prarūḍhamuṁ, ahiṁsāsramuṁ, phaḷavantamumembavakkuṁ,
alli satpraṇīttrajītamembudu bhayarāgādi dōṣarahita praṇītamappa dharmaṁ;
samānamembudu, brāhmaṇa kṣatriya vaiśya śūdra paśu mr̥ga pakṣi sarī
sr̥pagaḷumaṁ, samaṅgāṇba dharmaṁ; nirūpādānamembudu, śaya
nāsana vastra chatrapāna kanaka bhājanādigaḷumaṁ, peṟavu sukhasādhanaṅgaḷu
manapēkṣisade pravartisuva dharmaṁ; niranvēṣamembudu, bhōgōpa
bhōga pūjāvandanādaidyaiśvaryādigaḷanapēkṣisade bhavya varapuṇḍarīkar
naḍava dharmaṁ; duṣkaścaramembudu, bāla vr̥ddha rōgārtarēṁ kāpuruṣari
nondu divasamappoḍaṁ negaḻalaśakyamappa dharmaṁ, prarūḍhamembudu
dīrghakālapravr̥ttamuṁ, anādya nidhanamappa dharmaṁ, ahiṁsāsra
membudu, ārambharahitamappa dharmaṁ; phaḷavantamembudu, jāti
jarārōga maraṇa vyavyucchēdadindaṁ śivamajaramakṣayamavyābādhamappa
parama nirvāṇamaṁ puṭṭisuva dharmaṁ; yellā prāṇigaḷumātyantika
sukhamaṁ bayasuvarāsukhamuṁ karmakṣayadinalladāgadu, karma
kṣayakke peṟavu kāraṇamoḷavāgiyuṁ, mukhya kāraṇa samyaktvamā
samyaktvādi guṇaṅgaḷge hētu, prathamāniyōgamā prathamāni

yōgamaṁ munne kaiḷāsācaḷadoḷādi brahmaraṁ bharatarājaṁ besagoḷe
jagatrayasvāmi kālatrayavidhi bhuvanatrayaikabandhu munnutsarpiṇi
kāladitihāsa purāṇaṅgaḷaṁ besase kēḷdu bharatarājaṁ mukuḷita karaka
maḷanumavanata maṇimukuṭanumāgi,

ene kalpavr̥ttapagatadānabuddhipūrvakanāgiyuṁ samupagata dēhi
samabhilaṣita vividha phaḷa vitaraṇa parāyatanappādidēvaṁ, sarva
bhāṣā svabhāvakamuṁ tribhuvana janada manake yugapadarthapratipādana
samarthamumappa divyadhvaniyoḷu mūḷatantra kartr̥ munnamādi
purāṇada pīṭhikeyoḷaṁ kāḷāvatāramuṁ kuḷadharāvatāramuṁmaṁ pēḻduḷiḻdaruḷada
mūḷatantra kartr̥gaḷappa tīrthakararumadaṁ pratipādise gaṇadhara prabhr̥ti
gaḷanu tantra paratantrakāra śiṣya pratiśiṣya matibhājanagatamāgi paraṁ
paryāyadiṁ bare paścima tīrthakara samavasaraṇaṁ vipuḷagiriyoḷire
gautama svāmigaḷu śrēṇika mahārājanaṁ kuṟitu besasidoḍadanava
dhārisi sudharma śrutakēvaḷigaḷu, jambūnāma bhāvī kēvaḷigaḷge
pēḻdu triṣaṣṭilakṣaṇamahāpurāṇadoḷādipurāṇa kathānibandhamadaṟoḷu
kāḷakuḷadharāvatāramoḷu daśasāgarōpama kōṭākōṭi sthitiyappava
sarpiṇi kālaṁ, suṣamasuṣame, suṣama, suṣamaduṣṣame, duṣṣama
suṣame, duṣṣame, ati duṣṣameyendu ṣaḍvidhamakkuṁ.

mattamalli suṣamasuṣameyemba kālaṁ catussāgarōpama
kōṭākōṭi sthiti pravartisuvandā kāladoḷu bharata ṣaṭkhaṇḍadoḷage
madhyama khaṇḍadoḷage navasthitōttama bhōgabhūmiyādudandina
manuṣyartaruṇa divākaravarṇaruṁ, ṣaṭsahasra cāpōtsēdha śarīraruṁ,
tripalyōpamāyuṣyaruṁ, dinatrayakke badarīphaḷamātrāhāraruṁ,
vihārādi vigataruṁ, śubhalakṣaṇa nirmaḷaśarīraruṁ, apagata mānasā
gantuka śarīraduḥkharuṁ, pramudita bhōganiratarumāgi daśavidha kalpa

vr̥kṣaṅgaḷabhimata phaḷapradaṅgaḷāge sukhamirparalli, madyāṅgavembudu mada
vikāramanāgisade nānāvidha pānaviśēṣaṅgaḷanittu dampatige rāgamaṁ
puṭṭisuvudu, tūryāṅgavemmembudu, paṇava maddaḷa kāhaḷa bhēri śaṅkha
mr̥daṅgādi vividha tūryaviśēṣaṅgaḷanīvudu, bhūṣaṇāṅgavemmembudu,
kaṭaka kaṭisūtra kuṇḍaḷa kēyūra hāra nūpurādi puruṣayōgya
bhūṣaṇa viśēṣaṅgaḷanīvudu, jyōtirāṅgamembumudu, sakaḷa digmaṇḍaḷa
prakāśana paraṅgaḷumaṁ candrāditya kiraṇa pravēśāvakāśaṅgaḷumappa
jyōtirviśēṣaṅgaḷanuḷḷudu, gr̥hāṅgamembudu, yēkataḷa dvitaḷa
tritaḷa catusthaḷa saptataḷādi nānā sōpāna maṇimaya bhitti virājita
vividha gr̥ha viśēṣaṅgaḷanīvudu, bhōjasāṅnāṅgamembudu, tējōbaḷāyu
rārōgya tuṣṭi, puṣṭi, pratibhā prītipradāyigaḷappamr̥tānnaṅgaḷa
nīvudu, bhājanāṅgamembudu, kanatkanaka maṇi khacita vividha bhājana
viśēṣaṅgaḷanīvudu, dīpāṅgamembudu, nijabhavanābhyantara samasta
vastu prakāśana paraṅgaḷappa pradīpaviśēṣaṅgaḷanīvudu, mālyāṅga
membudu, jāti kētaki maruvaka prabhr̥ti sarvartuka dhāma viśē
ṣaṅgaḷanīvudu, vastrāṅgamembudu dēvāṅgādi vividha vastraṅgaḷanīvudu.
pesariṁ jyōti pradīpāsana vasana laasadbhūmbūṣaṇābhōjyaśōpyavādyāvasatha
sragbhōjanāṅga prakaṭatara daśāṅgāmarānōkahaṁ sandhisuguṁ tā
mēnasonnondaṁ bagedaravasē tandarthiyiṁvenyindendoḍenḍanendusirvaṁ pēḻiṇṇa
taddampatigaḷa paramāpāgaṇya satpuṇyadoḷpaṁ, tadanantaraṁ, vr̥kṣa vīrya
hāniyuṁ, manuṣyōtsādi hāniyumāge, suṣamumembemamembiraḍa
neya kālaṁ, trisāgarōpama kōṭākōṭi sthitiyiṁ pravarttisuvandā
kālada manuṣyaru cāmīkara nirmaḷa śarīraruṁ; catuḥsahasra cāpōtsē
dharuṁ, dvipalyōpamāyuṣyaruṁ, dinadvayuyadinakṣaphaḷamātrāhāraru
māgiyanavasthita madhyama bhōgabhūmi sthitiṁ negaḻi pūrvōkta krama
doḷu, vr̥kṣa vīrya śarīrōtsēdhāyurādi hāniyoḷu suṣama
duṣṣamamemba kālaṁ dvisāgarōpama kōṭākōṭi sthitiyiṁ pravarti
suvandākālada manuṣyaru priyaṅgu śyāmavarṇaruṁ, dvisahasra cāpō
tsēdharuṁ, palyōpamāyuṣyaruṁ, pratidinamāmaḷaka pramāṇāhāraru
māgintu navasthita jaghanya bhōgamī sthitiyoḷu pūrvōkta kramadoḷu
naḍeye, palyōpamāmaṣṭabhāgāvaśēṣaṁ tr̥tīya kālamādoḍe kalpa
taru prabhāparicyutiyoḷu āṣāḍha puṇṇameyaparāhṇadoḷu candrāditya

rkaḷu pūrvāparadoḷu jājvalyamānarkaḷāgi tōṟi bhōga bhūmija
radr̥ṣṭa pūrvāparamuṁ kaṇḍākuḷavyākuḷavyākuḷarāgirpuduṁ, ā
prastāvadoḷu, pratiśrutiyemboṁ prathamamu kuḷadharaṁ palyōpadasamarā
yuṣyanumaṣṭa sahitōttara sahasra cāpōtsēdhanumamuppātanārya
ranañjadirimivu candrādityarkkaḷembuvivaradeseyiṁyuṁ nimagonduṁ
bhayamilla, bharata kṣētradoḷallindittavīteravada niyōgamakkumendaṟipi,
tadanantara kramadoḷu tārakādarśanamāge sanmatiyemboṁeyemboseraḍaneya
kuḷadharaṁ triśatādhika sahasra cāpōtsēdhaṁ amama pramāṇa varṣā
yuṣyanumamuppātasivu tāragegaḷembuvivakkañjavēḍendaṟipi, tadanantaraṁ
kṣēmaṅkaranemboṁ mūṟaneya kuḷadharaṁ aṣṭaśata cāpaśarīrōtsēdhaṁ
r̥ṣika pramāṇa varṣāyuṣyanumamuppātaṁ munnakāla svabhāvadinupa
śāntaṅgaḷāgirda siṁha vyāghrādigaḷappa kōḷmr̥gaṅgaḷalli baḷiya
manuṣyaraṁ kaṇḍu garjanādigaḷinañjise nīmivaraṁ pariharisi bāḻvudeṁ
daṟipe, tadanantaraṁ kṣēmandharanemboṁ nālkaneya kuladharaṁ pañcasapta
tyuttaraśata cāpōtsēdhanuṁ, aṣṭapramāṇa saṁvatsarāyuṣyanumāgi
duṣṭa mr̥ganirākaraṇōpāyamanaṟipidātaniṁ baḷiyaṁ, sīmaṅkara
nemboṁanembonaydaneya kuladharaṁ pañcāśamuttara saptaśata cāpōtsēdhanuṁ,
kamaḷa pramāṇāyuṣyanumāgi vr̥kṣa sīmāvivādamambarisidātaniṁ
baḷiyaṁ sīmandharanemboṁānembosāṟaneya kuḷadharaṁ pañcaviṁśati uttara
saptaśata cāpōtsēdhanuṁ naḷina pramāṇamāyuṣyanumāgi sīmegaḷigā
ghāṭaśuddhiyuṁ māḍidātaniṁ baḷiyaṁ vimaḷavāhananemboṁ,yēḷaḻaneya
kuladharaṁ saptaśatacāpōtsēdhanuṁ padmapramāṇa varṣāyuṣyanumāgi
karituragārōhaṇōpāyamanaṟipidātaniṁ baḷiyaṁ cakṣuṣmanembo
neṇṭaneya kuladharaṁ pañcaśata saptatyuttara ṣaṭkr̥ṭśata cāpōtsēdhanuṁ
padmāṅga pramāṇa varṣāyuṣyanumāgi, strīpuruṣaṅgaḷu sutamukha
kamaḷadarśanākuḷitaṅgaḷādavaraṁ tiḷipidātaniṁ baḷiyuṁ yaśasviyemboṁ
pombattaneya kuladharaṁ pañcāśaduttara ṣaṭkr̥ṭśata cāpōtsēdhanuṁ
kumuda pramāṇa varṣāyuṣyanumādoḍātana kāladoḷu makkaḷge
pesariṭṭu yugaḷaṅgaḷu lōkāntaritarapparātaniṁ baḷiyuṁ abhicandra
nemboṁ pattaneya kuladharaṁ pañcaviṁśatyuttara ṣaṭkr̥ṭśata cāpōtsēdhanuṁ
kumudāṅgapramāṇāyuṣyanumādoḍātana kāladoḷu mithunaṁ
gaḷoḷu śiśugaḷge śaśi darśanādi krīḍanamuṁ tōṟi lōkāntaritarappa
rātaniṁ baḷiyuṁ candrābhanemboṁ pannondaneya kuladharaṁ ṣaṭkr̥ṭśata
cāpōtsēdhanuṁ niyuta pramāṇāyuṣyanumādoḍātana kāladoḷu

mithunaṅgaḷoḷu putrajanakke candradarśanādi krīḍana katipaya divasa
nibandhana sahajīvā nantara lōkāntaritarappātaniṁ baḷiyaṁ maruddēva
nemboṁ panneraḍaneya kuladharaṁ pañcasaptatyuttara pañcaśata cāpōtsē
dhanuṁ marutāṅga pramāṇa vatsarāyuṣyanumādanākāladoḷu putra
sahita cirakāla jīvanamuṁ apasamudra parvata samutpattiyuṁ madhura
salila jala vr̥ṣṭiyuṁ kutsita nadigaḷumādupuvātaniṁ baḷiyuṁyaṁ prasēna
jittemboṁ padimūṟaneya kuladharaṁ pañcāśatyuttara pañcaśata cāpō
tsēdhanuṁ, parva pramāṇāyuṣyanumāvanā kāladoḷu puṭṭi garbha
maḷa nirākaraṇamuṁ mūtra purīṣa dōṣāpanayanamumādudātana
magaṁ nābhirājanemboṁ padinālkaneya kuḷadharaṁ pañcaviṁśatyuttara
pañcaśata cāpōtsēdhanuṁ, pūrva kōṭivarṣa pramāṇāyuṣyanu
mādoḍātana kāladoḷu śiśugaḷge nābhi nikartanamādoḍātana kāla
doḷu niravaśēṣa kalpataru vīryahāniyoḷu pērmaḷekoḷe jaḷavasu
matīpavanātapa gaganagōcaramappa kēvana adānata viharaṇāśra ava
gāhana sannidhāna janitōpakāraṇadiṁ beḷadeṟagida śāḷi gōdhūmādi sasya
sampattiyuṁ gajakumbhamaṇḍaḷa nirvartita mr̥śāyuya sthāḷika kaḷaśa
diśōdhikāraṁ janakaranarkāḷiḷa bījakādi bhājanaṅgaḷupacajana bhōjanēkṣu
rasa grahaṇōpāyamuṁ nābhirājanindāduvī pēḻda padinālvaruṁ
manugaḷuṁ vidēhaṅgaḷoḷu śubha pariṇāmasahitaṁ dānādi kuśalavidhi
bandhamanuṣyāyuṣyaru parigrahīta samyagdarśana prakaṭīkr̥ta kṣāyika
samyagdr̥ṣṭigaḷumāgi bandīkṣētradoḷpuṭṭi samadhigata jātismaraṇadi
nīteṟiṟada yōgagaḷanupadēśaṅgeydaru.

vr̥ṣabhanāthaṁ kuladharanuṁ tīrthakaranumāvaṁdaṁ, bharatēśvaranu
kuladharanuṁ cakravartiyumādanākāladoḷā manuṣyaraparādhaṅgeyye
munnamayvvayvarmanuṅgaḷu hākāralakṣaṇamappa daṇḍamaṁ māḍidaru,
baḷiyumayvvayvarmanuṅgaḷu hāmākāradaṇḍamaṁmuṁ māḍidaru, matta
mayvvayvarmanuṅgaḷu hāmādhikkāra daṇḍamaṁmuṁ māḍidaru, bharataṁ śarīra
daṇḍamaṁmuṁ māḍidaṁ, hādaṇḍamayvvayvariṁ hāmādaṇḍa mattayvvayvariṁ,
hāmādigbhēdaṁ kuladhararayvvayvarinādudu tanudaṇḍamāvāytu bharatē
śvaraniṁ.

intu kāḷāvatāramuṁ, ṣōḍaśakuladharāvatāramuṁ, prathamānu
yōgada pīṭhikeyoḷabhivarṇisi purāṇakathegaḷoḷu, lōkākhyānamuṁ,
dēśākhyānamuṁ,nagarākhyānamuṁ,rājākhyānamuṁ, tīrthākhyānamuṁ,
tapōdhanākhyānamuṁ,gatyākhyānamuṁ,phalākhyānamumembavaṣṭavidhavarṇana
makkuṁ. alli lōkākhyānamembudanantānantamappākāśa bahumadhya
pradēśadoḷu saṅkhyātātma pradēśātmakamāgi vāyutrayavēṣṭitamu
madhastiryagūrdhvabhēda bhinnamaṁ jīvādi padārthāvaḷōkana karaṇa
dhātabhūtamumakr̥trimumanādi nidhanamuṁ dvisaptarajjūtsēdhamuṁ,
saptaika pañcaika rajjūjju vistāramumāgi pr̥thvīsamūhaikāntaḷita
saṅkhyāta dvīpasamudrasaritsarōvara kuṇajaḷa siddhālaya vimānādi
gaḷādhārabhūtamappudaṁ pēḻvudu; dēśākhyānamembudu, viṣaya
vyāvarṇanamāviṣayaṅgaḷavāvuvenmendoḍe kaccheyuṁ, sukaccheyuṁ,
mahākaccheyaṁ,āvarteyuṁ, āmaṇḍaḷāvarteyuṁ,puṣkaḷeyuṁ, puṣka
ḷāvatiyuṁ, embī eṇṭu pūrva vidēhada sītānadiya baḍagaṇa taḍi
yavu; vatseyuṁ, suvatseyuṁ, mahāvatseyuṁ vatsāvatiyuṁ,
ramyeyuṁ, ramyimyakeyuṁ, ramaṇīyeyuṁ, maṅgaḷāvatiyumembī
yeṇṭuṁ teṅkaṇataḍiyavu; padmeyuṁ, supadmeyuṁ, padmāvatiyuṁ,
saṅkhyeyuṁ, naḷineyuṁ, kumudeyuṁ, sarideyumembīyeṇṭumu
paravidēhada sītānadiya teṅkaṇataḍiyavu; vapreyuṁ, suvapreyuṁ,
mahāvapreyuṁ, vaprakāvatiyuṁ, gandheyuṁ, sugandheyuṁ, gandhiḷe
yuṁ, gandhamāḷiniyuṁ, yembīyeṇṭuṁ baḍagaṇa taḍiyavintu prada
kṣiṇamāgeṇisida viṣayamuṁ vyāvarṇisuvudu,nagarākhyānamembudu; nagara
vyāvarṇanamānagaraṅgaḷāvuvendapaḍe, hēmapuriyuṁ, mariṣṭeyuṁ,
mariṣṭapuriyuṁ, khaḷgeyuṁ, mañjūṣeyuṁ, dipadiyuṁ, puṇḍarī
kiṇiyumembīyeṇṭuṁ,sītānadiya baḍagaṇataḍiyaviṣayaṅgaḷa rājadhāni
gaḷu; sīmeyuṁ, maṇḍaḷeyuṁ, parājiteyuṁ, prabhākariyuṁ, padmā
vatiyuṁ, śōbheyuṁ, ratnasañcayamembīyeṇṭuṁ teṅkaṇataḍiya
viṣayaṅgaḷa rājadhānigaḷu; aśvapuriyuṁ, siṁhapuriyuṁ, mahā
puriyuṁ, vijayapuriyuṁ, araleyuṁ, viraleyuṁ, aśōkeyuṁ,
vītaśōkeyuṁ embīyeṇṭuṁ sītānadiyu teṅkaṇataḍiya viṣayaṅgaḷa
rājadhānigaḷu; vijayeyuṁ, vaijayanteyuṁ, jayanteyuṁ,
aparājiteyuṁ, candrapuriyuṁ, khaḷgapuriyuṁ, mayō
dhyedheyuṁ, mavadhyeyumembīyeṇṭuṁ, baḍagaṇa taḍiya viṣayaṁ
gaḷa rājadhānigaḷu; vividha nagaraṅgaḷaṁ vyāvarṇisuvudu; rājā

khyānamembudu, tatpatiyapparasana vaṁśa vīrya vibhavaṅgaḷaṁ
pēḻvudu; tīrthākhyānamembudu duritavināśakāṅkṣekāṅkṣaigaḷuṁ, saṁsāra
samudravanīsalendu jinapatimukhakamalavinirgata dharmasantatiyaṁ praka
ṭīkaraṇaṅgeyvudu; tapōdhanākhyānavembudu jinatīrthadoḷu puṭṭida
purāṇapuruṣara tapada meyviḍiyvaḻivakke śrāvaka niyōgaṅgaḷa meyviḍiyvaḻidakke
āanupūrva tatrānupūrvaṅgaḷiṁḷaṁ saddharmakathanaṁ geyvudu; gatyākhyāna
membudu triṣaṣṭiśalākā puruṣakr̥ta dharma sambandha janita sukhādi
manubhavakāraṇaṅgaḷappa gativikalpaṅgaḷaṁ pēḻvudu; phalākhyāna
membudu ā triṣaṣṭiśalākāpuruṣara puṇyakarma paripākadoḷpuṭṭida
bhyudaya sukhamanakke karma kṣayadoḷu puṭṭida niśrēyasa sukhamuma
nakke pēḻvudu; yintu mahāpurāṇada pīṭhikā mukhamanabhivarṇisi
kathāvatāradoḷu jambūdrumōpalakṣita jambūdvīpamuṁ; apara
vidēhada sītānadiya baḍagaṇataḍiyoḷu sītōdaya nīḷagiriya
ūrmimāḷiḷa vibhaṅga nadiya naḍuvaṇa gandhiḷa viṣayada vijayārdha
parvataduttaraśrēṇiyaḷakāpuramembapoḻaḻilanāḷvanatibalanemboṁ, vidyā
dhara rājasātana mahādēvi manōhariyembaḷavara magaṁ mahā
baḷanemboṁ ātaṅge yuvarājapadaviyaṁ koṭṭondu divasaṁ tanna
kenneya nareyaṁ kaṇḍaduve nirvēgarāgi mahābalaṅge rājyamaṁ ko
ṭṭatibalaṁ sāvirarasu makkaḷumaynūrvararasiyaruṁ berasu guṇadhara
kēvaligaḷa pādamūladoḷu tapamuṁ kaikoṇḍanitta mahābalanuṁ
svayambuddha, mahāmati, sambhinna, śatamatigaḷemba nālvaru mantrigaḷa
meyyoḷu rājyabhāramaṁniṟisi niścintamirdondu divasaṁ, tanna
varṣavardhana dinadomoḷu mahāsanāsīnanōlagaṅgoṭṭirpudumāpra
stāvadoḷu saddharmōpadēśa labdhāvasaraṁ svayambuddha varanintenda
ninna vidyādhara sāmrājya puṇya janitamideyuṁ cakra śakrādi
lakṣitaṅgaḷellaṁ puṇyaprabhāvadindakkumene, lōkāyatika matānusāri
mahāmati jīvanilladāśrayamappa puṇya pāpaṅgaḷumilladaṟiṁ
sattaṁ puṭṭaṁ koṭṭaṁ keṭṭanendu nuḍiva tadanantaraṁ vijñānavādamanā
śrayisi śatamatiyuṁ, tantamma matada kuhētu dr̥ṣṭāntaṅgaḷinda
mintu mūvaruṁ, jīvābhāvamane samarthisidoḍavara nuḍiyanavadhārisi
svayambuddhaṁ jīvamillembirappaḍenalsattu kaleverasu puṭṭuvu
dumaṁ bhavamaṟidu puṭṭidaru munnina baykegaḷaṁ tōṟuvudumavaṁ

dēvagatiyoḷupuṭṭi hantukāmu, ratikāmu, balikāmigaḷu tantamma
baykeyaṁ tīrcuvudumaṁ kāṇalādapuvendivu modalāgoḍeya
peṟavuṁ hētu dr̥ṣṭāntaṅgaḷinavaraṁ niruttaraṁmāḍi mattaṁ sabheyaṁ
sabhāpatiyumaṁ tiḷipuva bageyiṁ śrutānubhūtadr̥ṣṭa kathegaḷaṁ tada
nvaya sambandhigaḷanintendu pēḻdaṁ. dēva ninna santatiyoḷaravinda
nembonambaracaraṁ, tanaga vijayeyuyembaḷgaṁ puṭṭida haricandra kuru
vindaremba makkaḷuverasu rājyaṅgeyvudu bahvārambha raudradhyānadi
nupārjita narakāyuṣyanāsanna mr̥tyuvāgi dāhajvara pāmāriyaḷaru
vantaḷute, candanadravādi sītaḷakriyeyiṁ santāpamanentu pāṟimāṇisa
lāṟade puṇyakṣayadoḷu tanna vidyegaḷu besakeyyadiydire haricandranaṁ
karedu dussahāvastheyanaṟipi nīnennaṁ ninna vidyeyinuttara
kuruvamaneydisalalliya taṇṇaneṇṇeḷaloḷttaḷtadīya santāpamanāṟisuve
nendu pēḻdoḍātanuṁ tanna gaganagāminī vidyeyaṁ besasidaḍadu
narakagamanābhimukhanāgirdaravindaṅgupakāraṅgeyvudemaga śa kya me ne,
vidyāvacanadiṁ tammayyana sāvumaṁ durgatigamumanamumanaṟidu viṣaṇṇa
manudāsīnasānāgirdanannegaṁ gr̥hakō(kā)kiḷaṅgaḷondondaṁ kāditine
panitaśrōṇita bindugaḷu tannameyge pāpa paripākadiṁ taṇpaṁ paḍeye
paramauṣadhamaṁ paḍevedevendu karaposaradindaṁ kuruvindanaṁ karedu
tvatpanna vibhaṅga mr̥gaṅgaḷikkeyanaṟidu niṣkarujaṇanavaṟuṟaruṇajaḷadoḷenage
krīḍā sarōvaramaṁ māḍendu pēṟiḻi nistriṁśa karmakke kokkarisi
pāpa bhīruvāgiyuṁ tandeyuparōdhadiṁ manamallava manamoḷātana
pēḻda mr̥gadikkeyaneydiyde guṇadhararemba divyajñānigaḷanallirdaraṁ kaṇḍu
nivēdita nijajanaka vr̥ttāntamanavara vacanadiṁ tammayyana sāvumaṁ
narakakke pōpudumanaṟidu karuṇadinadaṁ māḍave raktamuṁ pōlvalā
kṣādravadoḷu boddaṇa bāviyaṁ tīvidoḍadaṟoḷōlāḍi mukkuḷisi
nōḍi kr̥taka rudhiramappudanaṟididavanennaṁ bañcisidanendu surigegittu
daḍadaḍisuttamiṟiyalu parivāpātaṁ bhāviya sōpānamanadaḍaruttaṁ
jāṟuvariduradoḷnaṭṭa surige bennoḷmroḷmūḍi sattu narakakkiḷiḷavanīgaḷu
vīīpurada janaṅgaḷu pēṟiḻi viditamidu tacchrutkr̥tantaṁ,mattamītana vaṁśadoḷu
daṇḍakanembonātanarasi saundariyemboḷavargemagaṁ maṇimāḷi
yembonāgi daṇḍakaṁ palavukālamarasugeydnyāydanyāyamodoḷu dravya
maṁ percise.pūṇdu baytiyttilubdhaṁ sattu tanna bhaṇḍāradoḷajagaranāgi

puṭṭi tanna munnina vastugaḷumaṁ maga maṇimāḷiyumaṁ kaṇḍu
jātismaranāgi magananalladuḷidarārumaṁ sāralīyadī bhaṇḍāramaṁ kādu
koṇḍippinamondu divasaṁ maṇimāḷi raticāraṇarembavadhi jñānigaḷa
najagara vr̥ttāntamaṁ besagoṇḍu tammayyanendaṟidu kelakke tandiṁ
tendanīnati lōbhadoḷārtadhyānadoḷu sattu tirikayōniyoḷpuṭṭi
namevadappepinnappaḍemēnenda dharmamaṁ kaikoḷḷeḷvanaloḍamaṟidu
toradu sattu svargadoḷu dēvanāgi puṭṭi tanna magaṅgeydupakāramaṁ
nenedu bandu maganaṁ pūjisi mēlappa maṇihāramaṁ koṭṭoḍade kula
dhanamāge nīnīgaḷu tokoṭṭirpperpai ivadanubhūtaṁ,avapalladeyuṁ nimma pitr̥
pitāmahaṁ sahasrabalaḷanemboṁ khēcara śrīyunanubhavisuttirdomme ghana
maya jaladharaniḷayayu nirīkṣaṇadiṁ viṣayaviraktanāgi tanna magaṁ
śatabalaṅge rājyamanittu mudurdhara tapadinaṇagāra kēvaḷiyāgi mōkṣakke
sandanā śatabalanuṁ ninna tandeyappatibalaṅge rājyamaṁmuṁ koṭṭu tapaṁ
baṭṭanaśanāvamōdaryādyācaraṇadiṁ kālāntyamodoḷu sanyasana vidhānadiṁ
muḍipi mahēndrakalpadoḷsaptasāgarōpama pramitanaṇimādyaṣṭa
guṇaiśvaryōpētaṁ dēvanāge kumāra kāladandu nīmumāmuṁ
krīḍā nimittadiṁ pōgi mandaravanandanavanadoḷu vanakrīḍeyāḍutta
mirpinamalliyakr̥trima caityālayamaṁ bandisalā mahēndrakalpadiṁ
bandu jina pūjeyaṁyuṁ māḍi poramaḍutaṁ ninnaṁ kaṇḍakkartu parasi
tarkaisikoṇḍu nīnemma mammane yēṁ nijavr̥ttāntamaṁ jinadharmame
svargāpavargamumudaṁmaṁ maṟiyadirimemvembudumanaṟipidanalladeyuṁ
nimmappaṁ ninage rājyamaṁ koṭṭu tanna makkaḷu mommakkaḷu peṟaru
marasu makkaḷverasu tapamaṁmuṁ kaikoṇḍu śukladhyānadiṁ ghātikṣayaṁ
geydu kēvaḷiyāge, dēvanikāyamoḍane nāmellamarcisi bandevidu
dr̥ṣṭamendintu śrutānubhūta dr̥ṣṭakathegaḷaṁ tōṟi jīva siddhigeykeyya
katheyaṁ sabhāpatiyuṁ tiḷidu jinadharmame dharmamendu vijaya
patramaṁ svayambuddhaṅge koṭṭu satkāra pūrvakaṁ tuṣṭidānaṅgoṭṭuṭṭā
tane tanagāptanāge mahābalaṁ mūvattāṟu lakke pūrvarājyaṅgeyyu
ttire, mattondu divasamā svayambuddhaṁ mandaradakr̥trima caityā
layaṅgaḷaṁ bandisi saumanasavanada pūrva digbhāgada jina bhavanada
maṇḍapadoḷirpannegamallige pūrvavidēhada sītānadiya baḍagaṇataḍiya

mahākaccha viṣayadariṣṭapurada yugandhatīrthakara samavasaraṇadiṁ
gaganacāraṇarādityagatigaḷu mariñjayarumembavadhijñādigaḷu bare bhakti
pūrvakamidirgoṇḍu bandisi bratamanēṟisikoṇḍu dharmaśravaṇānaṁ
taramādityagatigaḷgantendu binnapaṅgeyduyda nemmarasaṅgāsentu dharma
śravaṇaṅgeydoḍaṁ bhōgaṅgaḷge vimukhanāganātanabhavyanō bhavyanō
dūrabhavyanō nimmaḍigaḷu tiḷiya besasimendoḍavarintendarātana
bhavyanallaṁ bhavyane bhavyasāgiyumāsannabhavyanaventene, jambūdvīpada
paravidēhada gandhiḷa viṣayada siṁhapuramanāḷva śrīṣēṇaṅgamātanarasi
sundarigaṁ, jayavarmanu śrīvarmanumemba taneyarāge kiriyātane
parivārakkamarasaṅgaṁ,maganāgi beḷeye śrīṣēṇaṁ piriya magaṁ yōgya
nallendu kiriya magaṁ śrīvarmaṅge rājyamaṁ koṭṭu tapakke pōda
nitta jayavarmaṁ kramakke puṭṭidātanirdante tammaṅge rājyamaṁ
koṭṭanībhavadoḷu paḍeyadoḍēmanya bhavadoḷappaḍaṁ rājyamaṁ paḍeve
nendu svayamprabha gurugaḷa baḷisāri dīkṣeyaṁ koṇḍu paṟidu
bisuṭa kuntaḷaṅgaḷaṁ puttinoḷage maḍagalendu kayyaṁ kutti modoḍallirda
kāḷiga nāgaṁ kaiyuṁ koṇḍaḍā prasthāvadoḷu mahīdharanemba vidyā
dharaṁ piridu vibhūtiyiṁvapumyindamambaradoḷu pōpudaṁ kaṇḍenna tapada phala
muṇṭappaḍe vidyādharanappenakkendu sattatibaḷaṅge mahābalanāgi puṭṭi
munnina bhavadoḷu bayasi paḍevada vidyādharaśrīyaninnegaṁ bisuḍadirda
ḍamēnāmududindu kanasinoḷu tannamūvaruṁ pergaḍegaḷaḍasi kaṭṭikoṟgaṟiga
saṟa bāviyoḷagaddē nīṁ bandurddanīmbanduba baggisi kanakapīṭhadoḷirisi mivisisuvudu
maṁ kaṇḍaśubha svapnadarśanakke kokkarisi ninna baravane pāruttamirda
nātaṅgemonde tiṅgaṇāḷāyuṣyamātaniṁ munnaṁ nīnī kanasugaḷaṁ
pēḻuṟu, pēḻiṟiloḍaṁ ninna mātane kaikoṇḍu nīnōsise nōntu mahā
balaṁ lalitāṅgaṁ,vajrajaṅghaṁ,āryaṁ, śrīdharaṁ, suvīdi,accutēndra,
vajranābhimahamindrasāgi bharatadoḷiḷannādidēvanappeṁppoṁ nīnu mūṟa
neya bhavadoḷu karmakṣayaṅgeyveyvayembuduṁ svayambuddhaṁ cāraṇa
yugalamaṁ bandisi bandu mahābalanaṁ kaṇḍu tanna kaṇḍa kanasuga
ḷellamaṁ saprapañcamaṟipi mattaṁ divya jñānigaḷu ninagondu tiṅgaṇāḷā
yuṣyamendu pēḻdaṟinnaṟidumāṇalāgadembudumante geyva
nendu nijagr̥hōdyānada jinagr̥hadoḷu mahāmahamemba mahāmahi

yiṁ yeṇṭu divasaṁ mahābaḷaṁ māḍi parijanamellamaṁ barisi tanna
maganatibaḷaṅge rājyamaṁ koṭṭu siddha kūṭakke pōgi triḥpradakṣiṇaṅgeydu
dēvaraṁ pūjisi vacanāgrahaṇa samētamārādhaneyinnarjisi vīrasaṁsthā
rūḍhanāgi svayambuddha niryāpakācāryanāgi pañcaguru samakṣa
modoḷu bāhyābhyantara parigraha tyāga puraḥsaraṁ mahābalanaṁ jātarūpa
dharanaṁ māḍi caturvidhāhāra śarīrapratyākhyānamaṁ koṭṭu tānuṁ
dīkṣeyaṁ kaikoḷe mahābalaṁ prāyōpagamanadinippatteraḍu divasaṁ
nōntu īśāna kalpada śrīprabha vimānadoḷondu sāgarōpamāyuṣya
mosoḍeyanuṁ saptahastōcchrēccrēdhanuṁ, pañcadaśadinakr̥ta samucchvāsanuṁ,
sahasravarṣa kr̥ta mānasāhāranuṁsuṁ, samprāptabhava pratyayāvadhijñāna
nuṁ, aṇimādyaṣṭa guṇaiśvaryōpētanuṁ, niṣṭapta kanakavarṇanumappa
lalitāṅganemba dēvanāgi puṭṭi, svayamprabhe, kanakaprabhe, kanakalate,
vidyudyarllateyemba nālvarmahādēviyaroḷaṁ nālsāsirvarmr̥sōrmsōnayana
vallabheyaroḷanubhavisi svayamprabhādēviyayupparlambaruṁ kaṟiḻiye tana
gaydu paḷitōpamāyuṣyamuṇṭimuṇṭene mattōrva svayamprabhādēviyuṁ
tānumaccutēndrana pūjeyiṁ svarga sukhamumananubhavisi jīvitānta
moḷsāmānika dēva pratibōdhitaṁ padinaydu divasaṁ tribhuvana jina
bhavanakr̥ta pūjāvidhānamaccutakalpada jinagr̥ha caityavr̥kṣa mūladoḷu
mukuḷīkr̥ta karakamaḷanāgi pañcanamaskāramanuccarisuttamadr̥śyanāgi
bandu jambūdvīpada pūrvavidēhada sītānadiya baḍagaṇa taḍiya puṣka
ḷāvati viṣayadutpaḷakhēṭamanāḷva vajrabāhugaṁ vasundharā dēvigaṁ,
vajrajaṅghanemboṁ maganāgi puṭṭi baḷedu tanna munnina bhavada svayaṁ
prabheyaṁ neneyuttirpinamāsvayamprabhādēviyuṁ jīvitāntyamoḷu
aāṟudiṅgaḷvaraṁ jinapūjeyaṁmāḍi mērugiriya saumanasavanada pūrva
digbhāgada caityavr̥kṣamodoḷu pañcanamaskāramanuccarisutaṁ prāṇaviyōga
māgebandāviṣayamodoḷu puṇḍarīkiṇī nagaramanāḷva vajradantaṅgaṁ lakṣmī
matigaṁ śrīmatiyemba magaṇāḷāgi puṭṭidaḷu. paṇḍiteyemba dādiyōdise
baḷedu yauvana prasthāstāvadoḷu tanna māḍadoḷu pavaḍisi beḷagappa jāva
doḷāṇāpoḻaḻila bahirudyānadoḷirda yaśōdhara gurugaḷa kēvalajñānō
tpattiyosagege bappadēvanikāyamaṅkaṇḍu tanna munnina bhavada lalitāṅga
dēvanaṁ nenedu mūrchevōge vajradantanuṁ, lakṣmīmatiyuṁ bandu

mūrcheyindeccaṟisi besagoḷe manambogade maunavrata pratijñeyuyi
nire paṇḍiteyaṁ nīnīkeyaṁ ninna ballandadoḷbesagoḷḷendu pōdaranne
gamātana gurugaḷappa yaśośōdhara gurugaḷige kēvalajñānamumāyudhā
gāradoḷ cakraratnamuṁ puṭṭideraḍosageyoḷu mukhyamappa kēvaḷiḷa
pūjeyaṁ viśōdhiyiṁ māḍidoḍavadhijñānaṁ puṭṭibandu cakra
pūjeyaṁ māḍi digvijayakke pōdanannegamitta paṇḍite śrīmatiyana
śōkavanamoḷtanna ollandamoḷoḍambaḍisi besagoḷe nija vr̥ttāntamella
maṁ pēḻaḻiltaguḷduḷddu ā nī bhavakke mūṟaneya bhavadoḷu dhātakīṣaṇpaṇḍada
mūḍaṇa mandaradapara vidēhada sītānadiyu baḍagaṇa taḍiyu gandhiḷa viṣa
yada pāṭaḷī grāmadoḷu nāgadattanemba paradanātana paradi sumatigaṁ
nanda nandimitra nandiṣēṇaṁ varasēnaṁ jayasēnanembayvartanayuya
rinda madanakāntiyuṁ śrīkānteyumemba tanūjeyarindaṁ kaḍeya
garbhamoṇāṁḷāṁ nelasaloḍamennadondadompaśubhakarmōdayadinennoḍahuṭṭaṭṭi
daruṁ tandeyuṅkaḷedoḍarasaradeseyiṁ mane kavatterttupōge pepēṟarakīliḻi
laṁsārdemmabbeyuṁ muttabbeyuṁ badagujegeydu irur̥tirpinaṁ āṁ puṭṭa
loḍamenna meyya durgandhakke pēsi kaṇḍarellamoṟimeḻidu kaḷeye, parētava
nadoḷennaṁ bambaṟaṇṇaṅṟibyaṅgaḷoḷu pudidirisitāṁ irvaruṁ tiridu tandikki
deñjalumaguḷumaṁ timpu betindupesarumillade nirnāmikeyindāgi baḷeva
nnegamavarirvarumenna mogadoḷniḷḷillade pōdaḍānuṁ cānuñjāraṇa caritamemba
parvatada mēle pihitāsravarembavadhi jñānigaḷaṁ kaṇḍaṟivillavedeyuṁ mana
dedēṟakadiṁ poḍavaṭṭinna geyduyda pāpamēnendu besagoṇḍoḍavarintendar.

ī viṣayada phaḷāḷa parvata grāmadoḷu dēvipilanemba gāvuṇḍagaṁ
sudatiyambā gāvuṇḍigaṁ dhanaśrīyemba magaḷāgi nīnāḍuveḍeyoḷu
samādhigupta yatipatigaḷadhyayanaṁ ninaganiṣṭamādoḍaṁḍavaṁ māṇisalendu
nāyuyapaḍukeyanikkidoḍavarinna pāpōpacayamanaṟidu baggisidoḍe
nīṁ becci bēgamapudaneḻiṟidu kaḷedaṟiyade geydenendaydembavara kālgeṟagida
paścāttāpadindaṁ manuṣyagatiyuṁ paḍede munnina geyduyda pāpada phaladi
ninitu duḥkhamanuṇḍevīnīninnappoḍaṁ jina dharmaṁ kaikoḷvudendoḍa
varu besasidandadoḷe śrāvakavratamaṁ kaikoṇḍu ṣōḍaśa kāraṇaṅgaḷu
maṁ pañcamahākalyāṇaṅgaḷumaṁ aṣṭamahāprātihāryamumaṁ,
catustriṁśapadatiśayumanuddēśaṁ geydu aṟuvattuttamūṟu divasaṁ nōmpa

jinaguṇa sampattiyusippatteṇṭu teṟada matijñānamumaṁ pannondu
teṟadaṅgamumaṁ panneraḍu teṟada parikarmamumanebbaṇbatteṇṭu teṟada
sūtramumanonduteṟada prathamānu yōgamumaṁ padinālkuteṟada
pūrvamumanayduteṟada cūḷikeyumaṁma nāṟuteṟadavadhijñānamuma
neraḍuteḻteṟada manaḥ paryayajñānamumanondu teṟada kēvalajñāna
mumanuddēśisi nūrayvatteṇṭu divasaṁ nōntu śrutajñānamumaṁ
yathā vidhiyaṁ nōntāyuṣyavasāna kāladoḷīśānakalpadoḷu śrī
prabhavimānadoḷu lalitāṅgadēvaṅgedēviyeṁ svayamprabheyenāgi
pūrvōpakāramaṁ bagedu pihitāśravagurugaḷa sānumātanu pōgi
pūjisi suralōkasukhamananubhavisi lalitāṅgadēvaṁ dēvalōkadiṁ
bandu elli puṭṭaṭṭuvanembanendaṟiyeṁ ānumātana viyōgadoḷaṟudiṁ
geydaraṁ jinamahimeyaṁ māḍi bandilli puṭṭa dēvā gamanamaṁ
kaṇḍu jātismareyenāgi lalitāṅgadēvanaṁ nenedu mūrchege sandenī
bhavadoḷātane gaṇḍanalladandinte kālamaṁ kaḷevenene paṇḍite ninna
nallananellirpoḍaṁ pokkaṟaṟisi tappenendākeyu bareda paṭamaṁ koṇḍalliya
baredavavinnāṇaṅgaḷaṁ besagoṇḍu pōgi nagara madhyasthita mahāpūta
jinālayada kelada paṭṭasāleya munde nēlisi kāryasiddhiyaṁ pāru
tirdaḷ.

annegamitta vajradanta cakravarti dikcakramaṁ bāykēḷiykeḷasi bandu
poḻaṟalaṁ pokku magaḷge baḻiyanaṭṭi nī nirvēgaṁ baḍadirnāḷe nāḷadu
nijapriyayu samāgamanamakkumadentendoḍe yaśōdhara gurugaḷoḷ
ppadhika bhaktiyinyundenage puṭṭaṭṭidavadhijñānadoḷenna ninna ninna, kāntana
janmāntaramanaṟidenendintendu pēḻalpaḻtaguḷdaṁ ānībhavakkaydaneya
bhavadoḷu puṇḍarīkiṇiyoḷardha cakravarti vāsudēvaṅge candrakīrti
yemba maganāgi jayakīrtiyemba keḷeyanumānumoḍavēḷaveḷedu gr̥hī
tāṇu bratadeve muṁ gr̥hastha dharmadoḷirvaruṁ negaḻdu jīvitāntyadoḷu
prītivardhanōdyānavanadoḷu candrasēnācāryara pakkade sanyasanaṁ
geydu samādhivaḍadu muḍipi mahēndrakalpadoḷsaptasāgarapramita
jīvitanaṁ dēvanāgi puṭṭaṭṭideṁ,jayakīrtiyumākalpadoḷennasamānanāgi
puṭṭaṭṭidoṁ, antirvarumamaralōka sukhamananubhavisi bandu puṣkaravara

dvīpada mūḍaṇa mandarada pūrvavidēhada maṅgaṇāvatī viṣayada ratna
sañcaya puramanāḷvaṁ śrīdharanarasiyarappa manōhari manōramegaṁ
śrīvarmanuṁ vibhīṣaṇanumemba pesaroḷu baladēva vāsudēvarenisi
baḷeye madīya janakanemmīrvarumanadhirāja yuvarāja padavi
yoḷirisi sudharma gurugaḷa pakkade tapamaṁ kaikoṇḍu karmaṁ
gaḷaṁ kiḍisi kr̥tārthanādonenna tāyi manōharigaṁ ennoḷappa
mōhaṅkāraṇamāgi sakala śrāvaka vratamaṁ kaikoṇḍu nūranālvattu
divasadiṁ neṟeva karmakṣapaṇamemba nōmpiyaṁyuṁnōntu jīvitānta
domoḷīśānakalpada śrīprabhavimānadoḷu lalitāṅgadēvanādoṁ,
annegamennanujanappa vibhīṣaṇana vipattinoḷu paṟivisuttirdenna śōkamaṁ
munnina bhavada jananiyappa lalitāṅgadēvaṁ vibhīṣaṇana rūpadiṁ bandu
baḻiyaṁyuṁ dēvarūpadinennaṁ pratibōdhise vibhīṣaṇasutaṅge rājyamaṁ
koṭṭu śrīvarmaṁ yugandhara tīrthaṅkarara pakkade pattusāsirarasu makka
ḷoḍane jinarūpamaṁ kaikoṇḍu sarvatōbhadra siṁha vikrīḍitamemba
tapamoḷnegaḻduḷgeydu samadhigatamatiśrutāvadhijñānanēṁ sanyāsanavidhi
yindamacyutakalpadoḷippatteraḍu sā ga rō pa mā yu ṣya ma no ḍe ya
nacyutēndranāgi jananī cara naranappa lalitāṅga dēvanindaminitondā
mududendu bandu lalitāṅgadēvanaṁ pūjisi prativardhana vimānamamu
nēṟisikoṇḍoydenna kalpadoḷaggaḷamappa divyāmbarādigaḷaṁ mannisi
denādivijanumēkasāgarōpamamu jīvitāntadoḷījambūdvīpava pūrva
vidēhada sītānadiya teṅkaṇataḍiya maṅgaṇapaṇāvatī viṣayava vijayārdha
parvataduttara śrēṇiya gāndharvapuravanāḷva vidyādhararājaṁ vāsavaṅgaṁ
prabhāvati embaṇātana piriyarasigaṁ mahīdharanemba tanūjasānāge vāsavaṁ
mahīdharaṅge vidyādhara śrīyaṁ koṭṭariñjayamunipatigaḷa pakkade
muktāvaḷī tapamaṁ kaikoṇḍu gellaṅgoṇḍaṁ, prabhāvatiyuṁ padmā
vatiyumembakantiyarasārete ratnāvaḷi tapadoḷnegaḻduḷgeydu acyutakalpadoḷu
pratīndranādodōnitta mahīdharanumorme puṣkalārdhada paḍuvaṇa
mandarada pūrva vidēhadava sītānadiya teṅkaṇa taḍiya vatsakāvatī
viṣayada prabhaṅkarīpuramanāpaḍuvaṇadeseya dēvadāruvanadoḷu
vinayandharayōgigaḷa parinirvāṇa pūjeyaṁ māḍi mērugiriya
nandanavanada pūrvadigbhāgadakr̥trima caijaityālayadoḷu vandanābhakti

yinire mahīdharananānalli kāṇaloḍamaṟidele viyaccara nīṁ lali
tāṅgadēvanappandu mātr̥caranendu pūjisideṁ nānacyutēndraṁ
nīnenitu viṣayāsaktanādappeyenaloḍaṁ mahīkampanemba nijananda
naṅge rājyamaṅkoṭṭu jagannandana gurugaḷalli śiṣyatvamaṁ pūṇdu
kanakāvaḷī tapadoḷnegaḻduḷgeydu muḍipi prāṇatēndranāgi suralōkada
sukhamanippattu sāgarōpamummambaramuṇḍu bandu dhātakīṣaṇḍada
mūḍaṇa manthamandharadaparavidēhada sītānadiya baḍagaṇa taḍiya gandhiḷa
viṣayapadayōdhyeyanāḷva jayavarmaṅgaṁ suprabhegaṁ ariñjayanemboṁ
maganādoḍātaṅge dharābhāramaṁ koṭṭu abhinandanaraṁ sārvajādārcāmla
vardhana tapadiṁ negaḻdu jayavarmaṁ paramapadamaneydaydidoṁ, suprabhe
yuṁ sudarśaneyaremba kantiyara sāre ratnāvaḷiyaṁ nōntacyuta
kalpadoḷanuddhata vimānadoḷdēvanāgi puṭṭaṭṭidoḷliḷalli ariñjayanuṁ
ṣōḍaśa varuṣa vayasadoḷu cakravarti padaviyaneydaydidaṁ baḻiyaṁyuṁ
ariñjayaṁ jinamahimeyaṁ māḍi pihita pāpāśravadvāranādudaṟinde pi
hitāsravanemba pesaraṁ paḍedu rājyaṅgeyyuttire, mattamānorme kaṇḍā
tanaṁ pracōdise paricchēdiyāgi sāsirvararasugaḷberasu mandarasthavira
munipatigaḷa pakkade mōkṣamārgamaṁ kaikoṇḍavadhijñāna gaganacāraṇa
r̥ddhi sampannaraynūrvarambaracāraṇaroḍane vihārisuttaṁ cāraṇa
caritamemba puṣkaṣkāraṇyadoḷagambaratiḷaka giriyoḷu yōgastharāgirdandu
nirnāmikeyappa bhavadoḷenna jananī caragurugaḷ enagaṁ ninagaṁ guru
gaḷādoḍavarpēḻdupadēśadoḷumāṁ nontu mahābala lalitāṅgaṅge
svayamprabheyemba dēviyādey āṁ munna jananī cara lalitāṅga dēva
noḷanubandhisida mōhadoḷu ninna dēvanappa lalitāṅgaṁ berasippartti
varlalitāṅga dēvaraṁ pūjisidenadaṁ nīnumaṟiveṁ avalladeyuṁ
nīnuṁ ninna dēvanuṁ kēḷuttire brahmēndranuṁ lāntavēndranuṁ
namma mūvara munnina bhavada gurugaḷappa yugandhara tīrthakararacarita
maṁ pēḻine yugandhara caritamanāṁ pēḻdaṁḻdeṁ adentendoḍe, jambū
dvīpava pūrvavidēhadasītānadiyayu teṅkaṇa taḍiya vatsakāvatī viṣayada
susīmānagaramanāḷva ajitañjayanembarasana sacivanamitamatigaṁ satya
bhāmegaṁ prahasitanemboṁ maganātana keḷeyaṁyuṁ vikasitanembirvaruṁ mithyā
jñānigaḷu śūnyavādigaḷondudivasamajitañjayanoḍane pōgi tatpatva

rōpavanadoḷaḷirdarasaddhiyoḷamr̥tāsravatvamemba r̥ddhi prāptarappa
matisāgara musinipatiyoḷu vādumugeydu hatapratibharāgi śiṣyatvamaṁ
pūṇdu mahāvratadoḷācāmlvamlavardhanamaṁ nōntu samādhivaḍadu
mahā śukra kalpakke sandu prahasitanindranādaṁ, vikasitanuṁ vāsudēva
vibhūtiyaṁ kaṇḍu nidhānaṅgeydu samādhi vidhiyiṁyaṁ kālāntado
ḷḷiḷliye pratīndranāgi, padināṟu sāgarōpamambaraṁ suralōka
sukhamananubhavisi bandu dhātakīṣaṇḍada paḍuvaṇa mandaradapūrva vidē
ha dapuṣkalāvatī viṣayada puṇḍarīkiṇiyanāḷva dhanañjayanarasiyarappa
yaśasvatigaṁ jayasēnegaṁ mahābalanumatibalanumemba rāmamukēśava
rāgi puṭṭi tandeya parōkṣadoḷ rājyaṅgeyyuttaydutratibaḷanemba kēśavana
vipattiyoḷu mahābalaṁ śivaguptara pakkade mahāvratamanāntu jīvi
tāntamodoḷu prāṇatakalpadoḷu prāṇatēndranāgi viṁśati samudrō
pama virāmadoḷu dhātakī ṣaṇḍada paḍuvaṇa maṁvamandarada pūrvavidēhada
sītānadiyayu teṅkaṇa taḍiya vatsakāvati viṣayada prabhaṅkarīpurama
nāḷva mahāsēnaṅgaṁ vasundharegaṁ jayasēnanemba maganāgi nijaguru
gr̥hīta mahāvratanāgi tanagāda cakravarti padamaṁ bisuṭu sīmandhara
jinara pakkade digambaranāgi ṣōḍaśabhāvanegaḷaṁ bhāvisi jīvitāntadoḷu
saumanasamembuparima madhyama graivēyakadoḷahamindranāgi mūvattu
sāgarōpamāyuṣyambaraṁ sukhamananubhavisi puṣkalārdhavada mūḍaṇa
mandaravada pūrvavidēhavada sītānadiyu teṅkaṇa taḍiya maṅgaḷāvatī
viṣayada ratnasañcaya puramanāḷva jitañjaya mahārājaṅgaṁ vasumatigaṁ
yugandharanemba maganāgi dīkṣeyaṁ pūṇdu ghātikṣayānantarōtpanna
kēvalajñānatīrthakara paramadēvaṁ vēdasamyaktvamutkr̥ṣṭa sthitiyoḷu
maṟuvattaṟu sāgarōpama kālamabhyudaya sukhamananubhavisi nirvāṇakke
sandaṁadaṅkēḷdu palaruṁ samyagdarśana viśuddharāvaradalladeyuṁ nammī
rvara gurugaḷappa pihitāsravara kēvalajñānōtpattiyosageyanambara
tiḷakagirigepōgi māḍidevu. avalladeyuṁ mērugiriyoḷu vana
kēḷiyuṁ svayambhūramaṇa samudradoḷu jalakēḷiyumanāḍide
mendivu modalāgoḍeya munninajanmada kathāntaramanaṟipidoḍa
dellamanaṟidenennavallabhaṁ lalitāṅganelli puṭṭidanembuduṁ āṁ ni
mmaṁ munnamaccudbhutakalpadiṁ bandilli yaśōdharagaṁ, vasumatigaṁ

vajradantanādeṁ ninna dēva lalitāṅganumīśāna kalpadiṁ bandutpala
khēṭamanāḷvinna maydunanaṁ vajrabāhugamenna taṅge vasundharegaṁ
vajrajaṅghanemba maganādoṁ āsvayamprabheye nīnenage magaḷāde vajra
bāhuvuṁ nimmatteyuṁ mūṟaneya divasakke barparāmumavargidi
rpōgivasageyayu mātaṁ koṇḍu paṇḍiteyumīgaḷe barpaḷumendu
pōdanannegaṁ śrīmatiyaṁ paṇḍite bandu kaṇḍu ninna bareda paṭamaṁ
mahāpūta jinālayavada munde nēlidenannegaṁ kēśava durmukhara
makkaḷuḷuṁ vāsava madurdantarembarirvaru durvivagdharavaṁ kaṇḍidella
memma prapañpopprapracamendu pusiyane mūrchevōdaraneccaṭṭaṟisiyalliya
vinnāṇaṅgaḷaṁ bisagoṇgoṇḍaḍavaraṟiyadirdaḍe banda baṭṭeyiṁ bijayaṁ
geykumendu nirākarisi kaḷevenannegamōrvvarva rājakumāraṁ bandu
dēvaraṁ vandisi siddhaśēṣeyuṁ koṇḍu pōṟamaṭṭu paṭamaṁ nindu
nōḍi pūrvabhavānusmaraṇamāge mūrchāgatanāgi śītala kriyegaḷaḷi
neccattidanilligārtandarembuduṁ āṁ tandenendoḍenage ninna bareyude
bañjibañcisida vinnāṇaṅgaḷāḷasātanaṟipidoḍāṁ ninna vallabhaṁ lalitāṅganappudaṁ
tappilludavaṟindātananendenīṁ lalitāṅgajaranappudavaṟināsvayamprabhe
nimmamāva vajradantaṅgaṁ nimmatte lakṣmīmatigaṁ śrīmatiyāta puṭṭa
mudaṟiṁ ninna tanna bayakegaḷu kūḍibandavembudumātanennaydannuydu
paṭamaṅkoṇḍu tānī paṭamaṁ baredittanensendondaṁ tōṟi vivāhōtsa
vakke barppa vajrabāhuva vajrajaṅghana baravanaṟipi barpparpannegamarasanavara
baraviṅgidirpōgi mundiṭṭoḍagoṇḍu poliṟalaṁ pokkabhyāgata pratipatti
geydu narghya vastravaṁ vajrabāhuge koṭṭoḍēnumanolleṁ nimmaḷa
yaṅge śrīmatiyaṁ kuḍuvudene piridumutsavadiṁ śrīmatigaṁ, vajra
jaṅghaṅgaṁ, maduveyuṁyaṁ māḍi vadhūvararge mūvattijrārchrāsirvarmakuṭa
baddhariṁ mūvattijrārchrāsira kalyāṇābhiṣēkaṅgeysiyse vīrabāhu, subāhu
prabhr̥tigaḷappa makkaḷverasutpaḷakhēṭakke kaḷivuvudumu; vajrajaṅghana taṅgiyu
mappanunsundariyuṁ śrīmatigaḷaṇṇanamitatējaṅge koṭṭavaraṁ paṇḍiteyu
maṁ puṇḍarīkiṇige kaḷisi vadhūvararsukhamirpinamavarge nālvattombhatta
maḷgaḷu puṭṭidarannegamondu divasaṁ, vajrabāhu māḍada mēgaṇa neli
yoḷirdu śaratkālada jaḷadharamaṁ kaṇḍavaṟimodoreya jaityālayamaṁ
māḍisuvenendu baṭṭige valageyaṁ tarisi taḍādākāramaṁ bareye, karagi

dudaṁ kaṇḍaduve nirvēgamāgi vajrajaṅghaṅge paṭṭamaṁ kaṭṭi vasundhari
verasu palarumarasiyarumaydyāydsāsirvararasugaḷuṁ śrīmatiya makkaḷappa
nālvattombhattattumaḷgaḷuverasu yaśōdhara munīndrara pakkade tapamaṁ
kaikoṇḍu muktiyaṁ sādhisikoṇḍan. itta vajradantanumondu nīḷā
ravindamaṁ piḍidu nōḍuttirda nadaṟoḷage sattirda tumbiyaṁ kaṇḍoṁ
dindriya vaśadoḷeḷisagidudakkentādudaydumindriyada basanadoḷeḷisagu
vemaṅgentakkumendu viṣaya viraktanāgi nijāgra tanūjaṅgamita
tējaṅge rājyabhāramaṁ koṭṭoḍātanentumolladirdoḍuḷida makkaḷu
manoḍambaḍisalāṟadamitatējaṅgamanundaregaṁ puṭṭida puṇḍarīka
nemba śiśuviṅge rājyamaṁ koṭṭu sāsirvarmakkaḷumaṟuvattu
sāsirvararasiyarumippattu sāsirvarmakuṭabaddharuṁ paṇḍiteyuṁ
berasu yaśōdhara jinara prathamagaṇadhararalli dīkṣeyaṁ kaikoṇḍu
mōkṣamaṁ sādhisidar. lakṣmīmatiyumanundhariyuṁ gāndharva
purādhipati mandaramāḷigaṁ sundarigaṁ jingañcintāgati manōgatiyemba
vidyādharara kaiyoḷu vajradanta tapaṁ baṭṭumadumaṁ puṇḍarīkaṅge nava
rājyadoḷāruṁ berumbisakeyduyyadumanaṟipeyaṭṭidoḍe tammayyana tannoḍa
hupuṭṭidarabyatikaramumaṁ kēḷdu śōkākuḷeyāda śrīmatiyaṁ vajra
jaṅghaṁ santayisi nijamantri mativaranoḷaṁ sēnānāyakanakampanoḷaṁ
purōhitānandanoḷaṁ seṭṭidhanamitranoḷamālōcisi bīḍaṁ pēḍaṁvēṟige
bappantu niyamisipayaṇadiṁ bandu sarpasarōvaramemba koḷada taḍi
yoḷu bīḍambiṭṭirpannegamallige dharmavararuṁ sāgarasēnarumemba cāra
ṇarkāntārada caryāmārgadoḷbapparaṁ tānuṁ śrīmatiyuṁ kaṇḍu
niṟisi navavidhapuṇya, saptaguṇasampannarāgi carigeyaṁ māḍi pañcāśca
ryamaṁ negaldvāḷdavāgagaḷarasanivaroḷaginituvaraṁ mōhavēkādudene vr̥ddha
kañcukipēḷdavēḷduḷumivargaḷu nālvattombhattaneyamaḷgaḷu ninna tanaya
rembudamaṟidenendusiradirendu bārisi tanmuniyugaḷada kālgarjida
nīroḷu poraḷdu dānānumōdadindamupaśāntaṅgaḷāgi munimukhāva
ḷōlōkanaṅgeydu śārdūla varāha gōlāṅgūlanakuḷaṅgaḷaṁ nōḍu
ttumavakke bhakṣakṣyadhūpaṅgaḷaṁ nīḍuttumarasaṁ tanna śrīmatiya bhava
sambandhamaṁ kēḷdu mativarākampanānanda dhanamitraremba nālvara bhavā
vaḷiyaṁ beyambisagoṇḍoḍavadhijñānigaḷu dharmavararintendateṅgarumativaranī

bhavakkaydaneya bhavadoḷu jambūdvīpada pūrvavidēhada kacchaviṣayada
prabhaṅkarī puradoḷatigr̥ddhanembarasanati lubdhanāgi tannoḍameyanu
pādriyoḷbayttuytu sattu paṅkaprabheyoḷu pattu sāgarōpamambaraṁ
duḥkhamanuṇḍu bandu tanna munnina baykkeykeya keladoḷpuliyāgi
puṭṭidanannegamānagaramanāḷva prītivardhanaṁ peraraṁ kāvadalu pōdaḍe
tanna tammaṁ vijigīṣuvāgi pōdoḍātanaṁ sāmādigaḷiḷanoḍambaḍisi
tandalli bīḍuviṭṭare śakunada nayadiṁ purōhitaṁ arasaṅgintendaṁ
uttama pātradānadiṁ kanakalābhamuṁ,pūjālābhamumīganinagāvuvapudeṁ
doḍīgirige muni ṟacarigevappandamāvudene purōhitanānaṟivenendu
poḻaḻilavīthigaḷoḷellaṁ nīraṁ taḷiyisi phaḷapuṣpaṅgaḷaṁ kedaṟisidoḍe catu
raṅgula cāraṇa pihitāśravamuni māsōpavāsaṅgeydayduprāsukamendu
poḻaḻilaṁ pugade bīḍaṁ puge nilisidāgaḷu pañcāścaryamādoḍā
parvatadoḷirda śārdūlaṁ jātismaranāgi tōṟidirdudembudanāmuni
panavapadhiyiyunaṟidu prītivardhananaṁ pratibōdhisuva bageyoḷāpuliya
pūrvabhava vr̥ttāntamumaṁ kālalabdhi dorekoḷe tōṟidirdudumana
ṟipi tadgiritaṭadoḷu munna pūṇda ponnakaḍāraṅgaḷaṁ tōṟijōcōdyaṁ
baṭṭu mahāpūjeyanarasaṁ māḍe tanmuniya pādamūladoḷu padi
neṇṭudivasaṁ nōntu samādhivaḍedu muḍipi śārdūlanīśānakalpadoḷu
divākaraprabhavimānadoḷu divākaraprabhanemba dēvanādonā prītivardhana
numalliye tapambaṭṭu mōkṣapadaviyaṁyuṁ paḍedonātana mantripurōhita
sēnāpatigaḷmūvaruṁ nr̥panadānānumōdaphaladinda muttara kururavado
ḷāryarāgi jīvitāntadoḷīśāna kalpadoḷu sēnānāyakanappāryaṁ
prabhākara vimānadoḷ prabhākaranemboṁ dēvanādoṁ, mantriyappā
ryaṁ kāñcanavimānadoḷu kanakaprabhanembonamaranādoṁ, purō
hitanappāryaṁ tuṣitākhya vimānadoḷu prabhaṁ(kara)jananembondēvanā
doṁ, munnapēḻda śārdūlacaranappa dēvaṁ berasantu nālvaruṁ dēvar
nīṁ lalitāṅganādandu ninage parivāra dēvarādoḍā lalitāṅga dēvane
nīnilli bandu vajrajaṅghasānādai ninnadēvi svayamprabhe śrīmatiyādaḷu.
śārdūlacara divākaraprabhadēvaṁ bandu matisāgaragaṁ śrīmatiyeṁ
baḷgaṁ maganāgi nimage mantriyatijacaranādoṁ, prabhākarāmaraṁ bandu
aparājitaṅgaṁ mārjavēgegaṁ maganāgi sēnānāyakanakampananādoṁ,

kanakaprabhadivijaṁ śrutakīrtigamanantamatigaṁ maganāgi purōhita
nānandanādoṁ, prabhañjanadēvaṁ dhanapavattaṅgaṁ dhanapavattegaṁ maganāgi
ninna seṭṭiṭṭa dhanamitranādonamukāraṇadinipadovaroḷati prītiyādudībhavakkeṁ
ṭaneya bhavadoḷu nīnāditīrthaṅkaranādanpandu śrīmati dānatīrthaprava
rtakaṁ śrīyaṣāṁyāṁsanakkuṁ ī ninna mantri mativaranandu ninage bharatēśvara
nembonātmajanakkumī ninna sēnānāyakanakampananuṁnuṁ bāhubaliyeṁ
boṁ tanayanakkumī purōhitānandaṁ vr̥ṣabhasēnanemboṁ tanūja
nakkumī seṭṭiṭṭadhanamitrananantavīryanemboṁ sutanakkumembudu
marasaṁ santōṣamsaṅkṣōbhambaṭṭu mattamintendaṁ, nimma mundirda puli,
pandi, kōḍaga, muṅguriyemba nālkaṟabhavāvaḷiyuṁ besasimembudu
mambara cāraṇarintendarī śārdūlaṁ pūrvajanmadoḷī viṣayada hastina
puradaparadaṁ sāgaradattaṅgamavana paradi dhanamatigamugrasēnanemboṁ
magana pratyākhyāna krōdhadiṁ tiryagārygāyuṣyamaṁ kaṭṭikoṇḍu(ḍā)
koṭṭārada karaṇaṁ(ṇiṇe)gaḷaṁ bañjibañcisi kaḷda dravyamaṁmuṁ sūḷege koṭṭoḍarasaṁ
piḍitarisi hatiyiyuse sattu puliyādoṁ pōdabhavadoḷīvarāhanumī
viṣayada vijayapuradoḷu mahānandanemba nr̥patigaṁ vasantasēnegaṁ
harivāhananemba maganapratyākhyānamānadoḷu tandege avinītanāgi pē
ḻdaḻdudaṁ geykuve śiyyadelīleyoḷu taleyuṁ tāṭisi sattu varāhanādoṁ. ī
vānaranuṁ munnina bhavadoḷu dhānyapurada paradaṁ kubēradattaṅgaṁ
sudattegaṁ sāgaradattanemboṁ maganapratyākhyānamāyeyiṁyuṁ tanna taṅge
yoḍaveyuṁ bañcisikoṇḍu kaḷedu sattuttī vānaranādoṁ ī nakuḷanuṁ
pūrvajanmadoḷu supratiṣṭhapuradoḷu apratyākhyāna lōbhābhibhūtaṁ
lōlupanemba kalluriganāgi poḻaḻilajayasēnanembarasana basadige bappi
ṭṭigegaḷaṁ purigegaḷaṁ koṭṭu koṇḍarasinōḻpudadumondu ponniṭṭige
yāvaḍe biṭṭiyavara kayyalliṭṭigegaḷaṁ koṇḍoṭṭi, mattondu divasaṁ
tanna magaḷa kekēlamūrge pōguttuṁ tanna magaṅgiṭṭigegoḷva besanaṁ
pēḻdoḍavanondumaṁ koḷḷadire muḷidavana taleyanoḍeye baḍidenna
paḍavugeḍisikoṇḍu pōdudempuvendu tanna kāla piḍivuduḍivudumadanarasa
naṟidu daṇḍise sattubandilli nakuḷanādoṁ. ninnī śārdūla, varāha,
gōlāṅgūla, nakuḷaṅgaḷu jātismaraṅgaḷāgi ninna dānānumōdadi
nuttara kuruviṅge baddhāyuṣyaṅgaḷāduvantu divyamānuṣyagōcara

sukhaṅgaḷaṁ ninnoḍanuṇṇutuṁ nīṁ bharatadoḷu bhāvī(ādi) tīrthaṅrthakaranā
dandu anukramadoḷu ninaganantavīrya, acyutavīra, dhīra, sudhīra
remba makkaḷapparendintu cāraṇamunīndraru besasi pōdarāgaḷu vajra
jaṅghanuṁ śrīmatiyumuṁvellaramavaraguṇamamunemativarādigaḷoḷu nuḍi
yuttumirdu maṟudivasaṁ payaṇambōgi puṇḍarīkijeṇiyaneydi
lakṣmīmatiyumananundariyumaṁ santayisi puṇḍarīkaṅge niḥkaṇṭakaṁ
māḍi utpalakhēṭakke maguḻdu bandu palakālaṁ rājyaṅgeyyutti
rdondu divasaṁ śayyāgr̥hadoḷu nidrāvaśagatarādarannegamalliya
muccida gavākṣaṅgaḷaṁ teṟiṟeyalmaṟiduṟdu dhūpaguṇḍigeyoḷaḷavapaṟiyade
sejjevaḷanikkida kēśasaṁskārada dhūpada poge pudidukoḷe vajrajaṅghanuṁ
śrīmatiyuṁ poge sutte sattudaṁ nēsarmūḍidāgaḷaṟidu mativarādi
gaḷavarumanalli satta tiryagjārygjātigaḷumaṁ saṁskarisi, śrīmatiyamagaṁ
vajrabāhuge paṭṭaṅgaṭṭi dr̥ḍhadharmagurugaḷa pakkade tapambaṭṭu jīvi
tāntyadoḷu adhōgraivēyakadoḷuheṭṭimaheṭṭimadoḷahamindra
rādar.

antu vajrajaṅghanuṁ śrīmatiyumātirikaṅgaḷuttama pātradānada
dānānumōdada puṇyadindaṁ jambūdvīpada mandaraduttara kuruva
membuttama bhōgabhūmiyoḷu dampatigaḷāgi puṭṭaloḍamavara tāyuṁ
tandeyuṁ sīntumāgaḷiḷasiyuṁ gata jīvigaḷādoḍēḻudivasadiṁ purā
tana(ha) puṇyakarma kāmadhēnustanōpamānanijāṅguḷī janita rasarasā
yanā svādadodoḷamuttānaśayyeyoḷaṁ kaḻiṟumpi pēṟēpeṟavēḻu divasadoḷu
taguḷduṁ pēṟēḻdampeṟavēḻu divasadoḷmevuyaḷbevayu mahītaḷadoḷu taḷarnaḍe
naḍeduṁ pēṟēdumpeṟavēḻu divasadoḷu pamaduḷaṁ naḍemuṁ pēṟēdumpeṟavēḻu divasadoḷu
kaḷāpravīṇaṅgaḷāgiyumēḻu divasadoḷuṁ vijñānavidaṅgaḷāgiyuṁ
mattamēḻu divasadoḷuṁ sampūrṇa yauvana śubhalakṣaṇa lakṣita śarīraṁ
gaḷāgi dampatigaḷantu nālvattombhattu divasadoḷu samacaturasra saṁsthā
naruṁ, vajra vr̥ṣabha nārāca saṁhananaruṁ āṟusāvirabilnilliḍiyarāgi dina
trayadoḷu badarīphaḷamātrāhāraruṁ vigata vihāraruṁ, ārōgya
śarīraruṁ, mandarākāraruṁ, tripalyōpamāyurjīvigaḷumāgi daśa
vidha kalpavr̥kṣaṅgaḷuṁ tamma bēḍidudane kuḍe sukhadinirdārya
yugaḷaṁ vanaśrīyuṁ nōḍutirdandu gaganadoḷu pōpa sūryaprabha
nemba dēvana vimānamuṁmaṁ nōḍi pōda bhavaṅgaḷaṁ neneyuttirpannegamī

var cāraṇa r̥ṣiyarallige vappudumavargeṟaṟiga poḍapōdavaṭṭu nimmoḷemagati
snēhamāytu pōda bhavadoḷu bandhutvamuṇṭumadanemagaṟiye
besasiṁ embudumavaroḷagraja muni muguḷnage nakku nīṁ mahābaḷavi
yaccaranāda bhavadoḷāṁ ninage sacivaneṁ svayambuddhanembenāgi samādhi
vidhiyaṁ māḍi baḷiṟiyaṁ nāṁ ghōra vīra tapaṅgeydu saudharma
kalpada svayamprabha vimānadoḷaṁ maṇicūḷadēvanāgi sādhika sāgarōpa
māyuṣyāntadoḷalliṁ bandu jambūdvīpadapūrvavidēhada puṣkalāvatī
viṣayuyada puṇḍarīkiṇiyanāḷva priyasēnaṅgaṁ, sundarigaṁ, prītiṅkara
nemboṁ maganāde nenniṁ kiṟiyarivaru prītidēvarembirvaruṁ svayaṁ
prabharalli dīkṣegoṇḍu cāraṇa r̥ddhisampannaravadhiyuṁyiṁ nīnilli puṭṭiduda
naṟidu mōkṣakke mukhya kāraṇamappa samyaktvamaṁ kaikoḷisalu bande
menvendu niśyaṅkitvādiyuktamappa samyaktvamaṁ kaikoḷisi śrīmatiya
nendaru; nīṁ strīrūpamoḷu toḍardudesegiḍalvēḍa.

va॥endu prītiṅkarācāryaru śrīmatyāryeyumaṁ śārdū
lāryyādiyyārdigaḷgaṁ samyaktvamaṁ kaikoḷisi punardarśanamakkendu
pōpuduṁ vajrajaṅghāryaṁ mahābala sānādandennaṁ svayambuddhanāgi
pratibōdhisidarīgaḷumennaṁ pratibōdhisalu bandarendavara dharmānu
graha buddhiyumaṁ snēhasambandhamumaṁ neneyuttirdu samyagda
rśanamumanaskhaḷitamārādhisi tripalyōpamāyuṣyāvasānadoḷu lōkāṁ
taritarāge vajrajaṅghāryanīśāna kalpadoḷu śrīprabhavimānadoḷu
śrīdharanemboṁ dēvanādoṁ, śrīmatyāryeyuṁ samyaktva mahātmya
diṁ strītvamaṁ pattuviṭṭu malliye svayamprabha vimānadoḷu svayaṁ
prabhanemboṁ dēvanādoḷ śārdūlāryanuṁ manōhara
vimānadoḷu citrāṅganemba dēvanādoṁ, varāhāryaṁ nandanavimāna
doḷ maṇikuṇḍaḷanemba divijanādoṁ. vānarāryaṁ nandyāvarta
vimānadoḷ manōharanemboṁ dēvanādoṁ nakuḷāryanuṁ prabhākara
vimānadoḷuṁ manōrathanemboṁ, dēvanādoṁ;antanibaruṁ sahāya

roḍane śrīprabhācaḷadoḷu prītiṅkarācāryara kēvala jñānōtpatti
yādudanavadhiyindaṟidu dēvanikāyadoḍane pūjisi śrīdhara dēvanenda
nānintōrante nimma dayeyiṁ sukhamanuṇutaṁ bande nāṁ mahābalanā
dandu ā nālvaroḷage mūvaru mantrigaḷalli puṭṭidaravanenagaṟiye
besasi mendoḍintendu besasidaru. sambhinnanuṁ mahāmatiyuṁ
nigōdhavaṁ povambokkaru, śatamatiyumemoraḍaneyu narakadoḷu puṭṭi naraka
duḥkhamananubhavisidappanembudu. śrīdharadēvaravarge namaskāraṁ geydu
gurūpadēśadiṁdindavamātanaṁ pratibōdhisalallige pōgi kaṇḍu śatamaticara
nārakanendaṁ ninna mithyā jñānadininitu duḥkhamaneydideyendu
samyaktvamaṁ kaikoḷisi pōdanānārakanuṁ kālāntaradoḷalliṁ bandu
puṣkaravara dvīpada pūrvavidēhada maṅgalāvatī viṣayuyada ratnasañcaya
puramanāḷva mahīdharacakravartigaṁ saundarigaṁ jayasēnanemba maganāgi
vivāha samayadoḷu tannanā śrīdharadēvanē bandu mattaṁ mūdalise
yamadhara gurugaḷa pakkade tapambaṭṭu jīvitāntyadoḷu brahmēndranāgi
pūrvōpakāramaṁ nenedu śrīdhara dēvanaṁ pūjisi pōdanitta śrīdhara
dēvaṁ bandu jambūdvīpada pūrvavidēhada vatsakāvatī viṣayuyada
susīmā nagaramanāḷva bhayaghōṣa cakravartiya maydunaṁ sudr̥ṣṭigaṁ
saundarasunaṁvēgaṁ suvidhiyemba maganāgi manōrameyemboḷanabhaya
ghōṣa cakravartiya magaḷaṁ maduvenindumātaṅgamākegaṁ śrīmati
dhacara svayamprabhadēvaṁ bandu kēśavanemboṁ maganādoṁ, mattamā
viṣayuyadoḷu suvidhige maganappa maṇpuṇḍaḷīka vibhīṣaṇaṅgaṁ priyadattegaṁ
citrāṅgahadharadēvaṁ bandu varadattanemba maganādoṁ nandiṣēṇaṅgama
nantamatigaṁ maṇikuṇḍaḷaṁ vāriṣēṇanemboṁ maganādoṁ, ratiṣēṇa
mahīśaṅgaṁ candramatigaṁ manōharadēvaṁ citrāṅgadanemboṁ maga
nādoṁ, prabhañjana rājaṅgaṁ citramāḷinigaṁ manōrathadēvaṁ śānta
madananemboṁ maganādoṁ. āgi tammanibarumoḍane sukhamananubhavi
suttirpannegaṁ suvidhitamma māvanappa bhayaghōṣa cakravarti vimaḷavāhana
jinaravandanā bhaktige pōgi tānā varadattanuṁ vāriṣēṇanuṁ citrāṅga
danuṁ śāntamadananumemba nālvarsahōdararuṁ tannamagaṁ kēśavanuṁ
berasu pōgi jinēndraraṁ bandisirdanannegamabhayaghōṣa cakravarti
dharmaśravaṇānantaraṁ nirvēgamāgi sāsirvararasiyaruṁ ayyāsi

rvarmakkaḷuṁ padineṇsāsirvararasumakkaḷverasu dīkṣeyaṁ kaikoṇḍaṁ.
suvidhiyuṁ kēśavanoḷappa mōhadomoḷu toḍardu rājyamanuṟidu
pāsakanāgi ||॥

lg.l: gāhe|| vaṁ॥daṁsaṇa vavayasāmāyuyiya pōsa dasa ccitarāya bhatteya |

div.p:
embī panneraḍaneyuya guṇasthānadoḷutkr̥ṣṭaṁ negaṟduḷdu saṁyama
maṁ kaikoṇḍu samādhiyuyinacyutēndranādoṁ. kēśavanuṁ guruvi
yōgadoḷu dīḷdīkṣeyaṁ kaikoṇḍalliye pratīndranādoṁ, mumbēṟdaḷda
nālvarumarasumakkaḷalliye sāmānika dēvarādōrantanibaruṁ dvāviṁ
śati sāgarōpamakālaṁ sukhamananubhavisi bandu jambūdvīpada pūrva
vidēhada puṣkalāvatī viṣayuyada puṇḍarīkiṇiyanāḷva vajrasēnaṅgaṁ
śrīkāntegamacyutēndraṁ bandu vajranābhiyemboṁ jēṣṭhaputranādoṁ
mattamā puṇya dampatigaṁ muṁ pēṟdamumbēḷda mativarākampanānanda dhana mitra
radhōgraivēyakadahamindraralli bandu subāhu, mahābāhu, pīṭha,
mahāpīṭharemba tanayarādaru. varadatta, vāriṣēṇa, citrāṅgada, śānta
madanamberasu sāmānika dēvaru vijayayu, vaijayanta, jayanta, aparā
jitaremba tanūjarādavaranteṇbarumanukramadoḷu vajranābhige sahōdara
rādaru. kēśavacara pratīndraṁ bandāpuradoḷu kubēranaravaṇikpatigama
nantaśrīgaṁ dhana dēvanemboṁ maganādonantanibarumoḍagūḍi baḷeye
vajrasēnamahārājaṁ vajranābhige rājyābhiṣēkaṅgeydu pariniṣkramaṇapūje
yuyināprapamravanōdyānadoḷu sāsirvararasugaḷveḷberasu dīkṣeyaṁ kaikoṇḍu
ghātikṣayadiṁ tīrthakaranādoṁ. itta vajranābhige cakraratnaṁ puṭṭi
doḍeeraḍosageyumaṁ māḍi dhanadēvaṁ gr̥hapati ratnamāge paṭṭaṇṭbaṇḍa
maṁ bāykēḷisi baḷeyuṁ viṣaya viraktanāgi vajradantanemba tanna magaṅge
sāmrājyamaṁ koṭṭu nijaguru samīpadoḷu sāsirvarmakkaḷuṁ
mūvattu sāsirvarmakuṭa baddharumayvattu sāsirvararasiyaru peṇba
roḍahuṭṭidaruṁ gr̥hapati ratnaṁ dhanadēvanuṁ berasu dīkṣeyaṁ
kaikoṇḍu dvādaśa tapadoḷu negaṟduḷdu trailōkyakṣōbhakāri tīrthakara
puṇyakke hētugaḷappa ṣōḍaśa bhāvanegaḷaṁ bhāvisi caturdaśa pūrvadhara
rāgi kālāntadoḷu śrīprabhādi śikharadoḷu prāyōpagamana vidhiyiṁ
sarvārthasiddhiyoḷahamindranādoṁ. subāhu, mahābāhu, prabhr̥ti

gaḷumalliye puṭṭidarantanibaruṁ trayatriṁśatsāgarōpamāyuṣyaruṁ
sama caturasra saṁsthānaruṁ, sarvāṅgōpāṅga saundararuṁ, śubhalakṣaṇa
sahitaruṁ, praśasta varṇagandha, rasa. sparśaruṁ, śaraccandrabhāsura dēharu
maṇimālyadyaṣṭa guṇōpētaruṁ, ēka ratni pramāṇōtsēdharuṁ, vaikri
yaka śarīruṁ, paramaśukla lēśyā pariṇāmaruṁ sārdha ṣōḍaśa māsa
kr̥ta niśvāsaruṁ trisahasrōttara triṁśatsahasra saṁvatsara samadhigata
mānasāmr̥tāhāraruṁ sapravīcārānantaguṇa niṣpravīcāra sukharuṁ,
lōkanāḷikābhyanbhyāntara gatāvadhi jñānaruṁ svāvadhi kṣētra pramāṇa baḷa
prakāśa vikriyāśaktisampannaruṁ dvicatvāriṁśatkr̥tādi śubhakarma sambhava
sarvāvadhi divya bhōgānubhavaniṣṭharumāgi sukhamirpinaṁ.

itta jambūdvīpada bharatakṣētradoḷu mumpēḻda manugaḷoḷu
padinālkaneya manu nābhirājaṅgamātanarasi marudēvi mahādēvigaṁ
vajranābhi carāhamindraṁ bandu bhāvi tīrthakaranādi dēvanāgi puṭṭu
puvudanavadhiyinaṟidu dēvarājanayōdhyeyemba poḻaṟalaṁ paḍedu avakke
sākētamuṁ vinīteyuṁ bhāvīkauśala viṣayavartiyappudaṟiṁ sukau
śalekaḷeyumemba pesargaḷaniṭṭu nābhirājaṅge rājyābhiṣēkaṅgeydu maru
dēvige mahādēvi paṭṭaṅgaṭṭi pūjisi munnamaṟudiṅgaḷuṇṭene vasudhā
āḻiṟeyumanayōdhyāpuradoḷu surivantudhaghanapaṅdaṅge besasidoḍā padmādi
sarōvara nivāsiniyaruṁ aṅgavardhana, dhairyavardhana, stutivardhana,
manōvardhana, prasādavardhana, saubhāgyavardhana, hētugaḷumappa śrī,
hrī, dhr̥ti, kīrti, buddhi, lakṣmīgaḷembaṟuvarumaṁ rucakācaḷada pūrva
dakṣiṇa paścimōttara digbhāgaṅgaḷeṇṭu kūṭadoḷippeppaibbaru digvaniteyaru
mavamūvarmūḍaṇa kūṭaṅgaḷoḷirpa nālvaruṁ vidyutkumāriyarumana
vaṟi digbhāgada vikaṭa kūṭaṅgaḷoḷirpa dikkumārikā mahattarikeyarumaṁ
mattamānagava kr̥takadvikrita viṭakūṭaṅgaḷoḷirpa vidyudyuvati purandhri
yarumaṁ, mattamanyanaganivāsinigaḷappamarakānteyarumaṁ marudē
vige paricārakeyarāgiraluṁ tīrthakara kumāra jātakarma karaṇa garbha
śōdhanādigaḷge vanitāgūḍha vyāpāraṅgaḷoḷu negaḻvanḷvantuṁ saudha
rmēndraṁ besase dinamprati dhanadaṁ mūṟuvare kōṭiyumare pañca
ratnavr̥ṣṭiyaṁ suriye digaṅganeyaruṁ dēvāṅganeyaruṁ indranu

besasidandadoḷunegaḻduḻi mattondu divasa marudēvi caturtha snāna
doḷu sūḻgevandu.|| ardhasamavr̥ttaṁ:

lg.l: gīta nihita hr̥dayaṁ madakuñjara mā(rū)pataṁ ta(tra)
nija puṣkarastha vana pūrita kanaka ghaṭōnmyainmukhairmadērdēbhādhipatikhi
divijēndra cāpa ruci līla mabhinavavanamēru pārijā
tādi sumaracita dāma yugaṁ divi saurabhānugamandāmampāḷinīsīvr̥taṁ
tphulla kuvalayavanaṁ niṣapadhācaḷa kūṭa maṇḍanakaraṁ niśākaraṁ
daḷitāmbu jāta mapanīta timira nikaraṁ karōtkara
pūta salila pūrita ratnamayau ghaṭau rugabhiruddha diṅmukhau
gīta mukhara makhiḷāmbu vihaṅgama rāji rājiparipūjitaṁ saraḥ
pavanōcchaccala dvipula vīci nicaya nijitaṁ caranmahā
parita sphuranmaṇi marīci masr̥ṇīta digantaraṁ karīṁ
kanakādri nīla ghanamauktika rucira harinmaṇi prabhā

div.p:
intu marudēvi mahādēviyarī pēḻda svapnānantaraṁ
nijavadanamaṁ gaja puguvudaṁ kaṇḍu avadhijñāniyappa nābhirājanindavara
phaḷaṅgaḷaṁ aṟidupu sukhamirpinamittapamuṁpuṁ pēḻda sarvārtha siddhīśvaraṁ
ā dēviyayu garbhakkavatarisi paripūrṇa prasava samayadoḷu caitra bahuḷa
navamiyoḷ uttarāṣāḍha nakṣatradoḷu brahmayōgadoḷu trijñānadharaṁ

puṭṭuvuduṁ saudharmēndraṁ siṁhāsana kampamāge tannavadhiyiṁ
trailōkyanāthanudayamanaṟivuduṁ, tannājñeyiṁ kalpanivāsigaḷu
ghaṇṭā ṭaṅkāradiṁ, jyōtiṣkaru siṁhanādadiṁ vyantarāmararu bhērī
nādadiṁ bhavanavāsigaru śaṅkhaninādadindaṟidu ātanājñeyiṁ gajarathāśva
vr̥ṣabhagāndharva nartakīpadāti lakṣaṇamappa saptānīkaṁ berasubare
saudharmēndraṁ janmābhiṣēka kalyāṇamuṁmaṁ māḍalendu, śaci mahādēvi
verasu airāvaṇārūḍhanayōdhyege vandu, nābhirāja bhavanamaneydiydu, śaci
mahādēvi marudēviya prasūtigr̥hamaṁ pokku mūṟu sūlbaḻbala
goṇḍu poḍevaṭṭu māyānidreyaṁ māḍi māyā śiśuvanirisi jina
śiśuvanettikoṇḍu jagatrayadoḷamatidurlabhamappa jinarājagātra sparśa
sukhamaṁ paḍedu piṇḍīkr̥ta tribhuvana sukhamumananubhavisidante santōṣaṁ
baṭṭaṣṭamaṅgaḷa dhāraṇeyurverasu tandindrana kaiyyoḷkoḍe dēva
nikāyaṁ jayayujayayu ninava pūrvakaṁ namaskāraṁ geyyeyke saudharmēndraṁ
kumārananairāvaṇa skandhadharaṁ māḍe kanakātapatramanīśānēndranetti
sanatkumāra mahēndrarcāmaraṅgaḷanikke śaṅkha, paṭaha, saṅgīta,
nartanapūrvakaṁ mandarājacaḷakke barpāgaḷairāvatada mūvatteraḍu
mogaṅgaḷondondaṟoḷeṇṭu kombu mōrondu kombinoḷeṇṭu
koḷanaṁ, poṟonrondu koḷanoḷondondabjabjiniyuṁ yondabjabjiniyoḷ
mūvatteraḍabjamuṁ ōrondabjadoḷ mūvatteraḍesaḷumondondesa
ḷoḷu mūvattettirvardēvakanneyarnartisuttuṁ barpinaṁ mēruvapaneydiydu
baḷāhakanirvirmita ratnamaya trividha sōpānadikkelamodoḷaṁ dēvanikāyaṁ
bare madhyama sōpānadinēṟi pāṇḍuka śilātaḷada pūrvōttara digbhāga
gatamappa siṁhāsanadoḷu bāḷakanaṁ pūrvābhimukhanāgirisi saudharmēṁ
drīśānēndrarikkeladoḷūbare vadakṣiṇōttara digbhāgasodoḷirdādikpāḷakaru
manavaravara digbhāgadoḷirisiyaṣṭōttara sahasra kanaka kaḷaśaṅgaḷoḷu
surasamiti tīvitanda pālgaḍala nīrgaḷiṁḷaṁ jayayu jayayu ninādapūrvakama
bhiṣēkaṁ geydu gandhamālyādigaḷindarcisi tanneraḍu kaṇgaḷoḷaṁ nōḍi
taṇiyayuve saudharmēndraṁ sahasrākṣanāgi nirvartita janmābhiṣēkadina
yōdhyege bandu nābhirājanumaṁ marudēviyumaṁ pūjisi dēvaṅgeṟagi
yānanda nr̥tyamanāḍi pōdaṁ.

itta dēviyaruṁ majjana maṇḍana krīḷanādi vidhigaḷaṁ māḍi
vayōnu rūpadiṁ kumāraṅganuṣṭhisuttirpannegamītyumakītkuttara caturlakṣa

pūrvakālaṁ paramāyuṣyanāgi nisvēdatvamuṁ, nirmaḷatvamuṁ, kṣīra
gaura rudhiratvamuṁ, vajravr̥ṣabha nārāca saṁhananamuṁ, samacaturasra
saṁsthānamuṁ, surabhigandhatvamuṁ, surūpaśeteyuṁ, svastikāṅkuśadhvaja
śrōtōraṇādi sahasrāṣṭa lakṣaṇamumapramita vīryatvamuṁ, priyahita
vāditvamumemba daśavidha svabhāvātiśaya samutpannamuṁ, śastrapāṣāṇa
vāyuvarṣa viṣāgni kāṣṭha kaṇṭakādi paraghātamuṁ, vātapitta ślēṣma
sannipāta sambhavāmayānēkaha karmapacahayādyupaghātamumillade jarādi
bhēdadantaka maṇādi rahitamuṁ niratiśayēndriyārtha samanugatābhyu
vadaya niśrēyasa paramasukha sādhanunamumappa caramadēhamaṁ tāḷdi nava
yauvanārambhadoḷu kaccaccha mahākacchara taṅgeyarappa yaśasvatiyuṁ,
sunandeyumappīrvarumaṁ, maduve nindu saṁsāra sukhamananubhavi
sutittirpannegaṁ subāhu mahīpati sarvārthasiddhiyiṁ bandu yaśasvatige
bharatēśvaranāgi puṭṭidoṁ.

muṁ pēḻdaḷda pīṭha mahāpīpiṭha vijaya vaijayanta jayantanaparā
jitaru sarvārtha siddhiyiṁ bandu bharataniṁ kiṟiyarāgi kramadoḷu
vr̥ṣabhasēna, aānantavijaya, aānantavīrya, acyutavīra, suvīraremba
rāgi puṭṭire antu bharatakumāraṁ berasebbarkumārarādiyāgi nūrva
rkumārarumanibariṁ kiṟiyaḷu brāhmiyemba magaḷumaṁ yaśasvati
paḍeye mumpēḻdaḷda mahābāhu mahīpati sarvārthasiddhiyoḷpuṭṭibandu
sunandegākālada kāmadēvaṁ bāhubali kumāranembōnādoṁ.
munna vr̥ṣabhēśvaraṁ vajrajaṅghanāda bhavadoḷā mahātmaṅge taṅgeyāda
aānundariye katipaya paribhramaṇadiṁ bandu bāhubali kumāraniṁ
kiṟiyaḷu, sundari yembaḷmagaḷāgi puṭṭidaḷ.

antu bharataṁ bāhubali kumāraṁ modalāge nūrvarku
māraruma nīrvarkanneyarumanādidēvaṁ nōḍi vividhābharaṇālaṁ
kr̥taṁ māḍisi “siddhaṁ namu”yendu ‘akārādi hakāra’ paryantā
kṣaraṅgaḷaṁ brāhmige dakṣiṇa hastadiṁ, gaṇitamaṁ saundarige vāmahastadiṁ
upadēśaṅgeydu vidyāparipūrṇeyaraṁ māḍi bharataṅge bharatamumartha
śāstramumaṁ, vr̥ṣabhasēnaṅge gīta vādyārtha saṅgrahamappa gāndharva
śāstramumaṁ, ananta vijayaṅge citrakaḷeyumaṁ vāstuvidyeyumaṁ,
bāhubalige kāmatantra sāmudrikāyurvēda hastyaśvatantra ratna

parīkṣeyumaṁ mattamivu modalāgi palavuṁ lōkōpakārigaḷappa
śāstraṅgaḷumaṁ mattina makkaḷellarge upadēśaṅgeydādibrahmaṅge viṁśati
lakṣapūrvaṁ kumāra kālaṁ salvinamāprastāvadoḷu phaḷa pākavirāmaṁ
gaḷappa garbhaṣaṣṭhiṣṭi vrīhi yava gōdhūmādi mahauṣadhigaḷumantiḷāgasi
kusumbhādi dīpauptauṣadhigaḷumaṁ yavanāḷa kaṅgukōdradhravādi sarvauṣadhi
gaḷumaṁ mattamakr̥ṣṭa pacyaṅgaḷappuvaṟinda viraḷaṅgaḷāgeyuṁ kalpa
vr̥kṣaṅgaḷapagata vīryavipākaṅgaḷāgeyuṁ ādhi vyādhi vyākuḷargaḷāge
manujarellaṁ nāllaṁsābhirājananumatadisādibrahmanallige banpandu puykaliḍe tatpa
jūjīvanōpāyamaṁ, pūrvāpara vidēhasthita samānamāge ṣaṭkarmaṁ
gaḷumaṁ varṇāśrama vibhāgaṅgaḷumaṁ grāma gr̥hādi bhēdaṅgaḷumaṁ
māḷpantindraṅge besasidoḍātanayōdhyeyoḷu munnaṁ jina mandiraṁ
gaḷaṁvinirmisi kauśaḷādidēśaṅgaḷumaṁ rājadhānigaḷumaṁ samakaṭṭi
puraṅgaḷanādibrahmana besadoḷu māḍi purandaravesaraṁ paḍedindraṁ.
pōdaṁ.

ādidēvanuṁ asimasi kr̥ṣyādigaḷumaṁ tannapaḍeva kṣatriyayu,
vaiśya, śūdrarembavarṇatrayakkamaṟipi yugārambhamāṣāḍha bahuḷa
pratipaddinadandu kr̥tamādudaṟiṁ kr̥tayugamembudāge tadanantaraṁ
dēvarājaniṁ prathama prajāpatikr̥ta rājyābhiṣēkanadhirāja padavi
yoḷu nindu makuṭādi vibhūṣaṇadharaṁ, māgadhavara tanuprabhāsa
kr̥tamāḷādi dēvārjitaṁ tanna munna paḍeda varṇatrayakkaṁ yathōcita
vr̥ttigaḷanaṟipalendu kṣatriyarge satyādigaḷumaṁ, jaḷa sthaḷa yātrā
diyaṁ vaiśyaṅge, śuśrūṣādiyaṁ śūdraṅge vartanaṁ māḍi daṇḍadhararilla
dandumatsyanyāyamakkumendu mūrdhābhiṣiktaraṁ, sōmaprabhaṁ
hari, ākampanaṁ, kāśyaparaṁ barisi sōmaprabhaṅge kururājābhidhānama
niṭṭu kurukuḷāgragaṇyaṁ māḍi, harige harikāntanāmamaniṭṭu harivaṁśā
gragaṇyaṁ māḍi, ākampanaṅge śrīdhapharanāmamaniṭṭu nāthānvaya purassaraṁ
māḍi, kāśyapaṅge magadhaphanāmamaniṭṭu ugravaṁśa lalāmaṁ māḍi,
avaraṁ māṇḍaḷika padadoḷnilisi, catussahasra mukuṭa baddha parivr̥taraṁ
māḍi kaccha, mahākaccha pramukharumaṁ ādhirāja padaviyoḷnilisi, nija
nandanargellamabhimatamappuppadanittu aṟuvatta mūṟulakṣa pūrvaṁ rājya
kālaṁ salvinaṁ kāśyapamembudu śēśrējamadaṁ pāḷisuvudaṟinda
kāśyapanuṁ, ikṣvu, khaṇḍikāvimardana samudbhūta rasasaṅgrahaṇa prayō

gamaṁ prajege tōṟidudaṟinikṣvākuvuṁvraṁ, ṣaṭkarmamaṁmuṁ prajegupadēśaṁ
geydudaṟiṁ prajāpatiyuṁ svargaṅgaḷoḷutkr̥ṣṭamappa sarvārtha
siddhiyiṁ bandudaṟiṁ pauramanuṁ kuru kuḷādigaḷaṁ māḍidudaṟiṁ
kuladharanuṁ viśvakarma vidhānadiṁ śrēṣṭhanumenisi sukhamirpinavonmondu
divasaṁ ādidēvana pariniṣkramaṇa kalyāṇamatyāsannamembudaṁ nijāvadhi
yindaṟidu indrambandu dēvananumatadiṁ saṅgītakkoḍarccercci
nīrāñḷāñjane yemboḷaccarisi, nartisuttirdu tanagāgaḷāṇāyuravasānamāge
raṅgadoḷu bhōṅkanadr̥śyamappuduminmidraṁ rasabhaṅgamappa bhayadiṁ
mattondu pātrapuṁmuṁ saṅkramisidoḍapavanārumaṟiyadire, dēvanaṟivudu
dēhānityateyuṁyaṁ bhāvisi saṁsāra bhōga viraktanāgirpinaṁ brahmakalpada
kaḍeyoḷirpa sārasvatādityāgni aruṇagardha tōya, tuṣita vyābādha
ariṣṭaremberembibbaruṁ lōkāntika dēvaru bandu padineṇṭu kōṭākōṭi
sāgarōpama kālaṁ masuḷdirda dharmamaṁ dēvā, nīnujvalaṁ mālpuṟpu
dendu tannaṁ pratibōdhisi pōdar.

itta ādidēvaṁ, bharatabāhubaligaḷaṁ ayōdhyāpaudapanapurādhipatya
doḷadhirāja, yuvarājaparmāḍi niṟisi vr̥ṣabhasēnādigaḷga miḷātaḷamaṁ
paccukoṭṭu, nābhirājanaṁ bīṟkoṇḍu pariniṣkramaṇa kalyāṇa mahābhi
ṣēkamaṁ saudharmēndraṁ māḍe mantri, sāmanta prabhr̥tigaḷaṁ visa
rjisi sudarśanamemba sivigeyanēṟi mahīpāḷarēḻaṟiḍiyaṁ viyaccara
rēḻaṟiḍiyanunuḥyduṁ baḻiṟiyaṁ surāsurar kiṟideḍeyanuydunuḥyye baḻiṟiya
mindraruydayye yaśasvatiyuṁ, sunandeyuṁ, baḻiṟiyaṁ taguḷdoḍarasa
nīgaḷe bakkumendu antaḥpura vr̥ddharuydar.

itta nābhirājaṁ bharatēśvara kaccha mahākaccha prabhr̥tigaḷuṁ maru
dēviyaruṁ pariniṣkramaṇamaṁmuṁ nōḍaloḍanebare siddhāddārthavanada naḍuvaṇa
candrakānta śilātaḷadoḷu sivigeyaniḻiṟipe śubhabhāvaneyiṁ trirātrōpa
vāsadiṁ samateyiṁ bhāvisi, bāhyābhyantara parigrahaṅgaḷaṁ, toṟeṟidu
vastrābharaṇādigaḷaṁ tolagisi, pūrvābhimukhanāgi palyaṅkāsanadoḷirdu
“namaḥ siddhēbhyaḥ” endu karpuva bēbīraṁ paṟivante kēśapāśamaṁmuṁ
paṟidu caitrabahuḷa navamiyoḷuttarāṣāḍhadomoḷu mūṟu jāvadāgaḷe
dīkṣeyaṁ kaikoṇḍaṁ āgaḷ manaḥparyayajñānamādudu. antu

caturjñājñānadharana kuntaḷamaṁ surapati ratnada padaḍalgeyoḷanḷāntukoṇḍu
pālgaḍaloḷikki pariniṣkramaṇa kalyāṇamaṁ māḍi pōdaṁ.

itta tadanantarame bharataṁ parijanaṁ bīrasu poḍamavaṭṭu nija rāja
dhānige pōvapanitta kaccha mahākaccharuṁ bharatana magaṁ marīciyuṁ
modalāge nālsāsirvarasumakkaḷ pōgaṟolollade arasanāvudanappe
nenvendu jātarūpamaṁ kaikoṇḍu pravyavr̥rṣiyarāgirdarpar. ādidēvanu
maṟiṟudiṅgaḷalladeḷllave kayyanettettinendu siniliyaṁyuṁ mēle pratimāyōgadoḷu
nilvalvuduṁ padmaniḷayeyo padmaviṣṭaravinirmisi dhavaḷātapatramaṁ piḍidirpina
amavyaktākṣara parijapōparāyaṇanāgi guñjangadgahā mahīdharakkejēṇeyādo
ḍādidēvaṁ saptardhi sampannanāgi yōgadomoḷ onderaḍu tiṅgaḷu
nile kaccha mahākaccha, marīcyādigaḷu mogamaṁ nōḍi kaiyanetti
koḷvaḷvudumaṁ kāṇapati kṣutpipāsāpīḍitarāgi paṇaṁṇṇaṁ tinnaluṁ nīraṁ
kuḍiyaluṁ kayyaṁ nīḍuvudaṁ kaṇḍu sīnīvīniravadyarūpinoḷanḷintu
negaḻaḻilāgadendu vanadēvategaḷu jaḍimodoḍañji valkalavasanaruṁ kaupīna
dhararuṁ bhasmōddhūḷitāṅgaruṁ jaṭādhararuṁ, ēkadaṇḍi, tridaṇḍigaḷu
amappa parivrājakarumāgi, phaḷajaḷaṅgaḷiṁ prāṇamaniṟisi nava (vana)
kusumaṅgaḷiṁ dēvaranarcisuttuttamire bharatana magaṁ marīci parivrājaka
vēṣanapasiddhāntadiṁ mithyātvavr̥ddhiyuṁ māḍi tanna māḍida kāpiḷa
siddhāntamaṁ yōgaśāstramaṁ tōmaṁśōṟi lōkamaṁ samyagdarśana
jñānaparāṅmukhamaṁ māḍidoṁ.

ittalādi tīrthaṅkarana tapaḥprabhāvadiṁ krūramr̥gaṅgaḷumanyōnya
vairamaṁ maṟidupaśāntaṅgaḷāge ādidēvara kuntaḷaṅgaḷuṁ beḷedu
jejaḍegaḷāge niścaḷacittasirirpannegaṁ kaccha mahākacchara makkaḷu namivinami
gaḷu bandu bandhujanakkellaṁ dēvā nīṁ nelanaṁ payiyageydeydu emma
bhāgamaṁ payiyageyvudendāgrahaṅgeykeyyiyōga vighātamaṁ māḍpuḻpuda
navadhiyiṁ dharaṇēndranaṟidu vikriyeyiṁ dēvarbbesasidantu māḍi,
vijayārdha dakṣiṇōttara śrēṇiyu gaganavallabharatha nūpura cakravāḷaṅga
ḷembiḷemberaḍu rājadhānigaḷu modalāge nūṟaṟupattu pōṟaḻalgaḷaḷga vara narasu
māḍi vajrāvartasāgarāvartaṅgaḷemba bibalgaḷaṁ gāndhāra pannaga vidyeṅgaḷa
nittu pōdaṁ.

annegamittalaṟudiṅgaḷaṁ nēṟapi kayyanettikoṇḍu caryāmārga
maṁ tōṟalu grāma nagara khēḍa kharvaḍa maḍambaṅgaḷoḷu naḍeye

kaṇḍarkaṇḍalliyemusuṟi namma paramasvāmi bandanendu vastrastu
vāhanamaṁ tandu mundiḍuvudumaprumupuvarantabiḷajanāścarya paryaṭana
doḷu maḷmattaṟudiṅgaḷpōge baṁbarisanneṟandu kurukumbhujāṅgaṇa viṣayada
hastinapuramanāḷvapurṇva kuruvaṁśada sōmaprabhaṅge dhanadēvaṁ sarvārtha
siddhiyuṁ bandu śrīyāṁsanemba tammanāgi tanagannandinabeḷagappajāvadā
gaḷu, mandarādriyuṁ, kalpavr̥kṣaṅgaḷuṁ, siṁha vr̥ṣabhaṅgaḷuṁ,
sūryēndugaḷuṁ, samudramumaṣṭamaṅgaḷadhāri bhūtarūpaṅgaḷuṁ,
tanna maneyamunde bandirpudaṁ svapnadoḷu kaṇḍu sōmaprabhaṅge
pēṟdāḻdādi brahmaṁ bappudaṁ purōhitarintarindaṟidirpudurpumāmunīśvaranu
āmāpuramaṁ pokku jaghanyōttama gr̥haṅgaḷoḷu candragatiyiṁ
saluttaṁ sōmaprabhana manege bare siddhārthanemba paḍiyaṟanaṟipe
tammirvarumarghyapādyaṅgaḷberasidireḻdu sāṣṭāṅgameṟagi poḍavaṭṭu
idirambare digambararūpamaṁ kāṇaloḍaṁ śrīmatiyāva bhavadoḷu vajra
jaṅghanuṁ tānuṁ sarpasarōvaradoḷu cāraṇayugaḷakke vidhipūrvaka
āmāhāra(mahā)dānamaṁ koṭṭudanāgaḷu puṭṭidapa bhavasaṁskāradinda
mamuṟipāvāditīrthakaranaṁ.
emba saptaguṇānvitanaṁ

emba navavidha puṇyapurassaramāgi nilisi karmabhūmiya moda
lōkādi dānatīrthapravartakaṁ śrēkaṁśrīyāṁsaṁ tammaṇṇanappa sōmaprabhanu
āmātanarasi lakṣmīmatiyuṁ berasu kanakakaḷaśadoḷu tīvida kabbinara
samaṁ pājijepātradoḷaṟivuduṁ

antu pañcāścaryaṁ negaṟi nimagakṣayadānamakkendu parasidaḍā
puṇyadinamaṁmuṁ vaiśākhaśuddha tadigeyanakṣayatr̥tīyeyemba puṇyadina

pāytta, antavarirvaru mādēvaraṁ kaḷupi maguḻdiḻdarittādi dēvara
cittavr̥ttiya nātanāvamāḻkkiḻkiyinaṟidanendu bharatēśvaranakampanādi
rājakaṁ berasubandu pūjisi besagoḷe kurudhvajaṁ pūrvabhavamodoḷu
cāraṇayugaḷakkāhāra dānamaṁ koṭṭudaṁ jātismaratvadinaṟidunegaḻdiḻdane
ne bharataṁ śrētaṁśrīyāṁsanaṁ nīne puṇyavantaneseyendu popōgaḻdu pūjisi
pōdapōೕvaṁ.

itta vr̥ṣabhanāthanuṁ maunavratadiṁ yōgayōgya pradēśamodoḷu
apavahita dhyānanāgi vihārisi saṁvatsara sahasraṅgaḷaṁ kaḷipi pūrvatāḷa
nagarada śa(ni)kaṭōdyānadālada marana keḷage nirmaḷa śilāṇāpaṭṭadoḷaṣṭa
mōpavāsadiṁ palyaṅkāsanamodoḷu pūrvābhimukhanāgi yōganiyōga
doḷ śukladhyānadiṁ ghātigaḷaṁ kiḍisi phālguna bahuḷa ēekādaśiyoḷu
uttarāṣāḍha nakṣatradoḷu pūrvāhṇadoḷu kēvala jñānōtpattiyāge
saudharmēndraṁ balāhakavikr̥ta kāmuka vimānamanēṟi bandu īśā
nēndraṁ nāgadattavikriyā samudbhūtairāvatamanēṟi bandu uḷidaṁ
dēva nikāyamuṁ tantamma vāhanamanēṟi bare saptānīka samētaṁ
kēvala jñānōtpattiya mahākalyāṇamaṁ māḍidaṁ.

itta bharatēśvaraṅge purōhitāyudhādhyakṣāntaḥpura vr̥ddha kañcuki
gaḷuṁḷu purudēvana jñānōtpattiyumaṁ cakrōtpattiyumanarkakīrti
kumāranutpattiyumanaṟipe mukhyamappa kēvalajñānapūjeyaṁ
māḻpisendu caturaṅgabalaṁ berasubandu mūṟusūḻbiḻbalagoṇḍu
gandhamālyādigaḷanarcisi palavuṁ stutigaḷaṁ stutiyise nijōcita sthāna
doḷ kuḷḷirdu vastusthitiyaṁ besagoḷe divyabhāṣeyoḷu besasida
tadavanantaraṁ bharataniṁ kiṟiyaṁ vr̥ṣabhasēnaṁ surapatigaḷindamabhyarca
mānanāgi ādijinapatiya samīpadoḷu saṁyamamaṁ kaikoṇḍu buddhi
vikriyātapōbaḷarasauṣadha kṣētra vikriyā bhēdamappaṣṭavidhardhiprāptaṁ
prathama gaṇadharanādaṁ.

tadavanantaraṁ sōmaprabhaṁ śrēbhaṁśrīyāṁsānanta vīryādigaḷuṁ dīkṣita
rāge brahmiyuṁ saundariyuṁ vivāhavimukhikheyarāgi tapamaṁ
kaikoṇḍu saundari prabhr̥tigaḷellaṁ brahmiyar gaṇanī pradhāneya
rādar. śrutakīrti śrāvakāgrajeyādaṁ, priyavrate śrāvikāpradhāne

yādaḷ. bharataputraṁ marīci poṟagāge munnaṁ bhagnataparāda kaccha
mahākacchādigaḷuṁ saṁyamamaṁ kaikoṇḍar. anantavīryaṁ muktige
sandaṁ bharatanuṁ jinapada padmakkeṟagi nijarājadhānige pōgi cakrapūjeyaṁ
māḍi śaratkāla pravēśadoḷu digvijayōdyuktanāgi munnaṁ pūrvābhi
mukhade gaṅgātaṭaṁ biḍidu naḍedu pumarudēvanemba manuvinakāladiṁ
taguḻduḻda parivr̥ddhamāgirdupasamudramaṁ pugade gaṅgāvana vēdikā
dvāradiṁ, vanamaṁ pokku nālvatteṇgāvudadanīḷada mūvattāṟu gāvuda
dagala bīḍaṁ biḍisi purōhitādi kulavr̥ddharuparōdhadiṁ trirātrōpa
vāsaṁ geydu darbhaśayanadoḷirdu, pañcaparamēṣṭhi gurugaḷge pūjeyaṁ
māḍi, paḍevaḷanaṁ paḍegaḷge kāpuvēḻdu, daśaturaṅga saṁvāhyamappa
jitañjayamemba rathamanēṟi gaṅgādvāradoḷagane lavaṇa jaladhiyaṁ
pokku panneraḍu yōjanaṁ pōdāgaḷ, rathaṁ piḍivantemāḍeḻe,
muḷidu vr̥ṣabhanāthanandanaṁ prathama cakravarti bharataṅge taddēśa madhya
vartigaḷu bandeṟaguvudembakkaramanamōghaśaradoḷbaredesuvudumadaṁ
kaṇḍu māgadhanemboṁ vyantarādhīśanāsphāsphōṭise nuḍisi mārkoṇḍu
kulavr̥ddharu tandeṟagise ratnakuṇḍaḷa hārādigaḷumanalliṁ koṇḍu dakṣiṇa
digvijayakkoḍarci vaijayanta dvāradiṁ pōgi varatanuvaṁ vaśaṅgataṁ
māḍi kavaca, kaṇṭhābharaṇa cūḍāratna, maṇimakuṭādigaḷaṁ paḍedu paḍu
vaṇa digvijayakkoḍarci sindhu mukhadoḷu prabhāsāmaranaṁsādhisi
santāna, kamāḷa, muktāhēmajāḷaṅgaḷanavanalli koṇḍu, sindhunadī
tīraṁ biḍidu, vijayārdhaparvatamaneydibare vijayārdha kumāranabhi
ṣēka pūrvakaṁ kanakabhr̥ṅgārusitātapatra siṁhāsana cāmaraṅgaḷaṁ
kuḍekoṇḍu bharatēśvaraṁ maguḻduḻi bandu, tamiśraguheya modaloḷu
balamanirisi kr̥tamāḷa maranaṁ vidhēyaṁ māḍi tiḷakādi caturdaśa
bhūṣaṇaṅgaḷaṁ kaige māḍi, sindhuvana vēdikeya tōraṇadvāradiṁ pokku
vijayārdhavēdikeya sōpānamanēṟi sindhunadiya paḍuvaṇa vēdikeya
tōraṇadvāradiṁ poṟamaṭṭu paścimakhaṇḍamanaṟudiṅgaḷge sēnā
nāyakaṁ vaśaṁmāḍi maguḻdu bare, dakṣiṇa bharatavada dēvarumanarasu
gaḷumaṁ vidyādhararumaneṟagisi mlēccha khaṇḍamaṁ bāykēḷisi cakra
pūjegeydu kaṭakamaṁ naḍeyisi sindhunadiya dvitīya bhāgavada mahā
vithīdvididatayadindaṁ guhādvāramaneydi mandagaṟtaleyoḷu maṇi,

kākiṇiya ratnaṅgaḷoḷubareva candrādityara beḷage beḷagāge sindhuvanada
taḍiviḍidu caturaṅga balaṁ berasu naḍedu sthapati ratnavinirmitamappa
sētuvindaṁ unmagnajaḷeyuṁ nimagnajaḷeyuvemmemberaḍu toṟeyumaṁ
pāydu, guheyiṁ poṟamaṭṭu vijayārdhamuttaravasōpakaṇṭhadoḷu
bīḍaṁ biṭṭu munninante paścimakhaṇḍamuṁmaṁ sēnāpatiyanaṭṭi bāykēḷisi
tānumuttarārdha madhyama khaṇḍamanaauṅki nindāgaḷ baḷākāvartarembi
rvar mlēccharājaruṭṭa vigrahamanettikoṇḍu kaḷakaḷadiṁ kaṭakamaṁ
bēsaṟisi tamma kuladayvamappa mēghamukharemba nāgarājaraṁ besasi
doḍavaru nelavellamanēkārṇavaṁvamaṁ māḍimoḍaḍiyoḷu pāsida carma
ratnamuṁ pōmuṁmēge piḍiva chatraratnamuṁ kāyvaydu cakraratnada beḷaginoḷēḻu
divasamire, kurukulāgrajeyappa sōmaprabhanamagaṁ jayakumāraṁ
sthapatiratnaviracita gaganagōcara rathaṅgaḷuṁ vajravagirigaḷuṁ berasu mēgha
mukhāmararoḷukāde, jayakumārana siṁhanādakkaṁ gaṇabaddha dēvara
jr̥mbhaṇakkaṁaḷki mēghamukharpoṟaprōrīge baḷākāvartarbaḷkuttuṁ tamma
pumakkaḷappa ebbaṇbar kanneyaraṁ mundiṭṭu tandu cakravartigeṟage jayana
ripujayakke mecci mēghēśvaranāmamumaṁ vīrāgraṇya padamumanittu
himavatparvatada sindhu prapātamaneydi sindhu dēviyindabhiṣiktanāgi
bhadrāsanamaṁ paḍedu himavatkūṭadoḷu munninante kr̥tōśōpavāsanāgi
tadviṣayavāsigaḷappa nāgayakṣādigaḷuṁḷu bandukāṇbudendu nijanāmāṅkita
śaradinise himavatkumāra prabhr̥tigaḷu bandu tīrthajaḷadinabhiṣēkaṁ
geydu gōśīrṣacandanamuvuṁmaṁ mahauṣadhigaḷumaṁ koṭṭu pōdaru.

bharatēśvaranuṁ teṅka mogadeve banduttarabharatada madhyama khaṇḍada
naḍuve vr̥ṣabhācaḷamaṁ kaṇḍu vijayapraśastiyaṁ alli bareyisuvenendu
pōgi pūrvacakravartigaḷa vijayapraśastiyuṅyaṅkaṇḍu gaḷitamadanāgi kiṟi
deḍeyuṁyaṁ daṇḍa ratnadinorasi kaḷedu vijayapraśastiyaṁ kākiṇīratnadiṁ
bareyisi gaṅgākūṭakke pōgi gaṅgādēviyindabhiṣiktanāgi siṁhāsanamaṁ
koṭṭoḍaṁ koṇḍubandu vijayārdhada kāṇḍaka prapāta guheya
baṅbeṅkeyayāṟuvannegaṁ pūrva digbhāgada mlēcchakhaṇḍamaṁ bāykēḷisa
lpōge dakṣiṇōttara śrēṇigaḷa vidyādhara rājarnamivinamigaḷu tammoḍavu
ṭṭida subhadreyemba kanyāratnamaṁ koṭṭu anarghya ratnaṅgaḷaṁ baḻiṟivaḻiṟi
goṭṭu pōge munnametteteṟidaṟudiṅgaḷāṟida kāṇḍaka prapāta guhe

yoḷagaṇinda popōṟamaḍuvāgaḷu mahākūṭanivāsi nāṭyapāmāḷāmaranidi
goṇḍu vaikakṣamaṁ kuṇḍaḷadvayamaṁmuṁ kuḍekoṇḍu pūrvadigbhāga
mlēñchakhaṇḍamumaṁ bāykēykīḷisi vanavēdikeya tōraṇadvāradiṁ pora
maṭṭu siddha digvijayanāgi ādi tīrthēśvaranaṁ kāṇalke kailāsakke vandu
mēdinī taṭadintoṭṭu mēle pañcasahasra cāpāntaramappa nabhō bhāga
doḷu saudharmēndrana besadoḷu dhanada (kubēra) nirmitamappa sama
vasaraṇamaneydi vandu dvādaśa yōjana samavr̥tta saṁsthānamu mēka
khaṇḍēndranīḷōpalaracitamuṁ pūrvādi dikcatuṣṭaya pratyēka virāja
māna pādalēpauṣadhi sāmarthyasampanna suramanuja tiryagbhavya sukhā
rōhaṇa hētubhūta maṇimayuya viṁśati sahasra sōpāna śōbhamāna
muṁ, bahirbhāgasthita makaratōraṇa śatānvitamuṁ ratnamaya sōpāna
nānāvidha dhvaja virājamānamuṁ bāhya jagatītaḷa yugaḷa pratiyugaḷa
pratiṣṭhāpita pratyēkāṣṭōttaraśata supratiṣṭha bhr̥ṅgārukaḷaśadarpaṇa
vyajana dhvaja cāmara chatrāṣṭa maṅgaḷālaṅḷaṅkr̥tamuṁ ratnadaṇḍadhara
jyōtiṣka dēva dauvārika manōharavumumantarjagatītaḷayugaḷasthita
pratyēkāṣṭōttaraśatakāḷamahākāḷa pāṇḍuka piṅgaḷanaisarpamāṇavaka
śaṅkha padma sarvaratna navanidhi parītamumappa nālkuṁ kāñcanamaya
gōpuradvāraṅgaḷindamoppuva sarvaratnacūrṇa ghaṭitamumappamaṭṭāḷa
kāvyaḷaṅkr̥tamumappa mūḷiprākāramumallindōllindoḷage nālkuṁ mahā
pīṭha madhyadoḷu prathama gōpuradvārakke garbhyōnvyōntaradoḷu pratyēka
kanakagōpura catuṣṭaya prakāratrayāṅyaṅgaḷoḷu prathama prākārābhyanta
ravana mahādikkugaḷoḷindra yama varuṇa kubēra kēḷī harmya prāsā
daṅgaḷiṁ dvitīya prākārābhyantara vanamadhya vidikkugaḷoḷagni nirr̥ruti
pavana īśānakrīḍāramya harmyaṅgaḷindamintaṣṭalōkapālakaniḷayaṁ
gaḷindaṁ, trikōṇa catuṣkōṇa samavr̥ttavāpī kaḷāpadinoppuva vanadva
yānantarantritaya prākāradindōdindoḷage vaiḍūrya kāñcana sarvaratna
mayaṅgaḷoḷage kramadineṇṭu nālku nālkuṁ bilniḍiyappa mūṟuṁ
pīṭhaṅgaḷa mēle jinabimba catuṣṭayāḷaṅkr̥ta caturasramūḷa bhāgadoḷu
samavr̥ttāgra bhāgada mēge ratnapaḷakōpa paripumutaḷa dikcatuṣṭaya sthita
purābhiṣikta jinabimbaṅgaḷoḷāndōḷita kētu cāmara maje ghaṇṭājāḷaṁ
gaḷoḷu chatratrayāḷaṅkr̥ta śikharaṅgaḷoḷaṁ neṟedu jāmbūnada ratna

maṇṭapadinoḷoppuva nālku mānastambhada prākāraṅgaḷa poṟage divija
nārījana majjanōcitaṅgaḷige maṇimaya sōpāna sphaṭikamaya
taḷaṅgaḷumappanande, nandōttare, nandavati, nandighōṣe, vijaya,
vaijayante, jayante, aāparājite, aśōke, supratiṣṭhe, buddhe, kumude,
puṇḍarīki, ānande, hr̥dayānande, mahānande, suprabuddheyendu
pūrvādiyāgondondu mānastambhakke nālku geydu samacatura
sraṅgaḷappa padināṟu bāvigaḷavaṟaṟivaṟa bāhyakōṇadvayasthita pāda
pakṣāḷanārthaṁ kāñcana kundadvayaṅgaḷiṁ neṟedu nr̥tyada kāminī nikā
yaṅgaḷiṁ nutipa śatamakha pramukhasura samūhaṅgaḷindopputirda
mithyājñāniya mānamaṁ stambhisuva mānastambhaṅgaḷiṁ mānastambhaṁ
baramēkaika jinālayāntarita vāpī, kūpa, sarōvara, samanvita vanakhaṇḍa
madhyagata pañcapañca prāsāda paṅktigaḷumaṁ mānastambhadubhaya
pārśvasthita ratnatōraṇa śataṅgaḷumaṁ, mānastambhadiṁ gavyūti mātraṁ
pōdalli pūrvōkta kramadoḷmaṇimaya sōpāna, bahuvidha dhvajābhi
rāma, bahirantarjagatītaḷa pratiṣṭhāpitāṣṭamaṅgaḷa navanidhi parītamuṁ,
jyōtiṣka, dauvārika, samētamumappa rūpyamaya gōpuradvārada
suvarṇavēdikābhyantaradoḷu sphaṭikamaṇi viḷasadubhaya taṭa ghaṭita suvarṇa
maṇimaya sōpāna śrēṇiyuṁ, jaḷa krīḍānirata sura, khacara, nārī
manōharamumanēka jaḷa cara jalakusuma ramaṇīyamumahīya
māna nirmaḷa sugandha salila bharitamumappa jaḷa khātikeyumaṁ,
dvitīya gōpura dvāradimpadindatta ratnatōraṇa śatasamēta gavyūtidva
yāntaradoḷu pūrvōkta kramadoḷ ratnamaya sōpānamumanēka
vividha dhvajavirājamānamumappaṣṭa maṅgaḷa navanidhi jyōtiramara, dauvārika,
samēta nānā ratnaracita rajatamaya gōpuradvārada hēmamaya vēdikā
bhyantaradoḷati mukta punnāganāga latālatānta parimaḷāsakta matta
madhukara kōkiḷa śukasaṅkuḷa kaḷarava manōharamumamara khacara
mithuna kēḷīviḷālāsālaṅḷaṅkr̥ta kr̥takācaḷa virājamānamumappavallī vanaṁ
gaḷumaṁ, tr̥tīya gōpuradvāradimpadindatta ratna tōraṇa śatasamanvita
yōjanāntaradoḷu maṇikhacita sōpāna bahuvidha patākāmayamu
maṣṭamaṅgaḷa nava nidhi samadhiṣṭhitamuṁ yakṣa dauvvārika rakṣitamumappa
rajata gōpuradvārada tapanīya prākārābhyantaradoḷaśōka tiḷakavakuḷa

hintāḷa tāḷa tamāḷa jambū jambīra lavaṅga nāraṅgādi vividha tarunikara
muṁ kr̥takagiri nadīpuḷinataḷa kēḷīvilasita kaḷahaṁsa cakravāka bakabalāḷā
kādi jaḷavihaga sahita sarōvara śōbhamānamuvāgi hēma prākārā
traya parivēṣṭita pīṭhatrayādhiṣṭhita prātihāryōpēta bhagavadarhadabhi
mukha paryaṅkasthita jinabimbālaṅḷaṅkr̥ta mūḷabhāga caijaityavr̥kṣōpalakṣitaṁ
gaḷāgi nālkuṁ deseyoḷamoppuva aśōka saptacchada campaka cūtavanaṅga
ḷumaṁ ratna tōraṇa śataṅgaḷineseva mahāvīthi irkeladoḷamondondu
nelegaḷoḷu mūvatteraḍu nāṭakaśāle ondondu nāṭakadoḷu mūvatti
rvarnartipar dēvāṅganeyarindoppuva mūṟu mūṟu neleya dhavaḷa
varṇaderaḍu nāṭakaśālegaḷumanavaṟa mundamumpaṇirkelaveraḍeraḍu dhūpa ghaṭaṁ
gaḷumaṁ, caturgōpuradvāradindōdindoḷage yōjanāntaradoḷu sarvaratna
ghaṭita maṇimaya sōpāna nānādhvaja virājamānamuṁ aṣṭamaṅgaḷa nava
nidhi parītamuṁ yakṣa, dauvārika dvārapāla rakṣitamumappa rūpya
gōpura dvārada hēmamaya vēdikābhyantaradoḷu pañcaviṁśati
cāpāntaramāgi gaja garuḍa mr̥gēndra, gavēndra haṁsa mayūra
kamaḷamāḷāḷacakravastralāñchanamappa daśavidhadinesedu pañcaratnamaya
stambhāgradoḷaṣṭāśītyaṅgaḷa viṣkambhadoḷondondavarke nūṟiṇṭāge
sāsiradembadeppattakkumantellaṁ nālkuṁ deseyoḷavāmāge nālsāsirada munnū
ṟirpattu pradhānadhvajaṅgaḷondondakke nūṟiṇṭāge nālkulakṣvekṣeyu
maṟuvattāṟu sāsiradaynūṟaṟuvattu parivāra dhvajaṅgaḷumaṁ, pañcama
gōpuradvāradiṁ ratna tōraṇa śatasahasrasahita yōjanāntaradoḷu
maṇikhacita sōpānamumanēkavidha dhvajābhirāmamumappa maṅgaḷa nava
nidhi samanvitamuṁ nāga pratihāra pāḷitamumappa rajatamayagōpura
