dvārada arjunavarṇaśāḷābhyantaradoḷu pūrvōkta vana varṇōpē
tamuṁ daśavidha kalpavr̥kṣa samōpētamuṁ prākāra tritayābhyantara pīṭha
trayādhiṣṭhitamumappa nālkuṁ deseya sumēru mandāra santāna
pārijāta taru mūlasthita bhagavadarhadabhimukha kāyōtsargasiddha
pratimegaḷumaṁ, ratna tōraṇaśataśōbhita mahāpīṭhaṭhīvibhāgōbhaya
pārśvasthita tritaḷadhavaḷaṅgaḷuṁ dvātriṁśannaṭarapura sundarī nayana
saundara dvātriṁśatuprēkṣaṇaṇika ramaṇīyamumappa nāṭyaśālādvayaṁ
gaḷumanavaṟa mundamumpaṇikkeladoḷamatibahuḷa kāḷāgaru dhūpa dhūma

vyōmāḷa śikharaṅgaḷapperaḍeraḍu dhūpaghaṭaṅgaḷumaṁ,aṣṭa gōpura dvāra
dinoḷage yōjanāntarambōdalli ratnamaya sōpāna bahuprakāra
dhvajavirājamānamuṁ maṅgaḷanidhi samētamuṁ ratnadaṇḍadhara dharaṇēndra
rakṣitamumappa rajatagōpuradvārada kanakamaya vēdikābhyāntaradoḷu
vajrādhiṣṭhāna bandhuramuṁ śānmuṁhānta kumbhamaya stambhamuṁ candra
kāntōpaḷa bhittiyuṁ dvitaḷa tritaḷa catusthaḷa saptataḷādi virājitamuṁ
jinābhiṣēka jinacarita gītanartana nirata suramithuna śata sanāthamuṁ
āndōḷitānēka patākā kīrṇamuṁ svastika sarvatōbhadradhavaḷābhi
jvajbadanānāchvanbhyanda saundaramumappa prāsāda paṅktigaḷumaṁ mahāvīthī
mamādhyadoḷu ratna tōraṇa śatāntaritaṅgaḷuṁ chatratraya camararuha
kiṅkiṇī māḷikālaṅkāraṅgaḷumappa jinasiddha pratimā saṅkīrṇamuṁ
sakala janārjircita padmarāga māṇikyamaya navanavasūptaṅgaḷumaṁ, sapta
gōpura dvāradindoḷagaṇardha yōjanāntaradoḷu ratnamaya sōpāna
nānādhvaja virājimānamuṁ maṅgala nidhi paripūrṇamuṁ, maṇikhacita
daṇḍadhara kalpāmara dauvvārika paripāḷitamumappa marakata
maya gōpura dvāradākāraśa sphaṭika prākārābhyantaradoḷu śrīmaṇḍapa
mākāśa sphaṭika navamavēdikeyaṁ koyantoṭṭudūḷa prākārambaraṁ nīḷda
mahāvīthīgaḷiḷakkeladoḷaṁ kṣullakadvāra rājavirājamānāmaḷa sphaṭika bhitti
gaḷoḷamubhayōbhaya vīthyantarāḷaṅgaḷoḷu navamavēdikeyaṁ koyantoṭṭu
ākāśa sphaṭikaṁ prākārambaraṁ baḷederaḍākāśa sphaṭika bhittigaḷoḷaṁ
vibhāgaṁ baḍeva panneraḍu kōṣṭhaṅgaḷoḷuṁ dakṣiṇānukramadoḷuṁḷaṁ gaṇa
dharādhīśvara vargamuṁ kalpāmara kāntānikāyamuṁ upāsakāṅganā
saṅgi janasamājamuṁ jyōtiramara yuvati samitiyuṁ vānavyantara
nitambinī nikurumbamuṁ, bhavanavāsi vanitā samūhamuṁ bhavanapaja
samājamuṁ vānavyantara santatiyuṁ jyōtirdēva samudayamuṁ
kalpa divija samudayamuṁ namuṁsaranikurumbamuṁ tiryak tatiyu
membī dvādaśa gaṇaṅgaḷumaṁ intanukramadoḷirda samavasaraṇa
bhūmaṇḍaḷadoḷu tīrthakara paramadēvōtsēdha dvādaśa gaṇōtsē
dhaṅgaḷumappa gōpura mānastambha prāsāda caityālaya kr̥takaparvata
caityavr̥kṣa dhvajastambha siddhārtha drumasthūla lakṣmīmaṇḍapāśōka
vr̥kṣamembivumuṁ tīrthakarōtsēdhakke caturguṇōtsēdhamuṁ krama

hāniyumappa prākāraṅgaḷumaṁ samarundramumappavēdigaḷumavarke
sātirēkamenipa tōraṇaṅgaḷumaṁ nōmaṁsōḍuttuṁ aṣṭama gōpuradvāradiṁ
doḷage gavyūtyantaradoḷirda vaiḍūrya kanaka sarvaratnamayaṅgaḷu
māgi yathākramadineṇṭeṇṭu nāsālku nāsālkuṁ daṇḍōcchritaṅgaḷumaṁ
pañcāśadadhika saptaśatārdhāṣṭa śatasahasra cāpaviṣkambhagaḷumappavaṟamēge
kramadoḷu nālkuṁ deseyoḷēka cāpōcchrita dharmacakradhara yakṣariṁ
daśavidha mahāyakṣadhvajaṅgaḷinaṣṭamaṅgaḷa navanidhigaḷinoppuva mūṟuṁ
pīṭhaṅgaḷumaṁ tripradakṣiṇaṁ geydu, tr̥tīya pīṭhada mēge ṣaḍdaṇḍa
śatavistāramuṁ navadaṇḍa śatōtsēdhamumappa gandhakuṭiya madhyama
bhāgamanaḷaṅkarisirda nānāratnamayamappa siṁhāsanamuṁ, nālveraḷaṁ
taradoḷu pumuṭṭade pañcaśata cāpōtsēdhanuṁ, samacchrēdhanuñcaturasrasaṁsthā
nanuṁ, aṣṭōttaraśatalakṣaṇa navaśata vyañjanāḷaṅkārakāyanumakhiḷa
bhuvana bhavyajana nayana śaradamr̥takaranikarāyamāṇa śātakumbhastambha
śumbhadvapuḥ, prabhāvaḷayavijita sakaḷa jyōtirlōka viḷasadaṁśumaṇḍa
ḷanuṁ, jagatrayaiśvarya prakāśana karātapatratrayanuṁ, yakṣakumāraka
rāndōḷita kṣīrāmbōnidhi vīcīrucira catuḥṣaṣṭi cāmaranuṁ,vinēya
vilōcana cañcarīka nicaya nicitāśōkānōkahanuṁ, sānandabr̥ndā
raka vādyamānamandra ninada gambhīra dundubhiyuṁ, sunr̥tya tribhuva
nōdyāna madhukarārabdhamadhu sudhāpānaka santānaka prabhr̥ti sura
kusumāsāranuṁ, aśēṣabhāṣā svabhāva sarvārdharthamāgadhīya parārdhartha
bhāṣā sudhāsārasantata santarpita divija manuja tiryak vinēyanu
māvirbhūta catustriṁśadatiśayanumamarapati sahasra cakṣura paryāpta
saundaryāvaḷōkanaṁnuṁ ahamahamikāvinamadamara nivaha mumakuṭa
saṅghaṭṭa vighaṭṭamāna muktāmaṇi prakara vihata pādapīṭhōpakaṇṭha
mahītaḷōpahāranumāgirdaśēṣa jagadatiśayāvaha puṇyapuñja
mūrtiyanamarapati saṅgīta saṅgīyamāna kīrtiyanarhadbr̥ndāra
karananādi bhaṭṭārakaraṁ prathama cakrēśvaraṁ kaṇḍu uttamāṅgōttaṁ
sīkr̥tāñjaḷipuṭa kañjakuṭmaḷālaṅkr̥ta bhūtaḷanāgi :

lg.l: sāndrībhūta mr̥gēndra viṣṭara taṭī māṇikya dīpāvaḷiḥ
prajñāpāra mitassa ēva gatavān pāraṁ savipaśruta
skandhābdhīḥbdhēḥ guṇaratna bhūṣaṇa iti ślāghyassa viēvadhruvaṁ
nīyantē jijana yēna karṇa hr̥dayālaṅkāratāṁ tvadguṇāḥ

div.p:
va॥endintu cakrēśvaranamarajana karṇāñjaḷi nipīyamāna
svarāmr̥taṅgaḷappatiśaya stutigaḷiṁ stutiyisi vr̥ṣabhasēna gaṇāgraṇigaḷa
niṭilakaṭa śikhara ghaṭamānakarapuṭaṅgaḷiṁ bandisi nijōcita sthānadoḷu
kuḷḷirdu samasta vastusthitiyaṁ besagoṇḍu nissaṁśayanāgi samava
saraṇa maṇḍaḷadiṁ podimpōṟamaṭṭipaṭṭaṟuvattu sāsiravarṣaṁ digvijayaṁ geydu,
ayōdhyeyaṁ puguvāgaḷu cakraratnaṁ pugave nindudaṁ kaṇḍā cakraskhaḷa
nakke manaskhaḷanamāge, purōhitaratnamaṁ besagoṇḍoḍātanintendaṁ.

dēvā, ninage rājakamellameṟagidudondī bāhubali kumāraṁ
modalāge ninna tammandirellaṁ ninageṟagevemba madadoḷirda parparadavaṟiṁ
cakraṁ pugade māṇdudesene kumārarallige śāsana cararanaṭṭivadaḍabhimāna
dhanarappanibarumeṟagalollade paricchēdisi nijaguru caraṇamūladoḷu
tapamaṁ kaikoḷvudumadaṁ kēḷdu bharatanāścaryambaṭṭu, manadoḷe
mecci, bāhubali kumāranalligamāsthitiyoḷōleyumaṁ dūtaru
manaṭṭidoḍe, lēkhavārtertā karṇanadoḷati kupitanuṁ samarasannaddhanu
māgi banda dūtaraṁ kaḷipe, bharatēśvaraṁ muḷidu naḍederaḍuṁ paḍe
yoḍḍi kāduvāgaḷubhaya balada mantrigaḷiḷarvarumarasugaḷappoḍe
caramadēhadhārigaḷirvarttartrammoḷōrōrvaraṁ nōyisaluṁ kolalu

māṟaradaṟindivara yuddhamembudu krūragraha yuddhadante sakaḷa
jana kṣayakaramudaṟoḷīvandapudendu tammoḷe samumakaṭṭi dharma
yuddhakke bharata bāhubaligaḷanoḍambaḍisi balameraḍuṁ miḍukade
nōḍuvantu niyamisidāgaḷu bāhubali bharatanaṁ dr̥ṣṭiyuddha jaḷa
yuddhadoḷu geldu mallayuddhadoḷu poṇardu palagāyaṅgaḷoḷu
poṇardu śrāntavādāgaḷu bharatanaṁ piḍidetti nelakkikkuvuduṁ bharataṁ
siggāgi cakraratnamuṁmaṁ besasidoḍamupu bandu bāhubaliyaṁ balagoṇḍu
nile tammaṇṇana rājyamōhadoḷāda ajñātegaṁ saṁsārada asārategaṁ
pēsi bharatanallige bandaṇṇa sigganuḷivudu nīsī sāmrājyamu nāvagaṁ
kaikoḷvudenagidēnuṁ bārteyillendu tapaścaraṇa niratamananādanāgaḷuṁ
bharataṁ paścāttāpanāgi bāhubaliya kālampiḍidentunoḍambaḍisalāṟade
yire bāhubali, mahābaḷiyemba tanna maganaṁ padaviyoḷniṟisi puru
dēvanallige vandu vinamitanāgi dīkṣeyaṁ kaikoṇḍu gurumatadiṁ
dvādaśāṅga caturdaśa pūrvamaṁ kaltēka vihāriyāgi saṁvatsarāvadhi
varaṁ pratimāyōgadoḷuninda bāhubaliya meyya naḍarva baḷḷigaḷaṁ
khēcariyaru brāhmī saundariyar rūpugoṇḍu sarasaṁ nuḍidu
biḍisi kaḷedar.

annegaṁ bāhubali munīndraṅge kēvala jñānōtpattiyāgadu
darkke bharataṁ vismayambaṭṭu pōgi vr̥ṣabhanāthanaṁ besagoṇḍoḍe indu
bharatana nelanaṁ innuṁ meṭṭirdenemba mānakaṣāyamaṁ kaḷeyaloḍaṁ,
kēvala jñānōtpattiyāgi yaṇagāra kēvaḷiyakkumendu besase bharataṁ
bāhubali muniyallige bandeṟagi mānakaṣāyamuṁmaṁ kaḷeye jñānō
tpattiyāge munīndraraṁ pūjisi bandu ayōdhyeyaṁ pokku māgadhavara
tanu prabhr̥tigaḷappa dēvaruṁ vidyādhararuṁ makuṭabaddharumirdu ṣōḍaśa
manuvuṁ cakradharanuṁ rājarājanuṁ ṣaṭkhaṇḍapatiyumendu siṁhāsana
doḷirisi tīrthajaḷaṅgaḷinabhiṣēkaṅgeyya bharata mahīśaṁ grāmamu nagara
khēḍa, kharvaḍa, maḍamba paṭṭaṇa drōṇāmukha, saṁvāhādi māsaṁ, vajrādi
sthānasahitamappa trimāgadha lāṭa, vatsaḷa, mahārāṣṭra, kaṭuka, lakṣaṇa
mappaṣṭādaśabhāṣā parivr̥ta ṣaḍkhaṇḍa bharatamanēkachachchatracchāyā yattamaṁ
ājñāvidhēyamaṁ māḍi vajra, vr̥ṣabha, nārāca śarīra saṁhanananu samu
caturasra saṁsthānanuṁ niṣṭapta kanakavarṇanuṁ pañcaśata śarāsanōtsē
dhanuṁ catuḥṣaṣṭilakṣaṇadharanumanēka vyañjanāḷaṅkr̥tanuṁ catura śīti

lakṣa pūrvanapavartyāyuṣyanuṁ, ananta vīryanuṁ, apratihata śāsanu
māgi mūṟavattirchāsirajanapadakkaṁ, mūṟavattirchāsirvarmakuṭabaddha
rggaṁrgaṁ, mūṟavattirchāsirvarvidyādhara dēviyarggaṁrgaṁ, mūṟavattirchāsirvar
janapada kalyāṇiyarggaṁrgaṁ, mūṟavattirchāsirvarupakalyāṇiyarggaṁrgaṁ,
antu tombhattāruṟu sāsiramandantaḥpurakkaṁ, mūṟavattirchāsira saṅgīta
saṅgata nāṭyaśālegaḷgaṁ peḷgaṁeṇbatttattu sāsira puraṅgaḷgaṁ, tombhattāṭuṟukōṭi
grāmaṅgaḷaṁ, tombhattombaisāsira drōṇāmukhaṅgaḷgaṁ, nālvatte
ṇṭāsira pattanaṅgaḷgaṁ padinārusāsira khēḍaṅgaḷgaṁ, aivattāṟantara
dvīpaṅgaḷgaṁ, padinālsāsira saṁvāhanaṅgaḷgaṁ, ēkakōṭi pramāṇasthāyi
gaḷgaṁ, ondulakṣa kōṭi halaṅgaḷgaṁ, mūṟuṟakōṭi gōmaṇḍalaṁ
gaḷgaṁ, eṇṇūṟu kukṣi nivāsigaḷgaṁ, irpatteṇṭāsira durgāṭavigaḷgaṁ
padineṇṭāsira mlēccharājarggaṁrgaṁ eṇbattunālkulakṣa bhadrahastigaḷgaṁ anite
rathaṅgaḷgaṁ,padineṇṭukōṭi jātyaśvaṅgaḷgaṁ,embhattunālkukōṭi padāti
balaṅgaḷgaṁ, adhipatiyāgi peputtaṁ laukikavārtā nirvartanamappa palavuṁ
pajñiṇaṇyaṅgaḷuṁ, ṣaṭkarma sādhana vastugaḷuṁ, divyaśayyāsana nānā sadanaṁ
gaḷuṁ, gōdhūmādi dhānyaṅgaḷuṁḷgaṁ,ghr̥tādi rasaṅgaḷuṁ, kṣaumamu dukū
lādi vividha vastraviśēṣaṅgaḷuṁ,strīpurṣayōgya vividhābharaṇaṅgaḷuṁ,nīti
śāstramuṁ, praharaṇaṅgaḷuṁ, ārkoḷvanḷvaḍantavada kanakarāsigaḷuṁ, padma
rāga marakata vajramuktāphaḷālādi ratnaṅgaḷumananukramadinda śrīgr̥ha
doḷpuṭṭiḷpaṭṭa, kuḍupa, kāḷa mahākāḷa, naisarpa pāṇḍuka, padma,
piṅgaḷa, māṇavaka, śaṅkha, sarvaratnaṅgaḷembī navanidhigaḷumāyudha
śāleyoḷpuṭṭidaḷpaṭṭava, cakrāsidaṇḍa chatraratnaṅgaḷuṁ, śrīgr̥hadoḷpuṭṭiḷpaṭṭada
maṇi, carma, kākiṇeṇi, ratnaṅgaḷuṁ, vijayārdhadoḷpuṭṭiḷpaṭṭada gajāśva
strīratnaṅgaḷumayōdhyeyoḷpuṭṭidaḷpaṭṭava sēnāpati, gr̥hapati, sthapati,
purōhita ratnaṅgaḷuṁ, intu padinālku jīvājīva ratnagaḷuṁ, padi
nāṟu sāsirvarggargaṇabaddha dēvaruṁ, kṣiti sāgaramemba prākārakamuṁ,
sarvatrōbhadramemba gōpuramuṁ,nandyāvartamemba śibira nivēśamuṁ,
vaijayantiyemba prāsādamuṁ, diksvastikamemba sabhābhūmiyuṁ,
suvidhiyemba saṅkramaṇayaṣṭiyuṁ, girikūṭamemba digāvaḷōkana
gr̥hamuṁ, varddhardhamānamemba prēkṣāgr̥hamuṁ, mahāgharmāntamemba
dhārāgr̥hamuṁ, gr̥ha kūṭamemba varṣāvāsamuṁ, puṣkalāvatiyemba
śayana sadanamuṁ, kubēbīra kāntamemba bhaṇḍāramuṁ, vasudhāraka
memba kōṣṭhāgāramuṁ, jīmūtamemba majjana gr̥hamuṁ, vasantike

yemba ratnamāḷeyuṁ, dēvaramyamemba paṭakuṭiyuṁ, siṁhavāhini
yemba śayyeyuṁ, anuttaramemba siṁhāsanamuṁ, yakṣakara vidhūya
mānaṅgaḷappa anupamānaṅgaḷemba mūvatteraḍu cāmaraṅgaḷuṁ, vidyu
tprabhaṅgaḷemba maṇikuṇḍaḷaṅgaḷuṁ, viṣamōcikegaḷemba pāvugegaḷuṁ,
abhēdyamemba kavacamuṁ, ajitañjayamemba rathamuṁ, vajrakāṇḍamemba
cāpamuṁ, amōghamemba śaramuṁ, vajradaṇḍamemba śaktiyuṁ, siṁhā
ṭakamemba kontamuṁ, lōhavāhiniyemba surigeyuṁ, manōvēga
membameñja kaṇeyuṁ, bhūtamukhamemba khēṭamuṁ, sudarśanamemba cakra
ratnamuṁ, caṇḍavēgamemba daṇḍaratnamuṁ, vajramayamemba carma
ratnamuṁ, cūḍāmaṇiyemba maṇiratnamuṁ, cintāmaṇiyemba kākiṇī
ratnamuṁ, sūryaprabhavemmemba chatraratnamuṁ, saunandakamemba khaḷga
ratnamuṁ, ayōdhyamemnemba sēnāpati ratnamuṁ,buddhisāgaranemba purō
hita ratnamuṁ, kāmavr̥ṣṭiyemba gr̥ha pati ratnamuṁ, bhadramukhanemba
sthapatiyuṁ,vijayārdhaparvatamemba gajaratnamuṁ, pavanañjayamembaśva
ratnamuṁ, subhadreyumyamba kanyāratnamuṁ, dvādaśa yōjanambaramesevā
nandigaḷemba panneraḍu bhērigaḷuṁ, anite vijayayu ghōṣaṅgaḷemba paṭahaṁ
gaḷuṁ, gambhīrāvartanamembippattāttnālku śaṅkhaṅgaḷuṁ, nālvatteṇṭukōṭi
patākegaḷuṁ, vīrāṅgadaṅgaḷemba hastakaṭakaṅgaḷuṁ, mahākalyāṇamemba
divyāhāramuṁ, amr̥ta rūpaṅgaḷemba bhakṣyarūpaṅgaḷuṁ amr̥ta kalpa
memba svādyamuṁ amr̥tamemba pānamuṁ bēmumbeṟasintu sāmrājya sahita
nāgi

emba daśāṅga bhōgadoḷu kūḍi sukhadi nirdōrme dānaṁ guḍuvaḍe
tapōdhanakkorkkoḷvarallar gr̥hastharoḷ dānakke yōgyarārendāraydvaydu
mendondu puṇyadinadoḷosageyuṁ nevaṁ māḍi haritāṅkura phaḷa
puṣpādigaḷanaramaneyoḷagaṁ poṟagaṁ kepaṟisi makuṭabaddha prabhr̥tigaḷa
nosagege barisidoḍellarumavaṁ meṭṭibare kelarvivēkigaḷaprāsuka
mendu baralolladire prāsukamappa pāmārgamoḷavaraṁ tarise nīmivaraṁ
ēke bandudillene haritāṅkura puṣpa pallavādigaḷē kēndriya śarīraṁ

gaḷavaṟoḷu sūkṣma bōdhara nirōdha prāṇigaḷu pratikṣaṇamanantānantraṁntaṁ
sāvuta puṭṭuta mirkumendādi bhaṭṭārakaralli kēḷdiḷdavadaṟiṁ parigragr̥hī
tōpavāsaka vravr̥taruṁ trasa parihārā prayatna parāyaṇarumappemage
parvadinadoḷuge sthāvara mardana nivr̥ttipūrva kōpavāsamuṁ, brahma
carya vratamuṁ, nirantara dēvapūjā vidhānamuṁ, berasirpuvadaṟiṁ
mahā vravr̥taṅgaḷoḷu manasthāvaraṅgaḷuṁ parvadinadoḷinḷandemagōvalvē
ḻkumendēkēndriya bādhā parihārārthaṁ sāvadya pathadoḷu bārade
niravadya pathamodoḷu bandevembudumavara nuḍiyaṁ kēḷdu, mecci padma
nidhiyiṁ tanda sūtradōḷavaravara selegaḷanaṟivantēka sūtramādiyā
gēkādaśa sūtramanmuntamappa yajñōpavītama navarge māḍi mannisi,
bharatēśvaraṁ munnamādi dēvaralli samākarjirṇitōpāsakādhyayanarappuda
ṟinarhatpūjālakṣaṇamappa ijyeyuṁ asi masi kr̥ṣyādi śuddha pravr̥tti
yindhanārjanaṅgeyva vārteyuṁ dayā davatti modalāda caturvidha
dattiyuṁ,tatvajñāna lakṣaṇamappa svādhyāyanamuṁ, aṇuvrata pravartana
mappa saṁyamamuṁ, anaśanādi lakṣaṇamappa tapamumembārya
ṣaṭkarmaṅgaḷumaṁ, mattamayvattumūṟu garbhādhānādi garbhānvaya
kriyegaḷumaṁ,nālvatteṇṭavatārādi dīkṣānvaya kriyegaḷumaṁ,saptavidha
mappa jātyādi paramasthāna kr̥tānvaya kriyegaḷumaṁ avaṟa vidhigaḷuma
navayavaṅgaḷumaṁ mantraṅgaḷumaṁ saprapañcamaṁ pēḻdavarge
brāhmaṇaruṁ,suśrutaruṁ,mānārharuṁ,nistārakōttamaruṁ,dvijaruṁ
bhūmi dēvarumendu pesaraniṭṭu nimma putrapautrādigaḷellamīyanda
doḷe naḍesuvudendappays pōysipōgalvēḻdu, mattondu divasaṁ niśāvasāna
samayadoḷu dusvapnaṅgaḷaṁ kaṇḍādibhaṭṭārakanaṁ besagoḷalendu kaiḷālā
sakke bandu dēvarige bhaktipūrvakameṟagaloḍa mavadhi puṭṭittāgaḷu bharata
nendaṁ, dēvara besanilladeyuṁ enna māḍida viprakula minnēnanakku
membudumenna kaṇḍa padināṟuṁ dusvapnaṅgaḷa phalamaṁ besasimene, nīnā
dvijanma jātiyanoḷḷittaṁ māḍideyendannevaragamoḷḷittāge naḍeguṁ
kālāntaramodoḷaṁ dravyalōbhadiṁ pāpigaḷuṁ krūrarumapparavaṟa
nannegaṁ sadācārarāgi naḍevaraṁ naḍeyalīvudendu dusvapnaṅgaḷa
nintendu besasidaru.

bharatamaṇḍaḷadoḷappatrattamūṟu siṁhaṁ krīḍisuttirdudaṁ kaṇḍu
daṟiṁ bharatadoḷannibaru tīrthakarara vihāradoḷu prācuryadiṁ

pāṣaṇpaṇḍigaḷāgarādaḍappaḍaṁ percarjalāṟaṟiru. kiśōra kēsariya saṁmukhakke
bārade peṟapeṟage barppa mr̥gaṅgaḷaṁ kaṇḍudaṟiṁ paścima tīrthakara
kāladoḷapagata vijr̥mbharāgiyuṁ mattaṁ prabaḷarapparu. madagaja
bhāramanāsanalāṟade bennanaṟimu naḍevahayamaṁ kaṇḍudaṟiṁ manō
vākkāya baḷadiṁ mahāpuruṣaru nirvahisuva mūlōttara guṇaṁ
gaḷaṁ tadbalahīnarumalpa satvaruṁ, nirvahisalāṟade, gurukuḷamaṁ
dūṣisuvaru. vividha tarulatākṣupavīrutpatra pallavāṅkuraṅgaḷanollade
śuṣkapatraṅgaḷaṁ mēvajakukkuḷamaṁmuṁ kaṇḍudaṟiṁ laukika janaṅgaḷuṁ
sāmānika janaṅgaḷuṁ tantamma samucitācaraṇamanapamānisi lōlupta
rāgi duścaritradoḷesaguvaru. madagajamanēṟiva kōḍagamaṁ kaṇḍuda
ṟindādi kṣatriya vināśamodoḷu vyādharuṁ duṣkulīnarumarasugaḷāgi
hitāhita vivēka vikaḷamatigaḷu anyāyadoḷu pravartisuvaru. kāge
gaḷu gūgegaḷaṁ musuṟi bādhisuvadaṁ kaṇḍudaṟinanyaliṅgigaḷu laukika
dharmatatvamaṁ apratibandhadiṁ prakaṭaṁ māḷpuḷpadu maruḷgaḷāḍuvudaṁ
kaṇḍudaṟiṁ dēvatā mūḍharappa janaṅgaḷātmīya kuḷaguṇanāmaṅgaḷaṁ
pattuviṭṭu pāpasahita nāmakaraṇadoḷu niyuktarapparu tīvida keṟe
naḍubattidudaṁ kaṇḍudaṟinaydaneya kālada kaḍeyoḷu pratyanta
vāsaṅgaḷoḷallade naḍunāḍoḷaṟināgadu. dhūḷīdhūsaritamāda ratna
rāśiyuṁ kaṇḍudaṟiṁ buddhitapōvikriyauṣadhi rasabaḷālākṣīṇa r̥ddhipara
rappa tapōdhanarāgaru. gandhamālyādigaḷinarcisirda siṁhāsanamanēṟi
nāysruganuṇe kaṇḍudaṟiṁ virati pramāda kaṣāyādi dōṣaduṣṭa
rappavarane pātrabhūtarendu mannisi janaṅgaḷu dānaṅguḍuvaru. kele
yuttaṁttuṁ barppa taruṇa vr̥ṣabhanaṁ kaṇḍudaṟiṁ dharmārtha kāmamōkṣa
prayōjanaṅgaḷoḷu manuṣyarāhārābhaya bhaiṣajya maithuna parigraha
sañjñāprakr̥ṣṭa balamilladudaṟiṁ bālakāladoḷaṁ vairāgyade negaḷvaru
madhyama vayasadoḷaṁ vārdhikyadoḷaṁ negaḻiṟiru parivēṣaṅgoṇḍa
candranaṁ kaṇḍudaṟindavadhi manaḥparyayātmakamappa pratyakṣa jñāni
gaḷāgaru. eraḍu vr̥ṣabhamoḍane barpudaṁ kaṇḍudaṟi nādyākr̥ti
saṁhananāpagamadoḷu balamilladudaṟinēkavihāramaṁ pattuviṭṭu muni
gaḷu samudāya vāsigaḷapparu. mugilaṁ musuṟida nēsaraṁ kaṇḍu
daṟiṁriṁ kēvaḷa jñānigaḷāgaru. patrapallavāṅkura virahita taruvaṁ kaṇḍu

daṟiṁ strīpuruṣaru dhr̥ti śauca satyādi sādhuvr̥tta vimukharapparu.
taṟigeleya puñjamaṁ kaṇḍudaṟindamamr̥ta madhujīvana rujāharādi
sāradravyaṅgaḷallada asāradravya vikalpaṅgaḷe manuṣyargupabhōga pari
bhōga hētugaḷakkuṁ embuempu mundappa dusvapna phalaṅgaḷaṁ ādibhaṭṭā
rakaru besase kēḷdu bharatarājaṁ dēvarge vinayayu vinamitōttamāṅga
nāgi pōgi tanna poḻila gōpura dvāradoḷu caturviṁśati tīrthakarara
nāppopoḻtuṁ smarisalendu hēmanirmitamuṁ ratnakhacitaṅgaḷumappa
yippattunālku ghaṇṭājālaṅgaḷoḷaniṟisidoḍaṁ kaṇḍu janaṅgaḷellaṁ
maṅgalakriyegaḷoḷu vandanamālegaḷoḷu māḍalu taguḷdaru.

mattondu divasaṁ bharatēśvaraṁ kaiḷālāsakke pōgi dēvaraṁ gaṇa
dhaphara dēvaraṁ bandisi tadanantaraṁ vr̥ṣabhasēnaruṁ, kumbharuṁ, dr̥ḍha
ratharuṁ, śatadhanaruṁ,dēvaśarmaruṁ,dēvabhāvaruṁ, nandanaruṁ,sōma
dattaruṁ, sūradattaruṁ,mayūraśarmaruṁ, vāyuśarmaruṁ,yaśō
bāhuvuṁ, dēvāgniyumagnidēvaruṁ, agniguptaruṁ, mitrāgniyuṁ,
haḷadhaphararuṁ,mahīdhaphararuṁ,mahēndraruṁ,paruṁvasudēvaruṁ,vasundhararuṁ,
acaḷaruṁ, mēruvuṁ,dhanamēruvuṁ, sarvayaśaruṁ,mērubhūtiyuṁ,
sarvajñaruṁ, sarvaguptaruṁ, sarvapriyaruṁ, sarvadēvaruṁ, sarva
vijayaruṁ,vijayaguptaruṁ,vijayamitraruṁ,vijayabhadraruṁ,vihaḷaruṁ,
aparājitaruṁ,vasumitraruṁ,viśvasēnaruṁ,sādhuṣēṇaruṁ,satyadēvaruṁ
dēvasatyaruṁ, satyaguptaruṁ, satyamitraruṁ, nirmaḷaruṁ, vinītaruṁ,
saṁvararuṁ,muniguptaruṁ, munidattaruṁ, muniyajñaruṁ,munidēva
ruṁ,dēvaguptaruṁ,yajñamitraruṁ,yajñaruṁ,svayambhuvuṁ, bhagadēva
ruṁ,bhagadattaruṁ,bhagaphalguvuṁ,guptaphalguvuṁ,prajāpatiyuṁ,sarvasiṁha
ruṁ,varuṇaruṁ; dharumphanapāḷaruṁ, tēruntījōrāśiyuṁ,mahāvīraruṁ, mahā
ratharuṁ,viśālaruṁ,mahābalaruṁ,suviśālaruṁ,vajraruṁ,vajrasāraruṁ,
candracūḷaruṁ, mēghēśvararuṁ, mahāsvararuṁ, kaccharuṁ, mahākaccha
ruṁ,namiyuṁ,vinamiyuṁ,baḷanuṁ,atibaḷanuṁ bhadrabaḷanuṁnadiyuṁ
mahābhōgiyuṁ,nandimitraruṁ,kāmadēvaruṁ,manassamararu membe
ippabbattu nālvargaṇadhapharara purāṇaṅgaḷaṁ kēḷdalli mēghēśvararembeppabba
ttombhattaneya gaṇadhapharadēvara purāṇamaṁ vinayapūrvakaṁ bharatarājaṁ

besagoḷe; gaṇadhara dēvēndra cakravartigaḷgallade poṟamaḍada divyadhvani
yoḷādi bhaṭṭārakarintendu besasidaru.

jambūdvīpada bharatakṣētrada kāśīviṣayada vāraṇāsīpuramanāḷva
nāthavaṁśāgragaṇyanakampananembonātana mahādēviyayumitaprabheyemba
ḷīīrvargaṁ hēmāṅgada, ratnāṅgada, sukētu, sukānta, pramukharā
sirvartanujaruṁ, salōcaneyuṁ, lakṣmīmatiyumembīrvartanuje
yarumādaralli, sulōcane, sumatiyemba, dādiyōdise sarvakalā
kuśaleyāgi navayauvanōdayadoḷu kārtīka nandīśvaradoḷara
maneya keladudyānavanada jinabhavanadoḷu eḷdiḷudivasaṁ jinapūjeyaṁ
nirvartisi siddhaśēṣeyuṁ koṇḍubandu siṁhāsanāsīnanāgirda tamma
yyaṅge kuḍuvāgaḷātanumāsanadindiḻidu karakamaḷa sampuṭa karaṇa
prakaṭīkr̥ta jinapati bhaktiviśēṣadiṁ śēṣamālyā dānapūrvakaṁ tale
yoḷiṭṭukoṇḍupavāsa pariśrama paripraśnānantaraṁ pārisalpōgavēḻiṟi
kanyābhavanakke pōdaḷ.

ittalakampananuṁ tanna magaḷu vivāhayōgyeyādudanaṟidu
cintākrāntanāgi śrutārtha siddhārtha sarvārtha sumatigaḷemba nālvaru
mantrigaḷaṁ besagoḷe śrutārthanendaṁ: ṣaḍkhaṇḍapatiyuṁ tribhuvanapati
sutanuṁ caramadēhadharanumenisida bharatarājaṅge kuḍuvudene siddhārtha
nendaṁ: bharatanappaḍe pariṇatavayanavadaṟiṁ samavayasanappa bharatanandanaṁ
garkakīrtige kuḍuvudalladandu paudanapurādhīśvara bāhubalidēvana
magandiru subaḷiḷa ratnabaḷiḷa sahasrabaḷiḷa pramukharoḷōrvaṅge kuḍu
vudu. mēṇ pūrvatāḷa puramanāḷva mahāmaṇḍaḷēśvaraṁ vr̥ṣabha
sēnaṅge puṭṭidanantasēnaṅge kuḍuvudu. alladandu kurukulatilakaṁ
sōmaprabhana makkaḷappa vijaya sañjayanta, jayanta prabhr̥tigaḷaṁ
piriyaṁ jayakumāraṅge kuḍuvudu koṭṭandu kurukula sambandha
mavicchinnamāginaḍeguṁ mattaṁ bhīmarathaṁ rathavara vajrāyudha bhīma
bhujādigaḷirdaravaroḷōrvaṅge kuḍuvudene sarvārthanendaṁ: bhūcara
sambandhaṁ namagendumuṇṭu khēcara sambandhamapūrvamadaṟiṁ kaccha
mahākaccharanvayada sunami vinamigaḷoḷagōrvaṅge kuḍuvudene
sumatiyendaṁ:āroḷaṁ virōdhamāgadantusvayambaramaṁmāḍpudu.

avasarpiṇiyoḷu vr̥ṣabhanāthanentu tīrthakarāgragaṇyaṁ śrēyāṁsanentu
dānatīrthapravartakaṁ bharatanentu cakradhara mukhyanante sulōcaneyuṁ
svayambarakkagragaṇiyayukku mendoḍaganakampananoḍambaṭṭiṭṭellā deśega
ḷoḷu bhūcara khēcara kumārarkaḷge baḻiṟiyanaṭṭirpannegamakampanana
pūrvabhavamitraṁ citrāṅgadaṁ saudharmakalpadiṁ bandakampana mahā
rājanaṁ kaṇḍu tadanumatadiṁ svayambara maṇṭapamaṁ samanise basanta
samayadoḷu bandarkakīrti mēghasvara pramukha bhūcararumaṁ
sunami vinami prabhr̥ti khēcararumaṁ yathōcita pratipattiyiṁ mannisi
śubhadinadoḷaḷāṣṭāhnika jinapūje purassara kanneyaṁ kaygeysi śivigeya
nēṟisi mahēndriyemba vr̥ddha kañcukeyindarasaṁ svayambara maṇṭa
pakke tarise sulōcaneyuṁ vr̥ddhakañcuki byāvyāvarṇitarappavanijacara gagana
cara kumārakara navadharisi kurukulāgragaṇyasampadvr̥tta balākā
(jeceḷātā)varta samarasantrājayanumenisida jayaṅge janmāntaraprēma
prēraṇeyuṁ svayambaramāleyanikkidaḷ. akampananuṁ vadhūvararaṁ
mundiṭṭu poḻaṟabilaṁ pokkaṁ annegaṁ siggāgi pōparka kīrtiyaṁ
durmarṣaṇanemba durmantri nīnire kanyāratnaṁ peṟara kaige pōgalu
takkudallillene niravadyanemba mantri mārkoṇḍu nīnī svayambara
maṇṭapa mārgamaṁ mīṟaṟilāgadeneyuṁ māṇadarka kīrti sulō
caneyanoppisuvudalladandoḍḍodandoḍḍi nilvudendu durmarṣaṇananaṭṭi bhara
tēśvarana magaṁ tānemage svāmiyendu jayaṁ nuḍidoḍa markakīrti
daparpamaṁ nuḍidoḍentanna peṇḍatiyaṁ bīyambēḍiyaṭṭidanante nēṟidoḍḍi
nilkendu dūtara naṭṭi vijayādigaḷappa sahōdarara balamuṁ sulō
canāgrajaṁ ratnāṅgadādi bandhu balamuṁ berasu aṣṭādaśākṣōhiṇī
balādhināthana kampana samētamuṁmaṁ yuddhasannaddhardhanāgi mēghēśvaranirpina
markakīrtiyuṁ saṅgrāma bhēriyaṁ poysi kaivīsi tāgidāgaḷ arka
kīrtiya nērvesanaṁ bēḍi tāguvappacandrarembambaracararisu
vambugaḷu nija śaraṅgaḷaṁ khaṇḍise sāgararārājanittardhacandramembamōgha
śaradinda mappaṣṭacandrarada taleyumanarkka kīrtiya piḍida billumanātana
vijayaghōṣamemba gajada taleyumaṁ paṟiyeccāgaḷarka kīrtisunami
vinamigaḷvaḷverasu khēcararaṁ pēṟdoḻdoḍe avaraṁ jayana mitraṁ mēgha
prabhaṅgele muḷidarka kīrti rathamanēṟi barejayantannērida vijayārdha

parvata gajadindiḻidu nāgarājanittajitañjayamemba rathamanēṟi vajra
kavacamaṁ toṭṭu vajrakāṇḍa kōdaṇḍamaṁ piḍivamōgha śaramaṁ tiripi
nile, tanagāpāsana kampanadoḷ, nāgarājaṁ vibhaṅga jñānōpayōgadiṁ
mēghasvarana samaramanaṟidu bandu munde nindu besanēnensendāgaḷīta
nenaginitasyānyāyamoḷneḷnigaḻdoḍamītaṅgaṁ tappalāgadu, ītana darpa
hataṅgeyvanite sālvudene nāgēndraṁ nāgapāśadindarkakīrtiyuṁ kaṭṭi
tandu mundiṭṭu bīḻkoṇḍu pōdaṁ.

jayanuṁ kōḷgaḷaṁ koṇḍakampanaṁ berasu rājadhāniyuṁ
pokku munname nityamaṇḍita jinālayadoḷupasargaṁ piṅguvannegaṁ
kāyōtsargadoḷninda sulōcaneyallige bandu, kaiyyaykenettikoḷisi
mēghasvaraṁ arkakīrtiyu geyda duścaritakke takkudugeydenydanendu mecci
bharatēśvaranaṭṭida lēkhavārtā śravaṇadiṁ santuṣṭarāgi sulōcaneyayu
taṅgeyuṁ lakṣmīmatiyuṁ arkakīrtigoḍambaḍisi koṭṭukaḷupi jaya
kumāranuṁ sulōcaneya vivāhānantaramakampananaṁ mahāvibhūtiyuṁ
kaḷipe, payaṇaṁ pōgi gaṅgā, sarayū taraṅgiṇī saṅgamadomoḷ, cakra
vyūha rūpadiṁ balamanirisi hēmāṅgadādigaḷaṁ sulōcanege kāpaṁ
pēḻdu, cakravartiya kāṇalmēghasvaranuṁ sākētapurakke pōgi vinamra
nāgi kaṇḍu labdhastuti pūjāmaṇimakuṭanāgi keladivasamirdubare
gaṅgātīramaneydāgaḷ andisiniruḷ sulōcane gaṅgeya ponaloḷu
pōpa kalpavr̥kṣamaṁ tāne piḍidu tegedu taḍige sārci surāṅganeyayu
roḍanarjircisuvudaṁ kanasugaṇḍu dusvapnōpaśānti nimittaṁ jinābhiṣē
kamaṁ māḍisi mēghasvarana baravanaṟidu pāruttamirdaṟ.ḷ

annegaṁ gaṅgā sarayū taraṅgiṇīsaṅgamamaṁ jayaṁ gajamanēṟi
pāyvalli kāḷiyemba jaladēvate pūrvabhavabaddha vairamoḷugra grāhā
kāradiṁ tegeye madagajaṁ muḻiguvāgaḷ kaṇḍu jayakumāranenagī
mahōpasargaṁ piṅguvannegaṁ āhāra śarīra nivr̥ttiyendirpinaṁ adaṁ
kaṇḍu sulōcane bandu siddhabhaktigeydu arasaṅgupasargaṁ piṅgu
vannabhāvadi pratyākhyānaṅgoṇḍu pañcanamaskāramanuccarisuttire, hē
māṅgadādigaḷappoḍapuṭṭidaruṁ vijayādigaḷa maidunaruṁ berasu
maḍuvinoḷ meyyaykanikkuvuduṁ. ākeya śīlamahātmyadiṁ gaṅgā

dēvigāsana kampamāge sulōcanegādavastheyanaṟidu nīrellaṁ battu
vantu māḍe dēvate yugrā(nakrā) kāraṅgeṭṭu pōge sulōcaneyuṁ
jayasonoḍanāseneyanēṟi gaṅgādēviyuya māḍida vibhūtiverasu taḍige
tandu tannavigusurvisida maṇimaṇṭapadoḷ oḷagaṇamaṇipīṭhada mēgirvarpa
rumanirisi mahāgaṁ(gā)dha jaladoḷu tīḷtīvida kanakakaḷaśaṅgaḷiṁ gaṅgā
dēvi mahābhiṣēkaṁ geydu siṁhāsanadoḷirisi divyavastrādigaḷiṁ pūjise
nīnīkeyanēnukāraṇaṁ pūjisideyendu jayaṁ besagoḷe gaṅgādēvi
pēḻtaḻaltaguḷdaḷ.pūrvajanmadoḷ vindhyapuramanāḷva vindhyaśaktigaṁ,vindhya
śrīgaṁ āṁ, śrīkānteyemba magaḷāge samyyasemyyyanennaṁ kalābhikṣegendu
sulōcaneya pakkadoḷirisidoḍe anupavāsaṅgeydu pipāsāśramadiṁ
sattu gaṅgāpātadoḷ dēviyādeṁ. enaginitu vibhavamembudu īkeya
prasādadindādudu, adaṟiṁ pūjisidenendu tanna prapañcamuṁmaṁ pēḻdu
māyānakrada vairasambandhamāvāgi intendu pēḻtaḻaltaguḷdaḷ: hastina
puradumudyānadoḷ śīla(śiva)guptamuniya sāṟere ninnoḍane dharmamaṁ
kēḷda nāgamithunamoḍaṇasāganaṁ kāṟiḍildolpoḍeyuye sattu dharaṇēndra
nāvaṁdaṁ ā banadoḷḷāḷnāgāṅganeyoḷnīḷcirada krīḍekēḷiyuṁ kaṇḍu durācārakke
nīṁnī kaḍumuḷidu avataṁsa nīlōtpaladiṁ iḍaloḍamullirdareḷḷirdellamitene
yuṁ baḍiyeyuṁ sattalli kēre kāḷiḷayemba jaladēvateyāgi puṭṭittu.
nāgāṅganeyuṁ tanna duścaritakke pēsi śubhapariṇāmadiṁ sattu dhara
ṇēndraṅge dēviyāgi vibhaṅgajñānadiṁ tanna sattateṟananaṟidu ninna
parōkṣadoḷ vaibhavavradhavyavr̥tamaṁmuṁ salisuttirdennaṁ jayaṁ kondanene
dharaṇēndraṁ, muḷidubandu ninna mañcada keḷage ninnaṁ kolalendu
paṭṭabiṭṭirpinaṁ ninnarasi śrīmatidēvi nīnirpēnintēke cintisuttirdeyendu ninna
besagoḷe nāgiṇeṇiya duścaritamaṁmuṁ nīnākege pēḻduduṁ kēḷdu, dhara
ṇēndraṁ mecci ninage divyāstramaṁ koṭṭu pōdaṁ. avaṟoḷu nīḷnīnuṁ
aṣṭacandraraṁ kondoḍavara makkaḷu tamma kuladaivakke śaraṇendoḍā
dēvateyuya besadoḷaṁ tanna vairadoḷaṁ kāḷi māyānakra svarūpadiṁ
ninage mahōpasargamaṁ māḍidoḍāṁ sulōcaneyuya śīlaprabhāvadiṁ
bandu baggisi kaḷedenendu pēṟiḻdu irvaruṁ santuṣṭarāgi gaṅgā
dēviyuṁyaṁ priyavacanapūrvakaṁ pūjisi ramyavanādi pradēśaṅgaḷaṁ
sulōcanege tōṟutta, jayaṁ hastinapuramaṁ pokku sulōcanege

mahādēvī paṭṭaṅgaṭṭi hēmāṅgadādigaḷaṁ mannisi visarjisi mahā
maṇḍalēśvara śrīyananubhavisuttirdomme tanna varṣavardhana dinadoḷu
parivārasahitaṁ harmyataḷadoḷirdu vidyādhara mithunaṅgaḷanākāśa
doḷu pōḷpōpudaṁ kaṇḍu mūrchāgatanāgi, nīḍaṟimbeḻcaraṟindeccattu hā prabhā
vatiyendu vipralāpaṅgeydu tanna hiraṇyavarmanāda bhavasambandhamaṁ
antaḥpurakkaṟipe sulōcaneyuṁ kapōtamithunamaṁ kaṇḍu pūrva
bhavamaṁ nenedu mūrchege sambeḻcasandeccattu dēvā, ninna pēḻda prabhāva
tiyu nānendu pēṟiḻdu antappaḍe namma pūrvabhava sambandhamellamaṁ
pēḻembuduṁ sulōcane pēḻtaḻaltaguḷdaḷ.

jambūdvīpada pūrva vidēhada puṣkarāvatī viṣayada puṇḍarī
kiṇiyanāḷvoṁḷvaṁ prajāpālanembarasanātana seṭṭi kubēramitranātaṅge
dhanapati modalāgi mūvattirvarpeṇḍirāge tadīyasaudhōparimataḷa
doḷu raḷrativaranuṁ ratisēneyumemba kapōta mithunamādalli, rativaraṁ
kutūhaḷarappavar dhārmikarge gatiyāpuvudendoḍūrdhva bhāgamaṁ,
pāpigaḷge gatiyāpuvudendoḍadhōbhāgamaṁ, tanna tuṇḍadoḷtōṟuttuṁ
elliyānuṁ manege banda munijanaṅgaḷa pāda dhūḷiyaṁ pakṣadvayadiṁ
toḍedu kaḷedu mattuṁ gr̥ha vyāpāramāduvellamaṁ dhanapatige tuṇḍa
vimpadiṁakkaramaṁ baredu tōṟuttuṁ pēḻvalli, saddharmamampēḻuttuṁ
manegella muddāgi baḷedu ratisēneverasu palakālaṁ sukhamirpinaṁ ā,
kubēra mitraṅgaṁ dhanapavatigaṁ kubērakāntanemboṁ maganādoṁ.
ātana puṭṭidiṁ baḻiyuṁ kāmadhēnu manōbhilaṣitamappudaṁ kuḍu
vudu. gandhaśāḷi kṣētramanavarataṁ beḷevudu, ikṣukṣētraṁ rasāyanamaṁ
pariṇamiyisuvudu. vīṇe tanage tānē manōhara dhvaniyaneseguvudātana
snāna samayadoḷ madhura gambhīra dhvaniyappa jaḷadharaṁ sakala rōga
mapahāri sugandhi jaḷamaṁ kaṟevudu. nālku kalpavr̥kṣaṅgaḷuṁ
kramadinabhimata vastra bhūṣaṇa annapānaṅgaḷaṁ kuḍuvuṁ. intu dēva
nirvr̥rmitamappa vividha bhōgaṅgaḷananubhavisuttuṁ navayauvananāda kubēra
kāntaṅge vivāhamaṁ māḍalendātana cittavr̥ttiyaṁ priyasēnanemba
liṅkasiṁhanindamārayyaykalupēḻdu nitya maṇḍita jinālayada sudarśanaremba
munigaḷa pakkade gr̥hītāṇuvrata samyagdarśanaṁ kubērakāntasēnēkapatnī
vratamaṁ kaikoṇḍudaṁ aṟidu, ā kubēra mitraṁ cintākrāntanāgi

naimittakar pēḻdampaḻdandadoḷ nityamaṇḍita jinālayada yakṣana munde
mūvattirvarkkanneyaraṁ parīkṣise pañcaratna mikkida laḍḍugeya
bāyanaṁ dhanavatiyaṇṇaṁ samudradattaṅgaṁ kubēra mitra seṭṭiya taṅge
kubēramitretraṅgaṁ puṭṭida priyadatteya kaisārvurpuduṁ. prajāpati mahā
rājaṅgaṁ kanakamālegaṁ puṭṭida lōkapālaniṁ kiṟiyaḷu guṇavatiyuṁ,
yaśasvatiyuṁ ratnamaya laḍḍugegaḷu tamma kaisāradudakke sigginoḷ
amitamatiyuṁ anantamatiyuṁ emba kantikeyara pakkade tapamaṁ
kaikoṇḍar. kubērakāntanuṁ priyadatteyuṁ vivāha vidhiyaṁ
kaikoṇḍu sukhamirpuduṁ. prajāpālana mahārājanuṁ lōkapālaṅge
kubērakāntana taṅge vasumatiyaṁ tandu kelavu divasadinātaṅge
rājyamaṁ koṭṭu seṭṭige samarpisi tapamaṁ kaikoṇḍaṁ.

itta lōkapālaṅge kubēramitraṁ karamāptanāgi naḍeye capaḷa
matiyemba kumāramantri sairisadupāyamaṁ carcisi, kubēramitraṁ
vr̥ddhamantrimānyaṁ ātanaṁ ellā poḻtuṁpōytuṁ sēvakarōḷiyoḷ barisu
vuduṁ ayuktamendu lōkapālaniruḷu tūṅkaḍisuvāgaḷ vakuḷa
māliyemba gubjiniyaṁ nuḍisidoḍamodarasanavaṁ svapnamendē bagedellā
poḻtuṁpōytuṁ avaraṁ bāradantumāḍi, mattondu divasamarasanuṁ kumāra
mantriyuṁ jalakrīḍeyoḷ, koḷadoḷage saṅkramisida padmarāgamaṇi
cchāyeyuṁyaṁ, ratnamegittu mantriyuṁ tānuṁ aṟiṟasi kāṇade pāda
skhalanamāge pāvaruṭeṭiyunde aramanege bandandiniruḷu puruḍisi, muḷi
dirda mahādēviyaṁyuṁ tiḷipalendu kālgeṟage taleyanodedupōdoḍa
rasanuṁ beḷagādāgaḷ siṁhāsanamadhyagatanāgi bāḷamantriyanarasara
taleyanodedoḍegeykuvudene kālaṅkaḍivudendadendantameneyarasanavadhārisi
muguḷnage nakku kubēramitraṅge baḻiyanaṭṭi ratnaprapañcamaṁ
pēḻdoḍadu nīroḷilladantarikṣadoḷirdudakkumendoḍaṭṭinōḍe,
māṁsamemba buddhiyaṁ padmarāgamaṇiyaṁ gr̥dhrantandu vāpimūḷada
vaṁśastambhadoḷikkiduvadanaṟidu mattaṁ arasugaḷa taleyanodevudakke
daṇḍamēnendu besagoḷe dravya kṣētra kālabhāvaṅgaḷaṁ parīkṣisi kubēra
mitranendaṁ: nimmanodeva kālaṁ pūjisuvudene lōkapālaṁ mecci
seṭṭiyaṁ pūjisi namma nimmoḍeyanā(vaḷ)rānuṅgeṇṭu māḍida
(ḷeṁ)rembudumarasanaṟidanēgettu keladoḷirda gubja bhayastheyāgi

bāḷamantriyu prayōgikakriyeyuṁ tanna nuḍimupudanaṟipe capaḷamati
garasaṁ muḷidu guruvacanaparāṅmukharādemmandigarēgeyvudidudillendu
vinayapūrvakaṁ seṭṭiya manege pōgalvēṟduḻdu, ondu divasaṁ kubēra
seṭṭiya (dhanamitra) śirōruhadoḷ paḷiḷatāṅkuramaṁ dhanavati kaṇḍu
nimage baṟiḻibandudendu nagutuṁ tōṟidoḍaduvenirvēgamāgi
kubērakāntaṅge seṭṭivaṭṭaṅgaṭṭi lōkapālanaṁ bīṟkoṇḻkoṇḍu siddhārtha
memba śivibigeyoḷu bahirōdyānakke pōgi tanna maidunaṁ samudra
dattaṁ modalāge palabaruṁ berasu vipuḷamati cāraṇara sāre saṁyamamaṁ
kaikoṇḍu kālāntaradoḷ brahmakalpadoḷ lōkāntika dēva
rādar.

ittaṁ priyadatteyuṁ vipuḷamati cāraṇargāhāra dānamaṁ nava
vidha puṇyānviteyāgi koṭṭu nanage tapamāsannadoḷakkume besasimene
makkaḷilladubbegadoḷnaḷnnaḍivaḷendu aṟidu muniyartamma dakṣiṇa hasta
paydu beralumaneḍava kakiṟukuṟikuñjikeyumaṁ tōṟi parasi pōge, kelavu
kāladiṁ kubēradattaṁ kubēramitraṁ kubēracitraṁ kubēradēvaṁ
kubērapriyarembayvarmagandiraṁ, kubēraśrīyembamagaḷumaṁ, priyayu
datte paḍedu sukhadisirpinamondu divasaṁ, jagatpāḷalacakravartiyu maga
ḷdarappa amitamatiyumanantamati kantiyaruṁ prajāpālana magaḷda
rappa yaśasvati guṇavatyārjikeyarberasupoṟaḻalgevandu nityamaṇḍita
jinālayadoḷaḷire, lōkapālanantaḥpuramaṁ kubērakāntanuṁ berasa
varalli dharmamaṁ kēḷdu, dāna pūje śīlōpavāsādi niratarāgippirpinaṁ.
mattondu divasaṁ jaṅghajaṅghācāraṇarcarigegevabare kubērakāntanuṁ priyayu
datteyuṁ idirgoṇḍu nilisuvudumavaraṁ kāṇaloḍaṁ kapōta
mithunaṁ tamma pūrvabhavāntaramanaṟidu munipada praṇāmaṅgeyvudu
mavaṁ kaṇḍu saṁsārasvarūpamaṁ bhāvisi jaṅghajaṅghācāraṇar nilalollade
pōdar.

ittaṁ priyadatteyuṁ ākapōtavadhuvanidirgoṇḍu ninna munnina
bhavada pesarēnene nijatuṇḍadiṁ tanna nāmākṣaramaṁ baredutōrpudu
mavaṁ kapōtaṁ kaṇḍenna munnina bhavada peṇḍatiyendaṟidati prītiyuṁyiṁ
priyadattege sukāntanemba tanna munnina bhavada pesaraṁ baredutōrpudu
mavaṁ kaṇḍenna munnina bhavada gaṇḍanendu kapōti rativaranaṁ sābhi

lāpadiṁ pōrde mamuneyu mānisargellamatiprītiyādudu. āṁ andina
kapōtiyayenendu sulōcane nuḍiye jayakumāraṁ nānu mundina
rativara kapōtanembudu paramāgamananda pariṇata(bharita)nāgimattaṁ dr̥ṣṭa
śrutaprakr̥tigaḷaṁ neneveyuppoḍe pēḻendu jayaṁ besagoḷe sulōca
ne pēḻaltaguḷdaḻdaḷ.

jaṅghajaṅghācāraṇar nilalollade pōda kāraṇamanaṟiyute lōkapāḷa
namitamati kantiyaruṁraṁ besagoṇḍoḍavaruṁ bhaṭṭārakaralli kēḷduḷdabanda
rappudaṟindintendu pēḻaltaguḷdaḻdar. ī vijayārdhada kelada dhānya
kamāḷāḷaṭavī samīpada śōkōbhānagaramanāḷdoṁ prajāpāḷalanembarasanāta
narasi śrīdēvi (dēvaśrī)yemboḷ ātana purōhitaṁ śakti
ṣēṇanemboṅgaṁ aṭaviśrīgaṁ satyadēvanemboṁ kr̥taka putranādoṁ
antasibarumaruṁamitamatiyumanantamati kantiyara pakkadoḷ dharmamaṁ
kēḷdu prajāpāḷala mahārājaṁ dēvaśrīberasu madyamāṁsa nivr̥tti
yumuṁmaṁ parvōpavāsamumaṁ kaikoṇḍu śaktiṣēṇanumupagāra dharma
doḷatithigāhāradānamaṁ koṭṭallavādānuṇenendu kaikoṇḍaṁ. aṭavi
śriyuṁ pośrīyuṁmonnada pāḍivapadoḷ kāḷavaṭṭaḷaṅkākaṣṭamiyoḷamuydu varuṣambaraṁ
nōmpa pravr̥ddha kalyāṇamanettikoṇḍaḷ. satyadēvanuṁ dēvaraṁ
bandisidallamuduṇenemba bratamaṁmuṁ kaikoṇḍu antasibaruṁ sukhamirpina
onmondudivasaṁ mr̥ṇāḷalavatiyemba naṇṭarūrge dēvaśrīyuṁ kaḷapalendu
śaktiṣēṇaṁ dhānyakamāḷada sarpasarōvarada taḍiyoḷ bīḍambiṭṭirpa
nnegaṁ, ittaṁ mr̥ṇāḷalavatiyunāḷdoṁ sukētuvembonāpurada paramaṁraṁ
rativarmaṅgaṁ kanakaśrīgaṁ bhavadēvanemboṁ maganādoḍātaṁ virūpa
nappudaṟinde oṭṭoṭṭiganuṁ duścaritranappudaṟinde paramuparyumadurmu
khanumemnemba pesargaḷāge tamma sōdaramāvaṁ śrīdatta seṭṭigaṁ vimuṁ
śrīgaṁnaṁ puṭṭida rativēgeyuṁ tanage bēḍidaḍe baḍavanendu kuḍadire, panne
raḍu varuṣamanavadhimāḍi, poḍamuvaḍeyalbōlpōgi, avadhige bāradirdoḍā
pōṟeḻala paravanasalōśōkadattaṅgaṁ vīradattegaṁ puṭṭida sukāntaṅge rati
vēgeyuṁ kuḍuvudumoṭṭoṭṭigaṁ bandu muḷidu kolvilvenese, bhayasthasta
rāgi vadhūvararu pōgi śaktiṣēṇana maṟeyuṁ puguvudumoṭṭoṭṭi
ganuṁ baṟiḻiyane taguḷdu śaktiṣēṇaṅgaḷka maguḷdaṁḻdaṁ.

ittaṁ śaktiṣēṇanuṁ carigepovokka cāraṇa r̥ṣiyarge vidhipūrvakaṁ
annavā(pā)namaṁ koṭṭu pañcāścaryamaṁ paḍedu tānumuṇḍu

sukhamirpinamallige mērudattanemba seṭṭiya sārthambandu bīḍaṁ
biṭṭirpudu. ā seṭṭiyuya peṇḍati dhāriṇiṇeyembaḷ ātaṅge śakuniyuṁ,
br̥haspatiyuṁ, dhanvantariyuṁ, bhūtārthanumemba nālvar mantri
gaḷāgirpinaṁ, ōrvaṁ hīnāṅrvaṅkṣīṇāṅganaṁ kaṇḍāvudu kāraṇadindintapparūpā
dumudendu seṭṭi besagoṇḍoḍavaroḷ śakuniyendaṁ: ītaṁ puṭṭa
dandavaśakunamādudese br̥haspatiyendaṁ pāpagraha nirīkṣaṇa dōṣa
mādudese dhanvantariyendaṁ: tridōṣa vaiṣamyamādudese mūvarumaṁ
māṟkoṇrkoṇḍu bhūtārthanendanivarendumallanyajanmadoḷ hiṁsādyadyupā
rjita pāpaparipākadindamītaṁ hīnāṅtaṅkṣīṇāṅganādoṁ. ivarinda śakunādigaḷu
munnārjita śubhāśubha karmaparipāka prakāśana sādhanaṅgaḷallade nirva
rtaka sādhanaṅgaḷallendu ellaruṁ mecci, nuḍiyuttirpannegamā prastā
vadoḷ satyadēvana petta tande satyakaṁ tanna magananaṟasuttaṁ bandalli
kaṇḍu mahāduḥkhaṅgeydusukhaṅgeyduśa śaktiṣēṇa mērudatta prabhr̥tigaḷge tanna magana
vr̥ttāntamanintendaṁ: ītaṁ maneyayu kiṟukuḷa vyasanaṁ māḍadire
tanna kiṟiyayubbe baidobadimoḍe muḷisudubandoṁ. mugumuduṟisalārada kruddha
nendā teṟanaṁ pēḻdu tannoḍanātaṁ nirvēdirmōhiyāgi bāradire, maṟu
bhavadoḷpoḷappoḍaṁ ninnaṁ kūḍirisikoḷvenakkendu nidhānaṅgeydu dravya
r̥ṣiyāgi kālāntaradoḷ lōkapālakanādaṁ.

ittaṁ mattondu divasaṁ aṭaviśrīyuṁ tanna nōmpiya pomonna
pāḍivadoḷupavāsaṅgeydu śaktiṣēṇaṁ berasāhāradānamaṁ munipati
gittu pañcāścaryamaṁ paḍedu seṭṭi mērudattanuṁ dhāriṇiyumada
kkarkkanumōdaṅgeydumage nīṁ maṟubhavadoḷ maganappeyakkendu
nidhānaṅgeydar. maṟepoṟivokka vadhūvararumanumōda puṇyamaṁmuṁ paḍadava
rembudumadaṁmaṁ kēḷdu lōkapālana mahādēvi vasumati tanna pūrva
bhava sambandhamanaṟidu mūrchānantarameccattu muṁ pēḻdaḻdu dēvaśrī
yembināsininitōntondu vibhūtiyuṁ nimma prasādadindameyduydevenesemma
rasaṁ prajāpālanellirdanembudumātaṁ lōkapālanādoḍenese priyayu
datteyuṁ tanna pūrvabhavamaṁ nenedu kantiyaraṁ bandisi nimma pēḻda
ṭavi śrīye nānembuduṁ, śaktiṣēṇanumemma naḍapida magaṁ satyadēvanu
mellirdarene, śaktiṣēṇanī kubērakāntaṁ, satyadēvaṁ ninna piriya magaṁ
kubēradattanādōnā mērudattanuṁ dhāriṇiyuṁ kubēramitranuṁ

dhanavatiyumādar. śaraṭṭojbokka vadhūvararuṁ nimma maneyōyoḷ kapōta
mithunamādavu. initumuṁ vijayārdha samīpada mahāmaḷayu kāñca
naguhāvāsigaḷappirvarcārjāraṇar nimma munnina bhavadōdoḷ sarpi
sarkōvaradoḷirdandu nimma maneyōḷ cayoḷjarige vakkavaruṁ nimage putrō
tpattiyumuyanupadēśaṅgeydayduvaruṁ pañcāścarya hētuvādavaruṁ kapōta
mithunaṅgaḷaṁ kaṇḍu lābhaṁmāḍi pōdavaruṁ, ninna tandegaṁ māvagaṁ
gurugaḷādavaruṁ ā irvare nimmanibara vr̥ttāntamanavaralli kēḷdapuṁḷdāvuṁ
nimagaṟipivedevendintu palakālaṁ sale, mattondu divasaṁ, priyadatte
yaśasvatī guṇavatyārjikeyaruṁ nimma tapambaṭṭa kāraṇamēnendoḍemma
māvanalli laḍḍuuḍdugeyu bāyinamaṁ baḍeyade nirvēgamoḷ tapambaṭṭevu.
munne dhanavatiyuṁ kubērakānteyuṁ amitamati kantiyara sāre
tapambaṭṭarendu pēḻduṟi, mattondu divasaṁ, ā kapōta mithuna māhā
rārdharthamāpoliṟila kelada jambūgrāmakke pōge, kadaḷīvanadōdoḷorbbordoṭṭo
ṭṭigaṁ mārjāranāgi puṭṭirdu, kapōtaṅgaḷaṁ kāṇaloḍaṁ piḍidu
koldudumavu sattu vijayārdha dadakṣiṇaśrēṇiya gāndhāraviṣayada
susīmānagaramanāḷvāḷdādityagatiyemba vidyādhara rājaṅgaṁ śaśiprabhādē
vigaṁ rativarakapōtaṁ hiraṇyavarmanemboṁ maganādonā vijayārdha
uttaraśrēṇiya gaurīviṣayada bhōgapuramanāḷvaḷda vāyurathanemba
vidyādharaṅgaṁ svayamprabhādēvigaṁ ratiṣēṇe, prabhāvatidēviyemba maga
ḷāgi puṭṭidaḷ.

sukāntanuṁ rativēgeyumāda janmada tandevire tamagandu
tandevirāgige jauvanaṁ neṟedanaṁnēṟiva prabhāvatiyanārge kuḍuvamendu mantri
gaḷoḷālōciḷōjisi tadanumatadiṁ svayambarakkoḍarci, gatiyuddhadiṁ tanna
geldoṅgallade prabhāvati māleya sūḍaḷembudaṁ priyakāriṇiyemba
cēṭi pēḻduṟi,kēḷdu vāyurathaṁ prabhāvativerasu siddhakūṭa jaicaityālayada
mundirdu biṭṭa māleyaṁ nelaṁ muṭṭalīyade mēruvaṁ triprada
kṣiṇaṁ geydu koḷalāṟade, cintāgativerasu palambaru vidyādhara kumāra
rgati yuddhadoḷpōlīḷsōle, hiraṇyavarmaṁ tannaṁ gele kaṇḍu, māleyuṁyaṁ
prabhāvatiyuyakke mattondu divasaṁ prabhāvati kapōta darśanadindaṁ
jātismareyāgi rativaranaṁ nenedu viraktamatiyāgirpinaṁ, hiraṇyavarmana
bareda paṭamaṁ priyakāriṇi tandu tōṟi,nīnidanelli paḍedeyembuduṁ,

hiraṇyavarmaṁ bareda paṭamaṁ ātana lēkhaṁlōkaṁ sukāntana kaiyiṁ koṇḍu
bandenene tānuṁ tanna caritamaṁ bareda paṭavanantākeyu kayyoḷaṭṭe
hiraṇyavarmaṁ kaṇḍantirvaruṁ paraspara prītarāgirpannegaṁ, bandhu
janaṅgaḷella neraredu vivāhābhiṣēka kalyāṇamaṁ māḍe daśamī snānadoḷ
siddhakūṭa jinālayada pūjege pōdalli paramāvadhi sampanna cāraṇaraṁ
kaṇḍu bandisi, hiraṇyavarmanuṁ prabhāvatiyuṁ tamma pūrva bhavamaṁ
besagoḷe cāraṇarintendu besasidar.

mūṟaneya bhavadoḷ mr̥ṇāḷaṇavatiyoḷ vaṇikkuladoḷpuṭṭida
rativēgeyaṁ sukāntanumenisi dampatigaḷāgirdoṭṭoṭṭigaṁ gaḷkeḷki śakti
ṣēṇana marevokku dānānumōdada puṇyamaneydi, kālāntaradoḷ
kapōtaṅgaḷāgi kubēramitrana maneyoḷ sukhamirdu, tapōdhanāva
ḷōkana prītiyiṁ pōgi sattu, dānānumōdana puṇya paripākadiṁ
bandilli vidyādhara mithunaṅgaḷādir. mūṟaneya janmada tandevirandu
ratiṣēṇa gurugaḷa pakkade parigrahīta prōṣadharvitānādyupakaraṇa
pūjeyaṁ jinabhavanakke māḍi bandilli vidyādhara kuladoḷpuṭṭi nimage
tandevirādar. andinabhava dēvana tandeyeṁ nāṁ rativarmanenilli śrī
varmanenāgi saṁyamamaṁmaṁ kaikoṇḍu, cāraṇa r̥ddhiyumaṁ paramāvadhi
yumaṁ paḍedenembuduṁ, adaṁ alli kēḷdati prītiyinīrvargaṁ pala
kālaṁ sale, vāyurathanomme mugil karagidudaṁ kaṇḍaduve nirvē
gadiṁ manōrathanemba magaṅge rājyamaṁ koṭṭu tapaṁ baḍuvudumadaṁ
kēḷdu, bandhugaḷellaṁ bare manōrathana magaṁ citrarathaṅge prabhāvatiya
magaḷ ratiprabheyaṁ kuḍuvudendappaysuvuduṁ āvyatikaramaṁ, kēḷdā
dityagati hiraṇyavarmaṅge sakala vidyādhara rājyābhiṣēkaṅgeydu, palaru
marasugaḷbeḷverasu yatīśvarara pakkade maidunarīrvar tapambaṭṭu kālāṁ
taradoḷ lōkāntika dēvarādaremba kathāvasānadoḷ rativēgeyuṁ
ratiṣēṇeyuṁ prabhāvatiyumādenendu sulōcane nuḍiye, sukānta
nuṁ rativaranuṁ hiraṇyavarmanumādenānendu jayaṁnuḍidu innemma
caritamaṁ pēḻiṟine sulōcane pēḷabiltaguḷdaḷ.

antu hiraṇyavarmaṁ puṇyōpārjita rājyasukhamananubhavisuttuṁ
prabhāvativerasu vihārisuttuṁ, dhānyakamāḷada sarpasarōvara darśanadiṁ
pūrvabhava sambandhamaṁ nenedu,nirvēgadiṁ poṟaṟilge vandu suvarṇavarma

nemba magaṅge rājyamaṁ koṭṭu, bhuvanakke(bhūmigi)bidu śrīpura
doḷ śrīpāḷasaṁyatara pakkade tapamaṁ kaikoṇḍaṁ. prabhāvati tammabbe
svayamprabheverasu guṇavatiyaremba kantikeyara pakkade tapamaṁ
kaikoṇḍar(ḷ).ā hiraṇyavarmaṁ muniyu prakr̥ṣṭa samyagdarśana,jñāna,
cāritra pariṇāmadiṁ vihārisuttuṁ, puṇḍarīkiṇige bandaṁ. guṇavatiyuṁ
yaśasvatiyuṁ, prabhāvatiyuṁ modalāgirpa āryeyarumallige
varpuduṁ. alli neleyāgirpa kubērakāntana bhārye priyadatte bandu
guṇavati kantikeyaraṁ bandisi vinayadiṁ amitamatyānantamati kanti
keyarellirdarembudumārādhana vidhiyuṁyiṁ sugatige sandarene, prabhāvati
kantikeyarendar-emagellaṁ kaṇṇāgirdaravaratītarādavarene nīmettalaṟivi
rendu priyadatte besagoṇḍoḍe, ratiṣēṇeyāda bhavadoḷāda sambandha
mellamaṁ pēḻduṟi, priyadatte rativaranellirdanene, hiraṇyavarmanāgi tapaṁ
baṭṭu vihārisuttuṁ illige bandanene, priyadatte pōgi hiraṇyavarma
muniyaṁ bandisi bandu, lōkapāla, kubērakānta prabhr̥tigaḷa
vr̥ttāntamaṁ prabhāvati kantikeyargintendu priyadatte pēḷaṟilta
guḷdaḷ.

ī vijayārdha parvatada gāndhāranagaramanāḷvoṁḷdoṁ ratiṣēṇanemboṁ
vidyādharaṁ, tanna kānte gāndhāriyuṁ keḷeyaṁ kubērakāntanuṁ
berasu vanavihāramoḷire, gāndhāri kubērakāntaṅgāṭisi kr̥takadiṁ
pāvukoṇḍudendu mūrcheyōpuduṁ, seṭṭiyuṁ ratiṣēṇanuṁ maṇiṇe
mantraṅgaḷineccarisalāṟade, ratiṣēṇaṁ manakṣatambaṭṭu mahauṣadhamaṁ
taralu vijayārdhaparvatakke pōgirdaṁ. itta gāndhāriyuṁ kubēra
kāntaṅge tannaḷapaṁ prakaṭaṁ māḍe, kubērakāntaṁ nāṁ napuṁsakanene
virakteyāgirppirpinaṁ, ratiṣēṇambare nimma munnina auṣadhi prayōgadoḷ
tīrdirtentendīrvaruṁ nijanivāsakke pōdar. ittondu divasaṁ priya
datte tannayvaydurmakkaḷverasu garbhajerbhiṇi vanavihārakke sivigeyanēṟi
pōpudumallige gāndhāri bandu, ninna seṭṭi napuṁsakanembarā mātuṁ
illa pēḻemṟimbuduṁ, priyadatteyendaḷ : ānalladavargellamātaṁ napuṁ
sakanene, gāndhāri tanagaduve nirvēgavāgi, ratiṣēṇaṁ berasu tapambaṭṭu
puṇḍarīkiṇige vandaḷ. avaḷaṁ priyadatte nilisi nimma tapakke kāraṇamāvu
dene, ninna puruṣanē kāraṇamembuduṁ ā nuḍiyaṁ nigūḍhadēhanāgirda

kubērakāntaṁ kēḷdu bandu bandisi, tapambaṭṭoḷḷikeydiydaremma keḷeyaṁ,
ratiṣēṇanellirdanembudumātanumemma kāraṇadiṁ tapambaṭṭallige vanda
rembuduṁ kubērakāntanuṁ, lōkapālakanumavarallige pōgi, bandisi
dharmaśravaṇānantaraṁ saṁvēgaparanāgi lōkapālaṁ guṇapālakumā
raṅge rājyamaṁ koṭṭu, kubērakāntaṁ kubērapriyaṅge neṭṭiṭṭavaṭṭaṅgaṭṭiṭṭa
ratiṣēṇa muniyarapakkade dīkṣitarādarendaṟipi mattondu divasaṁ
priyadatteyuṁ tanage puṭṭiṭṭada kubēraśrīyuṁ guṇapālaṅge koṭṭu
prabhāvatikantikeyaralli dharmamaṁmuṁ kēḷdu guṇavati kantikeyara pakkade
tapamaṁ kaikoṇḍaḷ. ittaṁ hiraṇyavarmamuniyuṁ parētavanadoḷu
saptadinambaraṁ pratimāyōgadoḷirpuduṁ. avara pūrvabhava sambandha
muṁ priyadattekantiyar nagara janaṅgaḷge pēḻvāgaḷ kēḷutirparda
priyadatteyamyumba sūḷeyoḍanirpa vidyuccōranadaṁ kēḷdu tanage puṭṭiṭṭada
vibhaṅgajñānadiṁ tānoṭṭoṭṭiṭṭaganāda bhavadindittaṇa vairamanaṟidu nitya
maṇḍita jinālayada munde rātri pratimeyiyurda prabhāvati kantikeyara
nettikoṇḍuydu parētavanadoḷ yōgastharāgirda hiraṇyavarmamuni
verasu irvarumanonde citakada mēgiṭṭu suḍuvāgaḷ avaṁ sairisi
viśuddhapariṇāmadiṁ muḍipi prathamakalpadoḷu kanakaprabhadēvanuṁ kanaka
prabhādēviyāgi puṭṭiṭṭadar.

ittaṁ suvarṇavarmanā prapañcamaṁmuṁ kēḷdu vidyuccōraṅge nigrahaṁ
māḻpenendu, kr̥ta pratijñānāsādudanavadhijñānadinaṟidu kanakaprabha
dēvaṁ munnina rūpadimbandu anuprēkṣādi dharma tatvamanaṟipi divya
rūpumaṁ tōṟi dēvalōkakke pōdaṁ, ādaṁannegamitta jambūdvīpada
pūrva vidēhada sītānadiya teṅkaṇa taḍiya vatsakāvatīviṣayada
susīmā nagaradoḷu śivaghōṣa bhaṭṭārakara kēvala jñānōtpattige dēva
nikāyamoḍane hiraṇyavarmacajara, kanakaprabha dēvanuṁ prabhāvatīcajara
dēviyuṁ, kanakaprabhādēviyuṁ bandu bandisirpannegaṁ ittalā poḻi
loḷ puṣpapālike (puṣpavaḷi) yuṁ, puṣpāvatiyumemba māligāṟara
magaḷdirīḷdīrvaruṁ munnamēḻiṟineya divasadindē puṣpakaraṇḍakamembu
dyānamoḷage guṇadhara kēvalagaḷa pakkade, dēvaranarcipa pūjādharmamaṁmuṁ
kēḷdu kaikoṇḍu, pūgoyyalu pōgi sarpāgni nimittadiṁ sattu, śata
makhaṅge śaciyuṁ, priyu ratidēvaṅge mēnakiyumemba, dēviyarāgi

bandavaruṁ tīrthakararaṁ bandisi tatkathā karṇānantaraṁ hiraṇyavarma
dēvanuṁ prabhāvatīcajaradēviyumalliya tamma bhava sambandhamaṁ kēḷdu
pūrvabhava sukhānubhava pradēśaṅgaḷaṁ nōḍuttuṁ sarpasarōvarada
samīpakke bandallige sārthadoḍane banda bhīmaremba sādhugaḷaṁ kaṇḍu
vinayadiṁ bandisi dharmamaṁ kēḷdu tadanantaraṁ nīmēṁ kāraṇaṁ tapaṁ
baṭṭiṭṭarene, bhīmu sādhugaḷendar.

puṣkalāvati viṣayada puṇḍarīkiṇiyoḷu daridra kuladoḷ puṭṭiṭṭade
nāṁ bhīmanembeṁ, ondu divasamōrva tapōdhanaraṁ sārdu, dharmamaṁ
kēḷdu hiṁsā, anr̥ta, stēya, paradāragamanamatilōbhaṁ dyūta, madhu,
māṁsatyāga lakṣaṇamappa vratamaṁ kaikoṇḍu bandoḍemma muttabbe
baḍavargemagī vrataṅgaḷēgeyvuvu. ivaṁ ninagittavarge maguṟi
koṭṭu barpaṁ bāyenduyempuyennanoḍagoṇḍu barpannegaṁ rathyā mārga
doḷu dēvatā gr̥hada kukkuṭaṁ bisiloḷoṇagikkivada dhānyamaṁmuṁ tindoḍe
adaṁ konda vajrakētuvembanaṁ taḷāṇāṟardaṇḍisuvudumaṁ, jinadēvana
bayakeyaṁ maṟeyisi pusi nuḍiva dhanadēvana jiṁhvōtpāṭanaṁ
geyvudumaṁ, seṭṭiṭṭaya maṇihāramaṁ kaḷdu sūḷege koṭṭaṭṭu ratipiṅgaḷa
nembōnaṁ śūladoḷikkuvudumaṁ, iruḷ maṟeyoḷu vivēka
millade tanna taṅgegabhilāṣeyāda rakṣaka(dhāraka)nembavaṅge aṅgacchēdaṁ
geyvudumaṁ, kṣētra lōbhadiṁ tammaṇṇanaṁ piḍidu konda lōla
nembonaṁ puyyaykaliḍeyiḍe nālkaḍigaḷevudumaṁ, sāgaradattanemba
noḷu jūjāḍi tammuḷḷudellamaṁ sōltu kuḍalilladī samudradattaṁ
sāramēya sakr̥ddūmāntargatanāgi bisiloḷu tagedirdurpudumanondu
maguvanettikoṇḍu pōgi bāḷatuṇḍamaṁ khaṇḍisikoṇḍu kūsaṁ
kondu, pūḷdu kaḷge koṭṭu kuḍida kaḷguḍipiyayugeydu, akr̥tyamamu
nākeya maganinda maṟedu muḷidavaḷge māḻpaḻpi nigrahamumuṁmaṁ,
sānandakanembarasanabhaya ghōṣaṇeyaṁyuṁ māḍidoḍe āarasaneḷaganaṁ kaḷdu
tindaṁ(nanda)kanemboṅge karacchēdanamaṁmuṁ māḻpudumaṁ āmuṁarasara taga
raṅkaḷdu tiṁvatinda pautrikanemboṅgaṁ amēdhya bhakṣaṇaṁ geysuvudumaṁmuṁ,
anukramadoḷe kaṇḍenna koṇḍa vrataṅgaḷa navadhārisi hiṁsādigaḷande
ydeydudenna munnina bhavada duḥkhaṅgaḷaṁ nenedu, hiṁsādigaḷaṁ geydu
neyduva nigrahaṅgaḷaṁ kaṇḍenna kaikoṇḍa, vrataṅgaḷaṁ pattuviḍade pōgi

gurugaḷaṁ kaṇḍempu muttabbeyaṁ pattuviṭṭu (bisuṭu) dīkṣeyaṁ
kaikoṇḍu, guru prasādadiṁ sakaḷa śāstraṅgaḷaṁ kaltu, mattondu divasaṁ
kēvaḷiḷagaḷa pakkade matpūrva bhava sambandhamaṁ kēḷdenadentendoḍe—
puṣkalāvatī viṣayada puṇḍarīkiṇiyuṁ vasupālanāḷuttire, vidyudvēga
nemba kaḷḷanaṁ piḍimuḷḷudellamaṁ koṇḍu mattumiddōḍameyaṁ
tōṟinṟendu, rāja purṣaru nigrahise nimma pergaḍe vimatiya kaiyoḷu
koṭṭenene vimatiyuṁ kaṭṭuvetta kaḷḷanellavumaṁ nuḍigu(maḍagi)meṁ
nnoḷaṁ tappadillembudaṁ upāyāntaradinaṅgapuvanalli kaṇḍu dharmādhi
karaṇar pēḻdu śrī kaṁsapātrī pramāṇasakr̥dbhakṣaṇamuṁ mallarindaṁ
triṁśadmuṣṭi praharaṇaṁ sarvasva haraṇamemba daṇḍatrayamumaṁ māḍe
vimati bāḷdāseyindeydu sattu narakakke pōpodanā vidyuccōranumaṁ
arasaṁ kollempu taḷāṇāṟaṅge pēḻdoḍe aṁhiṁsā vratamuṇṭadaṟiṁ
kollenembonendoḍivanavana kayyoḷu lañcaṁ goṇḍanakkumendu kaḷḷaṅgaṁ
taḷāraṅgaṁ keḷe saṅkaleyayu nikkidāgaḷ kaḷḷanennaṁ kolladinitu duḥkhamuma
nēkeydeyene, taḷāraṁ pēḻiltaḻaltuguḷdaṁ.

vasupālanayyaṁ guṇapāḷanātana sabheyoḷ naṭṭuvanamagaḷu
nāṭyamālile sābhinayadināḍutirdorpoḍarasaṁ mecci cōjōdyambaḍe, kela
doḷirdutpala mālileyemba gaṇike guṇapālaṅgendaḷ idu cōjōdyamaltu
nimma bhāvaṁ kubībērapriyuṁ upavāsa pūrvakaṁ rātri pratime nile pala
teṟadindena(sāpa)ḷipiṁḷiṁ kāḍi cittavikāramaṁ māḍalāṟadudaṟiṁ
brahmacarya vratamaṁ kaikoṇḍenendoḍarasaṁ meccideṁ bēḍikoḷḷendo
ḍenna kaikoṇḍa śīlabratamaṁmuṁ kāvude sālgumendirpinamondu divasaṁ
ākeyallige sarva rakṣitanemba taḷāṇāṟaṁ iruḷ bandoḍe indiṅge nīṁ
pōgendu nuḍiyuttirpannegaṁ mahāmantriyayu magaṁ arasara
maidunaṁ pr̥thuvanembanalligevare taḷāranaṁ mandasinoḷagiṭṭutpalamāli
pr̥thuvanendaḷ enna sarvābharaṇamaṁ ninna taṅge satyavatigoydīke tande,
illendoḍe tandīvenendu nuḍidu pōgi maṟudivasaṁ bēḍeyaṭṭiyuṭṭa
doḍe vrataṅgoṇḍavanaṟidu muḷidu kuḍadire, guṇapālaṅgaṟipidoḍe
arasaṁ pr̥thuvaṁ kaḷakaḷimu kaḷeye, pēḻdoḍaṁ, pr̥thuvaṁ kaḷakaḷidumu
kuḍadire mandasinoḷirda taḷāṟana sākṣi nuḍisidoḍaṁ mattamivillene
satyavati tannābharaṇamaṁ kuḍemuḷidarasaṁ ī pr̥thuvaṅkolalpēḻvuduṁ

ā prastāsthāvadoḷ kubībērapriyaṁ bandu munnorme yāgahasti muni
patigaḷ ōduva dharmaśāstramaṅkēḷdu pūrvabhavamaṁ nenedu māṁsa
kavaḷa(piṇḍa)manolladire ondu upāyadiṁ sādiṁnānaṟidu prāsakamappa
kavaḷamaṅkuḍe koṇḍoḍaṁ enage meccugoṭṭarārasaṁ mecciṁ gītanaṁ
kāvudendu kaṇḍa(kāpa)nāpr̥thuvaṁ pramadavanadoḷatibalanemba vidyā
dharanalli kāmarūpa (vidyādhararūpa mudre) mudrikeyaṁ paḍedu tanna
tammaṁ vasupina kayyoḷu koṭṭu nīṁ seṭṭiya rūpugoṇḍu pōgi
satyavatiya keladoḷ kāvaḷadoḷ nuḍiyuttamirendu tānumarasanaṁ
kaṇḍu madanābhilāṣeyiṁ bandanenda avicāradinarasaṁ kubībērapriyanaṁ
nīne kollendu pr̥thuviṅge besavēṟ seṭṭiyumaḻdaseṭṭiyudondumaṁnaṟi
yade śubhapariṇāmadiṁ tanna maneyoḷ pratimāyōgadoḷiḻirdanaṁ
rāṇiyayu vāsakke tappidanendu poḻalgellamaṟiye sāriparētavana(kokkoḍa
goṇḍoydā rakṣakaṅge)ydā rakṣitaṅge kolalendupaisidoḍe aṅgō
pāṅgaṅgaḷaniṟidoḍella papuḷḷigalligābharaṇamāge poḻaloḷagaṁ poṟaguṁgaṁ
mahōtpātaṅgaḷādoḍe arasanuṁ purajanamuṁ bhayastrarāgi śīlā
laṅkāranappa seṭṭiyane śaraṇpokkar āgaḷ seṇaseṭṭiyupasargaṁ piṅge
dēvarkaḷellamātana śīlaprabhāvamaṁ baṇṇise bandellaruṁ kālgeṟagi
nīmemmaṁ parīkṣisadegeyda parādhamaṁ kṣamiyisuvudene, kubībērapriyu
nidenna pūrvōpārjita duḥṣkarma paripākadinādudidakke, nīmēnuṁ
viṣādaṅgeyyadirimendavaranādarisi poḻalaṁ pokku sukhamirdu kelavu
divasadiṁ guṇapālana magaṁ vasupālaṅge seṭṭiya magaḷ pāriṣēṇeyaṁ
maduveyaṁ māḍi mattondu divasaṁ guṇapālanāsthānadoḷirdu
dharmārtha kāmamōkṣaṅgaḷ paraspara virōdhaṅgaḷappavallendu ā
seṭṭiyaṁyuṁ besagoḷe dharmārtha kāmamōkṣaṅgaḷananubhavisal balla
samyagdr̥ṣṭige parasparānukūlaṅgaḷu, mithyādr̥ṣṭige viruddhatvadiṁ prati
kūlaṅgaḷ entendoḍe :

embudumarasaṁ meccideṁ bēḍikoḷḷiḷpamembunduṁ kubībērapriyanena
genduṁ sāvilladantumāḷpuṟpudendoḍarasanenagaśakyamendoḍadaṁ paḍeva
upāyama nāne balleṁ ennaṁ bēḍimendoḍe arasanuṁ gr̥hatyāgaṁ

geyal bagedu tanna makkaḷavyaktarendu cintisuva prastāvadoḷ kelakke
bīṟoḻdoḍedapaḷḷilliya tattrittiyoḷagirda maṟi keladoḷirvarda mākṣikamaṁ
piḍidukoḷvudaṁ kaṇḍellā prāṇigaḷuṁ upadēśamillade jīvitōpāya
nāhārādi sañjñōtkarṣadiṁ tāme ballumendu vasupāla, śrīpālara
nadhirāja yuvarāja padaviyoḷ niṟisi guṇapālaṁ, kubībērapriyaṁ
modalāge palambaru berasu saṁyamamaṁ kaikoṇḍar. adaṟinandā
kubībērapriyana vratada phalamaṁ kaṇḍu ānumahiṁsāvratamaṁ kai
koṇḍeṁ. adaṟiṁ ninnaṁ hiṁsegeydu nillendataḷaṟiṁ vidyudvēganaṁ
pratibōdhisidoḍātanuṁ tanna geyda duścaritakke bhayastranādonendu
bhīmasādhugaḷ hiraṇyavarmahacaradēvaṅgaṁ prabhāvatīhacaradēvigaṁ pēṟduḻdu
mattamintendar :

mr̥ṇāḷavatiyoḷ bhavadēvanādandu rativēge sukāntaroḷu baddha
vairanāgi kapōtaṅgaḷāda bhavadoḷu marjāranāgi koṇḍu khēcara janma
doḷu vidyudvēganāgi mahōpasargamanavarge māḍi naraka duḥkhama
nuṇḍu bandu, nīnilli puṭṭideyendu jinapatigaḷenage besasidar. ānu
menna janmāntaramanaṟidenembudumadaṁ kēḷdu nīvuṁ kole satta
vare nāmendaṟipi niśśalyaṅgeydu bandisi pōdarendu sulōcane
jayakumāraṅge pēṟduḻdu mattamintendaḷ: ondu divasaṁ bhīma
sādhugaḷ puṇḍarīkiṇiya śivaṅkarōdyānamodoḷ kēvaḷa pūjeyayu
geydiydarpannegaṁ nālvar dēviyar bandu bandisi, dhāriṇiyuṁ dharma
śravaṇānantaramintendar : emma karmavaśadiṁ patiyilladirderdēmemuma
gāvoṁ patiyakkuṁ besasimene bhīmakēvaḷigaḷ intendu besasidar,
ī poḻaloḷ suradēvanemboṁ bōjaganātaṅge vasuṣēṇeyuṁ vasuṁ
dhareyuṁ, pr̥thuviyumemba nālvar bhāryeyar avara cēṭakiyar
śrīmatiyuṁ,viśōkeyuṁ, vimaḷeyuṁ,vasanteyumembar avarellaṁ
ondu divasaṁ udyānavanadoḷ yatipavarara samīpadoḷ dānādi
vrataṅgaḷaṁ kaikoṇḍu tatphaladinacyuta kalpadoḷu pratīndraṅge rati
ṣēṇeyuṁ, susīmeyuṁ, sukhavatiyuṁ, subhageyumemba dēviya
rādar. nimma cēṭakiyaruṁ, citraṣēṇeyuṁ, citravēgeyuṁ, dhana
patiyuṁ, dhanaśrīyumemba, vānavyantara kanyeyarādar mumpēṟdaḻda
suradēvaṁ piṅgaḷakanemboṁ rākṣasanāgi dōṣadiṁ saṅkaleyoḷirda

suradēvana tāyiyumarasana magaḷāgi puṭṭi śrīpālakumāraṅge
kuḍuva vivāhōtsavadoḷellara seṟiṟegaḷuṁ biḍuvāgaḷ. piṅgaḷakana
seṟiṟeyuṁ biṭṭoḍātanuṁ sanyāsanaṅgeydu budhavimānadoḷu puṭṭivapa
dēvanilligīgaḷ bandu nimage patiyakkumembudumāsthitiyoḷ bandu
patiyādaṁ. ā vānavyantara kanyakiyaruṁ emagāvoṁ patiyakku
mendu besagoḷe, mumpēḷda piṅgaḷakanamagaṁ atipiṅgaḷanuṁ sanyasana
doḷirdanātaśane nimage patiyakkumene nālvarumātanaṁ pōgi pūji
suttirdar. alli ratikulanembos manmadanasammōhana vyatikaramuma
nātana tande maṇināgadattana vr̥ttāntamumaṁ sukētuva kathāprapañca
mumaṁ kēḷdantātaṁ dēvanādandu ā nālvaruṁ dēviyarāvarendu
dr̥ṣṭaśrutamappudaṁ sulōcane pēṟiḻi kurupati mattaputramēnānuṁ kaṇḍa
kēḷda kathegaḷaṁ pēṟemḻimbuduṁdu, śrīpāḷa vasupāḷālākhyānamanintendu
pēṟdaḻdaḷ :

ī jambūdvīpavada pūrvavidēhada puṣkaḷāvatīviṣayada puṇḍarī-
kiṇiya nāḷvoṁ, śrīpālanuṁ vasupālanu māḷuttire vasupālanatāyi
kubībēraśrīge vana pālakar bandu suragiriyoḷ guṇapāla bhaṭṭāra
kargge, kēvala jñānōtpattiyādudendu binnapaṅgeydoḍe eṟiḻiḍiyuṁ
naḍapuduttamāṅgadoḷirdu (naḍepadattamogadirdu) bandisi, vanapālakaṅge
meccugoṭṭu ghōṣaṇā pūrvakamellarumaṁ barpantu besasi kubībēra
śrīyuṁmunnamepōgi dēvaraṁ bandisuttirpannegaṁ śrīpāla vasu-
pālar mahāvibhūtiyimbandu jagatpāla cakravarti dīkṣegoṇḍu
pramadavanada jinālayada muṁvaṇa yakṣapratimeya kelālada maravaḍi
yoḷirda rājamaṁmuṁ (rāṭamaṁmuṁ) kaṇḍu śrīpālakumāranendaṁ: ī
puruṣaṁ strīvēda(ṣapha) paranallanduṁ ī strī puruṣa vēṣadhāraṇe
yalladaṁ (duṁmuṁ ivara āṭamu) dēvarājanēpēḷpudendupalakṣisaloḍaṁ
puruṣavēṣamodoḷāḍuttirda madanavēge mūrchevōpōvumuṁduṁ eḻcaccarise
śrīpālanindintēke yene, priyarati pēṟaḻaltaguḷdaḷ :

suramya viṣayada śrīpuramanāḷvaṁ śrīdharanembarasaṅgaṁ śrīmati
dēvigaṁ jayamatiyemba pāgaṇaḷamoḍākeya puṭṭidandu naimittikarīke
cakravartigaṁ mahādēviyakkumendoḍe ā naimittikar pēṟdanḻdandamoḷ
parīkṣisalendu naṭanaṭībhēdadiṁ arasuttumbandu kaṇḍumīkeyenna

magaḷ, īnaṭaṁ vāsavanembonendoḍarasaṁ priyaratige meccugoṭṭu
suragirige nijaguru vandanārthadiṁ baruttumōrvanondaśvamaṁ
tandu koṭṭoḍava nēsēṟidoḍe adu gaganataḷakkogedu tannavidyādharare
rūpamaṁ tōṟiyuṁ mumbēḷda yakṣaṁ bandu poydu baggisi (doḍe
aśanivēga khēcaraṁ) kaggadoḍarasanaṁ khacaraṁ biṭṭu pōge yakṣaṁ
parṇalaghuvidyeyiṁ ratnāvartagiriyamēle tandiṟipi palavuṁ lābhaṅgaḷa
ninita nīgeyduguṁ endu yakṣampōdaṁ ittā vasupālanuṁ guṇapāla
jinarambandisi tadupadēśadiṁ sapta rātrakke nijānujana baravanaṟidu
santōsaṁśōṣadi nirdaṁ. itta kumāranondu koḷadoḷu mindu vana
phalaṅgaḷaṁ tindu pariśramamumanāṟisuttirpannegaṁ tatsamīpada sudhā
gr̥hadiṁ rājakanyakiyarantaṟuvarbanduṁ ītaṁ rājaputranendaṟidu
tamma vr̥ttāntamanintendaṟipidar:

siṁhapuramanāḷvanarapālaṅgaṁ guṇapālanataṅge rājaśrīgaṁ puṭṭide
pāvuṁ, ratikānte, ratisēne, rati, ratiprabhe, jayāvati, jayadatte
yarembī āruvarumanemmaṁ aśanivēgaṁ bhaumavihāradoḷu kaṇḍaḷipi
doḍāmuṁ śrīpālaṅgallade peraraveṇḍirāgevendoḍemmaṁ muḷidī
cāraṇa kūṭadoḷ śaṟiyaniṭṭu śrīpāla kumāranaṁ kolalendu
pōdanembannegaṁ (ḍendige barpaṁnegaṁ) aśanivēganataṅge vidyudvēge
yemboḷ, taṁmuḷtaṁmaṇṇanabesadiṁ kolalubandu kumāranaṁ kāṇaloḍaṁ
āsakteyāge nijavr̥ttāntamellamuṁ intendaṟipidaḷ, kuntaḷapurama
nāḷvastanitavēgaṅgaṁ jyōtirvēgegaṁ aśanivēganembōmumagaṁ naṁmunaṁmaṇṇa
nātane ninnallige bandu kolalennannanaṭṭidoḍillige bandu ninnaṁ kaṇḍu
sōlteṁ īsaudhabhavanakke pōpamene kumāra nolladire,vidyeyiṁ saudha
bhavanamanalliyenirmisi munninaṟuvaruṁ rājakannikeyaru berasirpinaṁ,
anaṅga (varṇarṁnega) patākeyambōḷ, vidyudvēgeya jēṭike bandu
kumāraṅgintendu binnapaṁ gaidaḷ: bhavadgurugaḷappa guṇapāla jinara
samīpamoḷu jyōtirvēgeya tandege tannaḷiyanaṁ śrīpālakumāranaṁ
stanitavēganā upāyadoḷaṁ aṟisuvudendu kubēraśrī besase tanna maga
naśanivēgantandanembuduṁ. stanitavēganuṁ bandhugaḷumaṟiduttara
śrēṇiyanāḷvaninīlavēganoḷ tamage pageyappudanālōcisi kumāranaṁ
prayatnadiṁ koṇḍubarpudene bandeṁ. ī vidyudvēgeyuṁ ninnaṁ kaṇḍu

sōltaḷ. īkeyaṁ kaikoḷvudene śrīpālakumāranendaṁ: tāyuṁ,
tandeyumirdu koṭṭoḍallade peṟaraṁ parigrahisavantu upanayana
kāladoḷ gurusamīpamoḷ vratamaṁ kaikoṇḍesene kumārana
manavaṁ munninaṟuvaruṁ tānuṁ rañjisalāṟade, vidyudvēge saudha
bhavanadoḷu kumāranaṁ ratnakambaḷāvr̥tanaṁ harmyataḷa gatamaṁmāḍi
khaḷakeḷeya bāgilantelantrettu tannagurujanamuṁmaṁ taralendu pōdaḷannega
mittaṁtraṁ, suptanāgirdakumāranaṁ piśitāpaśakti (śaṅkeyiṁ) bhīruṇḍavakki
koṇḍoydu siddhakūṭa jinālayada caityavr̥kṣada mēgikkidomoḍeṭṭaṟilbba
sajītanarāgirdaraṁ tinnada kāraṇadiṁ bhīruṇḍanuṁ bisuṭu pōytu.
kumāranuṁ maradindiṟidu koḷadoḷu mindu sugandha puṣpaṅgaḷaṁ
koṇḍoydu jinabhavanamaṁ triḥpradakṣiṇaṅgeydāgaḷu tammaṁ tāme
paditaṟiḍiteṟeye santōṣadi pēdindēvaranarjircisi bandisi bandirpannegaṁ ōrva
vidyādharaṁ bandetti koṇḍoydu manōhara viṣayada śivaṅkara purama
nāḷvaninīḷavēga vidyādhararājaṅgaṁ kāntāvatīdēvigaṁ puṭṭida bhōgavati
yamyemboḷaṁ ākāśa sphaṭikabhavanataḷa mr̥duśayanadoḷu puṭṭidōrḷaṁḷaṁ
tōṟi, kumāra pēḷīkeḷkeyāvaḷembuduṁ, kupita viṣama bhujaṅgi
yendu sarasaṁ nuḍiye vidyādharanā kanneyayu tandeyalliguydu nimma
magaḷanītaṁ viṣama bhujaṅgiyendanene, muḷidu durdhara tapōdhanara
munijana nivāsadomōḷītanasonoydu bisulvuṭṭudembuduṁ āldiḷdina besa
doḷu vijayārdhaduttara śrēṇiya manōhara nagarada bhīṣaṇa smaśāna
doḷu śītavētāḷa vidyeyiṁ kumāranaṁ jaratīrūpadharanaṁ māḍi
bisuṭu pōpramuṁ, ōrvaḷaspr̥śyakuḷasambhave tannaḷiyanaṁ grāma
mr̥garūpadiṁ tanna magaḷa kālgaḷoḷu poraḷdu tiḷipuvante māḍe mattaṁ,
pūrvasvarūpamoḷirdanaṁ kaṇḍu, kumāraṁ tannoḷvidyādhararādorellaṁ
rūpa parāvartana samartharapparendu bagevannegaṁ tanna maiykoyyoḷu
kr̥tānta sōpāna paṅktiyantirparda tereyumaṁ, kāsa kusuma sanni
kāśamāgirdanareyumaṁ toṭṭane kaṇḍu nācciṇci viṣaṇṇanāgirpannegaṁ
mumpēḻdaḷda bhōgavatigaḷaṇṇaṁ harikētuvemboṁ mahauṣadhi vidyeyaṁ
sādhise vidye mr̥takarūpadeḷirda kumāranaṁ karedenna baya(vani)si
dudaṁ śaṅkeyillade kuḍiyembuduṁ avadanā sthitiyoḷenegaṟi sarvavyādhi
vināsiyappa vidye ninnanāśrayasidumudendu ati priya vacanamaṁ nuḍidu
harikētu pōdaṁ.

ittaṁ kumāranuṁ pūrvasvarūpamaṁ tāḷdu baruttuṁ ondālada
maradaḍiyoḷirdanōrvanaṁ kaṇḍī pradēśamāvudene, vijayārdha
parvatamuttara śrēṇiya nīḷapuragiriya dakṣiṇadigbhāgadi susīmā viṣayada
mahā nagarada bhūtavanamembudī pradēśaṁ illi sapta pāṣāṇamembudu
poḷavu. avanondondaṟa mēlondaḍakiliṭṭu niṟisidātaṁ cakravarti
yappanene, kumāranāsthitiyoḷaniṟise, kaṇḍu tatpurādhipatige pēḻiṟi
lātaṁ pōdanittaṁ kumāraṁ saṁsāra śarīrabhōga nirvēgaparāyaṇanāgi
baruttamondu maradaḍiyoḷ bībhatsākāradinirdaḷōrva vr̥ddheyaṁ
kaṇḍu puṣkalāvatī viṣayakke pōpa baṭṭeyāvudene, nabhō(gamanadina)
bhāgadalalladallige pōgalbāradu. gavyūti śatōtsēdhamappa vijayārdha
giriyindittalirpardallige pōpanda māvudene(mpu(ndu) mattamintendatembaḷ :

jambūdvīpada vatsakāvatī viṣayada vijayārdhagiriya rājapurama
nāḷva vidyādhara cakravarti dharaṇīkampaṅgaṁ prabhāvatī(karī) dēvigaṁ
magaḷāṁ prabhā(sukhā)vatiyanembeṁ. jāti kula sādhita vidyāpārageye
nānondu divasaṁ kacchakāvatī viṣayada vijayārdha parvatada mēle
pōguttuṁ. akampana magaḷ voppiliyembōyemboḷaṁ enna keḷadiyuṁ
ennallige barpaḷaṁ kaṇḍākeya kaiyallirda ratnakambaḷamanivasedanelli paḍade
yemboḍe. idā dēśa kambaḷamendu madana dahana santapteyādaḷaṁ
negaṁ āvopoppiliyaṁ nōḍalākeyayu keḷadi madanavatiyembōḷ
kāñcanapuradiṁ bandu kambaḷada kaḍeyoḷtuḷtaguḷdirda ratnamudrike
yoḷbarevada śrīpāla nāmākṣaraṅgaḷaṁ kaṇḍākeyumanaṅgaśara paravaśe
yādoḷānumīgaḷe baredirdadda pesarāta nī viṣayakke banda kāraṇa
māvudu puṇḍarīkiṇiṇege savistara vāārayvenendu pōgi nityamaṇḍita
jinālayadoḷu dēvaraṁ bandisi kuḷḷirdu matte kubēraśrīye ninna
pravāsa vr̥ttāntamumaṁ nenage pēḷe ninna taralendu barutaṁ vidyudvēgeyuṁ
kaṇḍāke pēḷe nijavārteyanaṟidu vidyudvēgeyanendaṁ nīnēnuṁ
viṣādaṅgeyyalvēlbēḍa kumāranaṁ tandu ninnoḷḷiḷnirapuvenendu santaisi
siddhakūṭa jinālayadoḷu kr̥ta namaskāranāgirda ninnaṁ puṇḍarīkiṇi
goykalu bandenene kumāranenda, nīnēke jaratiyādeyene nakku
sukhāvati ninagēke muppāytene nōḍi, tanage muppāduvaṁ kaṇḍu
nīnintēke māḍideyene sukhāvatiyendaḷu. vappileya madanavatiyuya

sōdarada maidunaṁ dhūmumavēganuṁ, harivaranu membaravarninage muḷi
dudanaṟidu ninage rūpa parāvartanaṁ māḍideṁ endu tanna tanda rasā
yanōpamānamāda phalaṅgaḷanātana paśivaṁ keḍisi ninnaṁ pottukoṇḍu
pōpenene strīyarpottoyke pōpenalleṁ guru samumakṣadoḷu gr̥hīta
vratanembuduṁ puruṣa vēṣadiṁ pottukoṇḍu siddhakūṭa jinālaya
mannaidi bandisi viśramisirpannegamandina divasame bhōgavati tanna manege
bhahadraṁ bandu maguḷe pōpudaṁ kanasugaṇḍu dusvapnaphala praśama
nārthaṁ cairthañjaityālaya pūjege kāntapatiyuṁ, rativēgeyuṁ, suvē
geyuṁ, amitamatiyuṁ, ratikānteyuṁ, citravēgeyuṁ, mada
vatiyuṁ, vappileyuṁ, vidyudvēgeyuṁ modalāge parijanaṁ verasu
bandākula citteyarāgi dēdhēvaraṁ bandisuvudumaṁ (sukhāvati) śiva
kumāranembonavakramukhavādēśapūruṣa darśanadiṁ saytādudumaṁ
kaṇḍu sukhāvati kumārananallinda muyke kāmumarūpa mudrikeyaṁ
tanna nānāvidha rūpaṅgaḷaṁ nīroḷu nōḍuttumirda harivara kumā
ranaṁ kaṇḍu piḍidoydu kāḷa guheyoḷikki modadoḍallirppa mahānāganātana
puṇya prabhāvadiṁ akiñcitkaranāge nāgaśayanadoḷpuṭṭirdu maṟudivasa
mādēvi puruṣaṁ vr̥ddharūpadiṁ poramaḍuvudaṁ parīkṣi (kar)taru
pēḷeḷi dhūmumavēgaṁ bandu candrapurada smaśānadoḷu kumāraṅge nānā
vidhāyudhaṅgaḷiḷanupasargaṁ māḍidoḍaveḍellavu kiñcitkaraṅgaḷāduvuṁ.
annegaṁ atibaḷanemba khēcaraṁ tannarasi citrasēneyoḷ tannoḷu polla
keydoḍavanaṁ suṭṭa citākāgniyoḷkumārana nikkuvuduṁ tanage sādhya
māda mahauṣadhi prabhāvadiṁ jvaḷana śaktikiḍe poramaṭṭu kumāranaṁ
kaṇḍu ātanaṁ muṭṭaṭṭida (tavaṁ puṭṭaṭṭida) kicciṅccaṅge dahanaśaktiyillembuda
naṟidu alli munna satta baṇṭana peṇḍati nirdōṣiyayunenna gaṇḍanaṁ
kemmane kondirendu śuddha prakāśa nimittaṁ ā citā(gniyaṁ pokku)
janadoḍanēkāgniyaṁ pokku pōṟamaḍe kumāraṁ kaṇraṅkuṇḍu yuvatiyayu
māyākavaca mārgamabhēdyamendu cōdyambaṭṭu barutamā poḻaṟala
nāḷva vimalasēnana magaḷu kamalavapatiyayu kāmumagrahamaṁ kaḷevalli nereda
janadoḍane pokku kumāraṁ kaḷedoḍā dēśa puruṣanendaṟidu tanna
magaḷaṁ koḍuvenendoḍātanolladire vāpāriṣēṇanemba maganaṁ kumāraṅge
nerampēramphēḷdītanaṁ bandhugaḷaneydisendu kaḷaḷipe, vimaḷa purōdyānadoḷu

tr̥pitanāda kumārananirisi nīraṁ taralpōdaṁ. itta sukhāvati gujji
yāgi bandu puṣpamāleyayu mēlikki tr̥ṣeyaṁyuṁ kaḷedu kumāraṅge
kanyārūpamaṁ māḍidoḍāpoḻaṟalaṁ āḷva rativēganemba khēcaraṅgaṁ
kāñcanamāleligaṁ puṭṭida kānteyuṁ, sukānteyuṁ. ratikānteyuṁ,
kāntavatiyumemba nālvaruṁ modalāge, palambaruṁ berasirda kr̥taka
kanneya kāraṇakke tammoḷaṟivadhūmumavēganuṁ, harivaranuṁ, bandhugaḷaṁ
barisi nimmīrvaroḷagāraṁ ī kanneyoldapaḷō kaikoḷvadendu tirdi
kaḷeye pūrvasvarūpadoḷirda kumāranaṁ kaṇḍu ā kanneyaru lajjite
yaruṁ, santuṣṭeyarumāgi mamuṟaṟidoḍātanaṁ prabhātadoḷetti
sukhāvati koṇḍoyke kumāraneccattu nōḍi nīninnegaṟillirdeyeyune
sukhāvati ninnanagalade ninagappa vanitāratnalābhamuṁ ninagapāyamilleṁ
budumanaṟidinnegaṁ mugaṁmoygaredirdenene santōṣambaṭṭu pōgi vijayā
rdhavada dakṣiṇaśrēṇiyu kelava gajapuradoḷondu va.pamadagajaṁ iruḷ visaṭaṁ
barpudaṁ kaṇḍu mūpatteraḍuṁ krīḍegaḷoḷaḷavaḍisi vaśaṁmāḍe tatpura
janamellaṁ nēsaṟmūḍimūrḍidāgaḷāṇādēśa puruṣaṁ bandavanendu aṣṭa śōbhe
geydu dirgōydirgoḷe mattamante nabhōgamanadoḷu bare, hayapura samīpa
doḷondu hayaṁ vimukta bandhanamāgi bandu kumāranaṁ pradakṣiṇaṁ
geyke, tatpurada janaṅgaḷu ādēśa puruṣanendaṟidu pūjise caturjana
pada mumadhyagatamappa sīmunmantagiriyaneydi kauvaregoṇḍu nōlpiḻbi
janamaṁ kaṇḍidēnendu besagoṇḍu pepēṟarārgaṁ kīṟaḻalāṟada bāḷaṁ
kittu bidira pogaṟaniṟvuṟivudu mudaṁ kaṇḍu purajana mārppumaṁpārvaduṁa, avaro
ḷōrva mūgaṁ jayaśabda pūrvakameṟagi poḍamaṭṭu, mattōrvaṁ
kuṇṭaveralātaṁ tanna beraluṁ saytādoḍe kr̥tāñjaḷiyādaṁ,
mattōrvaṁ vajramapuṇiyaṁ aḍutumirdātaṁ avaṟapākadoḷumātaṅge
vinayaparanādoṁ.

antu mumpēḷda karavāḷapati vijayapuradoḷu puṭṭidātaṁ bhaviṣya
ccakravarti śrīpālaṅge sēnāpatiyakkuṁ, ā poḻalanāḷva varakīrtiyeṁ
bana magaḷu kīrtimati kānteyakku madakke karavāḷōddharaṇamādēśaṁ,
āmūgaṁ śrīpuradoḷu puṭṭidanātaṁ kumāraṅge purōhitanakkuṁ,
ā poḻalanāḷva śivasēnana magaḷu vītaśōke vaniteyakkuṁ avakke
mūka paribhāṣaṇamādēśaṁ, ā kuṇṭaṁ śilpapuradoḷpuṭṭidanātaṁ

kumāraṅge sthapati ratnamakkuṁ, āpoḷalanāḷva parapatiyembana magaḷu
rativimaḷe lalaneyakkuṁ, avarge saṅkucitāṅguḷi prasāraṇamādēśa
māvajramaṇi pākithādhānyapuradoḷpuṭṭidavasānātaṁ kumāraṅge pradhānapuruṣa
nakkuṁ, āpoḻalanāḷva viśālanr̥patiyuya magaḷu vimalasēne vadhuvakkuṁ,
āvarge vajramaṇipākamāvādēśaṁ,antibarbaruṁ tantamma kāryasiddhiyuṁyaṁ
prakaṭaṁ māḍal tantamma nelegaḷge pōdar. itta sukhāvati vāhana
māgi kumāraṁ bare pūrvōkta vairiyuṁ, dhūmavēganembanaḍḍa bandu
baggisi nilvuduṁ mumpēḻda puṇḍarīkiṇiya yakṣaṁ vidyādhara rūpadiṁ
bandelile sukhāvati nīṁ kumārananañjade biṭṭu pōgene, dhūmavēga
noḷ poṇardoḷ. ittaṁ kumāranuṁ dharaṇītaḷada śilākhātaḷakkavatarisi
barpannega mātana pūrvabhavada piriyabbe dēvaśrīyembaḷ, yakṣiyāgi
dārke bandu nijakarakamaladiṁ śarīrasparśanaṅgeydu,pariśramamanāṟiḻisi
kāñcana guheyoḷagaṇa maḍuvaṁ pugavēḻduṁḻvuduṁ, yakṣiyayu vacanamaṁ
pramāṇaṁ māḍi pokku tanmadhyaśilā stambhava mēlirdiruḷellaṁ pañcanama
skāra padamanōduttuṁ, prabhātadōdoḷapavauttara digbhādoḷirda jinā
layava jinabimbamanarcisi namaskāraṁ geyvudu, malliya sahasrapadmaṁ
cakramāytu, kūrmamātapatramāytu, sahasraphaṇabhujaṅgadaṇḍa
ratnamāytu, kharpavarmaraṁ cūḍāmaṇiyāytu, nakraṁ carma ratna
māytu, raktapr̥ṣṭhiṣṭikaṁ kākiṇī ratnamāytāgaḷu yakṣiya pēḻdupa
dēśadiṁ cakraratnamanetti, daṇḍaratnamaṁ piḍidu, pradyōtamāna carma
ratnōpānahamānāgi yakṣikoṭṭa sarvaratnamayābharaṇaṅgaḷaṁ toṭṭu
guheyiṁ poyimpōṟamaṭṭu, dhūmavēgaṅge mānabhaṅgaṁ māḍivaṁdaṁ, (māḍe
bandu) sukhāvati, suragiriyaneydi, samavasaraṇa maṇḍaḷamaṁ pokku,
guṇapāla jinapatiyuṁyaṁ bandisi kubēraśrīyumaṁ vasupālanumaṁ
vinayadiṁ kaṇḍu tapādāśīrvāvadamaṁ kaikoṇḍu sukhāvatiya prabhāvadinda
menaginitu mahāvibhūtiyāmamudendākeyuya praśaṁsegeydu pūrvōkta
saptadinadāgaḷu mahāvibhūtiyiṁ poḻalaṁ pokku vasupālaṁ vālampāriṣēṇa
modalāge palambar kanneyaraṁ, śrīpālanuṁ jayavati modalāgeṇbattu
sālvarkanneyaraṁ maduve nile, jayavatige svargāvataraṇa pūrvakaṁ
guṇapālanemba magaṁ puṭṭe, śrīpālaṅge cakraratnaṁ puṭṭe, daśāṅgabhōga
mananubhavisi guṇapāla kumāraṅge jayāvatiya aṇṇanappa jayavarmana

magaḷ jayasēneyumaṁ, aśanivara, naśanivēga, manōvēga, hari
kētu, śivaprabhr̥tigaḷa magaḷdaḷdirumaṁ tandu vivāha vidhiyaṁ māḍe,
mattondu divasaṁ candragrahaṇamaṁ kaṇḍu, nirvēgadiṁ guṇapāla
kumāraṅgātmīya pūrvabhava sambandhamaṁ tannoḷinḷantendu bagevaṁ:
puṣkarārdhadaparavidēhada padmaviṣayada kāntāpuramanāḷva kanakarathaṅgaṁ
kanakaprabhādēvigaṁ kanakaprabhanemba maganāgi bahirōdyāna kēḷiyoḷu
nijavallabhe vidutprabhādēvi, sarpadaṣṭeyāge tadviyōgadiṁ mātr̥ pitr̥
bandhujanaṁ berasu samādhiguptara pakkade dīkṣegoṇḍu ṣōḍaśa bhāvane
gaḷaṁ tīrthakara puṇyamaṁ kaṭṭi jīvitāntyadoḷ jayanta vimānadoḷu
ahamindranāgi puṭṭi, tanna bandudaṁ bagevannegaṁ mumpēḻda hiraṇya
varmana, priyadatteya, prabhāvatiyuya tandepirappa ādityagatiyuṁ,
samudravadattanuṁ, vāyurathanuṁ mattaṁ kubēra kāntanuṁ, lōkāṁ
tika dēvarāgirdavaruṁ bandu tannaṁ pratibōdhise, guṇapāla kumāraṁ
saṁyamamaṁ kaikoṇḍu tīrthakaratvamaṁ paḍedaṁ, sukhāvatiya magaṁ
yaśaḥpālaṁ prathamagaṇadharanādaṁ, śrīpāla cakravartiyuṁ dharmaśravaṇa
pūrvakaṁ ātmabhavasambandhamaṁ besagoḷe,tīrthakarar intendu besasida
rendu sulōcane jayakumāraṅge pēḷaltaguḷdaḷ.

puṇḍarīkiṇiyuṁyaṁ yaśaḥpālaṁ paripālisuttirpinaṁ ā poḻala seṭṭaṭṭi
sarva samr̥ddhanembōnātaṅge sāgarasēnanoḍa puhuṭṭida vēdēvaśrīyuṁ,
dhanañjayanosoḍapuṭṭida dhanaśrīyuṁ, bhāryeyarādaravaroḷage dēva
śrīge vaiśravaṇadattanemba maganāgi vaiśravaṇadatteyemba magaḷumādarā
dhanaśrīge sarvadaitanemsemba maganuṁ sarvadayiteyemba magaḷumādar.
sarvasamr̥ddhanoḍapuṭṭida sāgarasēnegaṁ sāgaradattanuṁ, samudradattanu
memba magandiruṁ, sāgaravadatteyemba magaḷumādar. sarvadayita
seṭṭige sāgarasēnana magaḷu jayasēneyuṁ, dhanañjayana magaḷu dhana
datteyuṁ, peṇḍirāge vaiśravaṇavadattaṅge sāgaravadatte bhāryeyādaḷu.
sāgaradattaṅge vaiśravaṇavadatte bhāryeyādaḷu. samudradattaṅge sarva
vayidayute bhāryeyāvadaḷu. intellaruṁ sukhamirpinamondu divasaṁ
dhanañjayaṁ parārghya ratnamaṁ, pāguḍamendu yaśaḥpālaṅge koṇḍo
ydaḍarasanātanaṁ mannisi piridu poḍomeyaṁ koṭṭoḍadaṁ kēḷdu,
poḻaloḷuḷḷa parapadarellaṁ dhanārjanakke pōgalendu keladūroḷu bīḍaṁ

biṭṭiṭṭare samudradattaṁ magaḻdu bandu r̥tukāla prāpteyāgirda sarva
daiteyoḷu neredu, sābhijñāna(saṁvujña)duṅgaramaṁ koṭṭu āru
maṟiyadandiniruḷu sārthamaṁ kūḍi pōdanittaṁ sarvadaite garbhamaṁ
tāḷe sāgaradattaṁ kaṇḍu duścariteyendu dūṟi samudradattaṁ bandu
pōda vr̥ttāntamaṁ āke pēḻiyuṁ, maneyaṁ poṟamaḍisi kaḷeye,
tammaṇṇaṁ sarvadayitasānākeyuya kayyuṅgaramaṁ kaṇḍu tanna maneyaṁ
pugalīyadirdoḍātana maneyu kelamoḷirdu maganaṁ paḍeye sarva
dayitanemagidu kulaparibhavamendā magananōrva parijārakanakaiyyoykoḷu
koṭṭu, bisuḍendoḍātaṁ jayabhāmeverasu pitr̥vanakke vidyeyaṁ sādhisa
lendu bandu, jayadhāmanemba seṭṭiya keḷeyanappa vidyādharana kaiyoḷ
koṭṭoḍātaṁ, tannāḷva bhōgapurakkoydu jitaśatruvendu pesaraniṭṭu
naḍavuttamirdaṁ. ittaṁ sarvadayite putraviyōga duḥkhite strī ninde
geydu sattu puruṣanāgi puṭṭidomoḷitta, samudradattaṁ sārthadoḍane
bandu nijabhāryeya vr̥ttāntamaṁ kēḷdu tammaṇṇaṅge kinisi niraparādhe
yennapeṇḍatigeḍegoṭṭanillendu sarvadaita seṭṭige kaḍumuḷidirpippinaṁ
vaiśravaṇadattaṁ, piriyanāgirdante seṭṭipadadoḷu tānindanimpanendati
krōdhadiṁ sāgaradatta, samudradatteyarverasu mūvaruṁ tapaṁ baṭṭar.

ittondu divasaṁ, sarvadaitaseṭṭi jitaśatruvaṁ sabheyoḷ kaṇḍu
samudra dattanoḷanurūpanese nīnārgendubesagoḷe jitaśatru nija
vr̥ttāntamellamaṁ pēḻi tatkararatnamudrikā darśanadindaṁ nambi
tannaḷiyanappudaṁ niścayisi tānuṁ tanna maydunanuṁ parīkṣisade
negaḻdudarkkerke nirvēgamāgi sarvaśrīyemba tanna magaḷumaṁ sarvasva
mumaṁ seṭṭivāḻumaṁ jitaśatruge koṭṭu jayadhāmamunuṁ, jaya
dhāmeyuṁ, jayasēnanuṁ, dhanadatteyuṁ, vaiśravaṇadatteyuṁ modalāge
palambarumberasu yativarara samīpadoḷ saṁyamumamaṁ kaikoṇḍu,
kālāntaradoḷu suralōkadoḷpuṭṭi bandilli jayadhāmaṁmuṁ vasupāla
nādoṁ, jayadhāme jayāvatiyādaḷ, jayasēne vappilileyādaḷ,
dhanadatte madanavatiyādaḷ, sāgaradatte sukhāvatiyādaḷ, vaiśravaṇadatte
vidyudvēgeyādaḷ, sāgaradattaṁ purūravana magaṁ harivaranādoṁ,
samudradattanuṁ jvalanavēgana magaṁ dhūmavēganādoṁ, vaiśravaṇadattaṁ
āśanivēganādoṁ, sarvadaita seṭṭiyesīṁ, trīsīntripāla cakravartiyādyedai.

sarvadaitege putraviyōgamumanandu nīṁ māḍidudaṟiṁ mātr̥viyō
gamaṁ, pitr̥viyōgamaṁ, bandhuviyōgamumādudandina śiśuvaṁ kolla
dudaṟiṁ mattaṁ ninage bandhu samāgama mādudu. andina keḷeyuṁ
pageyu mīgaḷ keḷeyuṁ pageyu māḍidar, andina tapada phaladiṁ
nīṁ cakradharanuṁ, caramadēhadharanumādeyendu tīrthakarar besasi
doḍanibaruṁ paraspara virōdharahitarādar. śrīpālacakravarti sukhā
vatiyu magaṁ narapālaṅge rājyamaṁ koṭṭu jayavati modalāge palaru
marasiyaruṁ vasupālaṁ modalāge palabarumarasugaḷuṁ berasu
saṁyamumamaṁ kaikoṇḍu muktige sandar. arasiyar, strītvamaṁ
pattuviṭṭu dēvarādarenvendu jinapati pēḷe nāmumallige vandanā bhaktige
pōgi kēḷdaḷdevendu sulōcane pēḻi sabheyallamāścaryaṁ baḍe, jaya
kumāraṅge pūrvajanmada prajñaptividye modalāge vidyegaḷellaṁ bandu besa
keydu tammoḍahuṭṭida vijayakumāraṅge rājyabhāramanappaysi sulō
caneverasu yathēṣṭa vividha vidyāvāhanaṁ jaladhiśaraśaiḷa vana nadī puḷina
mādi pradēśaṅgaḷoḷ jayakumāraṁ vihārisuttumondu divasaṁ
kailāsa parvatada banadoḷu sulōcaneyuṁ inisānu magaḻdu vihā
risuvannegamōrvaḷ bandu, vijayārdhaduttara śrēṇiya manōhara
viṣayada ratnapuramanāḷva piṅgaḷagāndhāraṅgaṁ suprabhādēvigaṁ puṭṭida
vidyutprabheyembennaṁ ī vidyādharana peṇḍatiyeṁ. munna mahā mēru
nandanadoḷ ninnaṁ kaṇḍanurakteyenāgi ninnanaṟasuttuṁ bandilli kaṇḍe
nendu parijanaṅgaḷanāgaḷe karedu nijābhilaṣitamanaṟipe jayakumāraṁ
svadāra santōṣavratamuṇṭadaṟiṁ parāṅganā saṅgamamumenagāga
dembuduṁ āke muḷidu rākṣasī rūpadindettikoṇḍu pōgal bageye
pūpōgoyuttirda sulōcane kaṇḍu baggisidoḍe ākeya pativratā guṇa
mahātmyatmye bhayadinadr̥śyeyāgi pōdaḷ. dēvarkaḷuṁ avarirvarumaṁ
praśaṁsegeydu pūjisi pōdarātaṅgādupasargamentādumudendoḍe,
mahēndraṁ surasabheyoḷ mēghīghēśvarana, sulōcaneya śīlamāhā
tmyamaṁ pogaḻi parīkṣisalendu saudharmakalpada raviprabhavimānada ravi
prabhadēvaṁ tanna kāñcaneyemba dēviyanaṭṭidoḍāke bandu initu
pasargamaṁ māḍi pōgi pogaḻdoḍe ādidēvaṁ parijana sahitaṁ bandu
pūjisi nīmennageydayduparādhamaṁ kṣamiyisuvudendu pōdaṁ.

ittaṁ mēghēśvaranādibrahmanallige vandu bandisi dharmamuṁmaṁ sapra
pañcamuṁmaṁ kēḷdu bōdhi puṭṭi śivaṅkaradēviyu maganappanantavīryyaṅryyarkkaṅge
rājyamuṁmaṁ koṭṭu bandhugaḷaṁ visarjisi, vijayayu, jayanta, sañjayanta
remba tanna tammandiruṁ, bharatana makkaḷappa ravikīrti, ripuñjayaṁyuṁ,
ariñjayaṁyuṁ, mahājayaṁyuṁ, śatruvīryaṁ, vīrañjayaṁ, rativīryāryyādi
gaḷ berasu bāhyābhyantara parigrahaṅgaḷaṁ koḻiḻedu saṁyamamuṁmaṁ
kaikoṇḍu r̥ddhiprāptanāgi īgaḷ eḷpatteṇṭaneya gaṇadharanādoṁ,
sulōcaneyuṁ, chatraviyōgadoḷ punaḥ santapteyāgire subhadre
yemboḷ bandu saṅkṣaisaṁśraise brāhmiyara pakkadoḷ tapamuṁmaṁ kaikoṇḍu
jīvitāntyadoḷ acyutakalpadoḷanuttara vimānadoḷu dēvanādō
ḷendu jayagaṇadhara purāṇamuṁmaṁ pēḻi bharatēśvaraṁ kēḷdu pōdaṁ.

ittal bhaṭṭārakar vr̥ṣabhasēnarmodalāgebbappattunālvar gaṇadha
raruṁ, nālsāsiradēḷnūrayvadimbarpūrvvarvadhararuṁ, nālsāsirada nūrai
yvadimbar śikṣakaruṁ, ombaiysāsirvar avadhijñānigaḷuṁ,
irpattusāsirvarkēvalijñānigaḷuṁ, ippattāṟusāsirvarvikriyayudhardhi
prāptaruṁ, pannirchārccāsiradēḷnūṟayvadimbarmanaḥparyaya jñāni
gaḷuṁ, anibarvādigaḷuṁ, brāhmīpramukharuṁ, mūṟulakṣeyu
mavayvattusāsira pūāryikāgaṇamuṁ pr̥thavrataṁ modalāge mūṟu
lakṣe śrāvakaruṁ, suvrate modalāge aydulakṣe śrāvakiyaruṁ, catu
rvidha dēvanikāyamuṁ, pakṣicatuḥpada sarīsr̥pādi tirygjātigaḷuṁ
berasu dharmakṣētradoḷu viharisi gaganagamanamuṁ upasargā
bhāvamuṁ, vigatāhāratvamuṁ, caturāsyatvamuṁ, acchāyatvamuṁ,
apakṣmaspandatvamuṁ, gavyūti śatacatuṣṭaya subhikṣatvamuṁ, prāṇivadha
vihīnatvamuṁ, samamuprasiddhanakhakēśatvamuṁ, anantajñānamunantadarśa
sanatvamumemba ghātikṣayaṇamappadaśaguṇaṅgaḷuṁ, mumbēḷda svābhāvika daśa
guṇaṅgaḷuṁ, ādarśataladoḷ pratimāratnamaya mahītaḷamuṁ, tr̥ṇa
dhūḷī śarkarākaṇṭakādi rahita mahītaḷadoḷu vātakumāra saṁskāra
ṇamuṁ, mēghakumāra surabhijaḷābhiṣēcanamuṁ, guhyakumāra kusuma
vr̥ṣṭipātamuṁ, surabhimr̥duśītapavana vijr̥mbhaṇamuṁ, āśāhānirmaḷa
tvamuṁ, vividha bhāṣā svabhāvakārdhamāgadha dhvaniyuṁ, samavasaraṇa
maṇḍaḷagata vairāmayavyapōhanamuṁ, vividha viṣayagōcarānandamuṁ,

śāḷi, vrīhi, yava, gōdhūmādi prakr̥ṣṭa sasyaniṣpattiyuṁ, sarvartu
kusumaphaḷapallavabharita taruvana parimāṇatvamuṁ, jagaccaraṇa kamaḷa
vinyāsa puraspr̥ssr̥ṣṭakanaka kamaḷasampat saṁnidhānamuṁ, aṣṭavidha maṅgaḷa
dhāri viṣayadajanapratyudgamanamuṁ, dharmacakrapurassara jinapatisaddharma
ghōṣaṇeyumemba dēvakr̥ta caturdaśātiśayamumaṁ, antu catu
striṁśadatiśaya samanvitanuṁ, vr̥ṣabha, svayambhu, brahma, viṣṇu, mahē
śvara, prajāpati, purudēvādyanvartha sahasrāṣṭanāmadharanuṁ, āgirdādi
tīrthakaranallige mattondu divasaṁ bharatēśvaraṁ bandu bandisi
dharmamuṁmaṁ besagoḷe bhaṭṭārakar daśakuladharmamumaṁ, dvādaśānu
prēkṣeyumaṁ, dvāviṁśati parīṣahaṅgaḷumaṁ, guṇasthāna jīvasthāna
mārgaṇāsthānaṅgaḷumaṁ, mūlōttaravikalpaṅgaḷumaṁ, dravyabhāṣava
lakṣaṇamumaṁ, caturvidha bandhamumaṁ, madhura kaṭukavipāka mumappa,
karma(bhēda) phalamumaṁ kēḷdu, trijñānadharaṁ kṣāyika samyaktvādi
guṇaṅgaḷoḷu samanvitanāgi pōdaṁ.

ittaṁ vr̥ṣabhanāthanuṁ ārykṣēryakṣētraṅgaḷaṁ vihārisi sāsiravarṣaṁ
gundidondu lakṣepūrva paripūraṇamodoḷu kaiḷāsakke vandu siddhaśikhara
taḷadoḷu pauṣyamāsada puṇṇamiyoḷu apagata viharaṇanāgirdaṁ.

ittaṁ bharatēśvaranīṣatprāgbhāra kṣētramumaṁ dharāḍhataḷamāmūyā madi
neydiydu nindudumaṁ, andina divasame yuvarājanarkakīrtiyuṁ sura
lōkadiṁ bandu mahauṣadhidrumamaṁ manujarajāti, jarāmaraṇaṅgaḷaṁ
keḍisi maguḻi pōḻpōpudumaṁ, gr̥hapatiratnaṁ janakkellamabhilaṣita vastuvaṁ,
kalpavr̥kṣamaṁ koṭṭu divakke pōgalirdudumaṁ, mantriyuṁ ratna
dvīpaṁ vividharatnaṅgaḷanarthigaḷgittu gaganataḷakkogevudumaṁ, sēnā
patiyu maṇivrapraja paṅkajaramaṁ bhēdisi siṁhapōtaṁ kaiḷāsadiṁ mēle
laṅghisuvudumaṁ, kuḍurājanappanantavīryanuṁ, candratāregaḷverasu
naralōkamoḷbeḷagi pōpudumaṁ, strīratnaṁ subhadreyuṁ, yaśasvanvatiyuṁ,
sunandeyuṁ berasu indrana dēvi śōkaṅgeyvudumaṁ, vārahāsēṇāsī
pati citrāṅgadanu pāmādityanuṁ dharaṇītaḷamodoḷu beḷagi gaganataḷakkoge
vudumaṁ, antellaruṁ kanasugaṇḍu beḷagāpāgaḷu tammatamma kaṇḍa
kanasugaḷaṁ purōhitaṅgaṟipidoḍātanuṁ vr̥ṣabhasvāmi karmanirmū
ḷanaṅgeydu palabaru munīśvararverasu muktige salvudumaṁ, aṟiḻ

puvudu māgaḷu bhaṭṭārakarabhyavastheyu nānandanembaṁ pēḻi, bharataṁ
caturaṅgabalaṁ berasupōgi dēvaraṁ triḥpradakṣiṇaṅgeydu bandisi mahā
mahamemba pūjeyaṁ māḍidaṁ, ādidēvanuṁ padinālku divasaṁ yōga
nirōdhaṅgeydu māghabahuḷa caturdaśiya pūrvāhṇadoḷu abhi
janmanmuhūrtadoḷu palaru munigaḷverasu pūrvābhimukhanuṁ, palyaṁ
kāsananuṁ āgi sakaḷakarma nirmūḷanaṅgeydu mōkṣa lakṣmīvallabhanuṁ,
trailōkyacūḍāmaṇiyumāgirdaṁ ittaṁ dēvanikāyaṁ agnīndra
makuṭānaḷōddīpita dīpa dhūpa surabhi mālyādigaḷiṁ,jinakṣētra pūjā
vidhiyaṁ nirvartisi tadbhūddhūpa pūtacūrṇa pañcakalyāṇa bhāgigaḷappevendu
lalāṭa bhujadvaya kaṇṭhahr̥dayapradēśaṅgaḷoḷu muṭṭi,saudharmēndraṁ
parinirvāṇa kalyāṇamomōṇananda nr̥tyamanāḍi pōdaṁ.

bharatarājanuṁ saptamōpāsaka prabhr̥ti brahmacārigaḷanupāsakara
nendaṁ: gārhapatyāhavanīya dakṣiṇāgni lakṣaṇamumappagnitraya samīpa
doḷu cakrātapatra jinabimbatrayaṅgaḷisiḷaniṭṭu samucita kriyākāladoḷu
parigrahītādigaḷappudendaṟipi guruviyōgākrāntanāge, vr̥ṣabhasēna
gaṇadhararātana śōkamanāṟisal, antanibara bhavāvaḷiyuṁ pēḻdaru.
jayavarmanuṁ, mahābaḷanuṁ, lalitāṅganuṁ, vajrajaṅghanuṁ,
āryanuṁ, śrīdharanuṁ, suvidhiyuṁ, acyutēndranuṁ, vajranā
bhiyuṁ, ahamindranumāgi vr̥ṣabhanāthanādoṁ. dhanaśrīyuṁ, nirnā
mikeyuṁ, svayamprabheyuṁ, śrīmatiyuṁ, āryeyuṁ, svayaṁ
prabhādēvanuṁ, kēśavanuṁ, pratīndranuṁ, dhanadattanuṁ, ahamindranu
māgi, dānatīrthakaraṁ, śrēyāṁsanādoṁ. atigr̥ddhanuṁ, nāra
kanuṁ, vyāghranuṁ, divākaraprabhanuṁ, mativaranuṁ, ahamindranuṁ,
subāhuvuṁ, ahamindranumāgi nīṁ bharatanādai. sēnāpatiyuṁ,
āryanuṁ,prabhākaranuṁ, akampanuṁ,ahamindranuṁ, mahābāhuvuṁ,
ahamindranumāgi bāhubali (dēvanā) yāmoṁdoṁ. mantriyuṁ,
āryanuṁ, kanakaprabhanuṁ, ānandanuṁ, ahamindranuṁ, pīṭhanuṁ,
ahamindranumāgi bandu mīgaḷaṁ vr̥ṣabhasēnanādeṁ. purōhitanuṁ,
āryanuṁ, prabhañjananuṁ dhanamitranuṁ,ahamindranuṁ, mahāpīṭhanuṁ
ahamindranumāgi bandu anantavijayanādoṁ. ugrasēnanuṁ,
śārdūḷanuṁ, āryanuṁ, citrāṅgadanuṁ, vanumparadattanuṁ, sāmāni

kanuṁ, vijayanuṁ, ahamindranu māgi bandu āananta vīryanādoṁ.
harivaranuṁ, varāhanuṁ, āryanuṁ, maṇikuṇḍaḷanuṁ, varaṣēṇanuṁ,
sāmānikanuṁ, vaijayantanuṁ, ahamindranumāgi bandu acyuta
nādoṁ. nāgadattanuṁ, pānaranuṁ, āryanuṁ, manōharanuṁ,
citrāṅgadanuṁ, sāmānikanuṁ, jayantanuṁ, ahamindranu māgi
vīranādoṁ. lōlupanuṁ, nakuḷanuṁ, āryanuṁ, manōrathanuṁ,
śāntamadananuṁ, sāmānikanuṁ, aparājitanuṁ, ahamindranumāgi
suvīranādoṁ, nīṁ ī vividha saṁsāramaṁ priya vipriyāpriya
samprayōgaṁ kṣaṇamuppavamappudanaṟidu śōkākuḷitanāgalvēḍa. namagava
rirduvē neleyukkumendu duḥkhamanāṟise, bharatarājanuṁ muni
janamaṁ bandisi poḻapōṟalge vonondondu divasaṁ, maṇidarpaṇadoḷu nija
palita darśanōtpannabōdhanarkakīrtige rājyamaṁ koṭṭu saṁyamamaṁ
kaikoṇḍu kēśōtpāṭanānantaraṁ manaḥparyaya jñānamāge tada
nantaramunmantarmuhūrtadiṁ kēvaḷiyāgi pūrva lakṣakālaṁ vihārisi
nirvāṇakke sandaṁ. tadanantarame vr̥ṣabhasēnādi purudēva nandanaruṁ
paramapadamaṁ paḍedar.
div.trailer:
idu sakaḷaśāstra saṁyama sampanna śrīmadajitasēna bhaṭṭāraka
caraṇa kamaḷa cañcarīkaṁ dharmavijaya śrī maccāvuṇḍarāja viracita
triṣaṣṭi lakṣaṇa mahāpurāṇamoḷ ādi purāṇaṁ.

div.head: ajitanāthapurāṇaṁ

eraḍaneya tīrthaṅkara
ajitanāthapurāṇaṁ
ajita purāṇaṁ
div.p:
ī jambūdvīpada pūrvavidēhada sītānadiya teṅkaṇa taḍiya vatsa
kāvatī (matsya) viṣayada susīmā nagaramanāḷva vimaḷavāhanaṁ ondu
divasaṁ, saṁsārabhīrute kāraṇamāgi palabararasumakkaḷverasu saṁya
mamaṁ kaikoṇḍu ēekādaśāṅgadharaṁ ṣōḍaśa bhāvanegaḷaṁ bhāvisi tīrtha
kara mahā puṇyamaṁ kaṭṭi caturvidhārādhanā purassaraṁ śarīramaṁ biṭṭu
pañcānuttaregaḷa vijaya vimānamodoḷ ahamindranāgi trayatriṁśatsāga
rōpamāyuṣyanuṁ, sarvāṅgōpāṅga sundaranuṁ, praśasta varṇa
gandha rasa sparśanuṁ, ēnuṁekaratni pramāṇanuṁ, śuklatara lēśyā pariṇā
manuṁ, sapravicārānantaguṇa niḥpravicāra sukhanuṁ, lōkanāḷikā
bhyantaragatāvadhi jñānanuṁ, tannavadhijñānakke polanappa kṣētramaṁ magu
ḷvikkurvanitu sābjakkrvanitusāmamarthyamanuḷḷanuṁ, ā kṣētramaṁ mūla śarīra
doḷ tīvuvanitu vikriyā guṇa sampannanumāgi pañcavidāntarāya
kṣayōpaśamadoḷaydumindriyaṅgaḷaṁ (triguptiyinde) dr̥ptiyinda
māttaṅtraṅgappa santōṣaṁ śānta śubha pañcakamembudantappa śānta śubha
pañca samudbhava divya bhōgaṅgaḷanuṇutirpinaṁ.

ittaṁ jambūdvīpada bharata kṣētradayōdhyānagaramanāḷva ikṣvāku
vaṁśada kāśyapa gōtrada jitaśatruvembarasana manōvallabhe jayasēnā
mahādēvi jēṣṭha māsada amāvāsye rōhiṇī nakṣatradandu beḷagappa
jāvadāgaḷu ṣōḍaśa svapnānantaraṁ nijavadanamaṁ gajaṁ puguvudaṁ

kaṇḍu avadhi jñāniyappa jitaśatru mahārājaṅge pēḻdudaṟiṟa phalaṅgaḷaṁ
kēḻdu santōṣadoḷirpinaṁ. itta svargāvataraṇa kalyāṇavidhipūrvakaṁ
vimaḷavāhanacarāhamindraṁ jayasēna mahādēviyaṁ garbhadoḷu
saṅkramisi navamāsaṁ neṟeye māgha māsada śuklapakṣada daśamiyuṁ
pradēśamemba yōgamumāge vr̥ṣabhanāthara tīrtha santānakālaṁ pañcā
