mēgharathanumaṁmuṁ, parivāraṁ berasu, tamma vimānamanēṟisikoṇḍu,
bharatādi kṣētraṅgaḷaṁ, himavadādi kulaśailaṅgaḷumaṁ, gaṅgādi mahā
nadigaḷumaṁ, padmādihradaṅgaḷumaṁ, avara naḍuvirpa śrīdēvēvi moda
lāpadaṟuvaruṁ dēviyara nivāsaṅgaḷumaṁ, vakṣāraṁmodalāge nagaṁ
gaḷumaṁ, grāhavati modalāge vibhaṅga nadigaḷumaṁ, kacchasukaccha moda
lāge viṣayaṅgaḷumaṁ, kṣēma, kṣēmapurimodalāge rājadhānigaḷumaṁ
tāmbracūḷa, kanakacūḷa bhūtaṅgaḷ tōṟi, nōḍuttaṁttuṁ, kulagiri
gaḷa, mahānadigaḷa, viṣayaṅgaḷa, puraṅgaḷa, vakṣāra girigaḷaṁ, pañca manda
raṅgaḷ, modalāgeraḍuvare dvīpamoḷaguḷḷa kr̥trima caityālayaṅgaḷa
narcanāpūrvakaṁ bandisuttaṁttuṁ bandu, puṇḍarīkiṇiyaṁ puge, bhūtaṁ
gaḷ kumāraṅganarghya ratnaṅgaḷaṁ koṭṭu, pūjisi, tamma vāsakke
pōdar, itta ghanarathanuṁ lōkāntika dēvar pratibōdhise, mēgha
rathaṅge rājyamaṁ koṭṭu, niṣkramaṇa kalyāṇābhiṣēka pūrvakaṁ dīkṣeyaṁ
kaikoṇḍu, śukladhyānadiṁ ghātigaḷaṁ kiḍise, tīrthakaranāgi, jagatraya
pūjeyaneydirdar.

itta mēgharathaṁ tannarasiyaruṁ tānuṁ dēvaramaṇōdyānada
śilāḷātaḷadoḷire, mattottōrva vidyādharanākāśadoḷ, tanna vidyā
dhariyuṁ tānuṁ pōguttamavara mēle vimānaṁ pōgade nile,
puḷidu nōḍi, avarirda śilāḷātaḷamanettuvāgaḷ, mēgharathanaṟiduṁ
guṣṭāgradoḷottuvuduṁ, kurgi, puyyalcuykalṭṭuva ravamaṁ kēḷdu, vidyā
dharana peṇḍatibandu, dēvā, nīnenage purupaṣa bhaikṣamanikkuvuduṁ, ninage
śaraṇāgateyenembuduṁ, priyamitratrekēḷdēḷdadēnendu besagoḷe, mēgha
rathaṁ tannapavadhiyinaṟimudu, intendaṁ-vijayaārdha parvatada aḷakāpura
manāḷva, vidyuddaṁṣṭraṅgaṁ, aniḷavēgegaṁ, siṁharathanembaṁ, ītaṁ
amitavāhana jinapatiyanabhivandisi barutuṁ, ennaṁ kaṇḍu, munidī
śilāḷātaḷamanettidomoḍānuṅnumuṅguṣṭhadoḷottidaḍe, poramaḍalāṟadirda
nembuduṁ, priya mitre vismayaṁ biṭṭu, munisiṅge kāraṇa māvudadaṁ
besasimese, mēgharathanintendaṁ.

dhātakī ṣaṇḍada, mūḍaṇa mandaradairāvata kṣētrada, śaṅkhapurado
ḷiḷarpoṁ, rāmaguptanembonātana peṇḍati śaṅkhiśaṅkhakeyemboḷavarirvaruṁ,
śaṅkhaśailadoḷ, sarvaguptamuniyara pakkave (jina)guṇavratōpadē
śaṅgaḷaṁ kaikoṇḍu, ondu divasaṁ, dhr̥tiṣēṇa munigāhāra dānamaṁ
koṭṭāścarya pañcakamaṁ paḍedu, kelavu divasadiṁ samādhi guptara
sāre, sanyāsanaṅgeydu, rāmaguptaṁ brahmēndranāgi puṭṭi pattu sāga
rōpamada kaḍeyoḷ alliṁ bandīsiṁharathanādaṁ. ā śaṅkhikeyuṁ
saṁsāradoḷirduḷtiridu, tapaḥphaladiṁ svargasukhaṁ baḍedalliṁ bandu, vijayā
rdha parvatada dakṣiṇaśrēṇiya, svāḷayapuramanāḷva indrakētuviṅgaṁ,
suprabhegaṁ īke madanavēgeyembōḷ magaḷāgi, siṁharathaṅge bhārye
yādaḷeḷīnaloḍaṁ, siṁharathaṁ santōṣambaṭṭu, mēgharathanaṁ pūjisi,
pōgi, kanakatilaka (ratha) nemba magaṅge rājyamaṁ koṭṭu, palambaruṁ
berasu, ghanaratha tīrthakara pakkade tapamaṁ kaikoṇḍaṁ. ā madana
vēgeyuṁ, priyamitreyara sāre, dīkṣeyaṁ tāḷdaḷ. itta mēgha
rathaṁ pūrvakr̥tapuṇyadiṁ, palakālamarasugeydu, dharmārtha kāma
tatparaṁ, samyagdarśana viśuddhi modalāge śrāvakavrataguṇaṅgaḷaṁ tāḷdai,
saptaparamasthānanappa mēgharathanuṁ, dr̥ḍharathanuṁ antaḥpuraṁ berasu,
nandīśvara jinapūjā pūrvakamupavāsaṅgeydu, dharmakatheyaṁ palarge

pēḻuttirpannegaṁ, ā prastāvadoḷondu, kapōtanadhikabhayadinarasana
maṟiyaṁ puguvudumadaṟabaṟiḻiyanaṭṭuttuṁ atijavadiṁ ondu
giḍagaṁ bampubandu, mēgharathaṅgendudu eledānaśūrā, kēḷānappaḍadati
kṣudhā pīḍitanenagīkapōtamaṁ āhārarthaṁ kuḍuvudalladandu, pasidu
sattapenembuduṁ, ā gr̥dhrananuḍiyaṁ kēḷdu, yuvarājanappa dr̥ḍharatha
nendaṁ, idu tirikanentu nuḍidappudivara bhavasambandhamaṁ besasimendu
tannatammaṁ besagoḷe, mēgharathanintendu pēḻdaṁ.

ī jambūdvīpavaidairāvatakṣētrada, padminīkhēṭada, sāgarasēnanemba
parapaṅvaṅgaṁ, amitamatigaṁ, dhanamitranuṁ, nandiṣēṇanumemba makka
ḷāgi, dravyasambandhadinorvanorvaraninaṟidu sattu, pakkigaḷāgi puṭṭi
duvuṁ, ī gr̥dhrana mēgōrvadēvaṁ, sannihitanāgi, nuḍidapanāta
nārgendoḍe, paamitāri śaktiya kāḷiḷagadoḷ, ennakayyoḷsatta kanaka
rathanemsemboṁ saṁsāradoḷtoṟaḻaldu bandu kailāsagiriyataṭada parṇa
kānteyemba śōṟitoṟeya sōmanemba tāpasaṅgaṁ, śrīdattegaṁ candra
nemba maganāgi, tapadoḷ negaḻdu kālāntaradoḷ, jyōtirlōka
doḷ, dēvanāgirdīśānakalpakke pōgi, sabheyoḷirdīśānēndraṁ
mēgharathanol doreyarāruṁ dānaśūrarillendu dēvarkaḷge pēḻdu
kēḷdu, sairisadennaṁ parīkṣisalendu, bandādēvanī gr̥dhrana meyyo
ḷardā pakṣiyanāhāra dānamīyendu nuḍidanidu dānayōgyamalla.
dānalakṣaṇamappaḍe,dātr̥menduṁ, dēyamenduṁ, pātramenduṁ,trividha
makkumalli, śraddhādi saptaguṇasampannaṁ dātr̥vakkuṁ. āhārābhaya
bhaiṣajya śāstravasati saṁyamōpakaraṇādigaḷgeḷu payōgamappavastu, dēya
makkuṁ, prakr̥ṣṭa samyagdarśana jñānacāritra sahitatvamuṁ, svaparahita
vistāraka guṇātiśaya tatvamumuḷḷoḍe pātramakkuṁ adaṟiṁ ī
dēvana meyyoḷ pātraguṇamilladudī dēyamappa vastuvalladalladeyu
māhāradānaṁ, pāramparyāyadiṁ mōkṣakāraṇamendu, dr̥ḍharathaṅge
pēvēḻduduṁ, kēḷdādēvaṁ tannasvarūpamaṁ tōṟi, ninnameyyoḷī
śānēndraṁ pēḻdaḻdinitu, (udāra) dāna śūratvaguṇaṁ neṟavudendu,
mēgharathanaṁ pogaḷduḻdu pūjisi, pōdanāpakkigaḷuṁ, tamma bhavamaṁ
kēḷdu, anyōnyavairamaṁ pattuviṭṭu, tōṟitoṟedu, sattu dēvaramaṇa
vanadoḷ sarūpa, atirūpamemba vyantara dēvarāgi puṭṭi kr̥tōpakāra

maṁ nenedu, mēgharathanaṁ pūjisi, pōdar itta, mēgharathanuṁ,
damumavararemba cāraṇar̥ṣiyargāhāradānamaṁ vidhipūrvakaṁ kuḍe,
pañcāścaryaṁ negaḻaṟa mattondu divasaṁ, nandīśvara mahāmahime
yōḷ, mēgharathanupavāsaṅgeydu jinapūjeyaṁ māḍi, rātri, prati
māyōgadhāriyāgirpinaṁ īnavamīśānēndraṁ, tanna sabheyoḷ, “ namō
mēgharathāya, dānaśūrāya ” yendu, prakāśavacanadiṁ namaskāraṁ
geyye, dēvarendarembarellargaṁ, “ nīṁ stutyanai, nīnāraṁ stutiyisi
dappe ” yendoḍīśāśāṁnēndranendaṁ, “ mēgharathaṅge namaskāraṅgeydaydu
penātanumīgaḷ, pratimāyōgadoḷirdanembuduṁ, atirūpeyuṁ
surūpeyumbemba dēviyarbandā mēgharathaṅge, cittakṣōbhamanentuṁ
māḍalāṟadīśānēndranuṁ pēḻdudu tappadendorvarorvaroḷ
nuḍidu, dēvalōkakke pōdar. itta mattondu divasaṁ, īśā
nēndraṁ, surasabheyoḷ, mēgharathanarasi priyamitreya, rūpu
saundaryakke samānamavappa strīyarillendu pogaḻdaṁṟa, ratiyuṁ, rati
ṣēṇeyumbembarādēviyarākeya rūpaṁ nōḍalendu, majjanāvasara
doḷ, sugandhatailābhyaṅganaṁ geydirda, priyamitreyaṁ kaṇḍindra
nentupogaḻdinantuṇṭīrūpendu tammoḷ pogaḻduḷdu, pattaṁ, para
darakanyanyekeyara rūpugoṇḍu, paricārakiyargendar— “arasiyayu
rūpaṁ nōḍal bandevendoḍāvātaṁ paricārakiyararasigaṟipidoḍa
varanannegaṁ porage kuḷḷirisimendu, majjanavidhiyaṁ nirvarttisi,
neṟiṟeye keygeydu, ā kanyanyekeyaraṁ barapēḻdoḷdoḍākegaḷ bandu,
nōḍi, ninna rūpaṁ, munnamati ramumaṇīyamīgaḷinisānuṁ, kānti
vihīnavāgirdudendoḍākegaḷa mātaṁ kēḷdu, priyamitre manakṣataṁ
berasarasanamovogamuṁvuṁ nōḍidāgaḷarasanendaṁ–daṁ—“ninna rūpanīśāśāṁnēndraṁ
pogaḻduṟa nōḍalendēviyarirvaruṁ bandu, ninna rūpaṁ munnaṁ
kaṇḍāgaḍina, cauyauvvanamuṁvuṁ, kāntiyuṁ, baḻiṟikkenōḻpāḷpāgaḷ, kāṇade,
yauvvanamuṁvuṁ, kāntiyuṁ, inisānuṁ kandidudaṁ kaṇḍu, nuḍida
rendoḍā dēviyatrmabhiprāttrambhiprāyayamamunarasanaṟidaḍe, nijasvarūpaṁ
tōṟi, pūjisi, dēvalōkakke pōdar.
andinditta, priyamitreyuṁ, dēhānityateyaṁ bhāvisi, virakta
matiyāgirpannegaṁ, ondu divasaṁ, manōharōdyānadoḷ,

bandirva, tartamma gurugaḷappa, ghanarathatīrthaṅkara samavasaraṇakke, mēgha
rathamahīpati, parivārasamētanāgi pōgi, dēvaraṁ bandisi, tamma
kuḷḷirpeḍeyoḷ kuḷḷirdu. bhavyajanaṅgaḷge, hitamappudaṁ pratipādi
suva bageyiṁ, śrāvakasiyōgamuma nenagaṟiya besasimendu, mēgha
rathaṁ binnapaṅgeyke, ghanarathatīrthaṅkararintendu besasidar—

gāhe|| vaṁsaṇavasāmāyiya pōsahasaṁ cantarāye bhanteya
bahvārambha pariṅgahamuṇuṇamuṁ diṇḍavēśaviramoyā
emba saṁyata, samyagdr̥ṣṭi modalāgēkādaśōpāsakasthānamaṁ, sa
prapañcaṁ pēḻdu pāsakarge, viśēṣa(vidhi) kriyeyōgaḷanaṟipravēḷeyuṁ
gamumappupāsakādhyayanamanintendu besasidar.

ijjeyuṁ, vāyumpārteyuṁ, dattiyuṁ, svādhyāyamuṁ, saṁyu
mamuṁ, tapamumembī, āryapaṣaṭkarmaṅgaḷ, śrāvakajanakke kula
dharmaṅgaḷlli ijjeyembudu arhatpūjeṭe nityamembuṁmeṁmuṁ caturmukha
membuṁmeṁmuṁ, kalpavr̥kṣamenduṁ, aṣṭāhnikamendakkumalli, nitya(maha)
membumaduniccaṁ, yathāśaktiyuṁ, jinagr̥haṅgaḷge tanna maneyiṁ,
gandhapuṣpākṣatādigaḷanuyvuduṁ, caityālayaṅgaḷaṁ māḍisi bhaktiyiṁ
grāmādigaḷaṁ, śāsanaṅgaḷaṁ biḍupuduṁ, munijanaṅgaḷaṁ pūjisu
puduṁ, caturmukhamembudu, makuṭabaddharu, mālpaḷpapūje mahā
(mukha)mahamuṁ, sarvatōbhadramembumapupaduve kalpadruma
membudu, bēḍidudane koṭṭu, taṇipi, cakravartigaḷ mālpuḷpudu.
aṣṭāhnikamembuvedellar mālpuḷpuvu; mahamēndradhvajamembudiṁ
drādigaḷmālpaḷpapūje; mattaṁ bali snapanamembuvu mūruṁsandhisañje
yoḷaṁ, jagatrayabandhuge pūjeyumabhiṣēkamumaṁ mālpuḷpudī
pēḻdavara kalpame peṟiṟupuṁ pūjāviśēṣamakkuṁ. vārteyembudu, asi,
masi, kr̥ṣi, vaṇik, vidyāśilpakarmaṅgaḷoḷ, viruddhavartiyinarthō
pārjanaṅgeyvudu, dattiyembudu dayāpādātrasamaṁmuṁ, sakalabhēdadiṁ
caturvidhamakkuṁ alli dayādattiyembuduṁ, anukampeverasanugrāhya
mappa prāṇigaḷge, triśuddhiyiyanabhayadānamaṁ kuḍuvudu; pātradatti
yembudu, mahātapōdhanarge, pratigrahārcanāvidhipūrvakaniravadyā
hāra saṁyamōpakaraṇaṅgaḷaṁ kuḍuvudu, samadattiyembudu tanno
ḷsamakriyāmantranappavistārakōtrattamaṅge kanyā, bhūmi, suvarṇa

hastyaśvaratha ratnādigaḷaṁ kuḍuvudu; tannoḷ samānamilladandu,
madhyama pātrakke kuḍuvudu, sakaḷadattiyembudu, tanna santatiyaṁ
niṟisalvēḍi, magaṅgakke, gōtrajaṅgakke, dharmamaṁrmaṁ, dhanamumanappa
yisi kuḍuvudu, anvayadattiyumapuve.

svādhyāyamembudu tattvatvajñānamanōduvuduvōdisuvudu, smari
yisuvudu, saṁyamamembudu pañcāṇuvratādi pravartanaṁ, tapameṁ
buduṁ, anaśanādi dvādaśavidhānuṣṭhānaṁ endārya ṣaṭkarmamanaṟipi,
saddr̥dr̥ṣṭigaḷganuṣṭhēyamappayvattumūṟu vikalpada, garbhānvayakriye
yuṁ, nālvatteṇṭu teṟaśēṟida dīkṣānvaya kriyeyuṁ, eṟiṟabēdada kartrārtā
nvaya kriyeyumemba trividhadodōḷ modala garbhānvaya kriyeyuṁ,
ādānamuṁ, prītiyuṁ, suprītiyuṁ, dhr̥tiyuṁ, mōdapamuṁ,
priyōdbhavamuṁ, nānākarmamuṁ, bahiryānavamuṁ, niṣadyeyuṁ, anna
prāśanamuṁ, vyāptiyuṁ, kēśavapanamuṁ, lipisaṅkhyāna saṅgrahamuṁ,
upanītiyuṁ, vratacaryeyuṁ, vratāvataraṇamuṁ, vivāhamuṁ,
varṇalābhamuṁ, kulacaryeyuṁ, gr̥hīśitvamuṁ, praśāntiyuṁ,
svagr̥hatyāgamuṁ, dīkṣādyamuṁ, jinarūpatvamuṁ, maunādhyayana
vr̥ttiyuṁ, tīrthakaratvabhāvaneyuṁ, gurusthānābhyupagamumaṁ,
gaṇōpagrahaṇamuṁ, svagurusthāna saṅkrāntiyuṁ, niḥsaṅgatvātma
bhāvaneyuṁ, yōganirvāṇasamprāptiyuṁ, yōganirvāṇasādhanamuṁ,
indrōpapātanamuṁ, indrābhiṣēkamuṁ, vidhividhānamuṁ, (sukhō)
kubhōdayamuṁ, impratyāgamuṁ, avagatāramuṁ, hiraṇyōtkr̥ṣṭatpṭa
janmamuṁ, puranarābhiṣēkamuṁ, gurupūjōpaḷambanamuṁ, yauva
rājyamuṁ, svarājyamuṁ, cakralābhamuṁ, digvijayamuṁ, cakrābhi
ṣēkamuṁ, sāmrājyamuṁ, niṣkrāntiyuṁ, yōgasannahamuṁ,
ārhatyamuṁ, tadvihāramuṁ, yōgatyāgamuṁ, agrasivr̥ttiyuṁ,
agranīvr̥ttiyumendādānādi nirvāṇaparyantamappayvattumūṟu
garbhānvaya kriyeyoḷ, eraḍaneya dīkṣānvaya kriyeyoḷagavatā
ramuṁ, vr̥tti(dhr̥ti)lābhamuṁ, sthānalābhamuṁ, guṇagrahaṇamuṁ,
pūjārādhyamuṁ, puṇyayajñamuṁ. pr̥thamundr̥ḍhacaryayuṁ, upayōgitva
membeṇṭu garbhānvaya kriyeyoḷ pēḻdaḻdu upanītaṁ modalāge,
nivr̥ttiparyantamappa nālvattumantu nālvatteṇṭu dīkṣānvaya kriye

yoyōḷ, mūṟaneya karttārtānvaya kriyeyoḷ, sajjātitvamaṁmuṁ, sadgr̥hala
hatvamuṁ, pārivrājyamuṁ, surēndratvamuṁ, sāmrājyamuṁ,
arhantyamuṁ nirvāṇamumbemba (padaviyuṁvemyumbemba) saptaparamasthānaṁ
gaḷ karttārtānvaya kriyegaḷ.

mattamatibālavidyākuḷāvadhi varṇōttamatvaṁ, pātratva sr̥ṣṭyōvikā
ratva, vyavahārēśitvamavadhyatvamagaṇyatva manārhatvaṁ, prajāsambandhāṁ
taramembippattumadhikāraṅgaḷumanaṟipe, mattaṁ, nirvāṇakke salvaruḷgaṁḷḷaṁ
danuṣṭhēyumappudanintendaṟipidar. tīrthaṅkara, gaṇadharara, kēvaḷi,
nirvāṇa pūjāsamumumpalabdhamuppā havanīyagārhapatya, dakṣiṇāgnigaḷemba
gnitrayaṅgaḷa, kelada vēdikeyoḷ siddha rasarjinarcisi, jinastutanarādhipa chatra
trayamumuvara cakratrayamuṁ berasu, jinabimbagaḷanabhimukhadoḷ
saṁsthāpanaṅgeydu ucca kuladoḷakke, mēṇ ujjōcca kuḷadoḷakke,
saddr̥ṣṭadr̥ṣṭigaḷ samyagdr̥ṣṭigaḷge, samyagdr̥ṣṭijīvaṁ garbhakkevappalli, nālkuṁ
nīrmindu, śuciyāgirda, patniverasu, suputrārthiyappupāsakaṁ,
dhavaḷāmbara yajñōpavītadharanumavyagracittanumāgi, vēdikeyayu kela
dagnitrayaṅgaḷoḷ mantra(kalatra)pūtaṅgaḷappa sāra jala darbha gandha
puṣpākṣataṅgaḷindabhyarcisi, pīṭhikājātivistāraka r̥ṣisurēndra paramu
rājyaparamēṣṭhi sambandhigaḷappa, saptavidhamantragaḷinarhatpūjāvaśiṣṭa
mappa, śucidravyaṅgaḷiṁ ghr̥tatiḷādigaḷanāhutigaḷanikkuttuṁ, jinamatā
vaḷambigaḷappa saptamōpāsaka prabhr̥tigaḷumpāsakarkkeladoḷire, rāgārtha
mallade santānārthadiṁ pūjāvyapāyaṅgeyvudu, mopodala garbhānvaya
kriyeyoḷ pēḻdaḻddigarbhādānakriye.
garbhādānadiṁ baḻiyaṁ, mūṟaneya tiṅgaḷoḷ munninante,
dvijariṁ pūjāvidhi mantrapūrvakaṁ bāgiloḷ tōraṇaṅgaṭṭi,
pūrṇakumbhaṅgaḷaniṭṭu, niccanicca bhēri ghaṇṭāsvanaṅgaḷeseye,
tantamma vibhavakkanusāriyāge, gr̥havēdigaḷiṁ, prayōgisuvudu

prītikriye, ā dānadiṁ baḻiyamuydaneya tiṅgaḷupāsa
kariṁ mantravēdigaḷanagnisākṣiyoḷarhadbimrdhyambaba sannidhiyoḷ, munni
nantavadhipūrvakaṁ vidhiyisuvudu prītikriye, eḷaneya tiṅga
ḷoḷ, pūrvasthitiyayunādaraṁ berasu garbhavr̥ddhinimittamavyagracittarappa
gr̥havēdigaḷiṁ prayōgisuvu(negaḻdappaḻpaḍuvu)duddhatakriye, ombhatta
neyu tiṅgaḷoḷ, pūrvasthitiyoḷādaraṁ berasu, dvijōttamariṁ,
gōtrikābandhanamuṁ, mantraprasādhanamuṁ, rakṣasūtramumuṁ, garbhi
ṇige māḻvuḻpudu, mōdakriye, jātikarmadoḷ, divija(jina) jātakamuma
nōdi kriyāmantraṅgaḷiṁ, yathāvidhiyāgi, mūlōpāsaka sūtra
doḷ, pēḻdante negaḻvudu priyōdbhavakriye, puṭṭida panneraḍaneya
divasakke, tāyiṅgaṁ tandegaṁ sukhāvahamāge, kūsinanukūla dinadoḷe
vibhavānusāradiṁ, pēḻisi, dēvar̥ṣidvijaraṁ pūjisi, santānavr̥ddhi
nimittaṁ, praśastanāmamaniḍuvudallindamaṣṭōttara sahasrajinanāmaṁ
gaḷanōlegaḷoḷ baradu, koḍadoḷikki ondu pesaraṁ kaikoḷvudu
nāmakarmakriye, eraḍaneya, mūṟaneya, nālkaneya tiṅgaḷoḷakke,
kūsinanukūla dinadoḷ yajñaṅgeyduysi, tūryādi maṅgaḷadhvanigaḷeḷve
rasu, tāya kayyoḷikki, dādiya kaiyoḷakke kūsaṁ koṭṭu, bandhu
jana paritōṣitapūrvakaṁ, prasūtigr̥hadiṁ poramaḍisuvudu bahiryāna
kriye.
maṅgaḷāḷaṅkr̥tamappa vistīrṇita talpadoḷ, siddhārcanā vidhi
pūrvakaṁ, divyāsanārhatvamumuttarōttaramumakkendu bāla
kananiṟisuvudu niṣadyākriye, māsapr̥thaktvaṁ pōgi, pūjā
vidhipūrvakaṁ yathākramadinaruḷūḍuvudannaprāśanakriye, ondu
varṣaṁ neradandu munninante dānapūjāpūrvakaṁ bandhugaḷaṁ barisi,
varṣavardhanaṁ māḍuvuduṁ vr̥ṣṭikriye; mūṟaneya varṣadandu,
śubhadina muhūrtadoḷ, gurupūjāpūrvakaṁ, bāḷakanaṁ gandhō
dakadoḷnaṟisi, siddhaśēṣākṣataṅgaḷanikki, tadanvayōcitamappa, cūḷi
keyanuḷipi, kaurakarmaṅgeysi, mattaṁ mīyaleṟadanulēpanabhūṣaṇā
nvitanaṁ, munigaḷge poḍavaḍisi bandhugaḷ parase, puṇyāhaṁ bājise, bāḷa
kriyeyu māḻvudu kēśavapanakriye; aidaneya varṣadoḷ, jinapūjā
pūrvakaṁ, upādhyāyaraṁ mannisi, prathamākṣaramuṁ tōṟpudu, lipi

saṅkhyāna saṅgrahakriye; garbhāṣṭavaṁma varṣadoḷarhatpūjeyaṁ māḍi,
gurusākṣiyoḷ vratārpaṇapūrvakaṁ muñjigaṭṭiṭṭa talegiridu, jeṇḍi
keyunuṇṭinumbipi, kaupīnasahita dhavala vastramamunuḍisi, vratacihnaṅgaḷeḷiseye,
brahmacārivēvesarāgi, bhikṣāvr̥ttiyoḷadhika vibhavanapparasara maneyoḷakkaṁ,
tatpuradoḷakke pōgi, pāśriyoḷpaḍedudanagramaṁmuṁ dēvarge carigedōri,
mikkāhāramaṁmuṁ kobvudupanītakriye.

ratnatrayuya parikalpitadiṁ triguṇamappa muñjiyuṁ tāḷduvudu
kaṭiliṅgaṁ; śrāvakadharmada nirmūrmaḷateyuntōrpante dhautasitasādhaka
muṅgaṇḍuḍisuttupurūvudūruliṅgaṁ; sapta paramasthāna parikalpadindēḷu
śarada janivāra (janmapara) manikkuvudurōliṅgaṁ; manavacana
kāyagatarāgaṅgaḷaṁ kiḍisalendu muṇḍanaṅgeyvudu śirōliṅgaṁ;
intu caturvidhaliṅgaṁ berasu sthūlahiṁsāviratyādi brahmacarya
vratamaṁmuṁ tāḷdu, dantakāṣṭhatāmbūlāñjanādigaḷaṁ toṟadu, dāri
drādi snānaṅgeyyade, dinamprati śuddhasnānaṅgeydu, khaṭvā śayanamuṁ,
parāṅganāparighaṭṭanamumbisuṭṭu, neladoḷorvane paḍuguvuda
nnegamōduvudannegamīsthitiyoḷe naḍevudōduvāgaḷavāvumendoḍe-
gurugaḷa mukhadindamupāsakādhyayanamumadhyātma granthamaṁmuṁ, śabda
vidyeyumarthaśāstraṅgaḷumaṁmuṁ ōdi tanna paṭutvamaṁmuṁ, saṁskāramumaṁmuṁ,
prakaṭisalinlendu, joyisamaṁmuṁ, chandasamuṁ, śakunaśāstramuṁ, saṅkhyā
tamumaṁmuṁ, kalvudu; brahma (vrata) caryakriye; panneraḍu varṣado
ḷakke mēṇ, padināṟu varṣadoḷakke, dēva(jina) pūjāpūrvakaṁ, guru
gaḷa sannidhiyoḷ, madhu, madya, māṁsa, pañcaudumbara parityāgamuṁ,
hiṁsādi viratiyumuṁ, sārvakālikaṁ kaikoṇḍu, gurugaḷadonda
nujñeyuṁ vratācaraṇadoḷ, vastrābharaṇa mālyādigaḷaṁ kaikoṇḍu,
śāstrōpajīviyappoḍe, nijavr̥tti parirakṣaṇārthamuṁ, śōbhārthamu
māge, śāstragrahaṇaṅgeydanydintu, bhōga brahmavratamuṁ, pattuviṭṭu kāmu
brahmavratamanuttarakriyeyarpinegaṁ, naḍayisuvudu vratāvataraṇa
kriye; gurugaḷadondanujñeyuṁ siddhārcanāvidhipūrvakaṁ, dvijō
ttamaraṁ pūjisi, kr̥tāgnikāryanāgi, puṇyāśramadoḷ, siddhaprativādi
mukhadoḷucita(vrataśīla) kulasamutpanneyaṁyuṁ, kanneyuṁ pāṇigrahaṇā

nantaramagnipradakṣiṇaṅgeydu, śayyānivēśavidhiyindēḷudivasambaraṁ,
brahmacarya vratadiṁ (muṁ) sa(tprata) syōcita bhūmiyoḷaṁ, tīrtha
bhūmiyoḷaṁ vihārisi manegevandu, kaṅkaṇamaṁ biḍisi, śayanataḷa
doḷ, kālōcitamāge, r̥tukāladoḷ (santōṣā) santānārthadiṁ,
kāmasēvanegeyvudu vivāhakriye; mātāpitr̥matadiṁ, dhanadhānyānyadi
sampattiyo(no)ḷkūḍi, bēṟondu maneyoḷ, svatantranāgirdu,
munninante siddhapratimārcanāpūrvakamupāsaka mukhyarasākṣiyoḷ,
pitr̥datta dhanamaṁvaṁ, dānadharmādigaḷoḷ tavisi, tannapaḍadoḍave
yumaṁyuṁvaṁ, dānadharmadoḷtavisi, jasamuṁvuṁ, dharmamumanunumpārjisu
pantu makkaḷaṁ gr̥hadharmadoḷanuṣṭhisuvudu varṇalābhakriye; pūjā
dattivārtādilakṣaṇamappārya ṣaṭkarmapravartanadiṁ, gr̥hasthakuladharma
doḷ negaṟvulvudu kulacaryākriye; dharmadoḷ dr̥ḍhanāgi gr̥hasthācā
ryanuṁnaṁ, varṇōttamanumenisi, śrutavr̥ttikriyāmantravivaraṇe (vivā
haṁ) gaḷembuttara kriyegaḷiṁ tannunnatiyuṁ negaṟdīldīmahīdēvanuṁ,
suśrutanuṁ, dvijōttamanuṁ, nistārakōttamanumāryarhanumeni
suvudu gr̥hītēsitvakriye.

tanaganurūpanuṁ, bhārarakṣamanuṁnumappamaganaṁ paḍedu, gr̥hastha
dharmamanātaṅge appaysi, viṣayaṅgaḷoḷ toḷetoḍaradupaśamabhāva
neyiṁ, svādhyāyaśīlanāgi, nānāvidhōpavāsadoḷ negaṟvulvudupa
śāntikriye; upaśāntipuṭṭi, tannaṁ kr̥tārthanāge bagedu, gr̥ha
tyāgōdyuktanāgi, siddhārcanāpūrvakaṁ, bandhusākṣiyoḷ, magaṅge
sarvasvanivēdanaṅgeyduydannaparōkṣadoḷ, kulakramamaṁmuvaṁ pratipāli
suvudu, paḍadoḍaveyaṁ mūru bhāgaṅgeydonyodondu bhāgamaṁvaṁ
dharmakke, mattondu bhāgamaṁvaṁ maneya bīyakke, mattamuḷidondu
bhāgamaṁvaṁ, tannoḍavuṭṭida gaṇḍugūsugaḷgaṁ, avaroḷpeṅgūsugaḷgaṁ
saṁvibhāgaṅgeydu, santatiyaṁ, vr̥tta (śruta vr̥ddhikriyā) vr̥ttiyāgi
mantravidhi jñānamamunālasyanumāgi kādu, gurugaḷuṁ, dēvarumaṁ
pūjisuvudendu, piriyamaganaṁ (kalpisi) nirisi, dīkṣābhimukhanāgi
maneyuṁyaṁ pattuviḍuvudu gr̥hatyāgakriye; ukēśamammabhāvaneyiṁ, jyēyiñjēṣṭha
putranaṁ kramadoḷirisi, jinarūpa mahātapadoḷesagidoḍe, svargamu
mapavargamumumakkumalli sandayayumuṇṭe. sadr̥ṣṭiśāntacittaṁ dīkṣeyaṁ

kaikoḷvannegamēkādaśādhikadharanāgi, dīkṣāgrahaṇādyuktanāgirpudu
dīkṣānvayakriye; bāhyādi parityāgadiṁ jinadīkṣeyaṁ koṇḍu, jāta
dūrūpadharanappudu, niḥsaṅgato mukhyamappa jinarūpadhāraṇe dhīrargallade,
kātarātmakarappa jantugaḷgaḷgeśakyamadaṟinārūpumaṁ kaikoḷvuḷvadu jina
rūpatākriyae; dīkṣōpavāsaṅgeydu pāraṇāvidhiyoḷ vāñjaya
manuṁ, vinītātmaśuddhakaraṇatrayātmakanumāgi, sakaḷaśrutamaṁ moda
lintaguḷdu, gurugaḷa sannidhiyoḷōdidoḍī bhavadoḷ yōgyateyaṁ
māḻkuṁ. maṟubhavadoḷuṁ śrutamprasannamakkumidu mōnādhyayana
kriye; āhācāraṁ modalāgi sakalaśāstraṅgaḷaṁ nōḍi, vibuddhyādhāradiṁ
ṣōḍaśatīrthakara bhāvanegaḷaṁ bhāvisuvudu mahābhyudayasādhanaṁ
samyagdarśana viśuddhyādilakṣaṇaṁ tīrthakara bhāvanākriye; gurugaḷanu
matadiṁ jñānavijñānasampannanuṁ, vinītanuṁ, dharmaśīlanumāgi,
gurupadadoḷ nilvudu gurusthānābhyupagamakriye; r̥ṣiyarumajji
yaruṁ; śrāvakaruṁ, śrāvakiyarumaṁ sanmārgadoḷ naḍayisi,
dīkṣārthigaḷge dīkṣeyaṁ śr̥yaṁśrutārthigaḷge śr̥śrutamuṁ, dharmārthigaḷge
dharmamumanāgaḷuṁ pratibōdhisi, sadhr̥trasāraṇamuṁ, mudhr̥tra
sāraṇamuṁ, geydu, pāpaphalamaṁ bōdhisi (pādamaṅgaḷamaṁ sādhisi),
gaṇapōṣaṇaṅgeyduyvudu gu(ga)ṇōpagrahaṇakriye; adhikavidyanāgi tadvi
dyarappa munīndrōttamarāda r̥ṣiyōgyanappa śiṣyaraṁ karedu, tamma
bhāramanavargapparppayisi gurugaḷanumatadinavara padaviyoḷ (niltraltta)
negaldu, gaṇamaṁ naḍayisuvudu gurusthāpana (sthāna) saṅkrāntikriye;
sarvasaṅganivr̥ttigeydēkavihāriyāgi, mahātapadoḷnegaldātma saṁskā
rapūrvakaṁ vītarāgarāgi, śiṣyapravahanaṅgaḷoḷ mamatvamilladēkāgra
dindācārya (caryā) śuddhiyoḷ naḍevupadu nissaṅgāssaṅgatātmabhāvanā
kriye; sallēkhanōdyatanātmaśuddhigeydu saṁvēgapūrvakaṁ yōga
doḷ yatnaṅgeydu, yōgyamappaparikaramaṁ, tanusādhana pūrvakaṁ
māḍi, śarīradoḍane rāgādi dōṣaṅgaḷaṁ kr̥ṣṭaṁ (kr̥śataṁ) māḍu
vudu yōganirvāpaṇaṁ sanyāsanadoḷe pūrvabhāvaneyaṁyuṁ jīvitāśe
yumaṁ mr̥tījñeccheyumaṁ pattuviṭṭu, bhavyātmaṁ labdhinimittadiṁ, rāga
dvēṣamumaṁ, śrēyaḥ prāptiyoḷappa saṁśayamumaṁ tōṟiṟuvuduṁ;
tanagallada vastugaḷaṁ tannavemba saṅkalpamanuṟidu manōvākkāya
trayaṅgaḷenage bēṟānavarke bēṟendu nuḍiva jñānatva bhāvaneya

nenagāne peṟarāṟārumenagallada vastugaḷandina manama noḷḷittugeydēkatva
mamvambhāvisi, nityānanta sukhāspadamappa lōkāgradoḷ matiyuyaniṭṭu,
yōgasiddhi nimittaṁ negaṟvildidu yōganirvāṇa samprāptikriye; āhā
ramuṁ śarīramuṁvuṁ toṟaduttamārthadoḷ kr̥tāgrahanāgi, sanyasta
dēhaṁ praśasta matiyiṁ, manōvacaḥ kāyaṅgaḷiṁ, tanniṁ bēṟūṟāge
bagedu, pañca paramēṣṭhi padadoḷ, manōvr̥ttiyuṁ nilisi jīvatānta
doḷ, yōga nirvāṇa sādhanamuṁvuṁ tanage māṟpulpudu yōga nirvāṇa
sādhanakriye. yōgadoḷsamāhitavāmāgi, prāṇa parityāgaṁ geydu,
tapōbaladinindranāgi, divyaśayyekayyoyoḷpuṭṭi, paripūrṇayauvananuṁ,
paramānanda paritanuṁ, divya tējōvirājitanuṁ, aṇimādyaṣṭa guṇa
sampannanuṁ, sahajāmbara mālā maṇibhūṣaṇa bhūṣitanumāgi, nijāva
dhiyiṁ, tannandamanaṟavudindrōpapāsakakriye; antalli puṭṭi,
divyagītavādya nr̥tyaṅgaḷesevina mabhiṣiktanāgi, tirīṭamaṁ tāḷdu, divya
viṣṭarārūḍhaṁ, dēvarkaḷiṁ pūjeyayuneyvudindrābhiṣēka kriye;
parivāra dēvarkaḷiṁ vidhi pūrvakaṁ vimānādigaḷaṁ kaṇḷaṅkuṇḍuvudu vividhāna
(vidhinā) kriye; palakālaṁ suralōka sukhamananubhavisuvudu sukhō
dayakriye; nijāyuṣyāvasānadoḷ svargāvataraṇamanaṟiṟadu, dēva
rkaḷumaṁ, tatpura vallabheyarumaṁ, karedennaparōparorōkṣadoḷeḷinna
padaviyōgadoḷnindātaṁ besakeyduyva bāṟimenṟavendavara sākṣiyoḷ
sāmrājyamaṁ toṟavudindratyāgakriye.

arhatpūjeyuṁyaṁ māḍi siddhanamaskāraṅgeydu svargāvataraṇa
kalyāṇa pūrvakaṁ, ṣōḍaśa śubhasvapna darśanānantaraṁ, kuḷācaḷaṅgaḷo
ḷaḷirpa śrīdēvi prabhr̥tidēvi janasēviteyappoḷa garbhakkavatarisuvudu
avatārakriye; munnaṟuṟadiṅgaḷuṇṭeḷuṇṭine, dhanadaṁ vasudhāreyuṁyaṁ kaṟeye,
viśvēśvariyuṁ, jagajjananiyuṁ, sumaṅgaleyuṁ, pūjyeyumenisida
mahādēvige puṭṭuvudu hiraṇyagarbhōtkr̥ṣṭa janmatākriye; mandarādri

yugradoḷ, dugdhābdhijaladiṁ, surēndrarabhiṣēkaṅgeypuyvudu manda
rābhiṣēkakriye; sakala vidyōpadēśadiṁ, svatantranuṁ, svayambhuvu
māgi, śiṣyatvamuṁmaṁ pattuviṭṭu jaga(sa)dguruvenisi, dēvarkaḷiṁ pūjeya
neyduvudu gurupūjōpalambanakriye; kumāra kāladov yuḷyuva
rājyābhiṣēkamaṁ paḍevudu yuvarājakriye; mūrdhābhiṣiktarappa pārthi
varindabhiṣiktanāgi, nēnelanellamanāḷvudu svarājyakriye; navanidhigaḷuṁ,
caturdaśaratnaṅgaḷuṁ puṭṭi, nija prakr̥tigaḷinabhiṣēkādi pūjeyaneydu
vudu cakralābhakriye; cakraratnamaṁ mundiṭṭu paṭṭaṇṣaṭkhaṇḍamumaṁ
bāykoyoḷisuvudu digvijayakriye; siddha digvijayanāgi bandu polilaṁ
puguvalli māṭpaḍpabhiṣēkaṁ cakrābhiṣēkakriye; cakraratnaṁ berasu, nidhi
ratnaṅgaḷaṁ pūjisi, bēḍidoḍa bēḍimumadane koṭṭu, mānyarappa pārthi
varaṁ mannisi, rājyābhiṣēkamaṁ paḍedu, maṅgaḷa tūryaṅgaḷeseye,
viśuddhakula sambhūtarappa nālvar pārthivar, tirīṭamaṁ kaviye, maṇi
kuṇḍaḷa maṇḍitanuṁ, ratnāhārālaṅkr̥tanuṁ, brahmasūtra pariva
rtanuṁ (pavitranuṁ), ratnakaṭaka śōbhitanumāgi, paura prabhr̥tigaḷuṁ
pādābhiṣēkaṅgeydu, pādārcaneyaṁ taliyoḷtāḷda, śrīdēviyaruṁ,
sariddēviyaruṁ, viśvēśvarādēviyaruṁ, tantamma niyōgadoḷ ōla
gisi, sukhamirpudu sāmrājyakriye; ā sthānamaṇṭapadoḷ maṅgala
prāsādhadanālaṅkr̥taṁ, siṁhāsanārūḍhanāgi, dhavaḷa cāmaraṅgaḷeseye,
dhr̥tiyumaṁ, praśāntiyumaṁ, dīptiyumaṁ, nirmaḷatvamumaṁ,
mālpiḍpi, pr̥thuvyaptējōvāyuvākāśamembīdēvatāṁśaṅgaḷinaḷaṁ
kr̥taṁ, prajānugrahadoḷavaṁ niyōjisi, sanmāna dānādigaḷaṁḷiṁ, prakr̥ti
gaḷananurañjisi, pārthivaraṁ barisi, prajāpāḷanadoḷ. nyāya pararāgi
naneḍevudanyāyadoḷ naḍedandu nimage vr̥ttilōkamumakkumamudariṁ duṣṭa
nigraha śiṣṭa pratipālanadiṁ, kṣatradharmadoḷ, divyāstradēvategaḷanārā
dhisi, tatprasādadiṁ labdhibdhajayarāgi, rājya vr̥ttiyananālasyadiṁ pālisi
dandu yaśōlābhamuṁ, bhūmilābhamaṁ, mahōdayamumamukkuṁ.

paratrayoḷabhyudayāvāptiyuṁ, kramadiṁ trailōkya nirjareyu
mumakkumendavarge niyamisi, tānumāsthitiyoḷnigaṟduldu, mattoṁ
dukāladoḷutpannabōdhanāgi, rājyaviraktaṁ lōkāntikadēvar prati
bōdhise, pārthivara sākṣiyoḷ, piriyamagaṅge rājyamaṁ samarpaṇaṁ

geydāyvāgaḷ. nīnu prajāpāḷanadoḷ nyāya paranādandīpraje, kāma
dhēnuvinante, bēḻpubpudellamaṁmuṁ paḍegumavudaṟiṁ, nyāyadoḷarthōpārja
naṅgeyduyvva, paḍedudaṁ percisi, percidudaṁ koṇḍu, satpātra pratipatti
geyvuyvadendu, caturvidha rājavr̥tta mumumanaṟipi, mati (pari) pāḷanaṁ,
kuḷapāḷanaṁ, ātmapāḷanaṁ, samamujatvaṁ, prajāpāḷanamemba pañcavidha
doḷalli, mati (pari) pāḷana memvembudu hitāhita vivēkamuṁvuṁ, ubhaya
lōkahitamuṁvuṁ, māḻpamatiyuyinindriyajayamuṁvuṁ, vr̥ddhōpasē
veyuṁ, dharmārthaśāstra vijñānamumuvuṁmakkuṁ; matihīnanādandu,
yuktāyuktamanaṟiyade, mithyājñānadōddhatariṁ, pariprathitarāgi
kiḍuguṁ, kuḷapāḷanamembudu, kuladharmavumuṁ, piriduṁ praya
tnadiṁ pratipālisuvuduṁ, alladandu kulaṁ duḥkula durvr̥tta dūṣita
makkuṁ, ātmapālanamembudu, sarvaprakāradoḷuṁmātraḷuṁātma rakṣegeyddaṁydaṁ
dellamaṁ rakṣisidoṁ, sāpatkara deseyunakke jitrāpatātpamāmānita kruddhalubdha
remba caturvidha kr̥tyavargadinakke, rasadatīkṣṇādigaḷanakke, apāya
māgadu; samañmuñjasatvamembudu prajāpālanadoḷ, samamudarśanavāgi,
negaḻvudu, samañmuñjasatvamumamukāraṇavadhamuṁvuṁ, vāgdaṇḍa pāḻuṟujvali
mumanāgalīyadariṣaḍvargaṅgaḷaṁ geldu, nijavr̥ttiyaṁ pālisidoḍī
bhavadoḷappannegaḻtiyuṁ, maṟubhavadoḷappa gatiyumakkuṁ, prajā
pāḷanamembudu, yathōkta kṣatradharma pāḷanadiṁ, jasamuṁ,
dharmamuṁvuṁ, vijayamuvumakkuṁ, prajegubbēgamāvādandu prajāpīḍana
santāpadinakke, paracakranakke rājyahāniyuṁ, prāṇahāniyumakkuṁkku
mendu, piriyamaganaṁ karisi, pariniṣkramamuṇābhiṣēka pūrvakaṁ, mahā
dānaṅgeydduydu, sāmrājyamaṁ toṟedu, tanna maneyiṁ tapōvanakke
pōpudu niṣkrānti kriye; dīkṣāgrahaṇānantaraṁ, ghātikṣayadoḷ,
kēvala jñānōtpattiyāge, tatpūjeyuneydduvuyvudu yōga sannaha
kriye; aṣṭa mahā prātihārya, catustriṁśadatiśayaṅgaḷeseye, sama
vasaraṇa maṇḍaḷadoḷ, dvādaśagaṇa parivēṣṭitanāgippudu ārhantyakriye;
dharmacakramaṁ mundiṭṭu kṣētraṅgaḷoḷ vihārisuvudu, tadvihāra
kriye; samavasaraṇaṁ visarjisi vihārādigaḷaṁ māḻpudu yōga tyāga
kriye; aghātigaḷaṁ kiḍisi, lōkāgradoḷ nilvudagranivr̥ttikriye;
intu garbhadānaṁ modalādagra nivr̥ttivaramayvattumūpūṟu garbhā

nvayakriye. eraḍa (eṇṭa) neya dikṣānvaya kriyeyoḷ avatāra
membudu tannanāśrayisida bhavya janakke vēdamuṁ, purāṇamuṁ, dharma
śāstramuṁ, cāritrapuṁmuṁ, kriyā vidhiyuṁ, mantramuṁ, dēva
teyuṁ, liṅgamuṁ, āhārādhi śuddhiyuṁ, ahiṁsā śuddhiyuṁ,
emba daśavidhadoḷalliḷḷi modala vēdamembudu, saptaparamasthānamanīva
dvādaśāṅgamuḷaḷidavēdaṁ, pāpasūtramendaṟige, eraḍaneya purāṇameṁ
budu, sanmārga sādhanamuḷaḷida purāṇaṁ durgatisādhanamendaṟige.
mūṟaneya dharmamembudu, ahiṁseyumaṁ tapamumaṁ pēḷvuḻvudu
ḷaḷida dharmaśāstraṁ dhūrta kavi prajījētamendaṟige; nālkaneya cāritra
membudu. sāvadya rahitamappārya ṣaṭkarmamumaṁ, mūlaguṇa
mumuttara guṇamumaṁ, sallēkhanamumayathākhyātamendivanu
ḷḷudu, cāritramuḷiduvellaṁ duścāritramasatyamendaṟige; aidaneya
kriye yembudu mumpēḻda, garbhānvaya, dīkṣānvaya, krakvatrānvaya,
kriyegaḷuḷida dānādi smaśānantamappavavu mithyākriyegaḷendaṟige;
āṟaneya mantramembudu pañcavidhamakkumavaroḷ, kriyā mantraṁ
saptaparamārhantyamaṁ māḷkuḻkumagnihōtra mantraṁsiddhasēvegehētu;
yajñāmantraṁ paramēṣṭhi sēvege hētu, saṁyamamantraṁ sakaḷa nivr̥
ttige hētu, karṇa (varṇa) jāpya mantraṁ śivagatige kāraṇamivayduṁ,
niravadya mantraṅgaḷumuḷidavellaṁ, prāṇimāraṇa hētugaḷ, durmaṁ
traṅgaḷendaṟige, eḷaneya dēvatāyembudu, daśa (satata) dēvatā
yenduṁ, grahadēvatāyenduṁ, kriyādēvatāyenduṁ, trividha
makkumalli daśa (satata) dēvatāyembudu, arhatsiddhācāryaravaro
ḷantarviśēṣōpakārigaḷavara, guṇa sampattinagakkendu namaskāraṅge
yvudu, siddhargavara samāna sthānamenagakkendu namaskāraṅgeyvudu,
ācāryaremage pratyakṣa vistārakarivara deseyindaṁ jñānamuṁ,
tapamuṁ, dhyānamuṁ, vratamuṁ, parīṣahajayamuṁ akkendavarge
namaskāraṅgeyvudu, gr̥hadēvatāyembudu, viśvēśvara(ri) vaiśraṇava,
dharaṇēndra, śrīdēviyarendu caturvidhamakkumavaṟoḷ, āyō
dhyādi mahānagaradoḷ, vasiyisuva puṇyadēvategaḷ, āḷananta (āananya)
sādhāraṇa mahā prabhāvaneyarappa jina jananiyaruṁ, viśvēśvaryyatemryemba
ravaraṁ, strīyarupāstigeydoḍavidhavālakṣaṇamuṁvuṁ, nirantara puṇyamu

makkuṁ, vaiśravaṇaṁ nidhi patiyappudaṟiṁṟaṁ, putrōpātpārjanārthamātana
nupāstigeyvudu, dharaṇēndranaṁ putrārthadinupāstigeyvudu garbha
pratipākaṅgeyvayvu (dhr̥tipūtaṁ mālpa) vairidēvategaḷ emmamaneyaṁvuyampu
gadirkendu, śrīdēviyaranupāstigeyvudu, śrīdēviya pratibimbaṁ
maneyoḷiḷare tatpritpratiyappa saudharmēndrana prabhāvadiṁ vairi dēvategaḷ
tamma maneyaṁ pugalaṇmavu.

kriyādēvatā embudu, chatratrayamuṁ, cakratrayamuṁ, agni
trayamuṁ, pratimeyumendintu daśavidhamakkumivu śāntihētugaḷu
pādēyuṅvēyaṅgaḷuḷidappapa. krūradēvategaḷ hēyuṅyaṅgaḷendaṟige; eṇṭa
neya liṅgamembudu, puruṣaliṅgaṁ, strīliṅgamendu dvividhamakku
malli, puruṣaliṅgaṁ, paramar̥vi(ni)stāraka liṅgamenduṁ, paramar̥ṣi
(mēndra)liṅgamenduṁ, paramarājaliṅgamenduṁ, paramēṣṭhi(ma)liṅga
menduṁ, siddhaliṅgamenduṁ, ṣadviḍvidhamakkumavandaroḷ paramavi(ni)stā
rakaliṅgaṁ, gaṇadharasādhanaṁ, paramar̥ṣiliṅgaṁ. puṇya darśanaṁ, nivr̥tti
lakṣaṇamappa tapōmayamuṁvuṁ, paramēndraliṅgaṁ, mahāpuṇyalakṣaṇaṁ,
paramarājaliṅgamuṁ mahāpuṇya lakṣaṇaṁ, paramēṣṭhi liṅgaṁ paramanirvāṇa
lakṣaṇaṁ, siddhaliṅgamakṣara(ṁmahā)lakṣaṇaṁ, nirvāṇasādhanamappakṣarameṁ
budu, caḷatvattva nirvāṇamembudu tr̥pti; alli strīliṅgaṁ sarasvatiliṅga
menduṁ, patipratāliṅgamenduṁ, kēśavratiliṅgamenduṁ, āduṁariñjaya
liṅgamenduṁ, caturvidha liṅgamakkumavaroḷ, sarasvati liṅgamadhya
yana kāraṇaṁ, patipratāliṅgaṁ vikalpayōgasādhanaṁ, kēśavratiliṅgaṁ
sanmārgasādhanaṁ, ānaṁariñjayaliṅgaṁ tr̥ptilakṣaṇaṁ; ivu parinirvāṇa
sādhanaliṅgamuḷiduvellaṁ kuliṅgamendaṟige; ombhattaneyāhāra śuddhi
yembudumu māṁsādi sāvadyāhāra varjanamāhāra śuddhi, kāmaśuddhi
yembudumu vigatakāmaruṁ, jitēndriyaruṁ, svadārasantuṣṭarumāgi
pudumuḷida sāvadyāhāramaśuddhamendīmendintu, naḍeyadorellaṁ viṭaruṁ,
viḍambakarumendaṟige; pattaneya hiṁsā śuddhi embudumu dharmārtha
muṁ, dēvatārthamuṁ, mōkṣārthamuṁ, (svabōdha)sukhōgārtha
mumāge, kolladudadu hiṁsā śuddhi; tamma kīrtige paśuvadhegeyvudu duṣṭa
buddhigaḷaśuddhavendaṟige; intu vikācāra pariniṣṭhitamuṁ, pariśuddhamu
mappātmamatamaṁ dharmaśrēyōhitārthiyappātanupadēśakaralli

kēḷdu, sanmārgadoḷ matiyanikkiṭṭu (durmārga)nmārgamaṁ pattuviḍu
vudu tatvajñāna garbhanāgi, tandeya samānamappa guruviṅge dharmava
maganāgi puṭṭuvudavatārakriye; munnēnnapēḻda garbhāvānada teṟaśrīne guru
pāda praṇāma pūrvakaṁ vrataṅgaḷaṁ kaikoḷvudu vr̥ttilābhakriye; jinā
layadoḷ śuciyappa raṅgadoḷ saṇṇamappa peṭṭisoḷānuṁ, nīroḷ
kalasida piṭṭisoḷānuṁ, candanādi dravyadoḷānuṁ, appavaḷa padma
(mana)kke samavr̥ttamappa jīva(jinā)sthāna maṇḍaḷayanakke(puṇṭapapumu
nakke) tajñariṁ barayisi, vividhārcanegaḷanarjisi, jina bimbābhimukhado
ḷācārya kr̥tōpavāsanuṁ, yathāśakti kr̥ta pūjāpidhānanuṁ, dhauta
dhavaḷavastra paridhānanumappa śiṣyananirisi, sinagipumupāsaka dīkṣeyendu
palavu sūḻ mastaka sparśanaṁ geydu, pañcamuṣṭhiṣṭiyuṁ (pañcapara
mēṣṭhiyaṁ) śirōruha sparśanaṁ geydu, nīnīniṁ dīkṣeyuṁ pavitranādesādave
yendu, siddhaśēṣeyayunikki, śiṣyaṅge pañcanamaskāra padamanumupadēśaṁ
geydu, ī mantramakhiḷapāpamaṁ kiḍisi, ninnaṁ pavitraṁ māḷkuṁḻkuṁ.

nīṁ illinditta niccaṁ śuciyāgi, śucipradēśaṣṭhuṁśuciyāgiśucipradēdoḷirdu, śuci
yappa dravyaṅgaḷiṁ trailōkyasvāmigarjarcanādigaḷiṁ kriyā kāṇḍadoḷ
pēḻda sthitiyiṁ māḍuvudendu nuḍidintīvidhiyellamaṁ māḍi, pāli
salpōgavēḷku, gurugaḷanugrahadiṁ negaḻvudu sthānalābhakriye; initu
kālamumajñānateyiṁ, mithyādēvategaḷaṁ pūjisi, pēpigaḷārjita dharma
maṁ kaikoṇḍeminnennamagivē daivamendu palaraṟiye, tamma maneyiṁ
poṟamaḍisi nimma meccideḍeyoḷiḷarimenduṁmendu, mithyādēvategaḷanoydu
visarjisi kaḷedarhatsamtsamambandhigaḷappa viśvēśvarā dēvategaḷanuyduttayttara gr̥ha
doḷ, vaiśravaṇanaṁ bhaṇḍāradoḷ, dharaṇēndrananelliyānumondu
śuddhapradēśadoḷ, śrīdēviyaṁ garbhagr̥hadoḷ sthāpanaṁ geyvudu
gaṇagrahaṇa kriye; arhatpūjōpavāsapūrvakaṁ, parvadinaṅgaḷoḷaṁ
gāthaṅgaḷaṁ kēḷvudu pūjārādhya kriye; pūrvōpasthitiyoḷ pūjō
pavāsapūrvakaṁ, brahmacāriyāgi, pūrvaṅgaḷaṁ kēḷvudu puṇyayajña
kriye; svasamaya śrutamellamaṁ neṟeṟiye kēḷdu, peṟarōdugaḷaṁ
kēḷvudu dr̥ḍhacaryākriye; pakṣōpavāsaparyantaṁ pratimāyōga
doḷ mumpēḻda, kriyākaḷāpadindaṁ, śuddhiyaṁ tāḷdiḷda, śiṣyayōgya
mappa cihnaṅgaḷaṁ kaikoḷvudupayōga(tā)kriye; dēvatā gurugaḷa

sākṣiyoḷ dhavaḷavastra yajñōpavītādivāraṇamavappa vipaṣamumārya
ṣapaṭkarma javitvamumappa vr̥ttiverasu samamuyōcitamappa dīkṣeyiṁ
gōtra jātyādināmanmuntaramaṁvuṁ tāḷdupanītakriye; upavāsaka
sūtravaṁvuṁ granthadindamarthadindaṁ kaikoṇḍu bratamaṁvuṁ naḍeyisuvudu
vratācāryākriyeyeṁ; gurusannidhiyoḷanvita śividyanāgi, bhūṣaṇādigaḷaṁ
kaikoḷvudu vratāvataraṇa kriye; dīkṣitaṁ tanna dharmapatniyumaṁ
suvratōcitamavappa dīkṣegoḷisi, siddhārcanā pūrvakaṁ, punarvivāha
vidhiyaṁ māḻpudu vivāhakriye; samāna jīvigaḷuṁ labdhavarṇaru
mappupāsakaroḷ sambandhamamunicchaccayisi, nālvar śrāvakāgraṇigaḷaṁ
barisi, satkāraṅgeydduydu, nīmamuppoḍe ni(vi)stārakaruṁ, dēvabrāhma
ṇaruṁ, lōkapūjitarumāgirdirānunuṁmīgaḷ,gr̥hītōpāsakabratanuṁ,
dīkṣitanumāgi, saddharmadoḷnegaḻdu, pātradānamuṁvuṁ, gurupūjije
yumaṁvuṁ geydduydu, gurugaḷanugrahadinayōni sambhavamavappa janmamaṁvaṁ
paḍedu, cirabhāvitamaṁvaṁ pattuviṭṭu, bhāvitamappudaṁ bhāvisi, suvrata
śuddhi nimittamuṁ pāsitanuṁ, kr̥tavidyanumumathitōpāsakādhyayananumāgi,
vratāvataraṇāntadoḷābharaṇādiparigrahamaṁvaṁ kaikoṇḍenna patniyuṁ
punarvivāhadoḷpāṇigrahaṇaṁ māḍide, sādharmigaḷappa nimrammadondanu
jñeyiṁ varṇalābhaṁ māḻpudene, nīvendudellaṁ yuktamī ninna dore
yorī dvijanmanāyō(vō)nidoreyayursamavunisidandu, samānajīviga
ḷappa, mithyādr̥ṣṭigaḷoḷaṁ sambandhamemagabhimatamadakke nīnētakke
yendu, nistārakarkuḍe, varṇalābhamaṁvaṁ paḍedavaḷ samānamāvāgippudu
varṇalābhakriye; āryaṣaṭkarmadoḷ, viśuddha vratanāgi negaḻvudu kula
caryākriye; vratādhyayanasampattiyiṁ, parānugrahasamarthanuṁ,
prāyaścittavidhānavidhiyiṁ, śruti smr̥ti purāṇanumenisi, gr̥hasthācā
ryanappudu gr̥hēśitvakriye.

bahuvidhōpavāsadiṁ bhāvaneyoḷnegaḻvudupaśāntakriye; gr̥hā
vāsadoḷviraktanāgi, yōgyanappa magaṅge yathā nyāyaṁ, (yajñōvaja
dājñāyuṁ) gr̥hatyāgamanupadēśaṁ geydduydu, tapōvanakke pōpudu
gr̥hatyāgakriye; ēkaśākaṭaka(sādhaka) dhāraṇa dīkṣādyuktakriye; parityakta
vastranāgi jātarūpamaṁ tāḷvuvudu, jinarūpatākriye; mōnādhyayana
vr̥ttiyiṁ taguḷdigranivr̥ttiḻdagranivr̥ttivavaramuḷida kriyegaḷellaṁ munna garbhā

nvayuya kriyegaḷoḷ pēḻdandavevame, mūṟaneya kartānvayadoḷ,
kriyeyoḷ, sajjātitvamembudu, dīkṣāyōgyamappanvayadoḷaṁ,
viśuddha kulajātiyoḷumuditōdita vaṁśadoḷ puṭṭuvuduṁ, dēhādi
sāmagriyuḷḷudu, sajjātikriye; kulamembudu pitr̥sambandhaṁ, jāti
yembudu mātr̥sambandhamiṣṭārthasiddhigellaṁ sa(jjā)jñātiye kāraṇa
mamudalladeyumāyumpāvudondu saṁskāramaneydī bhavyātmaṁ, dvijanmama
veyduguvudu saṁskāraniyayu(jani)ta sa(ñjñā)jñātijā್tiyembudakkuṁ;
viśuddhamamuppāgaradoḷ, puṭṭida maṇiyentu saṁskāra vaśadinusutkr̥ṣṭa
mamukkumante, bhavyātmaṁ, kriyāgōtra saṁskāradindutkr̥ṣṭakke salguṁ;
suvarṇāphaḷavenmentu satkriyeyuyaneydiydu śuddhamamukkumante bhavyātmanuṁ
kriyeyuyaneydiydu śuddhanakkuṁ; (innu) vijñāna saṁskāramembudu,
jñānajanitamāvājñānamuṁvuṁ, samyajñānamāvāgalkemāgavēḻkumamudu sarvajña
nattiṁ puṇyavantarge dorekoḷgumante, dorekoṇḍa paramamujñānaṁ
garbhamamuppā saṁskāradimpuṭṭi, śīlavraprata(diṁ) bhūṣipitanappātaṁ, dvijanma
nembōnakkumantu, sarvajña pradhānappa dvijanmaṅge, mantrapūrvakaṁ,
vratacinha sūtramāgalvēḻpudāsūtraṁ, dravyasūtraṁ bhāvasūtra(mupā
sakasūtra)menditteṟattaḻinakkumalli, yajñōpavītaṁ triguṇātmakaṁ, dravya
sūtramupāsaka sūtraṁ, darśana jñāna cāritra trayīlakṣaṇaṁ, bhāva
sūtramītreteṟadiṁ labdha saṁskāranāgi, parabrahma(vumu)tvakke sandōnanabhi
vandisi, guṇācāryaṁ siddhaśēṣākṣataṅgaḷanikki, saptaparamasthāna bhāgi
gaḷāgimendu parasi(pumu) dharma(sthirīstrī)svīkaraṇa pūrvakavātanaṁ prōtsā
hisuvarantāyōgi(tanayō) sambhavamuṁvuṁ, divyajñāna garbhamumppa,
janmamamuneydi sajjāti bhājananakkumantu, sajjātiyu neyduguṁ;
sadvr̥ttattvavembudārya ṣaṭkarmavuṁvumaṁ, gr̥hasthanāgi negaḻdātmakr̥ta
mamuppa, gr̥hacaryānuṣṭhānadoḷanālasyadiṁ naḍedu, jinēndra saṁskāra
labdhi janmanuṁ, gaṇadhara sūtrarakṣitanuvāmāgi, paramu brahmavarcasavaṁvuṁ
tāḷdi, dhārmika dharmavumūrtiyendu kīrtise, yajana, yājana kriye
yoḷamadhyayanādhyāpana kriyeyoḷaṁ neṟedu, bhūmi sparśanavuṇmuṇṭā
giyuṁ, bhūmigata dō(dvē)ṣadoḷ poreyade, bhūmidēvanāgi
purdupāsaka sūtraṅgaḷaṁ māḍi,yajña doḷpaśuvadhegeyva kubrāhmaṇaṁ,
jātimadāvēśadiṁ intennanī manuṣya janmadoḷpuṭṭi, ninna munnina

kulamuṁvuṁ, jātiyuṁ, śarīramumuḷḷante, dēvanādandumāvudu
dēvatātithi pitrāgni kāryadoḷanādaranuṁ, dēvaguru dvija pramāṇa
doḷ, parāṅmukhanumāgi, jaina dīkṣeyuṁ kaikoṇḍalli, ninagādatiśaya
māvudendu nuḍiye, jina brāhmaṇanemma dēvatvamuṁmaṁ kēḷimidiṁ
tendaṁdantattvajñānagarbhadoḷnirmaḷanappajinanejanakanāgesamyagdarśanacāritraṅgaḷanupārjisisaṁskāradindvitīyajanmampaḍedayōgisambhavarappadēvarādevundalladeyuṁsvayambhuvamukhadattaṇindavemagedvitīyajanmamādudaṟindvijarādevemmāgamōktadimpavitramappayajñōpavītamumagepratacihnaṁnīmappaḍeapagatasūtrānugataruṁ(pāpasūtrajñaruṁ)sanmārgakaṇṭakarundōṣadōṣitarumendumattantammadvijatvamanaṟipuvabageyinintendaṁśarīrajanmaṁsaṁskārajanmamenditteranakkuṁśarīramaraṇaṁsaṁskāramaraṇamendumaraṇamitteṟanakkumulliśarīrajanmamembudupūrvavidēhaparīkṣadoḷmattondudēhavuṅkaikoḷvudusaṁskārajanmembudulabdhātmalābhanāgisaṁskāravaśadindvijanmavumpaḍevuduśarīramaraṇavembudunijāyuḥpyavasānadoḷdēhadindēhāntarakkesalvuduṁsaṁskāramaraṇavembuduātmaṅga(ra)hitavappamithyājñānadarśanajñānacāritraṅgaḷampattuviṭṭuātmahitavappasamyagdarśanajñānacāritraṅgaḷaṅkaikoṇḍintumunninaparyāyavumpattuviṭṭumattonduparyāyāntarakkesalvudusaṁskāramaraṇavudaṟimpāpōpahitavalladasaṁskārajanmamuṅgurugaḷadondanujñe(yaṁ)yimpaḍedudēva(spa)dvijarā(ja)devendumattambrahmanamakkaḷubrāhmaṇarapparābrāhmaṇanuṁsvayambhuvumparamēṣṭhiyuñjinōttamanesamyajñānādiguṇabr̥haṇadimbrahmanembanvarthanāmavumperargaveraḍuvendukr̥ṣṇājinadharanuñjaṭākūrcōpalakṣitanumappātaṅkāmagardabhambrahmanalladaṟindivyamūrtiyuñjñānagarbhanumappajinēndranumpēldavratavuntrādisaṁskāradindvijōttamaruvādemmaṁvarṇāntaḥpātigaḷmāḍinuḍiyalvēḍāvarṇōttamaruṅkṣāntiśaucānvitaruṁviśuddhācārarumāmulladellampāpārthigaḷāgipaśuvadhegeydumadanedharmaṁmāḍinuḍivapāpaśāstrōpajīvagaḷuṁ.

cāritraṅgaḷanupārjisi, saṁskāradiṁ dvitīya janmapuṁnmaṁ paḍedayōgi,
sambhavarappa dēvarādevundalladeyuṁ, svayambhuva mukhadattinttaṇindave
mage, dvitīya janma mādudaṟiṁ dvijarādevemmāgamōktadiṁ, pavitra
mappa yajñōpavīta vemumage prata cihnaṁ, nīmappadeḍe apagata sūtrā
nugataruṁ (pāpa sūtrajñaruṁ) sanmārgakaṇṭakaruṁ, dōṣa dōṣitaru
mendu, mattaṁ tamma dvijatvamanaṟipuva bageyinintendaṁ; śarīra
janmaṁ saṁskārajanmamenditteranakkuṁ. śarīra maraṇaṁ, saṁskāra maraṇa
mendu maraṇamitteṟa nakkumamulli, śarīra janmamembudu, pūrvavidēha
parīkṣadoḷ mattondu dēhamuṁvuṁ kaikoḷvudu; saṁskāra janmameṁnmeṁ
budu, labdhātmalābhanāgi saṁskāravaśadiṁ dvijanmamuṁvuṁ paḍevudu; śarīra
maraṇamemvembudu, nijāyuṣyāyuḥpyavavasānadoḷ dēhadiṁ dēhāntarakke
salvuduṁ, saṁskāra maraṇamemvembudu ātmaṅga(ra) hitamavappa mithyājñāna
darśanajñāna cāritraṅgaḷaṁ pattuviṭṭu ātmahitamavappa samyagdarśanajñāna
cāritraṅgaḷaṁ kaikoṇḍintu munnina paryāyamuṁvuṁ pattuviṭṭu,
mattondu paryāyāntarakkesalvudu saṁskāramaraṇamuvudaṟiṁ, pāpō
pahitamavallada saṁskāra janmamuṁ gurugaḷadondanujñe(yaṁ)yiṁ pa
ḍedu, dēva(sr̥spa)dvijarā(ja)demenvendu, mattaṁ brahmana makkaḷu, brāhma
ṇarapparābrāhmaṇanuṁ, svayambhuvuṁ, paramēṣṭhiyuṁ, jinōttamane
samyajñānādi guṇa br̥haṇadiṁ brahmanembanvarthanāmavuṁ, pergarargave
raḍuvendu, kr̥ṣṇājina dharanuṁ, jaṭākūrcōpalakṣitanumappātaṁ,
kāmumagardabhaṁ, brahmanalladaṟiṁ, divyamūrtiyuṁ, jñānagarbhanumappa
jinēndranuṁ pēḻdu vraldavratatamunvuntrādi saṁskāradiṁ dvijōttamaruvā
demmaṁ varṇāntaḥ pātigaḷmāḍi nuḍiyalvēḍā, varṇōttamaruṁ,
kṣānti śaucānvitaruṁ, viśuddhācārarumāmulladellaṁ, pāpārthigaḷāgi,
paśuvadhegeyvuydumadane dharmaṁmāḍi, nuḍiva pāpa śāstrōpa jīvagaḷuṁ,

karmacāṇḍāḷaruṁ, pāpapaṇḍitaruṁ, saddharmabāhyaraṁ, paśuvadhege
yvaraṁ, daṇḍisaltakkudu paśuvadhegeydu '‘svargakke pōpaḍe, dharmaṁ
geyduvarelligepōparāpāpigaḷinaggaḷaṁ, maḷiṇa caritaruṁ, kr̥ṣṇa mati
gaḷumillemmanmmindaggaḷaṁ, nirmaḷācāraruṁ, śuklamatigaḷumilla, śruti
smr̥ti purāṇa mantrakriyāvra(kr̥)tamappa; dēvatāliṅgaṁ, kāmumakr̥ta
śuddhiyuṁ munnakr̥taśuddhiyumuḷḷa dvijaṅgakku; viśuddha vr̥ttiyiṁ,
dēvatākr̥ta śuddhiyaneydātaṁ śuklavarṇamuḷidarellaṁ kr̥ṣṇavarṇa
(rga)mā śuddhiyumpuyumaśuddhiyu nyāyānyāya pravr̥ttiyenditteranakkuṁ.
dayārdravr̥drvattitvaṁ, nyāyuṁyaṁ, prāṇi māraṇamanyāyuyamudaṟiṁ, viśu
ddhavr̥ttaruṁ varṇōttamaruṁ jaganmānyarupāmādyaruṁ. jainare matta
mentānupūmārya ṣaṭkarma jīvaṅgaḷe sāvadyamakkumembeyuppoḍappōgadu
sambhavisidadentendoḍe, pakṣaṁ, caryaryeka, sādhyasādhakatvamemba trividha
dindaṁ sāvadya māgadavaṟoṟiūḷ, pakṣamembudu jainaṅge sarvahiṁsā
varjanaṁ (visarjanaṁ) maitri pramōdakāruṇya mādhyasthōsthyōpabr̥ṁhitaṁ
(sthāpabruhataṁ); caryemembudu dēvatārthamuṁvuṁ, mantrasiddhyartha
mumēvumepaṇārthamuṁvuṁ, āhārārthamuṁvuṁ, svabhōgārthamuvāvumāge, jaina
nappātaṁ hiṁsegeyvanallanakāmumakr̥ta hiṁseyādoḍaṁ, prāyaścittadiṁ
viśuddhanāgi, gr̥hadharmamellamuṁvuṁ tamma magaṅgappayisi, maneyumpattu
viḍuvudusādhakamembudu; jīvitāntadoḷ dēhāhāratyāgaṅgeydu
paramumadhyāna śuddhiyiṁ, lōkāgradoḷ matiyuniḍuvudaṟinīpēḻdu
mūṟiṁ treṟadoḷ negaḻvalva, jainadvijaṅge hiṁsādōṣamāgadendu
nijapakṣadōṣa nirākaraṇaṅgeyvudu, mattaṁ caturāśramaśuddhiyembu
dārhatadoḷ pēṟavellamuvicārita (pēṟipupeṟavu vicārita) ramaṇīyaṅgaḷeṁ
tene, brahmacāriyuṁ, gr̥hasthanuṁ, vānaprasthanuṁ, bhikṣukanuvenmendu
nālvarapparavaroḷ, upanayuyana avaḷambaṁ dīkṣārū(gū)ḍha naiṣṭhikabhē
dadiṁ brahmacārigaḷayvarapparavaroḷu, upanayuyana brahmacāriyemboṁ,
yajñōpavīta dhāriyāgi, samumastāgavuma gr̥hānuṣṭhānadoḷ negaḻvoṁli³ḻdaṁ;
avaḷamba brahmacāriyemboṁ, kṣullullaka(na) rūpadiṁ āgamābhyāsaṁ
geydu gr̥havāsa(stha)doḷ negaḻvoṁli³ḻvaṁādīkṣābrahmacāriyemboṁvēṣavondumilladāgamābhyāsaṅgeydugr̥hadharmadoḷnegali³ḻvaṅgūḍhabrahmacāriyemboṁ.

geydu, gr̥hadharmadoḷ negaḻvoṁli³ḻvaṁ; gūḍhabrahmacāriyemboṁ,

kumāra śravaṇanāgi samastāgamābhyāsaṅgeydu, bandhugaḷinarasarindariṁmu
snaha parīṣahaṅgaḷindakke nirastaparamēśvara rūpanāgi, gr̥hadharmado
ḷnegaḷdoṁḻdoṁ; naiṣṭhika brahmacāriyemboṁ, śikhādharanuṁ, dhavaḷarakta
vastra khaṇḍakaupīnadhara kaṭiliṅganuṁ, snātakanuṁ, yajñōpavītalakṣita
vakṣasthaḷanuṁ, bhikṣāvr̥tti niratanuṁ, dēvatārcanāparanumakkuṁ; eraḍa
neya gr̥hasthāstharārya ṣaṭkarma niratar, jāti kṣatriyarenduṁ tīrtha
kṣatriyarenduṁ itteṟanappar, alli, jāti kṣatriya (kṣatriya) brāhma
ṇa(nu) vaiśya, śūdraremba bhēdadiṁ caturvidhamappar, uḷidaru vr̥tti
bhēdadindanēka vidhamappar. mūṟaneya vānaprasthanemboṁ, parigr̥grahīta
jinarūpakanēka vastradharaṁ, niratiśayakayu tapadoḷnegaḷdoṁḻdoṁ. nālkaneya
bhikṣumemboṁ jinarūpadhara mūlaguṇōttama guṇadhārigaḷuṁ, vividha
rdhihastaruṁ (prāptaruṁ) gaṇadhararuṁ, (gaṇadhara) kēvaḷigaḷendu bahu
prakāramapparendintu, tanna mahātmyamaṁ kiḍalīyade, peṟarge yu
ktiyiṁ pratipālisuvudāsagradgr̥haha(hī)tva kriye; pārivrājaka (pari
vāvrājya)membudu gr̥hasthadharmamaṁ pratipāḷisi, viraktacittaṁ dīkṣō
dyuktanāgi, viśuddhakulagōtranuṁ, sadvr̥ttanuṁ, kalyāṇāṅganumeni
sida, dīkṣāyōgyanappātaṁ nirgranthācāryara pakkade, śubhatithi yōga
nakṣatra lagna grahāṁśakadoḷ, grahōparāga grahaṇa pravēśa, suracāpa
vakragrahōdayānaṣṭamāsādhikamāsa, saṅkrānti riktatithi vivarjitama
ppudaṟoḷ, dīkṣegoḷvudu pārivrājyalakṣaṇamappa sūtra(pada)ṅgaḷippa
ttēḷu teṟanakku mavāvuvendovendeḍe,-jātiyuṁ, mūrtiyuṁ, lakṣa
ṇamuṁ, saundaryamuṁ, prabheyuṁ, maṇḍalamuṁ, cakramuṁ, abhi
ṣēkamuṁ, nāthatvamuṁ, siṁhāsanamuṁ, upadānamuṁ, chatramuṁ,
cāmaramuṁ, ghōṣaṇeyuṁ, aśōkavr̥kṣamuṁ, nidhiyuṁ, gr̥ha
śōbheyuṁ, avagāhanamuṁ, kṣētramuṁ, ājñeyuṁ, sabheyuṁ,
kīrtiyuṁ, vandyaśreteyuṁ, vāhanamuṁ, bhākṣeyuṁ, āhāramuṁ,
sukhamumendakkumalli, jātyādi saptaviṁśati sūtra padalakṣaṇa lakṣitanappa,
bhagavadarhadbhaṭṭāraka(na) caraṇayugaḷamanāśrayisi, tanna jātiyoḷappa,
(paramaṁmuṁ) mudamaṁ pattuviṭṭu dīkṣegoṇḍoḍe divyavijayaparamā
nuparamemba jāti catuṣṭayamuṁ, paḍegumalli, divyajātiyindahamiṁ
dratvamuṁ, vijaya jātiyinda cakravartitvamuṁ, paramajātiyinda

mārhantyamuṁ, anupama jātiyinda siddhatvamuṁ, paḍeyalakkuṁ,
mūrtiyembudu; paramamūrtiyembudu paramamūrtiyappa jinēṁ
drananānāśrayisi, peṟavu jīvanikāya mūrtigaḷaṁ nīṁ barduṅkugu
membabhayadiṁ, tanna śarīrava kēḍambageyude, mahātapadoḷnegaḷdoḻdoḍe,
divyamūrtiyuṁ, vijayamūrtiyuṁ, paramamūrtiyuṁ, anupama
mūrtiyumaṁ paḍeyalakkuṁ siddhaśarīramappudaṟindanupamamū
rtige, sambhavamillenduḷida mūṟu mūrtiyane, matāntaradoḷkūḍi
dar. (ḷu nuḍivaru).
lakṣaṇamembudu, paramalakṣaṇadharanappa, jinapatiyanāśrayisi, tanna
dēha lakṣaṇamanapamānaṅgeydu, tapadoḷ negaḷdoḍe, divyalakṣaṇa,
vijayalakṣaṇa, paramalakṣaṇaṅgaḷaṁ paḍeyalakkuṁ. saundaryamembudu
paramasaundarya samētanappa jinapatiya matamanavalambisi, tanna dēha
saundaryamaṁ mahātapadoḷ(diṁ) kṣapiyisidoḍe, divyavijaya
paramasaundaryamaṁ paḍeyalakkuṁ; prabheyembudu, paramakāya
prabhānvitanappa paramēṣṭhiya pādamūladoḷ tannakāyaprabheyaṁ
bageyude, tapadoḷnegaḷdoḍe, divyādi prabhābhāsuranakkuṁ; maṇḍala
membudu, paramatējōmaṇḍalamaṇḍitanappa jinapatigeṟagi, maṇidīpa
snēhadīpamembiraḍumaṁ pattuviṭṭu, tapadoḷosagidoḍe, divyādi
tējōvaḷayōjvaḷanakkuṁ; cakramembudu, dharmacakradharanappa jina
patiyanārādhisi, samastaśastra parityāgaṅgeydu, tapadoḷnegaḷdoḍe
divyacakramuṁ, vijayacakramuṁ, paramātmacakramumaṁ paḍeya
lakkuṁ; abhiṣēkamembudu, paramajanmābhiṣēka pavitranappa jinēndranaṁ
pordi, snānādi nija saṁskāramaṁ pattuviṭṭu, tapaścaraṇaṅgeydoḍe,
divyavijaya paramābhiṣēka prāptiyakkuṁ. nāthatvamembudu, jagatrita
yanāthananupāstegeydaihika (geyudyaikasvā) sāmyamaṁ pattuviṭṭu,
tapadoḷesagidoḍe divyavijayaparama svāmitvamaṁ paḍeguṁ; siṁhāsana
membudu, paramasiṁhāsanārūḍhanappa jinapatiya dharmamaṁ pordi,
nijōcitāsana bhēdamaṁ bisuṭu, tapōnuṣṭhānadoḷ negaḷdoḍe, divya
vijaya paramātma viṣṭaraṁ dorekoḷguṁ; upadānamembudu, paramō
padāna parītanappa jinapatiya matamanaṟidu, nijōpadānādigaḷaṁ
pattuviṭṭu, bāhya mātrārjita nirastadiṁ sthaṇḍila śayanadoḷnega

ṟiddoḻdoḍaṁ, divyavijaya paramumaśayuyanōpadāna labdhiyakkuṁ; chatraveṁmeṁ
budu, dhavaḷachatratrayātmakanapparhaddēvanaṁ pordi, nijātapatrādi
parityāgaṅgeydu, nirgrantha tapadoḷnegaḻdoḍe, divyavijaya paramāta
patra samprāptiyakkuṁ; cāmaravemmembudu, paramacāmara virājitaneni
suva jinapatiyoḷappa bhaktiyiṁ, cāmara(bha)vyajana visarjanaṅgeydu,
tapadoḷnegaḻdoḍe divya vijayu cāmara vījyamānanakkuṁkkuṅghōṣaṇeyembuduparamadundubhighōṣaṇālaṅkr̥tanappaguṇanidhiyunarhaddēvanampordivividhānakasaṅgītaghōṣaṇavantoṟedutapadoḷesagidoḍedivyavijayuparamadundubhighōṣaṇalabdhiyakkuṁaśōkavr̥kṣamembuduparamāśōkataruvirājamānanappajagadguruvananāśrayisinijōdyānanāsādrumacchāyāśramavumpattuviṭṭudīkṣābhi(pi)dhānadoḷnegaḻdudivyavijayuparamāśōkadrumōdyānapariprāptiyakkuṁnidhiyembuduparamaguṇanidhiyunarhaddēvananārādhisetannanidhidravyaṅgaḷampattuviṭṭudīkṣeyoḷnegaḻdoḍedivyavijayuparamanidhigaḷgadhīśvaranakkuṅgr̥haśōbheyembuduparamalakṣmīgr̥haśōbhākāranappajinēndranupadēśadiṁnijagr̥haśōbhādityāgaṅgeydutapadoḷnegaḻdoḍedivyavijayuparamagr̥haśōbhādipatitvamakkuṁavagāha(na)membuduparamatapōvagāhanapararappajinapatiyatapadiṅgirigahanapradēśadoḷnegaḻdoḍedivyavijayuparamasukhāvagāhanamakkuṅkṣētramembuduparamakṣētrādhipatiyuñjinapatiyumpordinijakṣētravastuparityāgaṅgeydutapadoḷnegaḻdoḍedivyavijayuparamakṣētramaneyduguṁājñeyembuduparamājñāviśēṣanaṁlōkanāthananupasēvegeydunijājñābhimānaparityāgadiṁmōnavratadhāriyāgitapadoḷesagidoḍedivyavijayuparamajñānapariprāptiyakkuṁallidēvājñeyembududēvēndrapuṇyadindēvarkaḷaṁvaśīkr̥taṁmāḷpuduvijayājñeyembuducakradharapuṇyadindēvavidyādharanarēndraraṁvaśyaṁmāḷpuduparamājñeyembuduṣōḍaśabhāvanāsamupārjitatīrthakarapuṇyadindvādaśagaṇamunājñāpurassaraṁmāḷpudusabheyembuduparamasabhāsampatsamētanappajinanāthanampordinijēṣṭabandhubhr̥tyasabhāsamutsarjanaṅgeydutapadoḷnegaḻdoḍedivyavijayuparamānupamasabhāpatiyakkuṅkīrtiyeṁ.

ḻdoḍandivyavijayaparamaśayanōpadānalabdhiyakkuñchatramembududhavaḷachatratrayātmakanapparhaddēvanampordinijātapatrādiparityāgaṅgeydunirgranthatapadoḷnegaḻdoḍedivyavijayaparamātapatrasamprāptiyakkuñcāmaramembuduparamacāmaravirājitanenisuvajinapatiyoḷappabhaktiyiñcāmara(bha)vyajanavisarjanaṅgeydutapadoḷnegaḻdoḍedivyavijayucāmaravījyamānanakkuṅghōṣaṇeyembudu paramumadundubhi ghōṣaṇālaṅkr̥tanappa guṇa
nidhiyunarhaddēvanampordi, vividhānaka saṅgīta ghōṣaṇavuṁ koḻduvantoṟedu,
tapadoḷesagidoḍe, divyavijayu paramumadundubhi ghōṣaṇalabdhiyakkuṁ.
aśōka vr̥kṣavemmembudu, paramāśōkataru virājamānanappa, jagadguru
vananāśrayisi, nijōdyānanāsādramudrumacchāyāśramuṁmavuṁ pattuviṭṭu,
dīkṣābhi(vipi)dhānadoḷ negaḻdaḻdu, divyavijayu paramāśōkadrumōdyāna
pariprāptiyakkuṁ, nidhiyembudu, paramumaguṇanidhiyunarhaddēvananārā
dhise, tanna nidhidravyaṅgaḷaṁ pattuviṭṭu, dīkṣeyoḷnegaḻdoḍe, divya
vijayu paramumanidhigaḷaḷgadhīśvaranakkuṁ; gr̥haśōbheyembudu, paramuma
lakṣmīgr̥haśōbhākāranappa, jinēndranupadēśadiṁ, nijagr̥haśōbhādi
tyāgaṅgeydu, tapadoḷnegaḻdoḍe, divyavijayayu paramumagr̥haśōbhādi
patitvamakkuṁ; avagāha(na)vemmembudu, paramumatapōvagāhanapararappa jina
patiya tapadiṁ, girigahana pradēśadoḷnegaḻdoḍe, divyavijayu paramuma
sukhāvagāhanamakkuṁ; kṣētravemmembudu, paramumakṣētrādhi patiyuṁ, jina
patiyumpordi, nijakṣētra vastu parityāgaṅgeydu, tapadoḷnegaḻdoḍe,
divyavijayu paramumakṣētramaneyduguṁ; ājñe yembudu, paramājñā viśē
ṣanaṁ. lōkanāthananupasēvegeydu, nijājñābhimānaparityāgadiṁ,
mōnavratadhāriyāgi tapadoḷesagidoḍe, divyavijayu paramumajñāna pari
prāptiyakkuṁ, alli dēvājñeyembudu, dēvēndrapuṇyadiṁ dēvarkaḷaṁ
vaśīkr̥taṁ māḻpuḷpudu; vijayājñeyembudu, cakradhara puṇyadiṁ, dēva
vidyādharanarēndraraṁ vaśyaṁ māḻpuḷpudu; paramājñeyembudu, ṣōḍa
śabhāvanāsamupārjita tīrthaṅrthakara puṇyadiṁ, dvādaśagaṇamunājñāpurassaraṁ
māḻpuḷpudu; sabheyembudu, paramumasabhāsampatsamētanappa jinanāthanaṁ
pordi, nijēṣṭabandhu bhr̥tyasabhāsamutsarjanaṅgeydu, tapadoḷnega
ḻdoḍe, divyavijayu paramānamnupavuma sabhāpatiyakkuṁ; kīrtiyeṁ

budu, paramukīrtiyapparhaddērhddēvana tattvamuṁmaṁ bhāvisi, nijaguṇa kīrta
navaṁmaṁ bisuṭu, tapadoḷesagidoḍe, divyavijayu paramānupamu
kīrtiyaṁ tanage māḻkuṁ; vandyateyembudulpaṁvandyateyembudupa, paramuvandyanapparha
ddēvanaṁ bhaktiyiṁ bandisi, tapadoḷ negaḻdoḻttoḍe, divyavijayu paramā
nupamuvandanegaḷaṁ paḍeguṁ; vāhanamembudu, paramupada vāhananappa
jinapatiyuṁ pordi, maṇi suvarṇa pādukādivāhana parityāgaṅgeydu,
mahātapadoḷ negaḻdoḻttoḍe divyavāhanaṅgaḷadhipatiyukkuṁ.

bhāṣeyembudu paramubhāṣā sundaravadanāravindanappa jinapatiyuya
nārādhisivāk samitiyiṁ tapadoḷ negaḻdoḻttoḍe divyādi bhāṣegaḷaṁ
paḍeguṁ; āhāramembudu, paramunāhāra mūrtiyappa jinōttamana
nāśrayisi, manōharāhāramuṁmaṁ pattuviṭṭanaśanādi tapadoḷ negaḻdoḻtto
dadhikatara kṣutpipāsābādhetanagādāgaḷīvidhada, dussaha parīṣahadiṁ,
mīnmīnmīnaṁ, pāvu pāvaṁ timbateḻiṟadiṁ, prāṇigaḷondondaṁ timbudeṁ
bidaṁ bagedu, parīṣahaṅgaḷaṁ sairisi, bhikṣāvr̥ttisādhita niravadyāhāranu
manāhāranumāgi, naḍedoḍe, divyavijayākṣīṇāmr̥tāhāraṅgaḷa klēśa
dinakkuṁ; jīnasēnācāryara ślōkaḥ

sukhavembudu, paramu sukhamayanappa bhagavadarhatparamēśvarana
nārādhisi, tadāḷambanasukha prārthaneyuṁ cakṣurādīndriyu sukhaṅgaḷaṁ
pattuviṭṭu, tapadoḷ negaḻdoḍe, divyavijayu paramu nirvāṇa sukhabhā
janarapparidu pārivrājyakriye surēndratvakriyeyembudu, pūrvajanma
kr̥ta pārivrājya phaḷōdayudinappa surādhipatyamudaṁ, munnemepē
ḻvudu; sāmrājyakriyeyembudu, cakraratna purassaraṁ, nidhiratnapura
ssaramappa, bhōgapurassaraṁ parampareyu neyduvudu; ārhantyakriye
yembudu, dharmacakrādhipatyamaṁ puṭṭisuvudu; paramu nirvāṇakriye
yembudu, ātmaguṇa sampūrṇatvaṁ; intugarbhadīkṣākartānvayakriye
gaḷanāgamōktaṅgaḷappavanālasyadinanuṣṭhisuvātaṁ, laghukarmiyāgi,
karmakṣayaṅgeyvuṁ;

mumpēḻdaḻdu banda, kriyegaḷge pīṭhikādi mantrōccāraṁ, ādā
nādi kriyārambhadoḷ, chatratrayu, cakratrayāgnitrayuṅyaṅgaḷverasu
vēdikeyanaḍuve, jina bimbagaḷaṁ pūrvōkta kramadiṁ sthāpanaṁ geydu,
pūjāvidhānadoḷ, ōṁ nirañjasyesyai namaḥ, darpa mathanāyuya namaḥ, śīla
gandhāyuya namaḥ, vimalāyuyanamaḥ, akṣatāyuya namaḥ, śr̥(tā khyāthyā)tadhūpā
yuyanamaḥ, jñānōdyōtāyuyanamaḥ, paramusiddhāyuya namaḥ, endintu
bhūmiśōdhanavunamvumbhōgandha, puṣpa, akṣata, dhūphapa, dīpa, caru,
mantraṅgaḷiṁ yathāsaṅkhyeyiṁ bhūmisaṁskāraṁ geydu, baliyuṁyaṁ
satyajātāyuya namaḥ, arhajjātāyuya namaḥ, paramu jātāyuya namaḥ,
anupajātāyuya namaḥ, svapradāyuya namaḥ, acalāyuya namaḥ, akṣatāyuya
namaḥ, avyābādhāyuya namaḥ, anantajñānāyuya namaḥ, anantadarśanāyuya
namaḥ, āanantavīryāyaṁya namaḥ, anantasukhāyuya namaḥ, nirañjase namaḥ,
nirmūrmaḷāyuya namaḥ, acchēdyāyuya namaḥ, abhēdyāyuya namaḥ, ajarāyuya
namaḥ, amarāyuya namaḥ, apramēyāyuya namaḥ, agarbhāvāsāyuya namaḥ,
akṣō(bhā)bhyāyuya namaḥ, avalinā(viḷivā)yuya namaḥ, paramu pūrṇāyuya
namaḥ, paramu kāṣṭhayōgarūpāyuya namaḥ, lōkāgravāsinenē namō
namaḥ, parimu siddhēbhyō namōnamaḥ, arhatsiddhēbhyō namōnamaḥ,
kēvaḷīsiddhēbhyō namōnamaḥ, anantakr̥t siddhēbhyō namōnamaḥ,
parampara siddhēbhyō namōnamaḥ, anādi parampara siddhēbhyō namō
namaḥ, anādyanupamu siddhēbhyō namōnamaḥ, samyagdr̥ṣṭige āsanna
bhavyaṅge, (nirmūrmaḷa) nirvāṇa pūjārhaṅge agnīndrāyaṅge sadā sēvā
phaḷaṁ paṭṭaramu sthānaṁ bhavatu; apamr̥tyu vināśanaṁ bhavatu, samādhi
maraṇaṁ bhavatu, pīṭhikāmantramanōdi, satyajanmaśaraṇaṁ prapadyāmi,
arhajjanmanaḥ śaraṇaṁ prapadyāmi arhan vānituḥśaraṇaṁ prapadyāmi,
arhat sutasya śaraṇaṁ prapadyāmi, anādigamunasya śaraṇaṁ prapadyāmi,
ratnatrayasya śaraṇaṁ prapadyāmi, samumagdr̥ṣṭi jñānamūrtertē sarasvatī

svāhā sēvāphaḷaṁ paṭṭarapumu sthānaṁ bhavatu, apamr̥tyuvināśanaṁ bhavatu,
samādhi maraṇaṁ bhavatu, endu jātimantramanōdi, satyajātāya
svāhā,arhajñājjātāya svāhā,paṭkarmaṇē svāhā, grāmapataraye svāhā,
anādi śrōtriyāya svāhā, snātakāya svāhā, śrāvakāya svāhā,
dēvabrāhmaṇāya svāhā,subrāhmaṇāya svāhā,anupamāya svāhā,
samyagdr̥ṣṭi divyanidhipati divyavaiśravaṇāya svāhā, sēvāphaḷaṁ paṭṭaramamu
sthānaṁ bhavatu; apamr̥tyuvināśanaṁ bhavatu; samādhi maraṇaṁ bhavatuḥ
endu nistāraka mantramanōdi, satyajātāya namaḥ, arhajñājjātāya
namaḥ, nirgranthāya namaḥ, vītarāgāya namaḥ, mahāvratāya namaḥ,
triguptāya namaḥ, mahāyōgāya namaḥ, vividha yōgāya namaḥ,
vividhardhaye namaḥ, aṅgadharāya namaḥ, pūrvadharāya namaḥ, gaṇadha
rāya namaḥ, paramarur̥ṣibhyō namaḥ, anupa majātāya namōnamaḥ,
samyagdr̥ṣṭi, bhūpati, nagarapati, kālaśravaṇa(ṇāya) svāhā; sēvāphaḷaṁ
paṭṭaramamusthānaṁ bhavatu; apamr̥tyu vināśanaṁ bhavatu; samādhi maraṇaṁ
bhavatu;endintu r̥ṣi mantramanōdi, satyajātāya svāhā, arhajñajjā
tāya svāhā, divyajātāya svāhā, nēmināthāya svāhā, saudha
rmāya ḥsvāhā, kalpādhipataye svāhā, paramparēndrāya svāhā, aha
mindrāya svāhā, paramārhatāya svāhā, anupamāya svāhā,
samyagdr̥ṣṭi, kalpapati, divyamūrti, vajranāmuma svāhā, sēvāphaḷaṁ
paṭṭaramasthānaṁ bhavatu, apamr̥tyuvināśanaṁ bhavatu, samādhi maraṇaṁ
bhavatu, endu surēndra mantramanōdi, satyajātāya svāhā, arha
jñājjātāya svāhā. anupamēndrāya svāhā, vijayārjitāya svāhā,
nēmināthāya svāhā, paramajātāya svāhā, paramārhatāya svāhā,
anupamāya svāhā, samyagdr̥ṣṭi, ugratējadiśāñjaya nēmi vijaya
svāhā(svāmigī), sēvāphaḷaṁ, paṭṭaramasthānaṁ bhavatu, apamr̥tyu
vināśanaṁ bhavatu, samādhi maraṇaṁ bhavatu, endu paramarājādi mantra
manōdi, satyajātāya namaḥ, arhajñājjātāya namaḥ, paramajātāya
namaḥ, paramārhatāyaḥya namaḥ, paramarūpāya namaḥ, paramatējasēnē
namaḥ, paramaguṇāya namaḥ, paramasthānāya namaḥ, paramu yōginē
namaḥ, paramuma bhāgyāya namaḥ, paramārthaye namaḥ, paramaprasādāya
namaḥ, paramuma kāṅkṣitāya namaḥ, paramuma vijayāya namaḥ, paramuma
darśanāya namaḥ, paramuma vīryāya namaḥ, paramasukhāya namaḥ,

sarvajñāyuya namaḥ, arhatē namaḥ, paramēṣṭhinē namōnamaḥ, paramu
nētrē namōnamaḥ, samyagdr̥ṣṭi, triḷōkavijayi, dharmamūrti,
dharmanēmi svāhā, sēvāphaḷaṁ paṭṭaramusthānaṁ bhavatu, apamr̥tyuvinā
śanaṁ bhavatu, samādhi maraṇaṁ bhavatu, endintu paramēṣṭhi mantrama
nōdi, intu pīṭhikājāti nistāraka r̥ṣi, surēndra paramumarāja, para
mēṣṭhi sambandhiyappa, saptavidha mantragaḷanārādhanāvidhikriyegaḷaṁ,
siddhārcanāpūrvakaṁ, gaṇadharācārya sūtrakkamikramave sādhana mantraṁ
gaḷ, sandhyātrayukkaṁ, agnitrayukkaṁ, dēvatā pūjegaṁ, nityakarma
kkamāhuti mantraṅgaḷumiḷuṁve.

ī mantraṅgaḷaṁ sādhisuvāgaḷ, (upa)siddha pratimā sannidhiyoḷ,
gandha puṣpākṣatādi, nivēdana pūrvakamupōmappōttara śata japaṅgeydu, siddha
vidyanāgi baḷiliyuṁ kriyārambhadoḷ, dhavaḷāmbara paridhānanuṁ,
yajñōpavītadharanuṁ, apa(madhya)gra cittanumāgi, ratnatrayu saṅka
lpadiṁ, dvijōttamasahitaṁ, tīrtharthaṅkara, gaṇadhara, kēvaḷīnirvāṇa pūjā
labdhamappagārhapatyāhavanīyu dakṣiṇāgnigaḷaṁ, mantrapūrvakaṁ pūjisi,
tannamaneyoḷnitya pūjegeydāhi(hu)tāgniyenisi, havirpākakkaṁ,
dhūpakkaṁ, dīpakkamallade, pavitramappagnitrayuvaṁvuṁ, peravakke kuḍalā
gaduṁ; agnisāvāmānyadiṁ, dēvatvavuṁmuṁ, pātra(pavitra)tvavumumavakkilla;
nirvāṇa kṣētra parikalpadiṁ, pavitramāduvaṁ pūjisidoḍe dōṣamilla;
vyavahāra nayāpēkṣeyiṁ, jainadvijanmaṅge agnitrayuṅgaḷ pūjyamī
gaḷ, pāpabuddhiyiṁ mithyājñānigaḷ koṁ(nō)ḍesuvadariṁ, jainarge
koṇḍāḍalāgadādā(doḍa)nādi kriyegaḷge, sāvāmānya mantragaḷaṁ
munna pēḻdantīḻdamīgaḷ, viśēṣa mantraṅgaḷaṁ pēḻvuvāvuvendoḍe,
sajjāta bhāgībhava, sadgr̥ha bhāgībhava, munīndra bhāgībhava, surēndra
bhāgībhava, arhantya bhāgībhava, paramunirvāṇa bhāgībhavamembudādāna
mantraḥ, trailōkyanāthōbhava, traikālajñānībhava, triratna svāmī
bhava endudu prītimantraḥ avatāra kalyāṇa bhāgībhava, mandarābhiṣēka
kalyāṇa bhāgībhava, niṣkāntiṣkāntīkalyāṇa bhāgībhava, ārhantyakalyāṇa bhāgī
bhava, parinirvāṇa kalyāṇabhāgībhavamembudu suprīti mantraḥ sajjāti
dhātratr̥ (dātratta) bhāgībhava, vaivāhakalyāṇa sadgr̥hadhātr̥ bhāgībhava,
munīndra dhātratr̥ bhāgībhava, surēndradhātr̥ bhāgībhava, phaparamu
rājyadhātratr̥ bhāgībhava, ārhantyadhātr̥ bhāgībhava, paramunirvāṇadhātratr̥

bhāgībhava, embudu dhr̥tikriyāmantraḥ; sajjāta kalyāṇa bhāgībhava,
sadgr̥ha kalyāṇa bhāgībhava, samūvaḥhākalyāṇa bhāgībhava, vaivāhakalyāṇa
bhāgībhava, munīndrakalyāṇa bhāgībhava, surēndrakalyāṇa bhāgībhava,
mandarābhiṣēkakalyāṇa bhāgībhava, yauvanarājyakalyāṇa bhāgībhava,
mahākalyāṇa bhāgībhava, paramarājyakalyāṇa bhāgībhava, ārhantyakalyāṇa
bhāgībhava embudu (gurumūḷa) kriyāmantraḥ; divyanēmivijayāya,
paramanēmi vijayāya, ārhantyanēmi vijayāya svāhā, embudu
priyōdbhava mantraṁ; ī janma(tajjanma)saṁskāramantradindaṁ siddhaśēṣā
bhiṣēkaṁ, gandhatāmbūla saṁsiktanappa bāḷakana tiśirasparśanaṅgeydu, kula
jāti vayōrūpa guṇaśīla prannanvaya bhāgyavidatā saumyamūrti samu
dhiṣṭiteyuṁ, samyagdr̥ṣṭiyumappaḷīke nimmabbe, nīnīkeya magane
yayudariṁ, cakratrayaṅgaḷaṁ paḍadu, samprītiyaneyduva yōgyavaṅga
sparśanaṁ geydu, bāhulyadiṁ tanaganurūpa(mappa)nonōḷ mūlātma
saṁskāraṅgeyduva(geyduydida) sōduvudu;

ślōka ॥ aṅgādaṅgātsambhavasi hr̥dayādabhipijāyasēse
ātmā vai putranāmāsi sajīva śaradāṁ śata

endōdi mantrapūrita, kṣīrājyāmr̥tamannābhiyoḷtaḷimu, dhāghātikṣaya
makkendu parase, nābhināḷavaṁ percisuvudu.

putraninage jātikriyeyaṁ śrīdēviye māḷkenlkendu parasi, magana
meyyaṁ pūrṇavāsadinudvartisi, mandarābhiṣēkārtharhanāgendu parasi,
gandhōdakadiṁ mīyaleṟadu, cirañjīviyāgendu parasi, śēṣākṣataṅga
ḷanikki, karmakṣaya bhāgiyāgendu, mukhadoḷaṁ nāsāpuṭadoḷaṁ,
jīvanōpada saṁsiddhamappa ghr̥tamaṁ, māteyaṟeṟaredeṟadu, viśvēśvarā
stanyabhāgiyāgendu tāyamoleypoliyanūḍidi, prītidānapūrvakaṁ munna
pēḷdante, jātakarmōtsavamaṁ māḍe, jarāyu paṭaḷamumaṁ, nābhi
paṭala(nāḷa)mumaṁ, kujamaṁr̥juyappa bhūmiyoḷ pūḷdaḷdigaḷ, samyagdr̥ṣṭi,
sarvamātā vasundhare svāhādiyemba mantramanōdi, salilārdrā
kṣataṅgaḷanallikki, nēneladoḷ pañcaratnamanikki, garbhamalamanapavaṟamēlikki,
ninna makkaḷantennamaganuṁ cirañjīviyayukkendu, kulaparvata jananiyappa

bhūmiyaṁ prārthisuvudarjisuvudarjisi, bhūtaḷadoḷ pālkrarada kiru
gombugaḷanikki yava(da)a mēle, bāḷantige mantrapūrvakamuṁ,
sukhōṣṇamumappa jaḷaṅgaḷaṁ mīyaleṟeduḻiḍu, samyagdr̥ṣṭi, āsannabhavye,
viśvēśvari, ūrjitapuṇye, jinamātāya svāhā, endu svapnamantramu
nōdi, jinajananiyentu putra kalyāṇōtsavaṅgaḷaṁ kaṇḍaḷante, matpa
tniyuṁ kāṇboḷakkendīpavidhiyaṁ māḍi, mūṟaneya divasadiruḷ,
anantajñānadarśiyāgendu parasi, tārakite nabhamuṁmumuṁmagaṅge tōrpuduṁ,
puṇyāhaṁ bājisi, yathāśaktiyuṁ dānaṅgeydu bhayaghōṣaṇeyuṁ, jāta
karmavidhiyuṁ māḷpuḻpudu; īgaḷupimidandvi jyōtpujōtsamaranuppiṣṭhisal takku
dendu pūrvācāryara mataṁ; nāmakarmavidhiyoḷaṁ siddhārcanapū
rvakaṁ munnēṭiḻdi saptamantraṅgaḷviḷverasu, mantragaḷanōpuduvude,
divyāṣṭa sahasranāma bhāgībhava, vijayanāmāṣṭa sahasra bhāgībhava,
paramanāmāṣṭasahasra bhāgībhava, endu nāmakarmamantramanōdi,
pūrvōkta kramadodōḷ vidhisahitaṁ pētampesaraniḍuvudu; upanayana
niṣkrānti bhāgībhava, munīndra niṣkrānti bhāgībhava, surēndra
niḥniṣkrānti bhāgībhava, mandarābhiṣēka niṣkrānti bhāgībhava, yuvarāja
niṣkrānti bhāgībhava, mahārājya niṣkrānti bhāgībhava, paramarājya
niṣkrānti bhāgībhava, ārhantya niṣkrānti bhāgībhava, endī mantraṁ
gaḷaṁ tadvijarinanujapaṅgeyisiysi; pūrvōkta vidhiyaṁ māḷpuḻpudu; bahi
ryānamantraḥmantraṁ, divyasiṁhāsana bhāgībhava, vijaya(pīṭha)siṁhāsana
bhāgībhava, paramasiṁhāsana bhāgībhava, embudu niṣadyāmantra; divyā
mr̥ta bhāgībhava, vijayāmr̥ta bhāgībhava, lakṣaṇākṣmāmr̥ta bhāgībhava,
embudu annaprāśana mantraḥmantraṁ, upanayana mantra; varṣavardhamāna
(janmanta vardhana varṣana) bhāgībhava, vaivāhaniṣṭha vardhamāna bhāgībhava,
sumunīndrajanma varṣavardhamāna bhāgībhava, surēndrajanma varṣavardha
māna bhāgībhava, mandarābhiṣēka varṣavardhamāna bhāgībhava, yuvarājya
varṣavardhamāna bhāgībhava, mahārājya varṣavardhamāna bhāgībhava,
paramarājya varṣavardhamāna bhāgībhava, arhantyarājya varṣavardhamāna
bhāgībhava, embudu vr̥ṣṭi (r̥ṣṭiṣṭa) kriyāmantraḥ.
upanayana muṇḍa bhāgībhava, nirgrantha muṇḍa bhāgībhava, paramu
ni(vi)stāraka kēśa bhāgībhava, paramēndra kēśa bhāgībhava, paramarājya

kēśa bhāgībhava, arhantyarājya kēśa bhāgībhava, embudu caulakriyā
mantraḥmantraṁ śabda parama bhāgībhava, artha parama bhāgībhava, śabdārthasaṁ
bandha parama bhāgībhava, embudu lipi saṅkhyāna saṅgrahaṇa kriyā
mantraḥmantraṁ, parama nistāraka liṅga bhāgībhava, paramar̥ṣi liṅga bhāgībhava,
paramēndra liṅga bhāgībhava, paramarājya liṅga bhāgībhava, paramā
rhantya liṅga bhāgībhava, paramanirvāṇa liṅga bhāgībhava, embudupanī
ta(ti) kriyāmantraḥmantraṁ; ī mantraṅgaḷaṁ, kr̥tasaṁskāranāda śiṣyanaṁ,
dhavaḷavastra paridhānanuṁ, kaupīnadharanuṁ māḍi mēkhalatrayāḷaṅkr̥ta
mappa muñji(mauñji) bandhanaṅgeydu, gaṇadharasūtradiṁ pavitraṁmāḍi,
bravrata cihnaṅgaḷaṁ niyōjisi, mantrapūtanaṁ, yajñōpavītāḷaṅkr̥tanu
mādātanaṁ, munnaṁ jātimātra brāhmaṇanīgaḷ, saṁskāradiṁ, dvija
nādanendu, gurusākṣiyoḷabuḷaṁvratārōhaṇaṅgeydu, guṇaśīlānvitanaṁ
māḍi, baliyamatibā(ba)ḷa vidyādiniyōgaṅgaḷa pēḷduḻdupāsakādhya
yana hacaraṇōjitanuṁ, kr̥ta saṁskāranumādātanaṁ, siddhārcanāpūrva
kamācārya pūjegeyisi, taddinadoḷ, bhikṣārthadiṁ bandu, gr̥hadoḷ
pokku, paḍedudellamanupādhyāyaṅge kuḍuvuduḷida vidhiyellamaṁ
munna pēḻdandadoḷācarisuvudu; ennegamadhīta vidyanakkumannegaṁ
brahmacaryavratadoḷ negaḻvudupanīta kriyāvidhi; bravratacaryāryeya
(ryiryeyo)doḷ kaṭi liṅgamuṁ, mūṟuliṅgamuṁ, murōliṅga
muṁ, śirōliṅgamuṁ, embī nālkuṁ mumpēḻduḻdavu; asimasi kr̥ṣyā
digaḷoḷ negaḻva sapraṣṭiyavr̥ttiyappappa dvijaṅgēnānumondu kāraṇadiṁ, kula
dūṣaṇavādoḍe. rājādigaḷa sannidhiyo(dhānado)ḷ, kuḷamaṁ śōdhi
sidoḍupanayanakkarhanāgi, putrapautrādi santatiyavarellaṁ, dīkṣā
yōgyarappar; dīkṣāyōgyamallada kuladoḷ puṭṭida, vidyākilpōpa
jīvigaḷādavar upanītyādi saṁskārayōgyarallaravargurjicita liṅgamēka
śākaṭaka dhāritvamuṁ, saṁnyāsa(na) maraṇaṁ baramakkuṁ, brakkuṁvrataśuddhi
yoḷ naḍeva dvijaṅge, nirāmiṣa bhōjanamuṁ, kulastrīsēvanamuṁ,
anārambhamuṁ, vadhōtsargamuṁ, abhakṣakṣyavēya varjanamuṁ, māgalpī
ḻdātaṅge, daśādhikāramupāsakādhyayanadoḷpēḻdaḻvadavāvuvendaḍe.
atibāḷavidyeyuṁ, kalāpadhiyuṁ, varṇōttamatvamuṁ, pātra
tvamuṁ, śiṣyā (sr̥ṣṭyā) dhikāratvamuṁ vyavahārēśitvamuṁ, avadhya

tvamuṁ avandyatvamuṁ, adaṇḍatvamuṁ, anārhatvamuṁ, prajāsaṁ
bandhatvamumuṁmendu daśavidhamumakkumavaroḷati bāḷavidyeyembudu
bālakāladoḷetaguḷdu vidyābhyāsaṅgeyvudalladandu, hēyōpādēya
manaṟiyade, mivithyāśrutaṅgaḷampordi, peṟattarnnanaṁ bhaṭārisi paḍagu
mudaṟiṁ, bāḷatvadoḷupāsakādhyayanamamunōdi, labdhi saṁskāranā
dātaṁ, tannunnamuṁ peṟarumuṁ koṇḍu, nistarisugaṁ; kuḷāvadhiyeṁ
budu, kulācāramaṁmuṁ darśanakkaviruddhamāge kādunegalbulvudu, adalladalla
dandu naṣṭakriyanāgi mattondu kulakkesalgguṁlguṁ; varṇōttamatveṁtvameṁ
budu, varṇaṅgaḷgeḷellamuttamanāgi tannunnamuṁ peṟarumanuddharisuguvu
lladandu, nikr̥ṣṭanāgi, tannunnamuṁ, peṟarumuṁ, viśuddhanāgisalāṟina
daṟiṁ, viśuddhiyuṁ bayasuvātaṁ kuliṅgigaḷaṁ, kubrāhmaṇaranupa
sēvegeydunyvundavara dōṣaṅgaḷ tanagakkuṁ. pātratvamembudu, guṇagaura
vadindānārhanuṁ, lōkapūjitanumakkumadaṟiṁ, guṇakr̥ta
mappaduṁ, pātrateyuṁ dr̥ḍhapālbudalladandumamupamānamumamuṁmuna
rthahāniyumayumpurasugaḷa deseyinakkuṁ; (dr̥)sr̥ṣṭyadhikāramembudu,
sadr̥ddr̥ṣṭikr̥tamappa (dr̥)sr̥ṣṭiyuṁ parihari(pratipādi)suvudanādi kṣatri
yara māḍi dharmasr̥ṣṭiyuṁ prabhāvisuvudalladandu, sr̥ṣṭivādadiṁ
kudr̥ṣṭigaḷ lōkamumaṁmuṁ, nr̥parkaḷumaṁḷuṁmuṁ. mōhisuvantumāḍi,
durmārgadoḷnaḍeyipparavarumavaranāśrayisirdarha dharmamaṁmuṁ kiḍi
suvar vyavahārēśitvamembudu prāyaścitta kriyegaḷoḷ, prāya
ścitta granthamuṁ kēḷdu, tannamuṁ, peṟarumuṁ, śuddhācāra mārga
goḷguṁḷu( (pāḍugu)malladandu, tānaśu(ci)ddhanāgi, peṟariṁ paribhūta
nakkuṁ; avadhyatvamembudu, dhārmikanasthāspātaṁ guṇaviśēṣadindaṁ, sthirā
tmanappa dvijōttamaṁ vadhyarhanallanantumellā prāṇigaḷuṁ mavadhyaṅgaḷ;
ī viśēṣadindaṁ brāhmaṇanavadhyanentendoḍe, dharmadoḷātanutkr̥ṣṭanā
ginegaṟbvanaṟvodaṟinavadhyanadu dharmada mahātmyaṁ; dharmamillada pāpa
karmanaṁ kaṇḍavargellaṁ kolva bageyukkuṁ, dhārmikarappavaranabhibhavi
sidandu, dharmada mahātmyaṁ kiḍugumamudaṟinādi kṣatriyu (patiyu)
paripāḷitadharmaṁ, sarvaprakāradoḷaṁ kāvudu, dharmakkādhārarappa
dhārmikaraṁ kādandu dharmamanemunēkādaṁ;
div.head: ślōka॥
div.p:
smayēnayōnyānatkēti dharmasthāṅgarvi tāṁśayaḥ
syōsōtkēti dharmamātmītrīyaṁ nadharmō’dhārmikairjirvinā
adaṇḍyatvamembudu, dharmadoḷ, sthiranappa dvijanadaṇḍyaṁ,
daṇḍyādaṇḍyavicāradoḷ dhārmikanesavarthanadaṟinarasaṁ, dhārmika
roḷaṇaḷōjisi, śāstrānugatavappa daṇḍamaṁ dōṣigaḷge māḍpudu;
dēvagurudravyamentu parihāryamante, brahmasvamuṁ parihāryapu
daṟiṁ dhārmikadvijanadaṇḍyaṁ, daṇḍyādhikāradoḷ pēḻdante, yukta
daṇḍanallada nr̥paṅgībhavamuṁ, maṟubhavamuṁ, keḍuguṁ, ārhatvameṁ
budu, guṇādhikaranappātaṁ vandyanuṁ, pūjyanumpaṅgi, mānya padavi
yoḷ nilpudu, guṇādhikanallavandapamānitanāgi, sthānalābhādigaḷaṁ
keḍugumuvaṟiṁ, jñāna cāritrādigaḷoḷ prayatnaparanāgi, guṇaṅgaḷaṁ
tanage māḍpudu; prajāsambandhāntaramembudu, prajāntara sambandha
(dhāntara)doḷ, tannunnatiyuṁ keḍalīyadirpanuṁ, karbonnoḷ
berasida ponnentu vivarṇamakkumante varṇāntaradoḷ sambandhamāge,
tannaguṇōtkarṣakke viplavamakkuṁ, (sthairamakku)membudi(mayi)llī
kendoḍe, tannoḷ sambandhamāda, prajāntaramuṁ, siddharasaṁ muṭṭida
lōhadante, tannaguṇamaṁ, taḍeyadeydisugumadaṟinī mahāguṇaṁ
dharma prabhāvōdyōtakamīguṇadindaṁ, peṟataṁ tanage māḻke(ḍalke)
yōgya makkumīguṇamilladandu, peṟarindaṁ guṇaprītiyāge, dvijaṁ
kr̥ṣṇanakkumintupāsakādhyayanadoḷ, kriyāmantra prasaṅgadiṁ, vrata
caryākriyāvidhānadoḷati bāḷavidyādi daśādhikāraṅgaḷ pēḻvuvu,
munne pēḻdellaṁ kriyā mantraṅgaḷ pirikādigaḷ sāmānya mantra
gaḷellā kriyegaḷoḷ (yōgadoḷaṁ) sādhāraṇaṅgaḷ baṟike peḻdavu,
viśēṣamantragaḷantīpēḻda mantragaḷellamanellākriyegaḷoḷaṁ, āva
sōrvayuktācāranāgi, niyōjisuvonātaṁ dvijōttamaṁ, kriyā
mantravihīnanappātaṁ dvijanallaṁ;

endintu ghanaratha tīrthakar mēgharathaṅge garbhadīkṣānvayu
kartānvayu kriyegaḷaṁ pēḷduṟdu, ninagī janmadoḷādānaṁ modalāgi,
yōga nirvāṇasādhanambaramanmuntu(kku)mūvatteraḍu kriyega(ḷo)
ḷakkuṁ; indrōpātaṁ modalāgi indratyāgambaramaydu kriyega
ḷoḷaṁ dēvalōkadoḷeydu, avatāraṁ modalāgagra nivr̥ttivaraṁ padi
nāṟuṁlkuṁ kriyegaḷaṁ mūṟaneya janmadoḷ, jambūdvīpada bharata kṣētra
doḷ āydaneya cakravartiyuṁ, padināṟaneya tīrthakaranumappande
yayduyduve. dīkṣānvaya kriyeyoḷavatāraṁ modalāgi, jinarūpatā

paryantamappa pattombhattu kriyegaḷoḷaṁ nīnamita tējanāda janma
bhavadoḷ vijaya kēvaḷigaḷa pakkade, samyaktvamaṁ kaikoṇḍandeydida
yendu taguḻdaḷda dānādi kriyegaḷaṁ, yathāsambhavameyduttuṁ
bandī kartrārtānvaya kriyegaḷoḷ sajjāti modalāge nirvāṇāntamappē
ṭuḻaṟumaṁ, dīkṣānvayadoḷ pēḻdiḻdavaroḷuḷaḷidippattombhattu kriyega
ḷumaninneyduveyendu besasi, mēgharathaṁ trividha nirvēgaparaṁ
saṁyamābhimukhanāgi, dr̥ḍharathaṅge rājyamaṁ koṭṭoḍātanolladire,
tannamagaṁ mēghasēnaṅge rājyamaṁ koṭṭu, dr̥ḍharathanumeṇbāṇbhāsirvarara
sugaḷveḷgerasu, ghanaratha tīrthakara pakkade tapambaṭṭēkādaśāṅgadhāriyāgi,
tīrthakara mahāpuṇyamabandhakāraṇaṅgaḷappa, darśanaviśuddhi, vinaya
sampannatā, śīlavratāśakanaticārōbhikṣṇa, jñānōpayōga, saṁvēgō
śaktitaḥtyāgatapasi sādhu samādhi vaivayyāpratyakaraṇamarhadācārya
bahuśrutaṁ,pravacana bhaktirāvaśyakaparihāṇi, mārgaprabhāvanā, pravacana
vatsaḷatvamemba ṣōḍaśa bhāvanegaḷoḷ, modala darśanaviśuddhiyeṁ
budu, niśśaṅkita, niṣkāṅkṣita, nirvicikitsā, amūḍhadr̥ṣṭitā, upabr̥ṁ
haṇa, sthitikaraṇa, vātsalya, prabhāvanā, embeṇṭaroḷarhadupadiṣṭamappa
mārgamanidakkumāgademba, saṁśayamaṁ pattuviḍuvuduniśśaṅke, iha
lōka paralōka viṣayōpabhōgakāṅkṣeyumaṁ, paraśrutikāṅkṣe
yumaṁ pattuviḍuvudu niṣkāṅkṣe, śarīrādigaḷanaśuciyendaṟidavaṁ
śuciyemba mithyāsaṅkalpamaṁ pattu viḍuvudumarhatpravacanamida
yuktaṁ, ghōrakaṣṭamidaṁ pordalāgademba pe(pa)sugeyaṁ pattuviḍu
vuduṁ, pravya bhāva bhēda nirvicikitse; kuhētu dr̥ṣṭāntaṅgaḷendurṇa
yaṅgaḷ tattvābhāsaṅgaḷāgirdaḍaṁ vimōhisadippudu amūḍhadr̥ṣṭitvaṁ,
uttamakṣamādi daśabhāvaneyiṁ, tanagaṁ peṟargaṁ dharmamaṁ percisu
vudu upabhr̥ṁhaṇe, dharma paribhraṁsakāraṇamappa kaṣāyōdayaṅga
ḷoḷaṁ dharmadoḷkiḍalīyade kāvudu sthitikaraṇaṁ; jinapraṇītamappa
dharmāmr̥taṅgaḷoḷ mithyānurāgamaṁ pattuviḍisuvudu vātsalyaṁ;
samyagdarśana jñānacaritra ratnatraya prabhāvadindātma prakāśaṅgeyvudu
prabhāvane; intu niśśaṅkādyaṣṭāṅga saṅgatamappudu darśanaviśuddhi.

vinaya sampannateyembudu mōkṣasādhanamappa samyagdarśana jñāna
cāritraṅgaḷoḷumavarkādhāramappaguruprabhr̥tigaḷoḷ yathāyōgya

saṁskāraṅgeyvudadu vinaya sampannate; śīlavratānaticāramembudu
cāritravikalpamappa hiṁsādi vrataṅgaḷoḷaṁ, tatparipāḷanamappa krōdhā
diparivarjana śīlaṅgaḷoḷaṁ, manōvacana kāyaṅgaḷoḷaṁ, niravadya
mappa negaḻte śīla vratānaticāraṁ; jñānōpayōgamembudu, jīvā
dipadārtha tattvatvaviṣayamuṁ, pratyakṣaparōkṣa lakṣaṇamumajñāna nivr̥tti
karaṇamuṁ, hitaprāptiyinahita prāptiparihāradinanubhayāpēkṣeyinavya
vahita phaḷadāyiyumappamatyādi vikalpajñānamuṁ, satata sēvege
yvudu jñānōpayōgaṁ; saṁvēgamembudu, śārīra mānasāgantuka
bahu vikalpamuṁ, iṣṭaviyōgāniṣṭa saṁyōgajamumuḷamaḷābhājanamu
mappa saṁskāra duḥkhaṅgaḷanati kaṣṭamendañjuvudu saṁvēgaṁ, tyāga
membudu, koṭṭadevasadoḷ prītiyaṁ māṟpāhāramaṁ pātrakke
kuḍuvudu, āhāradānamumēkabhavavyasanāpahāriyappabhayadānamu
manēkabhava śatasahasra duḥkhōttaraṇa pariṇatamappa samyajñāna dānamu
memba trividhamumaṁmuṁ yathāvidhiyaṁ kuḍuvudutyāgaṁ; tapamembudu
mārgavirōdhamāgade, tannaśaktiyaṁ maṟaṟeyisade, kāyaklēśānuṣṭhā
naṅgeyvudutapaṁ; samādhiyembudu, bhaṇḍāgāra samutthitāgniya
nentuppaśparivudiṁ, nandipuvarante bahūpakāriyuṁ, śīlavratadhāriyu
mappa, munigaṇada tapakkēnāsumondu vighnamādoḍe, bēgamadaṁ
praśasamisuvudu samādhiyembudu; vayyāvr̥tyamembudu, guṇavanta
rappa sādhujanakke duḥkhōpa nipātamāge, niravadya vidhiyinadampaharisu
vudu vayyāvr̥tyaṁ; ārhadādi bhaktiyembudu, kēvaḷajñāna dhararappā
rhadbhaṭṭārakaroḷ śrutajñānadharakappācāryaroḷaṁ, parahita karaṇaprabhr̥
taruṁ, nija parasamayamumaṁ vistaradindaṁdiṁvaṁ niścayisalballarappa bahu
śrutaroḷaṁ, śrutadēvatā sannidhīkaraṇa pariṇatamumapavargārōhaṇa
janakke niśrēṇi bhūtamappāgamadoḷaṁ, manōvākkāya triśuddhiyina
ppanurāgamarhadācārya bahuśruta pravacanabhakti, āvaśyakāparihāṇi
yembudu, sāmāyika, caturviṁśati stavana, vandana, pratikramaṇa
pratyākhyānaṁ, kāyōtsargamemba ṣaḍāvaśyakaṅgaḷoḷḷiḷalli, sāmāyika
membudu sarvasāvadyayōganivr̥tti lakṣaṇamumēkāgramappa cittamaṁ
jñānadoḷirisuvudu; caturviṁśati stavanamembudu, tīrthakaravuruṇya
guṇānu kīrtanaṁ vandaneyembudu.

emba lakṣaṇamanuḷḷadu; pratikramaṇamembudu, pūrvakr̥tadōṣa nivr̥tti
lakṣaṇaṁ; pratyākhyānamembudāgāmidōṣa pratīkāraṁ; kāyōtsarga
membudu, parimita kāladoḷ śarīradoḷappa mamatvamaṁ pattuviḍu
vudīpēṟdaṟuvāvaśyakakriyeṅgaḷoḷanutsukatvadiṁ, yathākāla prava
rtanamāvaśyakāparihāṇi; mārga prabhāvaneyembudu, jñāna, tapa,
jinapūjeyemba trividhadoḷ, jñānamemba ravikiraṇadiṁ parasamaya
khadyōtādyōtamanaḍaṅgisuvudu, mahōpavāsādi lakṣaṇamuṁ,
dēvēndraviṣṭara prakampaka(na)samartha muppa tapadiṁ, tannasamu
yamaṁ koṇḍāḍuvuduṁ, mahādāna mahāpūjādigaḷaṁ, dharmaprakā
śanaṅgeyvudu mārgaprabhāvane; pravacana vatsaḷatvamembudeḷagandi(yā
kaḷu)yantāgaḷpuṭṭida tanna karuviṅgati snēhiteyakkumante, cāturva
rṇakkaṁ kr̥takamilladati snēhaṅgeyvudu vatsaḷatvaṁ, emba ṣōḍaśa
bhāvanegaḷ niraticāramādanduvyastamuṁ, samastamumāgi, tīrthakara
puṇyabandakāraṇamappudaṁ bhāvisi, mēgharathamuni, tīrthakara puṇyamaṁ
kaṭṭi vihārisuttuṁ, saṅkhyātāsaṅkhyātānanta vikalpamappa darśana
jñāna cāritra tapadoḷ niraticāraṁ negaḻuṟuttuṁ bandu, śrīpuramanāḷva
vasu (śrī) ṣēṇamahārājanuṁ, dattapuramanāḷva nandana mahārājanuṁ,
puṇḍarīkiṇiyanāḷva siṁhasēna mahārājanuṁ, yathākramadiṁ vidhi
pūrvakaṁ nirise, nindu, pañcāścaryaṁ negaḻte, viviṟdavividhadhardhiprāptarāgi,
mēgharathamuni dr̥ḍharathamuniverasu, nabhastiḷaka parvatakke ondondu
tiṅgaḷāhāra parityāgaṅgeydu, prāyōpagamanadiṁ muḍipi, sarvārtha
siddhiyoḷahamindrarāgi puṭṭi, mūvattamūṟu sāgarōpama māmāyuṣya
manoḍeyaruṁ, dhavalavarṇaruṁ, śuklalēśyā pariṇāmaruṁ, lōka
nāḷikā bhyantaragata samastavastu paricchēdana samarthadēśāvadhijñājñanaru
māgi munnajitapurāṇadoḷ pēḷdaṟda, śātaśubhapañcaka samudbhava sukha
mananubhavisuttirpinaṁ.

ittaṁ, jambūdvīpada bharatakṣētrada, kurujāṅgaṇa viṣayada,
hastina puramanāḷva, kāśyapagōtradajitasēnamahārājana priyadarśanā

mahādēvi, bāḷacandra prabhr̥ti śubhasvapnaṅgaḷaṁ kāṇe, brahmakalpada
dēvaṁ bandu, viśvasēnanemba maganāgi puṭṭidaṁ. itta, gāndhārapurama
nāḷva jitañjaya mahārājaṅgaṁ, ajiśātādēvigaṁ, sanatkumāra kalpada
dēvaṁ bandu, airādēviyemba magaḷāgi puṭṭidoḍairādēviyaṁ viśva
sēnaṁ maduve niltu, sukhamirpinaṁ. bhādrapada māsada bahuḷa sapta
miya beḷagappa jāvadoḷ bharaṇīnakṣatradoḷ ṣōḍaśa śubhasvapnadarśa
nānantaramairādēvi, tanna vadanāravindamaṁ gajēndraṁ puguvudumaṁ
kaṇḍu, maṅgalapāṭhakadhvanigaḷiṁ gatanidreyāgi, maṅgaḷābhiṣēka
pūrvakaṁ, puṇyaprasādanāḷaṅkr̥te, viśvasēnanallige vandardhāsanaikadēśa
manalaṅkarisi, tanna kaṇḍakanasugaḷellamaṁ, avadhijñāniyappa tannarasaniṁ
daṟidu sukhamirpinaṁ. vasudhārāgarbhasaṁśōdhanaṁ svargāvataraṇa
kalyāṇapūrvakamairādēviya garbhakke mēgharathacajarāhapamindranavatarisi
paripūrṇaprasava samayadoḷ, dharmabhaṭṭāraka tīrthasantānaṁ paḷi
tōpamaṁ nālkubhāgaṁ māḍidalli, mūṟu bhāgaṁ gundiva mūṟu
sāgarōpamada kaḍeyoḷ paḷitōpamada nālkaneya bhāgadoḷ dharmaṁ
keṭṭire, taśkātkālada jējyēṣṭha bahuḷa caturdaśiya beḷagappa jāvadoḷ,
yāmyayōgadoḷ trijñānadharaṁ puṭṭiṭṭe, caturnikāyāmarar sahitaṁ,
saudharmēndraṁ bandu, munnamādi vēdēvarge māḍidandadantadoḷ, janmā
bhiṣēka kalyāṇamaṁ māḍi, jagakkellamivarpuṭṭe śāntiyādupudaṟiṁ,
śāntinātharendu pesaraniṭṭu, jinagurugaḷaṁ pūjisi, tadanantaramānanda
nr̥tya(nāṭaka)manāḍi, kumāraṅgaḷaṅkārādi bhōgōpabhōgaṅgaḷaṁ
māḍimendu, lōkapāḷaranappayisi, dēvēndraṁ pōdaṁ.

ittaṁ, dr̥ḍharatha ahamindraṁ bandu, viśvasēnamahārājaṅgaṁ,
yaśasvatidēvigaṁ, cakrāyudhanemboṁ maganādonāge, śāntikumāra
nondulakke varṣaṁ paramāyuṣyamanoḍeyanuṁ, kanakavarṇanuṁ,
nālvattu bilnidiḍiyanuṁ, dhvajatōraṇātapatramandara sūryadhāma
siṁha śaṅkha cakrādi lakṣaṇōpalakṣitanumāgi baḷedippattaisāsira varṣaṁ
kumārakālaṁ sale, mattamippattaisāsira varṣaṁ maṇḍaḷika rājyaṁ
pōge, cakravartisādhanabhōgamappa cakrātapatrāsidaṇḍaṁ(ratnaṁ)gaṇāḷā
yudha gr̥hadoḷ, carma(chatra) kākiṇiṇī, cūḍāmaṇigaḷ śrīḷtrīgr̥hadoḷ,
sthapati, (gr̥ha phari), sēnāpati purōhita ratnaṅgaḷ hastinapuradoḷ,

hastyaśva kanyāratnaṅgaḷvijayārdhadoḷ navanidhigaḷ nidhi mukhadoḷ
puṭṭidoḍintivellamaṁmuṁ, dēvartandu kuḍe, sakaḷa cakravarti rājyakāla
mippattaisāsira varṣaṁ sale, mattondu divasaṁ, masaṁmujjanambokkaḷaṅkāra
gr̥hadoḷ, kaigeydu kannaḍiyaṁ nōḷpalli, nijapratibimbameraḍāgi
tōrpudupudaṁ kaṇḍu, vismayaṁ baṭṭu, matijñāna(venīkṣa) kṣayōpa
śamaprakarṣasamutpannabōdhaṁ, pūrva bhava santatiyuṁ nenedu, nirvē
gaparaṁ lōkāntikadēvar bandu, palyōpamada caturthabhāgaṁ,vicchinna
māgirda dharmamaṁ, dēva; nīṁ niṟisuvudendu pratibōdhise, nārā
yaṇanemba nijatanūjaṅge rājyamaṁ koṭṭu, bandhugaḷaṁ visarjisi, pari
niṣkramaṇa kalyāṇābhiṣēkapūrvakaṁ, sarvārthasiddhiyemba sipigeyu
nēṟi, sahasrāmravanakke pōgi, maṇijeśilātaḷadoḷuttarābhimukhanāgi
palyaṅkāsanamoḷirdu, jēṣṭhabahuḷa caturdaśiyaparāhṇadoḷ, bharaṇī
nakṣatradoḷ, ṣaṣṭhōpavāsadiṁ tanna tammaṁ cakrāyudhanuṁ, sāsirvara
rasumakkaḷverasu, bāhyābhyantara parigrahamuṁ toṟedu, siddhavinayuya
pūrvakaṁ pañcamuṣṭiyiṁ kēśōtpāṭanaṁ geydu, tapamaṁ kaiko
ḷvaduḷdumaḷikuḷanīḷakuntaḷaṅgaḷaṁ saudharmēndraṁ ratnapaṭalakado
ḷoydu, pañcamāmbudhiyoḷikki, śāntināthaṅge sāmāyika śuddhi
saṁyamadhāraṇānantaraṁ, manaḥ paryaya jñānamogeye, bhikṣārthadiṁ
mandarapuramanāḷva, sumitranembarasana maneyoḷniḷsale, pañcāścaryaṁ
negaḻdu, padināṟuvarṣaṁ chadmasthakālaṁ sale, tammaniṣkramaṇada sahasrā
mravanadoḷ, nandyāvartadrumadaḍiyoḷ, pakṣōpavāsadiṁ pūrvābhi
mukharāgi, palyaṅkāsanamoḷire, puṣyaśuddhada daśamiyaparāhṇadoḷ, adhaḥ
pravr̥tti pūrvanivr̥tti karaṇaṅgaḷaṁ, kṣapaka śrēṇiyanēṟi, dvitīya
śukla dhyānadiṁ, ghātigaḷaṁ kiḍisi, kēvala jñānōtpattiyūge, dēvani
kāya sahitaṁ saudharmēndraṁ tatkalyāṇa pūjeyaṁ māḍe, śānti,
arha, siddha, sarvajña, svayambhu, brahma, viṣṇu, hiraṇyagarbha, pitā
mahaṁ, ajaṁ, mahēśvara, śiva, bhava, tryambaka, sthāṇu, rudra, ruja
hara, tripurahara, jina, kāmaśatru, anāhāraṁ sarvagatanendivu moda
lāgi, sāsiradeṇṭanvarthanāmaṅgaḷaṁ tāḷdi, cakrāyudharverasu, mūva
ttaṟuvargaṇadhararuṁ,eṇṭu nūrvarpūrvadhararuṁ, nālvattaiṣṭātteṇsāsiradeṇṭu
nūrvar śikṣakaruṁ, mūṟu sāsirvaravadhi jñānigaḷuṁ, nālsāsirvarvvar

rkēvaḷigaḷuṁ, ā sāsirvarvikriyardhi prāptaruṁ, nālsāsirvarmanaḥ
paryaya jñānigaḷuṁ, irbārbbāsirada nānūrvarvādigaḷuṁ, hariṣēṇā
ryikeyarmoyumodalāge aṟuvattu sāsirada mūnūrvarajjiyaruṁ, sura
kīrti modalāge nālkulakke śrāvakaruṁ, arhaddāsiyarmoyumodalāgi
nālkulakke śrāvakiyaruṁ, asaṅkhyāta dēvaruṁ dēviyaruṁ, saṅkhyāta
tiryagjātigaḷuṁ, berasu, śāntinātharmunnepēḻdannēṟda arhantya kriye
yaneydi sakaḷapraguṇaṅgaḷinalaṅkr̥tarāda paramēśvarar padināṟu
varṣadiṅgundidippattaisāsira varṣaṁ vihārisi, sammēdagiriparvata
moḷondu tiṅgaḷu viharaṇa vidhiyiṁ māṇdu, jēṣṭhabahuḷa caturdaśiya
pūrvarātradoḷ, bharaṇī nakṣatradoḷombaisāsirvarmunigaḷverasu,
pratimāyōgadoḷ śāntināthar mōkṣalakṣmiyaneydidar. saudha
rmēndranuṁ parinirvāṇa kalyāṇamaṁ munnādi purāṇadoḷ pēḻdaṁ
dave māḍi, tadanantaraṁ ānandanr̥tyamanāḍi pōdaṁ. śrīṣēṇanuṁ,
āryanuṁ, śrīprabhanuṁ, amita tējanuṁ, ādityacūḷanuṁ, aparā
jitanuṁ, acyutēndranuṁ, vajrāyudhanuṁ, ahamindranuṁ, mēgha
rathanuṁ, sarvārthasiddhīśvaranuṁ embivu śāntināthara bhavāvaḷigaḷuṁ.
aninditeyuṁ, āryeyuṁ, vimaḷaprabhanuṁ, śrī vijayanuṁ, maṇi
cūḷanuṁ, anantavīryanuṁ, sārakanuṁ, mēghaninādanuṁ, acyuta
pratīndranuṁ, sahasrāyudhanuṁ, ahamindranuṁ, dr̥thaḍharathanuṁ,
sarvārthasiddhīśvaranumembivu cakrāyudha gaṇadharara bhavāvaḷigaḷuṁ.
div.trailer:
idu sakaḷaśāstrasaṁyama sampanna śrīmadajitasēna bhaṭṭāraka caraṇa
kamala cañcarīkaṁ, dharmavijaya śrīmaccāvuṇḍarāja viracita triṣaṣṭi
lakṣaṇa mahāpurāṇadoḷ śāntināthapurāṇaṁ.

div.head: kunthunāthapurāṇaṁ
hadinēḷaneya tīrthaṅkara
śrī kunthunātha purāṇaṁ
kunthunātha purāṇaṁ
div.p:
jambūdvīpada, pūrvavidēhada, sītānadiya, teṅkaṇa taḍiya,
vatsa viṣayada susīmā nagaramanāḷvaḷda, siṁharathanembarasanondudivasasaṁ
muḷkāpāta darśanadiṁ, trividha nirvēgaparaṁ, yati vr̥ṣabhamuni samīpa
doḷ, dharmamaṁ kēḷdu, tanna magaṅge, rājyamaṁ koṭṭu, palabaru
marasugaḷveḷdarasu, dīkṣeyaṁ koṇḍēkādaśāṅgadharaṁ, ṣōḍaśa bhāvane
gaḷiṁḷaṁ, tīrthaṅkara nāma gōtra mahāpuṇyamaṁ kaṭṭi, nijāyuravasāna
doḷārādhanā vidhiyaṁ muḍipi, sarvārthasiddhiyoḷahamindranāgi
mūvattamūṟusāgarōpamāyuṣyamanoḍeyanuṁ, enuṁēkaratni pramā
ṇōtsēdhanuṁ, dravyabhāvadiṁ śuklalēśyanuṁ, sapravicāra(nunna)nanta
guṇa, niḥpracārasukhanuṁ, lōkanāḷikābhyantaragatāvadhijñānanuṁ, tanna
vadhige polanappa kṣētrapramāṇabaḷaprakāśa vikriyā(śakti)guṇasampannanu
māgi sukhamirpinaṁ.

ittaṁ, jambūdvīpada, bharatakṣētrada, kurujāṅgaṇa viṣayada,
hastināpuramanāḷvaḷda, kuruvaṁśada, kāśyapa gōtrada, sūśūrasēna mahā
rājana śrīkāntā mahādēvi, śrāvaṇabahuḷa daśamiya beḷagappa jāva
doḷ, kr̥ttikā nakṣatramāge, ṣōḍaśa śubhasvapna darśanānantaraṁ, nija
mukha kamalamaṁ gajaṁ puguvudaṁ kaṇḍavadhi jñāniyappa, tannarasaniṁ
tatphalamanaṟidu, sukhamirpinaṁ. munne pēḻda hamindraṁ, svargāva
taraṇa kalyāṇa pūjā pūrvakaṁ, ā dēviyu garbhakkavatarise, navamāsaṁ
neṟeye, śāntibhaṭṭārakara tīrthasantānamardhapalyōpamaṁ pravartisu

vandākāladoḷ, vaiśākhaśuddha pāḍivadoḷāgnēya yōgadoḷ,
trijñānadharaṁ puṭṭi, saudharmēndraṁ janmābhiṣēka mahākalyāṇa
pūjeyuṁ munnādibrahmaṅge pēḷdinḻdandadadoḷemāḍi, kunthu prabhr̥ti sattvatva
rāsigaḷge dayāpararapparendu kunthunātharembanvartha nāmamaniṭṭu
pōdaṁ.
