ittaṁ, jinakumāraṁ, kanakavarṇanuṁ, mūvattaidu bilniḍi
yanuṁ, śomnuntombhattaisāsiravarṣa paramāyuṣyanumāgi baḷedaisāsira
dēḷnūrippattamūṟuvarṣaṁ kumārakālaṁ sale, maṇḍaḷika padaviyoḷ
nitukālaṁ nindu, vaiśākhaśuddha pāḍivadandu, cakrādi caturdaśa ratnaṁ
gaḷ puṭṭi, cakravarti padaviyoḷ nile, daśāṅgabhōgamananubhavisutti
rdondu divasaṁ, caturaṅgabalasahitaṁ, kusumita vanādi ramaṇīya
pradēśaṅgaḷaṁ nōḍuttaṁ pōjittampoḻalge maguḻdu baruttamātapayōgado
ḷirdarordorvamuniyaraṁ kaṇḍu, tannamantrige nōḍi, r̥ṣiyarivarendu
boṭṭuśōḻ praṟipraṇāmapūrvakaṁ, mukuḷitakarakamaḷanāgi, mantri
yendanintappa, mardha(stra)ra tapadoḷgeyabiḷnegali. phaḷamēnene, vaparahasita
vadananāgi, kumāranendanīḥni vidhada tapadoḷgeḷnegalddīlibdaībhavabhavadoḷ karma
kṣayamakkumāgadandu, surapati, cakravartigōcaramappabhyudaya
sukhamananubhavipisi, sarvasaṅga parityāgaṅgeydu, jinapadaviyumaṁ,
siddhapadavipiyumaṁ paḍevar. ī tapakke parāṅmukharādavar saṁsārigaḷeḷa
yāgirparendu, nijabhavōpayōgadiṁ, labdhabōdhanaytomyvatombhaisāsira
deṇṭunūranālkuvarṣaṁ, sāmrājyakālaṁ sale, lōkāntika dēvar
pratibōdhise, tannamagaṅge rājyamaṁ koṭṭu, niṣkramaṇa kalyāṇābhi
ṣēka pūrvakaṁ, vijayeyemba śivigeyanēṟi, sahētuka vanadoḷ
tapōpavāsadiṁ, vaiśākhaśuddha pāḍivadaparāhṇadoḷ, kr̥ttikā nakṣatra
māge, sāsirvararasugaḷverasu dīkṣeyaṁ kaikoṇḍu, caturjñānadhara
normerve, pāraṇeya divasadoḷ, hastinapuramaṁ(kke) jacarigevōge,
dharmamitranembarasaṁ nīṟise, niltu pañcāścaryamāge, padinālkuṟu
varṣaṁ chadmasthakālaṁ pōge, svadīkṣāvanadoḷ, tiḷakada marada moda
loḷ, tapōpavāsadiṁ, caitraśuddha tadigeyaparāhṇadoḷ, kr̥ttikā
nakṣatramāge, kēvalajñānōtpattiyoḷ saudharmakr̥ta kalyāṇa pūjeyu
neydi, kunthu prabhr̥ti sāsiradeṇṭanvartha nāmaṅgaḷaṁ, tāḷdi, svayaṁ

(pra)bhugaḷaṁ modalāge mūvattaiyvargaṇadhararuṁ, eḷnūrvarpūrva
dhararuṁ, nālvattamūṟusāsiradanūṟayvadimbar śikṣakaruṁ, mūsā
siradainūrvaravadhijñānigaḷuṁ, (mūsāsiradaynūrvarkkai91) anibaruṁ
kēvaḷigaḷuṁ, aisāsiradanūrvar vikriyayurdhiprāptaruṁ, mūsāsirada
mūnūrvar manaḥparyaya jñānigaḷuṁ, irppasirarcchāsidayvadimbarvādi
gaḷuṁ, bhāvitiyarmoyurvodalāge aṟuvattsātttusāsirva(radamunnūraivattarjirci)
rajjiyaruṁ, eraḍulakke śrāvakaruṁ, mūṟulakke śrāvakiyaruṁ, asaṁ
khyātadēvaruṁ, dēviyaruṁ, saṅkhyāta tirygjāryugjātigaḷumberasu, saddha
rmōpadēśaṁ geyyuyvuttamippattamūṟusāsiradēḻnūaṟumūvattanālku
varṣaṁ vihārisuttonttavondu tiṅgaḷ viharaṇa vidhiyanuḷidu, sammēda
giriyoḷ, sāsirvarmuniyayurverasu, pratimāyōgadhāriyāgi,
vaiśākha śuddha pāḍivada pūrvarātradoḷ kr̥ttikānakṣatramāge, kunthu
bhaṭṭārakar muktige sandar. saudharmēndranuṁ parinirvāṇa kalyāṇa
pūjeyoḷānanda nr̥tyamanāḍi pōdaṁ.

idu sakaḷaśāstra saṁyuma sampanna śrīmadajitasēna bhaṭṭāraka
caraṇakamala cañcarikaṁ, dharmavijayi śrīmaccāvuṇḍarāja viracita
div.trailer: triṣaṣṭi lakṣaṇa mahāpurāṇadoḷ kunthubhaṭṭāraka purāṇaṁ.

div.head: aranāthapurāṇaṁ
hadineṇṭaneyu tīrthaṅkara
śrī āranātha purāṇaṁ
aranātha purāṇaṁ
div.p:
jambūdvīpada, pūrvavidēhada, sītānadiya baḍagaṇataḍiyu, kaccha
viṣayuda kṣēmapuramanāḷva dhanapatiyembarasanarhanandana tīrthaṅkara
samīpadoḷ, dharmamaṅkēḷdu, sambhūtiyembamagaṅge, rājyavaṁ
koṭṭu, palabarumarasugaḷverasu, saṁyamamaṁsaṁyumuṁ kaikoṇḍu, ēkādaśāṁ
gadhāri bhāvitadyadvyaṣṭa (dvyaṣṭa ghōḍaśa) kāraṇaṁ (idiṁ), tīrthaṅkaranāmamu
mahāpuṇyamaṁ kaṭṭi, samyagārādhanāvidhiyiṁyiṁa nuttareyu jayanta vimāna
doḷahamindranāgi, trayayutriṁśatsāgarōpa māyuṣyamu mōkaratni
pramāṇa śarīrōtsēdhanuṁ, dravyabhāva pariṇata paramaśukalēśyanume
nisi, sukhamananubhavisuttippinaṁrnaṁ,

ittaṁ, jambūdvīpada, bharatakṣētrada, kurujāṅgaṇa viṣayuda,
hastināpuramanāḷva, kuruvaṁśada, kāśyapagōtrada, sudarśana mahā
rājanarasi mitrasēna mahādēvi, phālguṇaśuddha tadigeya beḷagappajāva
doḷ, rēvatī nakṣatramāge, ṣōḍaśa śubhasvapnaṅgaḷaṅkaṇḍu, avadhi
jñāniyuppa nijādhīśaniṁ tatphalamanaṟidu, sukhamirpinaṁ. munnādi
dēvarge pēṭṭi teḻdaterarade svargāvataraṇa pūjāpūrvaka mahamindra dēvanā
dēviyu garbhakkavatarise, kunthunāthara tīrthasantānaṁ sahasrakōṭi
varṣaṅgundida palyōpamada caturthabhāgaṁ pravartisuvandākāladoḷ,
mārgaśiraśuddha caturdaśiyu puṣyayōgadoḷ trijñānadharaṁ puṭṭe,
saudharmēndraṁ bandu, janmābhiṣēka kalyāṇānantaramādēvara janmadina

dodōḷ, cakrākrrara samāvānanidhi darśana mādudaṟindarabhaṭṭārakarendu
pesaraniṭṭu pōdaṁ.

ittaṁttraṁ, jinakumāraṁ caturāśīti sahasravarṣa paramāyuṣyanuṁ,
triṁśaccāpaśarīrōtsēdhanuṁ, kanakavarṇanumenisi baḷedu, ippatto
ccāsiravarṣaṁ kumārakālaṁsale, mattattramanitekālaṁ maṇḍaḷika padavi
yoḷnindu, mattattramanitukālaṁsale, cakravartipadaviyoḷnindondu
divasaṁ, śaratkāla mēghavināśa darśanadinutpannabōdhaṁ lōkāntika
dēvarprurprati bōdhise, rājyabhāramanaravindakumāraṅge koṭṭu, pariniṣkra
maṇa kalyāṇābhiṣēka pūrvakaṁ, vaijayantamemba śivigeyoḷ, ṣaṣṭhō
pavāsadiṁ, sahētukavanakke pōgi, mārgaśiraśuddha daśamiyaparāhṇa
doḷ, rēvatī nakṣatramāge, sāsirvararasugaḷverasu, saṁyamamaṁ
kaikoṇḍu, caturjñānadharaṁ, pāraṇādinadoḷ, cakrapuramanāḷva
kanakavarṇanappa aparājita nr̥panaramaneyoḷ niltulttu, pañcāścaryaṁne
gaṟi, padināṟuvarṣaṁ, chadmasthakālaṁsale, dīkṣegoṇḍā sahētukavana
doḷāmbra vr̥kṣadaḍiyoḷnile, ṣaṣṭhōpavāsadiṁ, kārtikaśuddha bārasi
yaparāhṇadoḷ, rēvatī nakṣatradoḷ kēvala jñānōtpattiyāge,
dhanadanirmitasamavasaraṇadoḷsaudharmakr̥ta tatkalyāṇananvarthasahasrāṣṭa
nāmadharanāgi, kumbhāryamomōdalāge mūvattu gaṇadhararuṁ, aṟu
nūṟipadimbarpūrvadhararuṁ, mūvattraittaisāsiradeṇṭunūṟa mūvattritti
varśikṣakṣvaruṁ, iccāsiradeṇṭu nūrvaravadhi jñānigaḷuṁ, anibare kēva
ḷiḷagaḷuṁ, nālcāsirada mūnūrvarvirvikriyadhirdhiprāptaruṁ, iccāsirada
yvattayvarmanaḥ praryayajñānigaḷuṁ, sāsiradaṟunūrvarvādi
gaḷuṁ, rakṣidāryiryekeya momōdalāgi aṟuvattu sāsirvarajjiyaruṁ,
ondulakke śrāvakaruṁ, mūṟulakke śrāvakiyaruṁ, asaṅkhyāta
dēvaruṁ, dēviyaruṁ, saṅkhyātatiryagjātigaḷverasu dvādaśagaṇa pari
vr̥taṁ, dharmōpadēśaṁ geyvuttuttimippattusāsiradombaynūṟaaṁ
bhattanālku varṣaṁ vihārisi, baṟiyamondu tiṅgaḷ viharaṇamanuḷidu,
sammēvada giriyoḷ, sahasramunisahitaṁ, pratimāyōgadhāri, jyaicaitrada
māvāsye, rēvatī nakṣatradoḷ, pūrvarātradoḷ, arabhaṭṭārakar
muktige sandaru. saudharmēndranuṁ parinirvāṇa kalyāṇadoḷānanda
nr̥tyamanāḍi pōdaṁ.

div.head: sahasrabāhunṛpakathā
div.trailer:
idu sakalaśāstra saṁyamu sampanna śrīmadajitasēna bhaṭṭāraka
caraṇakamaḷa cañcarikaṁ, dharmavijayi śrīmaccāvuṇḍarājaviracita triṣaṣṭi
lakṣaṇa mahāpurāṇadoḷ arabhaṭṭāraka purāṇaṁ.
div.head: “sahasrabāhu nr̥pakathā”
div.p:
śrīmaṟadarabhaṭṭārakara tīrthadoḷ subhaumanemba cakravarti tanna
pūṟimūṟaneya janmadoḷ, jambūdvīpada bharata kṣētradoḷ, bhūpāḷa
nembarasaṁ saṅgrāma raṅgadoḷ tanagāda mānabhaṅgame nirvēgakāraṇa
māge, sambhūta gurugaḷa pakkade saṁyamamaṁ kaikoṇḍu, cakravarti
śrīge, nidānaṅgeydu nānāvidha tapadoḷniḷnīgaltuldu, māsōpavāsadiṁ
mahāśukrakalpadoḷ dēvanāgi, ṣōḍaśa sāgarōpama sukhamananu
bhavisuttirpinaṁ.

annegaṁ bharatada, kauśaḷaviṣayada, sākētamanāḷvikṣvāku vaṁśada,
sahasrabāhunr̥paṅge, ujjainiyanāḷva pāratanamagaḷ citravati emboḷa
rasiyāge, kr̥tavīranembonavarge maganāgirdaṁ, itta, sahasrabāhu
vina kiṟiyaykaṁyyaṁ, śatabindugaṁ, pāratanarapatiya taṅgeyappa śrīma
tigaṁ, ja(ya)madagnirāpanemboṁ maganādoṁ. ātaṁ kumāra kāla
doḷ, nija jananiviyōga nirvēgadoḷ tāpasanāgi, pañcāgni tapa
doḷniḷnīgaṟuluttirpinaṁ; itta, dr̥ḍhagrāhiyembarasaṅgaṁ, hariva(śa)rma
nemba pārvaṅgaṁ, akhaṇḍita mitratvamāginaḍeye, dr̥ḍhagrāhi nirgrantha
tapamoḷ negaldu saudharma kalpadoḷ dēvanādoṁ. harivarmanuṁ
tāpasatapadoḷ negaldu, jyōtirlōkadoḷ, dēvanāge dhr̥dr̥ḍhagrāhi
dēvaṁ mithyādr̥ṣṭiyappa jyōtirlōkada dēvanaṁ, samyaktvamaṁ
kaikoḷisaluṁ, tāpasa tapada pollameyumaṁ tōṟalendu, bandātaṁ
birasu,gījagavakkiya mithunamāgi,tapaṅgeyyuttirda,jamadagnirāmana,
niḍiyagaḍḍadoḷgūḍiṭṭaṭṭirdondu divasaṁ, gaṇḍuvakki peṇbakkiyanendu
dāsondeḍege pōgibandappe, nīnillirpudene, peṇbakki ninna pōgaṁ
niścaykayve, nīnenage sūruḷtuḷvu pōgene, pañcamahāpātakadoḷagāvudaṁ
sūruḷtoḍe nambuveyendoḍantēnumanolleṁ; nīṁ pōgi taḍado
ḷīdīgoravanī tapadoḷ pōpagatige pōpeyendoḍadondu sūruḷuṁ
poragāgi peṟadaṁ sūruḷvanene, kēḷdaḷdā tāpasaṁ, muḷidā tāmra viphūbhū

rṇamāna lōcananeraḍu pakkiyumaṁ, bhōṅkenepiḍidu posedu bisu
ḍal bagedu, nīmenna tapamanentu meccadirillellise, pakkigaḷendavelitā
pasa, kōpakkesalladiru, kiṟideheppinaḷeyoḷentu pirivappa pālukiḍugu
mante, kiṟidānuṁ krōdhadiṁ ninnatapamellaṁ kiḍuguṁ; nīnappaḍe
kumāra brahmacāriye, putra mukhaṅgāṇade tapaṁ baṭṭudaṟiṁ, ninage
sugatiyillendu, tatvābhāsamaṁ nuḍida pakkigaḷa nuḍiyaṁ kaikoṇḍā
hārādi sayijñege vaśyamādōratapaṁ kiḍugumembudanaṟiyade, pakki
gaḷambiṭṭu, tanna ujjinigevandu, tanna sōdaramāvanappa, pāratanara
patige kanyārthadiṁ banda tanna vr̥ttāntamanaṟipidoḍātanesenna nūrvar
magaḷdoḷagārvorōrvar nimma sōḍambaḍuvavaraṁ kaikoḷvudene,
tanna tāpasavēṣamaṁ kaṇḍu, jēsi, kanyeyarārumolladirdoḍanibaraṁ
kiriya rēṇukeyemba bāḷakiyaṁ, makkaḷoḍanāḍutirdaḷaṁ kaṇḍu,
kadaḷī phalamantōṟi, nīnollālvāyendoḍavanāke kaṇḍollisene, tanna
pūvina sejjejjiyoḷākūsaṁ ikkikoṇḍu pōgi peṇḍatimāḍidaṁ.

andinditta, dharmapatniverasu tapaṅgeyyuttirdāydudā jamadagnirāmaṅgaṁ
rēṇukigaṁ indrarāmanuṁ, śvētarāmanumembarirvarmakkaḷāgirpina
mondu divasaṁ, rēṇukigaḷaṇṇaṁ ariñjayar̥ṣi nōḍalendu bare,
yathōpacāra darśanānantaraṁ, jamadagniya prēraṇeyuṁ, rēṇuki
tammaṇṇananēmnempaḷ. enna maduvesuḍavandēnumaṁ baḷuvaḷiyaṁ koṭṭa
rillendoḍandu kuḍamoḍamīgaḷ samyagdarśana dhanamaṁ ninage koḍa
lendubandeṁ, adakke trailōkyamuṁ beleyalluḷidadhanavondu bhava
doḷ ciḷajiramumapāyuya bahuḷamumāgi svalpabhōgamanīvudu, samyagda
rśanadhanaṁ svargādi vividha sukhamanittu, cijiramappanantasukhamanīvuvene,
rēṇuki piridumarthiyiṁyaṁ, samyaktvamaṁ kaikoṇḍaḍe, mecci, manō
bhilaṣita vastupradāna samarthamappa kāmadhēnu vidyeyumanadaṅkāya
lendu, mantrapūtamappa parasamaṁ koṭṭu pōdaritta, mattondu
divasaṁ, kr̥tavīraṁ biramberasu sahasrabāhu jamadagniya tapōvanakke bare,
tamma nammakāraṇamāge, nīmemma maneyoḷuṇḍu pōdapudendu,
kāmadhēnubaḷadiṁ balamellamaṁ tatkṣaṇadoḷūḍisuvumudanaṟidu,
kr̥tavīraṁ, tammakiṟiyabbe rēṇukiyanempanabbā, kāmadhēnuvanema
gīyalvēḷku mendoḷkamemboḍidappoḍemma hō(kā)madhēnu tāpasayōgya

mallade, varṇāśramamu paripāḷakanappa ninage yōgya mallendoḍānuḍi
tanage karṇaśūlamāge, jagadoḷāvudanarghyavastuvakkumamudu narapālaṁ
gakkuṁ, kanda mūla phalāhārige, goravaṅgidēgeyvudārānumuḍḍaṁddaṁ
barpar bakkendu, ballāḷtanadiṁ kāmadhēnuvaneliṟidoyvāgaḷaḍḍaṁddaṁ
bappa jamadagniyaṁyuṁ kondu, koṇḍu poliṟilge pōdaṁ.

ittamindrarāmamunuṁ, śvētarāmamunuṁ samiddharbherbha puṣpaphaḷādi
hōma dravyaṅgaḷaṁ koṇḍubandu, pitr̥maraṇa vr̥ttāntamaṁ kēḷdu,
tāyayuduḥkhamanāṟisi, kāmadhēnumaṁmuṁ ninagārittarentubandudene,
rēṇuki tadvr̥ttāntamaṁ pēṟaṟdu kēḷdu kāmadhēnuvina mahātmyamana
aṟidirvaruṁ, paraśudhvajarāgi, "tuṟu(gō)grahaṇadoḷ sattaḍe puṇya
makku," emmemba nuḍiyuṁ prakaṭaṁmāḍi, palambaruṁ munikumārarbe
rasu, sākētapuramampuguvalli, kr̥tavīranuṁ, sahasrabāhumaṁmuṁ yuddha
doḷkondu, nēsarpaḍuvāgaḷ poliṟilaṁ pokku, sahasrabāhuvaṁśavaṁmaṁ
nirvaṁśamāṟvenenda paraśurāmanabhiprāyamanaṟidu, śyāṇḍilyanemba
tāpasaṁ, tannataṅge citramatiyuṁ garbhiṇiyuṁ mundiṭkoydu, subu
ddha(bandhu)remba r̥ṣiyarge, tadvr̥ttāntamanaṟipi, tannivāsadoḷirisi,
paraśurāmamu vr̥ttakamanārayyal pōdaṁ.

itta, citramatige munnepēḻda mahāśukrakalpada dēvaṁ maganāgi
puṭṭidaḍe, vanadēvategaḷītaṁ paṭṭaṇṭkhaṇḍa patiyuyakkumendaṟidātanaṁ kādu
koṇḍire, kelavudivasakke, subuddha(bandhu)muniyayurātanaṁ kaṇḍītaṁ,
puṇyabhājananakkumene, citramati endaḷītaṁ, puṭṭuvāgaḷ mahītaḷā
liṅganaṁ geydu puṭṭidonadaṟi nentu puṇyavantanappa(kkume)nene, padi
nāṟu varṣadandiṅgītaṁ, cakradharanakkumamudakke vinnāṇamāvudendoḍe,
prajvalita hutavahamappoleyumēge pe(saṇa)śalaṅghr̥takiḷāsa dusparśa
mappapūpaṅgaḷaṁ koṇḍu tindaṁ(ḍalli)gidusābhijñānavenmendācitramatiyuya
duḥkhamaṁ bhaṭṭārakarāṟisi, śāṇḍilyatāpasaṁ bandu, tannāśrama
kkoydu, mahītaḷāślēṣaṁ geydu puṭṭidudaṟiṁ, subhaumanemba pesara
niṭṭu, naḍasuttirpannegaṁ, indrarāmamunuṁ, śvētarāmamunuṁ, nijaguru
maraṇa vairadinippattondu sūbvabhvaraṁ kṣatriyu jātiyuraṁ kondu,
bharata vija(ṣapa)yādhipatigaḷāgirpinavonmondudivasaṁ, nimittavidanemboṁ

naimittikaṁ paintumumpēḻdaraśurāmubhaṭṭārakaratīrthasantānanendaṁ- ninakālandviśatakōṭivarṣampōge pagevanappoṁ puṭṭidanadaṟiṁ,
ninage śrēyumappantu negaṟimene, śatrusamutpattige vinnāṇamāvu
dendoḍe lōkāntara(iḷākāntara, gata)narapatigaḷa daṁṣṭraṅgaḷāvano
rvaṅgasanamāgi pariṇamisugumātane, ninage śatruvembudumaṁ parīkṣi
salendu, sarvārtithyavacanamaṁ prakāśaṁ māḍi, dīnānāthajanakke paraśu
rāmuṁ chatravuṁ māḍe, subhaumanuṁ subuddhi munipar pēṟda vinnāṇa
manāsthitiyoḷe ba(bhu)bhukṣuvāgi tōṟi,mattondu divasaṁ,tannapitr̥
maraṇa vr̥ttāntamaṁ, nija jananipēṟi parivrājakavēṣa saṁvr̥ta rūpa
mappa palaru purasu makkaḷaṁ kūḍikoṇḍu, tannamanōgatarahasyama
naṟipi, sākētanagaramaṁ puge, tannagaradēvatākrandana, mahīkampādi
mahōtpātaṅgaḷnegaṟi paraśurāmuna chatradoḷuṇalbokkalli, pātra
nikṣiptamappa narapatigaḷa daṁṣṭraṅgaḷumannamāgi tōṟi, parīkṣisalirda
paricārakaradaṁ, paraśurāmuṅgaṟipidoḍātanaṁ piḍidu tannimendaṭṭe,
pēṟirtaṟalāradire, tāne sannaddha baḷanāgi pōgi tannatantramaparimita
māgiyuṁ, subhaumana puṭṭidandu taguḷdu, bharata dēvarādhipatigaḷpari
pāḷisuvudaṟindātaṅgidiroḷ nilalneṟiyude, paraśurāmuṁ muḷidu,
gajamunēṟi naḍeye, subhaumana puṇyōdayadiṁ gandhavāraṇamuṁ,
cakraratnamuṁ munde nile, cakradiṁ paraśurāmunaṁ kondu, abhayu
ghōṣaṇeyuṁ māḍi, tānuṁ brāhmaṇa vaṁśamunippattondu sūḻvaraṁ
kondu, brahmaṇyambhō emba vacanamunendiṅgaṁ, prasiddhamāgadante
māḍi, bharataṣaṭkhaṇḍapatiyādoṁ.

intu mumpēṟda rabhaṭṭārakara tīrtha santānakālaṁ, dviśatakōṭi
varṣaṁ pōge puṭṭida subhaumanuṁ, padināṟuvarṣadindeṇṭaneyu cakra
dharanāgi, ṣaṣṭisahasravarṣaṁ paramāyuṣyanuṁ, ippatteṇṭu bilniḍi
yanuṁ, hēmavarṇanuṁ, ikṣvākuvaṁśada cūḍāmaṇiyumenisi,
daśāṅga bhōgamananubhavisuttirdondu divasaṁ, amr̥tarasāyana
nemboṁ bāṇasigaṁ, rasāyanavembamblike(bali)yaṁ prabhātadoḷ
tandoḍadara guṇamanaṟiyude āparīkṣakamenagambaliyuṁ tandanendu
daṇḍise, bāṇasiganumarasanaṁ kolvenakkendu nidānaṅgeydu, alpapuṇya
paripākadiṁ, jyōtirlōkadoḷ dēvanāgi, vibhaṅga jñānadiṁ, pūrva
bhava vairamanaṟidu, vikriyeyiṁ, vaṇigvēṣadharanāgi, pañcēndriya

div.head: nandiṣeṇapuṇḍarīkacaritaṁ
div.p:
lōlupanappa subhaumanandamanaṟisu, madhurarasa vividha phaḷaṅgaḷiṁ,
pratidinamōlagisi, niccaminte tappudendu besase, paradasendanāṁ tarala
śaktaneṁ, nimagarthiyappoḍennoḍane bandu, sulabhamappa phalaṅgaḷaṁ timbu
dene, vipraḷamba vacanamanaṟiyade, puṇyakṣayadoḷ purōhitanuṁ
bārivudagēḷade, kapaṭa vaiśyanoḍane, bahitramanēṟi, samudradoḷpōge
yakṣa rakṣitamappa caturvardaśa ratnaṅgaḷuṁ pattuviḍe, mūrāntaramuydu,
pūrvajanmasvarūpamaṁ tōṟi, vairasambandhamanaṟipi, bahuvidha
nigrahaṅgeydoydaḍati krōdhadinārta raudradhyānadiṁ sattu, subhaumaṁ
narakakke pōdaṁ. lōbhadindaṁ sahasrabāhuvuṁ, kr̥tavīranuṁ tirika
gatige sandar. jamadagnisutar hiṁsāparatantrarāgi narakagāmigaḷā
dar. mattamara bhaṭṭārakara tīrthadoḷ nandiṣēṇa, puṇḍarīkaremba
rāṟaneya rāmakēśavara caritaṁ.
div.head: nandiṣēṇa, puṇḍarīkaremba rāma kēśavara caritaṁ
div.p:
mattamarabhaṭṭārakara tīrthadoḷ nandiṣēṇa puṇḍarīkarembarāṟa
neyuya rāmakēśavara caritaṁ.

jambūdvīpada. bharatada, kākandi nagaramanāḷdaṁ, samastaguṇa
sampannaṁ, mahābhōgi mitravarmanembarasanātaṅgayvoynūrvararasiyu
cūḍāmaṇiyembaḷ mahādēviyāge, vigatarājya citrattanākeyoḷ, surata
sukhānubhava tatparanāgi, kelavukālaṁ sale, mattondu divasaṁ, pratyaṁ
tavāsi sukētuvemboṁ, rāṣṭravibhramaṁ māḍi kiḍisuvuduṁ. ā prastāva
doḷ cūḍāmaṇi mahādēvi sarpadaṁṣṭreyāgi, viṣavēgadiṁ kaṇṭhagata
prāṇeyāgirdoḷaṁ, nijāṅga sthaḷadoḷiṭṭu lajjegeṭṭu, krandana virasana
paridēvana śōkṣōbhanādigaḷaṁ, karuṇārasamogeye, puykaliṭṭu, malmralmala
maṟugi, maṟuḷgoṇḍirdondu divasaṁ, śivaguptācāryara pakkadā
pēkṣaṇe, vikṣēpaṇe saṁvēga, nirvēgayuktamappa dharmamaṁ kēḷdu,
svasthanāgi tapamaṁ kaikoṇḍu, tapaṣṭaścaraṇa phaḷamuḷḷoḍe, anyajanmadoḷ
mahāparākramanāgi, sukētu prabhr̥tigaḷanabhibhavisuvenakkendu, carama
kāladoḷ nidānaṁ geydaṁ.

itta, jambūdvīpadaparavidēhada, suvarśananembarasaṁ, mitra
varmaṅge pēḻdanṭdandadoḷe, duḥkhitanāgirdu, sumitrārhatpādamūla

doḷ dharmamaṁ kēḷdu, tapamaṁ kaikoṇḍu, mitramuniyuṁ,
sudarśana muniyuṁ, saudharma kalpadoḷpuṭṭi bandu, subhaumana kaḍe
yoḷ, aṟunūṟu kōṭivarṣaṁ pōge, jambūdvīpada, bharatakṣētrada,
cakrapuramanāḷvikṣvāku vaṁśada, varasēna mahārājaṅgaṁ, ātanarasi
yuyappa, vaijayantigaṁ, lakṣmīmatigaṁ, nandiṣēṇanuṁ, puṇḍarīkanu
vemba tanayarāgi, pañcaṣaṣṭiṣṭhi sahasravarṣaṁ paramāyuṣyaruṁ, paḍviṁdviṁśati
cāpōtsēdaruṁ, sitāsita varṇarumenisi baḷedu, sukhamirpinaṁ.
mumpēḷdaḻda, sukētuve tārakanumemba prativāsudēvanāgi, bharata
trikhaṇḍamanāḷutirdaṁ. indrapuramanāḷvupēndrasēnaṁ, tanna magaḷ
padmāvatiyuṁ puṇḍarīkaṅge koṭṭudaṁ kēḷdu, muni(ḷi)du bandu,
tārakanaṁ, saṅgrāmadoḷātana cakradindaṁ kondu, rājyaṅgeyyutti
rpurduduṁ, kēśavanālka(ṟa6)neyu narakakke pōdaṁ; haḷadharanuṁ śivaghōṣa
yatigaḷa pakkade saṁyasaṁyumamaṁmuṁ kaikoṇḍu kramadiṁ muktige sandoṁ.

div.head: mallināthapurāṇaṁ
hato್tambhattaneya tīrthaṅkara
śrī mallinātha purāṇaṁ
mallinātha purāṇaṁ
div.p:
jambūdvīpada, pūrvavidēhada, kacchakāvatīviṣayada, vītaśōka
puramanāḷvaḷda, vaiśravaṇanembarasanondu divasaṁ, jaḷadhara kāladoḷ
ramaṇīya pradēśaṅgaḷaṁ nōḍalendu pōgi baruttuṁ, pergāḷiya
kōḷoḷ (poylḷ)yloḷ) keḍadirda vaṭavr̥kṣamaṅkaṇḍu; nirvēgadiṁ
magaṅge rājyamaṁ koṭṭu, śrīnāgagiriyoḷ, śrīnāgayatigaḷapakkade,
dharmamaṁ kēḷdu, saṁyamamaṁ kaikoṇḍu, samyaktva pūrvakaṁ
palarumberasu, tapamaṁ kaikoṇḍēkādaśāṅgadharaṁraraṁ, ṣōḍaśa bhāvane
gaḷaṁ, tīrthakara puṇyanārādhanāvidhiyuṁ, kālāntaradoḷanuttaregaḷo
ḷaparājita vimānadoḷahamindranāgi, trayatriṁśatsāgarōpamāyu-
ṣyanumēkaratni pramāṇōtsēdanumenisi sukhamirpinaṁnaṁittajambūdvīpadabharatakṣētradavaṅga(maṅgala)viṣayadamithiḷāpuramanāḷdakvākuvaṁśadakāśyapagōtradakumbhamahārājanarasiprabhāvatimahādēvicaitraśuddhapāḍivadabeḷagappajāvadoḷāśvinīnakṣatradoḷṣōḍaśaśubhasvapnānantaraṁnijavadanamaṅgajampuguvudaṅkaṇḍavadhijñāniyappanijapatiyintatphalamanaṟidusukhamirpinaṁmumpēḻdahamindraṁsvargāvataraṇapūjāpūrvakamādēviyagarbhakkavatarisimunnamarabhaṭṭārakaratīrthasantānakālaṁsahasrakōṭivarṣapramāṇapravartisuvandākāladalumārgaśiraśuddhēkādatiyoḷaśvinīnakṣatradoḷtrijñānadharampuṭṭisaudhamēndrañjanmābhi.

itta, jambūdvīpada, bharata kṣētrada vaṅga(maṅgala)viṣayada,
mithiḷāpuramanāḷvakṣvākuvaṁśada, kāśyapagōtrada, kumbhamahārājanarasi
prabhāvati mahādēvi, caitraśuddha pāḍivada beḷagappa jāvadoḷ, aśvinī
nakṣatradoḷ, ṣōḍaśa śubha svapnānantaraṁ, nijavadanamaṁ gajaṁ pugu-
vudaṁ kaṇḍavadhi jñāniyappa nijapatiyuṁ, tatphalamanaṟidu, sukhami-
rpinaṁ. mumpēḷdahamindraṁ, svargāvataraṇa pūjāpūrvaka mādēviya
garbhakkavatarisi, munnamarabhaṭṭārakara tīrthasantānakālaṁ, sahasra
kōṭi varṣa pramāṇa pravartisuvandākāladalu, mārgaśira śuddhēkāda-
śiyoḷaśvinī nakṣatradoḷ, trijñānadharaṁ puṭṭi, saudharmēndraṁ janmābhi-

ṣēka kalyāṇamaṁmuṁ māḍi, kaṣāyēndriyayu parīṣahādigaḷaṁ geldudaṟiṁ,
mallinātharendu pesaraniṭṭu pōdaṁ.

itta, pañca pañcāśatsahasra varṣaṁ paramāyuṣyanumippattaydu
bilniḍiyunuṁ, kanakavarṇanumāgi baḷedu, nūṟu varṣaṁ kumāra
kālaṁsale, nijavivāhasamayamuyudoḷ, maḷmiḷirvapatākegaḷiṁ, negalva śaṅkha
paṭahadhvanigaḷinesevanagara śōbheyuṁ kaṇḍu, tannapuṭṭibandaparājita,
vimānamaṁmuṁ nenedu, nijabhavōpayōgalabdha nirvēgaṁ, lōkāntika
dēvaprarpratibōdhise, kumārakāladoḷ, pariniṣkramaṇa kalyāṇābhiṣēka
pūrvakaṁ, jayantiyemba śivigeyoḷ, śvētavanakke pōgi, ṣaṣṭhōpa-
vāsadiṁ mārgaśira śuddhēkādaśiyaparāhṇadoḷ mūnūrvararasugaḷvaḷve-
rasu, saṁyamamaṁ kaikoṇḍu, caturjñānadharaṁ, pāraṇādinadoḷ,
mithiḷāpurada, kanakavarṇanappa nandiṣēṇa narapatiyayu maneyoḷnindu,
pañcāścaryamaṁryaṁ negaṟiḻdu, chadmasthakālaṁ mūrudivasaṁ pōge, mumpēḷdaḻda,
dīkṣāvanadoḷaśōkavr̥kṣadaḍiyoḷ, ṣaṣṭhōpavāsadiṁ mārgaśira śuddha
ēkādaśiyayu parāhṇadoḷaśvininakṣatradoḷ (pauṣyakr̥ṣṇa bidigeyu pūrvā-
hṇadoḷ, punarvasu nakṣatradoḷ), kēvala jñānōtpattiyāge, saudha
rmēndrakr̥ta tatkalyāṇananvartha sahasrāṣṭanāmamudharaṁ, viśākhārya
rmodalāgippattembatteṇbargaṇadhararuṁ ainūṟayvadimbapūrvadhararuṁ, ippa
ttombhaynāysāsirvarśikṣakaruṁ, iccāsiradinnūrvaravadhijñānigaḷuṁ, ani
bare kēvaḷigaḷuṁ, iccārccāsiradayinnūrvarvikriyardhi prāptaruṁ sāsira
dēṟinūṟayvadimbarmarmunaḥparyyaya jñānigaḷuṁ, sāsirada nānūrva
rvādigaḷuṁ, bandhuṣēṇāryakerykeyurmodalāgaivattaiynāsiyā್sirvara-
rjirjjiyaruṁ, ondulakke śrāvakaruṁ, mūṟulakke śrāvakiyaruṁ,
asaṅkhyāta dēvaruṁ, dēviyaruṁ, saṅkhyātatiryyagjātigaḷuṁ berasa
yvatta nālkālchāsiradeṇṭunūṟa tombhattomto್tambhabhattuvarṣamuṁ pannondu
tiṅgaḷumippattanālku divasaṁ vihārisibandu, sammēdagiriyoḷondu
tiṅgaḷ viharaṇa vidhiyuṁyaṁ māṇdu, aisāsirvarmunigaḷverasu, prati
māyōgadharaṁ, phālguṇa śuddha pañcamiyayu pūrvarātradoḷ, bharaṇī
nakṣatradoḷ, mallinātharmuktige sandar. saudharmēndranuṁ parinirvāṇa
mahākalyāṇamaṁmuṁ munnādi dēvarge māḍidante māḍi pōdaṁ.

div.head: padmacakravartikathā
div.trailer:
idu sakaḷa śāstrasañcayama sampanna śrīmadajitasēna bhaṭṭāraka
caraṇakamala cañcarikaṁ, dharmavijayi śrīmaccāvuṇḍarāja viracita,
triṣaṣṭi lakṣaṇa mahāpurāṇadoḷ mallinātha purāṇaṁ.
div.head: padma cakravartiya kathe
div.p:
śrī mallinātha tīrthasantānadoḷ, padmanemboṁ cakravarti,
tr̥tītiya janmadoḷ, jambūdvīpada, pūrvavidēhadoḷ, sukaccha viṣa
yada, śrī puramanāḷvaṁḷdaṁ, prajāpāḷanembarasaṁ ulkāḷkāpāta darśana
nirvēgadiṁ, tannamagaṅge rājyamaṁ koṭṭu, śivaguptajinara pakkade,
saṁyamamaṁ kaikoṇḍutkr̥ṣṭa dvādaśavidha tapadoḷ negaḻdu, kālāntara-
doḷacyutēndranāgi, sukhamananubhavisi bandu.

jambūdvīpada, bharatakṣētrada, kāśīviṣayada, vāraṇāsī purama
nāḷviḷdaikṣvāku vaṁśada, kāśyapagōtrada, padmanābhaṅgaṁ, padmāvatī(rāmā)
dēvigaṁ, padmanemba maganāgi, triṁśadvarṣa sahasra paramāyuṣyanuṁ,
ippatteraḍu bilniḻiḍiyanuṁ, kanakavarṇanumāgi, kramadiṁ, cakrampuṭṭi,
daśāṅgabhōgamananubhavisi, pr̥thvīsundariyarmoyurmōdalāgeṇbajjaru magaḷda-
rumaṁ, sukētu vidyādharana makkaḷge koṭṭu, sukhamirdondu
divasaṁ, jaladharaviḷaya darśanalabdha bōdhaṁ, sarvasaṅga parityāgaṅgeyva
nendirpuduṁ.

itta, sukētu nr̥panuṁ dīkṣābhimukhanādoḍorvaṁ, śūnyavādi
kuḷavr̥ddhanendaṁ nīnuṁ kelavu divasaṁ bhōgaṅgaḷananubhavisuvudīga
ḍede(ḷe) rājyamaṁ pattuviḍalāgadendu, lōkāyatamatānusāri
kuhētu dr̥ṣṭāntaṅgaḷaṁ tōṟ, saṟisamuttaradinātaśanaṁ tiḷipi, bandhugaḷaṁ
visarjisi magaṅge rājyamaṁ koṭṭu, samādhigupta kēvaḷigaḷa pakkade
(sūsāre), padma cakravartiyoḍane saṁyamamaṁ kaikoṇḍu, padmanuṁ
kēvaḷiyāgi muktige sandar.
div.head:
mallināthatīrthasantānadoḷ ēḻaneya baladēva vāsudēvarāda
nandimitra hāgū dattara kathe
div.p:
mattamā santānatīrthadoḷēḻaneya rāmakēśavar, tr̥tīya
janmadoḷ, sākēta puradoḷ, rājaputrarāgi tammayyaṁ tanage kuḍade,

div.head: nandimitradattacaritaṁ
div.p:
tanna tammaṅge yuvarāja paṭṭaṅgaṭṭidoḍellamaṁ mantri māḍidanendu,
mantriyoḷ baddhavairanāgi, dharmajina tīrtha santānadoḷ, śivagupta
yatigaḷapakkade dīkṣeyaṁyuṁ kaikoṇḍu jīvitāntyadoḷ, saudharmakalpada
suviśāla vimānadoḷ dēvanāgi puṭṭibandu, kāśīviṣayada, vāraṇāsī
puramanāḷvaṁ, ikṣvākuvaṁśadagniśikhanarapatigaṁ, aparājiteyu, kēśavati
yumembarasiyargarbhaṁrgaṁ, nandimitranuṁ, dattanumemba makkaḷāgirdu,
dvātriṁśadvarṣa sahasra paramāyuṣyarumippatteraḍu bilniḍiyaruṁ,
kundēndīvara varṇarumāgirpinaṁ, mumpēḻda mantri, saṁsāra pari
bhramaṇadoḷ, duḥkhamananubhavisi bandu, vijayārdha parvatada mandara
puradoḷ, balīndranemba vidyādhara rājanāgi, rāmakēśavarallige, kṣīrō
damemba gandhakariyanaṭṭugendaṭṭidoḍe, tanna magaḷanemagittoḍaṭṭuve
menvendu sarasaṁnuḍidaṭṭi, muḻiḷidu, kādalendu bare, kēśavatigaḷaṇṇaṁ,
dakṣiṇa śrēṇiya, surakāntānagaramanāḷvoṁ, kēsari vikramanemboṁ,
sammēda giriyoḷ, siṁhavāhiniyuṁ, garuḍavāhiniyumemba vidyādhidi
gaḷaṁ sādhisi, tannaḷiyarge koṭṭu, tānumaparimita baḷanāgi pōgi,
rāmakēśavaroḷkūḍi, balīndranokkāḷkādi, māyāyūyuddha, dvandva
yuddhaṅgaḷoḷ, balīndra sutanappa śatabaliyaṁyuṁ baladēvanaṁ bhaṅgabaḍise,
balīndraṁ muḷidu, cakradoḷiḍe, kēśavanā cakradindātanaṁ kondabhaya
ghōṣaṇeyaṁ māḍi, bharata trikhaṇḍamanāḷdu, kēśavanavadhisthānakke
sandōnātana viyōgadoḷ baladēvaṁ sambhūta kēvaligaḷa pakkade
dīkṣeyaṅgoṇḍaṇagāra kēvaliyāgi muktige sandaṁ.

div.head: munisuvratanāthapurāṇaṁ

ippattaneya tīrthaṅkara
śrī munisuvratanātha purāṇaṁ
munisuvratanātha purāṇaṁ
div.p:
jambūdvīpada, bharatakṣētrada, aṅgaviṣayada campāpuramanāḷdaḷva,
harivarmanembarasanondu divasamamugrōdyānavanadoḷanantavīryaremba
aigāra kēvaḷigaḷa samavasaraṇaṁ bandirpurdudendu vanapālakanappa yatir̥ci
nivēdakaṁ binnapaṁ geydoḍarasanēṟidiyuṁyaṁ naḍedattamogade kaimugidu,
ānandabhēriyaṁ poysiyusi, vividhārcanāsahitaṁ vandanā bhaktige pōgi,
mānastambha caturvana kanakaprākārāḷaṅkr̥tamappa samavasaraṇa maṇḍaḷa
maṁ nōḍuttuṁ, kēvaḷigaḷaṁ mūṟusūḻ balavandu, bandisi,
jīvabhēda karmabhēdamaṁ kēḷdu, harivarmaṁ saṁsārasthitiyaṁ besago
ḷdumanantavīrya kēvaḷigaḷ sarvabhāṣāsvabhāvamappa divyadhvaniyo
ḷantendu besasidar.
anādi saṁsāradoḷ toḷaluttirda jīvaṅgaḷge, dravyapariva
rtanamuṁ, kṣētra parivartanamuṁ, kāla parivartanamuṁ, bhava pariva
rtanamuṁ, bhāva parivartanamuṁ, endaydu terada saṁsāramakkumalli
dravya parivartanamatītakāladoḷellā jīvaṅgaḷuṁ koṇḍu bisuṭa pudga
laṅgaḷ, sarvajīvarāśiyanoḍeyananantaguṇaṁ, sarvajīvarāśiya
prathamavargamunoḍeyanananta vargasthānaṁ pōdalli, pudgalarāśi
(embudu) puṭṭuguṁ sarvajīvarāsiyinda mumbisuṭa pudgalaṁ
sarvapudgalarāśiyanoḍeyananantaguṇahīnamādoḍamandu jīvanuṇḍu
bisuṭa pudgalaṅgaḷ sarva pudgalarāsiyendudu vastradēkōddēśaṁ
bendoḍā vastraṁ bendudembante, ondu jīvaṅgappa dravyaparivartanaṁ,

nokarma pudgala parivartanavendu, karma pudgala parivartanavenditte
anakkupalli nokarma pudgala parivartanavembudu, jīvanoḷpudgaḷakke,
gamanāgamanaṁ prativirahamilladoḍaṁ, buddhiyiṁ pudgala rāsiyellamaṁ
bērkeydondu pudgala parivartanamaṁ modalmāḍi sarva pudgala rāśi
yoḷ paramāṇumanondumanappoḍaṁ, koṇḍudillendu parikalpaṅge
yā pudgala rāśigagr̥hītamendu pesaraniṭṭu, vivakṣita pudgala parivartana
prathama samayadoḷamagr̥hītamane koḷguṁ eraḍaneya samayadoḷama
gr̥hītamane koḷguṁ intutkr̥ṣṭa dinanantasamayambaramagr̥hītamane
koḷguṁ (janita magr̥hītamanekoḷguṁ) jaghanyadinderaḍusamayadoḷa
magr̥hītamane koḷguṁ; adentendoḍe—
prathama samayadoḷpaḷpuṭṭi, dvitīyayu samamuyadoḷ nirjarisi,
(ā) karmabhāvakke sanda(du)vaṁ, tr̥tīyayu samamuyadoḷe, karma
paryāyakke sandavaṁ(du) kaṭṭuguṁ; nokarmakkā bādhe illaduda
yādi niṣaka(ṣaṭka)ṣṭakkamappudaṟindaṁ, ī nokarma pudgala parivartana
kālamamugr̥hita grahaṇandeyendu miśragrahaṇandeyendu, gr̥hīta graha
ṇandeyendu trividhamukkumalli vivakṣita pudgala parivartana prathama
samamuyadoḷ toṭṭu, anantakālambaramamugahidagahaṇandēyumamukkuṁ;
baṟiya mattommettavorme miṁsagahaṇandēyukkuṁ; mattameraḍaneya sūci
nantakālamamugahitagahaṇandēyu salākegaḷananantamukkumiṁ; miṁsagaha
ṇandēyumukkumintīprakāradoḷ miṁsagahaṇandegamusantamāge kaḍe
yoḷagahidagahaṇandeyiṁ, baṟiyumovorme, gahida gahaṇandēyukkuṁ.
ī (kramu) cakradoḷanantakālaṁ, pokkumannegaṁ gahida gahaṇandēyuya
śa(sa) lākegaḷanantamukkumannegaṁ, intu (prathamu) pr̥thu parivartanaṁ
pōgeyunantakālaṁmiṁ, sahagahaṇande pōgeyormeyugahida gahaṇā
deyukkuṁ; (intu) mattamavunantakālaṁ, miṁsagahaṇandiyormeyuga
hida gahaṇandeyukkuṁ; intī prakāradoḷagahida gahaṇandegaḷamavunantaṁ
pōge, kaḍeyumiṁsagahaṇande pōgeyo(imbaṟiya mo)rmeyugahida
gahaṇandeyukkuṁ; mattamavunanta kālamiṁsagahaṇande pōgeyormeyayu
gahida gahaṇandeyukkuṁ; intī prakāradoḷagahida gahaṇandegaḷanantaṁ
pōge kaḍeyumiṁsahagahaṇandeyuṁ baṟiyunorme gahidagahaṇande
yayukkumintu dvitīyayu parivartanamāvāge, mattamavunantakālaṁ miṁ sahaga

haṇande pōgeyorme gahada gahaṇandeyukkuṁ; mattamavunanta kāla
miṁ sahagahaṇadiṁ pōgeyorme gahaṇandeyukkuṁ; intī prakāra
doḷ, gahida gahaṇandegaḷaḷumanantaṁ pōge, kaḍeyu miṁ sahagaṇandeyu
baṟiyumovormeyugahida gahaṇandeyukkuṁ, ī kramudoḷanantakālaṁ
gahidagahaṇande pōge, orme gahada gahaṇandēyukkuṁ, intī prakāra
doḷegahida gahaṇandegaḷaḷumanantaṁ pōge kaḍeyayu gahida gahaṇande, imba
ṟiyumovormeyu gahida gahaṇandēyukkuṁ; ī kramudoḷanantakālaṁ
pōkumannegaṁ, agahida gahaṇandeyu śalākegaḷanantamāge, vivakṣita
pudgala parivartanada prathamamunōkarmarmu samamuyu prabaddhamappa karma
bhāvakke sandu, kaḍeyu agahida gahaṇandeyoḷ, śuddhambandandadoḷ,
nōkarmarmu pudgala parivartanamembudīnālku parāvartanamuṁvuṁ modala
parivartanakālamuvu nōḍe, mēgaṇa kāladoḷ, tammovmoḷondondakke,
anantaguṇavivaṟioḷ, modala kālaṅgaḷoḷ, bappa pudgalaṅgaḷbēgaṁ
bappuvadaṟiṁ mēgaṇa kālaṅgaḷbiriyuvu;

gāhe॥ agahida miṁ sayugahida miṁ samugahidantaha vagahidantahe
vagahidañca
miṁsagahida magahidaṅgahidaṁ miṁsagahidañca ॥
agahidakkondara lekkaṁ, miśrakke haṁsapadaṁ ○ ○daṁ00 1 1
karma pudgala gahidakke sonne karma pudgalakke + 01 1 ○0 +
mīteṟiṟanekiṟidu viśēṣavuṇṭu, parivartanakka vīte ○ ○00 + 1
ane kiṟidu viśēṣavuṇṭunokarmarmudravyavu nāhāra vargaṇeyi
nātmaṅgoḷguṁ maḷguṁmudaṟiṁṟimiṁsagahaṇandevumpēlddalddi teṟiṟane, aṣṭavidha karma
pudgalanātmaṁ kārmarmuṇa vargaṇeyiṁ koḷguṁmaḷguṁmudaṟajaghanyamiṁsagaha
ṇandetrisameyādhikāvaḷiyoḷakkumamudentendoḍe.
baddhāvaḷi pōdimbaṟiyumondu samayadoḷākaṇḍaṇeyiṁ,
prāptōdayuvāge, eraḍaneya samayuda karmabhāvakke sandar.
mūṟineyu samayadoḷ, karmasvarūpakkesandu, peṟivaroḷ kūḍe
bandhakkevakkuṁ; intī eraḍu pudgala parivartanadoḷ, karmaparivarta
nakke, sūkṣma nigōdhaṁ, labdhyaparyāptana vigraha prathamu samayuvaṁ
nōḍa(moda)lmāḷpudu; nokarmakke pēldda pañjanta(pajjatta)na śarī
rōdaya prathamusamayuvaṁ modalmāḷpudidu dravya saṁsāraṁ;

gāhe॥ saṁvevipoṅgaḷākhaḷu egabhantu jhōda bhū
jīvēṇa āsahiṇento poṅgaḷa pariyuṇṭa saṁsāre
kṣētra parivartanadoḷondujīvaṁ, mēru mūla madhyada aṣṭa
pradēśamu tanage madhya pradēśamāgiyuṅguḷā saṅkheñjadibhāgavātraṁ,
jaghanya śarīrōgāhaneyoḷ puṭṭisattu, toḷaldu bandādigahaneyoḷ
munnina pradēśadoḷondaṁ(ḷpondi) pattuviṭṭu, mattondu pradēśa
manoḷagāgi puṭṭi, sattu, toḷaldu, mattamādi gāhaneyoḷe, munnina
pradēśadoḷondi pattuviṭṭu, mattondu pradēśamanoḷagāge puṭṭi,
intu jaghanyaśarīrāvagāhaneyoḷanukramadinondondu, pradēśa
manottutuṁ, lōkālōkākāśa pradēśadoḷellaṁ neṟiye, puṭṭi,
munnina śarīrāvagāhaneyoḷagondu pradēśamadhikamāgi, kramadināyuṁ
dadoḷe, lōkadoḷellaṁ neṟiye, puṭṭi, innondu pradēśamadhika
māgiyasaṅkhyāta śarīrāvagāhana vikalpaṅgaḷoḷ, lōkākāśa pradē-
śaṅgaḷoḷagelliyuṁ puṭṭi, kṣētramuṁ, śarīrāvagāhaneyuṁ kunduṁ
(peccallade), kramudoḷa, pradēśōttaramāge puṭṭi, munnina jaghanya
śarīrāvagāhaneyoḷ, mērumadhya pradēśadoḷ puṭṭidoḍadondu
kṣētrasaṁsāra;

gāhe॥ saṁvaṁ hi lo aṅkheṁ takamusōtaṁṇanthikṣētraparivartanadoḷondujīvaṁmērumūlamadhyadaaṣṭapradēśamutanagemadhyapradēśavāgiyaṅguḷāsaṅkheñjadibhāgavātrañjaghaṇṇathandalaṇaṁ
o gāhaṇā ṭa bahuso hindaṁ trēkhēntaneyoḷpuṭṭisattutoḷaldubandādigahaneyoḷmunninapradēśadoḷondaṁ(ḷpondi)pattuviṭṭumattondupradēśamunoḷagāgipuṭṭisattutoḷaldumattamādigāhaneyoḷemunninapradēśadoḷondipattuviṭṭumattondupradēśamunoḷagāgepuṭṭiintujaghanyaśarīrāvagāhaneyoḷanukramudinondondupradēśamunottutuṁlōkālōkākāśapradēśadoḷellaṁneṟeyepuṭṭimunninaśarīrāvagāhaneyoḷagondupradēśamudhikamāgikramudināyundadoḷelōkadoḷellaṁneṟeyepuṭṭiinnondupradēśamudhikamāgiyasaṅkhyātaśarīrāvagāhanavikalpaṅgaḷoḷlōkākāśapradēśaṅgaḷoḷagelliyumpuṭṭikṣētramuṁśarīrāvagāhaneyuṅkunduṁ(peccallade)kramudoḷapradēśōttaramāgepuṭṭimunninajaghanyaśarīrāvagāhaneyoḷmērumadhyapradēśadoḷpuṭṭidoḍadondukṣētra saṁsārera

kāla varivartanadoḷondu jīvamuvasarpiṇiyu prathagāhe॥saṁvaṁhiloaṅkhentakamu samuya
doḷpuṭṭi, sattu, mattondavasarpiṇi yaraḍaneyu samuyadoḷpuṭṭi,
yintavasarpiṇiyu samuyaṅgaḷininitoḷavanitaroḷaṁ toḷaldu, kramu
doḷ (puṭṭi) mattamutsarpiṇiyu prathamu samuyadoḷpuṭṭi, sattu,
mattondutsarpiṇi yaraḍaneyu samuyadoḷpuṭṭi, intutsarpiṇi samu-
yaṅgaḷenitoḷavaanitaṟoḷaṁ toḷaldu, kramudoḷ puṭṭi, kundeyuṁ,
pecceyuṁ, puṭṭidudallade, mattamuvasarpiṇiyu prathamu samuyadoḷpu
ṭṭuvudadu kāla saṁsāraṁre,

gāhe॥ ō sampikālavarivartanadoḷondujīvamuvasarpiṇiyaprathamusamuyadoḷpuṭṭisattumattondavasarpiṇiyaraḍaneyasamuyadoḷpuṭṭiyintavasarpiṇiyusamuyaṅgaḷinitoḷavanitaroḷantoḷaldukramudoḷ(puṭṭi)mattamutsarpiṇiyaprathamusamuyadoḷpuṭṭisattumattondutsarpiṇiyaraḍaneyasamuyadoḷpuṭṭiintutsarpiṇi samuyāyaṅgaḷenitoḷavaḷiyāṇiraṁ(ru) tarā saṁvā
(jāḍavaṁ) jādomudoyu bahusōhintaṁ lōḷpuṭṭikundeyumpecceyumpuṭṭidudallademattamuvasarpiṇiyaprathamusamuyadoḷpuṭṭuvudadu kāḷala saṁsāreraṁ

bhava parivartanadoḷondu jīvaṁ, narakada jaghanyamappa pattu
sāsira varṣāyuṣyadoḷpuṭṭi, sattu, caturgatiyoḷtoḷaldu,
mattondu samayādhika daśasahasra varṣāyuṣyadoḷpuṭṭi, toḷalde
raḍu samayamadhikamāgi puṭṭi, intukramadiṁ, samayādhikamāgi,
narakada mūvattu (muhūrta) mūṟu sāgarōpamadoḷaṁ puṭṭi,
tirika, manuṣyaroḷanantaparmumuhūrta āyuṣyadintoṭṭu, samayādhika
kramadiṁ, mūṟu paḷitōpamammumbaraṁ puṭṭi, dēvāyuṣyadoḷ pattu
sāsiravarṣadintoṭṭu, samayōttaradoḷparimōparimagraivēyakada
mūvattondu sāgarōpamambaraṁ puṭṭi, kundi, peḷci, pumuṭṭidalekka
mumallade, samayōttara kramadoḷpuṭṭi, mattaṁ, narakada jaghanyamappa
pattusāsira varṣadoḷpuṭṭuvudidondu bhavasaṁsāraṁ.

gāhe॥ ṇira(da)yāvuvema jaheṁṇejāpavadu vuvariṁlade vudugeveñje|
।jīvōvinthaṁ tavasābhavaṁ didihindido bahuso॥

bhāva parivartanadoḷ, pañcēndriyayumuṁ, sañjñiyuṁyumuṁ, paryā
ptamuṁ, mithyādr̥ṣṭiyumappadondu jīvaṁ, jñānāvaraṇīyayuda sarva
jaghanyamuṁ, tatratprayōgyamappantaḥ kōṭi (kōṭi) sthitiyuṁ kaṭṭuva
jīvakkasaṅkhyāta lōkamātraṁ, kaṣāyādyadhyavasāya sthānaṅgaḷ,
ṣaṭsthāna patitaṅgaḷā jaghanyasthitige yōgyaṅgaḷondondu kaṣāyadyayādhyava
sāyasthānakkasaṅkhyāta lōkamātramanubhāgamupuva bandhādyadhyavasāyaṁ
(sthānaṁ)gaḷintu, sarvajaghanya sthitiyumuṁ, sarvajaghanya kaṣāyādyadhyava
sāyasthānamumuṁ, sarvajaghanyānubhāgabandhādyadhyavasāyasthānamumuṁ,
kaṭṭuvāgaḷ, tadyōga sarvajaghanyayōga sthānamakkumuñkkamañjaghanya
sthitigaṁ, jaghanyakaṣāyā dyadhyavasāya sthānakaṁ, jaghanyānubhāga bandhā
dyadhyavasāya sthānakaṁ, munnina jō(bhā)gakke asaṅkhyāta bhāgavr̥ddhi
yumapperaḍaneyayu bhāgamakkukkamintu, jaghanya sthitikaṣāyādyadhyavasāya
nubhāgādyadhyavasāya sthānaṅgaḷaḷgasaṅkhyāta bhāgavr̥ddhyādi catuḥtusthāna parita-
mappa śrēṇyasaṅkhyeyu bhāgamātra jōsthānaṅgaḷakkukkamājaghanya sthitiyu,
jaghanya kaṣāyādyadhyavasāya sthānaderaḍaneyayunubhāgādyadhyavasāyasthānakke
jōga sthānaṅgaḷ, munninante, mattamājaghanya sthitiyu, jaghanya kaṣā
yādyadhyavasāyasthānada, mūṟaneyanubhāgādyadhyavasāyasthānakkaṁ,

jōgaṅgaḷmuḷamunninante, intu jaghanya sthitiyakaṣāyādhyavasāya
sthānakkaṁ, saṅkhyāta lōkamātramappanubhāgādhyavasāyasthānaṅgaḷge,
jōgasthānaṅgaḷge, munnina pēḻdandame, jaghanyasthiti, eraḍaneya kaṣā
yādhyavasāyasthānada, asaṅkhyāta lōkamātramappanubhāgādhyava
sāyasthānaṅgaḷaṁ, jōgasthānaṅgaḷaṁ, jōgasthānagaḷaṁ pēḻdeṟiḻdateṟane,
jaghanyasthitiyayu, mūṟaneya kaṣāyādhyavasāya sthānadiṁ toṭṭasaṁ-
khyāta, lōkamātraṁ kaṣāyādhyavasāya sthānaṅgaḷge, kramavr̥ddhiyu-
ppanubhāgādhyavasāya sthānaṅgaḷayōga sthānaṅgaḷīpēḻdeṟiḻdateṟane.

innāsamayādhika jaghanya sthitiyintoṭṭu, jñānāvaraṇīya
dutkr̥ṣṭamappa, triṁśatkōṭikōṭi sāgarōpama sthitivaraṁ, karma
(krama)vr̥ddhige sanda kaṣāyādhyavasāyaṁ sthānaṅgaḷgaṁ, kramadiṁ
peccidanubhāgādhyavasāya sthānaṅgaḷaṁ jōgasthānaṅgaḷumīteṟiṟane,
intu jñānāvaraṇīyada, jaghanya sthitiya, jaghanya kaṣāyādhyavasāya
sthānada, jaghanyānubhāgādhyavasāya sthānamaṁ, jaghanya(dōṣapa)jōgadiṁ
kaṭṭi, kramadinnadaṟutkr̥ṣṭambaraṁ, kaṭṭiyuḷida mūla prakr̥tigaḷuma
nuttara, prakr̥tigaḷumanīteṟiṟadoḷe kaṭṭi, mattaṁ jñānāvaraṇīyada,
jaghanya sthitiyumaṁ, jaghanya kaṣāyādhyavasāya sthānamumaṁ, jagha
nyānubhāgabandhādhyavasāya sthānamumaṁ jaghanyayōgadiṁ kaṭṭidoḍa
dondu bhāva saṁsāraṁraṅgāhe॥sampopagadiṁ(ri)khidhivoaṇubhāgapadēsabandhathāṇāṇiṁ।minthantasaṁsideṇayabhamidāṇidubhā(bha)vasaṁsāre॥.

gāhe॥ sampo pagadiṁ(ri)thidhivo aṇuīpēḻdadravyakṣētrakālabhavabhāva(ṅgapadesabandhaṭhāṇāṇiṁ|
minthaṁ tasaṁ sideṇaya bhamidāṇidu bhā(bha)vasaṁsāre. ॥raṅgaḷanulōmadindantammoḷondondakkekāladindamanantaguṇaṁvilōmadindaṁvāramanantaguṇaṁ

ī pēḻda dravyakṣētra kālabhava bhāva(ṅgaḷa) saṁsāraṅgaḷanulō
madindaṁ, tammoḷondondakke, kāladindamanantaguṇaṁ, vilōma
dindaṁ, vāramanantaguṇaṁ.

intu harivarma narapati pañcavidha saṁsāramumaṁ, saṁsāra
viṣaya vividha duḥkhaṅgaḷumaṁ kēḷdu, saṁvēga nirvēgaparaṁ
piriya magaṅge rājyamaṁ koṭṭu, bāhyābhyantara parigrahamumaṁ
toṟedu, palabaṟumberasu saṁyamamuṁmaṁ kaikoṇḍēkādaśāṅgadharaṁ,
ṣōḍaśa kāraṇa bhāvanegaḷiṁḷaṁ tīrthakara puṇyamaṁ kaṭṭi, kālāntyadoḷā
rādhanāvidhiyiṁ, prāṇatakalpadoḷ prāṇatavimānadoḷ, prāṇatēndra
nāgi, viṁśati sāgarōpamāyuṣyanuṁ mūṟuvare moḷa niḍiyanuṁ,
śuklalēśyāpariṇāmanumāgi, sukhamirpinaṁ.

itta jambūdvīpada, bharatakṣētrada, magadhapiviṣayada, kuśālagrāma
(kuśigra) puramanāḷda, harivaṁśada, kāśyapagōtrada, sumitranembarasa
narasi sōmā(bhāmā) mahādēvi, śrāvaṇabahuḷa, bidigeyayu, paścima
rātradodōḷ, śravaṇanakṣatradodōḷ, manōhara yāmadodōḷ, ṣōḍaśa
śubhasvapnadarśanānantaraṁ, nijavadanamauṁ gajaṁ puguvudaṁ kaṇḍavadhijñāni
yappa nijīśaniṁ, tatphalamanaṟidu, sukhamirpinaṁ. svargāvataraṇa
kalyāṇapūrvakaṁ, prāṇatēndranādēviya garbhakkavatarisi, mallijinatī
rthakara santānamayvattu lakke varṣaṁ pravartisuvandā kālada, caijaitra
bahuḷa pañcamiyoḷ, śravaṇanakṣatradoḷ, trijñānadharaṁ puṭṭi,
saudharmēndraṁ janmābhiṣēka kalyāṇānantaramintī dēvaniṁ, munigaḷ
suvratarapparendu, munisuvratanātharendu pesaraniṭṭu pōdaṁ, itta
triṁśatsahasravarṣa paramāyuṣyanuṁ, ippattu bilniḍiyanuṁ, indra
nīḷavarṇanumāgi beḷedu, eṇsāṇṇāsiradaynūru varṣaṁ kumāra kālaṁ
sale, rājyadoḷninḷnandu, padinaydu sāsiravarṣaṁ rājyakālaṁ pōge,
mattondu divasaṁ, jaḷada kāladoḷ, yāga hasti banamaṁ nenedu,
kavaḷaṁ goḷḷadire, pamudamavararembavadhijñānigaḷadara cittavr̥ttiyanaṟidu,
kutūhaḷadiṁ, besagoḷva prajege, gajada pūrva bhavasambandhamanintendu
besasidar.

•pūrvatāḷapuramanāḷvaḷda, narapatiyembarasaṁ, kulābhimānadiṁ,
kapōtalēśyā pariṇāmadiṁ, pātrāpātramanariyade yathēṣṭadāna pari
pākadiṁ, gajapatiyāgi puṭṭitembuduṁ, yāgahasti pūrvabhavamaṁ
nenedu, saṁyamāsaṁyamamaṁmāṁ kaikoḷe, tatkāraṇa samutpannabōdhaṁ,

div.head: hariṣeṇacakravartikathā
div.p:
lōkāntika dēvapratibōdhise, vijayanemba yuvarājaṅge rājyamaṁ
koṭṭu, pariniṣkramaṇa kalyāṇapūrvakaṁ, aparājiteyemba śibipigeyoḷ,
nīḷakavanakke, ṣaṣṭhōpavāsadiṁ pōgi, vaiśākhabahuḷa daśamiyaparāhṇa
doḷ, śravaṇanakṣatradoḷ, sāsirvararasugaḷveḷderasu, saṁyamamaṁ
kaikoṇḍu, catujñārjñānadharaṁ, pāraṇādinadoḷ, rājagr̥hamanāḷva,
kanakavarṇanappa vr̥ṣabhasēnanembarasana maneyoḷ niltu, pañcāścaryaṁ
negaḻtiḻte pannondu tiṅgaḷ chadmasthakālaṁ pōge, munna pēḻda dīkṣā
vanadoḷ, campakadrumadaḍiyoḷ, ṣaṣṭhōpavāsadiṁ nile, vaiśākha
bahuḷa navami(daśami)yaparāhṇadoḷ, śravaṇanakṣatramāge, kēvala
jñānaṁ puṭṭi, tatkalyāṇa pūjeyaneyd, sāydasāsiradeṇṭanvarthanāmaṅgaḷaṁ
tāḷdaḷdi, mallināthamormodalāge padineṇbargaṇadhararuṁ, aynūrvarpūpūrva
dhararuṁ, ippattojrājbāsirvarśikṣakaruṁ, sāsiradeṇṭunūrvaravadhijñāni
gaḷuṁ, anibare kēvaḷigaḷuṁ, ijrārjbāsiradinnūrvarvikriyardhiprā
ptaruṁ, sāsiradaynūrvarmanaḥparyajñānigaḷuṁ, sāsiradinnūrva
rvādigaḷuṁ puṣpadantāryuryakiyarmodalāgeyvattu sāsirvararji
yaruṁ, ondulakke śrāvakaruṁ, mūṟu(eraḍu)lakke śrāvakiyaruṁ,
āsaṅkhyāta dēvaruṁ, dēviyaruṁ, saṅkhyāta tiryagjñāgjātigaḷuṁ berasu,
dharmōpadēśaṅgeyvuttumeṇsāttuṁmēṇṇāsiradanālnūra tombhattuttombhattu varṣa
mūvonmumondutiṅgaḷvihārisi, sammēdagiriyoḷondu tiṅgaḷ, viharaṇa
vuḷisu, sahasra munisahitaṁ, pratimāyōgadoḷ, phālguṇabahuḷa,
bārasiya paścimarātradoḷ, śravaṇanakṣatradoḷ, munisuvrata bhaṭṭāra
kar muktige sandar. saudharmēndranuṁ parinirvāṇa kalyāṇadoḷā
nampananda nr̥tyamanāḍi pōdaṁ.
div.trailer:
idu sakaḷa śāstrasaṁyama sampanna śrīmadajitasēna bhaṭṭāraka
caraṇakamala cañcarīkaṁ, dharmavijaya śrīmaccāvuṇḍarāja viracita
triṣaṣṭilakṣaṇa mahāpurāṇadoḷ munisuvrata purāṇaṁ.
div.head: hariṣēṇa cakravartikathe
div.p:
śrī munisuvrata bhaṭṭārakara tīrthasantānamodoḷ, hariṣēṇa
nemboṁ, cakravartiyādanātaṁ, tr̥tīya janmadoḷ, ananta bhaṭṭāra
kara tīrthadoḷorvaṁ, rājaputranutkr̥ṣṭa tapadoḷ negaḻdu, kālāntya

div.head: rāmalakṣmaṇacaritaṁ
div.p:
doḷ, sanatkumāra kalpada, suviśāḷa vimānadoḷ, paḷṣaṭsāgarōpamā
yuṣyamanoḍeyoṁ, dēvanāgi sukhamananubhavisi bandu, jambūdvī
pada, bharatada, bhōgapuramanāḷvaḷda, ikṣvākuvaṁśada, padmanābhanembara
saṅgaṁ, airā mahādēvigaṁ, hariṣēṇanemba maganāgi, daśasahasra varṣaṁ
paramāyuṣyanuṁ, ippattu bilniḍiyanuṁ, suvarṇa varṇanumāgi,
navayauvana prāptanāge, padmanābhanondu divasaṁ, manōharōdyāna
doḷirdanantavīrya kēvaḷigaḷaṁ bandisi, dharma śravaṇānantaraṁ,
nirvēgadiṁ, hariṣēṇaṅge rājyamaṁ koṭṭu, palabarumarasugaḷverasu,
tapamaṁ kaikoṇḍaṁ. hariṣēṇanuṁ śrāvaka vratamaṁ kaikoṇḍu pōḻa
lge vandu, sukhadinire, padmanābhamunige, dīkṣāvanamodoḷ, pratimāyōga
doḷ, kēvala jñānōtpattiyāge, hariṣēṇaṅgemādivasamoḷāyudhā
gāradoḷ cakrāsi, chatra, daṇḍa ratnaṅgaḷuṁ, śrīgr̥hadoḷ cūḍā
maṇi, kākiṇi, (carma) ratnaṅgaḷuṁ, puṭṭidoḍāvārteyaṁyuṁ pēḻdātaṅge
tuṣṭidānamaṁ koṭṭu, jinapatiya samīpakke pōgi, bandisi, kēvaḷa
pūjeyaṁyuṁ māḍi, poḻabilge vandu, cakrapūjegeydu, digvijayōdyōga
doḷ, puṭṭida gr̥hapati, sēnāpati, purōhita, ratnaṅgaḷuṁ, vijayārdha
doḷ puṭṭida hastyaśva kanyā ratnaṅgaḷuṁ, nadī mukhadoḷpuṭṭida
gaṇabaddha dēvaruṁ tareṇe banda navanidhigaḷuṁ, kaigevare, sāmrājyābhiṣēkamaṁ
paḍedu daśāṅgabhōgamananubhavisuttirdardu, kārtika nandīśvaradaṣṭāhnika
jina pūjeyaṁyuṁmāḍi, paurṇame dinadoḷ, mahōpavāsasahitaṁ, saudha
taḷadoḷ, sabhāmadhyagataṁ, candragrahaṇamaṅmuṅkaṇḍu, nirvēgadiṁ, dvāda
śānuprēkṣānusmaraṇa pūrvakaṁ, mahāsēnaṅge rājmaṁjamaṁ koṭṭu, nidhi
gaḷoḷirdōrdoḍameyaṁ bīyaṅgeydu, sīmantagiriyoḷ, śrīnāgakēva
ḷigaḷa pakkade, palabararasugaḷverasu, saṁyamamaṁ kaikoṇḍu, bahuvidardhi
prāptanāgi, caturvidhārādhanā vidhiyiṁ sarvārtha siddhiyoḷahamindra
nādoṁ.
div.head:
śrī munisuvrata bhaṭṭārakara tīrthasantānamoḷ
eṇṭaneya baladēva vāsudēvarappa
rāma lakṣmaṇara caritaṁ
div.p:
jambūdvīpada, bharata kṣētradamaḷa viṣayada, ratnapuramanāḷvaḷda,
prajāpati mahārājaṅgaṁ, guṇakāntādēvigaṁ, candracūḷanemba maga

nādanānr̥pana mantriyayu magaṁ, vijayanembanavarīrvargamatipritiyāge,
tamage tāyuṁ tandeyuṁ kūrpudaṟindaṁ, rūpa kaḷāguṇayauva
nādigaḷiṁ garvamuḷḷudaṟindaṁ, yathēṣṭa duścāritra vartigaḷuṁḷāṁ,
niraṅkuśamāgirdondu divasamāpoṭila, gautamuma vaiśravaṇana magaṁ,
śrīdattaṅgaṁ kubērana magaḷ kubēradattegaṁ pāṇigrahaṇamappāgaḷā
keya rūpu lāvaṇyamaṁ, tanage paricārakarpēḻ viṟivijayaṁ berasu,
candracūḷanākeyuyanēḻduṟidu taralpōge, purajanaṅgaḷberadu, puyyaliḍe,
kēḷdarasaṁ, kumārara duścaritrakke muḷidu, taḷāṟiraṁ karedu, piḍitare
yene, kādipiḍidu taḷāṟirarasanallige tandoḍēketandiravaraṁ śūladoḷi
kkimembudu, mantriyuṁ, nagarapradhānarumbandu, bālatvadinaṟiyayude
negaḻda kumāraldikumāra dōṣakkokkidommege kṣamiyisuvudendoḍarasaṁ, duṣṭa
nigraha śiṣṭa pratipāḷanamarasaṁ geyyayvudandu, prajeyaṁ kāyalu bāradu
madaṟinnivaraṁ kolveṁ, nīmidakke mārkoḷḷadirimevene, mantri prajā
pati mahārājana muḷisanaṟidinnavaranāne daṇḍisuvenendarasananuma
tadiṁ, kumāraranoydu, vanagiri parvatada śiḷātaḷadoḷirisi, nimage
maraṇamappaḍe, nirvyājamādudinnilla, puruṣākāraṅgiḍade sāvudene,
kumārarendarduścaritadoḷnegaḻduldudakke, nammanāvaṟiyude negaḻdalda
vallamemage sāvudembudēṅgahanaveṁvene, mantri, nagarajanakkamavurasaṅgaṁ,
kumārarga mubhayuya lōkahitamappantu (ppuppadaṁ), tat(ī)giri śikhara
doḷirda, mahābaḷarembaṇagāraraṁ bandisi, nijāgamana vārteyunaṟipe,
munipati manaḥparyaya jñānadhararintendu besasidar, ī kumārari
rvaruṁ, tr̥tīya janmadoḷ rāmalakṣmaṇara pesaroḷ rāmuma, kēśava
rāgi bharata trikhaṇḍamanāḷvarene, mantri santōṣambaṭṭirvargaṁ,
dharmatattvamanaṟipi, saṁyamamuṁmaṁ kaikoḷisi, bandarasaṅge, tadvr̥ttāṁ
tamanintendaṟipidaṁ.

guhāvāsitvamuṁ, peṟiradeseyindaṁ bhīrutvamuṁ, svapriyaroḷa
nādaratvamuṁ, grāmavāsa dūratvamuṁ, svanispr̥hatvamuṁ, svakārya
doḷmitratvamuṁ, araṇyavāsitvamunuḷḷavaralli kumāraraṁ nivēdisi
bandemavarumemmaṁ, peramurṭṭaṭṭadirimemagāveme daṇḍaṇegeyvemendu,
svahastasamutpādita vēdaneyiṁ, paralōkābhmubhimukharāgirdarānumumadarkke,
santōṣaṁ baṭṭubandenembudumarasaṁ duḥkhitanāgi, ninnī nuḍiyayuna

ṟidenilla, saytuyta pēḻimbuduṁ, parityakta (pihita) grāmanivāsaruṁ,
niyatagupti(hā)vāsigaḷuṁ, samucita dhairyākaravāḷa nihatēndriya
vairigaḷaṁ svanigrahapararuṁ, bhayavivarjita hr̥dayaruṁ, pāpame mūrti
vantamāgirdudendasaṁyataroḷ nirādhararumappalli, dharmatattvamaṁmuṁ
kēḷdu, nirvēgadiṁ kumārardīkṣitarādarene, mantriya vacanadinarasaṁ,
santōṣaṁ baṭṭu bhayalōkahita vidāya nīnalladillendu, mantriyuṁyaṁ
pūjisi, tanna kuladoḷ yōgyaṅge rājyamaṅkoṭṭu, vanagiri śikhara
doḷirda kumāra munigaḷaṅkaṇḍu, vandisi, nīmonnemennageydaparādhamaṁ
kṣamiyisuvudubhayalōkahitamappa saṁyamamaṁ paḍadirendu, ava
roḷ priyamaṁ nuḍidu, mahābala gaṇadhararaṁ gurubhakti pūrvakaṁ
bandisi, tatpārśvadoḷ palambararasugaḷverasu, tapamaṁ kaikoṇḍu,
kēvalajñānaṁ puṭṭi, muktige sandaṁ.

ittal candracūḷa muniyuṁ, vijayayu muniyumutkr̥ṣṭa tapado
ḷnegaḻdu, khaḷgapurakke vandātapōyōgadhārigaḷāgirpinaṁ, tatpurādhi
pati, suprabhanuṁ, puruṣōttamanumemba rāmakēśavaroḷ, puru
pōṣōttamana rājyavibhūtiyuṁyaṁ kaṇḍu, candracūḷa muni, (bhōga) nidā
naṅgeydu, jīvitāntyadoḷārādhanā vidhiyindirvaruṁ muḍipi, sanatku
mārakalpada kanakaprabha vimānadoḷ, vijayaṁ kanakacūḷanemboṁ dēva
nādoṁ; maṇiprabha vimānadoḷ, candracūḷaṁ maṇicūḷanemba dēva
nādoṁ. antirvaruṁ, saptasāgarōpamāntadoḷalliṁ bandu, jambū
dvīpada, bharatakṣētrada, kāśīviṣayada, vāraṇāsi puramanāḷva daśaratha
mahārājaṅgaṁ, subaḷādēvigaṁ śubhasvapna darśanānantaraṁ, phālguṇa
bahuḷa terasadoḷ, maghānakṣatradoḷ, kanakacūḷaṁ rāmanāgi, trayō
daśa sahasra varṣāyuṣyanādonādaśarathanarasi kaikege, prasanna sarō
vara, kamaḷavana, sūryēndu, siṁhapōta, pañcavidha svapna darśanā
nantaraṁ, māghaśuddha pāḍiḍyavadoḷ, viśākha nakṣatradoḷ, maṇicūḷaṁ
lakṣmaṇanāgi dvādaśa sahasravarṣaṁ paramāyuṣyanādoṁ. antirvaruṁ,
padinaidu bildilniḍiyaruṁ, dvātriṁśallakṣaṇadhararuṁ, samacaturasra saṁsthāna
ruṁ, vajra vr̥ṣabha nārāca saṁhanaruṁ, ananta vīryaruṁ, kumuda
nīḷōtpaḷa varṇarumāgi, rāmaṅgayvattayduvarṣaṁ, lakṣmaṇaṅgaivattu
varṣaṁ kumārakālaṁ pōge, sukhamirdar.

itta jambūdvīpada, bharata kṣētrada, sākētapuramaṁ, bharatarāja
prabhr̥tigaḷ, ikṣvākuvaṁśada nr̥patigaḷasaṅkhyātarāḷdatikrāntarādimba
ḷiyuṁyiṁ, hariṣēṇanemboṁ daśama cakradharaṁ sarvārtha siddhige sandiṁ
baḷiyuṁyaṁ, sāyira pavarṣaṁ pōge, sagaranemboṁ maṇḍaḷiḷīkaṁ, suḷase
yembaḷaṁ svayaṁvaradoḷ, madhu piṅgaḷanembanaṁ śarīralakṣaṇa dūṣaṇa
dindaṁ kaḷeye, sagaranoḷ, baddhavairanāgi tapaṅgeydu, mahākāḷaneṁ
basuranāgi puṭṭi, sagaravaṁśamaṁ nirmūḷaṁ māḷpabhiprāyadoḷire,
mahākāḷana pañcaneseyanaṟiyuveyade, vihitātharvaṇa vēdanirūpitamuṁ,
vividhaprāṇi hiṁsā lakṣaṇamumappayāgamaṁ nirvartisi, narakakke pōgi,
sagarakuḷamintu niḥśēṣaṁ keṭṭuvemdembudaṅkēḷdu, daśaratha mahārāja
nidemma pūrvajanmasthānavendu, rāmalakṣmaṇasahitaṁ sākētamaṁ
pokku, bharatanuṁ, śatrughnanumemba tanayaraṁ paḍedu, sukhadinire,
rāmu lakṣmaṇarge daśakandhara vadhadiṁ vijayakāraṇaṁ prakr̥ta māgi
rpai(ḷpaḷpi)saṁ.

itta, mithiḷāpuradoḷ, janakanembarasaṅgaṁ, vasudhādēvigaṁ,
rūpavinayuya vijñānānvite, sīteyemboḷmagaḷāge, yauvana paripūrṇa
doḷ, dēśāntara vāsigaḷapparasugaḷākeyaṁ bēḍiyaṭṭiṭṭe, sakunaṁ binandiḍe,
kuḍuvamendu, sōpacāra vacanaṅgaḷanaṭṭiṭṭe mattondu divasaṁ, vidva
jjana vipirājita sabhāmaṇḍaḷadoḷ janakaṁ, dharmakathāprarūpaṇā nirūpaṇa
nāgirdu, kuśalamatiyemba sēnāpatiyanintendu besagoṇḍaṁ—
munne sagaranembarasaṁ suḷaseyembaḷverasu, aśvamēdha modalāge paśu
gaḷaṁ bēḷambeḷdu, bondeverasu svargakke pōdaremba vacanamaṁ kēḷalappa
daṟiṁ, yāgadoḷ, suralōkamaṁ paḍeyalakkumappoḍāmuṁ,
yajñakriyāvidhiyoḷ suralōka sukhabhāgigaḷappamene, sēnāpati
endaṁ— asura kumārargaṁ, nāgakumārargaṁ matsaramadaṟiṁ,
parasparārabdha prayō(prayā)jana nyāghātaṅgeyvuyduttirparīgaḷ, mahā
kāḷasuraṁ pūsaśontondu yajñavidhiyaṁ māḍivanaduve nimuge yajñakri
yāmukhyaṁ; dharaṇēndrana pratiṣṭhita nami, vinamigaḷavaranantatiyavarī
rajatāḍaḷada, vidyādharararadarindavarnamma yajñakke vyāghātamaṁ
māḷpudaṁ kāvaruḷḷoḷḷaḍe yāgasiddhiyakkuṁ. vijayārdhamilligegeṇṭu,
namamuge samīpavartiyāgi rāvaṇanirponārghraṇātaṅge nāmuṁ munnaṁ, śaṅkisu

tirpudaṟiṁ, nammayāgamuṁ kāyalsamarthanappaṅge sīteyuṁ kuḍu
vamene, sabhāsadarellamudanoḍambaḍe, janakaṁ madīkaṁya yāgajñarakṣaṇārthaṁ
rāmaṅge baḻiyu naṭṭe, ātaṅmālkamilligeyvamendoḍeāgamasāranembamantriyendandharmanimittamāge sīteyuṁ kuḍuvenendu, rāmunegaldakāryaṁvighnamilladesiddhamādandubhayalōkahitamakkundharmanimittavighnasahitamādoḍandharmanibandhanamappudaṟimpuṇyamuñjasamumpaḍeyalakkumudaṟiṁyāgarakṣaṇakkekumārarapōgoḷḷittenevivēkaparaṁatisayamatiyembamantriyendandharmamembinitaṟoḷambuddhiyoḍeyarnegalvirallarpālaṅkuḍegendupēldaḍekṣīrasāmānyadoḷikkeyukaḷḷiyupālanaparīkṣitaṅkuḍiyalāgadantevaktr̥pramāṇadiṁvacanapramāṇaṁsarvaprāṇihiṁsāvidiyappayajñāgamakkekartr̥prāmāṇyamillapūrvāparaviruddhamappudaṟiṁunmattakavacanadante(datta)prāmāṇyaṁyajñaśāstradondeḍeyoḷhiṁseyoḷoḍambaḍadudaṟiṁyajñaśāstrañjanyajanakasambandharahitakartr̥kaṁsvayambhumembarappaḍedēvanārakajaḷacarādigaḷellaṁsvayambhūtvaprasaṅgamakkumudaṟimpūrvāparaviruddhaṁahiṁsā
lakṣmakṣaṇargaṁ, mattaṁ, peṟarumarasumakkaḷaṁ baḻiyuṁ pāguḍamumumuntribhuva
naṭṭe, daśarathaṁ, dūhitavacanamuṁ. lēkhāmumuntattvamuntattvajñānaṁsarvajñapraṇītamumappudāgamuṁyajñaśabdandānadoḷandēvapūjeyoḷampravartisuguṁyajñaṅkratumakhavembivēkārthamuvaṟiṁyajñaśabdārthamappaḍedēvapūjālakṣaṇandharmadimpuṇyamaṁnerapidēhigaḷgēvēndratvamumanavadhāneydaśatakratuśatamakhādināmōpalakṣitarapparāyajñamuṁmārisi, mantriṣānāriṣa(ārṣaanārṣa)bhēdadindvividhamakkumudaṟoḷāriṣamembudādibrahmōpadiṣṭamuñjīvādipadārthayadātmaprarūpaṇamumappavēdadoḷkrōdhāgniyuṅkāmāgniyuṁudarāgniyumembagnitrayaṅgaḷaṅkṣameyuṁvairāgyamumupavāsamembāhutigaḷa
nendaṁ.

janakaṁ yajñarakṣaṇārthaṁ kumārara baravaṁ pāruttirdaṁ,
dharmārtha kāmaprayōjanaṁ sārthakamumanarthakamumappa pratītiyu
māṟkumilligeyvemendoḍe, āgamasāranemba mantriyendaṁ- dharma
nimittamāge negaḻda kāryaṁ vighnamillade siddhamādandubhayalōka
hitamakkuṁ. dharmanimitta vighnasahitavādoḍaṁ, dharmanibandhana
mappudaṟiṁ puṇyamuṁ, jasamumaṁ paḍeyalakkumudaṟiṁ yāgarakṣa
ṇakke kumārarapōgoḷḷittene, vivēkaparaṁ atisayamatiyemba mantri
yendaṁ- dharmamembinitaṟoḷaṁ buddhiyoḍeyar negaḻvarallar,
pālaṁ kuḍegendu pēḻdaḍe, kṣīrasāmānyadoḷakkeyu kaḷḷiyu pālana
parīkṣitaṁ kuḍiyalāgadante, vaktrapramāṇadiṁ, vacanapramāṇaṁ, sarva
prāṇihiṁsā vidiyappa yajñāgamakke, kartr̥prāmāṇyamilla; pūrvāpara
viruddhamappudaṟiṁ, unmattaka vacanadante (datta), prāmāṇyaṁ yajña
śāstradondeḍeyoḷ, hiṁseyoḷoḍambaḍadudaṟiṁ, yajñaśāstraṁ janya
janaka sambandha rahita kartr̥kaṁ; svayambhuvembarappaḍe, dēvanāraka
jaḷacarādigaḷellaṁ, svayambhūtva prasaṅgamakkumadaṟiṁ pūrvāpara
viruddhaṁ; ahiṁsā lakṣaṇamuṁ, tribhuvana hitamuṁ, tattvamuṁ,
tattvajñānaṁ sarvajña praṇītamumappudāgamuṁ; yajñaśabdaṁ dāna
doḷaṁ, dēvapūjeyoḷaṁ pravartisuguṁ; yajñaṁ, kratu, makhameṁ
bivēkārthamuvaṟiṁ, yajña śabdārthamuppaḍe dēvapūjālakṣaṇaṁ dharmadiṁ
puṇyamuṁ nerapi, dēhigaḷdēvēndratvamumaneydi, śatakratu, śatamakhādi
nāmōpalakṣitarapparāyajñamuṁ, māriṣā nāriṣa (ārṣa, anārṣa)
bhēdadiṁ dvividhamakkumadaṟoḷāriṣamembudādibrahmōpadiṣṭamuṁ,
jīvādi padārtha yadātmyaprarūpaṇamumappa vēdadoḷ, krōdhā
gniyuṁ, kāmāgniyuṁ, udarāgniyumembagnitrayaṅgaḷaṁ, kṣame
yuṁ, vairāgyamuṁ upavāsamembāhutigaḷiṁ, santarpaṇaṅgeydu,

vānaprastha, r̥ṣi, yati, muni, aṇagāra, paramabrāhmaṇarātma
yajñamaṁ bēḷdu, karmanirmuktarāgi muktiyaneyduvar. tīrtha
kara, gaṇadhara, aṇagāra kēvaḷaḷi, śarīrapūjāsambandhiyappagnīndra
makuṭōdhr̥tāgnitrayaṅgaḷaṁ, paramātmabhūtarappa, pitr̥pitāmaharaṁ
pūjisalvēḍi, niravadyamappa puṣpagandhākṣataṁ, baliyuharu, purōḍāśā
digaḷaḷināripaṣa vēdamantrōccāraṇegaḷaṁ bēḷdu, vidhipūrvakaṁ, gr̥hāśrama
dīkṣeyaṁ kaikoṇḍu, mahā(arhata) brāhmaṇa dāna śīlōpavāsādi
sahitaṁ bēḷdindrasāmānikādigaḷaṁ, mānyarappa lōkāntika dēva
brāhmaṇarāgi, sura(para)lōka sukhamananubhavisuttumanādya nidhana
mappa, śrutajñāna vēdakke, dravyakṣētrakāla bhāva bhēdadiṁ, kartr̥gaḷuṁ,
pañcakalyāṇa bhāgigaḷumappa, parama brahmara pariniṣkramaṇa kalyāṇadoḷ
pūjisi, dēvapūjāvidhi samudbhava puṇya paripāka jātābhyudayabhōga
(sukha)mananubhavisi, kramadindaṁ muktige salva(rari)ntu, pārampā
ryadiṁ, vēdayajñaṅjñāṅgaḷoḷ, negaḻda brāhmaṇarubhaya lōkahita
vidāyuyigaḷaṁḷeṁ tāripi yajñamaṁ pravartisuttire, mahākāḷanemboṁ
asuraṁ, sagaravaira sambandhadiṁ, munisuvratanāthara tīrthasantāna
doḷ, hiṁsālakṣaṇamappanāripaṣa yajñakke modaliganāvanadennentendoḍe—–

jambūdvīpada, bharata kṣētrada, cāraṇayugaḷavemba poḻiḻalanāḷvaṁ,
suyōdhananembarasaṅgaṁ, atithiyembarasigaṁ, suḷaseyemba magaḷāda
ḷākeya svayambarakkarasumakkaḷellaṁ nereye, sākētapati sagaranuṁ
pōgalirdondu divasaṁ, musaṁmajjana gr̥hadoḷ, gandhatraitailadiṁ śirōbhyaṅga
naṅgeykuyyuttumondu nareyuṁyaṁ kaṇḍu, nirvērbēgadiṁ, svayambara gamana
nirādaranāgirpuduṁ; maṇḍōdari embadādiyendaḷ- prathama paḷita
darśanaṁ pavitraṁ dravyalābhamaṁ pēḻguṁ. idu sirinareyendarasaṅge
santōṣamaṁ māḍe, viśvabhūtiyemba mantriyendaṁ- svayambarakke
neredarasugaḷgaḷge, parāṅmukhiyāgi, suḷase ninagappanppaḷentenna kuśaḷikeyuṁyiṁ
māṟpeḍvenembudumatiprītanāgi, caturaṅga balaṁ berasu, suyōdhana
purakke pōge, kelavu divasadiṁ, sagarana rūpu, saundarya, vinaya,
vibhava, parākramādigaḷananyasādhāraṇaṅgaḷmāḍe, maṇḍōdari tanagaṟipede,
suḷase sōltudanaṟidavarabbeyatithiyendaḷ-—ḷ– suramya viṣayada,
pōdanapurādhipati bāhubalidēvana santānadoḷ, puṭṭidoṁ tradontr̥ṇapiṅgaḷa

nembonemmrammaṇṇanātanarasi sarvayuyaśōdēviyemboḷavarge puṭṭidoṁ,
madhupiṅgaḷanemboṁ, sañjāta(abhijana) vidyāvratarūpupavinaya vibhava
parākramādi guṇasamanvitanadaṟinennaṁ bagedennaḷiyaṅge, nīṁ māleyaṁ
sūḍuvudu; sagaranappoḍe vr̥ddhanātanaṁ bayuyase, ninage jarāvaniteyuṁ
savati māḍadirendu, virakta citteyu māḍi, maṇḍōdarigengandimbaṟiyuṁ,
bāgiluvārise, dādipēṟi, saṟsagaraṁ, prastuta kāryaṁ vighātamādudana
ṟidennabhilasita(prēta) kāryamanoḷakoḷisal, naralōka br̥haspati
yenisidenna pergaḍe viśvabhūti sālgumendadātanuṁ, kanyakāmanōja
lakṣaṇa prarūpaṇapūrvakadiṁ, piṅgākṣādi tadviparīta lakṣaṇa puruṣa nirā
karaṇadiṁ, svayambara śāstramanutpādisi, pottageyoḷ baredu, manmunda
sinoḷikki, peraraṟiyadantu, neladoḷ pūḻdiṟdirdu, kelavu divasadiṁ,
svayambarakkudyānamaṁvaṁ sōdhisuvalli, nēgilamoneyoḷneḷnigeda, manmundasi
noḷagirda pottageyuṁ kaṇḍu, tānaṟiyadantu, kr̥tavismayadinidu
purāṇa pustakamendu nereda sabheyoḷ, piṅgākṣaṅge kanyaki māle sūḍi
doḍe, pañcamahāpātaka bhāgiyayukkumāpiṅgākṣanaṁ sabheyoḷpugisalā
gaduveventtānuṁ pokkaḍe, ātana meṭṭideḍeyoḷ, sagaṇi nīraṁ taḷivupu
dendu bājisi, madhupiṅgaḷaṁ vōḷampōduvudaṅkēḷdu, ā guṇaṁ tanaguḷḷa
daṟiṁ, nāṇci, peṟaraṟiyalīyade(dantu) pōgi, hariṣēṇa gurugaḷa
pakkade, dīkṣeyaṁyuṁ kaikoṇḍanadaṅkēḷdu, sagaraṁ viśvabhūti prabhr̥tigaḷ
santuṣṭarādar.

itta suyōdhananuṁ, sahasrakūṭadoḷaṣṭāhnika pūjeyuṁmāḍi,
jinapadābhiṣēka snānapūrvakaṁ mahādarśanaratyātnā snānaṅgeysi, vastrā
bharaṇādigaḷinaḷaṅkr̥taṁ māḍi, śubhatithiyoḷ suḷaseyuṁ svayambara
śāleguyye, purōhitaṁ mundirdu(ṭṭu), bhadrāsanādhirūḍharapparasu
makkaḷanukramadoḷ, kuḷa, baḷa, vijñāna parākramādigaḷaṁ pēḻdaṟda
tōṟidoḍārumanollade, munne tāṁ bayuyasidaḷappudaṟiṁ sagaraṅge
māle sūḍidoḍāgaḷanurūpa samānamādudendu santōṣaṁ baḍe,
vivāha kalyāṇa parisamāptiyoḷ, sākētakke pōgi, sagaraṁ sukha
mirpinaṁ.

itta madhupiṅgaḷa muniyuṁ, dvādaśa vidha tapadoḷneḷnigaṟdonṟi್dondu
poḻiṟalge(dinaṁ purakke) carigevōpōge, naimittikanōrvanavara śarīra lakṣa

ṇamuṁ kaṇḍītaṁ, rājyārhalakṣaṇa śarīraṁ tapada nivēśadoḷ ninda
nendu tannimittaṁ śāstramuṁ nirākarise, mattorvanendaṁ— sagara
mantri māḍidaḷika kābyadindītaṅge, tapambaḍuvudādudābyabyājadoḷ
suḷaseyuṁ sagaraṁ parigrahisidanembudumuṁmudaṁ kēḷdu, atikrōdhadahana
santāpa(tapta)nāgi muni, munidenna tapada phaḷamuṇṭappaḍe, maṟubhava
doḷ sagara vaṁśamuṁ nirmūḷanaṁ māḻpeṟpenakkuṁkkeṁ(neṁ)du nidānaṁ
geydu, jīvitāntyadoḷ, asurēndrana mahiṣānīka prathamuma kakṣe
yoḷ, catuḥṣaṣṭi sahasra dēvādhipati mahākāḷanembonāgi, tanna bhava
sambandhamuṁ vibhaṅgajñānadinaṟidu, tanna vairigaḷappa sagaranumuṁ,
mantriyumuṁ āgaḷe kolalendāgrahaṅgeydu,(kolalbagedavaruge
ydudu), kiṟidu puṇyamuṇṭu sugatige salvaradaṟinupāyadoḷavaraṁ
pāpadoḷ negaḻciṟci narakādi duḥkhaṅgaḷanuṇbantu māḍi tadvaṁśamuṁ
nirmūḷaṁ māḻpeṟpenendippinaṁ. itta, jambūdvīpada, bharatakṣētrada,
dhavaḷa viṣayada, svastikāvatī viṣayamunāḷva, harivaṁśada, viśvāvasugaṁ
śrīmatidēvigaṁ, vasuvemba maganādoṁ. ā poḷaloḷaṁ pārvaṁ kṣīra
kadambanemboṁ, upādhya padaviyoḷ nile, parvatanuṁ, nāradanumemba
rātana makkaḷ, rājakumāra vasuvuṁ, matta dēśāntaradimbanda,
bhātrarubhrātrumātanalliye vidyāpāragarāge, parvatanōrvanuṁ, viparītagrāhi
yādonuḷidarellaṁ yathōpadiṣṭitagrāhiyādorondu dedēvasa mupā
dhyāyaroḍane vasuvuṁ, parvatanuṁ, nāradanuṁ berasu samiddarbhe
puṣpādigaḷaṁ taralpōdarannegamondu, giri śikhara śiḷālātaḷadoḷ, śruta
dhararemba r̥ṣigaḷirdaravara śiṣyamūrvarmūvarumaṣṭāṅga mahānimittamuṁ
kaltu, parisamāptiyoḷ, gurubhaktipūrvakaṁ, kuḷḷirdaḍavara balmeyuṁ
parīkṣisalendu gurugaḷ besagoṇḍar—

ī brāhmaṇanoḍanebarpa mūvaruṁ śiṣyara kulamuṁ, pariṇā-
mavuṁmuṁ, gatiyumāvudu pēṟimene, munnonnamorvanendanī munde
bappātanarasaramumagaṁ, vasuvemboṁ, tīvrarāgadvēṣa mōha pariṇā-
madiṁ, hiṁsādharmamuṁ niścayisi, pātāḷa nimagnanāgi narakambugu-
gumembudu; eraḍaneyuya muniyendanī naḍuve bappātanuṁ brāhmaṇana
magaṁ, parvatanemboṁ, jaḍamati mahākāḷōpadēśadiṁ adharma
nirūpitamappa hiṁsādharmadoḷesagi, hiṁsānanda raudradhyāna pariṇā

madiṁ narakagāminiyayukkumene (narakakke pōkumene); mūṟaneyuya
muniyendanellaṟiṁ pēṟige bappātaṁ, brāhmaṇanamagaṁ nāradanemboṁ,
dharmadhyānadi (sukha) pariṇāmabhāvaneyiṁ, ahiṁsālakṣaṇamappa dharma
doḷesagi, girataṭa(taṁ) nagarādhipatiyāgi, sarvasaṅga parityāgaṅgeydu,
tapadoḷnaḍadu, sarvārtha siddhige salgumene, mūvara nuḍiyu navadhā
risi, śāstratatvamanoḷḷittāgi kaikoṇḍirendu, gurugaḷavaraṁ praśaṁse
geydu, kṣīra kadambaṁ pratyāsannataru gulma latāntaritanāgirdadellavaṁvuṁ
kēḷdu, vidhivihita minnidakke geyyal bakkumendallirda r̥ṣiyuraṁ
bandisi, vaimanasyadiṁ poḻiṟalaṁ pokkanantēḻuṟu varṣadintaguḻda, paṟdudi
nālku varṣambaraṁ, sarvaśāstra pāraganāda vasuviṅge yauvana pari
pūraṇadoḷ paṭṭaṅgaṭṭi, viśvavasu tapōvanakke pōdaṁ.

vasuvuṁ pr̥thviyuṁ niḥkaṇṭakaṁmāḍi, rājyaṅgeyyuttirdondu
divasaṁ, vanavihārakkepōgi, nōḻpaḷpanannegamākāśadoḷ pāṟuva pakki
gaḷ, kalloḷtāgidante keḍevudaṅkaṇḍēṁ kāraṇadiṁ, vihaṅga praskhaḷana
pātamādudendavaṁ parīkṣisaleccu nōḷpudumummambu kalloḷtāgi keḍe
dudaṅkaṇḍu, rathikanuṁ tānuṁ āścaryambaṭṭeḻdaṭṭēṟda(eṭṭeṭṭē) pōgi,
kayyoḷeḷavi nōḻpuḷpudavākāśasphaṭikamaṇi stambhavendaṟidu, peṟaraṟi
yayudantu tandadaṁ siṁha viṣṭarakke pādacatuṣṭayaṁ māḍi, siṁhāsanā
rūḍhanantarikṣadoḷippantirdu, sāvantaparivāra parivr̥tanāgire, vasu
tanna satyaphaladiṁ nelanaṁ muṭṭade, siṁhāsanārūḍhanantarikṣadoḷirpa
nembavāsaneyuṁ jagatprasitsiddhamāgirpinavondu divasaṁ, parvatanuṁ,
nāradanuṁ, samitpuṣpa nimittamaḍavige barutamondā toṟeya taḍi
yoḷ nīruṇalbandu pōdavumayūra (mārga)vuṁmuṁ kaṇḍu, nārada
nendanele parvata, nōḍilli nīruṇḍupōda navilgaḷoḷondu gaṇḍēlibaṟi
peṇṇembuduṁ. adaṁ kēḷdu, sairisadoḍavemēnendu parvataṁ kiṟidaṁ
taraṁ pōgi, nāradana pēḻdinṟdindadoḷekaṇḍu vismitanāgi, matte mante
kiṟidantaramuṁ pōge, karēṇumārgavuṁmuṁ kaṇḍu, nāradanendanībaṭṭe
yoḷaṁ piḍipōdudadaṟiḍada kaṇṇilladanēṟi pōdākeyuṁ garbhiṇi
biḷidaṁ mēlkoṇḍaḷākeyumindu magambaḍadaḷene, parvatanendanelli
yānuṁnuvondudiṭaṁ pēḻda taṟduguḷe gaḷapidappe, tannabalmeyuṁ puruḷanā
naṟiyayudanallenendasahananāgi barutuṁ, nagara samīpadoḷandha kaṟiṇi

yumuṁ, biḷidaṁ podedadanēṟi bandāke mugaṁ baḍedudumuṁ nārada
pēḻdanḻdindadoḷe kaṇḍāścaryambaṭṭu, nija jananiyallige bandenda
nemmayya nenage śāstratattvamamunoḷḷittāgipēḻde, nāradaṅge savistaraṁ
pēḻdirendu, tattvapañprañcamamunaṟipe, pārvanti mamuganamātaṁ nambi, snānā
gnihōtra dēvārcanā parisamāptiyoḷ, atithi parigraha pūrvaka
muṇḍu bandu, kuḷḷirda kṣīra kadambaṅgadellamuṁ nivēdise, pārva
nendaṁ.

ānīrvargaṁ nirviśēṣamupadēśaṁ geydeneyddenuttuṁ, “pratipuruṣaṁ
bhinnabuddhiyaḥ” embudu buddhiviśēṣadiṁ, “śāstrārthame puṇyamārga
marūpamukku” maendakke nāradanoḷappa maccaraṁ bēḍendavara keladoḷ,
nāradana buddhiyuṁ parīkṣisalendu upādhyāyanendanaraṇyadoḷmayūra
mārgādidarśanamuṁvuṁ nīnaṟidandamāvāvudene - vinayadiṁ nāradanendaṁ
parvatanumānuṁ naguttuṁ nuḍiyuttumpōge, nīruṇḍu muguḻda
navila pajjejjiyuṁ kaṇḍalli, sōge nāndoḍe naḍeyulbāradendu pimmemmaṭṭi
nīruṇḍu pōda baḻiṟiyumipadārdrirdrīkr̥ta patrabhāramuṁ bidirdu
pōda baḻiṟiyumuṁ kamuṅkaṇḍanumānadindamonvondugaṇḍēṟuṁṟiṁ peṇṇendaṟideṁ.
karēṇu mārgadoḷpaścimaccimupādadiṁ svamūtra saṅghaṭṭana prayāṇadindaṁ,
dakṣiṇabhāga tarulatāgulma śākhā bhaṅgōpayōgadindaṁ, baṭṭegeṭṭu pōpu
daṟindadu kariṇiyenduṁ, adakke vāmēkṣaṇamillendumaṟidemudanē-
ṟidāke, nadīpuḷinasitacchāyā pradēśadoḷ paṭṭōṭṭoīdudarasparśana
lāñchanadindāke garbhiṇiyendaṟideṁ, mēldalddara seraṅgineḷegaḷ kelada
muḷmaradoḷ toḍadirdoḍe biḷidaṁ podedaḷendaṟideṁ; piḍiyirdramane
yoḷ guḍiyuṁ, baddaddhavaṇamumeseye mugambaḍadaḷendaṟideneṁ-
buduṁ. kṣīrakadambaṁ tanagaparādhamunāgalīyudantātana mativiśēṣamuṁvaṁ
avargetōṟi, mattondu divasaṁ munnēnnepēḻda munijanādēśa śravaṇa
sandigdha cittanavarirvara bhāvamuṁ parirīkṣisalendu, ēkāntadoḷ tānuṁ
brāhmaṇiyumirderaḍu pōtaṁ piṭṭinoḷmāḍi, gandhamālyādigaḷinarcisi
vanapradēśadoḷiṭṭu, perarkāṇadantirvarumivara kiviyunaṟidu tappuppū
dene, parvataraṇya pradēśadoḷārkaṇḍaparendaṟidu tandaṁ; nāradanuṁ
gurūpadēśadiṁ pōgi, tannoḷ bagedu, manuṣyarkāṇadoḍantirikaṁ
kāṇugumagamuvukāṇadoḍaṁ jyōtirgaṇaṅkāṇugumagamuvukāṇadoḍaṁ byantarādi

gaḷ kāṇbamudaṟindaṟi dentu karṇacchēdanaṁ geydendusirade,
koṇḍubandu gurugaḷa mundiṭṭu, peṟaṟa rāṟākāryaṇadurṇaḍu dondeḍeyillavuṁ-
ppudaṟiṁ karṇacchēdanaṅgeydu nilla; nāmasthāpanādravyabhāvalakṣaṇavappa
padārthaṅgaḷoḷ, pāpaprakhyāti(ta) saṁsā(baṁ)dhana kriyegaḷa kārya-
mudanaṟidu, negabilāgadendu bandenene, nāradaṅge (danaṁ) mecci
parvatana jaḍatvamamunaṟidu, “kāraṇānurūpaṁ kārya” mendu nuḍi
vēkānta vādigaḷa mātupusi, kāraṇa kāryadvitayaguṇaṅgaḷaṁ nuḍiva
nēkānta vādigaḷa nuḍiye satyavāgirkumēmenēkānta vādigaḷa tatvame
tatvamenduniścayisi, nāradanendu nīnindumodalāge, nīnupādhyāya
padaviyoḷḷillulla, palargaṁ vyākhyānaṁ geyvudendātanaṁ pūjisi, parva-
tananendaṁ.
maganē, nīṁ vivēkamilladenegaṟdu pollakeydu, ennaparōkṣadoḷi
nnentu bāḷviyānappoḍe, dariyumaranippaṁ(daṁ)te patanōnmukhanāgi
rdenendu tandeyuvajña geydopamānadinati lajjitanāgi, nāradaṅge
manadoḷmuḷidirpinaṁ; kṣīrakadambaṁ sarvasaṅga parityāgaṅgeyyal
bagedu, vasuvinallige bandintendanenna pārvantiyuṁ, parvatanumappoḍa
vivēka vikaḷa matigaḷadaṟinavargentuṁ, punakṣata māgadantu nīṁ nega
ḻdudideyenage kuḍuva gurudakṣaṇeyuṁ idendu nuḍiye, vasuvendaṁ
nimmanugrahamanoḷkittāgi kaikoṇḍenagadēṅgahanaṁ, parvatana deśege
niścintarāgi paratrārthadoḷ negaṟimendu pādapraṇāmapūrvakaṁ
visarjise, parasipōgi, saṁyamamaṁ kaikoṇḍu, kṣīrakadambaṁ sura
lōkakkesandaṁ. parvatanuṁ pitrasthānadoḷnindu śiṣyavargakke śāstrō
padēśaṅgeyyuttirdaṁ. nāradanumāpoḻaloḷ, samasta vidvajjana
pūjitanuṁ, sūkṣmamatiyuṁ, śāstrārtha tatvanipuṇanumenisi, diganta
vyāptakīrtiyāgirdanantirpinamondudivasaṁ. “ajairhōtavya” vemba
vākyārtha prarūpaṇadoḷ ajaśabdamuṁ parvatanuṁ paśuvāciyene, nāra
danōṣadhivāciyene, visaṁvādamāge, dharmādhikaraṇaṁ neradu besagoḷe,
matta nāradanendaṁ trivarṣōpēta yavabījamupagatāṅkura śaktikamaja
membudu, tadvikāradinagni mukhadoḷ māḷpudēvārcanaṁ, yajñaveṁ
budendārṣavēdāgamu prasiddhiyaṁ nuḍiye, parvatanendaṁ ajaśabdaṁ
paśuviśēṣaṁ, tadvikāradinappagnihōtraṁ yajñavendu nijābhiprāyuvaṁ

prakaṭaṁ māḍidoḍe, avarirvara nuḍiyuṁ brāhmaṇa pramukha sādhugaḷ
kēḷdu, parvataṅgemuḷidu, sānāradana maccaradōḷitaṁ hiṁsālakṣaṇavuṁ
dharmavendu pāvembampamāḍaloḍarcidanīdurātmanoḷsambhāṣaṇegeyvudumamu
yōgyamivaṁ pātaviṁvampākanendu pañcatāḷaṅguṭṭi ghō(do)ṣise, parvatanuṁ
mānabhaṅgadināṟumavaṟiyadantu poṟaliṁ poramaṭṭu, vanagahana
doḷ barpanannentegaṁ.

brāhmaṇa vēṣadharanuṁ, pariṇatavayanuṁ, daṇḍahastanumāgi, sagara
suḷasā viśvabhūti nibandhana krōdhapariṇāmamumē triguṇita bhūtamāvādaṁ
tirda yayujñōpavītamuṁ tāḷdi jaṭādhavaḷapauḷiyuṁ, praskhalitapadavi
nyāsanumāgibarpa, mahākāḷāsuranaṁ parvataṁ kaṇḍu, pratyutthānaṁ
geydu vinayadinabhivādaṅgeyyayye, svastivacanadinātanaṁ parasi, mahākāḷa
naṟiyadantu besagoṇḍa nettaṇiṁ bandēṅbandembakāraṇadiṁ ninagaraṇya bhramaṇa
mādudene, parvataṁ nijavr̥ttāntamumaṁ, paribhramaṇa kāraṇamumana
ṟipe, mahākāḷanenna vairiyuyappa, sākētapatiyuṁyaṁ nirvaṁśaṁ māḷpaḍilli nī-
tanenage sahāyanā(vā)galtekkenltakkanendaṟidu, vañcana praṇayacittaniṁ
tendaṁ. ānuṁ nimmayyanappa kṣīrakadambanuṁ, viṣṇuvuṁ, sthaṇḍilanuṁ,
upamanyumenventīyuyayvaruṁ, muṁ bhaumōvōpādhyāyara pakkade, śāstrā
bhyāsaṅgeydu mamudaṟiṁ, nimmayyanumānuṁnumuṁ, sahādhyāyigaḷemā
tanaṁ nōḍalendu bandu, kāṇalbaḍade millemma bambarapuṁvuṁ, niḥphalamāytā
doḍaṁ, ninna śatruvidhvaṁsanakke, sahāyanappenañjadirendu, parvatābhi
prētārthānusārigaḷumatharvaṇagataṅgaḷuṁ, ṣaṣṭi sahasra pramāṇaṅgaḷu
mappa ricer̥jegaḷanutpādisi, vēda rahasyaṅgaḷivendaṟipi, parvatananōdisi,
śānti pauṣṭyabhicāra lakṣaṇakriyegaḷ mantra(sa)hitaṅgaḷādandu,
kiccuṁ gāḷiyuṁ kūḍidante, nissaṁśayamiṣṭārthaphalapradaṅgaḷakku
mendaṟipi, nijavaira praśamanārthaṁ, svabhāvadindamaśubha kriyānu
raktarappasurarambarisi, sagaraviṣayakke viṣamajvara vyādhiyuṁ māḍiyeṁ
pappayisi, tat śāntihōtr̥travāgi parvataṁ chātrasahitaṁ sākētamaṁmuṁ
pokku, mantrāśīrvādapūrvakaṁ sagaranaṁ kaṇḍu, tanna sāmarthyamamu
naṟipi, ninnaviṣayadavyādhi dōṣamuṁ, mantrapūrvakaṁ, yajña kriye
yoḷe kaḷevenendu, yajñaprabhāvamamunarasaṅgaṟipalintendaṁ—

“yajñārthamuṁ sarva santr̥ptyarthamumāge paśugaḷaṁ brahmaṁ
paḍapadana”daṟiṁ yajñavadhamempathavembudu puṇyārthamallade pāpārthamallendu
nambisi, parvatanaṟupavattusāsira paśuvumaṁ peṟavuṁ yāgasādhana dravyaṅga
ḷumaṁ tarisi, yāgaprārambhadoḷ prāṇigaḷaṁ mantrapūrvakadintaṟidu
bīḷebēḷi, mahākāḷanā prāṇigaḷaṁ vimānadoḷiṭṭu pūrva śarīraṁ berasu
svargakke pōpantu māḍe tōṟi, viṣayagatamappa jvarōpasargamuṁvuṁ
māṇe, kaṇḍajñānigaḷellaṁ, māyā prapañcamamunaṟiyade, yāgamaraṇa
kāṅkṣitarādarantu, yajñārthamavasānadoḷondu jātyaśvamumaṁ,
rājājñeyiṁ suḷasādēviyumanikki, baṟika kāntāviyōgasantā
padiṁ, sagaraṁ nagarakkevandenna nēgaṟdugelddu prāṇihiṁsānandamidentakku
mendu, sandēgambaṭṭirpina mondudevasaṁ, yativararemba munigaḷaṁ
bandisi, besasimevennageydaydu yāgaṁ, puṇya pāpaṅgaḷoḷāvudarke hitavakku
mene, “pāpamamukkume”ne, bhaṭṭārakarintendu, dharmaśāstra pratiṣēdhyadyamappa,
mahāpātakaṅgaḷellamamulliyoḷavappudaṟindā ninnageyda yāgaṁ, prāṇi
gaḷanēṟineyu narakakkoygumamudakke vismānmāṇamāvudembeyembpoyemppoḍindiṁ
gēṟineyudivasadandiṅge, aśanipātamāgadaḍemma pēṟdaḻdda narakagati pravēśa
māgadene, r̥ṣivacanamellamunarasaṁ tanage pēṟdaṟa parvatanendanañjadi
rellaṁ pusi; samavāyamāmupāyuvādoḍaṁ śāntikriyeyinimbumāṟveṟpenendara
sana manamaṁ sthiraṁmāḍi, mattaṁ yajña prārambhaṅgeyyayye, saptamadina
sannidhiyoḷ, mahākāḷamāḍida māyeyiṁ, parivāra sahitaṁ suḷase
munnasatta paśumr̥gaṅgaḷverasu, vimānārūḍheyāgi nabhadoḷnindu,
yāga maraṇaphaladindanāvuṁmuṁ dēvagatiyuṁ paḍedu, ninage moṟiyu
lendu bandemīyaviṁyujñadiṁ, dēva, r̥ṣi, pitr̥gaḷuṁ prī(suva)tarāda
rembudumadaṁ, pratyakṣaṅgaṇḍā sagaraṁ nambi, yāga maraṇaphalameve(vidhi
ye)satyamārhantya munigaḷ pēṟdudaḻddasatyamenvendu, tībrahiṁsā
(pāpā)nurāgadiṁ, saddharmadvēṣiyāgi, tanagahitamane hitaṁ māḍi
negaṟdu, mūlōttaraḻddamūlōtta pratyaya sahitaṁ, pratantatprayōgyasamutkr̥ṣṭa
saṅklēśasādhana(diṁ baddha)narakāyuṁ prabhr̥tyaṣṭavidha karmaṅgaḷaṁ, svōci
tōtkr̥ṣṭa sthityanubhāgadoḷ (pādā), snigdhanikācita baddha kāḷa mahā
kāḷane bandaśaniyāgi poyyayye, tatkarmānuraktarappa bahuvidhadēhigaḷve
rasu, sagaraṁ rauravamuṁ pokkanākṣaṇadoḷ, mahākāḷaṁ tanna pageyuṁ
neṟaṟipi, mattamātanaṁ daṇḍisuvenendati krōdhadiṁ, tanage saluvupuḷḷa

mūṟineyu narakambaraṁ pōgi, nōḍi kāṇade, viśvabhū(ti) prabhr̥tigaḷge,
maraṇa prayōgamaṁmuṁ māḷpalpa bageyiṁ maguḻduldu bandu, parvatana
prasādadinindenaginitu vibhūtiyādudendātanaṁ praśaṁsegeydu, vimā
nārūḍhanāgi suḷiḷaseperasu sagaranirpantu vigurvaṇeyuṁ māḍe.

sagaraṁ narakakke pōdiṁ baḻiṟiyuṁ viśvabhūti viṣaya patiyāgirdu,
mahāvēdamemba yajñamaṁmuṁ prārambhaṅgeyya, mahākāḷa, māyeyiṁ
vimānāntargatarāda dēvaruṁ, pitr̥gaḷumākāśadoḷirdu, mahāvēda
yajñamaṁmuṁ māḍida puṇyaṁ ninagalladillendu viśvabhūtiyuṁ pogaḻvanlvantu
māḍi tōṟi, nāradanuṁ r̥ṣiyayurkaḷumimadellamaṁmuṁ kēḷdu, parvatanemba
mahāpātakaṁ, durmārga pravartanaṁ māḍidanadaṟindāvupāyayudo
ḷadaṁ māṇisuvamendu sākētakkevandu, viśvabhūtiyuṁ kaṇḍintendar.
arthamuṁ kāmamuṁ sādhisalke pāpabhīrugaḷalladar, prāṇivadhadiṁ nega
ḻvalvaraṁ, dharmanimittaṁ, prāṇivadhadoḷ nimmantu negaḻvalvarārumilleṁlliṁ
trene.

emba pūrvar̥ṣi vacana pramāṇadiṁ, pāpanibandhanamappudaṁ nega
ḻalil ninagayuktamendu, muniyayurkaḷ nuḍiye, viśvabhūtiyendaṁ.
pratyakṣa yāgamaraṇa phalamaṁmuṁ kaṇḍumamudillendentumarasalbakkumamudaṁ,
lōkavemellaṁ kaṇḍapudene, nāradanendaṁ. ninagintu nuḍiyalāgadu,
hiṁsāviṣāyiyahiyuppa vākyaṁ vēdadoḷillāllavanānuṁ tanage kāyvaraṁ,
nirmūḷaṁ māḍalende nayu(dīga yupāyedoḷ) vaikriyeyiṁyuṁ
pratyakṣa yāgaphala darśanamaṁmuṁ māḍi, mahēndrajālamaṁmuṁ tōṟiyuṁ,
nimmaṁ mōhisidanadaṟindidu, satyamalla, śīlōpavāsādyādi r̥ṣi
vēdamappa yajñadoḷ(trata) neguḻdeldudene, viśvabhūti parvatananendaṁ—
nāradanidaṁ nuḍidippanidakke prativacanamaṁmuṁ kuḍivendu tannaṁ prērisi,
parvataṁ svabhāvadindamatatvajñanuṁ, mahākāḷaprabhāvamōhitanumappuppa
daṟindintendaṁ— nāradanapakhyāṇamamunāvaṟiyudanallanemmayyanappa
kṣīrakadambanemagamītaṅgamupādhyāyanappudaṟindamadhyayayuna kāla
doḷ, gurusannidhiyoḷemaṅpuṅge maccarisuvātanīgaḷāgade maccarisida

ne(ndā) madgurugaḷa dharma bhrātr̥gaḷ sthaṇḍilarembaravarjagakkellaṁ
pramāṇabhūtaravaremage vēdarahasyaṅgaḷaṁ pēḻdaraldidalladeyuṁ, yāga
maraṇa phalamuṁ pratyakṣaṁ nīmēkaṇḍirantu nambirappoḍe—

dhavaḷa viṣayayuda, svastikāvatīpuramamunāḷva, vasurājaṁ satyaparanemba
vacanaṁ jagatprasiddhamamudaṟinātanaṁ besagoḷvamene, nāradanendaṁ—
prāṇivadhame dharmasādhanaṁ, dānōpavāsa śīla prabrājyādigaḷ, pāpa
sādhanamembeyappoḍe, matsyaśvabambandha śākunika śauśēkarādigaḷellamamu viśiṣṭa
dharmāvāptiyukkumantalteltu, yajñadoḷ paśuvadhaṁ puṇyahētuvamuḷi
deḍeyoḷpāpahētuvemmembeyappoḍeraḍeḍegaṁ, duḥkhahētu samānamappa
daṟiṁ, phaḷadoḷ samānavāgalelipēḻkuḷkumadaṟiṁ, yuktiśūnya yajñā
rthadiṁ, paśugaḷaṁ brahmaṁ paḍedanembeyappoḍe, paśugaḷ peṟapeṟaveḍegupa
yōgigaḷāgalāgaventendoḍe— ślēṣma praśamanārthaṁ koṭṭauṣadhaṁ peṟa
puḷi dōṣakaravamappantu, yajñārthadiṁ paḍeda paśugaḷe, kraya
vikraya, dōhana vāhanādigaḷoḷupayōgigaḷādandaniṣṭa phaḷaprāpti
prasaṅgamamukkuṁ. kaydugaḷiḷaneṁ(geṁ)tu prāṇa(ṇi)gaḷaṁ byāpādisi
doḍentaśubha pāpaṁ kaṭṭugumante, mantragaḷiṁ paśugaḷaṁ kondaḍe,
duḥkarmabandhamakkumentuṁ, hiṁsādi dhōṣaṁ kiḍugumalteltu, pitā
mahaṁ paḍevāgaḷ uḷḷudaṁ paḍedano mēṇilladudaṁ paḍedano,
munnamuṇṭappoḍe paḍevude kāraṇamillamudaṁ paḍevanappoḍe, śaśaśr̥ṅga,
gaganapuṣpādigaḷanēke paḍedanillidellaṁ, svavacanaviruddhamendu nāradaṁ
parvatanaṁ niruttaraṁ māḍe nuḍidu, sabhāsadariṁ labdha pra(sanna)śaṁsa
nāgi, namage vasurājaṁ pramāṇamappoḍāvudu dōṣavāmātanaṁ besa
goḷvamendu, nāradapramukharvasuvinalligevare(gōge), parvatana prarō
paṇeyiṁ, tadvr̥ttāntamanaṟidu, parvataṁ berasaparaḻbabdhayuppa pārvanti
vasuvinallige rahasyadoḷpōgi, ninnaguru tapōvanakke pōpandennamannupa
nītanumaṁmuṁ, ninage keyyoyyaḍeyenyonda(goṭṭa)ppayisida nadaṟinīgaḷ,
parvataṅgaṁ, nāradaṅgaṁ, saṁ(vi)pāvādavāgi bandarāvipāvādadoḷ, bhaṅga
mādandu, parvataṅge sāvude paricchēdavāmāvudumanīmeve(muṁ nīne)ya
ṟiyudirene, gurupatni prārthaneyo(vaśyā)ḷaṁ, guruparōkṣa(śikṣa)vina
yābhiprāyudoḷaṁ, vasuvendaṁ, abbānīmidakkēnuṁ śaṅkisade niścinta
miri, parvataṅge sarvaprakāradoḷaṁ, mānabhaṅgamanāgalīyenendu

pōgalvēḻiṟi, mattondu divasamākāśa sphaṭika maṇi pāda vidhr̥ta siṁha
viṣṭarārūḍhanāgirda, vasurājanaṁ viśvabhū prabhr̥tigaḷ bandu besagoṇḍa
rele, mahāpuruṣa(harṣa) kēḷ, ahiṁsādi dharmaparara(rī)kṣaṇa para
tantrarappa nimma pūrvajar, himagiri, mahāgiri, samagiri, vasugiri
suragiri prabhr̥tigaḷumintī vaṁśatiḷakarapparasugaḷ palarumatikrāntarāgi,
nimmayyaṁ dharma parāyaṇaṁ, mahāpuruṣaṁ, puṭṭidanātaṅgaṁ, lakṣmī
matidēvigaṁ, ahiṁsālakṣaṇa paramamu satyavādiyuṁ nyāya dharmanu
menisidanīṁ puṭṭide, nīyudaṟiṁ sandēhasthānadoḷentu viṣāgni
tulādi viśēṣaṅgaḷuṁ, pramāṇamunte, nīṁ pramāṇavāgirdeyuda
ṟindahiṁsā lakṣaṇaṁ dharmamendu nāradaṁ nuḍidaṁ; hiṁsālakṣaṇaṁ
dharmamendu parvataṁ nuḍidaṁ; nimugaṁ tamugaṁ kṣīrakadambācārya
rentupadēśaṅgeydarā sthitiyoḷ pakṣapātamillade pēḻenṟindu tannaṁ śā್ra
visi besagoḷe— vasurājanāriṣamaprāptavacanamuṁ paramatatvamanaṟiva
nāgiyuṁ, mahākāḷana saṁmōhadoḷaṁ, duṣṭaṣvamu kāḷāsannatvadoḷaṁ,
parvatana kaikoṇḍa pakṣamamune saṁsthāpanaṅgeyyalendu, pakṣapātadiṁ saṁra
kṣaṇānanda raudradhyāna pariṇatanintendaṁ—

sagaranentu hiṁsāka(thadha)rmadiṁ suralōkakke sandanadaṟiṁ,
namumagaṁ pramāṇamude, munnamuriyuttamirda soḍaraṁ, soḍagorṁrgoṇḍara
ḍarasuvante, kāṇuttirdentillenalbakkumendu, hiṁsānanda mr̥ṣānanda
dhyāna pariṇāmabhāgiyuṁ, baddha narakāyuṣyanumāgi, pāpaka(kka)rmō
pavā(rā)dakkañjade, hiṁsādharmave paramārthamanmudaṟoṟintoḷnīvuṁ
negaḻviremlvemembī pāpavākyaṅgaḷ, vasuvina mukhadiṁ poramaḍuvāgaḷ,
diṅmukhaṅgaḷellaṁ masi malinaṅgaḷādavākāśadiṁ, rudhira varṣavādudā
dityamaṇḍaḷaṁ maḷaṁmaṁsuḷapāytu, tōṟigaḷellaṁ pratikūḷa pravāhaṅgaḷā
davu, tīvida koḷaṅgaḷellaṁ battidavu, carācara prāṇigaḷellaṁ kada(katha)
kampanagoṇḍavu, hā hā krandanaṅgaḷkeḷgegaḻdapāgaldvāḷ, nāradanuṁ, muni
gaḷumeḷampeddu pañcamahāpātakaṁ pakṣapātadinintanyāyayu pravartanaṁ geyda
nendu viṣaṇṇarāgi, bāyuṁ biṭṭirpinaṁ, avara biṭṭa bāyoḷānelaṁ
oliṟi(movoḷagi)bāydaṟiye, vasurājanaṁ nuṅgalendu banda,
kr̥tānta mukha vivaradantirda mahīvivaradoḷ, siṁhaviṣṭaraṁ keḷagi
ḷiye kaṇḍu, dēvaruṁ, vidyādhararuṁ, purātana caritramanatikramisi,

vasurājaṁ hiṁsādharmamuṁ māḍi polla keydanene, siṁhāsanamaṇmaḍigi
ḷiye vaimāmanasyadoḷ dīnamukharāgirda vasurājanumaṁnuṁmuṁ parvatanumaṁnuṁmuṁ
mahākāḷana besadoḷtāpasa vēṣadhārigaḷāgirdasurarañjadiri, nāmirdante
siṁhāsanamaṇmaḍagiḷiyalēkittevendu mēgettuvantāge māḍi tōṟi,
vasurājaṁ nambi, parvatana vacaname paramārthamuṁ, satyamuṁ māṇade
takkañjuvenendu, mapattamudane nuḍiye, koralvaramudārgardāgaḷ sādhu
janaṅgaḷellaṁ neredu, vasurāja! nīnintappaḍaṁ, satyavacanamuṁ nuḍipuprada
satyadindaṁ, ninagiṁ(ni)tādudeneyuyuṁmollade, mattaṁ, hiṁsādharmamamune
paramārthamendu nuḍiye, muḷidu nēlanātananiḷeyikkidante guḷummane
keḷagiḷidēṭineyuya narakakke pōdanāgaḷmahākāḷaṁ, sarvajagatpratyattrayārtha
mākāśadoḷ, sagarana vasurājana rūpamuṁ tōṟi, yāga maraṇa
mahātmyadiṁ dēvarādaradariṁ nāradanamātaṁ kaikoḷḷadirimenda dr̥śya
māge, bhuvanajanamevellaṁ vismitaruṁ, viṣaṇṇarumāgi. vasurājaṁ
saptamanarakakke pōdanembudaṁ pusi, suralōkakke pōdanendu nambi,
viśvabhūvuṁ prayāgeyoḷ rājasūyamemba yajñamuṁ māḍi, mahā
puramumanāḷva bhūpati pramukharbhuvanajanada maruḷtanakke vismayaṁ
baṭṭu, paramuma brahmasamuddippa mārgānuraktarappudaṟindaṁ, nārada
nemba puṇyavantaniṁ, dharma maryāde naḍadappudendātaṅge, giritaṭa
vempemba poḻiṟila nāḷkegoṭṭu, muniyuyarkaḷuṁ dayādharma vighaṭana
viṣāda vicaḷita cittarkaḷāgi tantammāśramakke podaru.

itta, mattondu divasaṁ, dinakaranemba vidyādharaṁ nāradanasalli
gevare, parvatanu māḍida sakaḷalōkaviruddhamappa caritamanentappaḍā
kaḷepudene, vidyādharanante geyvenendu pōgi, samumuṁ(ji)dita vidyā
prabhāvanappa, gāndhārapannennagaraṁ besase, mahākāḷanadanaṟidu, mattaṁ
pratikūḷanāgi bandondu muhūrtambaraṁ kāde, tatpratvabhāvadiṁ tanna
sāmarthyaṁ keḍe, mahākāḷaṁ bhaṅgavāpāgi podanitta yajñāntarāyayu
māge. viśvabhūvuṁ parvatanu madaṅkaṇḍella puguvamembumaṟiyadire
bāyumbiḍe, mahākāḷaṁ bandemmavma vairigaḷappa, nāgar namaginitu
vighnamaṁmuṁ māḍidarā nāgavidyegaḷ vidyānuvāda pūrvasamuddiṣṭiṣṭa
taṅgaḷaṁmappudaṟiṁ, jinabimbaṅgaḷa mēlavaṟi vijr̥mbhaṇaṁ sallavu,
jinabimbaṅgaḷaṁ dikṭtukcatuṣṭayadoḷiṭṭarcisi, mattaṁ nīvu yajñakkoḍarci
mendu pāyuvamuṁvaṁ pēḻdu pōge, diḷiddapōgedinanakaradēvaṁ, yajñavighnaṁ

māḍalbandubhagavadarhat pratibimbātilaṅghanadoḷvidyādēvategaḷa
śaktikiḍe, tatpratvapañcamuṁ nāradaṅgaṟipi pōdanitta, nirvighnadiṁ yajñaṁ
geydu, viśvabhūvuṁpuṁ(tiyuṁ), parvatanuṁ, jīvitāntadoḷ, naraka
duḥkhamuṁ palakālamanubhavisuttirdaritta; mahākāḷaṁ tanna manōgata
prayōjanamellamuṁ tīrcidimbaṟiṭiyuṁ, divyamūrtiyuṁ kaikoṇḍu
bandennā madhupiṅgaḷanādandina baddha vairamuṁ nenedu, sagarana viśva
bhūmanmuntriyu mātsaryadininitaṁ māḍidanahiṁsālakṣaṇaveveṁ dharmaveṁ
paralōkārthigaḷ hiṁsādharmadoḷnegaṟdarivenḻddiridu palaraṟiye
nuḍidu pōgi, tānuṁ prāyaścittaṁ goṇḍaṁ.

itta, parvataṁ sagaraṁ vasurājaṁ viśvabhūnaraka gāmigaḷāda
rembudaṁ divyajñānigaḷ pēṟdaṟa vivēka matigaḷuṁ pāpabhīrugaḷu
mappavarella parvatana pēṟdaḻdda mārgamuṁ pattuviṭṭu, mūḍhamati kela
rentuṁ pattuviḍade, kumārgadoḷ naḍadaparendatiśayamati mantri
pēṟdu maḻddattaminnariṣṭa jinatīrthasantānadoḷappaṁ, brahmāṇḍa purāṇamuṁ
divyajñānigaḷappa guṇavara (gaṇadhara) muniyuyara pakkade tanna kēḷdandade,
anādinidhananirantara yajñagōcara hiṁsādūṣaṇamuṁ sakaḷabhavana
pramāṇabhūtamappa, byāsanaśiṣyaṁ rōmaharṣaṇanindaṟipalirdudaṁ,
nēmijina tīrthakara kāladindamuvuttara kāladoḷappa vyāsavacana pramāṇa
tvadindaṁ, jagadoḷ vartisalpaṭṭulbaṭṭadanintendaṟipidaṁ. vyāsamuni
yembanondu vēdamuṁ, r̥gyajuḥsāmātharvaṇa bhēdadi nālkukreśreṟisāge
māḍi avarkaṅgōpāṅgamumuṁmuṁ, purāṇamumuṁmuṁ, dharmaśāstramumuṁmuṁ
māḍi, tanna śiṣyaru jaiminiyuṁ, sumantuvuṁ, (śai) paiḷanuṁ,
vaiśampāyananumemba nālvargamamuṟipi, jagadoḷ pramāṇabhūtavāgi
naḍeye, nēmitīrthadoḷāda yajñavidhiyoḷ, r̥ṣi, dēva, narapatigaḷinu
palakṣitamappa mahāsabheyōḷ, sūtanemboṁ vividha purāṇa nirūpaṇaṁ
geyyayye, kēḷdu, mecci, tamage rōmamu harṣamāge, sabhāsada
rāṟātaṅge (antē) rōmaharṣaṇanembapesaraṁ koṭṭu, narakādi duḥkha
nirākaraṇadiṁ, sukhasādhanamāvudene, śīlōpavāsa dānādigaḷanaṟipi,
munneviśvabhūpa kathāprasaṅgadoḷ banda, yajñādi kāraṇadoḷ,
parvata nārada visaṁvādadoḷ negaṟdudaḻddanaṟipi, posatumāḍida paśuvadha
yajñakke dūṣaṇaṁ māḍe, muni samudbhūtamappātma yajñamuṁ,

āptamamuhimāsambhavamappa dēvayajñamuṁ, paramasthānagata siddha
pūjāgōcaramappa pitr̥yajñamumuṁ, brahmāṇḍa purāṇa samāna(hita)
mappa saṁhiteyoḷ pēḻdaṟda upōdghātapadadoḷ baṇṇisiduda, nellamuṁ
kēḷdu, ahiṁsādi pañcaniyamuṅmaṅgaḷuṁ, modalāge dharmasādhanaṁ
gaḷoḷ niya(ra)tarādar, yamaniyamalakṣaṇamentendoḍe

gāhe॥ ṇāṇādirayuyaṇa(0)tiyamihasaṁ jhantaṁsāhaṇaṁ cajamaṇi
ya mātaṁ paja māsaṁsadi yāṇiyu māṇiyu ranthaṁ pariṇāmā॥
adaṟiṁ ahiṁsālakṣaṇame yajñamendatiśayamativantri pēḻde, daśaratha
mahārājanumāgamasāranemba mantriyuṁ, janakanayajñaṁ sāvadya
hētumendu, paramāgamavacanadoḷ, sānurāganāgirdudumatiśayu
mati mantriyamātaṁ kēḷdu, daśarathana sabheyoḷirda mahābaliyemba
sēnāpatiyindaṁ janakanayajñakriyeyoḷ, puṇyamakke pāpamakke-
magadēnuṁ prayōjanamaltu neladoḷuḷḷa rājaru (ka me)gaḷellamalli
neradudaṟiṁ, rāmalakṣmaṇara prabhāvamanallitōrpudoḷḷittene.
daśarathaṁ parīkṣisi negalvevendu mantri, sēnāpatigaḷaṁ pūjisi,
hitōpadēśakanappa purōhitanaṁ barisi, janaka nagarakke kumārarpō
doḍabhimatārtha siddhiyakkume pēḻimene, nimitta nibandhanamappa
śāstradoḷaṁ, purāṇadoḷaṁ, tanna kaṇḍaterananintendu binnapaṅgeydaṁ.

jambūdvīpada, bharata kṣētraadaṟiṁahiṁsālakṣaṇameyajñamendatiśayamatimantripēṟidaśarathamahārājanumāgamasāranembamantriyuñjanakanayajñaṁsāvadyahētuvenduparamāgamavacanadoḷsānurāganāgirdudamatiśayamatimantriyamātaṅkēḷdudaśarathanasabheyoḷirdamahābaliyembasēnāpatiyindañjanakanayajñakriyeyoḷpraṇyamakkepāpamakkemagadēnumprayōjanamaltuneladoḷuḷḷarājaru(kame)gaḷellamallineredudaṟiṁrāmalakṣmaṇaraprabhāvamanallitōrpudoḷḷittenedaśarathamparīkṣisinegaḷvemendumantrisēnāpatigaḷampūjisihitōpadēśakanappapurōhitanambarisijanakanagarakkekumārarpōmoḍabhimatārthasiddhiyakkumepēṟimenenimittanibandhanamappaśāstradoḷavasarpiṇikālada(ḷampurāṇadoḷ) caturda
śamanugaḷuṁ, caturviṁśati tīrthaṅkararuṁ, dvādaśa cakravartigaḷuṁ,
navabaladēvaruṁ, navakēśavaruṁ, navaprati śatrugaḷapparembuduṁ, pratha
mānuyōgadoḷ pēḻdavaroḷivareṇṭaneyu rāmakēśavarappudaṟiṁ,
prativāsudēvaṁ rāvaṇanembōnātana kathāsambandhamumaṁ binna
paṅgeyveṁ (pēḻveṁ). atasībhavakke mūlineyubhavadoḷ, dhātakī
ṣaṇḍada, mūḍaṇamandarada, bharatakṣētrada, sārasamucca (sāgara samu)yu
viṣayada, nāgapuramanāḷva, naradēvanembarasanondu divasamanantaremba
gaṇadhararambandisi, dharmamuṁ kēḷdu, nirvēgadiṁ, bhōgadēvanemba
magaṅge, rājyamuṁ koṭṭu, saṁyamamuṁ kaikoṇḍutkr̥ṣṭa cāritra
nondu divasaṁ, capaḷavēganemba vidyādharana vibhūtiyuṁ kaṇḍu, nidā
naṅgeydu, jīvitāntyadoḷ, saudharmakalpadoḷ, dēvanāgi puṭṭidaṁ,

itta, vijayārdhada, dakṣiṇa śrēṇiyu, mēghapuramanāḷva, vinami
vaṁśada, sahasragrīvanembarasaṁ, tannoḍavuṭṭidavaruṁ. makkaḷaṁ muḷidu
kaḷeye, laṅkāpurakke bandu, mūvattu sāsiravarṣambaravāmāḷdanātana
magaṁ, śatagrīvanippattu sāsiravarṣavāmāḷdanātanamagaṁ, pañcāśata
drīvamippattu sāsiravarṣavāmāpoḻiṟilanāḷdanātana magaṁ, paulastya
nemboṁ, pañcadaśa sahasra varṣaparamāyuṣyanātanarasi, mēghaśrī
yumyamboḷavarge, naradēvacaraṁ svargalōkadimbandu, daśagrīvanemba
maganāgi, caturdaśa sahasravarṣa paramāyuṣyaṁ, rājyamoḷirdondu
divasaṁ, vanavihārakke pōge, vijayārdhada, vanavēdikeya samīpa
doḷaḷakāpuramanāḷva, vidyādhararājaṅgamitavēgigampuṭṭida, maṇi
matiyemboḷvaidyaḷvidyeyuṁ sādhisalendirdadaṁ kaṇḍu, kāmamōhavaśagata
nāgi vidyāsiddhige, (vidyege) vighnaṁ māḻpuṟpuduṁ, dvādaśavarṣōpavāsakke
phaladiṁ tanagandu sādhyamāgalidda vidyege vighnaṁ māḍidoḍe, maṇimati
muḷidu, ninnamagaḷāgi ninage padhārthamakke(ppe)na(da)kkendu, nidā
naṅgeydu sattu, maṇḍōdariyu garbhadoḷa(dinda) patarise, bhūmi
kampādyutpātaṅgaḷaṅkaṇḍīpuṭṭida kūsina kāraṇadiṁ rāvaṇaṅge vināśa
makkumembādēśamuṁmaṁ kēḷdaḷkeḷikke, laṅkēśvaraṁ mārīcanaṁ karedu,
ī kūsaṁ bisuṭubā yendaṭṭuvudumadaṁ maṇḍōdari kēḷdu, rājā
