jñeyuṁyaṁ mīṟade, mandasinoḷkūsanikki, piridoḍavemeyuṁ manavatāra
lēkhapatramanalliṭṭati snēhite(snig)yappudaṟinīkūsaṁ, nirvādamappe
ḍegaḷoḷikkendu kaṇṇanīranikkiyoppise, mārīcaṁ koṇḍupōgi, mithiḷā
puradudyānada samīpada, parētavana bhūmiyoḷ mandasaṁ pūḻduṟdu
bandanittaṁ.

annegamitta, janakana besadiṁ, bhūmi śōdhanaṅantubandavasantōtsavadoḷrāmaṅgeyvalli, nēgila
moneyoḷ, negaḻda mandasamaṁ paricārakaroydutōre, tadantargata
śiśuvaṅkaṇḍavatāra līkhapatramumbāmeṇbar(nr̥pakānte)kanyeyarumaṁlakṣmaṇaṅgepr̥thvidēvimodalāgepadinaṟuvar(nr̥pakuḷa)kumāriyarumañjisi, tadīyanapūjā pūrvāpara sambandha
manaṟidu, sīteyendu pesararvatrakaṅgaḷpūrvakr̥tapuṇyōdayadiniṭṭu, tannarasi vaṣṭaviṣayakāmabhōgaṅgaḷananubhavisudhādēvige kuḍe,
baḷedu, sakaḷa kaḷāpravīṇeyādaḷadaṟiṁ, janakana yajñaprapañcamaṁ
daśagrīvaṁ kēḷdu, bāradannegaṁ, rāmaṅgīsīteyaṁ kuḍuguma(vu)
daṟiṁ, kumāraranaṭṭi pamene, naimittika vacanadiṁ, śubhatithi muhūrta
doḷ, rāmalakṣmaṇaraṁ caturaṅgabala sahitaṁ, mithiḷerdaśarathanendarkāśīviṣayadavāraṇāsinagaramaṁnemmapūrvajanmasthānavendukēḷdamadaṟindēvaranugrahadoḷalligekaḷipōgipe, ccisuvudumenetadviyōgakkāadedaśarathanendanemmavaṁśajanaka
nidiraṁ bangaḷellamīpolalōḷirdēpalarumarasugeydudadaṟiṁnīmīrvarumēkadēśastharāgirdoḍañcandrādityarantemahīmaṇḍalavyāptaprabhāvarāgirpiradaṟimpōpudu, kajjamallenemattaṅkumārara rūpa, vinayādyananyasādhāraṇa guṇaṅgaḷumaṁ
kaṇḍu, tanna munnegeyda dāna, śīla, pūjōpavāsa puṇya paripākamaṁ
pogaḻ purajanaṅgaḷa pogarteyuṁ kēḷutta, poḻalaṁ pokku, kelavu
divasadiṁ, nijōdyukta kāryamaṁ tīrci, nereda nr̥pasamūha sannidhi
yoḷ, sīteyuṁ rāmaṅge janakaṁ mahāvibhūtiyiṁ koṭṭu,
nimmayyanappaḍe ni(mmani)nnanintukālamāgali maṟiyunadaṟiṁ kāla
haraṇaṅgeyyade pōpudene, lakṣmaṇaṁ berasi pōgi, bharata, śatrughnarmoda
lāge aṣṭādaśaśrēṇigaḷidirvare, viḷāsadinindrapratīndrarante poḻalaṁ
pokku, vinayadiṁ daśarathanaṅkaṇḍu sukhamirpinaṁ.

lg.l: goḷe bandattandu mādyanmadhukara kuḷa jhēṅkāra kāntaṁvasantaṁ

div.p:
antu banda vasantōtsavadoḷ, rāmaṅge puttameṇbar
(nr̥pakānte) kanyeyarumaṁ, lakṣmaṇaṅge pr̥thvīdēvimodalāge padinaḻuvar
(nr̥pakuḷa) kumāriyarumaṁ, jinapūjāpūrvakantare, sarvartrakaṅgaḷ,
pūrvakr̥ta puṇyōdayadiniṣṭa viṣaya kāmabhōgaṅgaḷananubhavisutti
dondu divasaṁ, labdha vijñāpanākṣaṇarāgi, rāmalakṣmaṇardaśarathanendar
kāśīviṣayada, vāraṇāsinagaramaṁ, nemma pūrvajanmasthānavendu kēḷdapa
daṟiṁ, dēvaranugrahadoḷallige pōgi perccisuvudumene, tadviyōgakkā
ade, daśarathanendanemma vaṁśajarbharatādigaḷellamīpoḻaloḷirdē,
palarumarasugeydaradaṟiṁ, nīvīrvarumēkadēśastharāgirdoḍaṁ,
candrādityarante, mahīmaṇḍalavyāpta prabhāvarāgirparadaṟiṁ, pōpudu
kajjamallene, mattaṁ kumārarendar.
adalladeyuṁ

endu nayaśāstra vacanamirdudaṟiṁ buddhiśaktyupāyajayaguṇa
prakr̥ti vibhāgaṅgaḷanaṟidu negalva nr̥pasutaṅgudyōgaṅgeyvalvēḷpa
dapalli, buddhiyembudu svabhāvikamuṁ, (daivi) vinayajakamuṁ enditteṟa
nakkuṁ. śaktiyembudutsāha mantraṁ prabhuvikalpadiṁ trividhamakku
malli-vikramaṁ baḷamutsāhaṁ śakti vividhavastuvicāraṇa sāmarthyaṁ,
mantra śakti kōśadaṇḍa (svī)sthitikaraṇaṁ prabhuśaktiyakkuṁ, upāya
membudu sāmōpapradāna bhēdadaṇḍa vikalpadiṁ caturvidha makkuṁ;
avaṟoḷ priya hitavacanamuṁ, gāḍhāliṅganamuṁ sāmaṁ;
hastyaśva viṣayamaṇikaṭakādi vitaraṇamupapradānaṁ; bhayōpadēśa
dinakke, hitōpadēśadinakkeripu, nr̥pa, pradhāna, puruparacittamuṁmaṁ tamage
māḻpuṟpudu bhēdaṁ, ripuviṣayadahana vilōpanamuṁ saṅgrāmādhikamuṁ,
daṇḍamakkuṁ. jayamembudu(kaṇṇtvaṇṇatvaga) karṇārṇatvagakṣi jihvāghrāṇēndri
yaṅgaḷge viṣayamappa, śabda, sparśa, rūpa, rasa, gandhaṅgaḷoḷa(da) śakti
yilladudu mēṇ kāmaṁ, krōdha, mada, māna, lōbha, harṣaṅgaḷaṁ
gelvuduṁ jayaṅguṇamembudu sandhivigrahadvayāvasthānaṁ dvaidīdhī bhāva
makkuṁ. prakr̥tiyembudu svāmyamātyajanapada, kōśa, daṇḍa, durga,
mitravikalpamakkuṁ. intartha śāstradoḷpēḻdiṟdinituṁ rājyasthāna hētuga
ḷivaṟoḷupāya sahitamappa(dya) vyavasāyaṁ, śakti pradhānaṁ. dhareyu
negaḻdalli nīruṁ, posaldillinīrumpodalli kiccuṁ, puṭṭumoḍaṁ kāṇalādapudu, phaḷa
prasavarahitamappa sahakāramanentu pakṣigaḷ poḷtuḷtavanāpta parēṣṭamappā
gamumanentu buddhiyoḍeyu pōrdarante(pērnte),rājaputramutsāha
hīnamādandu yōdhamahāmātraṁ sāmantādigaḷ porduvaralla; śatru
maṇḍaḷamuṁ bagevupudalladaṟindudyōgaṅgeyva mene, daśarathanavaṟa
mātaṁmecci, rāmaṅgadhirāja maṇimakuṭamaṁ kaviduṭṭi, lakṣaṇaṅge yuva

rāja paṭṭavamaṁvaṁ kaṭṭi, paramāśīrvādaṅgaḷiṁ parasi pōgalvēṟiḻa, vāraṇā
sige bandu, sukhadinirdu, nagarajana jannapadavāsigaḷaṁ dānamānādi
gaḷoḷaṁ santōṣambaḍisi, duṣṭanigraha śiṣṭapratipālanaṁ geydu,
pūrvamaryādeyaṁ dāṇṭadarasaṅgeyyuttirpinaṁ.

itta, rāvaṇaṁ laṅkādhiṣṭhānavamppa, dakṣiṇabharatatrikhaṇḍakellamadhi
patiyenānembabhimānadindondu divasaṁ, āsthāna maṇṭapadoḷirpina
mākāśamaṇḍaḷadiṁ piṅgaḷa jaṭākaḷāpanaṁ, raktāmbarōpadānanu
mindra nīḷākṣasūtravaḷayāḷaṅkr̥tanumāgi, nāradaṁ bandaṁbandu, daśakaṇṭha
nanupacārapūrvakaṁ kaṇḍoḍeṟaḻalikki palavukāladiṁ kaṇḍevellillirdu bandi
rēgeyduṁ dendu rāyudendurāvavaṇaṁ besagoḷe, nāradanendaṁ— sākētanagaradiṁ
bandenadanāḷva nikṣvākuvaṁśa cūḍāmaṇi, daśarathanembonātana magaṁ,
kula, rūpa, vibhava, vijñāna, parākramābhirāmaṁ rāmanembonātaṅge,
mithiḷēśvaraṁ tanna jannada nepadiṁ baḷiyuṭṭi, sakaḷakaḷāguṇavikhyāteyaṁyuṁ
sīteyaṁyuṁ ninnanunaṟiyade koṭṭanākeyuṁ, ninage takkaḷ (khānta)
ninnanāṁ nōḍi pōgalbandenenda. nāradana nuḍiyanavadhārise—

antu daśakandharaṁ, sītānibandhanavacana śravaṇa saṁvardhita kāma
(rāga) tāpanāgi, bhūmigōcaraṅge strīratnamēgeyduyyudadaneṟaḻadu tappa
nendu sabheyoḷāsphōṭisi nuḍiye, mattamātaṅge muḷisanadhikamāḍa
lendu, nāradanendapanempanīgaḷ, rāma lakṣmaṇarappoḍadhirāja yuvarāja
padaviyoḷniltaltu, vāraṇāsiyoḷire, bharatatrikhaṇḍa rājasūnugaḷuṁ
tantamma magaḷdiranavarge koṭṭunaṇṭapaṁ koṇḍāḍidaradaṟinavargabhi
vr̥ddhi kāḷapuvaroḷ, vigrahaṅgeyvuyyudu ninagoḷḷitaltu, ninagapuvarga
māvudantaramendu nuḍida nāradana nuḍige kaḍumuḷidu, nīnenna
sāhasamaṁ kaṇḍu nambūdendu pōgalvēṟiddu, mantraśāleyuṁ
pokku, mārīcanaṁ barisi, sīteyuṁ tarpupāyamāvudene, dēva, ninna
bageda kajjaṁ, pāpakkamapakhyātigaṁ kāraṇamadaṁ negalilāgadene, rāvaṇaṁ

muḷidu, kajjambēḻvuṟvadadadaṟoḷēgeydape, enage sīteyuṁyaṁ tappupā
yamaṁ pēḻnṟindu kīḻ beṟibesagoḷe, ninaginitāgrahamuḷḷoḍāke, nina
ganuraktae viraktaeyembudaṁ, dūta samprēṣaṇadinaṟidanuraktikteyappoḍe
nānumondupāyadiṁ tappappudu, virakteyappoḍākeyuṁ ballāḷtanadiṁ
tappappudumene pecci, sūrpanakhiyuṁ karedu, ninna ballampadinenage
sīteyuyanoḍambaḍisi bappudene, vāraṇāsige sūrpanakhi barpannegamā
poḻalila, citrakūṭōdyānavanadoḷ, vanavihārakke sīteyumantamantaḥ:puraṁ
berasu pōge, rāmaṁmuṁ jalakrīḍeyoḷirduṁ madhyandina samayadoḷ,
bhaviṣya cakravartiyappa lakṣmaṇanaṁ, sūrpanakhi kaṇḍanurakteyāgi
nōḍuttamaśōkadrumada keḷagaṇa marakata śilātaḷadoḷ, paricārike
yarberasu, gandhamālyādi vibhūṣaṇaṁ gaḷinaḷaṅlaṅkarisuttamirda sīteyuṁyaṁ
kaṇḍu, vr̥ddheyu vēṣadineyduvaydipare, keladoḷirdākegaḷākeyayu nīnārgē
nembeyendu besagoḷe, vr̥ddhe pēḻgeṟgumāṁ vanapāḷakiyeṁ, endavara
manamaṁvaṁ mōdalkulpaḍidu, nīme puṇyavanteyarintappa rājakumāra
roḷanubhavisalpaḍede, munnina janmadoḷāpa puṇyavaṁ neradiradanenagaṟipi
mānumante negaḻdu, nimmantarasiyāgi, nimma nallaranenage nallar
māḍi, nimage viraktaṁ māḻpeṟpenembudumaṁpudaṁ kēḷdākeyumana muḷimeḷadu,
meyyōḷmappendorvarorvara kayyaṁ poydu naguvuduṁ. māyā
(vapayō)vr̥ddhaddhe mattamintendaḷ— kularūpayauvana saubhāgyadi
sampanneyarappa vaniteyarge, subhaganumanukūḷanumappa puruṣanoḍa
nirpudaṟindavumuggaḷaṁ. janmaphalamuḷḷoḍe pēḻvemṟimembuduṁ, priya
prasaṅgameve ninage janmaphaḷavamukkumamuppoḍadanarasanoḷpittāgi māḻpeṟkumā
morvaraṁ bārisuvemallallemarasaṅge, mahādēviyāgendu antaḥpura
kānteyurapahāsyaṁ geydu sarasaṁ nuḍiye sīte kaṇḍu karuṇisi nīṁ
hitamanaṟiyayude peṇḍirappudanēke bayayusuvai; strīyayura pāpaphalamuṁ
kēḷendintendaḷ–gaḷgarbhadoḷirdandina duḥkhamuṁ kanyākāladoḷanabhimamuta
lakṣaṇamāvāgi puṭṭidamamuneyoḷaṁ, koṭṭamaneyoḷandoḻyuṟayuvuduṁ,
bañjeyappuduṁ, baḍatanamappuduṁ, paḍaṇigeyendu gaṇḍanollade bisu
ḻpuṟpidumaśuciyendu pēṟmuṭṭaṟamurṭṭadirpuduṁ, pativiyōgadoḷ santā
paṅgoḷvuduṁ, cakravartiyu magaḷādoḍaṁ peṟarge kiṅkurvāṇaṁ
geyvuduṁ, savapatiyar geyvavamānakke mānabhaṅgamuṁ sairisuvuduṁ,

svabhāva kuṭilaṅgaḷappa manōvākkāyaṅgaḷoḷ māyā prapañcamuṁvaṁ
tāḷvuduṁ, garbhiṇiyāgi garbharōgādi vēdaneyuṁ sairisuvuduṁ,
prasava samayadoḷādāpattaṁ, puṭṭida makkaḷa sāvinoḷappa marukamuṁ,
āroḷaṁ nambugevaḍeyuyadirpuduṁ, tannabasa(nasa) malladudaṟiṁ, dāna
śīlōpavāsaṅgaḷiṁ, paralōka hitadoḷ negalilvaḻvaḍeyuduṁ, vaidhavya
maraṇāntaduḥkhamanuṇbuduṁ, para(ma)puruṣa kāṅkṣeyuṁ, tapaścaraṇa
doḷniḷnegaṟduḻduduṁ; paḍigadante palareñjalge sōvatamappudumellā
strīyargaṁ sādhāraṇamumadaṟiṁ, strītvamuṁ bayasade sadācāradoḷniḷnega
ṟvudeḻvadeva, vayasadoḷparalōkahitadoḷ negaṟdeḻde sukhamanentu baya
suveyācāravatiyādandāruṁ, paribhavisuvarallabhibhavisuvaruṁ, naraka
bhāgigaḷāgipparenda sīteya nuḍiyuṁ kēḷdu, māyāvr̥ddhi tanna mana
doḷ, mandaraśikharadantappa jānakiyayu manamamunārgaṁ cariyiyu(bhēdi)
salbāradendu cintisi, dēviyayu vacanaśravaṇa kutūhaḷadindenna manevā
rteyaṁ maṟiṟedenendu poḍavaṭṭu, viṣaṇṇacitteyāgi, rāvaṇanaṁ kaṇḍu,
sīteyayu śīlamaṁ baṇṇisi, duḥśīleyurapparanāke nindi(kiḍi)suvupudanaṟi
denna manōgata(ratha)maṁvaṁ nuḍiyalaṁ(daṁ)ji bandenembudumākeyu
nuḍiyuṁ nambade, nīnākeyayu garjanegañji bande, peṇḍira dhairyameṁ
budu karikaḷabha karṇāgradante caḷasvabhāvaprayōja(na)ka viśēṣadindaṁ,
dhī(vī)ra hr̥dayeyuṁ; chalātmakeyukkuṁ; sañcaḷeyuṁ, vīyumpīrātmake
yukkuṁ: adaṟindā(sānā)keyayu śīlaguṇamaṁmuṁ(kkekka), pramāṇamāḍuvu
(du)pāyadoḷamākeyayu citta(bhēda)maṁvuṁ parīkṣisade bandu, kārya
hāniyaṁyuṁ māḍideyendu maṟidu nuḍiye, mattamintendaḷ—

upa(saṁ)bhōga paribhōgaṅgaḷaṁ tōṟi, sīteyayu manamaṁvaṁ
rañjisuvoḍavargaḷupabhōgādi vastugaḷaṁ peṟariṟiruḷkanasinoḷappoḍaṁ
kāṇalbāradu, śauryādi guṇadoḷ, rāmanaṁ naranelliyuṁ kāṇalba
radu, sakaḷakaḷāguṇaṅgaḷellamālayamāgirdaḷadaṟiṁ duḥśīḷeyayura
manamaneṟaṟigisuvantu, śīḷavatiyayura manamaneṟaṟigisalārge, bakkuma
daṟiṁ dūtaṟintirpa, kajjamaltene, rāvaṇaṁ sūrpanakhiyu mātaṁ
niścayisi, mārīcaṁ barisu, puṣpaka vimānārūḍhanāgi, nabhasthaḷakko
gedu, citrakūṭōdyānavanamaneydi, mārīcanaṁ parārdhamaṇi hariṇa
pōtaṁ māḍi, sīteyayu munde suṟiyalvēṟoddaṁḻdoḍaṁ sīte kaṇḍu,

arasaṅge tōṟi, vicitra varṇamr̥gamiduṁ, rājabhavanayōgyameṁ
budumarasanākeyarthiyaṁ tīrcalendu, mr̥gada baṟiyaṁ taguṟoḷdda
ḍadu dūramumāsannamumalladāsedōṟi, kiṟideḍeyunoydākāśakke
pāṟipudumadaṟaṟi pōpabaṭeyaṟiyunaṟiyade, maguḻdannenennigamitta rāvaṇaṁ,
rāmuvēṣadharanāgi sīteyallige banvandu, maṇimr̥gapōtakamaṁvaṁ piḍidu
poṟalgeṭṭiṟilgṭidenīgaḷastamayastramaṁyu samayamāduvāḍudu, poṟaṟilge pōpaṁ śivibigeyu
nēṟemṟimbuduṁ, śibikākāradoḷirda puṣpakavimānavanēṟisi śivibigeyu
keladoḷ tānuṁ turaṅgārūḍhanāgi barpandamaṁvuṁ māyeyiṁ māḍi,
tanage mr̥tyudēvateyunoyvantoydu, laṅkeyuneydi poṟavoṟalilo
ḷirdu, māyāvidhiyaṁ piṅgisi, tanna tanda vr̥ttāntamamunaṟipi, hari
nīḷavarṇōjvaḷamappa nijasvarūpamaṁ tōṟi, janakaje lajjeyoḷaṁ,
bhayadoḷaṁ, rāmana virahadoḷaṁ mūrchāgateyāge, śīḷavatiyappa
sīteyu kōpamamuḷāṅgasparśanadinākāśagāmini vidyevināśanamakkumemba
bhayadiṁ muṭṭalañji, vidyādhariyayuraṁ barisi, śītaḷakriyegaḷiṁ sīteyu
neccarisidoḍerdidāva pradēśamene, laṅkāpurada bahirudyānasamīpradēśa
millige ninnaṁ rāvaṇaṁ tandanātaṅge mahādēviyāgi sukhamirpudaṁ,
peṟadaṁ bageyadirembudumadaṁ kēḷdu, śōkākuḷiyāgi, vinasvarā
tmakamappoḍalogelgosugamenna śīlamaṁ keḍe negaṟinalleḻnallenennarasanaṁ,
kāṇbannennigamāṟoṟioḷaṁ nuḍidenallenātana kṣēmavārteyuṁ kēḷvannennigamā
nuṇbenallenātaṅge polladādandu, bāhyābhyantara parityāgadiṁ sanyāsanaṁ
geydu sāvenendu paricchēdaṅgeyduyduye್dala, lakṣaṇamappa kelavābharaṇaṅgaḷa
niralittuḷidavellamaṁ kaḷedu, nīminnenna muṭṭadirimendu khēcariyayuraṁ
bārisi, maunabrabr̥tadinirpinaṁ. laṅkeyoḷanēkamutpātaṅgaḷāge, cakra
ratnamāyudhāgāradoḷpuṭṭe, tadutpātaṅgaḷaṁ kaṇḍu beragāge, purō
hitādigaḷuṁ bandintendar— sīteyuṁ tandutaṁmu pollakeydurnimaṅgahita
mapakhyātiyumappante māḍide, innuṁnnu maguḻa kuḍuvudoḷḷittettane—
rāvaṇanendaṁ— sīteyuṁ tanda kāraṇadinenage sakaḷa bhuvanādhipatyamuṁvaṁ
māḻpi cakraratnaṁ puṭṭidudaṟiṁ, nīmidakke mārkoḷadirimenvendu
bārise, purōhitādigaḷumemḷuṁvempugidasādhyamenvendusiradirdarittaṁ—

rāmanu maṇimr̥ga pōtakadabaṟiyaṁyuṁ tagaḷdumagaḻdu baratu
miraḷdeśeyunaṟiyade suḷiyuttire, rāmanaṁnuṁ sīteyunumarasi

kāṇade, parijanamellaṁ vaimanuṣyadinirdu, nesamūḍivūrḍidāgaḷaṟisuttaṁ
bandu, tannaṁ kāṇe, sīteyallirdarduḷendu rāmaṁ besagoḷe, kaṇḍe
millembudaṁ, mūrchāgatanāgi śītaḷa kriyeyeṅgaḷineccattirpannennigamonvondu
bidara podaroḷ toḍardirda sīteya mēludaṁ kaṇḍu koṇḍu
bandu, paricārakartōṟaṟi, lakṣmaṇaṁ barirasu tatradēśakke barpannennigaṁ,
daśarathananaṭṭina dūtaṁ bandu, rāmanaṁ kaṇḍu, nimmayyanindiruḷ
kanasinoḷ rāhu(vu) rōhiṇiyaṁyuṁ koṇḍu pōge, candraṁ gaganadoḷ
toḷalvulpudaṁ kaṇḍidara phaḷamēnendu purōhitanaṁ besagoḷe, sīteyaṁ
rāvaṇaṁ koṇḍu pōge, rāmanasahāyanāgi, banadoḷorvane toḷulatta
mirdanendaṟipe, naimittika vacanadiṁ nimmalligennanaṭṭidoṁ, endu
karaṇḍakadoḷirda lēkhanapatramunmantōṟi, taleyōḷiṭṭukoṇḍō
leyuṁ bācise, dakṣiṇa samudrāntavartigaḷappayvattaṟu dvīpaṅgaḷ,
sakaḷacakravartiparipāḷitaṅgaḷavaṟoḷardhamuṁmaṁ kēśavanāḷdoṁḷvoṁ, vinami
vaṁśajarappa pūrvōkta vidyādhara rājacatuṣṭayaṁ laṅkānagaradoḷara
sugeyvaratikrāntarāge. caturdaśa sahasravarṣamparavāyāpyaṁ, rāvaṇa
nādonātaṅge, nāradaṁ sīteyayu rūpulāvaṇyamamaṁnabhivarṇise, kāma
santāpadiṁ bandumarasikoṇḍu pōdanadarinnāmudyōgaṁ
geyvannennigaṁ, śōkamaṁvamuṁ pattuviṭṭu sairisuvudendu, sīteyallige
dūtaranaṭṭupudembalēkhavārteyuṁ kēḷdu, rāmamusvāmi kōpara
sākrāntanāge, mithiḷēśvaranuṁ, bharata śatrughnaruṁ, adaṁ kēḷdu
bandu, rāmanaṁ kaṇḍu, duḥkha praśamanaṅgeydu, rāvaṇanappoḍe,
sīteyuṁ kaḷdu koṇḍoydanadakke mage paribhavamillentāgiyuṁ,
sīteyuṁ tappudakke sahāyaranarasalvēṟpuḻpudembannennigamirbarvidyādhara
rbandu, vinayayudiṁ kāṇe, rāmunavaraṁ nīvāmārgēnembirettaṇiṁ bandi
rene, vijayārdhada, dakṣiṇaśrēṇiyu, kiḷaṅḷuṅkiḷunagaramanāḷvaṁ, balīndra
vidyādharaṅgaṁ, priyaṅyuṅgu sauṁ(suṁ)darigaṁ bāliyuṁ sugrīvanu
membirvamarukkaḷādoravaroḷāṁ sugrīvanemmayyaṁ, lōkāntarita
nāguttumemmaṇṇaṁ bāligadhirāja paṭṭavamumenage yuvarājapaṭṭamumaṁvumuṁ
koṭṭoḍantirvarumirpinamevemmaṇṇanennaṁ nāḍindaṭṭi kaḷeye bandenītaṁ
dakṣiṇaśrēṇiyayu vidyutkāntānagaramanāḷva prabhañjana khacaraṅgamaṁmuṁ janā
dēvigaṁ, amitavēganembamagaṁ, kuḷajāti sādhita vidyāpāraganondu

divasaṁ, vidyādhara kumārarberasōrōrvara vidyeyaṁ parīkṣisa
lendu, vijayārdhagiri śikharamaṁ, dakṣiṇa pādadōḷ meṭṭi, vāma
pādadōḷāditya maṇḍaḷamaṁ somanodedoḍākṣaṇadoḷe nijaśarīramaṁ trasa
rēṇu pramāṇaṁ māḍidoḍandiṁ baliyamamuṇuvantanemba pesarādudīta
naśēṣavidyā vyākaraṇa pariṇatanenna keḷeya nānumītanumorme sammēda
giriyōḷ, siddhakūṭatīrthakṣētradoḷ, dēvatāstavanaṁ geydirde
vavunnegaṁ.

jaṭāmukuṭadharanuṁ, muktāmaṇi yajñōpavītanuṁ, kaṣāyayu
vastra paridhānanuṁ, kakṣāvaḷambitaratnakamaṇḍaḷa samētanuṁ, karataḷa
vidhr̥tāta patranuṁ, naiṣṭika brahmacāriyuṁ, raudradhyāna pariṇatanuṁ,
samucita śi(khādhi)bikā rūḍhanumappa sānāradanākāśadindaṁ bandu,
dēvaraṁ tripradakṣiṇaṁ geydu, bandisi, kuḷḷirpudu mātanaṁ sādur
besagoṇḍenennamunninaneleyōḷ nilal paḍevenō, paḍeyanō
pēḷiḻimene, nāradanendaṁ rāmalakṣmaṇararbhardhabharatasvāmigaḷapparavara
kāryakke neravāge, ninnamanōrathaṁ tīrgumākāryamumāvu
dendūḍe-rāmanarasi sīteyuṁ vanavihāradoḷirdaḷaṁ, rāvaṇaṁ
(kaḷdayyeḷduykai)koṇḍuyyeykai rāmalakṣmaṇaruṁ, laṅkegārayyaykailaṭṭal
samartha puruṣaranarasuttirdarallige, nīvēmō samartharene, nāradōpadē
śadinda bandevembuduṁ sanmāna dānadigaḷindavaraṁ santōṣambaḍise,
vinayudinaṇuvanintendu binnapaṅgeydaṁ-sītādēviyunellivokku marasi
barpenennaṁ kaṇḍaripantu, dēvar vinnāṇavaṁ besasuvudene vinamivaṁśa
doḷ puṭṭidātaṁ, mahāprabhāvanītanindamovonnakāryaṁ tīrgumenvenda
ṟidu rāmaṁ nijanāmamudrikeyaṁ caraṇḍakadoḷagiṭṭukoṭṭu sīteyayu
śarīra lakṣaṇaṅgaḷuminnivendaṟipi, bīḷkoṇḻkoṇḍu pōgi, gaganagāmini
vidyeyineydi, samudrāntaradoḷ dvādaśa yōjanāyāmadoḷaṁ,
navayōjana vistāradoḷaṁ, dvātriṁśadgōpura ghaṭita prakāra vaḷayu
doḷaṁ, sogayisupava laṅkeyampokku, kāmarūpavidyeyiṁ madhukara
rūpamaṁ kaikoṇḍu, rāvaṇana sabhāgrahamaṁ pokku indrajit kumāra
nantaḥpuramumaṁ pokkunōḍe, siṁhāsana madhyagatanāgirda rāva
ṇanaṁ kaṇḍu, paradārāsaktanappītaṅginitondu rājyabhōga menventādu
didu, kelavu divasadiṁ vināśakke salgumenvendu, niścayisi, sīteyunalli

kāṇade, nēsarpaṭṭaṭṭaṅgaḷ, poḷiḷala paḍuvaṇagōpuramanēṟi nōḍe,
sarvatōrkartukamembudyānada, śiṁśapāvr̥kṣadaḍiyoḷ, sāma bhēdādi kuśaḷe
yarappa khēcariyariṁ parivr̥teyāgirda sītādēviyanarasaṁ pēḷduḻdu
kuṟupugaḷaṁ kaṇḍaṟidākeya pativratāguṇakke mecci, rāvaṇaṅge muḷidu,
sairisi, tannabanda vr̥ttāntamanarasigaṟupal kṣaṇaṁ bāṇañcā(bā)ruttirpa
nnegaṁ, candrōdayamāge, saptamadināti(0(nta) kramaṇadōḷ, sīteyu
samāvastheyunaṟiyalendanēka, karadīpikā cakravāḷa parivr̥tanantaḥ
purasahitaṁ rāvaṇambare, kaṇḍaṇuṟuvaṁ, śiṁśapāvr̥kṣada taḷiroḷaguḷidu
nōḍuttire, rāmananēkāgracittade dhyānisuttirda sīteyuṅkaṇḍākeyu
patibratāguṇakke vismayumyambaṭṭu, dūra(sthita)sthanāgirdu, mañjarike
yembadūtiyunaṭṭidoḍāke bandu, jānakigintembateṁḷ

vidyādharādhirājanappa rāvaṇanayyūrvararasiyurggaṁrgaṁ, nīnagragaṇye
yāgi mahādēvivī paṭṭaṅgaṭṭisi, kāmabhōgaṅgaḷananubhavisi sukhadi
nirpuduṁ rāmumbandu rāvaṇanaṁ geldu ninnasonoyvanemba puruḷ(ḷuṁ)va
geyuṁ bisuṟpulpudene, niścaḷa matiyāgirda sīteyayullige, rāvaṇaṁ tāne
bandu, sāmabhēdadaṇḍaṅgaḷiṁ baggigisi nōḍi, tanagebasaṁmāḍalāṟade,
muḷidu, keḷardunuḍiyeṁ, maṇḍōdari mārkoṇḍu, nīnīkeyaṁ
muṭṭidoḍe, gaganagāminī mōvōdalāge vidyegaḷellaṁ vināśakke salguṁ,
vidyāvihīnarādandu vidhyādharara kiñcitkararappupparadalladeyuṁ, sulōcane
yunarkakīrti, svayamprabheyu aśvagrīvaṁ, sutāreyunaśanighōṣaṁ,
paribhavamaneydanydidante, nīnumīkeya kāraṇadineydvēydalvēḍa. peṇḍira
nuḍiyendeṟisalvēḍennavāmātaṁ kēḷvudinnu sīteyunoppisuvudene,
rāvaṇaṁ maṟuvāmātaṅguḍade, muḷidu, pōgi, poṟiṟalaṁ pokkaṁ;
maṇḍōdariyumitta sīteyaṁyuṁ pordi, munnamorva magaḷanāṁ
paḍedoḍaśubha(ḍādēśa)bhayuyadiṁ, neladoḷ pūṟdināḻdākeyaṁyuṁ nīnendē
bagedeṁ, ninnoḷappa snēhamenagasādhāraṇamidāva bhavada snēhamenda
ṟiyenennatāytanamaṁ, ninnatatkarmeryurmiyumaṁ bagedu, peṟitaṁ bage
yayude, ninnanenage rāvaṇaṁsavati māḍpaḻpagaḷ, sāvane paricchēdisuvudendu
pēḷdaveḷemoliḻveḷemoligagaḷmoṟiyeḷottaṟiyeka, kaṇṇa nīrgaḷ sūse(suriye), munnyaga
dgadakanteyāda maṇḍōdariyuṁ, sīte nijajananiyuṁ kaṇḍantatisnēhite
yāge, kiṟidu bēgadiṁ maṇḍōdariyendaḷ— ninna śarīrasthiti

nimittamāhāraṅgoḷvudu, śarīra sthitiyiṁyuṁ ninage rāmadarśanamuṁ,
mēṇ tapaścaraṇamumimbāgi kūḍibakkuṁ, nīnintā(ninnā)hāramuṁmaṁ
toṟediṟdippeyappoḍānumindu modalāgiyuṇisaṁ toṟeveṟvenene, jānaki
manadēgoṇḍenagīke tāyindaggaḷamāge kūrtu nuḍidapaḷendu kālge
raṟagi, madhura nirīkṣaṇaṁ geyduyye, maṇḍōdari kaṇḍindagiyimbaliṟiyuṁ
puṭṭida kūsaṁ bisuḷvandu mogamaṁ nōḍi kaṇḍenākeya dr̥ṣṭipātaka
mumimīkeya dr̥ṣṭipātamuṁ samānamāgirkumendu, maṇḍōdari
mūrchāgateyāge, śītalakriyegaḷineccarise, duḥkhākuḷeyāgi, poṟiṟalge
pōdaḷ.

ittalaṇuvaṁnumaṁ plavaṅga vidyeyiṁyuṁ kapimūrtiyaṁyuṁ kaikoṇḍu kāpi
navargellaṁ mahānidreyaṁ māḍe bandu, sīteyu mundeṟigeṟagi poḍa
vaṭṭu, rāmaru pēḷdaḻda vinnāṇaṅgaḷumanaṭṭida lēkhapatramumaṁ tandu
kuḍe, rāvaṇana māyāprapañcamendē bagidu nambadirdu, rāmumanāmākṣa
rōpalakṣitamuṁ, śrīvatsalāñchanamummumappa ratnāṅguḷīyakamumaṁ
kaṇḍu, taleyoḷiṭṭukoṇḍu bājisi nōḍi, santōṣambaṭṭaṇuvana
mogamaṁmuṁ nōḍe, nimma noyvayvunitu sāmarthyamenaguḷḷoḍapurasana
besanilladuyyaykel bāradu, samarthanappa rāvaṇaṁ kaḷdaḷdu tandante tāradiru,
rāvaṇanumaṁ kondukoṇḍu, laṅkāpuraśrīyumaṁmuṁ, sīteyumaṁmuṁ kaikoṇḍu
tappenendarasaṁ besasiyuṭṭidanadaṟiṁ, caturaṅga bala sahitanarasaṁ barpa
nnegaṁ, śarīrasthitinimittamāhāraṁ goḷvudu, duḥkhamaṁ bhāvisadirpu
dendu nuḍidu bīḷkoṇḻkoṇḍu, nēsapurūrchiḍidāgaḷ rāmasvāmiyuneydi,
poḍevaṭṭu, tadāliṅgana sambhāṣaṇānantaraṁ, tannapōda banda vr̥ttānta
manaṟipi, sāmamu bhēdōpapradānaṅgaḷiṁ, sādhyanalladātaṁ daṇḍasādhya
nadakke takkantu, dēvarnernēgaḷvudembududaṁmaṇuvaṅge sēnāpati paṭṭamuṁmaṁ,
sugrīvaṅgadhirāja paṭṭamuṁmaṁ kaṭṭe emage kāryavāvudendoḍaṅgadaneṁ
danarthavijayiyuṁ, asura vijayiyuṁ, dharmavijayiyumendarasu
gaḷ mūvarapparuttama, madhyama, nīca mūlabhēdadiṁvarasvabhāvaṁ
caturvidhamakkumavaṟoḷuttama svabhāvamappar dharmavijayigaḷ
sāmalakṣaṇamappupāyadiṁ sādhyar; madhyamasvabhāvarapparthavijayigaḷ
dānavaśīkaraṇōpāyamakkuṁ; nīcamūla svabhāvarappasuravijayigaḷ
bhēdadaṇḍaṅgaḷoḷ vaśīkaraṇamupāyaṅgaḷakkuṁ; avaroḷ rāvaṇaṁ

nīca prakr̥tiyu asura vijayiyumappudaṟiṁ, bhēdadaṇḍa prayōga
mucitamannegaṁ, sāmōpāyamanavaḷambisi, dūtasamprēkṣaṇaṁ geydu
nōḷpaḻpamuḷidupāyaṅgaḷaṁ baṟiyaṁ prayōgisupavamendaṅgadaṁ
nuḍiye, kēḷdanellavoḍambaṭṭaṭṭinna(ppa)lligāranaṭpuvamene, bhūmigōca
rarge dakṣatōdyaṣṭaguṇaṅgaḷuḷḷoḍapuvarge, gaganagamana sāmarthyamilla
dudaṟiṁ, sēnāpatiyādaṇupantananēkōpāya kuśalanātanindemage
kāryasiddhiyakkumātananaṭpuvudendaṅgadaṁ nuḍiye, vijayayunuṁ,
manōvēganuṁ, kumudanuṁ ravigatiyumembinibaruṁ berasaṇu
vantanaṁ mannisi, nīṁ pōgi, vibhīṣaṇanaṁ kaṇḍu, nimma ballandallampadoḷ
ātanaṁ namamuge māṟpuḻpudātaṁ namagāge rāvaṇana lakṣmikṣmī emamugādapaḷ.
oṟiyaṁ rāvaṇana niścayamamunaṟidu barpudene, khacarakumārarsahita
maṇuvaṁ poḍevaṭṭu pōgi, laṅkeyuneydi, vibhīṣaṇanaṁ vinayudiṁ
kaṇḍu, rāmasvāmi nimmalligintendaṭṭidaneraḍumanege tāne mudagaṇ
tannindamaggaḷaṁ peṟamirtrarilladaṟinemmanaṭṭida mānasaraṁ mundiṭṭu
rāvaṇanaṁ kāṇisi, kāryasiddhiyaṁ māḍugendaṭṭidanātaṁ, sīteyaṁ
biḍadandu, rājyalakṣmikṣmī yōgya puruṣa guṇādhāranēnubhayalōka hitanu
mappa rāmanaṁ, prakr̥timaṇḍaḷamanuraktanāgi pattidudātaṅgebbittu
kōṭiyumebbattanālku lakṣeyuṁ bhūmigōcara caturaṅga balamuṁ
mūṟukōṭiyumare vidyādhara baḷamuṁ, neredudanitaṟoḷ tāne
bandu sīteyunuyyal nēṟvaykelneṟivanādoḍaṁ, ninnoḷappa sambandhāpē
kṣeyiṁ, nimmalligemmanaṭṭidanene, vibhīṣaṇaṁ santōṣambaṭṭu, mundi
ṭṭoydu rāvaṇanaṁ kāṇise, rāmadūtarayōdhyānagaradiṁ bandarenda
ṟipe, śrīvatsalāñchanamappa lēkhamaṁ mundirkkuvuduṁ, mēlikka
lvēṟpuḻpudu, rāvaṇana besadiṁ rājalēkhakanadaṁ koṇḍintendu bājisidoṁ.

śrīmatsākētādhipati, sakaḷa bharataśikhāmaṇi, śaradindukiraṇadhavalita
diganta karṇapūrāya mānākīrtikuśaliyappa rāmuṁ, kuśaliyappa
rāvaṇaṅge kāryamuṁ nivēdisuvadu— sīteyunaṟiyaduydaḍamēnā
dudoppisuvudu, vinamikuḷa vibhūṣaṇanappa, tanna mahātmyakkidu takku
dallemba lēkhavārteyunavadhārisi, rāvaṇanendaṁ— sīteyunaṟiyade
tandenalleṁ, parīkṣisiye tandeṁ. ākeyaṁyuṁ kanasinoḷappaḍaṁ biḍuve
nalleṁ; ārponappoḍe tannudyōgamuṁ tōrpudemba garvajanaṅgaḷaṁ

nuḍiye, kēḷdimḻdimpavanendaṁ— cakravartiye, peṟaraṁ bārisuvudugeṭṭu
nī duścaritradoḷ negaṟdadaḻdayuktamene, paulastyasutanendaṁ—
strīratnamuṁ peṟavu parārthyardhyavastrustugaḷuṁ sakaḷa bhuvanasvāmige yōgya
membudāpāla(cāra) gōpāla prasiddha mamudaṟnṟindenaganurūpamappa dhana
maṁ koṇḍalli duścaritamāvudapalladeyuṁ, enagaṟipade janakaṁ
sīteyuṁ rāpaṅge koṭṭoḍeṟduḻidutandenene, mattamaṇumimbupaṁ kōpāru
ṇēkyakṣr̥ta viḷōcananendaṁ— eṟduṟidu tandenendu nāṇcade nuḍivirāra
kayyoḷāva ballāḷtanadoḷeṟduḻidu tandiremumage mithyāgarvamuṁ nuḍiyu
lvēḍa, ninage matibhraṁśavādudentene— bharata, sagara, sanatkumārādi
gaḷappa ṣaṭkhaṇḍapatigaḷuṁ, prathamu kēśava svayambhū, puruṣōttamu,
madhusūdanādigaḷappa, trikhaṇḍapatigaḷuṁ, ninnantallade negaṟttiḻteyuyunnā
rpēra(yuṁ negaṭd)rārumilla, niḻda)rārumillaninanage puṇyahāniyuṁ, prāṇa hāniyu
manāgalīyude, sākētapatige sīteyanoppisuvudene, rāvaṇaṁ kaḍu
muḷidu, dr̥ṣṭiviṣapannaga phaṇāmaṇiyumaṁmuṁ, enna keygvandaygoṇḍa sīte
yumaṁ koḷalārgetīrgumīninna maruḷttaḷtanamanuḷivudendu baggisi
rāvaṇanallindedurduddu pōpuduṁ; kumbha, nikumbha, kumbhakarṇādigaḷuṁ,
indrajit, indravarma, atikāyu, khara, dūṣaṇaṁ, lakṣmakhkhadu, durmukhakhi,
mahādurmukhādi kumārarkaḷuṁ, muḷidu, garjise, peṇḍiramunde
nīvellamintu gajari garjisidoḍēnādudu, nāḷe saṅgrāmuma raṅgadoḷ,
nimma namma parākramanariyalakkumendu baggisi, sīteyallige bandu,
maṇḍōdariyuṁ tānuṁ pāraṇāvidhiyaṁ māḍisi, rāmanallige vandu,
sarvaprakāradoḷaṁ rāvaṇaṁ sīteyuṁ biṭṭanallanalliganurūpamappantu
negaṟpeḻtimene, rāmusvāmi, caturaṅgabala samētanāgi naḍedu, citrakū
ṭōdyānadoḷ, varṣakālamuṁ kaṟpeḻipe, bāliyudūtaṁ bandintendu
binnapaṁ geydaṁ.

sugrīvanumuṇuvanuṁ kicitkararavaraṁ pattuviṭṭu, dēvaremmaṁ
kaikoṇḍu, citrakūṭadoḷirpudānepōgi, rāvaṇaṅge bhaṅgamuṁ māḍi,
sītādēviyuṁ(yuṁmuṁ) tappenendu bālibinnapaṁ geydṭiydaṭṭidoḍane-kiṣkiṁ
dādhi patiyu sāmu bhēdalakṣaṇa vacanakke, namuguttaramāvudendu mantri
gaḷaṁ besagoṇḍoḍaṅgadanendaṁdaṁ–-dvādaśa rājakadoḷimage rāvaṇaṁ śatru,

bālimitranadaṟiṁ, nammoḷkūḍade, rāvaṇanoḷ tānuṁ(ḷkūḍe tānu
mātaṁ) kūḍidoḍekaramememballidanakkumadanāgalīyayude, bāliyaṁyuṁ
munnaṅkiḍisi, baṟiyundaśagrīvana mēle naḍavudene, rāmanadane
kaikoṇḍu, bāliyayudūtanoḍane, tannadūtaranaṭṭi, mahāmēgha(ru)
memba gandhagajamaṁ mundiṭṭu tappudalladandu, tanage takkudaṁ māṟviḻve
nene, bālikēḷdu munidu, tannapeṇḍatiyaṁ koṇḍu pōda rāvaṇaṅge,
takkudaṁ māḍadanenage māḍadirpane, tannoḷappanaṇpaṁ bayasi, sāvumu
vaṁ nuḍidaṭṭidoḍinītaṁ nuḍidaṭṭidanendu, bāliyugarvavacanaṅgaḷaṁ
kēḷdu, laṅkēśvaraṁ sīteyuṁ ballāḷtanadoḷkoṇḍu pōdanallaṁ,
kaddu kaṇḍu pōdanadakkanurūpamappadaṇḍamaṁ taḍeyude māṟpuḻpudaṁ
nīveṅvemekāṇbarenda rāmudūtanaṁ bāli baggisi, nimmāḷdantanage sāmarthya
muḷḷoḍe gandhakariyuṁ bandu koḷgambudumadellamaṁ, nijadūtana
ṟipe, rāmaṁmuṁ lakṣmaṇanaṁ daṇḍanāyakanaṁ māḍi, sugrīvapramukha
baḷamanaṭṭiṭṭe, daṇḍu naḍedu, khadiravanamaneydu, bāliyubalamidirambaṁ
doḍḍikāde, mahāsaṅgrāmadoḷ lakṣmaṇana karṇāntākr̥ṣṭabāṇaṅgaḷiṁ,
bhinnavakṣasthaḷanumāgi, bālilōkāntarakke sandanātanapadaviyuṁ, sugrī
vaṅgaṇuvaṅgaṁ koṭṭu, kelavudivasadiṁ lakṣmaṇaṁ bandu rāmanoḷkūḍe,
varṣakālamuṁ kaṟipi. kiṣkindhanagaramanōharōdyānadoḷ biṭṭalli,
padinālkukṣōhiṇibhūmigōcarabalambandu kūḍe, gajatpāda(la) giri
yoḷ, śivaghōṣa kēvaḷigaḷa nirvāṇasthānadoḷ lakṣmaṇanēṟudivasa
mupavāsasahitaṁ, vidyāpūjegeyddaydaṣṭa śatarakṣaka puruṣasannidhiyoḷ,
prajñaptividyeyaṁ sādhise, sugrīvanuṁ sammēdagiriya siddhaśiḷātaḷa
doḷuḷumpavāsasahitaṁ, sarva mahāvidyāpūjeyaṁ māḍi, rāmalakṣmaṇa
sugrīvarkaḷāḷōcita vānaravidyāsamudbhūta dhvajavāhanānvitanappaṇaṁ
pambirasu laṅkābhimukharāgi naḍador.

itta, purajanamuṁvuṁ, sāmantarumindragiyuṁ, kumbhakarṇa prabhr̥ti
gaḷuṁ, rāvaṇanalligevandu, nammujvalamappa kulakkamī mahātmyatmakkamī
duścaritamayuktamamudaṟiṁ, peṟara peṇḍatiyunemmambagedoppirpisuvu
dene, rāvaṇanendaṁdaṁ–-rāmunemboṁ pulmānasiganaparimitabalambirasu, emma
mēle bandappanendu kēḷdeḷdi madaṟi nīgaḷ koṭṭoḍañjikoṭṭantāgirkuṁrkurkka
moppisuvenallene, vibhīṣaṇanendaṁdaṁ–- ikṣvākuvaṁśa tiḷakanappa rāmamunaṁ

pulmānasanendēkēḷisi, nīnīstrī ratnamuṁ kuḍalāṟaṟidennindaggaḷa māva
nendu nāṇcadentu nuḍiveyene, rāvaṇaṁ muḷidu, munnamorme,
rāmudūtanoḷondi bandennaṁ nuḍide; matta mīgaḷ sabheyoḷennanintu
nuḍideyudaṟiṁ, ninage peṟadēnuṅgeyvenallenamma nāḍiṁ poṟamaṟivaṭṭu
pōpudene, vibhīṣaṇanīduścaritradindamivaṅge vināśamakkumendaṟidu
bandu, rāmunoḷkūḍe, rāmunātanaṁ manaṁmunnisi, kelavudivasadiṁ samudra
taṭavaneydiyddi, bīḍambiṭṭirdoḍaṇuvambandu, vanabhaṅgamuṁmamuṁmaṁ laṅkāda
hanamuṁmamuṁmaṁ māṟpuḻpudantādoḍe, rāvaṇamporamuḍugu mātampēṟvāḻvā
sādhya makkumene, nīnedaṇḍanāyakanāgi pōpudendarasaṁ besase,
māruti vānaravidyeyindaṁ vānara balamuṁ paḍedu pōgi, vanabhaṅga
muṁmāḍi, kāpināḷaṁ bhaṅgambaḍise, vanapālakarpuryyaliḍutaṁ pōge,
nagarapāḷakaṁ kēḷdu, rākṣasavidyā sampādita dhvajōpalakṣitarāgi, pavana
sutanavānara baladoḷkādi, vanataruprahāra jarjirīkr̥ta tanugaḷ bhaṅgaṁ
baṭṭu pōṟiḻilaṁ puge, mahāgnijvālāvidyeyiṁ poravoḷalaṁ suṭṭu,
gōpuraṅgaḷellampahisi, vānarabalaṁ tammoḷāruṁ kāduvarilladaṇuvaṁ
berasu rāmunalligevare, rāvaṇanēkāraṇadiṁ porapumaṭṭanillendu, rāmuṁ
besagoḷe vibhīṣaṇanendaṁdaṁ–-rāvaṇaṁ laṅkeyoḷilla, bāli lōkāntaṟita
nādudumaṇuvanasugrīvana vidyābaḷa pra(paṅka)karṣamuṁmuṁmaṁ kēḷdeṇṭu
divasamupavāsaṅgeydandagiyuṁ kāpuvēḷdāditya pādagiriyoḷ, rākṣasa
vidyemodalāge (mahāvidye modalāge) mahāvidyegaḷaṁ sādhisuttirda
nātaṅge vidyesādhyamāgadannega madakke vighnamuṁ māḍe, namma balamuṁ
laṅkege naḍayiṁsuvudene, sugrīvanumaṇuvanuṁ siṁhavāhini, garuḍa
vāhini bandhamōcani, praharaṇāvaraṇimodalāge rāmuṅgeṇṭu, lakṣmaṇaṁ
geṇṭu sādhita vidyeyuṅkuḍe, prajñapti vidyā pariṇateyindāda mahā
vimānaṅgaḷanēṟi, laṅkāsamīpadoḷ bīḍaṁ biṭṭarittavidhyādharakumāra
rarasanabesadinādityapādagirige bandindagiyoḷ vigrahaṅgeyyuttippannegaṁ
vidyādēvategaḷ rāvaṇanallige vandu, ninna puṇya phaladininitukālamuṁ,
ninnabageda kāryyamellamuṁ tīrcutirdevīgaḷninage, puṇyaparipāka
hāniyoḷasamartharēṁ māḍevembuduṁ, rāvaṇanendanenage nīmilladaḍe
niradē ennarakṣākārabaladoḷe rāmubalakkebhaṅgamuṁ māṟnenṟpenendu
muḷidu bandindagiverasu pōṟiḻilampokku, rāmura baramuṁ paricāraka

pēṟkēṟikēḷdu, hariṇadhvajanaṁ, ravikīrtiyumemba sēnāpatiyuṁ,
gajarathāśvapadāti vidyā lakṣaṇavappa pañcāṅgasādhanamuṁ, kumbha, nikumbha
kumbhakarṇādigaḷappoḍapuṭṭippudaruṁ, indrajitu, indrakīrti indra
varma pramukharappa makkaḷuṁputraruṁ, kharadūṣaṇādigaḷappa narapatigaḷuṁ
berasu, bhūmigōcararappa baḍavugaḷenagidiranārāmparendu, jagadoḷ
rāmalakṣmaṇarpesarilladantumāḻpeṟpenendu, kāḷamēghagajamanēṟi, rākṣasa
vidyādhvajōpalakṣitanuṁ, cakraratna puraḥsaranuṁ, chatracāmara patākā
kīrṇagaganamaṇḍaḷamuṁ, paṭahakahaḷādidhvani badīdirita digantaranumāgi,
rāvaṇaṁ kādal poramaḍuṭṭuvuduṁ.

itta rāmanaṁnuṁ vidyādhara gajaturaga padāti pañcavidhabalasamē
tanuṁ, tāḷadvadhvajanumañjana parvata gajādhirūḍhanumāgi, lakṣmaṇaṁ
vijayaparvatagajādhi rūḍhanuṁ garuḍadhvajanamāgi, sakaḷabhuvana samū
hāndhakāra nirākaraṇa kēvala jñāna pradīpanapparhadbhaṭṭārakaṅge
namaskāraṅgeydu, tannaṁ paricchēdisi kādal poramaḍuvuduṁ;
ubhayabaḷaṁ vindhyācalatarunikara sannikāśa samavaradurdharapadāti, baḷa
muṁmu manīḷahativicaḷita, mahāsamudra kallōḷa māḷāyaḷeyumānānēkaṁ
tuṅgaturagabaḷamuṁmuma kāḷa nīḷaghanaghaṭāyayumāna madajaḷārdragaṇḍasthaḷa
pracaṇḍa ghana ghaṭābaḷamumanēkacakra, cītkāra badīdiritaṁ sakaladikcakra
mumappa rathabaḷamumanēka vidyā vijr̥mbhaṇāptamṣṭamba vimānārūḍha,
vividha vidyādhara baḷamumanukramadinondondaṟoḷpoṇardiṟiye,
baḷapadahati samutthita bahaḷa dhūḷīpaṭaḷa sasihita diṅmaṇḍaḷaguṇamumanēka
nānākharācaparamparā jarjarīkr̥ta vīrabhaṭanavakṣasthaḷavigaḷita rudhirajaḷapravāha
bhīkaramumappa saṅgrāmadoḷanisuṁ, bhaṅgambaṭṭa tanna baḷamuṁmaṁ rāvaṇaṁ
kaṇḍu, vidyeyiṁ sīteya śiyukiracchēdaṁ geyda tandu, rāmaṅge tōṟi,
saṁmōhavyākuḷamāgippudumāprastāvadoḷ, rāvaṇana baḷamunabhi
bhavisi bandu vibhīṣaṇaṁ śīlavatiyappa sītegēnuṁ bhayamillamividemmaṇṇana
kr̥trimamene kēḷdu, rāmaṁ rāvaṇana manadapa poḍarpanaḍaṅgisuvuduṁ;
rāvaṇaṁ tannamamukkaḷverasu, māyāyuddhamaṁmuṁ poṇarci, gaganataḷa
doḷnindukāde, rāmalakṣmaṇaruṁ siṁha, garuḍavāhini vidyārūḍharanu
madādi vidyādharabalasahita mantarikṣadoḷnindu rāmaṁ rāvaṇanoḷ
lakṣmaṇanindanindragiyoḷ, sugrīvaṁ kumbhakarṇanoḷ, aṇuvaṁ ravikīrti

yoḷ, kumumundanindravarmanōnoḷ, aṅgadanindrakētuvinoḷ naḷina
kētu kharanoḷ, nīḷaṁ dūṣaṇanoḷ, māḷmahāyā dvandvayuddha yuddha
doḷkāde, rāmundaśagrīvananabhibhavisuvuduṁ kaṇḍindagi bandeḍegoṇḍu
nile, śaktiyuniṭṭoḍātambīṟvuḻvuduṁ, adaṁ kaṇḍu rāvaṇaṁ muḷidu,
kudidu tāge, lakṣmaṇaneḍagoṇḍu nile, vidyāsamudbhūta gajavāhanādhi
rūḍhanāgi rāvaṇaṁ bahuvidhāyudhaṅgaḷaṁ suriye, lakṣmaṇaṁ praharaṇā
varavidyeyinavellamuṁ kiḍise, cakradiniḍuvudumadaṁ kaṇḍu, nāradādi
gaḷ siṁhanādadinārvudu mācakraṁ tannaṁ tripradakṣiṇaṅgeyduyda nile,
lakṣmaṇanā cakradiṁ rāvaṇana niṭṭukondu, vijayayu śaṅkhamuṁ pūrisi,
tadanantaramabhayayughōṣaṇeyuṁ māḍidāgaḷ, rāvaṇana sāmanta,
yōdha, mahāmātrādigaḷ rāmalakṣaṇaraṁ bandu kāṇe, maṇḍōdari
modalādarge daśagrīvanantaḥpura duḥkhapraśamanāpūrvakaṁ, vibhīṣaṇaṅge
paṭṭamuṅkaṭṭi, rāvaṇananvayāgata bhūmiyuṅkoṭṭu, sītādēviyuṁ
mahōtsavadiṁ tarisi, śubhadinadoḷ (baḷa) pīṭhagiriyoḷ, sahasrāṣṭa
kanaka kaḷaśaṅgaḷindabhiṣiktanāgi, lakṣmaṇaṁ kōṭika sileyunettidoḍallippa
sunandanemba yakṣaṁ rāmukēśavaraṁ pūjisi, sānandakamemba khaḍga
ratnamuṁ kuḍe, gaṅgātīraṁ biḍidu naḍadu, gaṅgādvāramuseydineyddi,
rathamunēṟi, nijanāmāṅkitamappamōgha śaradinese, māgadhanaḷkibandu,
ratnahāra, tirīṭa, ratnakuṇḍaḷaṅgaḷaṁ koṭṭu, tīrtha jaḷadinabhiṣē
kaṅgeyduyda pōge, samudratīraṁ biḍidubandu, vaijayanta dvāra
doḷpōgi, varatanuṁnumpaṁ vaśagataṁ māḍi, kaṭakāṅgada kaṭisūtra, graivē
yaka cūḍāmaṇivāḷivibhūṣaṇagaḷaṁ paḍedu bandu, sindhu gōpura
doḷ prabhāsakaṁ bandoḍavana kayyoḷ, santānaka mumaktājāla
praḷambasūtrādigaḷaṁ koṇḍu bandu manavēdikeyuṁyiṁ pōgi, paścima
khaṇḍa vāsigaḷaṁ bāykēḷisi, bahuvidha vastugaḷaṁ koṇḍu, mūḍa mogade
naḍedu, vijayārdha parvata vāsigaḷanēneṟigisi, gaja, truturaga, vidyādhara
kanyakādigaḷumuṁḷuṁmaṁ kaikoṇḍu, pūrvakhaṇḍamumpuṁnuṁmuṁ bāykēḷisi, ratnādi
gaḷaṁ paḍedu, padināṟu sāsirpaṭṭabaddha narapatigaḷuṁ, nūra paṣadiṁ
barvidyādhara rājaruṁ, trikhaṇḍavāsigaḷappa vyantaradēvaramberasu, siddha
digvijayanāgi, nālvatteraḍupavarṣadiṁ bandu, sākētamaṁvaṁ pokku,
śubhadinadoḷ, rājavidyādhara vyantarādhipatigaḷ, siṁhāsanamanēṟisi,

sahasrāṣṭa suvarṇakumbhaṅgaḷindabhiṣēkaṅgeydu, nīmīrvarumeṇṭa
neyuya rāmaṁ kēśaparībhatatrikhaṇḍa patigaḷivarendu, maṇi, makuṭavaṁ
kavidhatiparamāśīrvādadiṁ parasi. lakṣmaṇaṅge pr̥thvīsaundari modalāge,
padināṟusāsiramantaḥpuramaṁ, rāmaṅge sīte modalāgeṇṭāsirvara
tasiyarāge, padināṟusāsira viṣayakkaṁ anibarērēṁmakuṭabaddhargaṁ
ombhatṭāttāsiradeṇṭu nūṟayvattu drōṇāmukhaṅgaḷaṁḷgaṁ ippattayṭāydā
sira pattanakkaṁ, pannirchāsirakharvaḍakkaṁ, anite maḍambakkaṁ, eṇṭāsira
khēṭakkaṁ, ippatteṇṭantaradvīpakkaṁ, nālvatteṇṭukōṭi grāmakkaṁ,
nālvatteraḍulakkekṣa dvipakkaṁ, aniterathakkaṁ, ombhattukōṭi turagakkaṁ,
nālvatteraḍukōṭi padātibalakkaṁ, eṇṭāsirvargaṇabaddha dēvargamadhi
patigaḷāgi, rāmaṅgaparājitamemvemba halamaṁmuṁ, kaumamudiyembagadeyuṁ
āmōghamemvemba śaramaṁmuṁ, ratnāvataṁsikeyemba māleyuṁ, intu
nālkuṁ pratyēka yakṣasahasra rakṣitaṅgaḷāge lakṣmaṇaṅge surakṣitamemvemba
cakramuṁvuṁ, kaumamudiyemba gadeyuṁ, amōghamamukhiyemba śaktiyuṁ,
sānandakamemvemba bāḷaṁḷuṁ, śārṅgamemvemba dhanuvuṁ, kaustubhamemvemba
maṇiyuṁ, pañcamukhamavāppa pāñcajanyamemvemba śaṅkhamuvumantēḻuṁ
pratyēkayakṣasahasra rakṣitaṅgaḷāge sukhamananubhavisuttirdondudivasaṁ,

manōharōdyānadoḷirda, śivagupta kēvaḷigaḷaṁ vinayayudiṁ
bandisi, dharmamaṁ kēḷdu, rāmādigaḷ, parigrahītaśrāvakadharma
rādar, lakṣmaṇaṁ nidānaśalyasamupalabdhabhōgāsaktanāgi, mōha ni
yōpadayadiṁ, samyaktvādigaḷillade, dharmānurāgamātraṁ kelavu
kālamirdu, bharata śatrughnarkaḷaṁ sākētadoḷniṟiḷbiṭṭisi, tāmīrvaruṁ
vāraṇāsige pōgi, vijayarāma, pr̥thvīcandrādi bahuvidha putra, pautrādi
parivr̥tarāgi, sukhamirdondudivasaṁ. nāgavāhiniyemba śayana taḷa
doḷ, duḥsvapnatrayamaṁ kaṇḍu, lakṣmaṇaṁ rāmaṅge pēḻdaḻdu purōhita
navara phalamanintendu pēḻdaḻdi nāladavamaramapunāne kīkēḷdudaṁ kaṇḍudaṟiṁ,
lakṣmaṇaṅge vr̥ddhipīḍeyukkuṁ; rāhugrastadiṁ dinakaranastamānakke
salvudaṁlvapaṁ kaṇḍudaṟiṁ, bhōgāpavasānamumakkuṁ; dhavaḷaprāsādadēkabhāga
bhaṅgamaṁ kaṇḍudaṟiṁ, rāmaṅge tapōvanagamanamakkumendu, purō
hitaṁ pēḻdaḻi tatpratīkārārthamabhayaghōṣaṇeyumaṁ, mahādānādi
gaḷumaṁ māḍi, pūrvakr̥ta puṇyāvasānadoḷ, asātōdayaṁya

(karma)diṁ vyādhiyāgi, māghavāmāsadaparāvāsyeyoḷ, lakṣmaṇaṁ sattu,
paṅkaprabheyoḷ puṭṭidoṁ; rāmanumātana śarīra saṁskāramaṁmuṁ māḍi,
lakṣmaṇaṅgaṁ pr̥thvīsaundarigaṁ puṭṭida, pr̥thvīcandraṅge rājyābhiṣēkaṁ
geydu, tanagaṁ sītegaṁ puṭṭideṇbarmakkaḷoḷaṁ vijayarāmādigaḷolla
dire, kiriya maganajitañjayaṅge yuvarājapaṭṭamaṁ kaṭṭi, mithiḷā
puramaṁ koṭṭu, rāmaṁ saṁsārabhōganirvēgaparaṁ, sākētapurakke
pōgi, siddhārthavanadoḷādidēvana pariniṣkramaṇa tīrthabhūmiyoḷ,
śivaguptakēvaḷigaḷa pakkade, saṁsārakāraṇaṁ, saṁsāraphalaṁ, mōkṣaṁ,
mōkṣakāraṇaṁ, mōkṣaphaḷamemvembivaṁ kēḷdu, baḻiḷiyaṁ, lakṣmaṇaṁ paṅka
prabhege pōdanendu bhaṭṭārakar besase, nirākr̥tasnēhanāgi, nibōdhika
jñānaprakr̥ṣṭakṣayōpasama samudbhūtabōdhaṁ, sugrīvanumaṇuvanuṁ,
vibhīṣaṇaṁ modalāgaynūyvarvararasugaḷ, aśītiśata putraraṁ berasu,
rāmaṁ tapamaṁ kaikoṇḍaṁ; sīteyuṁ, pr̥thvīsaundariyuṁ modalāga
rasiyarellaṁ, śrullaṁśr̥tamati kantiyarasāre, dīkṣeyuṁyaṁ kaikoṇḍar. pr̥thvī
candranumajitañjayanuṁ gr̥hītaśrāvakadharmarāgi, namaskāraṅgeydu,
pōdar.

itta samyagdarśana jñāna cāritra tapadoḷnigaḻdaḷnīgiyda rāmanumaṇu
vanuṁ śrutakēvaḷigaḷādoruḷidarellaṁ bhavardhikriyār̥ddhisampannarāda
rantu, rāmaṅge chadmasthakālaṁ nālnūruvaparṣaṁ pōge, nijadhyāna
viśēṣadiṁ, ghātikarmaṅgaḷaṁ kiḍisi, rāma kēvaḷiyuṁ, mānastambha
caturvana (himava) prākārasamētanuna mōkṣabhatrādi prātihāryā
nvitanuṁ, tribhuvana pūjitanu māgi, dharmāmr̥tamaṁ kaṟeyuttuṁttaṁ,
kēvaḷi vihāra kālamuṟumaṟinūṟuvarṣaṁ pōge, phālguṇaśuddha caturdaśiyuya
pūrvāhṇadoḷ sammēdagiriyoḷ, aghātigaḷaṁ kiḍisi, rāmamuniyuyuṁ
maṇuvanuṁ muktige sandar, vibhīṣaṇa prabhr̥tigaḷ anuddiśadoḷpuṭṭi
dar. sīteyuṁ, pr̥thvīsaundariyuṁ modalāge palarumacyuta kalpa
doḷpuṭṭidor, uḷidorellaṁ saudharmakalpadoḷpuṭṭidar, lakṣmaṇanuṁ
narakadimbandu kramadiṁ mōkṣagāmiyappaṁ.

div.head: namināthapurāṇaṁ
ippattondaneya tīrthaṅkara
śrī naminātha purāṇaṁ
śrī naminātha purāṇaṁ
div.p:
jambūdvīpada, bharatakṣētrada, vatsaviṣayuyada, kauśambinagaravu
nāḷvikṣvākuvaṁśada, pārthivanembarasuṅsaṅgaṁ, sundaridēvigaṁ, siddhārtha
nemba puganāge, pārthivanondu divasaṁ, manōharōdyānadoḷ
paramāvadhi jñānigaḷappa, munipavararemba munivararaṁ, vinayudiṁ
bandisi, dharmatattvaṁttvamaṁ kēḷdu, siddhārthaṅge rājyamaṁ koṭṭu,
saṁyusaṁyamamaṁ kaikoṇḍaṁ; siddhārthanuṁ śrāvakavrataṅgaḷaṁ kaikoṇḍu,
sukhadinirdondu divasaṁ nijagurugaḷ lōkāntarakke sandoḍaduve
nirvēgavāge, udyānavanadoḷirda mahābaḷakēvaḷigaḷa samīpadoḷāptā
gamapadārthaṅgaḷaṁ kēḷdu, saṁsāramaṁ pattuviḍuvude śrīśrēyumendu,
śrīdattaṅge rājyamaṁ koṭṭu, samadhigata kṣāyika samyaktvasaṁya
mamaṁ(dīkṣeyuṁyaṁ), kaikoṇḍēkādaśāṅgadharanāgi, bhāvitadvyaṣṭadvappakāraṇaṁ,
tīrtharthaṅkara puṇyamaṁ kaṭṭi, jīvitāntyadoḷārādhanāvidhiyiṁ, anuttare
yuparājita vimānadoḷ, lavasattattvamahamindranāgi, trayatriṁśatsāga
rōpamāyuṣyanamōnumēkaratnipramāṇa śarīrōtsēdadhanuṁ, paramu śukla
lēśyanumāgi sukhikhamirpinaṁnaṁittajambūdvīpadabharatadaaṅgaviṣayadamithiḷānagaramunāḷvaikṣvākuvaṁśadakāśyapagōtradavijayamahārājanarasivarpilādēviyarāśvijabahuḷabidigeyapaścimarātradoḷaśvinīnakṣatradoḷmanōharāyāmadoḷṣōḍaśaśubhasvapnaṅgaḷumaṁnijamukha.

itta jambūdvīpada, bharatada aṅgaviṣayuda, mithiḷānagaravunāḷva
ikṣvākuvaṁśada, kāśyapagōtrada, vijayamahārājanarasi, varpilādēvi
yar, āśvija bahuḷa bidigeya, paścimarātradoḷaśvinīnakṣatradoḷ
manōharāyāmadoḷ, ṣōḍaśa śubhasvapnaṅgaḷumaṁ, nijavamukha

pravēśi gajarūpamumuṁmaṁ, kanasusuṅgaṇḍavadhijñāniyappa nijapatiyiṁ,
tīrthakaradēvaṁ tanage tanayanappudanaṟidu, sukhamirpinavāpālavasattattva
mahamindranā dēviyugarbhakkavatarisi, munisuvrata tīrthasantānaṁ ṣaṣṭi
lakṣa varṣapramāṇaṁ pravartisuvandākāladoḷ, āṣāḍha bahuḷa daśami
yaśviniyōgadoḷ, trijñānadharaṁ puṭṭi, surarājaṁ bandu, dvitīya
kalyāṇamaṁ māḍe, triḷōkādhipatigaḷuṁ namisuvudaṟindaṁ, nami
bhaṭṭārakarendu pesaraniṭṭu pōdaṟaṟitta, daśasahasravarṣaṁ paramā
yuṣyanuṁ, padinaydu bildallaḍiyuyanuṁ, kanaka varṇanumenisi, baḷe
dijbarsicchāsiraravarṣaṁ kumārakālaṁ pōge, rājyadoḷninḷḷindaydaydāsiravarṣaṁ
rājyakālaṁ sale, mattondu divasaṁ jaḷada kāladoḷ, vanavihārakke
madasindhura skandāskandhārūḍhanāgi barpappa kumārananirvardēva(viyu)r vina
yadiṁ kaṇḍintendu jibinnapaṅgeydar.rdhātakīkhaṁ(ṣaṁ)ḍadoḷāmirvaruntapaṅgeydusaudharmakalpadoḷindiṅgeraḍaneyudivasadandudēva(viyu)rāgipuṭṭijambūdvīpadapūrvavidēhadavatsaviṣayadasusīmānagaradoḷaparājitavimānadinavatarisidaparājitatīrthakarakēvalapūjegāmirvarumpōdemunnegambharatakṣētradoḷīgaḷtīrthakararārendudēvēndrambesagoḷebhaṭṭārakarintendubesasidaraṅgaviṣayadamithiḷānagaradoḷaparājitavimānadinavatarisidanamikumārantīrthakaranakkumenenōḍabandevendusuttiyisipōdarittakumārampoṟilampokkaparājitatīrthakararaparājitavimānadiṁsukhamananubhavisibandudavadhi(prathamu)jñānakṣayōpaśamasamupalabdhabōdhiyindaṟidutammapūrvabhavasantatiyumaṁavadhārisisuprabhakumāraṅgerājyamaṅkoṭṭupariniṣkramaṇakalyāṇābhiṣēkapūrvakamuttarakuruvembaśivigeyanēṟicitravanōdyānakkeṣaṣṭhōpavāsadimbandāṣāḍhabahuḷadaśamiyaparāhṇadoḷaśvininakṣatradoḷsāsirvararasugaḷverasusaṁyamamaṅkaikoṇḍucaturjñānadharampāraṇādinadoḷvīrapuramunāḷvakanakavarṇanappadattanembarasaṁniliseniltupañcāścaryaṁnegaḻduchadmasthakālamombhattuvarṣampōgedīkṣāvanadoḷvakuḷadrumadataḍiyoḷṣaṣṭhōpavāsadiṁmārgaśiraśuddhaikādaśiyaparāhṇadoḷaśvinīnakṣatradoḷkēvalajñānōtpattiyāgesaudharmakr̥tatatkalyāṇananvatha

pravēśigajarūpamuṁmaṅkanasuṅgaṇḍavadhijñāniyappanijapatiyintīrthakaradēvantanagetanayanappudanaṟidusukhamirpinapālavasattvamahamindranādēviyugarbhakkavatarisimunisuvratatīrthasantānaṁṣaṣṭilakṣavarṣapramāṇampravartisuvandākāladoḷāṣāḍhabahuḷadaśamiyaśviniyōgadoḷtrijñānadharampuṭṭisurarājambandudvitīyakalyāṇamaṁmāḍetriḷōkādhipatigaḷuṁnamisuvudaṟindaṁnamibhaṭṭārakarendupesaraniṭṭupōdaṟittadaśasahasravarṣamparamāyuṣyanumpadinaydubillaḍiyanuṅkanakavarṇanumenisibaḷedicchāsiravarṣaṅkumārakālampōgerājyadoḷḷindaydāsiravarṣaṁrājyakālaṁsalemattondudivasañjaḷadakāladoḷvanavihārakkemadasindhuraskandhārūḍhanāgibappakumārananirvardēva(viyu)rvinayadiṅkaṇḍintendubinnapaṅgeydardhātakīkhaṁ(ṣaṁ)ḍadoḷāmirvaruṁ tapaṅgeydu, saudharmakalpa
doḷindiṅgeraḍaneyudivasadandu dēva(viyu)rāgi puṭṭi, jambūdvīpada,
pūrvavidēhada, vatsaviṣayuyada, susīmānagaradoḷaparājita vimāna
dinavatarisidaparājita tīrthakara kēvalapūjegāmirvaruṁ pōdemunnegaṁ.
bharatakṣētradoḷīgaḷ, tīrthakararārendu dēvēndraṁ besagoḷe, bhaṭṭā
rakarintendu besasidar aṅgaviṣayuyada, mithiḷānagaradoḷaparājita vimā
nadinavatarisida, namikumāraṁ tīrthakaranakkumene, nōḍabandevendu
suttiyisi pōdar itta, kumāraṁ poḻaṟilaṁ pokkaparājita tīrthakarara
parājitavimānadiṁ sukhamananubhavisibandudamavadhi(prathamamu)jñāna
kṣayōpaśamuṁma samupalabdha bōdhiyindaṟidu, tamma pūrvabhava santati
yumaṁ avadhārisi, suprabhakumāraṅge rājyamaṁ koṭṭu, pariniṣkramaṇa
kalyāṇābhiṣēkapūrvakamuttarakuruvemba śivigeyanēṟi, citravanōdyā
nakke ṣaṣṭhōpavāsadiṁ bandāṣāḍha bahuḷa daśamiyaparāhṇadoḷ,
aśvininakṣatradoḷ, sāsirvararasugaḷverasu, saṁyamamaṁ kaikoṇḍu,
caturjñānadharaṁ, pāraṇādinadoḷ, vīrapuramamunāḷva, kanakavarṇanappa,
dattanembarasaṁ nilise, niltu, pañcāścaryaṁ negaḻdeḻdu, chadmasthakāla
mombhattuvarṣaṁ pōge, dīkṣāvanadoḷ, baḷvakuḷa drumada taḍiyoḷ,
ṣaṣṭhōpavāsadiṁ, mārgaśiraśuddhaikādaśiyaparāhṇadoḷaśvinī nakṣatra
doḷ, kēvalajñānōtpattiyāge, saudharmakr̥ta tatkalyāṇananvaththa

div.head: jayasenacakravartikathā
div.p:
sahasrāṣṭanāmadharaṁ, suprabhāryarmodalāge, padineḻvaḷvargaṇadhararuṁ,
nālkaḻalkūṟayvadimbapūrvadhararuṁ, pannijchājbhāsiradaṟunūrvarśikṣakaruṁ,
sāsiradaṟunūrvar trijñānadhararuṁ, anibare kēvaḷigaḷuṁ, sāsira
daynūrvarvikriyardhiprāptaruṁ, sāsiradinnūraivadimbar manaḥ
paryayajñānigaḷuṁ, sāsirvarvādigaḷuṁ muṅḷuṁmaṅginyāyiryirkeyurmoda
lāgi nālvattaydāsirvararjiyaruṁ, ondulakke śrāvakaruṁ, mūru
lakke śrāvakiyaruṁ, asaṅkhyātadēvaruṁ, dēviyaruṁ, saṅkhyātatirya
gjātigaḷuṁ berasu, dharmōpadēśaṅgeyyuttamijchārchāsirada nālnūra
tombhatteṇṭuvarṣaṁ vihārisi, sammēdagiriyoḷ ondu tiṅgaḷ,
viharaṇamuḷiḻidu, sāsirvarmunigaḷverasu, pratimāyōgadharaṁ, vaiśākha
bahuḷa caturdaśiyayu paścimarātriyoḷ, aśvinīnakṣatradoḷ, śrīnami
bhaṭṭārakamurktirmuktigesandar, saudharmēndraṁ parinirvāṇakalyāṇānantara
māsannandanr̥tyamanāḍipōdaṁ.
div.trailer:
idu sakaḷaśāstrasaṁyama sampanna, śrīmadajitasēnabhaṭṭāraka caraṇa
kamala cañcarikaṁ, dharmapijayi śrīmaccāvuṇḍarāja viracita triṣaṣṭi
lakṣaṇa mahāpurāṇadoḷ śrīnamibhaṭṭāraka purāṇaṁ.
div.head: jayasēna cakravarti kathe
div.p:
śrīnamibhaṭṭārakaratīrthadoḷ, pannondaneyuya cakravarti, vijaya
sēnanemboṁ, tr̥tīyuya janmadoḷ, jambūdvīpadoḷ, airāvata
viṣayuyada, tripuramamunāḷva, vasundharanarapati padmāvatidēviyuya viyō
gadiṁ nirvēgadiṁ manōharōdyānadoḷirdaparadharma kēvaḷigaḷa
pakkade, dharmamaṁ kēḷdu, vinayunyandharaṅge rājyamaṁ koṭṭu, palaṁ
baruṁ berasu, saṁyamamaṁ kaikoṇḍutkr̥ṣṭa cāritradoḷnegaḻdārādhanā
vidhiyiṁ, mahāśukrakalpadoḷdēvanāgi, ṣōḍaśa sāgarōpamakālaṁ
sukhamananubhavisibandī bharatakṣētrada, kacchaviṣayuyada, kauśambīnagaravumu
nāḷvikṣvākuvaṁśada, vijayamahārājaṅgaṁ, prabhaṅkaridēvigaṁ, (vi)jayu
sēnanemba maganāgi, trisahasravarṣa paramāyuṣyanuṁ, padinaydu
bildallaḍiyuyanuṁ, kanakavarṇanuṁ, cakrādi caturdaśaratnanuṁ, navanidhi

gadhipatiyumāgi, bharataṅge pēḻdandade, daśāṅgabhōgamananubhavisu
ttirdondu divasamantaḥpuraparivravr̥taṁ, harmya taḷadoḷ, digāva
ḷōkanaṅgeyyuttamirduḷkāpātadarśanadiṁ, nirvēga paranāgi, piriya
makkaḷolladirdoḍellariṁ kiriyamagaṅge, rājyamaṁ koṭṭu, varadatta
kēvaḷigaḷa sāre, dīkṣeyaṁ kaikoṇḍēkavihāradoḷ śrutakēvaḷiyāgi,
padineṇṭuteṟada buddhimahardhiyumittettarada kriyāvr̥ddhiyuṁ, sapta
vidhamappa tapōvr̥ddhiyuṁ, trividhamappabaḷavr̥ddhiyuṁ, ṣaḍvidhamappa
rasavr̥ddhiyuṁ, aṣṭavidhamappa auṣadhavr̥ddhiyuṁ, dvividhamappa kṣētra
vr̥ddhiyuṁ, aṣṭavidhamuṁ bahuvidhamumappa vikriyārdhiyumembaṣṭa
vidhavr̥ddhi sampannanāgi, sammēdagiriya cāraṇakūṭadoḷ, prāyōpa
gamanavidhiyiṁ ayinanuttarajayanta vimānadoḷ, lavasattamahamindranāgi divya
sukhabhōgamananubhavisuttirdaṁ.

div.head: nemināthapurāṇaṁ
ippatraraḍaneya tīrthaṅkara
śrī nēminātha purāṇaṁ
śrī nēminātha purāṇaṁ
div.p:
jambūdvīpadapara vidēhada, sītānadiyaṁ baḍagaṇa taḍiya, sugaṁ
dhiḷa viṣayada, siṁhapuramanāḷva arhaddāsanembarasanātana mahādēvi jina
datteyemboḷaparīrvaruṁ, ippaṣṭaviṣayu kāma bhōgaṅgaḷananubhavisutti
darṣṭāṣṭhikaddaṣṭāhni mahāmahimeyaṁyuṁ māḍi, kuḷavistārakanappa nōrva
maganaṁ paḍiḍevenakkendu parasi, jinadatte pavaḍisuge, siṁha, gaja,
sūryarenryendu lakṣmī(sthānaṁ)gaḷaṁ kanasugaṇḍu, garbhamaṁ tāḷdi,
maganaṁ paḍadu, ripubaḷakkekka jēyayunappuppadaṟinda aparājitanendu bandhuga
ḷpesariḍe, rūpu vijñāna vinayānvitanāgi baḷeyuttirpannegamarhaddāsa
nompu divasaṁ—

vimamuḷavāhana tīrthakarara samavasaraṇaṁ, manōharōdyānadoḷ
bandirdudendu vanapāḷakaṁ pēṟi, ranijāntaḥpura parivr̥tanāgi pōgi,
dēvaraṁ pradakṣiṇaṁ geydu bandisi, pūjisi, dharmamaṁ kēḷdu, saṁsāra
śarīra bhōga parinirvēga parāyaṇanāgi, tanna nija tanūjaṅge, rājya
lakṣmikṣmīyaṁ koṭṭaynūṭṭuyamnōrvarararasugaḷveḷvarasu saṁyamamaṁ kaikoṇḍaṁ;
aparājitanuṁ samyagdarśana śuddhanāgi, śrāvaka brataṅgaḷaṁ kaikoṇḍu,
poṟalge bandondu divasaṁ, gandhamādana giriyoḷ, vimamuḷavāhana
jinapatiyumayuṁarhaddāsanuṁ muktige sandaremba vārteyaṁyuṁ kēḷdaḷdua parā
jitaṁ, vimamuḷavāhana jinapatiyaṁyuṁarhaddāsanaṁkaṇḍalladuṇṇenendeṇṭu
divasamummuṁupavāsaṁ geydu pārisalolladire, surarājanaṟidu, dhanapatiyuṁ

vimamuḷavāhananaarhaddāsana pratibimbamaṁ tōṟise, kr̥tārthanāgi,
namaskāraṅgeydu pārise, mattondu divasaṁ phālgunaṇanandīśvaradoḷ,
jinabhavanaṅgaḷanarjircisi, prītimatimodalāgellarantaḥpurakkellaṁ dharmōpa
dēśaṁ geyvuttirdu, cāraṇa tapōdhana yugaḷaṁ bare, kaṇḍidirerdu
bandisi, dharmamaṁ kēḷdu, kiridu bēgadinaparājitanendaṁ— bhaṭṭāraka,
nimmaṁ munna kaṇḍaṟivantāgirdudendoḍavaroḷ piriya munipati
gaḷ, nīmevemmaṁ kaṇḍeḍeyaṁyuṁ pēḷvimendintenṟvamendintendadar—

puṣkara varadvīpada, paḍuvaṇa mandaradaparavidēhada,sītā(tōdā)
nadiya baḍagaṇa taḍiyuya gandhiḷa viṣayada, vijayārdhaduttaraśrēṇiya
sūryaprabha nagaramanāḷva sūryaprabhanemba khēcara rājaṅgaṁ, dhāriṇi
dēvigaṁ, cintāgatiyuṁ, manōgatiyuṁ, capaḷagatiyumemba mūva
rtaneyurādarā śrēṇiyoḷarindamapuramanāḷvariñjayu narapatigamajita
sēnādēvigaṁ, prītimatiyemba magaḷāge, gagana gamana svayambaramaṁ
māḍe, mandaragiriyoḷākege, palaruṁ vidyādharar, sōle(pōri),
baṟi(kke)yuṁ manōgatiyumaṁmuṁ, capaḷagatiyumamunākegele, cintāgati
yuddhadoḷ geldu, nīnenna tammaṁ capaḷagatige māle sūḍuvudendoḍe
nnageldaldu nīnirdante, perargemāpāleyu sūḍenene, cintāgatiyendanenna
tammandir kāraṇamāgi ninnoḷ poṇadrdurdugeldeṁldaṁ, nīnivaranolladandu,
ninna kaikoḷviḷvenallenene, adaṁ kēḷdāke nirvēgadiṁ, rāmārjikā samīpa
doḷ, prītimati tapamaṁ kaikoṇḍaḷadaṁ kaṇḍu, palaruṁ tapambaṭṭar.
cintāgati, manōgati, capaḷagatigaḷuṁ, dharmamavara gurugaḷa pakkade,
saṁyamamaṁ kaikoṇḍu, jīvitāntadoḷ, māhēndrakalpadoḷ,
sāmānika dēvarāgi, saptasāgarōpamāntadoḷ, manōgatiyuṁ, capaḷa
gatiyuṁ, jambūdvīpada pūrvavidēhada, puṣkalāvatī viṣayada, vija
yārdhaduttaraśrēṇiyu, gaganavallabha nagaramanāḷva, gaganacandra mahārā
jaṅgaṁ, gagana sundarigaṁ, amitagāmiyuṁ, amitatējarumemba
taneyuremāgi, puṇḍarīkiṇiyoḷ, svayamprabha tīrthakara pakkade, tamma
bhavatrayamaṁ kēḷdaḷdumattaṇṇaṁ cintāgati ellirdanendu besagoḷe, siṁhapura
doḷaparājitanāgi rājyaṁ geyyuyvuttirdanene, tatsamīpadoḷīrvaruṁ
saṁyamamaṁ kaikoṇḍu, gagana cāraṇar̥ddhi sampannarumāgi, nimmaṁ
nōḍalendu bandemāmuṁvāvuṁ, nimma tammandiremenvendaṟipe, ninagondu

tiṅgaḷāyuyuṁṣyavunvandaṟiṁ, paralōkahitavuṁ bagevudendoḍaparājita
nendaṁ— nīvuṁ, niḥsaṅgarāgiyuṁ, pūrvasambandhadinenagenitupa
kāraṁ geydirendoḍavaruṁ, parasi pōdaritta prītiṅkaraṅge rājyavuṁ
koṭṭaṣṭāhnika jajinapūjeyuṁ māḍi, bandu, visarjanaṁ geydayduparājita
nippatteraḍu divasaṁ, prāyōpagavumana sanyasanadinacyutakalpada, sātaṅkara
vimānadoḷacyutēndranāgi, dvāviṁśati sāgarōpavamāntadoḷ—

jambūdvīpada, bharata kurujāṅgaṇa viṣayada, hastināpuravumanāḷva,
śrīcandra mahārājaṅgaṁ, śrīmati dēvigaṁ, supratiṣṭhanemba maganāgi,
yauvanōdayadoḷ, sunandādēviyuṁ maduvenile, śrī candranā
taṅge rājyavuṁ koṭṭu, sumundara munigaḷa pakkade, dīkṣitanādonitta
supratiṣṭha narapatiyuṁ, yaśōdhara munigāhāradānavuṁ koṭṭā
ścarya pañcakavuṁ paḍedondudivasavuntaḥpurasahitaṁ, harmya taḷa
doḷiruḷu, digāvalōkanaṅgeyyuyvuttirduḷkāpātavuṁ kaṇḍaduve nirvē
gadiṁ, nēsavurmūḍidāgaḷ, sudr̥ṣṭige rājyavuṅkoṭṭu, sumundira
jinara samīpadoḷ, dīkṣeyuṁ koṇḍēkādaśāṅgadharaṁ, ṣōḍaśa bhāvane
gaḷiṁ tīrthaṅrthakara puṇyavuṁ kaṭṭi, nijāyurantya(kālāntara)doḷ
mūṟutiṅgaḷ, prāyōpagavumana sanyāsanadindanuttara jayanta vimā
nadoḷahamindranāgi; trayutriṁśatsāgarōpamāyuṣyanumēka ratni
pramāṇōtsēdhanuṁ, śuklalēśyāpariṇāmanuṁ, pañcadaśadinādhika
ṣōḍaśamāvāsa niśvāsanuṁ, trayutriṁśadvarṣa sahasra mānasāmr̥tāhā
ranuṁ, sapravicārānantaguṇaniḥpravicāra sukhanuṁ, lōkanāḷikābhyaṁ
taragatāvadhijñānanuṁ, svāvadhi kṣētrabaḷaprakāśa vikriyā prabhr̥tiguṇa
vibhūṣaṇanuvāmāgi sukhavamananubhavisuttirdaṁ.

ittalādēvaṁ puṭṭuva kulavyāvarṇanaṁ jambūdvīpada, bharatada,
vatsaviṣayada, kauśambīnagaravumanāḷvoṁ, maghavanembarasaṅgaṁ, vīta
śōkādēvigaṁ raghuvemboṁ maganāpoḻabiloḷe sumukhanemba seṭṭi
yāge, vīradattanemba paradaravumagaṁ, sārthadoḍane pōge, kōḷpaḷvaṭṭu,
tannapeṇḍati vanamāleverasu pōgi, kauśambige bandu, sumukha śeṭṭigā
ḷāgirpinavondudivasaṁ vanavihārakke pōdalli, vanamāliyuṁ kaṇḍu,
sumukhaṁ panninneraḍu varṣadaparadiṅge, vīradattanambesanaṭṭi, vanamāleli
yoḷ puduvālittirpinaṁ. panninneraḍaneyu varṣakke, vīradattaṁ bandu,

tatprattvapañcavumanaṟidellargaṁ puyyargampraykaliṭṭoḍāruvārayydiyyidire, nirvēgadiṁ,
prōṣṭhila munigaḷapakkade, dīkṣeyaṁ koṇḍu, jīvitāntadoḷ,
saudharmakalpadoḷ, citrāṅgadanemba dēvanādoṁ, itta seṭṭiyuṁ,
vanamāleyuṁ, dharmasiṁha munige niravadyāhāravuṁ koṭṭu, dāna
puṇyavuṁ paḍedu, tamma duścaritakke kokkarisuttirdondu divasaṁ,
siḍilpolvoḍeyesattu, bharatakṣētrada, harivarṣa viṣayada, bhōgapuravuma
nāḷva, harivaṁśada, prabhañjana narapatigaṁ, mr̥kaṇḍū dēvigaṁ, siṁha
kētuvemba maganādoṁ. vasvāḷeya nagaravumanāḷva, vajracāpa mahī
patigaṁ, śubhādēvigaṁ, vanamāḷe vidyudyanmāḷeyemba magaḷādoḷākeyuṁ,
siṁhakētuṁ maduve nile, vanavihāradoḷavarirvaruṁrumuṁ, citrāṅgada
dēvaṁ kaṇḍu, kolalendettikoṇḍu pāṟuge(pōge) munnapēḻda,
raghunarapati sumukhapriya sahāyuṁyaṁ, śrāvakabrata phaladiṁ, saudharma
kalpadoḷsūryaprabhanemba dēvanāgi puṭṭi, citrāṅgadanaṁ kaṇḍu, nīni
varaṁ kondaḍe phalamāvuduṁ, pāpānubandhi(panibandhana) ninagadayu
ktamīmithunavuṁ bisuḻvudene, citrāṅgada dēvaṁ, nijapuṇyaparipāka
manīyeḍeyoḷī mithunaṅgaḷeyddenydugendaṅgaviṣayayuda, campānagaradu
dyānadoḷ bisuṭu pōpuduṁ.

ā poḻaḻilanāḷva, candrakīrti embarasanaputrakanāgi kaḷeyeṁye, rājya
santānakke yōgyananarasalendu, prakr̥ti maṇḍaḷaṁ, gandhagajavuṁ gandha
puṣpādigaḷanarjisi biḍe, vanadoḷirda mithunavumanetti, nijaskandhavumanē
ṟisi poḻaḻilaṁ puge tadviṣaya prakr̥tigaḷeddudurdu, rājyābhiṣēkaṁ geydu,
ninna tāyuṁ, tandeyuvāmārendu, mantri, sāvansvāmantādigaḷ besagoḷe,
mr̥kaṇḍuvuṁ prabhañjananuṁ endhanumendaṟipi. harivaṁśa sambhavanēnendu pēḻdaḻdi,
mr̥kaṇḍuge puṭṭidaṟiṁ, mārkaṇḍēyanendu pesaraniṭṭu, munnavāmādi
tīrthakara kāladoḷ harivaṁśavāmādudinnītana putra pautra santāna
kkekellaṁ, harivaṁśa vyapadēśavukkendubhijanaṅgaḷ stutiyise, palakāla
marasugeyddaydu, mārkaṇḍēyana santānadoḷ harigiriyuṁ, hēmamu
giriyuṁ, vasugiriyuṁ modalāge palaruvamatikrāntarāge—

kaśārthaviṣayuda, sauryapuravumanāḷva, sūrasēna narapatige puṭṭida
sūravīragaṁ, dhāriṇidēvigaṁ, andhakavr̥ṣiyuṁ, narapati vr̥ṣṇiyu
memba tanayarādaravaroḷandhakavr̥ṣi gaṁ,subhadregaṁ, savumudravijayanuṁ

akṣōbhanuṁ, stimitasāgaranuṁ, himavantanuṁ, vijayanuṁ,
acaḷanuṁ, dāraṇanuṁ, pūraṇanuṁ, abhinandananuṁ, vasudēvanumbemnumemba
padimbartaneyaruṁ, kontiyuṁ, mādriyumbemyumembirvartanujeyaru
māge, savumudravijayādigaḷuvumappombadimbargarṁrgaṁ, śivadēviyuṁ, dhr̥tī
śvareyuṁ, svayamprabheyuṁ, susīmeyuṁ, sīteyuṁ, priya
vacaneyuṁ, prabhāvatiyuṁ, kāḷindiyuṁ, suprabheyumbemyumembarasiyayu
rāge, narapativr̥ṣṇigaṁ, padmāvatigaṁ, ugrasēnanuṁ, dēvasēnanuṁ,
mahāsēnanumbemnumemba mūvarmagandiruṁ, gāndhāriyumbemyumemba pumagaḷu
māge, kuruvaṁśada pāṇḍurājaṅge kontiyuṁ, mādriyuvuṁ,
dhr̥tarāṣṭraṅge gāndhāriyuvuṁmuṁ kuḍe, pāṇḍunarapatigaṁ kontigaṁ
munnaveme jāragarbhadoḷ, karṇaṁ puṭṭidanadentendoḍe—

hastinapuravumanāḷva, kuruvaṁśada śaktinarapatigaṁ, śavakiyembara
sigaṁ, parāśaranemboṁ maganādoṁ. parāśaraṅgaṁ, matsyakuḷa rāja
suteyappa satyavatigaṁ vyāsanemba maganādoṁ, byāsaṅgaṁ subhadregaṁ
dhr̥tarāṣṭranuṁ, pāṇḍuvuṁ, viduranumbemnumemba mūvartanayurāge, vajra
māḷiniyemba vidyādharaṁ, vanavihāradoḷ, tanna hastamudrikeyuṁ
maṟiṟedupōge, pāṇḍurājanā mudrikeyuṁ kaṇḍu koḷvuduṁ; ā
khacaranarasuttumttambare, nīnēnanaṟisidappeyendu pāṇḍurājaṁ besagoḷe,
vanavihāradoḷennaṅguravuṁmuṁ kiḍisidenendu khēcaraṁ pēḻdaḻdi, ninnaṅgu
rada sāvumarthyamēnendu besagoḷe, kāvamarūpa sādhinimembuduṁ; adara
sāvumarthyavuṁ nōḻpanannegaṁ kelavu divasamonna kayyoḷikkene, khacaraṁ
koṭṭupōdanitta pāṇḍurājaṁ māyārūpadiṁ kontiyoḷ, aprakāśa
saṁsargavuṁmāḍe, karṇaṁ puṭṭidoḍāruvamaṟiyadardandantu, mandasi
noḷ, ratnakavaca kuṇḍala, lēkhapatrasahitaṁ, putrananikki kuḍe, paricā
rakaryuvumunā pravāhadoḷ biṭṭubandar.

itta, campāpuravumanāḷva ādityanembarasaṁ, saritpravāhadoḷ
pōpa mandasavuṁmuṁ tarisi, tadantargata bālakanaṁ rādheyemba tannarasige
koṭṭoḍātanāgaḷ rādheyu karṇasparśanaṁ geydudaṟiṁ, karṇa
nemba(du) pesaraniṭṭanitta, pāṇḍurājaṅgaṁ, kontigaṁ, yudhiṣṭhiranuṁ,
bhīmanuṁ, arjunanumbemnumemba taneyaruṁ, mādrige, nakuḷa sahadēva
remba tanūjaruvāmāge, dhr̥tarāṣṭraṅgaṁ, gāndhārigaṁ, duryōdhana,

duśśāsana, durdarśana, durmarṣaṇādigaḷ nūrvarmakkaḷāge,
mattondu divasaṁ gandhamādanagiriyoḷ, supratiṣṭhamumuṁni samīpa
doḷ, sūravīraṁ tanna putra-pautrādigaḷverasu dharmavuṁ kēḷdu,
saṁvēgaparanandhakavr̥ṣṇige rājyavuṁ koṭṭu, narapativr̥ṣṇige yuvarāja
paṭṭaṅgaṭṭi, saṁyavumavuṁ kaikoṇḍaṁ.

itta, dvādaśa varṣātikrāntadoḷ gandhamādana giriyoḷ, supra
tiṣṭha muni pratimāyōgadoḷire, sudarśananemba dēvaṁ muḷidupa
sargaṁ māḍe, tadupasargavuṁ sairisi, kēvaḷigaḷāge, barpa dēva nikāyayu
doḍane kēvaḷipūjegandhakavr̥ṣṇiyuṁ bandu, dēva, nivumagīdēvaṁ,
mahōpasargavuṁ, eṅkāraṇadiṁ māḍidonene, jinapatigaḷ besasidar—
jambūdvīpada, bharatada, kaḷiṅgaviṣayada, kāñcīpurada, paradar, sūra
dattanuṁ, sudattanumbemnumembarantirvar, aśōkadvīpa laṅkādvīpādi
gaḷoḷokkaḷavoḍave badaḍadu poḻaḻilaṁ puguvalli suṅkigargaḷkaḷki, maguḻdu
bandu koḷvenḷvemendondu podaṟaṟikeḷage pūḻdupōpudumōrvaṁ
śauṇḍikaṁ madyaprayōga hētuvappa vanaspati mūḷavumanagaḷuttumavara
pūṟikoḻkoḍaveyuṁ kaṇḍu, bēruṁ, (bakke)bikkeyoḷ barpudīyoḍave
matputrapautrādigaḷellamāvamaraṇāntambaraṁ sālgulvumendu rāgisi
koṇḍu pōpanannegaṁ. avarīrvarumalli tavmommoḍaveyu kāṇadōrō
rvaraṁ nambade, tavmommoḷōrōrvanaṟidu sattu, modalanarakadoḷpuṭṭi
bandu, vindhyāṭaviyoḷ, tagargaḷāgi pōddudu sattu, gaṅgātīrada
gōkuladoḷ, basavaṅgaḷāgi, mattalli poṇardu sattu, savmēmmēda giri
yoḷ vānaraṅgaḷāgi, śilāsalilanimittamondondaṁ tindondāgaḷe
sattudondu kōḍagaṁ kaṇṭhagataprāṇanāgire, suraguru, dēvaguru
gaḷemba cāraṇa tapōdhanar(r̥ṣiyar) dharma tattvavamanaṟipi, pañca
navamaskāraphalavuṁmuṁ pēḻdaḻdi, kaikoṇḍu, saudharmakalpadoḷcitrāṅgada
nemboṁ dēvanāgi (alliṁ) bandu, jambūdvīpada, bharatada, suramya
viṣayada paudanapuravumanāḷva, susthita nr̥patigaṁ, sulakṣaṇegaṁ, supratiṣṭha
nemba maganāgi, jaḷada kāladoḷormerve markaṭa yuddhavuṁmuṁ asita giri
yoḷ kaṇḍu, pūrvabhava sambandhavuṁmuṁ nenedu, sudharmācāryara
pakkade, dīkṣegoṇḍu kēvaḷigaḷādemāvunmundina sūradatta cararemā
sudatta carakapiyuṁ, saṁsāradoḷttiḷtiridu, sindhutīradoḷ, mr̥gā

yaṇanembaṁ tāpasaṅgaṁ, viśāḷeyemboḷggaṁ, gautamanemboṁ maganāgi,
pañcāgni tapadiṁ, jyōtirlōkadoḷ, sudarśananemba dēvanāgi,
pūrvabhava vairamaṁ nenedemuṅmagupasargaṁ māḍidanembudupudaṁ kēḷdu,
sudarśanaṁ vairamaṁ pattuviṭṭu, saddharmamaṁ kaikoṇḍanāgaḷandhaka
vr̥ṣṇiyuṁ, mukuḷita karakamaḷanāgi, tanna pūrvabhavamaṁvaṁ besagoḷe,
jinapatigaḷintendu besasidar.

jambūdvīpada, vinītāpurādhipananantavīryanembarasanāpoli
loḷ, surēndradattanemba paradaṁ, sakaḷāgama pāragaṁ, saddharma
vatsaḷaṁ, nitya pūjeyoḷpattattraṣṭavimi yoḷippattamāvāsyeyoḷ nālvattu,
puṇṇameyoḷeṇbattu geydu, gadyāṇa ponnanarhatpūjegaṁ, pātradā
nakkaṁ koṭṭu, śīlōpavāsaṅgaḷoḷ negaldu, dharmaparanendellargaṁ
stutyanāgirdondu divasaṁ paradupōvōgalbagedu, tanna keḷeyuṁyaṁ rudradatta
nemba pārvanaṁ karedu, dēvapūjā vyayakke, panneraḍuvarṣada ponnaṁ
koṭṭinna barpannega muharttūppamarhatpūjegaṁ, pātradānakkaṁ māḍpulpudendu
pōdoḍāpārvanuṁ, strīdyūtavyasanādigaḷinā ponnellamaṁ tavisi, kaḷa
ltaltuguḷdondu divasaṁ, arasara taḷāraṁ sēnakanemboṁ, iruḷkaṇḍu,
ninnaṁ brāhmaṇanidormmagaṁrmmergaṁ, kolvinaldīpuradiṁ poramavaṭṭu pōgu,
ninnaninnelli kaṇḍoḍaṁ kolvenendoḍonduḷkāmukhimemba, bēḍara
paḷḷiyoḷirpa kāḷakanemba vyāghradhanoḷkūḍi, vinītānagarada tuṟuvaṁ
koṇḍalli sēnakaṁ kole, sattu, narakambokku bandu, timiṅgaḷanuṁ,
kēsariyuṁ, dr̥ṣṭiviṣanuṁ, śārdūḷanuṁ, śakuntapatiyuṁ, vyāḷanuṁ,
vyādhapatiyumāgi, sattu, narakaṅgaḷellamaṁmuṁ kramadiṁ kūḍe pokku,
poramaṭṭu, trasa sthāvara yōnigaḷoḷ palakālaṁ tolilaldu, jambū
dvīpada, kurujāṅgaṇa viṣayada, hastinapuramaṁ, dhanañjayanembo
nāḷuttire, gautamagōtrada, kapiṣṭaṣṭhanemba pārvaṅgamuṁmasundarigaṁ,
gautamanemba maganādonātana puṭṭidāgaḷe, kuladoḷuḷḷellaruṁ sāye,
kṣudhābādheyiṁ, kr̥śīkr̥tōdaranumasthitirāvaśiṣṭatanuvuṁ, lakṣāyuṅkā
cita śirōruhanumāgi, (caṁ)bhadrakāḷiyuṁ koṇḍutiridu, pugarada
maneyaṁyuṁ pokku, bikkeyumaṁ paḍeyude, ouṟidu bisuṭa kūḷaṁ
kāgeyuṁ tānuṁ tiṇḍutindu, tanna bāyunātakke noṇaṁmuṁṇaṁmusuṟiṟa, gomma
gareye, jīrṇājīrṇa kappaṭāvr̥ta kaṭitaṭanumanmatimumalinavarṇanumpunumappavaḷaṁ

biṭita daṇḍanuṁ, rasanēndriya vaśagatanumāgi suḷivanaṁ, poliṟila bāla
karsderneredu, baṟiyuṁ taguḷduldu, kalguṇḍaṁ kaṟiṟeye, muḷidu, magu
biddāṟdāgaḷe, keḍadintukālamaṁ. kaḷiputtirdondu divasaṁ, tanage karma
kṣayōpaśamuvāmamāge, samudrasēnaremba muniyar carigevokkoḍavara
baṟiyusene pōgi, samr̥ddhanappa vaiśravaṇanemba vaṇikpatiya maneyoḷā
kaṇṭhakaṇḍapramāṇamuṇḍu, munipatiyāśramumakke bandennaṁ nimmante māḍpulpu
dene, bhaṭṭārakar bhavyanendaṟidu, kelavu divasambaramoḍanirisi,
saṁyamumamaṁ kuḍe, palavuvarṣamutkr̥ṣṭa tapadoḷgiḷkegaldu, kōṣṭavr̥vya
(bu)ddhiyuṁ, akṣīṇāsanavuṁ, kṣīrāśrāvitamuṁ, vikriyeyumbemba
buddhigaḷaneydu, gurugaḷ śrī gautamanemba pesarumumpaṁ, guru
sthānavummumpaṁ koṭṭu, jīvitāntyadoḷ, madhyamagraivēyakada suvi
śāḷamembūrdhva vimānadoḷ puṭṭidar. śrīgautamanumārādhanā
vidhiyiṁ sanyāsanaṁ geydu suviśāḷa vimānadoḷ ahamindranāgi,
divyabhōgamunippatteṇṭu sāgarōpama kālamamunanubhavisi bandandhaka
vr̥ṣṇiyāde, endu, tannabhavamunaṟipe, tannatanayaranibara bhavasambandha
manandhakavr̥ṣṇi besagoḷe, sarvabhāṣā svabhāvakamappa divyadhvaniyoḷ
kēvaḷigaḷanḷintendu besasidar.

jambūdvīpada, bharatada, maleya viṣayada, bhadriḷa purama nāḷvaḷpa,
mēgharathagaṁ, subhadregaṁ, pr̥ḍhathurathanemba maganātaṅge, yuvarāja
paṭṭaṅgaṭṭi, tatpuradoḷ, dhanadatta seṭṭigaṁ, nandayuyaśōvanitegaṁ,
dhanadēvanuṁ, dhanapāḷanuṁ, jinadēvanu, jinapāḷanuṁ. arhaddattanuṁ,
arhaddāsanuṁ, jinadattanuṁ, priyamitranuṁ, dharmaruciyumemyumbemba
kombadimbartanayarāge, priyadarśaneyuṁ, jyēṣṭheyumemyumbemba
nirvartanūjeyarāge, sukhamirdondu divasaṁ, sudarśanōdyāna
modoḷirda, mandara gurugaḷa samīpadoḷ, arasanuṁ, seṭṭiyuṁ, putra
kaḷatra parivāra sahitaṁ, dharmamaṁ kēmaṅkeḷdarasaṁ, nirvēgadiṁ, dr̥ḍharathaṅge
rājyamaṁ koṭṭu, tapambaṭṭu, seṭṭiyuyuṁmombadimbarmakkarkkaḷverasu
dīkṣitanādaṁ, nandayuyaśōvaniteyuṁ, tattanūjeyarirvaruṁ, sudarśa
nāryikeyuvara pakkade, saṁyamamaṁ kaikoṇḍarāmēgharathamunige,
vāraṇāsiya priyaṅgu ṣaṇḍōdyānadoḷ kēvala jñānaṁ puṭṭeṭṭi, dhana
pattanumalliye kēvaliyāgi, bhavyajanakke dharmāmr̥tamaṁ kaṟidu,

jīvitāntyadoḷ, rājagr̥hada siddhaśiḷātaḷadoḷ muktige sandara(a)
lliye dhanadēvādigaḷombadimbaruṁ, prāyōpagamanadiṁ, sanyāsanaṁ
geydudaṁ kaṇḍu, nandayuyaśōvaniteyuṁ, jyēṣṭheyuṁ, priyadarśa
neyuṁ ī bhavadoḷintādudante, maṟubhavadoḷaṁ emumaginibaroḷaṁ
bandhu sambandhamakkendu, nidānaṅgeydu, tāvuṁmuṁ sanyāsanadiṁ muḍipi,
tammanibarumānata kalpada, sātaṅkara vimānadoḷ puṭṭi, viṁśati
sāgarōpamāntadoḷalliṁ bandu, nandayuyaśōvanite subhadreyādaḷ,
dhanadēvādigaḷ samudravijayādigaḷādar, priyadarśaneyuṁ,
jyēṣṭheyuṁ, konti, mādriṅgaḷādarembuduṁ.

mattaṁ, vasudēvanabhava sambandhamumbesagoḷe, bhaṭṭārakarintendu
besasidar kuruviṣayada, paḷāsakūṭa grāmadoḷ sōmaśarmanemba
baḍapārvanamagaṁ nandiyemboṁ, tammamāvanappa dēvaśarmana mane
yoḷ kūsuvaḍevāseyoḷire, puṭṭideṇbar magaḷdirumaṁ, māvaṁ
peṟaṟirge kuḍe, duḥkhitanāgi, mattondu divasaṁ, mahānāṭakamaṁ
nōḍuttirda jana saṅghaṭṭadoḷavara karapraharadiṁ, peṟaṟimeṭṭuvāgaḷeḍapi
keḍeye, kaṇḍu, kaipaṟiguṭṭi, nerada janamellaṁ nage nāṇci, bhr̥gupatana
doḷ sāvenendu pōgi, parvatamanēṟi sāyuyalbagedañji, maguḷdviḷvi
neliṟilaṁ kaṇḍāgiriya taḷpadoḷirda. śaṅkharuṁ, nirnāmikarumemba
tapōdhanartammaguragaḷappa, drumasēnaranidāranebiṟilene, nimagiṁ mūṟiṟa
neya janmadoḷ tandeyappātana neṟilembudumīrvarumātanallige
vandu, nimagī maraṇa nirvēgaṁ niṣphalādudaṟiṁ, saubhāgyarūpu
bhōgādigaḷaṁ bayasuvaḍe, tapadindamakkekkumendaṟipi, tapamaṁ
kaikoḷisi, jīvitāntadoḷ, mahāśukra kalpadoḷdēvanāgi, ṣōḍaśa
sāgarōpa māntadoḷnagevāvamagaṁ vasudēvanādonembuduṁ, andhaka
vr̥ṣṇisaṁvēga paranāgi, samudravijayaṅge paṭṭaṅgaṭṭi, supratiṣṭhajinara
pakkade, palambaruṁ berasu, dīkṣeyuṁ kaikoṇḍu mōkṣakke pōdaṁ,

itta, vasudēva kumāraṁ, gandha gajārūḍhanāgi, hastyaśvaratha
padātiparivr̥taṁ, śaṅkha paṭaha bhērīravaṅgaḷeseye, puṇyapāṭhakarōde,
vandivāmāgadhar pogaṟiṟa, muktāmaṇi kaṇṭhikāḷaṅkr̥ta pakṣasthaḷanāgi,
rājalīleyiṁ neradōlagaṁ poṟaṟimuḍe, niccaluṁ, nagaravaniteyurātana
rūpuviḷāsamaṁ kaṇḍu, gr̥havyāpāramaṁ maṟidu, tammatreyara

mundugaṇgaḷaṁ gaṇḍara mātugaḷanavakarṇise, nagara janaṅgaḷ vipaṇṇarāgi
pōgi, samudravijayaṅge puyyaliḍe, kumāraṅge, manakṣatamāvāgadantu,
bēṟi karedendaṁ tammaninna mey sītōṣṇādibādheyiṁ, vicchāplāya
mādudadaṟindōlagaṁ poṟaṟimuḍavēḍa, rājabhavanamudupavanada, dārāgr̥gra
haṅgaḷoḷaṁ, kr̥takācaḷaṅgaḷoḷaṁ, mantri, sāmanta, yōdha,
mahāmātra, sūnugaḷverasu vinōdadoḷirpudene, tammaṇṇana vacanamaṁ
mīṟadāsthitiyoḷe sukhamirpinaṁ nipuṇamatiyemba leṅkaṁ bandu,
ninnanīne(vana)vapadoḷarasaṁ seṟiyāgikkidaṁ, nīnidanaṟideyillene,
kumāraṁ ninnaṟidandamāvudendu besagoḷe, niccaṁ nīṁ poṟaṟimaḍu
vāgaḷ, nagara vaniteyurninnanēnonōḍi, meymaṟivaruṁ, maṟuguvaruṁ,
tammagaṇḍaranavajñegeyvaruṁ, ninnanē kanavanisuvaruṁ, kanasugāṇbaru
māge, nagarajanarapuyyalge, ninaginitaṁmāḍidonene, tannaleṅkana
mātaṁ parīkṣisalendu, poramaḍalpalbageye, paḍiyaṟaṟinaḍḍaṁḍdaṁ bandu,
nimmaṇṇana besanintuṭu māṇimene, leṅkana mātaṁ nambi, mattondu
divasaṁ, vidyāsādhanakke pōdapenembanevaṁ māḍi, samunmudravijayādi
gaḷge pēṟide pōgi, vasudēvakumāranagnipravēśaṅgeydendōle
yamyumbaredu, kudureya koraḷoḷkaṭṭi, beṅgevandu, citā(takā)gniyaṁyuṁ
pradakṣiṇaṅgeydalli pāydante māḍi, hayamammumbisuṭu, meymaygeredu
pōgi, vijayapuramaneyduydi, bahirudyānadaśōka vr̥kṣadaḍiyoḷire,
neṟiltirigadirdudaṁ kaṇḍādēśapuruṣanendaṟidu, vanapāḷakaṁ magadha
rājaṅgaṟipe, koṇḍubandu, tanna magaḷaṁ śyāmaḷeyuṁ tanage kuḍe,
kelavu divasamirdu, bañcisi pōgi, dēvadāruvanada, puṣpāraṇyamemba
koḷadoḷ vanagajadoḍane nīrāṭamāḍi beṅgevare, kaṇḍōrva vidyādhara
nītaṁ kāraṇapuruṣanendaṟidu, vāraṇadindiṟipi, vijayārdhapa, kinnara
gītamanāḷva anivēgaṅgaṁ, pavanavēgegaṁ puṭṭida, śālmalīdatteyuṁ
kuḍe, koṇḍu, kelavudivasa mallirdallindaṁ pōgalbagedirpinamumaśani
vēgana dāyiganaṅgāravēganemboṁ, kumārananettikoṇḍu gaganadoḷ
pōpudumanaṟidu, śālmalidatte satteyendu (eddu) khaḷga haste
yāgi, baṟiyaṁ taguḷdaṟili, kumāranaṁ bisuṭōḍidaṁ.

itta, parṇa laghuvidyeyiṁ, campāpura samīpada sarōvara madhya
gata dvīpadoḷmellaniṟipuvudumadaṟataḍiyoḷirda, janamanāva baṭṭe

yimbarpudendu besagoṇḍoḍītaṁ, oṭṭeyayuṟiyadākāśadimbirda
nakkumendoḍoḷtaṟidirākāśadimbirdenendoḍavarkku baṭṭeyuṁ
dōṟi, pōṟipuṭpaṭṭi, pōṟalaṁ pokku, manōharanemba gāndharvō
pādhyāyanaṁ kaṇḍirpinamalli,gandharvadatteyeṁ boḷavaḷā,vīṇāsvayaṁ
barakkendu, palaruṁ vīṇā śikṣegeyye, vasudēvaṁ tanna parijñānamumaṁmuṁ
paṟirariyayudantu, vīṇeyuṁ koṇḍu, tumbi,phaḷabhēdanaṁ,tantricchēdanaṁ,
daṇḍa bhañjanādigaḷaṁ māṟpuduṁ, chātrarellarumahāpahāsyaṅgeyye,
kelakālamirpinaṁ; gandharvadatteyu svayamyumbarakke bhūcara khēcara
janaṅgaḷgeṟiye, cārudatta prabhr̥tigaḷ, svayamyumbara prāsāda maṇḍaḷa
doḷ, śrōtr̥gaḷāgire, gāndharvadatte vīṇāvādyadoḷpalabarumaṁmuṁ
gele, vasudēvaṁ nijōpādhyāyaṅyuṅgaṟipi, pīṭhamanēṟi, nijōcita
mappa nirdōṣamappa vīṇeyuṁ tannimene, nālkailkedu, bīṇeyuṁ
mundirkuvupudumalli, tantriyoḷ lōmalavadarśanamuṁvuṁ, tumbi biḷa
phaḷadoḷ śalyadarśanamuṁvuṁ, daṇḍadōṣadoḷ, pāṣāṇa prakaṭīkaraṇamaṁma
geyye, ninagabhimatamappa bīṇeyāvudene, kumāranemma meccuva
vīṇegaḷintakkumenda (sva)thārthākhyānamuṁvuṁ pēṟiltaguḷdaṁ.

hastinapuramamunāḷva, mēgharathaṅgaṁ, padmāvatigaṁ, viṣṇuvuṁ,
padmarathanumemba tanayarāge, mēgharathanu viṣṇu, tapakke pōge, padma
rathaṁ pitr̥sthānadoḷ nindondu divasaṁ, pratyantavāsigaḷ masagibare,
baliyemba mantri sāmādigaḷiṁ prasavise, padmarathaṁ mecci ninnamecci
dudaṁ bēḍene, saptadinambaramāne rājyaṅgeyvenendu mantri bēḍi
koḷe, koṭṭoḍondu divasa māpovila suramyaka giriyoḷ akampana
gurupramukhamunimaṇḍaḷa mātapayōgadoḷire, mantri, munne,
vidvatsabheyōḷakampanaguruge nuḍidu sōltanappudarinavaraṁ kolalba
gedu, rājyamaṅkoṇḍu, mantri tadgiriya baḷasiyuṁ, prārthitagāgrā
hāramaṅkuḍalendu pavanada dēvatāparitarpaṇaṅgeyyalendu, yajñada
nevadiṁ suttaluṁ, dhūmōpasargamaṁvuṁ māḍe, viṣṇu kumāraṁ padmaratha
nalligevare, sarāgavirāgāsanavu nēralikki doḍevarvirāgāsanadoḷ kuḷḷi
rpuduṁ, padmarathanabhivandisi, nimaṅgāvudabhimatamudaṁ tīrcuveṁ,
besasimenvendoḍātapayōgadoḷḷinḷninda munigaḷge, ninnamantri mahōpa
sargamaṁmuṁ mūḍidappanadaṁ piṅgisembuduṁ ēṟuḷudivasaṁ baramemonna rājya

manātaṅgekoṭṭenenage bālisalbāradu, nīme pōgi māṇisimene, vāmana
rūpadiṁ brāhmaṇanāgi baliyallige pōgi, svasti, mahāpuruṣa, ninnallige
bēḍibandemenevemase, ninagāvudu bārteyayudaṁ koḷḷeḷḷavemene, mūṟaḍi
nelanaṁ nī nīvumemvembuduṁ kiṟidaṁ bēḍidodiroḷḷittāgi koḷvadenḷvdendu,
jaḷadhārāpūrvakaṁ kuḍe, vikriyeyinondu kālaṁ mānuṣōttara
parvataśikharadoḷmattondu kālaṁ mērugiriya mastakadoḷāge,
mattondaḍigeḍeyillade vijr̥mbhise, khēcarabhūcararneredu, gīta, vīṇā
mukharāgi bandu, saṁsāra hētuvappa muḷisaṁ bisuḍpuṟpudu, nimma
kālanuḍuguvudene, tapuduparōdhadinduḍuge, dēvarkaḷ lakṣayuta
madhura gīta vādyaśravaṇa parituṣṭarāge, vidyādharargerargellaṁ ghōṣeyuṁ,
sughōṣeyumemyuṁemba bīṇeyuṁyaṁ, bhūmigōcararge mahāghōṣeyuṁ,
(su)ghōṣavatiyumemba bīṇeyuṁyaṁ koṭṭarāgaḷ, mūṟaḍi nelanaṁ
neṟikoṭṭanillendu viṣṇukumāra muni munidu, baliyuṅkaṭṭi,
munigaḷōṇōpadravamaṁ kiḍise, padmarathaṁ muḷidu, baliyuṁ kolalbage
doḍātanaṁ bārisi, baliyumaṁ, peṟaruṁrumaṁ jinadharmānuraktarārmāḍi,
dharmaprabhāvamaṁ prakaṭisi, viṣṇumuni pōdanavadaṟinā dēvar koṭṭaṭa
bīṇegaḷ, sughōṣeyemba bīṇeyu vaṁśasannidhānōpagatamupanmantanni
vembuvempu, tarisikoṇḍu, vāpādyagītaṅgaḷiṁ, śrōtr̥hr̥dayayu rañjanamaṁ
māḍe, gāndharvadatte ratnamāleyuṁ vasudēvaṅgikkuvuduṁ; vivāha
maṁ māḍi, vidyādhara śrēṇiyoḷīṟunūṟu śōbhanaṅgaḷaneydi, banda
riṣṭapuramamunāḷva, hiraṇyavarmaṅgaṁ, padmāvatigaṁ, puṭṭida, rōhiṇiyayu
svayamyumbarakke kaḷāguṇa viśēṣamanabhyāsaṅgeyva śiṣyajanakkupādhyāya
nāgi, vēṣadoḷpokka vasudēvaṅge rōhiṇi māleyuṁ sūḍe, samudra
vijayādigaḷ, svayamyumbarakke negeda rājakamellaṁ masagi, kanneyuneḷadu
koḷveḷvamendu bare, hiraṇyavarmaṁ bandhugaḷverasu, tannaṁ kaikoṇḍu
nile, vasudēvaṁ tanna nijanāmāṅkita śaradinise, samudravijayunadaṁ
kaṇḍu, bājisinōḍi, vijayaghōṣaṇeyaṁ māḍe, vasudēvaṁ samudra
vijayādigaḷge vinatanāgi kaṇḍu, pēpeṟage maduveninda vidyādharakannake
yaraṁ tarise, samudravijeyuṁ berasu, mahāvibhūtiyiṁ poṟalaṁ
pokku, sukhamirpinaṁ.

munne pēṟdaḷda śaṅkhamuni, mahāśukrakalpadiṁ bandu, vasudē
vaṅgaṁ, rōhiṇigaṁ padmanemba maganāgirpinamitta gaṅgeyu gandhavatiyu
kūḍa(ṭa)loḷ, jaṭhara kauśikanemba tāpasavaḷḷiyunāyukaṁ vaśiṣṭa
nemboṁ, pañcāgni tapadoḷneḷgeyddunegaṟda, negaḻ, guṟiguṇabhadra, vīrabhadraremba
cāraṇayugaḷaṁ bandidajñānatapamidaṟoḷe taguḷdeḷddeyene, nīmevennajñāna
teyuṁ tōṟimevene, vaśiṣṭana jaṭākaḷāpadoḷirda, pēnuṁ, sīru
manātanamīvalli jeḍeyoḷtoḍardu bandu, sattirdakiṟumīṅgaḷumaṁmuṁ,
pañcāgniyoḷoṭṭida puḷḷigaḷoḷirdu bībēvapāvumpuṟuṅgaḷumaṁmuṁ tōṟi,
cāraṇavacanamaṁmuṁ satyamendu nambi, tatsamīpadoḷdīkṣegoṇḍu, upa
vāsaniyumamudoḷaṁ ātapasthānayōgadoḷaṁ negaḷvuduvdu, mēṟbaryanrntara
dēvateyurbandemavuge besanēnene, maṟubhavadoḷemavuge besakeyvemenyvendu
pōgalvēṟdirpinamumuṅgrasēna mahārājanāmuniyaṁ kaṇḍu, bhaktanāgi,
peṟarivaraṁ nirisalāgadāne nirisuvenendu, ghōṣaṇegaḷeye, pāraṇādina
doḷ, rājabhavanaṁ kiccaidoḍe, niṟisalmalbaṟiye, mattondu tiṅga
ḷpōḷbōge, yāga hastikṣōbhadiṁ maredu, mattondu tiṅgaḷpōḷbōge,
mūṟaneyu tiṅgaḷa pāraṇādinadoḷ nilisuvenendirpinaṁ, jarāsaṁ
dhanaṭṭidōle bandaḍābyatikaradoḷtratye maḷmattaṁmaṟiṟiye, nr̥pabhavanadiṁ magu
ḻdu pōṭdapōpapa muniyaṁ kaṇḍu, nagarajanaṅgaḷ neradu, nammramaṁ
nilisalīyayunarasaṁ, tānuṁ nilisuvanallamidāvabhiprāyamendaṟiye
vembuduṁ, r̥ṣi muḷidugrasēnaṅge maganāgi, rājyamamuneṟidukoḷva
nakkendu, nidānaṅgeyduyddu sattu padmāvatiyu garbhadoḷniḷnelase, garbhiṇi
tannarasana hr̥dayamāṁsamaṁ bayase, mantrigaḷupāyudiṁ peṟaṟara
māṁsamamunarasana māṁsamendu kuḍe, bayayukeyanyuntīrcimaganaṁ
paḍedoḍītanemmoḍaniralke yogyanallanendarasaṁ lēkhapatraṁ, piṟidu
oḍamemoverasu, kāṁsamañmuñjūṣeyoḷikki, jaguneyoḷ biḍise, kausambī
nagarada, maṇḍōdariyemba, śauṇḍavanitekaṇḍu, naḍepibaḷedu, tannoḍa
nāḍuva vakkaḷaṁ baḍiduṁ, bayduṁ, puyyaliḍise, maṇḍoyaddampuyyaliḍisemaṇḍodadaripoṟa
maḍisi kaḷeye, sauryapurakkevandu vasudēvaṅgāḷāgidardaṁ.

itta jarāsandhaṁ, suramyaviṣayayuda, paudana puramamunāḷva, siṁha
rathanaṁ piḍidu tandātaṅgenna magaḷ jīvañjaseyumamunardha viṣaya
mumaṁ koḍuvenendu gōsane gaḷeye, vasudēvaṁ gōsaneyuṁ piḍidu,

siṁhamūtrabhāvita (neneyisida) turaga ghaṭita rathadiṁ siṁharathanoḷkādi,
kaṁsaninda mātanaṁ kaṭpiṭṭisi tandu, jarāsandhaṅgoppise, vasudēvaṅge
dēśārdhamumaṁmuṁ, kanyakiyumaṁmuṁ koṭṭoḍāke lakṣaṇa hīneyappudaṟiṁ,
tānollade. siṁharathanaṁ kaṁsaṁ piḍidanītaṅge kuḍupudene, kulaparīkṣege
maṇḍōdarige baṟiyunaṭṭe, mandasaṁ tandu mundiṭṭa (ṭṭaṭṭi i)lli
puṭṭidanappudaṟiṁ, kaṁsanendu pesaraniṭṭenendallirda lēkhapatramuṁmaṁ
tōprpurpudumugrasēnana, padmāvatiyumaganendaṟidu, jīvañjaseyuṁ
kuḍe, kaṁsaṁ tanna puṭṭidandē kāḷindiyu maḍuvinoḷbasuṭudumaṁ
pūrvabhavavairamaṁ nenedu, muḷidu, madhurāpurakke vandu, tāyuṁ
tandeyumaṁ piḍidu, gōpuradoḷ sereyikki, mr̥gāvatī viṣayuda,
daśārṇavapuramamunāḷva, dēvasēnaṅgaṁ dhanadēvigaṁ puṭṭida, dēvaki
dēviyuṁ vasudēvaṅge koṭṭu, sukhamirpina monvondu divasaṁ.

atimuktaremba muniyurcarigegevare, jīvañjase dēvakiyu
meynaṟidāpānanda vastramuṁmaṁ, nimmammr̥taṅgeyu vastramendu tōṟi naguvu
dumādēvakige puṭṭida magaṁ ninnagaṇḍanaṁ kolvemembuduṁ, jīvaṁ
jase kēḷdu vastramaneraḍāgi sīḷvuduḷdumatimuktaka muni mattendaṁttondaṁ—-
ninna tandegamāvātanindame sāvakkumene, berci, kālgaṟilaguvuduṁ; dēva
kiyumaṅmugaṁ sakaḷa mahīpāḷanakkumendatimuktaka munipōdanitta
tadvr̥ttāntamumuṁ kaṁsaṅgaṟipe, vasudēvanalligevandu, kaṁsa
nendaṁ— dēvakīdēvi besaliyaleyuppandemma manege vandu besaliyappaleyuppu
dendu bēḍidoḍe, manamamullada manadoḷ koṭṭu, mattondu divasa
vamatimuktakamuni carigevare, vasudēvanuṁ, dēvakiyuṁ nilise,
pēṟimemavemuge dīkṣāvidhiyukkakkupāgadembudumaṁmuṁ maṟayisi besagoṁ
ḍoḍavariṅgitamanaṟidu, nimamugēḷvarmakkalvirkkaḷappoḷavaṟoḷaṟuvaṟ
parasthānadoḷ baḷadu, saṁyamasaṁyumumaṁ kaikoṇḍu muktige salvar.
kaḍeyu magaṁ trikhaṇḍamamunāḷvemenḷuṁendu pēṟi dēvaki mūṟu sūlimuvu
ḷḷaḷaṁ paḍedoḍavarcaramu dēhadhararendaṟidu, śatamukhaṁ besase, naigamu
r̥ṣiyemba dēvanāgaḷe, peṟivuṟapuṟi sattirdamupuḷḷaḷaṁ dēvakiyu
mundikkikke, bhadriḷapuradaḷakeyemba vaṇiksteyu munde dēvakige puṭṭida
maḷḷaḷanikke, kaṁsaṁ bandu sattirdamumaḷḷaḷaṁ kaṇḍu, muni(vara)
vacanamusatyavendā mr̥takaṅgaḷaṁ, śiḷātaḷadoḷtāṭisi pōge, mattaṁ

dēvaki garbhavuṁmaṁ tāḷda, saptamamāsadoḷe, tannamaneyoḷ maganaṁ
paḍeyeyeṁ, kaṁsanaṟiyalīyade, gōdāvanada nandagōpaṅge koṭṭu
naḍapuvavendu dēvakigaṟipi, baladēvaṁ kūsanettikoṇḍu naḍeye,
vasudēvaṁ koḍepiḍidu bare, nagara dēvate vr̥ṣabharūpadiṁ tanna
kōḍoḷ soḍarpottisi munde naḍeyeyeṁ, śiśucaraṇa sparśamātradiṁ
paḍigaḷtaeṟeyeṁ, gōpuradoḷseṟeḷsaṟiyiṭṭugrasēnanivarārene, ninna
saeṟeṟiyuṁ biḍisalke rerēvātanītanuṁsiradirendu koṇḍoyye, tatrbhātprabhāvavadini
vargirvagiyāda jaguneyuṁ pāydu barpannegaṁ.

nandagōpanondu peṇgūsanettikoṇḍu barpanaṁ kaṇḍīpoṟtallige
pōdappeyene, nimma toṟtiṟtu magambaḍevenakkenkkandu dēvategaḷge parisi,
maṅgaḷaṁ paḍedoḍidanā dēvategaḷge kuḍal pōdapenembuduṁ; tamma
bandavr̥ttāntamanaṟipe, bhāvīcakradharananātaṅge koṭṭu, peṇgūsaṁ
tandu dēvakiya mundiṭṭaritta, nandagōpanā śiśuvaṁ tandu dēvate
yurninage gaṇḍu kūsanaṭṭidarendu tanna peṇḍatige koṭṭanitta,
dēvaki magaḷpaḍedaḷendu kēḷdu, kaṁsaṁ bandu, pikr̥ta nāsikemāḍi
pōge, bhūmigr̥hadoḷ baḷiḷedu, subratāryikeyara pakkade tapamaṁ
kaikoṇḍu, vindhyagiriyoḷ sthānayōgadoḷire, bēḍar dēvateyenda
rcisi pōge, pulitine, sattu, svargakke pōdoḍākeya pulitinduḷida
mūṟu beraḷumuṁmaṁ, kṣīragandhādigaḷiṁ bēḍararjircise, mūḍhātmarappa
tadviṣaya pāvāsigaḷāryaryeyuṁ, vindhyavāsiniyuṁ, endandimbaṟiya
dēvate māḍi koṇḍāḍidar.

itta, madhurāpuradoḷanēkamutpātaṅgaḷāge, varuṇanemba naimi
ttikanaṁ karedu, kaṁsaṁ tatphalamaṁ besagoḷe, nimage śatru puṭṭidanadaṟi
nātaṅge vipināśaṁ māḷpuṟpudene, kaṁsaṁ cintākrāntanāgirpuduṁ, pūrva
bhavada dēvategaḷ bandu besanēnene, nīmemonna pageyayunaṟisi kollimeṁ
buduṁ- ōrvaḷ pūtini vibhaṅga jñānadiṁ vāsudēvanirdeḍeyanaṟidu,
tajjananiya rūpadiṁ viṣastana kṣīramamunūḍi kolalbare, kēśavanaṁ kādirda
dēvate, molegaḷaniṭṭotte, puyliyyaliṭṭu pōdaḷannegaṁ, mattōrvaḷ
pūtane śakaṭākāradiṁ paritare, nuccunūṟoṟāge bāḷakanodeyeyeṁ,
mattondu devasaṁ, oralaṁ tanduḍeyoḷkaṭṭe, nandagōpinīrdara
lpōge, baṟiyaṁyuṁ, taguḷvanasotti kolalendamaḷmamuḷmr̥ttigaḷāgi banda dēvate

yuraṁ kiṟtīṭittīḍāḍe, mattaḍiyiṭṭāḍuva vayasadoḷ, tāḷavr̥kṣākāradiṁ
tannamēle phalaṅgaḷaṁ suriva dēvateyumuṁmaṁ, peṇgaṇgetteyāgi kaccal pari
tappa dēvateyumuṁ mumaṁmūṟiye piḍidoḍadr̥śyamādavannegaṁ; matto
rvaḷ pūtane, turagarūpadiṁ kolal bare, muṁsumbanottuvudu
mōḍikeṭṭiṁ(tra)tu, kaṁsana besadinērbbar dēlbirdēvavateyaruṁ śaktigeṭṭu
pōge, mattondu divasamamuriṣṭanembanorvanātana puruṣākāramaṁ parī
kṣisalendu, kariya basavanāgi paritare, muḷidadakke grīvābhaṅgamaṁ
māḍe, magana puruṣākāramaṁ janamukha parampareyiṁ kēḷdu, vasu
dēvanuṁ, dēvakiyuṁ, gōmukhiyemba nōmpiyayu nevadiṁ, tuṟu
paṭṭige bandu, kr̥ṣṇavr̥ṣabhana grīvābhaṅgamaṁ māḍirda kr̥ṣṇanaṁ gandha
mālyādigaḷinarcisi, kaṭaka, kaṭisūtraṁ, kuṇḍaḷādyābharaṇa bhūṣitaṁ
māḍi, maganaṁ balavappa dēvakiyu moletoredu bāḷakana mēle pāla
dhāre bhōrene suriye, baladēvaṁ kaṇḍu rahasyabhēdamamukkumendu,
dēvakigupavāsaśramadiṁ mūrcheyādudendu koḍavālgaḷaṁ suridu,
peṟaṟiyudantu, nandagōpādigaḷaṁ mannisi, gōpakumārarbercerasu,
kr̥ṣṇanaṁ nōḍi poṟaṭilge bandar.

itta, mattondu divasaṁ, permaḷe koḷe, sēḍuṅḍugoḷva gōku
ḷamaṁ gōvardhanagiriyunetti kāḍu, kr̥ṣṇanirpinaṁ, madhurānagara
sthāpanārhadbhūtamappa, jinagr̥ha samīpadindradigbhāgada dēvāyayutana
doḷ, kr̥ṣṇana puṇyaparipākadiṁ, dēvatārakṣitaṅgaḷappa śaṅkha, dhanu,
sarpaśayanaṅgaḷ puṭṭiṭṭe, madhurāpati kaṇḍivupuṭṭidalli phaḷavēmēnendu
varuṇanemba naimittikanaṁ besagoṇḍoḍivaṁ sādhisidātaṁ pr̥thvīrājyaṁ
geygumene, kaṁsaṁ sādhisalbagedasamarthanāgi, nāgaśayanamanēṟi,
śaṅkhamanondu kayyoḷ piḍidotti, mattondu kayyoḷ billanēṟi
sidātaṅgenna magaḷaṁ kuḍuvenendu gōsanegaḷedā nevadoḷpaḷvarīkṣisalendu,
rājakamellamaṁ barise, kaṁsana maidunaṁ subhānu tanna magaṁ bhānuva
noḍagoṇḍu rājagr̥hadiṁ barutaṁ gōdāvanada mahā nāganivāsamamamppa
koḷada taḍiyoḷ bīḍambiṭṭaṭṭire, kr̥ṣṇanallade, koḷada nīranārtarpa
rendu gōvuḷigar pēṟi, kr̥ṣṇanaṁ barise, bandu, nīmellige pōdappi
rene, subhānuvendaṁ— madhureya mūḍaṇa dēvāyayutanadoḷpuṭṭida
billanēṟisiyuṁ, nāgaśayanamavaṁnēṟiyuṁ, śaṅkhamaṁvaṁ pūrisiyuṁ,
kaṁsana magaḷaṁ kaige māḍalpōdappevene, kr̥ṣṇanendanemmandigarga

mantu negaḷilil bakkumappoḍānuṁ barpenembuduṁ, kr̥ṣṇanaṁ subhānu
vomoḍagoṇḍu pōgi, kaṁsanaṁ kāṇe, palarumarasugaḷaḷāṟide, mānabhaṅga
māgi pōge, subhānuvaṁmaṁ keladoḷirisi, kēśavananitumaṁ negaḷda
tuṟupaṭṭige pōdanitta, subhānuvuṁmaṁ, tanna maganappa bhānuve negaḷdalda
nendu pēṟi, nāgaśayanamaṁ kādirdavar bandu, bhānu negaḷdildinallaṁ,
peṟanōrvaṁ negaḷdaldanene, nīmātananaṟisi tannimātaṅgenna magaḷumaṁ
koḍuvenendu kaṁsanirpinaṁ.

itta, nandagōpanaḷkkaḷka, gōmaṇmuṇḍaḷamaṁ koṇḍu pōgi, peṟa
tondeḍeyoḷirdu, peṟarārgamettalbāralāṟada kallakambhamanōrvane bala
dēvaṁ kittette, janaṅgaḷātanaṁ vastrābharaṇādigaḷiṁ pūjise, baladēvana
prabhāvamanaṟidenagēnuṁ bhaya(ṅga)millendu nandagōpaṁ gōmaṁmuṁ
ḍaḷaṁ berasu, pūrvasthānadoḷ bandirpuduṁ. kaṁsaṁ tanna pageyuṁ
parīkṣisalendu, viṣadhararakṣitamappa sāviresaḷa tāvareya hūvanaṭṭu
gendu, nandagōpanalligaṭṭiṭṭe, tandeyuya besadiṁ pōgi, kr̥ṣṇanā koḷanaṁ
puge, viṣadharaṁ viṣamanisvāsaṁ berasu, phaṇāmaṇigaḷ beḷage, masagi
kolalbarpudaṁ kaṇḍadara, phaṇāmaṇḍaḷadoḷtanna pītāmbaramanoge
puduṁ, pannannegamadr̥śyamāge, sahasra patrāmbujamaṁ koṇḍu kaṁsanalli
gaṭṭiṭṭe, tanna śatru nandagōpana maneyoḷirdanendu niścayise, kr̥ṣṇanuṁ,
gōpakumāraroḍane mallamllupōrduṁ, peṟavumenitānuṁ bālakrīḍeyiṁ
baḷedu, navayauvananāge, kaṁsanenna mallar pōrtamaṁ nōḍalba
rkendu baṟiyunaṭṭe, mallavēṣadhārigaḷappa gōvaḷarberasu, madhurā
purakke vāsudēvaṁ barpannegamondu, madāndha gandhasindhuraṁ tana
gidiraṁ pariye(bare) pōgadenindu, tanna (gaḷa) taḷaprahāradoḷ birdā
neyu kombaṅgoṇḍu, namma jayamanide pēḷdappudendu, gōpaldippudendugō
kumārakar prōtsāhise, dēvakīnandanaṁ, kaṁsana sabheyaṁyuṁ puge,
vasudēvaṁ kaṁsana citrattamaṁ tānaṟidu, tanna sāmantasamūhamberasu
sannaddhanāgi bare, baladēvanedur bhujāsphāḷanaṁ geydu, sāre meṭṭuva
nevadoḷaṁ kr̥ṣṇananeydi, kaṁsanaṁ kolalidepadanendu pēḷduḷca, maguḷda
nāgaḷuṁ, nandagōpanandanaṁ, sīmāravilikhita patravalli viḷasita
bhujanuṁ, mahītaḷa vilōla pītāmbara kakṣanumāgi, nivartanāvartana
bhramaṇa valgana plavanāvasthānādi kriyā pariṇataṁ, tiripi(dokkarisi)

nindāgaḷ kaṁsana besadiṁ cāṇūraṁ bare, dr̥ḍha kaṭhiṇa bhuja parirambhadi
navana śarīraṁ jarjharitaṁ māḍe, cāṇūra mallaṁ sattabililoḷ kaṁsaṁ,
kaṇṇugāṇadinisarpaḍaṁ māṇade bandu peṇeyeyeṁ, kālaṁ piḍidu, bīsi
koṇḍu, vasudēvanavumagaṁ nandagōpana maneyoḷ baḷedanembudanā
gaḷe janaṅgaḷaṟiye, seṟeyoḷirdugrasēnanaṁ biḍisi, nandagōpādi
gaḷaṁ dāna sanmānapūrvakaṁ visarjisi, sūryapuravaṁ pokku, bandhu
gaḷberasu kr̥ṣṇaṁ sukhamirpinaṁ.

kaṁsana sattabililoḷ jīvañjase jarāsandhanallige pōgi puyliyyaliḍe,
muḷidu, yādavaraṁ kiḍisalendu jarāsandhana besadoḷ banda makkaḷ
bhaṅgaṁ baṭṭu pōge, mattamaparājitanemba maga(na)ṁ mēle(vē)ḷe,
nālvattāṟu sūṟ kādi sōltu pōge, kālayavamanemba maganaṁ
jarāsandhaṁ besase, barpudanaṟidu yādavarellaṁ, mundappa kāryamaṁvaṁ
nāḷōcisi, sauryapura, madhurāpura, hastinapuraṅgaḷaṁ bisuṭu pōge,
yādava nagaradēvategaḷ baṭṭeyoḷkaccanoṭṭi vr̥ddheyarūpadinire, kāla
yamuṁmaṁ bandidēsennendu besagoḷe, matputraruṁ ninna baraviṅgaḷkeḷka,
yādavarellamilli pokkarene, maguḷdanitta saldinittamudratīradoḷirda yādavara
balakkiraleḍe māḷpeṟippenendaṣṭōpavāsaṁ geydu, kr̥ṣṇaṁ darbhaśayanado
ḷirdanannegaṁ, naigamanembadēvaṁ turagākr̥tiyiṁ bandu, kr̥ṣṇana
nēṟisikoṇḍu panneraḍu yōjanānantaraṁ samudradoḷ puge, nīru
gidoḍalli, dēvēndranājñeyiṁ dvārāvapatiyemba poṟalilaṁ, nēminā
thōtpattisthānaṁ, jinabhavana sthāpanāpūrvakaṁ, papra prākāra khātāṭṭā
ḷaka mahāmandirālaṅkr̥tamaṁvaṁ kubēraṁ māḍipōge, yādavarsahitaṁ
piṣṇa poṟalilaṁ pokku sukhamirpinaṁ.

mumpēḻdaḷda ahamindraṁ naralōkakke baraliralaṟudiṅgaḷuṇṭene,
harivaṁśada kāśyapagōtrada, samudravijaya mahārājana mahādēvi śiva
dēviyuṁ, śrīdēviyurmodalāgaṟuvarōlagirsēvise, dhanadaṁ vasudhā
reyuṁ suriye, kārtika śuddha ṣaṣṭhiyu beḷagappa jāvadoḷuttarāṣāḍha
nakṣatradoḷ śivadēvi ṣōḍaśa śubhasvapnamumuṁmuṁmaṁ nijavadanapravēśa gaja
rūpamumuṁmuṁmaṁ kaṇḍavadhijñāniyappa, samudravijayayuniṁ tatphalamanaṟidu,
sukhamirpinaṁ. svargāvataraṇa kalyāṇapūrvakaṁ ahamindranā dēviyu
garbhakkavatarisi, namibhaṭṭārakara tīrthasantānamaydulakke kālaṁ

pōge, śrāvaṇaśuddha ṣaṣṭhiyoḷ tvaṣṭrayōgadoḷ, trijñānadharaṁ
puṭṭiṭṭe, saudharmēndranādidēvarge māḍidandadoḷ, janmābhiṣēka
mahākalyāṇānantaramariṣṭanēmigaḷendu pesaraniṭṭu pōdanitta saha
sravarṣaṁ paramāyuṣyanuṁ, daśa cāpōtsēdhanuṁ, nīlavarṇanuṁenumenisi
baḷeḷidu, sukhavartivirdanaṁ.

itta, magadha viṣayada, paradaṁ jalayātradoḷdeseyaṟiyade,
dvārāvatige bandalli, (pāradaṁ)sāra vastugaḷaṁ koṇḍu, rājagr̥hakke
pōgi, cakraratnaṁ puṭṭiṭṭe, rājyaṅgeyyuyuttirda jarāsandhanaṁ kaṇḍu,
vāsudēvana rājyalīleyuṁyumaṁ, dvārāvatī nagarōtpattiyuṁyumaṁ,
