nēminātha janmābhiṣēka vibhūtiyuṁmayumaṁnaṟipe, jarāsandhaṁ muḷidu
mēle vaprupradaṁ nāradanaṟipe, śārṅgadharaṁ nēmikumāranalligevandu
nīṁ pōbinīmpoṟalge kāpirdudāṁrdāṁ pōgi, jarāsandha cakriyuṁyaṁ, bhavatprabhāvadiṁ
kolvenendu, kumārana darahasita madhura nirīkṣaṇa cittapraṇidānadiṁ,
tanna jayamuṁyuvamaṁ niścayisi, nijasāmantaruṁ, jayanuṁ, vijayanuṁ,
sāraṇanuṁ, aṅgajanuṁ, udbhadbavanuṁ, sumukhanuṁ. mandaranuṁ,
padmanuṁ, jaranuṁ, satyakanuṁ. caramamunuṁ, sudr̥ṣṭiyuṁ, yudhiṣṭhi
rārjurarājuna, bhīmasēna, nakuḷasahadēvaruṁ, virāṭanuṁ, drupadanuṁ,
viduranuṁ, dr̥ṣṭārjunanuṁ, ugrasēnanuṁ, yādavabalamberasu,
baladēva, vāsudēvar kurarukṣētrakke vandirpuduṁ itta, jarāsandhanuṁ.
bhīṣma, drōṇāśvatthāma, karṇa, kr̥pa, kr̥tavarma, śalya vr̥ṣasēna,
indrasēna, jayadratha, rudhira, rugmi, hēmaprabha, duryōdhana, duśśā
sana durmarṣaṇa, durjaya, bhagadatta prabhr̥tigaḷ berasalligevare, vāsu
dēvaṁ maṇimayābharaṇālaṅkr̥tanāgi, kanakahastimukhaṅgaḷantikāvi
gaḷita, jaḷadhinādavemenisi, samutthāna samayadoḷ, jaḷāñjaḷiyaṁ
sūsi, jinēndrananabhivandisi, sāmanta sahitaṁ, ripubalakkidiraṁ naḍe
dāgaḷ, pratihāranarasana besadiṁ, caturaṅga balamu neḍevaṟiyadoḍdu
puvudendu sāṟi, balameraḍondondaṟoḷ poṇardaṟiye, sūra
puraṣa karavimukta śara nārāca, piṇḍivāḷa nirantarākīrṇa dinakara maṇḍa
ḷamuṁvuṁ, dhīra turagārōhaka karāḷa, karavāḷa nikr̥taṁ caraṇa turagabaḷa
muṁvuṁ, kupita madavāraṇa, danta saṅghaṭṭana, sañjanita, dahana dahyamāna,
kaṇṭaka kudāstaraṇa kētana, mukhapaṭaha karṇacāmara samudayuyamuṁ

sūra sārathi paricōdita syandanārūḍha karayantra dhanurvēda viśārada
rathi(dhi)ka vijr̥mbhaṇa bhayaṅkaramumappa raṇaraṅgadoḷ, tanna caturaṅga
balamuṁ parape, parabalamamutikramise, kr̥ṣṇaṁ vr̥kapravēśikeyiṁ
pokkunindu, nimmrammardeḍeyoḷ balidu nilvudendu niyōjisi, parā
nīkamamunabhibhavise, magadhādādhīśaṁ muḷidu, cakradi niḍuvudumumadu tannaṁ
pradakṣiṇaṅgeydu nile, jarāsandhananācakradiṁ kondu, vāsudēvaṁ
dakṣiṇa bharata trikhaṇḍapatiyuṁ, ṣōḍaśa sahasra narapati parivr̥tanumāgi,
mahāvibhūtiyiṁ dvārāvatiyamyumpokku, dēva, vidyādhara narapatigaḷinabhi
ṣiktanāgi, sahasravarṣaṁ paramāyuṣyanuṁ, (ṣōḍaśa) daśa cāpōtsē
dhanumenisi, cakramuṁvuṁ, śaktiyuṁ, gadeyuṁ, śaṅkhamuṁvuṁ, dhanuvuṁ,
daṇḍamuṁvuṁ, nandakamuvumemba dēvarakṣita saptaratnaṅgaḷ kēśavaṅgāge,
ratnamāleyuṁ, gadeyuṁ, halamuṁvuṁ, musalamuvumemba dēvarakṣita
nālkuratnaṅgaḷ baladēvaṅgāge, vāsudēvaṅge rugmiṇiyuṁ, satya
bhāmeyuṁ, jambhāvatiyuṁ, susīmeyuṁ, lakṣakṣmaṇeyuṁ, gāndhā
riyuṁ, gauriyuṁ, padmāvatiyuṁemyumembavarmahādēviyarverasu padi
nālkuṟu sāsirvararasiyarāge, baladēvaṅge eṇṭāsirvararasiyarāge, intu
kēśavaṁ, pūrvakr̥ta puṇya paripākadiṁ, lakṣmrakṣmaṇaṁ pēṟdandadinardha
cakravarti śrīyanubhavisuttirdondu divasaṁ—

manōharavemmemba koḷadoḷantaḥpura sahitaṁ, jalakrīḍeyoḷirdalli,
nēmikumāraṁ jalakrīḍārdramappa divyavastramuṁmaṁ satyabhāmeya kayyo
ḷkuḍe, satyabhāme sarasaṁ nuḍidu, nīnuṭṭa puṭṭigeyanēke muṭṭuveṁ,
ninage nāgaśayanamanēṟuva, śārṅgadhanuvanēṟisuva, aivāyu śaṅpāñcajanyaśaṅkhakhamuṁ
pūrisuva śaktiyuḷḷaḍappudene, nēmikumārananitumanormeye nega
ṟvuduṁ, madagaja jalaṅgaḷ, karacara nāsāradanapanihi(ha)ta, manōja
turaga kaḷevaraṅgaḷumunmūḷita drumaṅgaḷuṁ, niraṅkuśaṅgaḷāgirpina
mitta,—– kusumacitreyemba sabheyoḷirdu, pītāmbaraṁ kumārana
geydu (nenda) nanyasādhāraṇamappadbhuta kriyege, santrāsa samudvarta
nayananuṁ, samudgīrṇanumappa khaḷganumāgi, kr̥ṣṇaṁ vismayaṁ baṭṭa
dēnendu besagoḷe, paricārakarendar— bēṟavēṟamuṟvēṟmupavāsasādhya
mappa nāgaśayanārōhaṇādi kriyegaḷaṁ, kumāranormeye nega
ṟdoḍintu kōḷāhaḷamāvādudembuduṁ, vāsudēvaṁ kumārana mahā
prabhāvakkaḷki, kumāraṁ rāgapariṇatanādanadaṟiṁ, vivāhayōgyanenda

ṟidugravaṁśa tiḷakanappugrasēnanallige tāne pōgi, (vi)jayavatiya
magaḷaṁ rāja(tri)matiyaṁ prārthisi, vivāhamaṇṭapamaṁ samedu,
maṅgaḷālaṅḷaṅkr̥tanāgirda kumāraṅge, purandhriyarsēseyikke, kaynī
reṟeṟiva divasadoḷ tannarājyamaṁ koḷgumemba śaṅkeyiṁ, nēminā
thaṅge nirvēga hētudarśanadiṁ, bhōgaviraktaṁ māḍalendu, kirātaraṁ
barisi, mr̥gagaṇamamunondeḍeyoḷ pugisi, pōpoṟage pebbēliyaṁ(kettiḍu
vuduṁ) kēṟisi, digāvaḷōkanakke balasahitanāgi, ratna śibivigeyanēṟi,
nēmikumāraṁ pōṟimurampoṟamaṭṭu, karuṇamāgi puyyalcvalcvava mr̥gagaṇamaṁ
kaṇḍivanilligārtandarene, dēva, ninage krīḍārthadiṁ, trikhaṇḍapati tarise,
tandevendu vāsudēva prēraṇeyinavakke kāpirdavar pēṟi, kēḷdu,
nirvēgadiṁ rājabhavanakke maguṟdaḷdabhinibōdhika prakarṣa kṣayōpaśamuma
samupalabdha bōdhaṁ, lōkāntika dēvar pratibōdhise, tanna pōprōda
bhavaṅgaḷaṁ nenedu, pariniṣkramaṇa kalyāṇābhiṣēkapūrvakaṁ, dēvakuru
vemba śivigeyoḷ, sahasrāmravanakke pōgi, ṣaṣṭhōpavāsadiṁ,
mūnūṟu varṣaṁ kumāra kālaṁ pōdandu, śrāvaṇa śuddha ṣaṣṭhiyupa
parāhṇadoḷ citrānakṣatramāge, sāsirvararasugaḷverasu, saṁyamamaṁ
kaikoṇḍu, caturjñānadharanaṁ, baladēva, vāsudēva prabhr̥tigaḷ gandha
mālyādigaḷinarcisi namaskāraṁ geydu pōge, pāraṇā dinadoḷ,
dvārāvatiyaṁyuṁ pokku, kanakavarṇanappa varadattanr̥pana maneyoḷ niltu,
pañcāścaryaṁ negaḻda chaḷcidmastha kālamayvattattāṟiṁ divasaṁ pōpudumujja
yanta giriyoḷ, ṣaṣṭhōpavāsadi nile.

vividha sukhāsaṅkranditamappa vēṇuvinaḍiyoḷāśvayija śuddha pāḍi
vada pūrvāhṇadoḷ, citrānakṣatradoḷ kēvalajñānōtpattiyāge,
dēvēndrakr̥ta tatkalyāṇānumanvartha sahasrāṣṭa nāmadharanumāgi,
varadatta pramukharappa pannōrvargaṇadhararuṁ, nālnūlkūrvarpūrva
dhararuṁ, pannirchāsiradeṇṭunūrvar śikṣakaruṁ, sāviradaynūrvarśairvaiva
ravadhijñānigaḷuṁ, anibarekēvaḷigaḷuṁ, sāsiradainūrvar vikriyardhi
prāptaruṁ, ombhaynūrvar manaḥparyaya jñānigaḷuṁ, eṇṭunū
rvarvādigaḷaṁḷuṁ, yakṣiyuṁ, rājamatiyuṁ, kātyāyiniyuṁ moda
lāgi nālvattusāsirvararjiyaruṁ, ondulakke śrāvakaruṁ, mūṟu
lakke śrāvakiyaruṁ, asaṅkhyāta dēvaruṁ, dēviyaruṁ, saṅkhyāta

tiryagjātigaḷuṁ berasu panneraḍu gaṇakkaṁ dharmōpadēśaṅgeyyuytutta,
nānā viṣaya vihāraṅgeydu, nēmibhaṭṭārakar dvārāvatiyarśairaivatrō
dyānadoḷ bandirpuduṁ, baladēva, vāsudēvarantaḥpura bandhu,
putra, nagara, parivārasahitarāgi bandu, samavasaraṇasthitanaṁ bandisi,
dharmamaṁ kēḷe, vāsudēvanenage jīvatattva nirṇayadoḷ sandēha
muṇṭu, kelabarātmanaṁ nityanembar, kelaru kṣaṇikanembar, kelaraṇu
mātranembar, kelarvaṭakaṇikāpramāṇanembar, kelaraṅguṣṭha parvamātra
nembar, kelarpañcaśatayōjanōcchratajcritanembar, kelarsarvagatanemba
rilli tatvamāvudaṟiyeṁ besasimene bhaṭṭārakarintendu besasidar—
kavi paramēśvarara vr̥tta ॥

lg.l: jñātā kartāca bhōktā svakr̥taphaḷa viśēṣasya dēhapramāṇaḥ

div.p:
endu jīva tattvamanaṟipi, saṁsāramucihitaṁ, mōkṣamārgaṁ hita
venmendu kelabar śraddhāsampannarādar; kelarcāritramānigaḷādar; kela
rdāna śilōpavāsa niratarādar.

āgaḷ dēvaki tanna saṁśayamaṁmuṁ tribhuvanapatiyunintendu besa
goṇḍoḷennamanege mūṟu sūṟīrvarrīrīrvare carigevokkaṟuvaroḷenage
bandhusnēhavenmentādudene— varadatta gaṇadhararintendu besasidar—
jambūdvīpada, bharatada śauryaviṣayayuda, madhurānagaramuṁ, sūrasēna
nembarasanāḷuttirpinamāpoṟiṟala, bhānudatta seṭṭigaṁ, yamunā
dattegaṁ, subhānuvuṁ, bhānukīrtiyuṁ, bhānuṣēṇanuṁ, bhānu
sūranuṁ, sūradēvanuṁ, sūradattanuṁ, sūrasēnanuṁemnumbembarēḻbarvarma
kkaḷāge, mattondu divasamamubhaya nandana gurugaḷa samīpadoḷ,
dharmamaṁ kēḷdarasanuṁ, seṭṭiyuṁ berasu palaruṁ saṁyamamaṁ
kaikoḷe, yamunādatteyuṁ, jinadattāryikeyara pakkade dīkṣiteyayu
rāge, sapta sūnugaḷuṁ saptavyasana sahitarādaḍarasanaṭṭikaḷeye,
mattondu divasaṁ, avantīviṣayada, ujjiniya smaśānadoḷ sūra
sēnananirisi poṟiṟalanaṟuvaruṁ kaḷalpoldokkarannegavā poṟiṟalanāḷva, vr̥ṣabha

dhvajanembarasana bhr̥tyaṁ, dhr̥ḍa(vr̥kṣa)prahāriyemba sahasrabhaṭaṅgaṁ, vapra
śrīgaṁ puṭṭida, vajramuṣṭige, vimaḷacandra seṭṭigaṁ, vimaḷegaṁ puṭṭida
maṅgiyembaḷ peṇḍatiyāge, vasantakāladoḷarasanoḍane palavaruṁ
vanavihārakke pōge, vapraśrī sosegasahanateyiṁ, pāvuverasirda
pūmāleyuṁ koḍadoḷikke, maṅgi tānuṁ vanavihārakke pōgalutta
vaḷeyāgi pūmāleyuṁ tegevalli, vasantakālasamuvardhitōgra viṣavuma
viṣadharaṁ (pāvu) koḷe, cētaraṇegeṭṭspanṭṭaspandarūpeyāgirpuduṁ, vapraśrī
kr̥taka duḥkhaṅgeyudda peṟaydupeṟiyuyadantu, maṅgiyuya peṇanaṁ saraviyo
ḷsiḷsutti, parētavanadoḷikki bisuḍuvuduṁ, vanavihārakke pōda vajra
muṣṭi bandu maṅgiyulliḷḷirdaḷendaḍe, sattvattavārteyuṁyaṁ tāyi pēṟi,
niśita karavāḷahastanāgi, maṅgiyanarasuttuṁttaṁ, parētavanadoḷ, rātri
pratimāyōgadoḷirda varadharmayatigaḷaṁ kaṇḍavaraṁ tripradakṣiṇaṁ
geydu bandisi, mattrittiyeyu darśanamāge sahasra patrāmbujadiṁ nimma
caraṇa kamalamumanarcisuvegandu parasi pōge, cētaraṇegeṭṭa maṅgiyaṁ
kaṇḍu, suttirda paḷāḷavartiyaṁ kaḷedu, bhaṭṭārakara pādamūlado
ḷtandikkuvuduṁ. avaru sarvauṣadhi śuddhi prabhāvadināke nirviṣeyāge,
kaṇḍu, santōṣambaṭṭu, vajramuṣṭi sahasra patrāmbujavaṁmaṁ taralvēḍi
(lendu) pōdanannegaṁ.

alli gulmāntarikanāsāgi nōḍuttirda sūraśēnanākeyuya manavaṁmaṁ nōḍa
lendu meydōṟi madhura sambhāṣaṇādigaḷaṁ negaḷdoḍāke ninnoḍanebarpe
senennaṅkoṇḍu pōgembuduṁ, ninnagaṇḍagañjuvenidaṁ nuḍiyadirendo
ḍañjadiravana sattvatvavēgeydupupadavanadeseyiṁ ninagapāyu māgadantu
māṟpenendōrōrvaroḷ nuḍiyuttirpannegaṁ, sahasra patrāmbuja
maṁ koṇḍu bandu, vajra muṣṭikaravāḷaṁ maṅgiya kayyoḷ koṭṭu,
municaraṇamumanarcisuvāgaḷ, ātananāke nimirdu poyye, sūrasenaṁ
piḍiye, beral paṟiye, bāḷkeḷkiladōḷ bīḷvudumadaṁ kaṇḍu,
maṅgiyunañjadirendu nuḍiye, māyārāṇiyāṁ beccidapanendaḷannega
mittatra, aṟuvaruṁ kaḷdu tandoḍaveyaṁyuṁ mundiṭṭu. ninagappa bhāgamaṁ
koḷḷene, sūrasēnanoḍaveyunolliṁ, saṁyuvulleṁsaṁyamamaṁ kaikoḷvenene, ninna
tapakke kāraṇavēmēnembuduṁ-tannapaṟida beralantōṟi, maṅgiya
prapañcavaṁmaṁ pēṟi subhānuvempaṁvendaṁ-strīyembaḷ svabhāvadiṁ pāpiyuṁ

kr̥tyākr̥tyavivēkavikaḷeyuṁ, vañcanaracanā catureyuṁ, asatya bhāṣi
ṇeyuṁ, kuladūṣaṇa nirdayatvaṁ krūratva, paiśūnyādi dōṣadūṣi
teyurumapparadaṟiṁ dhīraruṁ, sattvātvādhikarumavaraṁ pariharisuvudenda
nibaruṁ paḍadoḍaveyuṁ tantappa peṇḍirge koṭṭu, varadharmayati
gaḷa pakkade, dīkṣegoṇḍaravara peṇḍiruṁ, jinadattāryikeyara pakkade,
tapambaṭṭarantēḻbar muniyarumondu divasamujjijjaniyu kānanadoḷi
rdaraṁ, vajramuṣṭi mūṟiṁṟusūḻ balagoṇḍu poḍavaṭṭu, nimma tapaṁ
baṭṭa kāraṇamēnene (besagoḷe) tamma dīkṣākāraṇamaṁ pēḻvuduṁ.

vajramuṣṭi strīnirvēgadiṁ varadharma gurugaḷa pakkade mahā
vrabratamaṁ kaikoṇḍaṁ; maṅgiyuṁ munne pēḻdaḻbararjiyar tapaṁ
baṭṭa kāraṇamaṁ besagoṇḍu tānumavara pakkade dīkṣiteyādaḷ, ā
saptar̥ṣiyaruṁ jīvitāntyadoḷ ārādhanāvidhiyiṁ, saudharma kalpa
doḷ, trayatriṁśaddēvarāgirderaḍu sāgarōpama kālaṁ divya sukhama
nuṇḍalliṁ bandu, dhātakī ṣaṇḍada, mūḍaṇa bharatada, vijayārdhada
dakṣiṇa śrēṇiyayu, nityāḷōkapuravanāḷva, citracūḷaṅgaṁ, manōharigaṁ,
subhānuvuṁ citrāṅgadanemba maganādoṁ uḷidavaruṁ mūṟimaḷ
ḷāgipuṭṭi, garuḍadhvajanuṁ, garuḍavāhananuṁ. maṇicūḷanuṁ, puṣpa
cūḷanuṁ, gaganānandanuṁ, gaganacarasemba pesargaḷāgesukhamirpina
mittaṁ-vijayārdhada, dakṣiṇa śrēṇiyayu, mēghapuramanāmusāḷva dhanañja
yaṅgaṁ, sarvaśrīgaṁ, dhanaśrīyemba magaḷāge, nandapurādhipati
hariṣēṇaṅgaṁ śrīkāntegaṁ puṭṭida harivāhanaṁ dhanaśrīge maidunanāgi,
bharatapayōdhyānagaradoḷ, svayambaramāge, dhanaśrī harivāhanaṅge
māle sūḍe, tadbharatapati, puṣpadanta cakravartigaṁ, prītiṅkarādēvigaṁ
puṭṭida, sudattaṁ, harivāhananaṁ kondu, dhanaśrīyuṁ koḷe,
citrāṅgadādigaḷeḻbarumaduve nirvēgadiṁ bhūtānanda tīrthaṅrthakara
pakkade dīkṣeyuṅgoṇḍu, jīvitāntyadoḷ, mahēndrakalpadoḷsāmā
nika dēvarāgi, saptasāgarōpamāntadoḷalliṁ bandu-

jambūdvīpada, bharatapa, kurujāṅgaṇa viṣayada, hastinapurada,
svētavāhana seṭṭigaṁ, bandhumatigaṁ, citrāṅgadaṁ, śaṅkhanemba maganā
donāsāpoḻalanāḷva, gaṅgadēvaṅgaṁ, nandayaśōvanitegaṁ, garuḍa
dhvajādigaḷāḷaruvaruṁ, gaṅgaṁ, gaṅgadēvaṁ, gaṅgamitraṁ, nandaṁ,
sunandaṁ, nandiṣēṇarembamavuḷḷāgi, nandayaśōvanite mattaṁ garbha

mantāḷdu, garbhamādiṁ baḻiyaṁṟiyuṁ, tanagarasanudāsīnanāge, puṭṭida
maganaṁ, rēvatiyemba dādiyu kayyoḷkoṭṭu, bisuḍendaṭṭidoḍe,
nandayaśōvaniteyakkanappa bandhutiyu kayyoḷīkūsaṁ naḍapendu
kuḍe, nirnāmukanendu pesaraniṭṭu, naḍasuttirpudumondu divasaṁ,
vanavihāradoḷ, gaṅgaprabhr̥tigaḷaṟuvarumoḍanuṇuttire, śaṅkhaṁ,
nirnāmukanaṁ karedu, nīnumivaroḍanuṇṇembuduṁ, śaṅkhanājñeyiṁ
duṇalkuḷḷirda nirnāmukanaṁ, nandayaśōvanite kaṇḍivanārgendu
munidodevuduṁ, mānabhaṅgamāge, śaṅkhanuṁ, nirnāmukanuṁ, arasusa
nōḍane pōgi, drumasēnarembavadhijñānigaḷaṁ kaṇḍu bandisi, dharmamaṁ
kēḷdu, nirnāmukaṅge, nandayaśōvanite muḷida kāraṇamēnendu
śaṅkhaṁ besagoḷe, bhaṭṭārakarintendu besasidar surāṣṭra(ramya) viṣa
yada, girinagaramamunāḷva, citrarathanembarasaṅgamr̥tarasāyayunemba sūpa
kāraṁ, tanage ruciyāge, māṁsamapunaṭṭu tandoḍātaṅge mecci,
(panneraḍu) bāḍamaṁmuṁ koṭṭoḍonṭṭondudivasaṁ, sudharmayatigaḷasāre,
dharmatattvamaṁmuṁ kēḷdu, mēgharathaṅge rājyamaṁmuṁ koṭṭu dīkṣitanāge,
mēgharathanuṁ paramamu śrāvakanāgi, sūpakāranāḷva bāḍaṅgaḷoḷoda
niralittuḷidumellamaneṭidukoḷvudumarasaṅge dharmaṁ pēḻdaṁ,
savaṇaninitaṁ māḍidanendu, bāṇasigaṁ muḷi(ni)du peṟaraṟiyadantu
sarva sambhāra saṁmiśramappa kōsātakī phaḷamaṁmuṁ carigevokka sudharma
munigikkidoḍade nimittadinujjayanti giriśikharadoḷārādhanā vidhiyi
sanattrenuttaregaḷoḷaparājita vimānadoḷahamindranāgi, mūvatteraḍu
sāgarōpamammumbaraṁ sukhamamunanubhavisuttirdar.

itta amr̥tarasāyayunanuṁ tr̥tīya narakadoḷpuṭṭi, saptasāga
rōpamānta duḥkhamamunuṇḍu bandu, trasasthāvarayōnigaḷoḷ
palakālaṁ paribhramise, jambhūdvīpada, bharatadamamuḷa viṣayada, palāsakūṭa
grāmada, yakṣadattanemba gr̥hapatigaṁ, yakṣadatteyemboḷgaṁ yakṣaneṁ
boṁmaganāge, yakṣiḷanemba norvanātaniṁ kiṟiyanāge, (tamma)
mattrivargaṁttirvargaṁsā sānukampa, niranukamparembiraḍaneya pesargaḷāge,
mattondu divasaṁ, sānukampanabāripuppuduṅgēḷade, niranukampaṁ baṭṭe
yoḷirdandhaka sarpada mēle tīvida bhaṇḍiyaṁ parisidoḍe, kāmunirja
reyindāpāvusattu, svētavikāra nagaramanāḷvamunvāḷa vāsava narapatigaṁ,
vasundhasundarigaṁ nandayaśōvaniteyāgipuṭṭatuṁṭṭitu. niranukampanuṁ,

tammaṇṇana nindu modalāgintappa saṁsāra hētuvaṁ negaḻdiḻidirembudu
mumpramupaśāntanāgi, nirnāmukanāgi puṭṭidanadaṟiṁ nandayaśōvanite
nirnāmukaṅge muḷidaḷembuduṁ; arasanumāruvarmakkaḷuṁ, śaṅkhanuṁ,
nirnāmukanuṁ, nirvēgadiṁ sarvasaṅga parityāgaṅgeydar. nanda
yaśōvaniteyuṁ, dādi rēvatiyuṁ, subrateyara pakkade dīkṣiteyu
rāgi, mūmaṟubhavadoḷamemumagivarare makkaḷakkavaranāme naḍapuvemakkendi
rvaruṁ, nidānaṁ geydar. antanibaruṁ, tapadoḷneḷnigaḻdāṟdārādhanā
vidhiyiṁ, mahāśukradoḷ, samānika dēvarāgi, ṣōḍaśa sāgarōpa
māntadoḷalliṁ bandu, śaṅkhaṁ baladēvanādoṁ. mr̥gātīviṣapayada,
dharmārśārṇavapuramamunāḷva, dēvasēna nr̥patigaṁ, dhanadēvigaṁ, nandayaśō
vanite nīṁ bandu dēvakiyādedai; mumpēḻda rēvatimamuḷayuviṣayayuda,
bhadriḷapurada, sudr̥ṣṭiyemba seṭṭigaḷakeyembabhāryeyāge, pūrvōkta
kumāraraṟuvaruṁ, nimamugavaḷḷāgi puṭṭiṭṭe, naigamamu r̥ṣi koṇḍoydu,
koṭṭoḍaḷakeyemba seṭṭiti naḍape, baḷedupu, dēvadattanuṁ, dēvapāḷanuṁ,
anīkadattanuṁ, anuṁānīkapāḷanuṁ, śatrughnanuṁ, jitaśatruvemba pesa
rgochoḷ, caramadēhadhārigaḷuṁ, yauvana kāladoḷ dīkṣegoṇḍu, nimma
madharmanege bhikṣārthadiṁ bare, pūrvabhavasambandhadiṁ, ninagavaroḷati snēha
māghāpudanā nirnāmukanuṁ, tapadoḷneḷnigaḻdinṭṭindu. svayumbhu kēśavana
vibhūtiyuṁ kaṇḍu, nidānaṁ geydudaṟiṁ, nimamugevumugaṁ vāsudēva
nāpamanembuduṁ, dēvaki santuṣṭeyāgi bandisirpuduṁ.

satyabhāme tanna pūrvabhava sambandhamanakāraṇa bandhuvaṁ besagoḷe,
varapattravattagaṇadhararintendu besasidar- śītaḷa tīrthasantānadoḷ, dharma
vyacchēdavāda kālada kaḍeyoḷ, bhadriḷapuramanāḷva mēgharathaṅgaṁ,
nandeyemyumboḷarasiyādoḷā poḻaloḷe, bhūtiśarmanemba pārvaṅgaṁ,
kapiḷigaṁ puṭṭida, muṇḍaśālāyayunanatyanta bhōgāsaktanāgi, tapadiṁ,
kāyayu klēśadinabhayādi dānamonduṁ phalamilla, suvarṇādidānamunabhi
laṣitatra sukhakāraṇamendu, viṣayāsaktanuṁ, kāyayuklēśakkasahananumanumppa
mēgharathaṅgaṟipe, purvārgamunellagurupadēśaṁ geydu, saptamamu
narakaṅgaḷoḷaṁ, tiryaryugjātigaḷoḷanēkavidha duḥkhamamunuṇḍu, gandha
māpādana giriyoḷ puṭṭida gandhapatiyemba toṟeyuṟciya samīpada, ballaṅke
yemba bēḍara paḷḷiyoḷ, kāḷanemba vanēcaranāgi, varadharmayatigaḷa

pakkade, madhu, madyamāṁsa parityāgaṁ geydu, jīvitāntyadoḷ, vija
yārdhadaḷakāpuramanāḷva, purubaḷaṅgaṁ, jyōtirmālegaṁ, haribaḷa
nemba maganāgirdanantavīryara pakkade, tapaṁ baṭṭu, dravya saṁyamumamu
paripākadiṁ, saudharmakalpadoḷpuṭṭi, sāgarōpamamudakaḍeyoḷalliṁ
bandu, vijayārdhada, rathanūpurādhipati sukētugaṁ, svayamprabhegaṁ,
nīṁ satyabhāmeyāgi puṭṭi, ninnammayyaṁ sukētu ninage patiyāvana
kkendu nimitta kuśalanemba naimittikanaṁ besagoḷe, cakravartige mahā
dēviyayukkumendu pēḷdaṁḻdaṁ.

tadanantararaṁ rugmi(kmi)ṇi mahādēvi tanna bhavasambandhamaṁ besa
goḷe, jambūdvīpada, magadha viṣayada, lakṣmīgrāmadoḷ, sōma
nemba pārvana peṇḍati lakṣmīmatiyemboḷondu divasaṁ, kayyuṁ
kannaḍiyaṁ nōḍuḻuttirdu, carigevokka samādhigupta muniyaraṁ kaṇḍa
vara prasvēda saliladigdhamappa śarīramamuḷa durgandhamakkumendu pēsi
yuṅguḷanttamīsavaṇanetta(nēke) bandanendu kinisi nuḍidudara phaladiṁ,
udumbara kuṣṭavāgi, puliḻitanāyaṁ kaṇḍante kaṇḍukaṇḍarella
perpaṭṭirvaṭṭe pāḷdaneyaṁ pokkuḻneyampokkusa, sattu pārvanoḷappa snēhakāraṇadinātana
maneyoḷ, durgandhamappa suṇḍiliyāgi, pārvana mēle pāyvuduṁ,
muḷidu poragīḍāḍe sattu, kuḷa(kuruḍu)pāvāgi puṭṭi, sattu,
goṅkurugappeyāgi mattaṁ pārvana manegaḍigaḍige bare, tadvijañjaḷa
kuṭa prahāradiṁ kālmuṟidu, puliḻitu, pāḷviḻviyoḷ pokku sattu,
matteyuṁ kuḷa pāvāgi, kuruḍunāyāgi, baṟiḻipi pandiyāgi, nāyuṁyu
gaḷoṟaḻaḷi tine, sattu, mandiragrāmada mastyanembambigaṅganaṅgaṁ, muṇḍū
kegaṁ, pūtike(gandhi)yemba magaḷāgi tāyuṁ, tandeyuṁ sāye,
tammamuttabbe naḍape baḷeḻedu, virūpeyuṁ, vikaḷa dantedantreyuṁ, durgaṁ
dheyumendu kaṇḍarellaṁ pēse, mattondu divasaṁ, mumpēḷdaḻda
samādhiguptaraṁ, pratimāyōgadoḷirdaraṁ, tōṭiḻiyoḷkaṇḷkoṇḍupaśama
vāge, tanna kayyoḷirda baleyoḷavara moyyoḷpattuva daṁsa masakaṁ
gaḷaṁ sōvuvuduṁ, yōga samāptiyoḷavaralli, dharmamuṁmumaṁ, tanna
bhava sambandhamuṁmumaṁ. kēḷdupavāsa bratamaṁ kaikoṇḍu mattondu
divasamarhatpūjānimittaṁ, battambeṟūrge pōpajjiyuyaroḍane pōgi,
tiripudu tampajjiyuyarikkida, kūḷoḷ prāṇamaṁ niṟiḻisi, giriparadoḷa

parduṁ, pūjeyuṁ poṟavumaḍisuva(māḍuva) śrāvaki nīmārgāhārādi
gaḷanunayvarā, śrāvakiyaranānuṁ nōnuṁnoḍalparṇenlbarpenendajjiyarge pēḷduḻdu,
pūjānantaraṁ girivarakkekkaivare, pūtikeyendaḷenna pāpakarmiyayunēnendu
nōḍalpanlbandeyendu gurugaḷalli kēḷda, tanna bhavasambandhamanākege
pēḷdati, munnonduḻdimunnondubha bhavada keḷadiyappudaṟināśrāvakiyendaḷ- nīṁ
jinadharmadoḷanurakteyāda puṇyavanteyey, muyaimunnegeyda pāpa phaladiṁ
virūpitva, rōgitva, vigandhatvādigaḷādavīgaḷ, paralōka hitamappa
brataśīlādigaḷaṁ paḍadeyuyadaṟindillinditta ninage, saṁsāra bhayamillendu,
prōtsāhise, sanyāsana vidhiyinacyutēndraṅge vallabheyāgirdayvattu
palyōpamada kaḍeyoḷ, vidarbha viṣayada, kuṇḍaḷapuramanāḷva
vāsavaṅgaṁ śrīmatigaṁ nīṁ rugmiṇiyāgi puṭṭi, kauśaḷa nagaramanāḷva
bhēṣaja narapatigaṁ, madridēvigaṁ śiśupāḷanembaṁ mūṟu kaṇberasu
puṭṭe, bhēṭṭibheṣaja narapatikaṇḍu, manuṣyaroḷidadr̥ṣṭapūrvamendu, naimittika
ranadara phalamaṁvaṁ besagoḷe, śiśupāḷana mūṟaneyuya kaṇṇāvanōrvanaṁ
kāṇaloḍane, keḍuṅgumātanindamītaṅge sāvakkumene, bhēṣajanuṁ,
madriyuṁ, śiśupālanuṁ vasudēvanaṁ nōḍal dvārāvatige bare,
kēśavanaṁ kaṇḍāgaḷe, tr̥tīyunayanamadr̥śyamāge, madri putrabhaikṣamu
nikkendu, tannaṁ prārthise, nūṟaparādhambaraṁ sairisuvenene, paḍadu
pōge, palarumanaḍaṭalendu, kēśavaṅge nūṟaparādhaṁ geydaṁyduṁ śiśupā
ḷaṅge, ninnaṁ kuḍalirpudumamudaṁ, nāradanaṟipe, kamaḷōdaraṁ balasahita
nāgi bandu, śiśupāḷanaṁ kondu, ninnaṁ mahādēviyuṁ māḍidoṁ.

jambhāvatiyayu janmāntaramamunintendu besasidar— jambūdvīpada,
pūrvavidēhada, puṣkaḷāvatī viṣayada, vītaśōkapurada, damu(na)ka
nemba paradaṅgaṁ, dēvamātr̥(mati)yemba paradigaṁ, vimuḷeyemba
magaḷāge, vasumitraṅge kuṇkuḍe, keladivasadiṁ vidhaveyāgi, jinadēvaguru
gaḷa samīpadoḷ, śīlabratamaṁ tāḷdīḻdīmandarada, nandanavanadoḷaṁ,
vyantaradēviyāgirdebbattinālkāsira varṣaṁ pōge, puṣkaḷāvatīviṣa
yada, vijayapurada, madhuṣēṇanemba paradaṅgaṁ, bandhumatigaṁ, bandhu
jaseyemba magaḷāge, jinadēva śrāvakana magaḷappa jinadatteyoḍanumnupa
vāsaṅgeydaydu, saudharma kalpadoḷ, kubēraṅge dēviyāgi bandu,
puṇḍarīkiṇiyu, vajranemba paradaṅgaṁ, suprabhegaṁ, sumatiyemba maga

ḷāgi, subratiyemba kantiyargāyugrāhāhāradānamaṁ koṭṭu, ratnāvaḷiyaṁ
nōntu, brahmakalpadoḷaccaraseyāgi bandu, jambūdvīpada, vijayā
rdhaduttara śrēṇiya, jāmbavanagaramanāḷva, jāmbava narapatigaṁ, jambu
ṣēṇegaṁ, nīṁ, jambāvatiyāgi puṭṭi, pavanavēgaṅgaṁ, śyāmuḷegaṁ
puṭṭida, namiyemboṁ ninna maydunanātaṁ, jyōtirvanadoḷ
kaṇḍu, jāmbavanarapatiyunenda nenage jambāvatiyuṁ kuḍuvudalla
dandeṟidukoṇḍu pōpenene jāmbavaṁ muḷidu, pākṣika vidyeyaṁ
besase, namikumārana māvaṁ, kinnarapurādhipati yakṣamāḷiyemboṁ,
sarvavidyāchēdiniyiyunadaṁ kiḍise, jāmbavanamagaṁ jambukumāraṁ
bandu, tanna vidyeyinabhibhavise, yakṣamāḷi beḷkettōḍuḷkatōḻuvuduṁ, nāradanā
prapañcamuṁvuṁ kr̥ṣṇaṅgaṟipe, ninnarūpātiśayaṁ baṇṇise, kr̥ṣṇaṁ balasahita
nāgi pōgi, vijayārdhada taḷpaladoḷ bīḍaṁ biṭṭu, tanagaśakyamappuda
naṟidupavāsaṅgeydu, cintisuttirpanaṁ, yakṣiḷanāpandandina bhavada
tammaṇṇaṁ yakṣaṁ, tapadaphaladiṁ, mahāśukradoḷdēvanāgirdātanaṟidu
bandu, vidyādvayasādhanōpāyayumanaṟipi pōge, kṣīrasāgaramaṁmuṁ vini
rmisi, tadantargata sarpaśayanada mēle, nālkutiṅgaḷirdu, siṁhavāhi
niyuṁ, garuḍavāhiniyumemba vidyegaḷaṁ sādhisi, baladēva vāsudēva
ravanēṟi, jāmbavanoḷkādi geldu, ninnaṁ tandu, mahādēviyaṁyuṁ
māḍidorendaṟipidar.

susīmeyayu bhavasambandhaṁ dhātakīṣaṇḍada, mūḍaṇamandarada,
pūrvavidēhada, maṅgaḷāvatīviṣayada, ratnasañcayapuramanāḷva, viśva
dēvananayōdhyānagarādhipati kolvudumāviśvadēvana peṇḍatiyappa
asundari, mantrigaḷ bāripuduṁ kēḷade, duḥkhadiṁ kiccaṁ pokku,
vijayārdhaparvatadoḷ, vyantaradēviyāgi, pattusāyiravarṣada kaḍe
yoḷ, mattaṁ saṁsāradoḷ paribhramiyisi, jambūdvīpada, bharatada,
śāḷigrāmadoḷ, yakṣaṅgaṁ, dēvasēnegaṁ, yakṣidēviyemba magaḷāgi,
yakṣagr̥hadoḷ dharmasēna muniyaralli subratamaṁ kaikoṇḍu,
māsōpavāsaṁ geydu munigāhāradānamaṁ koṭṭu, vanavihāra
modoḷondu dedivasaṁ, perpuḷirbuḷe koḷe, giriguheyaṁ puguvudumallirda
jagaraṁ koḷe, sattu, harivarṣadoḷ puṭṭi, bhōgamananubhavisi, jīvi
tāntyadoḷmāgiṇiyāgi bandu, jambūdvīḷgaṇiyāgibandujambūdvīpapada, puṣkaḷāvatīviṣayada,

puṇḍarīkiṇiyanāḷva, aśōkanr̥patigaṁ, sōmaśrīgaṁ, śrīkānteyemba
magaḷāgi, jinadatteyarasāre, dīkṣeyaṅgoṇḍu, kanakāvaḷiyaṁ nōntu,
mahēndraṅge dēviyāgi bandu, surāṣṭravardhana narapatigaṁ, sujyē
ṣṭeṣṭhegaṁ, susīmeyāgi vāsudēvaṅge mahādēviyādaḷ.

lakṣmaṇeyayu bhavāntaraṁ—jambūdvīpada, pūrvavidēhada, puṣkaḷā
vatīviṣayada, ariṣṭapuramanāḷva, vāsavanarapatigaṁ, vasumatigaṁ,
suṣēṇanemba maganāge, vāsava, sāgarasēna gurugaḷa pakkade dīkṣegoḷe,
vasumatiyuṁ putrasnēhadoḷ, maneyuṁ pattupiḍalālaṟade sattu,
alpapuṇyadiṁ puḷindiyāgi, nandivardhana cāraṇara pakkade bratamaṁ
kaikoṇḍēḷiḻaneya kalpadoḷ, śatamukhaṅge nartakiyāgi bandu, jambū
dvīpada, bharatada, vijayārdhada, dakṣiṇaśrēṇiyayaṁ, candrapuramanāḷva,
mahēndraṅgamanunnandarigaṁ, kanakamāliyemba magaḷāgi svayambara
doḷ, harivāhana kumāraṅge ratnamāleyanikki, mattondu divasaṁ,
siddhakūṭadoḷirda yamadhara gurugaḷalli tanna bhavasambandhamaṁmuṁ kēḷdu,
muktāvaḷiyaṁ nōntu, sanatkumāraṅge dēviyāgi, navapalyōpa
māntyadoḷ, suprakāranagaramanāḷva, śambaranarapatigaṁ, śrīmatigaṁ
puṭṭida padmanuṁ, drupapaṁṣēṇanumembirvartanayariṁ kiṟiyaḷ lakṣmaṇe
yemboḷāge, pavanavēga vidyādharaṁ, kamaḷōdaraṅge, lakṣmaṇe ninage
yōgyamendaṟipe, nīne koṇḍu barpudene, tadīya gurugaḷanu
matadiṁ, pavanavēgaṁ lakṣmaṇeyuṁ tare, vāsudēvaṁ mahādēvi
māḍidoṁ.

gāndhāriyu, gauriyu, padmāvatiyu, bhavasambandhamaṁmuṁ vāsudēvaṁ
besagoḷe, gāndhāriyu bhavasambandhamaṁmuṁ dēvarintendu besasidar—
jambūdvīpada, sukauśalaviṣayadayōdhyānagaramanāḷva, rurundranembo
narasi vinayaśrīyemboḷondudivasaṁ, sambuddhārtharemba tapōdha
narge dānaṅgoṭṭuttara kuravadoḷpuṭṭi bandu, candraṅge, candramati
yemba dēviyāgi bandu, jambūdvīpada, vijayārdhada, dakṣiṇaśrēṇiyayu,
gaganavallabhapuramanāḷva, vidyudvēgaṅgaṁ, vidyudvēgegaṁ, svarūpe
yemba magaḷāgi nityāvaḷōkanapuramanāḷva, mahēndra vikramaṅge
koṭṭoḍavarirvaruṁ mandarakke jinabhavana pūjānimittaṁ pōgi, vinīta
remba cāraṇaralli, dharmamaṁmuṁ kēḷdu, mahēndra vikramaṁmuṁ dīkṣegoḷe,

surūpeyaṁyuṁ, subhadreyayura pakkade tapambaṭṭu, saudharmakalpadoḷdēvi
yāgi, palyōpamāntadoḷgāndhāraviṣayada, puṣkaḷāvatīnagaramanā
ḷvindragiri nr̥patigaṁ, mērumatigaṁ, gāndhāriyāgi puṭṭi doḍākeyau
mayduyyunanappa namuñjige kuḍuva prastāvadoḷ, nāradanaṟipe, nīnā
taṅge bhaṅgavuṁmuṁ māḍi, gāndhāriyuṁ tandu mahādēviyuṁ māḍidaai.
gauriyu bhavasambandhaṁ-jambūdvīpada, sāgapuramanāḷva, hēmābha
narasi, yaśasvati, yaśōdhararemba cāraṇaraṁ kaṇḍu, tanna pūrvabhavamuṁ
nenedu hēmābhaṁ besagoḷe pēḷaltaguḷdoḷ— dhātakīṣaṇḍada, mūḍaṇa
mandaradhaparavidēhada śōkāpuradānandaseṭṭige, nandajaseyembabhāryeya
yāgirdamita sāgaramunigāhāramaṁ koṭṭāścaryapañcakamuṁ paḍadu
ttara kuruvinoḷ puṭṭibandu, bhavanavāsīndraṅge bhāryeyāgi
bandilliyāṁ, yaśasvatiyāgi puṭṭidenendu jātismareyāgi, janmāṁ
taramuṁ pēḷdu, siddhārthavanadoḷ, sāgara gurugaḷa pakkade, upavāsa
bratamuṁ kaikoṇḍu, saudharmakalpadoḷdēviyāgi bandu, jambūdvī
pada, kauśambīnagarada, suvrati śrēṣṭhigaṁ, subhadregaṁ, dhārmikeyemba
magaḷāgi, jinapatiyuremba kantiyara pakkade, jinaguṇa sampattiyuṁ
nōntu mahāśukra kalpadoḷdēviyāgi puṭṭirdappattumūṟu palyō
pamada kaḍeyoḷalliṁ bandu, vītaśōkapuramunāḷva mērucandraṅgaṁ,
candramatigaṁ, gauriyemba magaḷāge, vijayapuramunāḷva, vijaya
nandanaṁ ninage kūrpudaṟidātaṁ tāne tandīye, ninage gauri mahā
dēviyādaḷ.

padmāvatigauriyu bhavasambandhaṁ-jambūdvīpada bhasāgapuratadujjayiniyumanāḷva,
hēmābhanarasiyaśasvatiyaśōdhararembacāraṇaraṅkaṇḍutannapūrvabhavamaṁneneduhēmābhambesagoḷepēḻtittuguḷdaḷ—dhātakīṣaṇḍadamūḍaṇamandaradhaparavidēhadaśōkāpuradānandaseṭṭigenandajayaṅgaparājitegaṁ, vinayaśrīseyembabhāryeyāgirdamitasāgaramunigāhāramaṅkoṭṭāścaryapañcakamampaḍaduttarakuruvinoḷpuṭṭibandubhavanavāsīndraṅgebhāryeyāgibandilliyāṁyaśasvatiyāgipuṭṭidenendujātismareyāgijanmāntaramumpēḻdusiddhārthavanadoḷsāgaragurugaḷapakkadeupavāsabratamuṅkaikoṇḍusaudharmakalpadoḷdēviyāgibandujambūdvīpadakauśambīnagaradasuvantiśrēṣṭhigaṁsubhadregandhārmikeyemba magaḷāgi, hastiśīrṣanagajinamatiyurembakantiyarapakkadejinaguṇasampattiyaṁnōntumahāśukrakalpadoḷdēviyāgipuṭṭirdappattumūṟupalyōpamadakaḍeyoḷallimbanduvītaśōkapurama
nāḷva, hariṣēṇaṅge kuḍe, samādhigupta munige dānaṅgoṭṭa haimavata
doḷ puṭṭi, jīvitāntyadoḷ candraṅge rōhiṇiyāgi, palyōpamāṁ
tyada kaḍeyoḷ, magadhaviṣayada, śālmalīgrāmada, vijayadēvaṅgaṁ,
dēvilegaṁ, padmadēviyemba magaḷāgi, varadharmayatigaḷa pakkade, pesaragevijayapuramanāḷvavijayanandanaṁninagekūrpudaṟidātaṁ
ṟiyada vanaspatiya paṇṇaṁ tinenendu brataṅgoṇḍu, śālmalīgrāmamuṁ
bēḍariṟiye, padmamahādēvi siṁharathaṅgaḷka, vanagahanamaṁ pokku, pasi
dirdu, vipataruvalli gulphala bhakṣaṇaṅgeydu, palaruṁ sāye, tanna
kaikoṇḍa bratamaṁ kāvenendu, padmadēvi phaḷabhakṣaṇaṁ geyyade, nirāhāri

yāgirdu sattu, haimavatada bhōgabhūmiyoḷ puṭṭi palyōpamānta
doḷ, svayamprabhavimānadoḷ, svayamprabhadēvaṅge, svayamprabhe
yemba dēviyāgi bandu, jambūdvīpada, bharatada, jayantapuramu
nāḷva, śrīdharaṅgaṁ śrīmatigaṁ, vimaḷaśrīyemba magaḷāgi, bhadriḷa
puramanāḷva, mēgharathaṅge kuḍe, sukhamirdondudivasaṁ, sudharma
muniyara pakkade, tannarasaṁ tapambaṭṭu sahasrārapatiyāge, tānuṁ
padmāvati kantiyara sāre, ācāmla vardhanamuṁmaṁ nōntu, sahasrāra
kalpadoḷdēviyāgi, pañcaviṁśati palyōpamāntadoḷ, ariṣṭapuramu
nāḷva, hiraṇyavarmaṅgaṁ, śrīmatigaṁ padmāvatiyemba magaḷāgi, svayaṁ
baradoḷninage ratnamāleyanikke, mahādēviyūdaḷendu kēśavaṅge
besase.

baladēvaṁ tānaṟidanāgiyuṁ, sabhegaṟipalendu, pradyumnana,
śambhavana, bhava sambandhamuṁ besagoḷe, bhaṭṭārakarintendu besasidar—r—
jambūdvīpada, magadhaviṣayada, śāḷigrāmada, sōmadēva brāhma
ṇaṅgaṁ, aggilegaṁ, agnibhūtiyuṁ, vāyubhūtiyumbemyumemba tanayarāgi,
mattondu divasaṁ, nandivardhana nagarada, nandighōṣōdyānadoḷirda,
nipuṇa(vipuḷa)mati munigaḷāṇāḷaṅkr̥tarappa, nandivardhana gurugaḷ saddha
rmamaṁ pēḷdaṟikēḷdagnibhūtiyuṁ, vāyubhūtiyuṁ, sairiṟdukēḷdagnibhūtiyuṁvāyubhūtiyuṁsparśisade,
visaṁvādaṅgeyyal barpudumadaṁ bhaṭṭārakaraṟidu, namuginmmindu
mahōpasargamādapudadaṟināmāroḷaṁ nuḍiyadirpamene, mōnabrata
doḷellarumirpinamamuvarīrvaruṁ, bandivarellaṁ mōnabratadhārigaḷendapa
hāsyaṅgeydu pōguttamūroḷ carigevokku barpa, satyaka muniyuṁ
kaṇḍahaṅkāradinavara kelakke vandāptāgama padārthaṅgaḷ śūnyaṅgaḷendu
nuḍiye, satyakamuni jinapati mataṁ vivakṣitāvivakṣita svarūpānēka
dharmāśrayaika dravyatattvanirūpaṇa pramāṇa syādvādāvalambanadindaṁ,
prahētra puruṣa pramāṇanibandhanadindamāgamādyavasthāpanaṁ geydē
kāntaśūnyavāda dūṣaṇadindamavarge bhaṅgavādoḍe, keladoḷirdarellaṁ
nage, mānabhaṅgadiṁ miṁdiṁmaṁḷidu bandu, rātri pratimāyōgadoḷirda
satyaka muniyuṁ kolal bagevuduṁ, suvarṇayakṣaṁ nimumagadanyāya
mendāyudha karastambhanaṁ geyvudumavara tāyuṁ, tandeyuṁ,
bandhugaḷuṁ bandu, munipatiya kālgaṟilgeṟage, yakṣanendanivarīrvaruṁ,

jinadharmamaṁ kaikoṇḍu negaṟtūḍiṟdivarge muktiyakkumadaṁ kaikoḷ
suvudendoḍantegeyvemendu pusiyune śrāvakadharmamaṁ kaikoḷvaḷvudaṁ;
stambhanavamaṁ piṅgisi pōge nīmī jinadharmamaṅkāraṇa parigrahīta
mappudaṁ bisuṭpenṭṭirendu, mātāpitr̥tra bandhugaḷāgrahaṁ geyduydū, pattu
viḍisalāṟade, kōpadiṁ sattu, saṁsāradoḷ tiṟiyuttirdaragni
bhūtiyuṁ, vāyubhūtiyuṁ, jīvitāntyadoḷ, saudharmakalpa
doḷ, pāriṣadēvarāgi, pañcapalyōpamāntadoḷalliṁ bandu—

jambūdvīpada, kauśaḷaviṣayada, sākētanagaramunariñjaya nr̥pa
nāḷe, tatpurada parada narhaddāsaṅgaṁ, (rati) vapraśrīgaṁ, pūrṇacandra,
maṇibhadraremba tanayarāge, mattondu divasaṁ, siddhārthavanadoḷirda,
mahēndra gurugaḷa samīpadoḷ arasanumarhaddāsa prabhr̥tigaḷ,
dharmamaṁ kēḷdarasaṁ, rājyapadadoḷ, arindamananiṟisi, seṭṭiverasu
saṁyamamaṁ kaikoḷe, pūrṇacandranenna munnina bhavada mātāpitr̥gaḷe-
llirdarendu besagoḷe, bhaṭṭārakarintendaravarīrvaruṁ, jinadharmadoḷappa
visaṁvādaphaladiṁ prathamapr̥thviyuyavasarvāvarta narakadoḷpuṭṭi, duḥkhamamaṁ
nuṇḍu, sōmadēvaṁ kākajaṅghanemba mādiganāgirdonaggileyuṁ,
ātana maneyoḷ, peṇṇāyāgirdaḷembuduṁ, pōgi, pūrṇacandraṁ
pratibōdhiridoḍavarīrvarumrumupasamabhāvaneyiṁ, sanyāsanavidhiyoḷsa-
ttu, kākajaṅghuṁjaṅghaṁ, nandīśvara dvīpakkadhipatiyappa yakṣanādonāpolibila
nāḷvarindamu nr̥patigaṁ, śrīmatigamāpeṇṇāyi bandu suprabuddhe
yemba magaḷāgi, yauvanōdayadoḷ, svayaṁvara maṇṭapa pradēśa
doḷ yakṣaṁ pratibōdhisaloḍaṁ, priyadarśaneya ra pakkade dīkṣe
goṇḍu, saudharmēndraṅge maṇimāḷeyemba dēviyāge, pūrṇabhadra,
māṇibhadrarīrvaruṁ saptasthāpanōpagata śrāvaka bratarāgi, kālāntya
doḷ, saudharmakalpadoḷ sāmānika dēvarāgi, dvisāgarōpamānta
doḷ alliṁ bandu.

jambūdvīpada, kurujāṅgaṇaviṣayada, hastināpuramanāḷvaarha
ddāsaṅgaṁ, kāśyapegaṁ, madhuvuṁ, krīḍavanumemba tanayarāge yuva
rājādhirāja padaviyoḷavaraṁ niṟisi, vimaḷaprabhara samīpadoḷarha
ddāsaṁ dīkṣitanāge, mattondu divasamumaḷakaṇṭhapuramanāḷva, kanaka
rathanarasi, kanakamāleyuṁ tanagupāsegeyyal bandoḷa rūpa

lāvaṇyamuṁmaṁ kaṇḍu, kāmatāpadiṁ, madhurājaneṟidukoḷe, kanakarathaṁ
nirvēgadiṁ dvi(jādi)jaḷiyemba tāpasara pakkade tāpasa bratamaṁ koṇḍa
nittaṁ, madhuvuṁ, krīḍavanuṁ sukhadoḷirdavarondu divasaṁ, vimaḷa
vāhanara pakkade dharmamaṁ kēḷdu, madhuvuṁ tannageyda parādha
garhaṇadiṁ krīḍavarberasu, saṁyamamuṁ kaikoṇḍārādhanāvidhiyiṁ,
mahāśukrādhipatigaḷāgi, ṣōḍaśasāgarōpamaṁ sukhamunanubhavisu-
ttirdaravarutpattisthāna mātāpitr̥tranāmanirdēśamenmuṁventendoḍe—

jambūdvīpada, bharatakṣētrada, dvārāvatīnagaradoḷirda, vāsu
dēvaṁ tanneṇbar dēviyoḷārge mahādēvivaṭṭaṅgaṭṭuvamendu
dēvakiyuṁ karedu, parīkṣisimene, satyabhāmādigaḷeṇbaroḷaṁ, krōdha,
māna, māyā, kalahapriyatva, paiśūnya, damḍambhatvādigaḷoḷavaṟiṁ,
mahādēvi vaṭṭaṅgaṭṭalke yōgyamallarendu, rūpa, vijñāna, vinaya
mr̥duvacanānukūlatvādigaḷinananyasādhāraṇa guṇānviteyarappa rugmiṇige
mahādēvi paṭṭaṅgaṭṭuvamendaṟipe, rugmiṇiyuṁ parigrahisi, vāsu
dēvanati surabhi parimaḷamappa rugmiṇiya tambulamaṁ, mēludaṟa seṟagi
noḷkaṭṭikoṇḍu pōgi, satyabhāmeyu mr̥du śayana taḷadoḷ, pusi
yune maṟedoṟagidanpanteyippudumidu, sugandhadravyavidaṁ, tanna nallaḷge
kaṭṭi maḍagiṭṭanakkumendu, sairisparśisade satyabhāme mēludara seṟaṅginoḷ
kaṭṭirda, tambulamaṁ biṭṭukoṇḍaredu meyyoḷpūsikoḷvuduṁ,
kr̥ṣṇaneddu peṟara mukhabhūṣaṇame nimage śarīra bhūṣaṇamāytendu
naguvuduṁ, satyabhāme nāṇcicci, tannaḷipane caturmāḍi, nīmēke
naguviremmakkana tambulaṁ pavitramudakke dōṣamāvudendu nagemāḍi
kaḷedemmakkanaṁ kāṇalardhiyādudākeyuṁ nōṟpeṟvenene, kēśavanantegeyya
mendondu divasaṁ, banadoḷaśōkeya maradaḍiyōḷ peṟaraṟiya
dantu satyabhāmeyuṁ bañjisalendu, rugmiṇiyuna (spansvandi)sphuṭite
yāgirisi vanavihāradoḷirpuduṁ, ākeyuṁ satyabhāme kaṇḍu, vanadēvate
yendu bagedu parivārasahitaṁ, gandhapuṣpādigaḷanarcisi poḍevaṭṭu,

tarugulmāntaritanāgirda kr̥ṣṇambandu, ninnoḍavuṭṭidaḷaṁ kāṇa
lbayasutirdīgaḷ vinayadiṁ kaṇḍoḷḷittādembuduṁ, satyabhāme
siggāgademmakkanu nōntu koṇḍaḍaṁ dōṣamilla, nimamugēnendu nage
māḍi kaḷeye, kr̥ṣṇa namavugēgeṭṭapudendu mattaṁ jalakrīḍeyoḷirdalli,
rukmiṇiyayu mēludaṁ satyabhāme tegedoḍeraḍāgi paṟiye, mattaṁ
peṟiṟa peṟiṟavuṁ tegeye, śatakhaṇḍamāgi paṟiye, savāmādhigupta muniya
parīṣahāpanayayuna puṇyaprabhāvadiṁ paṟiyante sandhisinile, kaṇḍanibaruṁ
alliṟki rugmiṇige poḍavaṭṭu, nīmidaṁ kṣamiyisendu pōpuduṁ.
intu vāsudēvaṁ, pūrvakr̥ta puṇyaphalamanantaḥpura sahitamanubhavi
suttirdondu divasaṁ, vanavihāradoḷ vinayanyundhararemba cāraṇamuni
yuyaraṁ kaṇḍu, rugmiṇigaṁ, satyabhāmegaṁ putrōtpattiyaṁ besagoṇḍo
ḍīrvargargemīrvartaneyurapparene, ondu divasaṁ, munnaṣāvaḷmagaṁ
baḍedaḷākeya magaṁ, baḷiḻika magaṁ baḍedākeyayu kuruḷaṁ meṭṭimīgu
mendu rugmiṇiyuṁ, satyabhāmeyuṁ kr̥tapratijñeyarāge, kelavānu
divasadiṁ, satyabhāmeyuṁ subhānuvemba maganaṁ paḍedosageverasarasa
nalligaṭṭe, parijanaṁ, chatracāmamurādi vibhavadiṁ prōdimpōgi, pavaḍisirda kr̥ṣṇanecca
ṟuvudaṁ pāruttantareya deseyoḷirpuduṁ, rukmiṇigaṁ madhucaradēvaṁ
pradyumnanemba maganāge, parijanada kayyoḷaṭṭapuduṁ, avarnrpandu
kāladeseyoḷkkaḷkuḷḷirdaḍarasaneccattu, tanagabhimukhanāgirda pradyumna
kumāranaṁ kaṇḍu, nāmamudrikeyuṁ, kambaḷamumuṁmuṁ rugmiṇige
kuḍe, satyabhāmeyayu parijanamemmarapiyu magaṁ subhānuvaṁ koṇḍu
munnamāmemembandevumene, ratnakaṭakamuṁ koṭṭu munnamāvonaṁ kaṇḍe
mātanene piriyanendu kr̥ṣṇaṁ nuṣṇaṁnaḍivuduṁ, marudivasaṁ, jyōtirlō
kadadēvaṁ, dhūmakētuvemboṁ, pradyumna kumāranaṁ caramadēha
dhāranappudanaṟitātana mēle vimānaṁ paṟiyadire, vibhaṅgajñānadiṁ,
tanna pūrvabhavada śatruvendaṟidu, kanakaratha tāpasacaranantaḥpurakkellaṁ
māyānidreyaṁ māḍi, kūsanettikoṇḍu gaganataḷa(mārga)kkoge
vupuduṁ. tadīya puṇyaprabhāvadiṁ kolva bageyanuḷidu, khadiravanada
takṣakaśileyuḍiyoḷikki pōpuduṁ;

vijayārdhada, dakṣiṇaśrēṇiyoḷamr̥tavati viṣayayuda, mēghakūṭavu
nāḷva, kāḷaśambaraṁ, kāñcanamāliverasu, jinabhavanārcanā nimittaṁ

baruttaṁ, śilāpracalanamuṁmaṁ kaṇḍidēṅkāraṇakke kallōlloḷiḍinappudendu
bandunōḍi, kumāranaṁ kaṇḍu, kāñcanamālege naḍapendu kukuṇḍe,
nīmiītaṅge yuvarāja paṭṭaṅgaṭṭuvaḍe, naḍapuvenene, tatkarṇatkṣaṇakanakapatra
doḷ paṭṭaṅgaṭṭi, mahāvibhūtiyiṁ polibilaṁ pokku, dēvadattanendu
pesaraniṭṭu sukhamirpinaṁ.

itta rugmiṇiyuṁ kr̥ṣṇanuṁ, putraviyōgadoḷ cintākrāntarā
girpuduṁ, nāradaṁ bare, kumārananellivokkaṟisi barpudene, nārada
nempaṁ— vidēhada puṇḍarīkiṇiyu, svayamprabhatīrthakara pakkade,
kumārana bhavasambandamumuṁmuṁ, parivr̥ddhisthānamumuṁ, anarghyavastu
prāptiyumuṁyuṁ, padināṟaneyu varṣadoḷ nimmallige barpudumuṁduṁ
kēḷdu bandenene, santuṣṭarāgirpuduṁ. itta kumāranuṁ navayauvana
nāgi, kāḷaśambarana besadinagnirājanembona mēle, balasahitanāgi naḍedu,
kādi piḍidu tandoppise, khēcarapati santōṣambaṭṭabhiṣēka pūrvakaṁ,
vastrayuyuṅgaḷa kaṭaka, kaṭisūtrādi parārdhyarthyavastugaḷaṁ koṭṭu kumāranaṁ
pūjisi, paripūrṇa yauvana vibhūṣaṇāḷaṅkr̥tanaṁ, kāñcanamāle kaṇḍu,
pūrvabhava snēhadiṁ, kāmudahana santapteyāgi, tannaḷipaṁ tōṟi,
ninagī prajñapti vidyeyunīvenennaṁ parigrahisuvudendoḍantegeyvenendu
upavāsaṁ geydu, siddhakūṭakke pōgi, cāraṇamuniyarge namaskāraṁ
geydu, dharmaśravaṇānantaraṁ, prajñapti vidyeyukāraṇamunavar(dinavarge)
besase, sañjayanta purāṇamuṁ kēḷdu, poliṟabilgevandu, vidyeyuṁ tana
gāke kuḍe, koṇḍu, tanna parigrahisalolladire muḷidu, kāñcanamāleli
duṣṭabuddhiyiṁ ī kumāranaṁ oḍanirisalkaltakkanallendu rahasyadoḷ
pēṟi, kāḷaśambaranavivēkadiṁ, vidyuddaṁṣṭraṁ modalāgaynūrvar
kumāraraṁ karedu, nimma ballandadoḷ pradyumnanaṁ kollimene, vana
vihāradoḷirdī(ḷaynūrvar)yagnikuṇḍadoḷ pāyvātane gaṇḍanene,
kumāraṁ nirvicāradinalli pāyvudumallirda dēvate piḍidu, suvarṇa
vastrayuyuṅgaḷavibhūṣaṇādigaḷiṁ pūjise, poṟaṟivaṭṭanaṁ kaṇḍanibaruṁ
vismayaṁ baṭṭu, mattaṁ prōtsāhise, kr̥ṣṇanandanaṁ mēṣagirigaḷa naḍuve
puguvuduṁ, mēṣarūpadiṁ pāyvavaneraḍukeyyoḷaṁ piḍidu tritivida
vaṣṭambhadoḷirpudumallirpadēvate mecci, kumāraṅge makarakuṇḍaḷa
dvayamuṁyuṁ kuḍe, poṟamaṟivuṭṭu, mattamavavumparu pēṟdanldandadiṁ, varāhagiri

bilamaṁmuṁ puge poṟamaḍuva varāhadvayadoḷondara dāḍeyayunondu
kayyoḷ kittuṁ, mattondara mastakamanondu keyyoḷ poyvudu
mananyasādhāraṇakriyegaḷallirpa dēvate mecci, vijayaghōṣamemba śaṅkha
mumuṁmumpuṁ, mahājāḷamumuṁmuṁ kuḍe, mattaṁ mahākāḷaguheyoḷmahākāḷa
rākṣasaṅge mānabhaṅgamaṁmuṁ māḍe, vr̥ṣabha rathamumuṁmuṁ, maṇikavacamumuṁmuṁ
kuḍe paḍedu, mattondeḍeyoḷōrva vidyādharaṁ, viyuccarananeraḍu
maradeḍeyoḷiṭṭu kīlise, vēdanākuḷitanāgirdanaṁ pradyumnaṁ kaṇḍā
tana khēṭakadoḷirda bandhavōciniyemba ghuṭṭike(guḷige)yayunavana
kaṇṇoḷicce, tanagupakāraṁ geydanendu surēndra jāḷamuṁ, narēndra
jāḷamuṁ, prastāramumuṁmemba mūṟuvidyeyaṁyuṁ kuḍe, koṇḍu, sahasra
mukha nāgabhavanadoḷ vijayaghōṣamemba śaṅkhaninādana mukharita
digantaranāgi barpa kumāraṅge, nāgēndranuṁ, nāgiṇiyuṁ, makara
dhvajamuṁ, vicitravarṇamappa dhanuvuṁ, nandakamemba bāḷumaṁmuṁ, kāma
rūpiṇiyemba mudrikeyuyuṁmuṁ kuḍe, koṇḍu, kapitthadruma pracaḷanadi
nākāśagāmiyappa pādukadvayamumaṁmuṁ paḍedu, suvarṇakaḷabhadruma
daḍiyoḷ pañcaśiranappa phaṇipatiyiṁ tarpaṇa, tāpana, mōhana, viḷāpana,
māraṇa, lakṣaṇamappa pañcaśaramuṁ paḍedu, kṣīravanadoḷ, markaṭaṁ
kuḍe, māḷiyuyuṁmumanōṣapadhimāḷeyuyuṁmumanātapatramumuṁmuṁ, cāmara
yuyuṅgaḷamumuṁmuṁ paḍedu, kadambamukhiyemba bāviyoḷnāgapāśamuṁ
paḍeduṁdu, mattaṁ vidyuddaṁṣṭrādigaḷirdu, pātāḷamukhiyemba bāvi
yoḷāvaṁ pāyvonātaṁ, sakaḷabhuvana cūḍāmaṇiyembudumavariṅgita
manaṟidu, tāṁ meygredirdu, tannarūpadiṁ prajñapti vidyeyiṁ
pāyise, kaṇḍanibaruṁ śaiḷa pātadiṁ tanna kolva gebeḍudanaṟidu,
anibar kumārarumuṁ nāgapāśadoḷ talikeḷagāgi kaṭṭi, mēge
kallaṅkavidanibariṁ kiṟiyaṁyuṁ jyōtiprabhanaṁ polilgaṭṭi tānallirpinaṁ.
kāmucāriyappa nāradanākāśadiṁ bandu, nijamātā pitr̥sambaṁ
dhamuṁ pēṟi māyāyuddhadoḷkāḷaśambaraṅge bhaṅgamuṁ māḍi,
baṟiyuṁ, tanna parādhamilladudanaṟipi, kāḷaśambaranumātana makkaḷumuṁ
biṭṭu, kōpamuṁ pattuviḍisesi, nāradana banda vr̥ttāntamanaṟipi,
vr̥ṣabha rathamanēṟi dvārāvatige baruttaṁttuṁ, nāradaṁ pēṟi pūrvabhava
sambandhamumuṁmanaṟidu, hastināpurada samīpadoḷ duryōdhananaṅgaṁ,
jaḷadhiyemboḷgaṁ puṭṭidudadhiyemba kannikeyuṁ, bhānu kumāraṅge

kuṇkuḍalendu mahādarśanābhiṣēka vidhiyoḷ nāradanamēle prastāra
vidyeyiṁ śileyuṁ kavidu bandu, janakkellaṁ bahuvidha hāsyavidhiyaṁ
māḍi, madhurāsamīpadoḷ pāṇḍavar tamma magaḷaṁ bhānukumāraṅge
kuḍaluyvudhuṁ kaṇḍēṟisida bilvirasu, byādharūpadinaḍdamḍḍambandu,
bahuprakāradiṁ kadarthisi, dvārāvatiyusēyduneydi, munninante nāradaṅgaṁ
spandanavidhiyuṁ māḍe, prajñaptividyeyiṁ vānararūpugoṇḍu satyabhā
meyu banamanuṇmunaṇḍidalliyu bāviyu nīrellamuṁ guṇḍigeyoḷtīvi, kumbha
kāravēṣadineḷaganoḷaṁ, katteyoḷaṁ, viparītamāgi pūḍida rathamanēṟi,
puragōpuradoḷpugupava, poṟamaḍuva janamuṁ vyākuḷaṁ māḍi,
poliṟilaṁ pokku, bhānukumāraṅgendu tanda kanyakiyarallige, dēśā
ḷōkya vaidyavēṣadiṁ pōgi, paṟida kiviyuṁ sandisuvenempanemballi vividha
hāsyaṅgaḷaṁ māḍi, satyabhāmeyu maneyuṁ pārvanāgi pokku, bhōjana
kāladoḷ pārvarellarumaṁmuṁ nirākarisi, dakṣiṇeyuṁ koṇḍu, kṣullaka
vēṣadiṁ rugmiṇi mahādēviyuṁ kaṇḍu, savyegdalapṭimyagdr̥ṣṭiyeṁ pasidu bande
nenage taṇiyuṇalikkevemmembuduṁ, vividhānna sambhō(yo)ga miśrasūpa
śākhadadhi pākadinennapasivu pōgapene, rugmiṇi mōdakaṅgaḷanikke santuṣṭa
nāgirpinapumpavanada campaka kusumaṅgaḷalare, madhura kōkiḷa kaḷaravaṁ
negaṟi, munnamūgiyāgirdāddāke toṭṭasene koḷe nuḍiye, rugmiṇi
nīnenna magaṁ pradyumna kumāranappeyallendu besagoḷe, nijarūpamuṁ
tōṟi, jananiyayu caraṇakamalaṅgaḷeṟage, ninna bālakrīḍeyuṁ nōḍa
(kāṇa)lbaḍedenillene, tadabhilakṣita bālakrīḍegaḷaṁ tōṟi, sukhamirpinaṁ.

satyabhāmeyuṭṭida nāvidaṁ rugmiṇiyallige bandu, nimma kuruḷa
nīpradavaṁ bhānu kumāraṁ meṭṭi mīvapanembuduṁ, pradyumna kumāraṁ
nāvidanaṁ vividha vikāramāgi māḍe, matte banda parijanamuṁ gōpura
doḷ talelikeḷagāgi kaṭṭe, vāsudēvana rūpadiṁ vidūṣakanaṁ baggisi kaḷe
vupuduṁ, javanemba mahattaraṁ bare, kālaṁ baḷeye nīḍi pugalīyayude
kaḷedu, vāsudēvanaṁ mēṣarūpadiṁ pāydu, baladēvanaṁ mr̥gapati
yāgi nuṅgi, rugmiṇīdēviyunabba, nīminisānuṁ meygrediripenmendu,
prajñaptividyeyuṁ, rugmiṇiyayu rūpaṁ māḍi, vimānamanēṟisi pōge,
samasta balasahitanāgi muṟidu barpa cakradharaṅgidiraṁ naḍedu,
narēndrajāḷa vidyeyiṁ māyā yuddhamuṁ poṇarcirji kr̥ṣṇanaṁ gelvudhu

māprastāvadoḷ nāradaṁ bandu, tandemagaṅgaṁ prathama darśanamintā
galuṁlu vēḷkumene, māyāsvarūpamuṁ piṅgisi, nijasvarūpamuṁ tōṟi,
baladēva, vāsudēvara caraṇakamalaṅgaḷe ṟagi, gāḍhāliṅganaṁ geydu,
mahā vibhūtiyiṁ poḻaṟalaṁ pokku, satyabhāmeyu magaṅgendu tanda,
kanyakiyaraṁ maduverampaḍupe niltu sukhamirpinaṁ. pradyumna kumāraṅge
tammanappaṁ dēvalōkadiṁ bandu, vāsudēvaṅgindu sūṟi pandākege
maganakkumembādēśadiṁ, satyabhāme kr̥ṣṇanaṁ bēḍikoḷe, kāmadēva
nadanaṟidu, rugmiṇiyu besadiṁ, jambhāpavatige kāmarūpiṇiyemba mudrike
yaṁ kuḍe, mudrikāprabhāvadiṁ, satyabhāmeyu rūpugoṇḍu, vāsu
dēvanoḷkerevupuduṁ; mumpēḻdaḷda krīḍava(ḍāmara) caradēvaṁ jambhāvatige
sambhavanemba maganāgi, gandhapaśakuna nirutada sainyada vibhūṣaṇada paṇita
bandhadoḷ, subhānuvaṁ śambhavakumāraṁ geldanembuduṁ, rugmigma
ṇiyuṁ, satyabhāmeyuṁ mayuṁmucca ramanuḷidanyōnya prēmadinirdarendu
bhaṭṭārakarbesasidoḍanibaruṁ mukuḷita karakamaḷarāgi poḍevaṭṭu
pōge.
mattondu divasaṁ, baladēvaṁ bandavanatamastakanāgi, vāsu
dēvana rājyamenituvarṣaṁ naḍagumene, bhaṭṭārakarintendu besasidar—
pannenniraḍu varṣakke madyaṁ nimittadiṁ, dvīpāyana kumāraniṁ, dvārā
vatige kēḍakkuṁ; jaratkumārana kaiyoḷ cakrapāṇi sattu, modala
narakadoḷpuṭṭi, sāgarōpamamanda kaḍeyoḷ, tīrthakaranāgi muktige
salguṁ; nīnumātana viyōgadoḷ, duḥkhitanāgi siddhārthaṁ prati
bōdhise, dīkṣegoṇḍu; brahmakalpadoḷpuṭṭi, daśasāgarōpamamanda kaḍe
yoḷalliye bandu, tīrthakaranāgi muktige salveyembudumadaṁ
kēḷdu, dvīpāyana kumāramunnarnname saṁyamamaṁ kaikoṇḍu
dēśāntarakke pōdaṁ, jaratkumāraṁ kauśambīnagaradaraṇyamaṁ pokkirda
nitta vāsudēvaṁ munna narakāyuṣyamaṁ kaṭṭi, baliyaṁ samyagdarśana
pūrvakaṁ ṣōḍaśa bhāvanegaḷaṁ bhāvisi, parigraha parityāgaṁ geydoṁ,
dīkṣegoḷvanalleṁ, pēṟardīkṣābhimukharapparaṁ bārisuvenallenenllendu
gōsanegaḷeye, rugmiṇiprabhr̥tigaḷaṁ, pradyumnādigaḷaṁ, vāsudēvādi
bandhugaḷaṁ visarjisi, saṁyamamaṁ kaikoṇḍar. dvīpāyanana nidhā
nāvasānadoḷ sambhavanuṁ, aniruddhanuṁ saṁyamamaṁ kaikoṇḍu,

pradyumna muniverasu, ūrjayanta kūṭatrayadoḷ, pratimāyōga
doḷire, kēvalajñānōtpattiyāge mūvaruṁ muktige sandar. itta
nēmisvāmigaḷuṁ munnādidēvaṅge pēḻdandadoḻdandoḷ vihārisuttuṁ,
pallavadēśakkevantevare, rāmakēśavarge munna bhaṭṭārakarbesasidudellamāge,
vāsudēvana rājyaviḷaya vārteyuṁyaṁ kēḷdu, dakṣiṇa madhurāpatigaḷuṁ,
pāṇḍavarnirvēgadiṁ payaṇamaṁda mēlepayaṇaṁ bandu, samavaśaraṇa maṇḍa
ḷamuṁmaṁ pokku, dēvaraṁ bandisi, tamma pūrvabhava sambandhamuṁmaṁ besa
goḷe, bhaṭṭārakarintendu besasidar.
jambūdvīpada, bharatadaṅgapiviṣayada. campānagaramuṁmaṁ, kuruvaṁśada
mēghavāhananāḷva kāladoḷ, sōmadēvanemba pārvaṅgaṁ, sōmile
gaṁ, sōmadattanuṁ, sōmilanuṁ, sōmabhūtiyumemba mūvarta
neyarāge tamma māvanappagnibhūtigamuggilegaṁ puṭṭida dhanaśrīyuṁ,
mitraśrīyuṁ, nāgaśrīyumemba mūvarumaṁ maduve nile, sōma
dēvaṁ nirvēgadiṁ tapambaṭṭaṁ; mattondu divasaṁ, dharmaruci tapō
dhanarcarigevandaraṁ, sōmadattaṁ niṟiḻisi, tammatamma peṇḍati nāga
śrīyunivarge carigeyuṁ māḍendoḍellā poytuḻtumenage besavēḻpaḷpanendu
muḷidu, viṣamiśrānnamanikke, sanyāsanavidhiyindāmuni sarvārthasiddhige
pōdarittaṁ, nāgaśrīgeyda duścaritramuṁmaṁ kēḷdu, sōmadattādigaḷ
mūvarumaruṇagurugaḷa samīpadoḷ dīkṣegoḷe, dhanaśrīyuṁ, mitra
śrīyuṁ, guṇamuma(pa)tyārjikeyara pakkade, saṁyamamuṁmaṁ kaikoṇḍa
cyutakalpadoḷayvaruṁ, sāmānikadēvarāgippatteraḍu sāgarōpamuṁmaṁ
sukhamananubhavisuttirdarā nāgaśrīyuṁ, pāpaphaladiṁ, pañcama narakado
ḷpadinēḻu sāgarōpamumakālaṁ, duḥkhamanuṇḍu, svayamprabha dvīpa
doḷ, dr̥ṣṭiviṣanāgi, mattaṁ dvitīya narakakke pōgi, mūṟu sāga
rōpamaduḥkhamanuṇḍu, mattaṁ śunakaṁ, varāhāditrasa sthāvara
yōnigaḷoḷ, kiñcinyūnnūnaveraḍu sāgarōpamuṁmaṁ tiṭṭane tiṟiḻidu,
campānagaradoḷ, mādigittiyāgi, samādhigupta muniyaraṁ kaṇḍu,
madhu, māṁsa nivr̥tti bratamuṁvaṁ koṇḍu, jīvitāntyadoḷāpoḻaloḷe,
subandhuvemba paradaṅgaṁ, dhanadēvigaṁ durgandhaśarīre sukumāriyemba
magaḷādoḷā poḻaloḷe, dhanadēvanemba paradaṅgamumaśōkadattegaṁ, jina
dēvanuṁ, jinadattanumemba tanayarāge, sukumāriyuṁ tanage koṭṭa

pumeṁmuveṁ(pareṁ)dākeya śarīra durgandhakke pēsi, jinadēvanuṁ subrata
muniyaralli dīkṣegoṇḍaṁ; jinadattanuṁ bandhugaḷuparōdhadindākeyuṁ
kaikoṇḍu, kanasinoḷappaḍamākeyuṁ nōḍadire, viraktanādudanaṟidu,
tannaṁ nindisi, gr̥hītōpavāsavrateyāgirpinaṁ; subrati kantiyuyararji
yuyarverasu tannamanege bare, sukumāri vinayadiṁ bandisi pēṟi pīḻmī
yirvararjiyarumeṅkāraṇadiṁ tapaṁ baṭṭiṭṭarene, kantiyarendar—irvarmunninabhavadoḷsaudharmēndraṅgevimaḷeyuṁsuprabheyumembadēviyarāginandīśvarajinabhavanapūjeyoḷsaṁvēgavāgimanuṣyajanmamampaḍedutapaṅgeyvemendirvaruṁvyavasthegeydaallimbandusākētamanāḷvaśrīśēṣaṇaṅgaṁśrīkāntegaṁhariṣēṇeyuṁśrīṣēṇeyumembamagaḷdirāgejauvanadoḷsvayambaramaṇṭapapradēśadoḷpūrvabhavavamuṁmaṁ(sambandhavaṁ)vyavastheyuṁnenedudīkṣegoṇḍarenesukumārinirvēgadimbandhugaḷaṁvisarjisitatsamīpadoḷtapambaṭṭondudivasaṁvanavihāradoḷvasantasēneyembagaṇikeyumpalaruṅkāmigaḷirdukeygeyvudaṅkaṇḍānumiṁnepalarumbayasuvantappenakkendunidānaṅgeydujīvitāntyadoḷtannamunninagaṇḍanappasōmabhūticaraṅgedēviyāgeyvattaydapaḷitōpamāyuṣyamoḍeyuḷāgirpinaṁsōmadattādigaḷmūvardēvarumākalpadimbandupāṇḍurājaṅgaṅkontigaṁyudhiṣṭhirārjunabhīmasēnarādirīdhanaśrīyuṁmitraśrīyuṁnakuḷasahadēvarādarkāmpilyanagaramanāḷvadrupadaṅgandr̥ḍharathegaṁsukumāribandudraupadiyāgeyauvanaprārambhadoḷārgekuḍuvamendudrupadamantrigaḷambesagoḷepāṇḍavargekuḍuvudentene—duryōdhananupāyudiṅkolalbageyelākṣāgr̥hamampokkuporamaṭṭunīroḷagemaradaḍiyoḷagirdallikilbiṣanaṅkondusuraṅgadoḷaganepōgicandradattanadēvileyamaganaṅkaḷāguṇaviśāradarmāḍisthūṇigandhanaṅkondindravarmaṅgerājyamaṅkoṭṭalligevarpadaṟivāroḷaṁvirōdhavāgadantusvayambaramaṁmāḷpudendumantrigaḷnuḍiyebasantakāladoḷsvayambaramampaṇṇerājakadoḍanebarpudumalligebhīmasēnanabhōjanadiṅgandhagajasōratarjanadimpārthanamatsyavēdhanadiñcāpārōhaṇadiṁnāra

muveṁ(pareṁ)dākeyaśarīradurgandhakkepēsijinadēvanuṁsubratamuniyarallidīkṣegoṇḍañjinadattanumbandhugaḷuparōdhadindākeyuṅkaikoṇḍukanasinoḷappaḍamākeyuṁnōḍadireviraktanādudanaṟidutannaṁnindisigr̥hītōpavāsavrateyāgirpinaṁsubratikantiyararjiyarverasutannamanegebaresukumārivinayadimbandisipēḻmīyirvararjiyarumeṅkāraṇadintapambaṭṭarenekantiyarendar—irvarmunnina bhavadoḷ, saudharmēndraṅge vimaḷeyuṁ,
suprabheyumemba dēviyarāgi, nandīśvara jinabhavana pūjeyoḷ saṁvēga
vāgi, manuṣya janmamuṁmaṁ paḍedu, tapaṅgeyvayvemendirvaruṁ, byaruṁvyavasthe
geyduyda allimbandu, sākētamanāḷva, śrīśēṣaṇaṅgaṁ, śrīkāntegaṁ,
hariṣēṇeyuṁ, śrīṣēṇeyumemba magaḷdirāge, jauvanadoḷ, svayaṁ
bara maṇṭapa pradēśadoḷ, pūrvabhavamuvamuṁmaṁ(sambandhamaṁvaṁ) vyava
stheyuṁ nenedu, dīkṣegoṇḍarene, sukumāri nirvēgadiṁ bandhugaḷaṁ
visarjisi, tatsamīpadoḷ tapaṁ baṭṭondu divasaṁ, vanavihāradoḷ,
vasantasēneyemba gaṇikeyuṁ palaruṁ kāmigaḷirdu keygeyvudaṁ
kaṇḍānumintemiṁne, palaruṁ bayasuvantappenakkendu, nidānaṅgeydu,
jīvitāntyadoḷ, tanna munnina gaṇḍanappa sōmabhūticaraṅge dēvi
yāgeyvattayduyda paḷitōpamāyuṣyamoḍeyuḷāgirpinaṁ, sōma
dattādigaḷ mūvardēvarumākalpadiṁ bandu, pāṇḍurājaṅgaṁ,
kontigaṁ, yudhiṣṭhirārjuna bhīmasēnarādirī dhanaśrīyuṁ, mitra
śrīyuṁ nakuḷa sahadēvarādar. kāmpilya nagaramanāḷva drupadaṅgaṁ,
dr̥ḍharathegaṁ, sukumāri bandu, draupadiyāge, yauvana prārambhado
ḷārge kuḍuvamendu drupada mantrigaḷaṁ besagoḷe, pāṇḍavarge kuḍu
vudentene— duryōdhananupāyayudiṁ kolalbageye, lākṣāgr̥hamaṁ
pokku, poramaṭṭu, nīroḷage, maradaḍiyoḷagirdalli kilbiṣanaṁ kondu,
suraṅgadoḷagane pōgi, candradattana, dēvileya maganaṁ, kaḷāguṇa
viśāradar māḍi, sthūṇigandhanaṁ kondindravarmaṅge rājyamaṁ
koṭṭalligevarpadaṟivāroḷaṁ virōdhavāgadantu svayambaramaṁ
māḍpuḷpudendu mantrigaḷ nuḍiye, basantakāladoḷ, svayambaramaṁ
paṇṇe, rājakadoḍane barpudumallige bhīmasēnanabhōjanadiṁ, gandhagaja
sōratarjanadiṁ, pārthana matsyavēdhanadiṁ, cāpārōhaṇadiṁ, nāra

dāgamanadiṁ, nimmambammbaramaṁ drupadanaṟidu, jinapūjāpūrvakaṁ, kanyā
ratnamaṁ svayambaramaṇṭapakke tare, siddhārthanemba purōhitaṁ tōṟi
darasugaḷaṁ(doḍārumaṁ) peccade, arjunaṅge māleyanikkuvuduṁ;
drupadaṁ modalādugravaṁśadarasugaḷuṁ, kuruvaṁśadarasugaḷuṁ, sama
samāyōgamādudendu santōṣaṁ baḍe, poḻaṟalaṁ pokku, sukha
mirpinaṁnandūtavyatikaramumbhujaṅgaśailapuradoḷkīcakadahananamuṁvirāṭanagōmaṇḍaḷamunduryōdhananabalambandukoḷesuśarmanuṁvirāṭanumbhīmanumbaliyantuguḻdamaguḻcidoḍuttaragōgrahaṇadoḷarjunaṅkādimaguḻcidudumendivumodalādapeṟavumpraghaṭṭakapāgekurukṣētradoḷnīvunduryōdhananoḷkādigeldarasugeyyuttiresubhadregamabhimanyuvembamaganāgedraupadigepañcapāñcāḷarembatanayarāgesukhamirdudvīpāyananindvārāvatibenduduṅkauśambīnagarāraṇyadoḷjaratkumāranakayyoḷvāsudēvasattudumbaladēvandīkṣegoṇḍuduṅkēḷdunirvēgadiṁnīmilligebandirembudumpalarumberasupāṇḍavarsaṁyamaṅkaikoḷekontiyuṁsubhadreyundraupadiyuṁrā(dhā)trimatikantiyarapakkadedīkṣegoṇḍacyutakalpadoḷpuṭṭibandumuktigesalvarpañcapāṇḍavaruṁr̥ddhiprāptarāgibhaṭṭārakaroḍanekelavukālaṁvihārisiśatruñjayagirigemandātapayōgadoḷireduryōdhananaḷiyaṅkuryuvaranembontannamāvanaṅkondapagegemuḷidukarbonnaṅkāsitandumakuṭakaṭakādigaḷāmaḍitandumeyyoḷittisetadupasargamaṁsairisiśukladhyānadiṅkarmaṅgaḷaṅkiḍisiyudhiṣṭhirārjunabhīmasēnamunigaḷmuktigesandarnakuḷasahadēvaruṁsarvārthasiddhigesandarnēmibhaṭṭārakarumujjayantagiriśikharadoḷaṟunūṟatombattombhattuvarṣamumpadinālkudivasamuṁvihārakālaṁsalvudumondutiṅgaḷviharaṇamuḷidaynūṟamūvattumūrvamunigaḷverasuāṣāḍhaśuddhasaptamiyapūrvarātradoḷśukladhyānadiṅkarmaṅgaḷaṅkiḍisimuktigesandarparamasukhādigaṇasahitaṁsiddhatvaparyāyapariṇatarāgirdarsurapatiyumparinirvāṇakalyāṇānantaravānandanr̥tyamanāḍipōdaṁ.

dāgamanadiṁnimmbaramandrupadanaṟidujinapūjāpūrvakaṅkanyāratnamaṁsvayambaramaṇṭapakketaresiddhārthanembapurōhitantōṟidarasugaḷaṁ(doḍārumaṁ)peccadearjunaṅgemāleyanikkuvudundrupadaṁmodalādugravaṁśadarasugaḷuṅkuruvaṁśadarasugaḷuṁsamasamāyōgamādudendusantōṣambaḍepoṟalampokkusukhamirpinandūta vyatikaramuṁ, bhujaṅgaśaila puradoḷ, kīcakadahananamuṁ,
virāṭana gōmaṇḍaḷamuṁ, duryōdhanana balambandu koḷe, suśa
rmanuṁ, virāṭanuṁ, bhīmanuṁ baliyinyantuguḻduḻda maguḻdoḻcidoḍuttara
gōgrahaṇadoḷarjunaṁ kādi maguḻduḻcidudumendivu modalāda peṟavuṁ
praghaṭṭakapāge, kurukṣētradoḷ nīvuṁ duryōdhananoḷkādi geldarasu
geyyuttire, subhadregamabhimanyuvemba maganāge, draupadige pañca
pāñcāḷaremba tanayarāge sukhamirdu, dvīpāyananiṁ dvārāvati
bendudumaṁduṁ, kauśambīnagarāraṇyadoḷ, jaratkumārana kayyoḷ
vāsudēva sattudumaṁduṁ, baladēvaṁ dīkṣegoṇḍudumaṁduṁ kēḷdu, nirvē
gadiṁ nīmillige bandirembuduṁ, palaruṁ berasu, pāṇḍavarsaṁyamamaṁ
kaikoḷe, kontiyuṁ, subhadreyuṁ, draupadiyuṁ rā(dhā)trimati
kantiyarapakkade dīkṣegoṇḍacyuta kalpadoḷpuṭṭibandu muktigesalvar;
pañcapāṇḍavaruṁ, r̥ddhiprāptarāgi bhaṭṭārakaroḍane kelavukālaṁ vihā
risi, śatruñjayagirige vanmandātapayōgadoḷire, duryōdhananaḷiyaṁ,
kuryuvaranemboṁ tanna māvanaṁ konda pagege muḷidu, karbonnaṁ
kāsitandu, makuṭa, kaṭakādigaḷāmaḍi tandu, meyyoḷpaḷittise, tadupa
sargamaṁ sairisi, śukladhyānadiṁ karmaṅgaḷaṁ kiḍisi; yudhiṣṭhirārjuna
bhīmasēna munigaḷ muktige sandar. nakuḷa sahadēvaruṁ sarvārtha
siddhige sandar. nēmibhaṭṭārakarumūrjamujjayanta giriśikharadoḷaṟunūṟa
tombhatombattombhattu varṣamuṁ padinālkudivasamuṁ vihārakālaṁ salvudu
mondu tiṅgaḷ viharaṇamuḷidaynūṟa mūvattumūrvamunigaḷverasu,
āṣāḍhaśuddha saptamiya pūrvarātradoḷ, śukladhyānadiṁ, karmaṅgaḷaṁ
kiḍisi, muktige sandar. paramasukhādigaṇasahitaṁ siddhatva paryāya
pariṇatarāgirdar. surapatiyuṁ parinirvāṇa kalyāṇānantaramāvānanda
nr̥tyamanāḍi pōdaṁ.

div.head: brahmadattacakravartikathā
div.trailer:
idu sakaḷaśāstrasaṁyumu sampanna śrīmudajitasēna bhaṭṭāraka caraṇa
kamala cañcarikaṁ dharmmavijayi śrīmuccāvuṇḍarājaviracita triṣaṣṭilakṣaṇa
mahāpurāṇadoḷ nēmibhaṭṭāraka purāṇaṁ.
div.p:
idaṁsakaḷaśāstrasaṁyumusampannaśrīmudariṣṭa nēmadajitasēnabhaṭṭārakacaraṇakamalacañcarikandharmavijayiśrīmaccāvuṇḍarājaviracitatriṣaṣṭilakṣaṇamahāpurāṇadoḷnēmibhaṭṭāraka santānadoḷ, hanneraḍaneya cakra
varti brahmadatta brahmanembarasaṅgaṁ, cūḷādēvigaṁ, saptacāpōtsē
dhanuṁ, saptaśatavarṣa paravāyuṣyanumappa brahmadattanembarasaṁ
panneraḍaneya cakravartiyādoṁ.

div.head: pārśvanāthapurāṇaṁ
ippattu mūraneya tīrthaṅkara
śrī pārśvanātha purāṇaṁ
pārśvanātha purāṇaṁ
div.p:
jambūdvīpada, bharatada, suramyaviṣayada, pōdanapuramanāḷvaṁ
aravindanembarasaṁ; tatpurada viśvabhūtiyemba brāhmaṇaṅgaṁ,
anundarigaṁ, kamaṭhanuṁ, marubhūtiyuṁ emyumemba, tanayarīrvarumara
saṅge, mantrigaḷādaralli, kamaṭhaṅge, varuṇiṇeyembaḷ, marubhūtige vasundhari
yembaḷ bhāryeyarāge, vasundhareyuya kāraṇadiṁ kamaṭhaṁ marubhūti
yaṁ kole, sattu, marubhūti, maḷaya parvatada, kubjakamemba sallakī
vanadoḷ vajraghōṣamemba karipatiyāge, varuṇeyuṁyumā banadoḷḷiḷviḍi
yāge puṭṭidoḷ.
ittalaravinda mahārājaṁ, rājyaparityāgaṁ geydu, saṁyutanāgi,
sārthadoḍane sammēdagiriyu tīrthavaṁ bandisalendu bandu pratimā
yōgadoḷire, vajraghōṣagandhahasti sallakīvanadoḷ vihārisuttuma
varaṁ kaṇḍu, kolal paridu, avara pakṣasthaḷada śrīvatsalāñchanamaṁ
kāṇaloḍaṁ, pūrva bhavamaṁ nenedu, munnina snēhadiṁ koleyuṁ
maṟedu, yōgāvasānadoḷivaralli dharmamaṁ kēḷdu, samyagdarśanamaṁ,
śrāvaka bratamaṁ, prōṣadhōpavāsamumaṁ kaikoṇḍu, peṟavānegaḷ
ghaṭṭisida kaḍikombugaḷaṁ tindumavaṟiṁ saṅghaṭṭanavāda nīraṁ kuḍidu
mintu, pāpabhīṟuvāgi dorverve, vēgavatiyemba toṟeya taḍiyoḷ
biddu, poṟamaḍalāṟadire, kamaṭhaṁ kukkuṭa sarpanāgi koḷe, sattu,
sahasrāra kalpadoḷ puṭṭi, ṣōḍaśa sāgarōpamāntadoḷalliṁ bandu,

jambūdvīpada, pūrvavidēhada, puṣkalāvatī viṣayayuda, vijayārdhada
trilōkō(ta)ttama nagaramanāḷva, vidyudgatigaṁ, vidyunmāḷiḷegaṁ, raśmi
vēganemba maganāgi, navayauvana prārambhadoḷ, samādhigupta muni
yara pakkade dīkṣegoṇḍu, sarvatōbhadraṁ podalāge nōmpigaḷaṁ
nōntondu divasaṁ, himagiri guheyoḷ pratimāyōgadoḷire,
kukkuṭa sarpaṁ sattu, pañcamanarakadoḷpuṭṭi bandajagaranāgi nuṅgu
vudumaccucyutakalpada, puṣkaravimānadoḷ puṭṭi, dvāviṁśati sāgarōpa
māntadoḷalliṁ bandu,—

jambūdvīpada, aparavidēhada, padmaviṣayayudaśvapuramanāḷva, vajra
vīryaṅryarṅgaṁ, vijayiyuṅgaṁ, vajranābhiyemba maganāgi cakravartipadado
ḷninḷḷindu, kṣēmaṅkara bhaṭṭārakaralli dharmamaṁrmuṁ kēḷdu, nirvēgadiṁ
magaṅge rājyamaṁ koṭṭu, palabaruṁ berasu, saṁyumadharanāgi, trikāla
yōgadoḷātāpayōgadoḷnilvuduṁ. mumpēḷda ajagaranāṟiṟaneya naraka
doḷippatteraḍu sāgarōpama kālaṁ duḥkhamanuṇḍu bandu, kuraṅganemba
bēḍanāgi bandātapōdhanarge vividhōpasargaṁ māḍe, samādhiyiṁ
sattu, madhyamagraivēyukada, madhyama subhadra(suprabha) vimānadoḷaha
mindranāgi, saptaviṁśati sāgarōpamāntadoḷalliṁ bandu, jambū
dvīpada, bharatada, kauśalaviṣayayuda, vinītāpuramanāḷvikṣvākuvaṁśada,
kāśyapagōtrada, vajrabāhu mahīpatigaṁ, prabhaṅkari mahādēvigaṁ
ānandanemba maganāgi, mahāmaṇḍaḷika padaviyoḷnindu, mattondu
divasaṁ—

svāmihitanemba mahāmantri pēṟa, phālguṇa nandīśvarada yātrā
dinadoḷ, jinapūjeyaṁ māḍe, tatpūjeya nōḍalendu bandu,
vipuḷamatigaḷemba gaṇadhararaṁ vinayadiṁ bandisi, dharmamaṁrmuṁ kēḷdu, tada
nantaramarasanendaṁ- pratikr̥tigaḷa cētanaṅgaḷnigrahānugraha parāṅmukhaṁ
gaḷavarke pūjeyuṁyaṁ māḍi, bhāktikarappavarentu pūjāphaḷamu(di)neyddaydudappa
radaṁ besasimene, munigaḷendarī poḻaloḷ, tapamuṁ amumabhayadānamuṁ,
śāstradānamuṁ, munnamādidēvaniṁ pravarti(kīrti)tamāge, bharata
rājaṁ jinabhavana pūjādi śrāvaka niyōgamuṁ tōṟidaṁ. hastinapura
doḷ, śrīḷśrēyāṁsanāhāradānamamunegeydogaṟidonadaṟiṁ, bharatanante
nīmuṁ īmumī jinapūjāphaḷamananubhavisuve. kalpavr̥kṣamuṁ, cintāmaṇiyuṁ

membuva cētanaṅgaḷāgiyuṁ, manōbhilaṣita phalapradagaḷante, jinabhavana
pratimegaḷa cētanaṅgaḷāgiyuṁ, sākṣātpuṇya bandhahētugaḷuṁ, śubhapari
ṇāmōtpatti kāraṇaṅgaḷumakkuṁ. rāga, dvēṣa, mōhamilladudarinā
(rindā)bharaṇāyudhādi vimukhanuṁ, niratiśayānindriya vibōdhanāgi,
kr̥tārthanappudaṟiṁ, jaṭājinādi vēṣarahitanumappa jinapatiya pratibimba
darśanadindallade śubhapariṇāma prakarṣa(rṇa)māgadu. puṇyapāpa prabaṁ
dhakke bāhyābhyantara sannidhānaṁ kāraṇamendaṟipi, jinapratibimba kathā
prasaṅgadiṁ, tribhuvana caityālaya varṇanābhiprāyadoḷ, munnaṁ
jyōtirlōkadoḷādityavimānagata jinabhavana vibhūtiyayunasādhāraṇaṁ
māḍi, munipati pēṟa piriduṁ ruciyāgi, jinabhavanaṅgaḷaṁ māḍi,
sūryōdayāstamaya samayadoḷ ādityabimbadarhadbhaṭṭārakaṅge
śāstrōkta kramadiṁ, nityapūjeyuṁ, aṣṭāhnikamuṁ, caturmu
khamuṁ, kalpavr̥kṣamuṁ, rathāvartamuṁ, sarvatōbhadramumemba pūje
gaḷaṁ māḍuttuṁ, jinabhavanakke poḍavaḍuvudane kaṇḍadane praṇāmaṁ
māḍi, tatvamanaṟivavarumaṟiyadavarumenmandimbaṟiyumādityabimba
mane pūjisal tagubdar. mattondudivaddirmattondudisamānandaṁ, tannataleyuya
nareyuṁ kaṇḍu nirvēgamāgi magaṅge rājyamanittu, samudragupta
yatiyuyara pakkade, palaruṁ berasu saṁyamamuṁmaṁ kaikoṇḍu, samyagda
rśana jñānacāritramembivaṟoḷ negaḻdaḷda, ēkādaśāṅgadharaṁ, ṣōḍaśa
bhāvanegaḷiṁ tīrthakara puṇyamuṁmaṁ kaṭṭi, kṣīravanadoḷ prāyōpagamana
vidhiyiṁ pratimāyōgadoḷire, mumpēḻdaḷda byādhanēḻiṟaneyunarakadiṁ
bandu, siṁhamāgi pāye, tadupasargamuṁmaṁ sairisi, caturvidhārādhanā
vidhiyinānata kalpada, prāṇata vimānadoḷ, ānatēndranāgi, viṁśati
sāgarōpamāyuṣyanuṁ, mūṟumuvare moḷaniḍiyanuṁ, śuklalēśyā
pariṇāmanuṁ daśamāsaniśvāsanuṁ, viṁśatisahasravarṣa mānasāhramr̥tā
hāranuṁ, manaḥpravicārasukhanuṁ, pañcama pr̥thvīgatāvadhijñānanuṁ,
svāvadhi kṣētra pramāṇa bala prakāśa vikriyāsamarthanumenisi, sāmāni
kādi nava vidhāmarānēka dēvi sahasra parivr̥tanuṁ divyasukhamananubhavi
suttirpinaṁ.
itta, jambūdvīpada, bharatakṣētrada, kāśīviṣayada, vāraṇāsī
puramanāḷvugravaṁśada, kāśyapagōtrada, viśvasēnamahārājanarasi brahma

dēvi, vaiśākhabahuḷa bidigeyu beḷagappa jāvadoḷ, viśākhānakṣatradoḷ
ṣōḍaśa śubhasvapnamumuṁmuṁ, nijamukhapravēśi gajarūpamumuṁ kaṇḍavadhi
jñāniyappa nijēśaniṁ tatphalamanaṟidu sukhamirpinavāmānatēndraṁ,
svargāvataraṇa pūjāpūrvakavāmādēviyuya garbhakkavatarisi, nēminātha
bhaṭṭārakara tīrthasantānamembattuttamūsāsiradainūṟayvattuvarṣaṁ pavavra
rtisuvandākāladoḷ, puṣyabahuḷēkādaśiyoḷ, nīḷayōgadoḷ,
trijñānadharaṁ puṭṭeṭṭi, divijarājaṁ janmābhiṣēka kalyāṇānantaraṁ, pārśva
membuduṁ triḷōka pūjitavammappa dharmarmumadakkāśrayamappudaṟiṁ
pārśvanemba(du) pesaraniṭṭu pōge. śatavarṣa paramāyuṣyanuṁ, apakva
śālivarṇanuṁ, navaratni pramāṇōtsēdhanuṁ enisi baḷedu, padināṟu
varṣaṁ pōge, mattondudivasaṁ, caturaṅgabalasahitamōlagaṁ pora
maṭṭu, maguḻdaḻdubarutavāmāśramavemvamemba vanadoḷ tammabbepasbigaḷaṇṇaṁ, mahī
pāḷanagaramanāḷva, mahīpāḷanembarasaṁ, mahādēviya viyōgadoḷ
tāpasadīkṣeyuṁyaṁ koṇḍu, pañcāgnitapadoḷirdanaṁ kaṇḍu, kelakke vandu
sirade kuḷḷirpudumātaṁ, tanage māvanēṁ, kuḷīnanēṁ, tapōpravr̥ddha
nēnenage vinayuṁ geyyadusiradirdanendu kumāraṅge muḷidu, kōpa
kaluṣitahr̥dayanāgi, kiccaccu nandidoḍe matte minthattamindhanamanikkalendu koḍali
goṇḍu puḷḷiyaṁ pōḻvagaḷ, kumāranidaṁ kaḍeyubēḍa, puḷḷiḷḷeyo
ḷprāṇiyuṁ dudayirdudaṟiṁ, pāpakāraṇamendu bāṟa(bōdhi)se, vārisi
kaḍidu kiccinoḷikkidoḍe, puḷḷiyoḷagirda nāganuṁ, nāgiyumeraḍu
nālku khaṇḍamāge kaṇḍu, subhaumanemba rājakumāranendanelegorava,
nīṁ tapasviye yēnendu sagarvamuṁmaṁ nuḍidai, pāpāśravamāvakāraṇadiṁ
(niṣkāraṇaṁ) sambhavisugumendaṟiveyulle, ninna jñānadoḷappa tapada
phalamēnene, goravanendanennanavajñe geyddaydanna tapōmahātmyamanaṟi
yade nuḍideyānappoḍe, pañcāgni madhyadoḷūrdhvabāhumēkapāda
sthitanumāgi, gāḷiyumuṁyuṁ, svayaṁ patita parṇādigaḷumanāhāraṁ
goṇḍu durdharamappa kāyaklēśadoḷ negaḻvinadaṟindaggaḷa tapamāvu
dembuduṁ; subhaumaṁ muguḷnage nakku, nimmaṁ piriyuyaranavajñegeyva
nallenendeṁ, nimmandigarāptāgama padārthatatvaṅgaḷanaṟiyade, mithyā
darśana saṁyama kaṣāya pramādāśubhayōgadiṁ, pr̥thivyaptējō
vāyuvanaspati trasakāyaṅgaḷoḷ, saṁrambha samārambhārambhadoḷaṁ,

kr̥takāritānumōdadoḷaṁ, sāvadyakarmadoḷnaḍeva pāpaṇṣaṇḍigaḷ,
durātma parikalpita matāvaḷambigaḷ muktiyuṁ bayasuvandaṁ, nīroḷ
beṇṇeyunarasuvantanda, pāṣāṇadoḷ ponnanaṟasuvantakkukkuṁmudaṟina
jñānapūrvakaṁ negaḻduḻda ninna kāyaklēśaṁ duḥkhakāraṇamukkumembudu
māmūgoravaṁ, svapakṣānurāgamūḍhatvadiṁ, kamaṭha janmada vairadiṁ,
saṁsāra paribhramaṇaṁ geydu bandu, goravanāgirdudaṟiṁ subhauma
nendaṁ— nīnēgeyveyennanī pārśvakumāraṁ paribhavisidonendu,
kumāranoḷappa hr̥cchalya(śya)diṁ sattu, jyōtirlōkadoḷ, sambara
semnemba dēvanādoṁ; sāganuṁ nāgiṇiyuṁ upaśamabhāvaneyiṁ nāgēṁ
dranuṁ nāgiṇiyumāgi puṭṭi, pārśvanāthaṅge mūvattuvarṣaṁ kumāra
kālaṁ sale, mattondu divasaṁ.

sākētapuramanāḷva vijayasēna mahārājaṁ, bhagaḷi dēśadoḷpu
ṭṭida kuduregaḷverasu pāguḍavuṁvaṁ tanna mantriyayu kayyoḷaṭṭuvuduṁ.
pārśvakumāraṁ banda mantriyaṁyuṁ pūjisi, sākētanagaravibhūtiyaṁ
besagoḷeḷi, sacivaṁ tanna kēḷdandadiṁ, nagaravibhavavarṇanaṅgeyvanalli puṭṭi
dādidēvanādyaprajāpatiyuṁ, munne ṣōḍaśa kāraṇa bhāvanegaḷiṁ
tīrthakara puṇyavuṁ kaṭṭi bandu, muktige sandanembudumamudaṁ kēḷdu,
pārśvakumāranānanda nr̥patiyāda bhavadoḷ tānumāpoliloḷe
bāhyābhyantara(grantha) parityāgaṅgeydu bhāvitādyadr̥ṣṭakāraṇanādudaṟiṁ,
tannimitta vijr̥mbhitābhinibōdhita jñāna prakarṣakṣamōpaśamadiṁ, tanna
pūrvabhava santatiyuṁ nenedu, lōkāntika dēvar pratibōdhise,
pariniḥṣkramaṇa kalyāṇābhiṣēkapūrvakaṁ, sphuṭa hitōpadēśa yuktimamudva
canaṅgaḷiṁ bandu visarjanaṁ geydu, vimaḷeyemba śivigeyoḷavōpa
vāsadinaśvatthavanakke pōgi, maṇiśiḷāgaḷadoḷuttarābhimukhanāgirdu,
puṣya bahuḷēkādaśiyu pūrvāhṇadoḷviśākhā nakṣatradoḷ, mūvadimba
rarasugaḷverasu, siddhanamaskārapūrvakaṁ dīkṣeyuṁ koṇḍu, caturjñāna
dharanāgi(raṁ) pāraṇādinadoḷ, gulmakhēṭa purada, śyāmavarṇanappa dhānya
(dhanada) nembarasana maneyoḷniltu, pañcāścaryaṁ negaṟiḻdi, nālku tiṅgaḷ
chadmasthakālaṁ pōge, dīkṣegoṇḍu banadoḷ, dēvadāra drumamudaḍi
yoḷ, aṣṭōpavāsadiṁ, atyanta śuddhapariṇāmadindēṟuḻudivasaṁ,
pratimāyōgadoḷirpurduduṁ.

jyōtirlōkada dēvaṁ, sambaranambaradoḷpōguttuṁ, tanna
vimānastambhamāpūāge, vibhaṅgajñānadiṁ, pūrvabhava vairiyirdanendaṟidu
(ravaṁ nesedu), muḷidu, mahāghōramappāli maḷeyuṁ māḍe,
dharaṇēndranavadhijñānadinaṟidu bandu, nijaphaṇāmaṇḍapamaṁvuṁ bhaṭṭārakara
mēle maṟivāmāḍe, nāgakanneyuṁ tatphaṇāmaṇḍapada mēge, vajramaya
mappāta patramuṁ piḍiye, sambaraṁ cāḷisalāṟalaṟidire, mahōpasargamuṁ
kṣameyembāyudhadiṁ geldu, caitrabahuḷa caturdaśiyu pūrvāhṇadoḷ,
viśākhānakṣatradoḷ, kēvalajñānōtpattiyāge, dēvēndrakr̥ta tatka
lyāṇanāgirpurduduṁ; sambaranupaśamabhāvaneyiṁ, samyaktvamuṁ kaiko
ḷvudumaṁmudaṁ kaṇḍu, tadvanavāsigaḷappēḻnūḷnūrvartāpasaruṁ mithyādarśanā
saṁyamaṁsaṁyuma kaṣāyāśubhayōgamuṁ pattuviṭṭu, samyagdarśana tattvatvamuṁ
kaikoṇḍaduve mōkṣamārgamendu bhaṭṭārakaraṁ pradakṣiṇaṅgeydu,
saṁyasaṁyumamuṁ kaikoṇḍar.

pārśvabhaṭṭārakaranvartha sahasrāṣṭanāmadharanāgi, svayambhu moda
lāge padimbargaṇadhararuṁ, mūnūṟayvaṟaivadimbapūrvadhararuṁ, sāsira
dombaynūyūrvarśikṣakaruṁ, sāsirada nālnūrvaravadhijñānigaḷuṁ, sāsi
rvarkērkkēvaḷigaḷuṁ, anibare vikriyardhi prāptaruṁ, eḻnūṟayvaṟaivadimba
rvar manaḥparyayajñānigaḷuṁ, aṟunūrvarvāvādigaḷuṁ, sulōcanā
ryikeyurvormodalāge mūvattaṟusāsirvararjiyaruṁ, ondulakke
śrāvakaruṁ, mūṟulakke śrāvakiyaruṁ, asaṅkhyāta dēvaruṁ, dēvi
yaruṁ, saṅkhyāta tiryagjātirygajātigagaḷumberasu, dharmōpadēśaṁ geyyuttu
maṟuvattombhattuvarṣameṇṭutiṅgaḷ vihārisi, sammēda giriyo
ḷondu tiṅgaḷ viharaṇa muḷidu, mūvattaṟuḻivarmunigaḷverasu prati
māyōgadoḷ, śrāvaṇaśuddha sapta(daśa)miyu pūrvarātradoḷ,
viśākhānakṣatradoḷ, pārśva bhaṭṭārakar muktige sandar. saudharmēṁ
dranuṁ parinirvāṇa mahākalyāṇamaṁvuṁ māḍi pōdaṁ.
div.trailer:
idu sakaḷa śāstrasaṁyama sampanna, śrīmadajitasēna bhaṭṭāraka
caraṇakamala cañcarikaṁ dharmavijayi śrīmaccāvuṇḍarāja viracita triṣaṣṭi
lakṣaṇa mahāpurāṇadoḷ pārśvanātha purāṇaṁ.

div.head: vardhamānapurāṇaṁ
ippattunālkaneya tīrthaṅkara
śrī vardhamāna purāṇaṁ
vardhamāna purāṇaṁ
div.p:
arhatśāsanadoḷ, caraṇa, karaṇa, dravya, prathamumabhēdadiṁ nālku
ni(danu)yōgamumakkumalli, caraṇānuyōgamembudu, kaṣāyēndri
yōpasarga, parīṣaha vijayigaḷappa, cāritramunigaḷa sadācāra prakāśanaṁ
geyvudu, karuṇānuyōgamembudu, gaṇita ku(kau)śaḷarirdu lōka,
dvīpa, samudra, parvata(pūrvaka), kṣētra, kāla saṅkhyā parimāṇa prakhyā
panaṅgeyvudu; dravyānuyōgamembudu, nānā dr̥ṣṭivāda nayuya
pramāṇa bhaṅga sūcanadiṁ, svapakṣasthāpanamuṁ, parapakṣadūṣaṇaṅgeyvudu;
prathamānuyōgamembudu, tīrthaṅkara, cakravarti, rāmumakēśavādigaḷa
bhavasantatiyumayumpunavaranubhavisida bhōgaṅgaḷumaṁmuṁ, parigraha parityāgaṁ
gaḷumaṁḷumpuṁ pēḻvuḷvudu; ivaroḷ prathamānuyōga mahārṇavadoḷ,
dharmakathōpadēśanaṅgeyvudu. ā dharmakathege bhāva(na)muydakkuydkkama
mavāvuvendaḍe—
dharmakatheyumuṁ, dharmakathāprayōjanavumuṁ, dharmakathāśrō
tr̥vuṁ, dharmakathāvastuvuṁ, dharmakathā nirvāhamumendavaṟoḷ,
dharmakatheyembācāra, prajñapti dr̥ṣṭivāda(daśa) kuśalamatiyumuṁ, gaṇita,
śabdaśāstranimitta purāṇahētu tarkaviśāradanumuṁ, lōkavēda pāṣaṇḍi
samayu nipuṇanumākṣēpa parihāra samarthanuṁ, sthirāsananumumpratihata
śarīra pañcēndriyanuṁ, priyahita madhurābhidhāriṇi(yi)yumuṁ, para
parivādālasya, bhrūbhaṅga kaṭākṣavikṣēpaṇādi vikāra virahitanumappaṁ;
dharmakathāprayōjanamembudu, paramudarśana vyākuḷitaruṁ, parijñi

nnāpavargamārgarumappa bhavya jīvaṅgaḷge darśanamuṁ dr̥ḍhaṁ māḻpudu,
dr̥ḍhadarśarādavarge(nārādhana)jñāna cāritra prakāśanaṁ geyvudumakku
malladandu, hitaprāptiyumahita parihārōpāyadarśanamuṁ geyvu
dalli hitamembuduṁ; niśrēyasaṁ, ahitamembudu, jāti, jarāmaraṇa,
duḥkhasampātamalli hitamaneyvupāyaṅgaḷumaṁmuṁ tōṟi, mithyā
darśanā pirati pravāmādādigaḷaṁ nirākarisi, ta(nna vidyutpra)trānnivr̥tyupāya
doḷ samyagdarśana, jñāna, cāritraṅgaḷanantu pālisuvudu, dharmakathā
śrōtr̥gaḷembar; rakta, duṣṭa, mūḍha, madhyasthabhēdadiṁ caturvidharappa
ralli raktanemboṁ, dōṣayuktamappa vacanamuṁ nuḍidoḍamudaṁ guṇa
doḷ (dōṣa) pratiṣṭhiṣṭha(sthāpi)suvoṁ; duṣṭanemboṁ, saddharma(śuddha)
nirapēkṣanuṁ, darśanāntarā(vipiptabhōdhiyumāgi) bhitadiṣṭabuddhiyu
māgi guṇasahasramuṁ pattuviṭṭu, pravādamuṁ pāruttirdalpadōṣa
(doḷaṁ)diṁ, kathābhaṅga māḻpoṁḻippoṁ; mūḍhanemboṁ, (tri)guṇa dōṣa
grahaṇadoḷ dūrīkr̥tamatiyāgi, vividha viśada cāṭukāraṁ vacana
vinyāsadiṁ soga(suga)suttoḷḷitoḷḷitendu nuḍivoṁ; madhyasthanemboṁ,
guṇadōṣa vicārasamarthanāgi, guṇabhāva(bhaṅga)doḷ guṇamuṁ
dōṣabhāvadoḷ dōṣamuṁ niyōjisuvoṁ; dharmakathāvastuvembu
dartha katheyenduṁ, kāmakatheyenduṁ, dharmakatheyenduṁ, vyāmiśra
katheyenduṁ caturvidhamakkumavaṟoḷ—

dharmakatheyembudu, dēśakālāpēkṣaṇamuṁ, sāpa(vā)dyōdyupāyu
samudbhūtamuṁ, alabdhalābhādi rājavr̥tta catuṣṭaya(lakṣaṇa)muma
ppudu; kāmakatheyembudu, strī, puruṣa, snigdhanayana, dūtasamprē
ṣaṇa, lalita, hasita manōhara sambhāṣaṇa, parasparabhāva parīkṣaṇa, vijr̥ṁ
bhaṇāliṅgana, vimardanādi gōcaramappudu; dharmakatheyembudu, ākṣē
paṇeyumuṁyuṁ, vikṣēpaṇeyuṁ, saṁvēdaniyuṁ, nirvēdaniyumendu catu
rvidhamakkumavaṟoḷ, āvudondaṟoḷ, jīvādi padārthaṅgaḷanavaṟa
bhā(gaṁ)vaṅgaḷaṁ, yathātma prarūpaṇaṁ geyvudu ākṣēpaṇeyembudu;
nijamata nirūpaṇadoḷ, paramata dūṣaṇaṅgeyvudu meṇbaramatakathana
doḷ, nijamataprakāśanaṁ geyvudu vikṣēpaṇeyembudu; jinadharmaphala
vibhūtiyuṁ pēḻvudu saṁvēdaniyembudu; darpadiṁ, pravādadindāda
pāpaphalamuṁ pēḻvudu nirvēdaniyembudu; vyāmiśrakatheyembudu,

nānāvidha puṇya pāpa phalamuṁ pēḻvudu. intivaṟoḷ, vikṣēpaṇi
yemba katheyuṁ jinaśāsana ṣaḍbhēdamamunaṟiyayudātaṅge pēḻalāgadē
kendoḍe— gr̥hīta tattvatvanappudaṟiṁ, parasamaya vyākuḷīkr̥ta citta
nakkumāge, paramatadūṣaṇa parāṅmukhanāgade tatvamuṁ kaikoḷvanalla
nadaṟiṁ, tatvamanaṟiyudannegaṁ, mithyādarśanamaṁmuṁ pattuviḍanadaṟinā
kṣēpaṇiyuṁ, saṁvēdaniyuṁ, nirvēdaniyumemba mūṟuṁ kathe
yumaṁmuṁ, munnamaṟipi, baṟiyaṁḷiyuṁ gr̥hīta samyagdarśananappaṅge
vikṣēpaṇiyayunaṟipuvuduṁ, dharmakathā nirvāṇamembudu, maṅgaḷādi
nirūpaṇa pūrvakaṁ purāṇaṅgaḷaṁ pēḻvuduṁ, avaroḷ, śrīvardhamāna
bhaṭṭārakara caritamanabhivarṇisuvenadentendoḍe—

jambūdvīpada, pūrvavidēhada, sītānadiya, baḍagaṇa taḍiya,
puṣkaḷāvatīviṣayada, puṇḍarīkiṇi nagarada, madhuka vanadoḷ, purū
ravanemba bēḍanātana peṇḍati kāḷikeyemboḷāge, mattondudivasamā
kānanadoḷ, polegeṭṭu suḷiva sāgarasēnaremba muniyuṁ kaṇḍu
bandisi, dharmamaṁmuṁ kēḻduḷdu, madhu, madya, māṁsa nivr̥ttigeydu, jīvi
tāntyadoḷ, saudharmakalpadoḷ, sāgarōpama sukhamananuṇḍu
bandu, jambūdvīpada, bharatada, kauśaḷaviṣayada, vinītānagarada(ma
nāḷdoṁ), bharata rājaṅgaṁ, anantasēnegaṁ, marīci emba maganāgi,
vr̥ṣabhanāthana parityāga kāladoḷ tānuṁ, sarvasaṅga parityāgaṅgeydu,
kṣutpipāsādi parīṣahaṅgaḷaṁ sairisalāṟade, bhavyanāgiyuṁ, dīrgha
saṁsāriyappudaṟiṁ, parivrājaka dīkṣeyaṁyuṁ kaikoṇḍu, tannanāśrayisi
davargamudanupadēśaṁ geydu, arhatpravacanamaṁmuṁ kēḷdu, saddharmamaṁmuṁ
kaikoḷḷade, purudēvanentu tannindame sarvasaṅga parityāgaṅgeydu,
tribhuvana kṣōbhakāriyappa mahātmyamaneydidosānumante, jagado
ḷenna matamanondaṁ māḍi, mahāprabhāvamaneyduvenemba, mānakaṣā
yōdayadiṁ kumārgamaṁmuṁ pattuviḍade, kamaṇḍaluṁ, tridaṇḍa
hastanuṁ, gairikarasasarakta jīvara paridhānanuṁ, muṇḍita śiraskaranuṁ,
nigōdha sambhava jalasnāna, kandamūlādyupayōga niratanumāgi,
tanna tatvamanaṟi(yu)dudaṁ prakaṭaṁ māḍuttattumindrajāliganante,
tatvābhāsamaṁmuṁ kapiḷādigaḷappa śiṣyavargakkaṟiputtuṁ, jagadoḷ paribhrami
yisi, jīvitāntyadoḷ, brahmakalpadoḷpuṭṭi, daśasāgarōpamāntada

kaḍeyoḷalliṁ bandu, sākētadoḷ, kapilanemba pārvaṅgaṁ, kāmpilyegaṁ,
jaṭiḷanemba maganāgi, parivrājaka tapadoḷnegaḻduldu, saudharmakalpado
ḷpuṭṭi, sāgarōpamāntadoḷalliṁ bandu, bharatada, sthūṇāgāra nagara
doḷ, bhāradvājaṅgaṁ, puṣpadantegaṁ puṣyamitranemba maganāgi, pari
vrājaka vēṣadoḷnaḍedu, saudharmakalpadoḷpuṭṭi, sāgarōpamāntado
ḷalliṁ bandu, bharatada sītikānagaradoḷagnibhūtigaṁ, gautamigaṁ, agni
sahanemba maganāgi, mattaṁ parivrājaka dīkṣeyiṁ, sanatkumārakalpa
doḷsaptasāgarōpamāntadoḷalliṁ bandu, bharatada mandarapurada
gautamaṅgaṁ, kauśikēkegaṁ agnimitranemba sūnuvāgi, parivrājakadīkṣitaṁ,
mahēndrakalpadoḷpuṭṭibandu, mandirapuradoḷ, śāḷaṅkāyanaṅgaṁ,
mandiregaṁ bhāradvājanemba maganāgi, parigr̥hita parivrājakavēṣakaṁ,
mahēndrakalpadoḷpuṭṭi saptasāgarōpamāntadoḷalliṁ bandu,
durmārga pravartanaphaladiṁ narakādigaḷoḷaṁ, trasasthāvaraṅgaḷoḷamasaṁ
khyāta kālaṁ paribhramisi bandu.

jambūdvīpada, rājagr̥hadoḷ, śāṇḍilyadvijaṅgaṁ, pārāśarigaṁ,
sthāvaranemba tanayuyanāgi, mattaṁ parivrājakanāgi, mahēndrakalpado
ḷpuṭṭibandu, bharatada, rājagr̥hamanāḷva, viśvabhūtigaṁ, jainidēvigaṁ
viśvanandiyemba maganāgi puṭṭe, viśvabhūtiya tammanappa viśākhabhūtigaṁ,
lakṣmaṇādēvigaṁ, viśākhanandanemba maganāgi sukhamirdondu divasaṁ,
mugilkaragidudaṁ kaṇḍu, viśvabhūti tanna tammaṅge rājyamaṁ koṭṭu,
magaṅge yuvarājapadamipiyunittu, śrīdharagurugaḷa pakkade munnūrva
rarasugaḷverasu, tapambaḍe, viśākhanandaṁ viśvanandiyayu banamanīvudendu
tammayyanaṁ bēḍe, pusiyune besananaṭṭikoṭṭudanaṟidu, viśvanandi
muniduvare, viśākhanandanōḍi, kapitthadrumamumaṁ maṟigoḷvudumamudaṁ
kiḻtīḍāḍe, kalla kambhamaṁmuṁ maṟigo(ḷva)ṇḍoḍamuduvaṁ(mamudaṁ) kara
prahāradiṁ śatacūrṇaṁ māḍe, mattaṁ beḷkuḷkattōḍuva viśākhanandananaṁ
kaṇḍu, karuṇisi, karedu, rājyamanātaṅge koṭṭu, sambhūta gurugaḷa
pakkade, viśvanandi dīkṣegoṇḍorverme, madhurege(yuṁ) carigevokkalli,
keṅgōkeṅgolmasagidapayunāvipiṟiyu keḍevudanallige, rājyabhraṣṭanāgi pēṟira besa
doḷōliyunaḍakuttuṁ bandu, prāsādaśikhara(saudha)doḷirdu viśākha
dandaṁ kaṇḍu, ninna śilāstambhamaṁmuṁ kīḻvandina darpamīgaḷettavōdu

dendu nage, ninnaṁ kolvinakkendu, nidānaṅgeyu್da, viśvanandi
muniyuṁ, viśākhabhūtiyuṁ mahāśukradoḷpuṭṭi, ṣōḍaśa sāga
rōpamāntadoḷalliṁ bandu----
jambūdvīpada, bharatada, suramyaviṣayada, paudanapuramanāḷva
prajāpati mahārājaṅgaṁ, jayāvatigaṁ, viśākhabhūti vijayanemba maga
nādoṁ; kiṟiyarasi mr̥gayāvatige viśvanandi tripiṣṭhanemba maga
nādoṁ; ā viśākhanandanuṁ saṁsāradoḷ tiridu bandu, vijayārdha
puttaraśrēṇiyoḷaḷakāpuramanāḷva, mayūragrīvaṅgaṁ, nīḷāñjanegaṁ,
aśvagrīvanemba maganāge, dakṣiṇaśrēṇiyaṁ, rathanūpurādhipaṁ, jvaḷana
jaṭigaṁ; divitiḷakamanāḷva candrābhagaṅbhaṅgaṁ, subhadreyemboḷ magaḷappa
vāyuvēgegamarkakīrtiyemba maganuṁ, svayamprabheyumemba maga
ḷāge, tripiṣṭhaṅgaṁ svayamprabhegaṁ vivāhamaṁ māḍi, siṁhavāhini, garuḍa
vāhini vidyegaḷaṁ koṭṭoḍaśvagrīvaṁ kēḷdu muḷidu, rathāvarta giri
yoḷ, caturaṅgabalamanoḍḍi nilvuduṁ; tripiṣṭhanātanoḷmāyāyuddha
dvandvayuddhadoḷ kādi gele, cakradoḷiḍuvuduṁ; tripiṣṭhanācakradoḷaśva
grīvanaṁ kondu, trikhaṇḍapatiyāgi, jīvitāntyadoḷ saptamapr̥thvige
pōgisandu, mūvattuttamūṟu sāgarōpamāntadoḷalliṁ bandu, jambū
dvīpada, siddhakūṭada, pūrvabhāgada, himagiri sānuvinoḷ mr̥gapati
yāgi puṭṭi, mattondu mr̥gamaṁ pāydu piḍidu timbāgaḷajitañjaya
rumamita guṇarumemba cāraṇarumāprastāvadoḷ kaṇḍā siṅgada pūrva
bhavasambandhamumaṁ, bhāvītīrthakaratvamanaṟideyduvandele, mr̥gēndra
nīṁ, tripiṣṭhanāda bhavadoḷ, parārdhya pañcavarṇa mr̥duśayana taḷa
doḷ, manōvallabheyaroḍane, mahāviḷāsadiṁ pavaḍisiyuṁ, tikta,
kaṭuka, kaṣāyāmbla lavaṇa madhurarasamanōhara divyāhāramanārō
gisiyuṁ, ati surabhi mālya dhūpānulēpādigaḷanāghrayisiyuṁ,
śr̥ṅgārādi navarasa vicitracitrakarakarmanāṭakādigaḷaṁ nirīkṣisiyuṁ,
ṣaḍja, vr̥ṣabha, gāndhāra, madhyama, pañcama, dhaivata, niṣādaṅgaḷemba
saptasvaraṅgaḷoḷ śravaṇa ramaṇīyamāge, pāḍuva divyagēyamanālisi
yumintu pañcēndriya sukhamananubhavisi taṇi(yu)diṣṭāniṣṭavastu
gōcara pravr̥ddharāgadvēṣa mōhacaurya prāṇihiṁsana paradāragamanā
digaḷoḷ meyviṭṭu negaḻduṟdu narakadoḷpuṭṭi, mahātyagrasītōṣṇa
bādheyoḷumācāmblati pādya(pāṣājya)sura vikriyā samudbhūta bhīma

vaitaraṇī pravēśadoḷaṁ, visphuliṅga parvatārōhaṇadoḷaṁ vāḷukā
dhūma jvalita jita kārpaṇadoḷaṁ, taptāyuyata(sa) putrikāklēśadoḷamumasī
patravananikr̥ttanadoḷaṁ, nānāvidha vr̥kṣa, mr̥ga, vihaga, kr̥ṣṇa kukkurā
dyugranigrahadoḷaṁ, parasparābhighātatāḍana (tarjana) rajjubandhanaśiraḥ
karōṣṭaṣṭhanāsikacchēdanadoḷaṁ, śūlārōhaṇadoḷaṁ, odavida mahā
duḥkhamananubhavisuttaṁttuṁ, krandana rōdana viḷāpanādi pariṇatiyindaṁ,
jīvitāntyadoḷalliṁ bandu, tiryaggāryuggga(gga)tigaḷoḷ puṭṭi, vātātapa
varṣa śītādibādheyoḷaṁ, kṣutpipāsā parīṣahadoḷaṁ muḷu(mumaru)
guttirdu, mattaṁ, prāṇihiṁsaṁ geydu, māṁsāhāradiṁ pāpamuṁmaṁ
nerapi, narakamuṁmaṁ bokku, duḥkhamananubhavisalvēḍa, nīnantappoḍu
jñānamuṁmaṁ pattuviṭṭu, dharmatatvadoḷ negaḻvuṟvudene, munivacanamana
vadhārisi, jātismaranuṁ, saṁsāraduḥkha bhayacakita hr̥dayamunumāgi,
samyaktvamuṁmaṁ negape, mr̥garājanupaśama bhāvaneyoḷirdudardanaṟidu, kaṇṇa
nīrgaḷaṁ kaikoḷvendu niścayisi, munipatigaḷ mattamintendar----

munnaṁ, nīṁ marīciyāgi sanmārgadūṣaṇamumaṁ, kumārga
prakaṭanamuṁ geydu, mithyātvavr̥ddhiyaṁ māḍida phaladiṁ, narakaṅga
ḷoḷ mahā duḥkhamananubhavisi, prasasthāvaraṅgaḷoḷamasaṅkhyāta
kālaṁ, tiṭṭane tiridu bandu, viśvanandiyāda bhavadoḷ, saṁyamamaṁ
kaikoṇḍu, ninna tapavemmembamr̥tamaṁ nidānavemmemba viṣadūṣitaṁ māḍi,
kiḍisi nīṁ narakaṁ bokkubandu, mr̥gapatiyāgi puṭṭideyudaṟiṁ,
saṁsāra kāraṇamappa mithyādarśanamanindu modalāge pattuviḍuvudumā
ptāgama padārthaśraddhānasahitamabhyudaya niśrēyasa nimittamaṁ samya
ktvamaṁ kaikoḷvededane, munipatiyuṅyugaḷamaṁ mūṟusūḻbilavandu,
meyyniymanikki poḍevaṭṭu, samyaktvamumaṁ, śrāvakabratamumaṁ
kaikoṇḍu, kālāntyadoḷ sanyāsanavidhiyiṁ saudharmakalpadoḷ
siṁhakētuvembadēvanāgirderaḍu sāgarōpamada kaḍeyoḷ alliṁ
bandu, dhātakīṣaṇḍada, mūḍaṇamandarada, pūrvavidēhada, maṅgaḷā
vatīviṣayada, vijayārdhaduttaraśrēṇiyaṁyu, kanakaprabha nagaramanāḷva,
kanakapuṅkhanemba nr̥patigaṁ, kanakamālilegaṁ, kanakōjvalanemba maganāgi,
kanakavatiyemba manōvallabheverasu, mandaragirige krīḍārthadiṁ pōgi,
priyamitraremba cāraṇaravadhijñānigaḷaṁ kaṇḍu, balagoṇḍu bandisi,
dharmamaṁ kēḷdu, nirvēgadiṁ sarvasaṅga parityāgaṅgeydu, jīvitāntya

doḷsaptamakalpadoḷpuṭṭi, padimūṟu sāgarōpamāntadoḷalliṁ
bandu, jambūdvīpada, kauśaḷaviṣayuyada, sākētapuramanāḷva, vajraṣēṇa
nr̥patigaṁ, śīlavatigaṁ, hariṣēṇanemba maganāgi, śr̥tasāgara muniyara
samīpadoḷ dīkṣegoṇḍu, kālāntyadoḷ mahāśukrakalpadoḷpuṭṭi, ṣōḍaśa
sāgarōpamāntadoḷalliṁ bandu, dhātakīṣaṇḍada, mūḍaṇa mandarada,
pūrvavidēhada, puṣkaḷāvatī viṣayuyada, puṇḍarīkiṇiyanāḷva, sumitra
narapatigaṁ, subratādēvigaṁ, priyamitranemba maganāgi, cakravarti
śrīyayuneydi, kṣēmaṅkarajinara samīpadoḷ dharmamaṁ kēḷdu, sumitra
nemba magaṅge rājyamaṁ koṭṭu, sāsirvararasugaḷverasu saṁyutanāgi,
jīvitāntyadoḷ, sanyāsanavidhiyiṁ, sahasrāra kalpadoḷ, sūrya
prabhanemba dēvanāgi, (caturdaśa) aṣṭādaśa sāgarōpamāntadoḷalliṁ
bandu,

jambūdvīpada, chatrakāpuramanāḷva, nandivardhananr̥patigaṁ, vīra
vatigaṁ, nandanemba maganāgi prōṣṭhiḷa gurugaḷa pakkade dharmamaṁ
kēḷdu, nirvēgadiṁ saṁyamamaṁ kaikoṇḍu, ēkādaśāṅgadharaṁ, bhāvi
tadvaidvyaṣṭakāraṇaṁ(diṁ), baddha tīrtharthaṅkara mahāpuṇya(muṁmaṁ), jīvitāntya
doḷcaturvidhārādhanāpūrvakamamucyutakalpada,puṣpōttara vimānadoḷ
dēvanāgi, dvāviṁśati sāgarōpamāyuṣyanuṁ, triratnipramāṇōtsē
dhanuṁ, śuklalēśyā pariṇāmanumēkādaśamāsa niśvāsanuṁ, dvāviṁśati
sahasravarṣamānasāmr̥tāhāranuṁ, manaḥpravicāra sukhanuṁ, ṣaṣṭhama
pr̥thvigatāvadhijñānanumātmāvadhi kṣētrapramāṇa baḷaprakāśa vikriyā
samarthanuṁ, sāmānikādi navavidha(su)dēva, vividha dēvi sahasra pari
vr̥tanumāgi, divyasukhamananubhavisuttirpinaṁ.

itta, jambūdvīpada, bharatada, vidēha viṣayuyada, kuṇḍaḷapurama
nāḷva, siddhārthamahārājana priyakāriṇiṇīdēviya maneyoḷ, munnaṟuṟi
diṅgaḷuṇṭene, mūṟu kōṭiyumare vasudhāreyuyanindranājñeyiṁ
dhanadaṁ suriye, priyakāriṇiṇīdēviyurāṣāḍhaśuddha ṣaṣṭhiyoḷuttarāṣāḍha
nakṣatradoḷ, saptataḷa prāsādada nandyāvarta garbhagr̥hada ratnaparyaṅka
doḷ pavaḍisi, raudra, rākṣasa, gāndharvamemba mūṟuñjāvamuṁ
pōge, manōharamemba beḷagappa jāvadoḷ, ṣōḍaśa śubhasvapnadarśanā
nantaraṁ, nijamukhāravinda pravēśi gajarūpupamaṁ kaṇḍu, maṅgaḷapāṭhaka
dhvanigaḷineccattabhiṣēka puṇyaprasādhana maṅgaḷa darpaṇāvaḷōkana vidhigaḷaṁ

tīrtherce, siddhārthamahārājanallige pōgi, sādara(pāda)pramāṇapūrvaka
mardhāsanadoḷ kuḷḷirdu, tanna kaṇḍa kanasugaḷanaṟipe, tatphalamanarasa
naṟipe, sukhamirpinaṁ. svargāvataraṇa kalyāṇapūrvakaṁ, puṣpōttara
vimānada dēvanādēviyu garbhakkavatarisi, pārśvabhaṭṭārakara tīrthasaṁ
tānaminnūṟayvattuvarṣaṁ pōdoḍākāladoḷ, caitraśuddha trayō
daśiyoḷuttarāphālguṇiyoḷ, śaśāṅkayōgadoḷ, trijñānadharaṁ
puṭṭe, saudharmēndraṁ pulōma kanyāsahitaṁ bandu, mahāvibhū
tiyiṁ kumāranaṁ mandaragirigoydu, pāṇḍukavanada pūrvōttara
digbhāgada, pāṇḍuka śiḷātaḷada pōpogaṇa siṁhāsanadoḷirisi, dugdhābdhi
jaḷadiṁ, janmābhiṣēka kalyāṇamaṁ māḍe, kumārananāsāpuṭadoḷ,
jaḷakaṇaṅgaḷ puge, mūgi(ni)ṟivudumavara samiti taṟigelegaḷante
pāṟiṟa mahāścaryadinabhiṣēkānantaraṁ, vīranāthanendu pesaraniṭṭu,
mātāpitr̥gaḷge koṭṭu, saudharmēndraṁ pōdaṁ.

itta, kiñcidūnadvāsaptativarṣa paramāyuṣyanuṁ, saptaratni
pramāṇōtsēdhanuṁ, suvarṇavarṇanuṁ, daśavidhanisvēdatvādi svābhāvika
guṇasamanvitanumenisi, kumāra janmadinadoḷ tamage sañjayuya vijayuya
remba cāraṇar, padārthaṅgaḷoḷ tamage sandēhavāmāge bandu, tīrtha
kara kumāranaṁ kāṇaloḍaṁ, nissandēhavāmāge, tamage sanmati hētuvā
dudaṟiṁ sanmatiyemba pesaraniṭṭu, pōparitta mattondu divasamindrana
sabheyoḷ, paramuma vīrasvāmigaḷa(yi)ndaggaḷaṁ śūrarillendu nuḍiye,
saṅgamanemba dēvaṁ parīkṣisalendu bandudyānavanadoḷ, samāna
vayaskaruṁ, caḷāḷaka pakṣadhararumappa rājakumāraroḍane, tarukrīḍā
parāyaṇanāgirda kumāranaṁ kaṇḍañjisalendu, marada modalintaguḻduṟdu
tudivaraṁ parbi mahānāgarūpadoḷire, tatkṣaṇāmaṇḍapamanāśrayi
(mi)si, vigatabhayanāgi, mattaṁ krīḍisuttirda kumāranaṁ kaṇḍatiprīta
nāgi, mahāvīranendu pesaraniṭṭu saṅgamaṁ pōdaṁ.

ittaṁ, mūvattu varṣaṁ kumārakālaṁ pōge mattondu divasa
mābhinibōdhika jñāna prakr̥ṣṭakṣayōpaśama vijr̥mbhita bōdhanātma bhava
sambhandhamaṁ nenedu, lōkāntikadēvar pratibōdhise, saudharmakr̥ta
pariniṣkramaṇa kalyāṇābhiṣēkaṁ bandhuvisarjanaṁ geydu, campracandraprabha
vemba śivigeyoḷanēka taru, kusuma, kisalaya, pallavāṅkura, rasā

svāda matta madhukara, kōkiḷa, śukakuḷa sanāthamappa ṣaṇḍavanakke
ṣaṣṭhōpavāsadiṁ pōgi, maṇiśilātaḷadoḷuttarābhimukhadoḷ(nāgi)rdu,
mārgaśira bahuḷa daśamiyaparāhṇadoḷuttarāphālguṇiṇa nakṣatradoḷkkaḷka
pūrvara kāladoḷ, siddhanamaskārapūrvakaṁ, pañcamuṣṭiyiṁ taleyuṁ
paṟiye, pañcamāmbudhiyoḷaḷikuḷa nīḷakuntaḷaṅgaḷaṁ ratnada paḍalige
yoḷkoṇḍoydu, saudharmēndranikki bandanitta, sāmāyika śuddha
saṁyamadhāraṇadindaṁ, caturjñānadharanāgi, pāraṇādinadoḷ, kūla
grāmadoḷ, priyaṅgukusumavarṇanappa kūlanembarasana maneyo
ḷklalttaḷniltavasu, vasudhāreyuṁ, dēvadundubhiyuṁ, puṣpavr̥ṣṭiyuṁ, mandā
niḷanuṁ, divija praśaṁsāravamumbemba pañcāścaryaṁ negaḻdu, chaḻabhaṭṭā
rakarujjijje niḷatimuktaka smaśānadoḷ rātri pratimāyōgadoḷirpurpudu
mīśvaraṁ gauriverasu bandu dhairyamaṁ parīkṣegeyyalendu, kriye
yiṁyisā tāmbra taraḷalōcananumativikaṭabhīṣaṇa bhrūbhaṅganuṁ, pādanyāsa
prakampita mahītaḷanumāgi, bētāḷa rūpaṅgaḷmanaḷāniḷa phaṇīndra,
gajēndra, siṁharūpaṅgaḷuṁmuṁḷumaṁ, kirātasainyamuṁ vidyāprabhāvadiṁ vigu
rvisi, masagi bandu, kahakahāṭṭhāṭṭahāsaṁ geydu, vividhōpasargadi
nentuṁ cāḷi(caḷiyiyu)salāṟadiredapati(dire) (mahati) mahāvīranendu pesara
niṭṭu poḍavaṭṭu pōdaṁ.

ittalondu divasaṁ, jēṭaka mahārājananandane candaneyemboḷa
nōrvaṁ vidyādharaṁ bardhu janadiṁ bañjisikoṇḍoydu, tanna peṇḍati
gañji, tandataṇḍa candaneyunaḍaviyoḷ bisuṭu pōpradumorvaṁ vanēcaraṁ
kaṇḍu, piḍitandu, vr̥ṣabhasēnanemba paradaṅge dhanalābhadiṁ koṭṭoḍā
paradana peṇḍati subhadreyemboḷākegātanettānumaḷiprupugumemba
śaṅkeyiṁ, navanāḷa sammiśramappa kōdravāhāramaṁ śarāva pātradoḷikki
kuḍe, saṅkaleyoḷbameḷpeyuttirpinavondu divasaṁ, vatsapiviṣayuyada,
