kauśambīnagaramaṁ camañjarigevopokku mahāvīrabhaṭṭārakaranāsādaradiṁ niṟi(diṁnīṟ(li)
salendidiraṁ naḍevāḷtanage tāne saṅkale paṟipudu pōge, parārdhyavastrā
bharaṇa vibhūṣiteyuṁ, aḷikuḷavinīḷa śithiḷa kēśabhāra vigaḷita navasurabhi
kusumavāḷaṅmāḷālaṅkr̥teyumāge, tadīya śīla mahātmyadinā śarāva
pātrame suvaveṁsurṇa pātramāgeyuṁ, kōdravāhārame śāḷitaṇḍuḷāhāra
māgeyuṁ, vidhipūrvakaṁ nilise, pañcāścaryamāge, candaneyu vr̥tta

kamanaṟidu seṭṭimannisupuvuduṁ; ākeyuya bandhugaḷu bandoyye
pōdaḷ.

itta vardhamāna bhaṭṭārakar dvādaśavarṣa chadmasthakālaṁ pōge,
jr̥mbhaka grāmada samīpada, r̥jugatiyemba toṟeyataḍiya, manō
harōdyānada viśāḷa śilāpaṭṭakadoḷātāpayōgadoḷu ṣaṣṭhōpavā
sadiṁ, śāladrumadaḍiyoḷire, vaiśākhaśuddha daśamiyu parāhṇadoḷ, candra
hastōttara madhyamāśritanāge, kēvala jñānōtpattiyāgirpuduṁ,
tatkalyāṇa pūjāpūrvakaṁ, akaṣāyuyaprāpti vākṣūjātiśayabhāgiyuṁ,
paramātmōpalakṣaṇōpētanu māgirpinaṁ; dēvarāja nāgamōpadēśa
hētubhūtanappananavadhividhiyunaṟidu, gautama grāmada gautamagōtra
doḷādityavimānadiṁ bandu indrabhūtiyemba pesaroḷabhimānadhanaṁ,
(raṁ) brāhmaṇanāgirdoḍātananupāyuyadoḷ, bhaṭṭārakara samīpakke tare
jīvādi padārtha tatvattvamuṁ sāmānya viśēṣa nibandhana dravyārthika, paryā
yārthika, nayaprarūpaṇadinaṟipe, pañcaśata brāhmaṇasūnugaḷ sahita
mindrabhūti saṁyamamuṁmaṁ kaikoṇḍu, r̥ddhikriyādyaṣṭavidhavr̥ddhi sampa
nnanāgi, śrāvaṇa māsada bahuḷa pāḍivada pūrvāhṇadoḷ caturdaśa
pūrvadarthapadaṅgaḷuṁḷumaṁ kēḷdu, samasta dvādaśāṅga caturdaśa
pūrvārtha tatvattvavēdiyāgi, pūrvarātradoḷaṅgaṅgaḷge, paścima rātra
doḷpūrvaṅgaḷge vacana racaneyuṁ māḍi, prathama gaṇadhararāgirdara
llimbaṟiyuṁ.

vāyubhūtiyuṁ, agnibhūtiyuṁ, sudharmaruṁ māryaruṁ,
mandaruṁ, putraruṁ, maitrītriyaruṁ, akampanaruṁ, acēlakaruṁ,
prabhāsanarumembapadimbargaṇadhararāge, śrīvardhamāna bhaṭṭārakara tamma
gautamarmorvodalāge pannorvargaṇadhararuṁ, mūnnūrvarpūrvadhararuṁ,
ombaynāsiradombaynūynūrvarśikṣakaruṁ, sāsirada mūnnūrvaravadhi
jñānigaḷuṁ, ēḻuṟu nūrvarkēvaḷigaḷuṁ, ombaynūrvarvikriyuyardhi
prāptaruṁ, āynūrvarmanaḥ paryaya jñānigaḷuṁ, nālnūrvarvādi
gaḷuṁ, candanārykeyurmoryikeyarvodalāge mūvattaḻuṟu sāsirvarrarjiyaruṁ,
ondu lakṣa śrāvakaruṁ, mūṟulakke śrāvakiyaruṁ, asaṅkhyāta
dēvaruṁ, dēviyaruṁ, saṅkhyātatirygāryagjā tigaḷuṁ, intu dvādaśagaṇaṁ
berasu, vardhamāna bhaṭṭārakar siṁhāsana madhyagatanāgi, ṣaḍdravya, nava

ṣapadārtha, saṁsāra mōkṣa hētu phala prapañca nayapramāṇa nikṣēpādigaḷa
nardharthamāgadha bhāṣeyiṁ besase kēḷdu, kelambarsamyaktvamuṁrsaṁyamamaṁ
kaikoṇḍar, antu, vardhamānādyanvartha sahasrāṣṭa nāmadharaṁ,
dharmōpadēśaṁ geyvutuṁ, kramadiṁ rājagr̥hamaneydi, vipuḷagiri
yoḷirpuduṁ.

śrēṇika mahārājaṁ caturaṅga balasahitanumaṣṭa sahasra makuṭa
baddha vaparivr̥tanumāgi bandu, dēvaraṁ pradakṣiṇaṅgeydu, gandhamālyādi
gaḷinarccircisi, dharma śravaṇānantaraṁ, tanna pūrvabhava sambandhamaṁ
besagoḷe, gautamasvāmigaḷintendu besasidar nīnībhavakke mūṟa
neya bhavadoḷ, jambū dvīpada, vindhyapumaḷayuyada, kuṭajavanadoḷ,
khadirasāgaranemba kirātamukhyanondu divasaṁ, samādhiguptaremba
muniyuyaraṁ kaṇḍu poḍevaḍe, dharmalābhamakkendu parase, dharma
membudēnadaṟinappa lābhavembudēnene, madhu, madya, māṁsādi
nivr̥tti dharmavemmembudadaṁ paḍevudu lābhavemmembudadaṟoḷ svargādi
sukhamaṁ paḍeyalakkumene, kirātananitumaṁ pattuviḍalārenembuduṁ,
munipatigaḷātana cittavr̥ttiyanaṟidu, nī munne kākamāṁsa bhakṣaṇaṁ
geyduydaṟiveyoyaṟiyōyembuduṁ, aṟiyenene, nīnantappo
ḍābratamaṁ kaikoḷḷene, kaikoṇḍirpinaṁ; kelavu divasadiṁ, vyādhi
puṭṭe, vaidyaridakke kākamāṁsa bhakṣaṇaṅgeyvudene, kaṇṭhagata prāṇanāgi
yuṁmudaṁ neyumadaṁnē(ne)(yu)galide, munnaṁ r̥ṣiyuyaralli koṇḍa bratamane,
bagedolladildirpinamavudanūḍalendātana maydunanaṁnaṁ sārasapuramamunāḷva
sūravīranembombaruttaṁ, vanagahanada vaṭavr̥kṣadaḍiyoḷaḷutirdo
rvaḷ strīyaṁyuṁ kaṇḍu, nīnārgēkattapeyendoḍāṁ yakṣiyaṁyeṁ, vyādhi
pīḍitanappa ninna vaimaidunaṁ khadirasāgaraṁ kākamāṁsa bhakṣaṇaviramumaṇabratada
phaladinenagadhipatiyādapponātanaṁ nīṁ pōgi, kākamāṁsamunūḍenāra
kanappantu māḍidappeyuyadaṟinattapenembudaṁ, adaṁ mādampāṟpenallendu
pōgi, tanna maydunanaṁ kaṇḍu, ninna vyādhige kākamāṁsamuṁ
(koḷalvēḷa) uṇalvēḷku, mene, ninnindaggaḷaṁ prāṇasamāna mitrarillada
ṟindenage nīṁ hitamappudane pēḻvadēnintu narakagati prāpaṇa hētu
vappudaṁ pēḻalāgadindē(te) sāvoḍaṁ sāvenenna kaikoṇḍa vratamuṁ
bisuḍpiḍvinallenendoḍātanabhiprāyamanaṟidu, tanage yakṣipēḻdudeḻdellamaṁ

nātaṅgaṟipidoḍadanavadhārisi, mattamahiṁsādiśrāvakabrataṅgaḷellamuṁmaṁ
kaikoṇḍu, jīvitāntyadoḷuṁḷaṁ, saudharmakalpadoḷ dēvanāgi puṭṭe,
sūravīraṁ nijanivāsakke pōguttuṁttaṁ yakṣiṇiyaṁ kaṇḍenna maydunaṁ
ninage patiyādapane, (nīṁ) pēḻipemḻembuduvātanahiṁsādi bratamuṁmaṁ
kaikoṇḍu vyantara gatiyoḷpuṭṭade, saudharma kalpadoḷpuṭṭi, divya
bhōgamumananubhavisidappa nenage patiyāda nillene, yakṣiṇiyu māvātaṁ
niścayisi vrataprabhāvakkāścaryambaṭṭu, samādhigupta muniyuyarapakkade
śrāvaka brataṅgaḷaṁ kaikoṇḍaṁ.

ā khadirasāgaranumenumperaḍu sāgarōpamāntadoḷalliṁ bandu,
kuṇika narapatigaṁ, śrīmati dēvigaṁ, śrēṇikanemba maganāgire, kuṇika
nondu divasamennamakkaḷoḷāvaṁ rājyārha nakkumendu naimittikanaṁ
besagoḷe, ninna makkaḷgaṇaṟalikkuvalli paramānnavanāpavanōrvaṁ kiḍalīya
duṇḍanātanē rājyārhanakku pondipu pomodalāgi pēḻipupra nimittaṅgaḷaṁ
nōḍi pēḻi niḻninnananitaṟoḷ parīkṣisi, ninage kūrtu, dāyigaradese
yoḷappapāyakke pumusimuḷisina nenēvadiṁ, ninnaṁ muḷisiṁ naḍeyene
dēśāntarakke kaḷipuvudu (pōge) marasanaṭṭida gūḍha praṇidigaḷa matadiṁ,
nandi grāmada janaṅgaḷ mannisade kaḷeye, nīnōrvaṁ brāhmaṇa
noḍane baṭṭevarutuṁ, dēvarājāri pāṣaṇḍalōhapratividāyigaḷappa
kathegaḷaṁ pēḻi, pāḻpārvaṁ tanna maneguydu, ninna vāgmitvamaṁ, kavitādi
gaḷaṁ mecci, ninage tanna magaḷaṁ kuḍuvudumitta. kuṇika mahārājaṁ
rājyamaṁ pattuviḍal bageduṁdu, ninnambarisi rājyamanīye, nandigrāmamu
doḷappa ninna muḷisaṁsuṁ peṟiṟaraṟiyudantadanupāyuyadiṁ nigrahaṅgeyyal
bagedu, nirvahisalaṟiyumappa besaṅgaḷaṁ pēḻdiṭṭuvuduṁ, ninagaṁ
brāhmaṇana kanyakigaṁ puṭṭida abhayakumāraṁ ninna bandu kaṇḍu, nandi
grāmadoḷappa cittakāluṣyamanupāya kauśaḷadiṁ prasamise, dvauhr̥dayuya
tiśumāyādi nibandhanaṅgaḷanabhayakumāra prakr̥taṅgaḷāgirpinaṁ,
nayuvāda kuśala matigaḷa abhaya paṇḍitanendu pesaraniḍe, nīnuṁ ninna
maganumillige bandirembuduṁ, adanavadhārisi mahāvratakkamaṇubratakka
menage ma:namparalbāradānē sanabhavyanō, bhavyanō besasimene, nīnā
sannabhavyaneyādoḍaṁ—bahvārambha parigrahādi bhōgāsaktiyiṁ, baddha
narakāyuṣyanādeyudaṟiṁ, ninage brataṅgoḷva bageyilla, samyagda
rśanavaṁmaṁ kaikoḷvuduṁ.

ā samyaktvamuṁ, ājñāruciyuṁ, mārgaruciyuṁ, upadēśa
ruciyuṁ, sūtraruciyuṁ, bījaruciyuṁ, saṅkṣēparuciyuṁ,
vistararuciyuṁ, artharuciyuṁ avagāḍharuciyuṁ, paramāvagāḍha
ruciyuṁ ponyumpendu daśavidhamakkukkuṁmavaṟoṟiyoḷājñāruciyembudu, sarva
jñanāsājñeyiṁ jīvādi padārthaṅgaḷoḷappa śraddhānaṁ; mārgaruci
yembudu, bāhyābhyantara parigraha parityāga lakṣaṇamappa mōkṣa
mārga śravaṇānantara samutpanna śraddhānaṁ, upadēśaruciyembudu,
tīrtha(ṁ)kara cakra(haḷa)dharādhi kāraṇa puruṣara śubhacaritōpadēśa
janita śraddhānaṁ; sūtraruciyembudu, tapōvikalpakramumani(pra)rūpa
ṇamappācāra śāstramātra śravaṇa janita śraddhānaṁ; bījaruciyembudu,
bījapada grahaṇa pūrvakamappa sūkṣmārthatattvaśraddhānaṁ; saṅkṣēparuci
yembudu, jīvādi padārtha saṅkṣēpa sambōdhanadoḷappa śraddhānaṁ;
vistārastraruciyembudu, dvādaśāṅga caturdaśa pūrvacadhara jīvādi vastu
gaḷoḷ nayapramāṇa nayanirūpaṇōpalabdhi śraddhānaṁ; artharuci
yembudu, vacanavistasttara parāṅmukhatvadinupadēśakar pēḻdaḷdarthasa (ttvata)tva
doḷappa śraddhānaṁ; avagāḍha ruciyembudu, ācārādi dr̥ṣṭivādānta
(dakara) dvādaśāṅga sāmāyikādyaṅga bāhya vividha śrutasamudrāva
gāhana samupajāta tattvaśraddhānaṁ; paramāvagāḍharuciyembudu, para
māvadhi kēvala jñāna prakāśita jīvādi padārtha viṣayātma prasāda
śraddhānaṁ endīvikalpamanaṟipe, mattamāptāgama padārthaṅgaḷanājñe
yinadhigamadinoḷpokku kaikoḷvudu samyaktvaṁ. niśyaṅkādyaṣṭa guṇa
viśiṣṭa(na)muṁ, śaṅkeyuṁ, kāṅkṣeyuṁ, vicikitseyuṁ, anyadr̥ṣṭi
praśaṁsanamuṁ, parapāṣaṇḍi kīrtanamuṁ, anāyatana sēveyuṁ,
avatsalatvamuṁ, aprabhāvanamumemnumumbembaṣṭa vidhadōṣa vivarjanamuṁ,
prasama, saṁvēga, anukampa, āstikyalakṣaṇamumuṁmabhyudaya niśrēyasa
sukhaprakarṣasādhanamumuṁmappudu samyaktvaṁktvaṁnīṁmunnaśāntipurāṇadoḷsavistarampēḷdadarśanaviśuddhyādiṣōḍaśabhāvanegaḷimbyastamuṁsamastamuṅkāraṇamuṁmappavambhāvisitīrthakarapuṇyamaṅkaṭṭiprathamanarakadoḷpuṭṭisaṅkhyēyavarṣadinallimbandutsarpiṇīkāladoḷībharatakṣētradoḷmahāpadmanembaprathamatīrthakaranappeyembuduṁśrēṇikamahārājaṁmunipati.

nīṁ munna śāntipurāṇadoḷ savistaraṁ pēḻda darśana viśuddhyādi
ṣōḍaśa bhāvanegaḷiṁ, byastamuṁ, samastamuṁ, kāraṇamumappavaṁ
bhāvisi, tīrthakara puṇyamaṁ kaṭṭi, prathama narakadoḷpuṭṭi, saṅkhyēya
varṣadinalliṁ bandutsarpiṇī kāladoḷībharata kṣētradoḷmahā padmanemba
prathama tīrthakaranappeyembuduṁ. śrēṇika mahārājaṁ, munipati

vacanadiṁ, samupalabdhōtkr̥ṣṭa śubha pariṇāmanuṁ, parigr̥hīta kāla
karaṇōpa samōpayōga bhāvalabdhiyuyuṁmupaśama samyaktva bhāgānta
rmuhūmurhūrtadinda vēdhaka samyagdr̥ṣṭiyuṁ māgi, baḷiyayumantarmu
hūrtakāladinadhaḥpravr̥ttikaraṇaṁ, apūrvakaraṇaṁ, anivr̥ttikaraṇaṅgaḷi
nantānubandhigaḷaṁ visaṁyōjisi, mattaṁ antarmuhūmurhūrtamaṁmuṁ viśra
misi, adhaḥpravr̥ttakaraṇā pūrvakaraṇaṅgaḷoḷe, anivr̥ttikaraṇa bahu
bhāgaṁ pōge, ēkabhāga muṇṭene, darśana mōhanīya mithyātvamumaṁmuṁ
samyagmithyātvamumaṁmuṁmuṁ samyaktvamumaṁmuṁmuṁ, prakr̥tiyumaṁyuṁmuṁ kṣapiyisi,
intu, saptaprakr̥tigaḷaṅkiḍisi, kṣāyika samyagdr̥ṣṭiyāgi, caramamusukha
kāraṇamappa samyagdarśana jñānalābhadināgaḍe muktanādarante
santōṣaṁ baṭṭu, mattamī puṇyakṣētradoḷānallade peṟaruṁ narakagama
nābhimukharuḷḷoḍe besasimene bhaṭṭārakarintendu besasidar.rkāḷasaukarikanembapārvanundvijapeṇḍati(tanūjā)yappaśubheyuṁnarakapravēśābhimukharāgirdaradentendoḍe—kāḷasaukarikanembanīpoliloḷubandubhavasthitinimittamēṟisūlvaregaṁnīcakuladoḷpuṭṭijātismaranāgipuṇyapāpaphalamuṇṭappoḍepeṟagaṇabhavadoḷānēgeydenāgibandillimanuṣyajanmampaḍedenendudēhigaḷapūrvārjitapuṇyapāpaphalasambandhavaṁnirākarisimr̥ṣāstēyaprāṇivadhamāṁsāhārabahvārambhaparigrahādikarmuniragibaddhanarakāyuṣyanavadhisthānakkesallalirdanātanapeṇḍatisubheyuṅkāripāgninirviśēṣakāvagebhilāṣapravr̥ddharāgadvēṣamōhapaiśūnyaṅgaḷaṁneṟadur̥ṣiyarkaḷaguṇaśīlācāraṅgaḷaṅkēḷvāgaḷumuvaraṅkāṇbāgaḷuṁsaṅklēśadimbaddhanarakāyuṣyeyāgipaṣmamapr̥thvigepōgaḷirdaḷembuduṁadaṅkēḷdabhayakumārantannabhavāntaramumbesagoḷenīnībhavakkemūṟaneyabhavadoḷjambūdvīpadabharatadoḷōrvambrāhmaṇandaivatīrthapāṣaṇḍijātilōkamūḍhavyākuḷīkr̥tamatiyuntatpraśaṁsanatadācaraṇapariṇatanumenisivēdādhyayananimittandēśāntarakkepōguttuṁōrvaṁārhatanaṅkaṇḍātanuntānumbarevarebaṭṭeyoḷondukallapuñjakeladoḷirdatāriyumaranaṅkaṇḍumuguḷnagenakkuapamānaṅgeyvabageyiṁāmaranakiṟugombaṁmuṟidutannakāladhūḷiyuntoḍedukaḷeduninna

vacanadiṁsamupalabdhōtkr̥ṣṭaśubhapariṇāmanumparigr̥hītakālakaraṇōpasamōpayōgabhāvalabdhiyuṁmupaśamasamyaktvabhāgāntamurhūrtadindavēdhakasamyagdr̥ṣṭiyuṁmāgibaḷiyumantamurhūrtakāladinadhaḥpravr̥ttikaraṇaṁapūrvakaraṇaṁanivr̥ttikaraṇaṅgaḷinantānubandhigaḷaṁvisaṁyōjisimattaṁantamurhūrtamuṁviśramisiadhaḥpravr̥ttakaraṇāpūrvakaraṇaṅgaḷoḷeanivr̥ttikaraṇabahubhāgampōgeēkabhāgamuṇṭenedarśanamōhanīyamithyātvamumuṁsamyagmithyātvamuṁmuṁsamyaktvamuṁmumprakr̥tiyuṁmuṅkṣapiyisiintusaptaprakr̥tigaḷaṅkiḍisikṣāyikasamyagdr̥ṣṭiyāgicaramusukhakāraṇamappasamyagdarśanajñānalābhadināgaḍemuktanādarantesantōṣambaṭṭumattamīpuṇyakṣētradoḷānalladepeṟaruṁnarakagamanābhimukharuḷḷoḍebesasimenebhaṭṭārakarintendubesasidarkāḷasaukarikanemba pārvanuṁ, dvijapeṇḍati(tanūjā)yappa
śubheyuṁ, naraka pravēśābhimukharāgirdaradentendoḍe—kāḷasaukarika
nemba nīpoḻaliloḷu bandu, bhavasthiti nimittamēḻuṟi sūḻvalvaregaṁ,
nīcakuladoḷpuṭṭi, jātismaranāgi, puṇyapāpaphala muṇṭappoḍe, peṟagaṇa
bhavadoḷānēgeydenāgi bandilli manuṣya janmaṁ paḍedenendu, dēhigaḷa
pūrvārjita puṇyapāpa phala sambandhamaṁvaṁ nirākarisi, mr̥ṣāstēyuya prāṇi
vadha māṁsāhāra bahvārambha parigrahādi karmarmuniragi baddhanarakāyuṣya
navadhi sthānakke sallalirdanātanapeṇḍati subheyuṁ, kāripāgni nirviśēṣa
kāvagebhilāṣa pravr̥ddharāga dvēṣa mōha paiśūnyaṅgaḷiṁḷaṁ neṟiṟadu, r̥ṣi
yarkaḷa guṇaśīlācāraṅgaḷaṁ kēḷvāgaḷumamuvaraṅkāṇbāgaḷuṁ, saṅklē
śadiṁ baddhanarakāyuṣyaṣyeyāgi, ṣaṣṭhapaṣmama pr̥thvige pōgaliḷirdaḷembuduṁduṁadaṅkēḷdabhayakumārantannabhavāntaramumbesagoḷenīnībhavakkemūṟaneyabhavadoḷjambūdvīpadabharatadoḷōrvambrāhmaṇandaivatīrthapāṣaṇḍijātilōkamūḍhavyākuḷīkr̥tamatiyuntatpraśaṁsanatadācaraṇapariṇatanumenisivēdādhyayananimittandēśāntarakkepōguttuṁōrvaṁārhatanaṅkaṇḍātanuntānumbarevarebaṭṭeyoḷondukallapuñjakeladoḷirdatāriyumaranaṅkaṇḍumuguḷnagenakkuapamānaṅgeyvabageyiṁāmaranakiṟugombaṁmuṟidutannakāladhūḷiyuntoḍedukaḷeduninna.

adaṁ kēḷdabhayakumāraṁ, tanna bhavāntaramuṁ besagoḷe, nīnī
bhavakke mūṟaneya bhavadoḷ, jambūdvīpada, bharatadoḷōrvaṁ
brāhmaṇaṁ, daivatīrtha pāṣaṇḍi jātilōka mūḍha vyākuḷīkr̥ta
matiyuṁ, tatpraśaṁsana tadācaraṇa pariṇatanumenisi, vēdādhyayana
nimittaṁ, dēśāntarakke pōguttaṁ, ōrvaṁ ārhatanaṁ kaṇḍātanuṁ
tānuṁ barevare, baṭṭeyoḷondu kallapuñja keladoḷirda tāriyu
maranaṁ kaṇḍu muguḷnage nakku apamānaṅgeyva bageyiṁ, ā marana
kiṟugombaṁ muṟidu, tanna kāladhūḷiyuṁ toḍedu kaḷedu, ninna

deyvaṁ arhatargēnaṁnuṁ bādhegeyvayyal neṟiyuyadendu nuḍivuduṁ
ātanendaṁ—emma deyvamaṁ apamānisidaḍēdēnādudu, ninna deyvamaṁ
kaṇḍoḍāṁ, adanapamānaṁ geyveṁyvaṁ, enagidavakke nīṁ upādhyāyane
endu kiṟideḍeyuṁ barpuduṁ. ā śrāvakanondoḍeyoḷ nasu
kunniyuṁ kaṇḍidemma deyvaṁ endadaṁ pradakṣiṇaṅgeyy, pāyyepārvaṁ
ādaṁ eraḍu kayyoḷ murci kāloḷorasuvuduṁ, asahyamappa
kaṇḍūti bādheyiṁ, ninna deyvaṁ sannihita mendaḍe, śrāvakanendaṁ—
tanna pūrvārjitada pesar deyvamembuduṁ, apadaṟiṁ buddhiyoḍeya
nappātaṁ śrēyamuṁ bayasuvaḍe, dēvatāmūḍhatvamaṁmuṁ pattuviṭṭu,
tapōdānādigaḷoḷ negaḻvuṟvudendā pārvana dēvatā mūḍhatvamaṁmuṁ
pattuviḍisi barutuṁ, gaṅgeyayu gandhavatiyayu taḍiyayu maṇigaṅgavemba
tīrthadoḷminḷbandu banda pārvaṅge, śrāvakaṁ tannuṇḍuḷida āhāramaṁmuṁ
gaṅgājaladoḷ eraci, nīṁ idanuṇbudene, pārvaṁ nīṁ uṇḍeñjalaṁ
entuṁ umbeṁ embuduṁ, nimma tīrthajaḷamappaḍe pāpaphaḷa(maḷa)
nirākaraṇa samarthaṁ, ucchiṣṭa dōṣamanēke kaḷeyayulāradembuduṁ;
nīnendantuṇṭene tīrthamūḍhatvamaṁmuṁ piṅgisi, baḷiyuṁ barevare,
pañcāgni madhyadoḷirdu tapaṅgeyva tāpasanaṁ kaṇḍātanuminda nīroḷ
sūkṣmamappa prāṇigaḷumaṁmuṁ, jeḍeyoḷottardirda kiṟumīnuṁ,
kiṟikappeyuṁ, pēnuṁ, sīrgaḷumaṁmuṁ, pañcāgniyoḷappa prāṇi
vadhamumaṁmuṁmuṁ tōṟi, pāṣaṇḍi mūḍhatvamaṁmuṁ piṅgisi, kṣatriyaṁyu, brāhmaṇa,
vaiśya, śūdra jātigaḷaggaṁḷgaṁ(ḷumaṁḷuṁmuṁ), garbhādāna pravartanadoḷaṁ,
rūpākāradoḷaṁ bhēdamilla, gōmāṁsādi bhakṣaṇadiṁ, cāritraśuddhiyiṁ,
nīcōcca(jāti)bhēdamanaṟiyalakkuṁ. brāhmaṇanuccakuladoḷpu
ṭṭiyuṁ, nīcakuladavannēgaḷva gōrngegalvamāṁsa bhakṣaṇādigaḷaṁ geyvuydudaṟiṁ
jātikr̥ta viśēṣavondumillendu jātimūḍhatvamaṁmuṁ piṅgisi, “vasati
riḷākṣigakṣaḥ padme lakṣmīrvaṭēṭī yakṣaḥ” endu nirantaramamulli pratyakṣaṁ
kāṇadeyuṁ, mūḍhatvadiṁ lōkaṁ nuḍivudu, āptāgama (puruṣa vira
cita āgama) vimukhatvadiṁ, unmattaka vacanadanta(agaḷaṁ ada) pramāṇa
mendu,lōkamūḍhatva(ka)maṁmuṁ kaḷedu, tannantiḷiyude pārvaṁ dēvatā
mūḍhatvamuṁ pattuviṭṭu, enagindu modalāge ninna dharmaveme dharma
mendu, jinadharmamaṁmuṁ kaikoṇḍi(ḍuba)rpiṟinavondaṭavī pradēśadoḷ
baṭṭegeṭṭimaṭṭemugilli baṭṭedōrparārendu pera(peri)dupāyaṁyuṁ illendā

śrāvakaṁ sarvasaṅgaparityāgadiṁ, sanyāsana mendirpuduṁ, adaṁ kaṇḍu,
pārvaṁ tānuṁ nōntu, saudharma kalpadoḷdēvanāgi puṭṭi, kālānta
doḷalliṁ bandu, śrēṇika mahārājaṅgaṁ abhayakumāranāgi puṭṭide.
illiṁ(daṁ) mēle dvādaśavidha tapadoḷnegaḻdu muktigeḷdamuktigesa salveyene
kumāranuṁ śrēṇikanuṁ dēvaraṁ bandisi, poḻalilge vandar mattondu
divasaṁsaṁśrēṇikamahārājaṁabhayupaṇḍitanamahātmyamamprakaṭisalendusabhāmadhyadoḷvastutattvamambesagoḷecaturdaśaguṇasthānamuntatpramāṇajīvasthānamuṁṣaḍvidhaparyaptiyundaśavidhaprāṇamuñcaturvidhasañjñeyuntatramāṇagatiyumpañcavidhajātiyuṁṣaḍvidhakāyamumpañcadaśayōgamuntrividhavēdamuñcaturvidhakaṣāyamuṁaṣṭavidhajñānamuṁsaptavidhasaṁyamamuñcaturvidhadarśanamuṁṣaḍvidhalēśyamundvividhabhavyatvamuṁṣaḍvidhasamyaktvadvividhasañjñedvividhāhāramārgaṇegaḷandvādaśavidhōpayōgamuṁembippattuprarūpaṇegaḷumuṁmattamūlapratyayōttarapratyayaṅgaḷumuṁmūlōttaraprakr̥tiya(gaḷumuṁ)caturvidhabandhamuṁmumpēḷda.

śrēṇikamahārājaṁendivumodalāgellamaṁsaprapañcamaṟipesabhāsadarellaṁ, abhayu paṇḍitananendupesaraṅkuḍe mahātmyamaṁ prakaṭisa
lendu, sabhāmadhyadoḷ vastutattvamaṁ besagoḷe, caturdaśa
guṇasthānamuṁ, tatpramāṇa jīvasthādattanundhanabhadranuṁupēndranuṁsudattanuṁsiṁhabhadranuṅkāmbhōjanuṁakampanumpataṅganumprabhañjanamuṁ, ṣaḍvidhaparyaptiyuṁ,
daśavidhaprāṇamuṁ, caturvidhasañjñeyuṁ, tatpramāṇagatiyuṁ, pañca
vidhajātiyuṁ, ṣaḍvidhakāyamuṁ, pañcadaśayōgamuṁ, trividha
vēdamuṁ, caturvidha kaṣāyamuṁ, aṣṭavidha jñānamuṁ, saptavidha
saṁyamamuṁ, caturvidha darśanamuṁ, ṣaḍvidhalēśyamuṁ, dvividha
bhavyatvamuṁ, ṣaḍvidha samyaktva, dvividha sañjñe, dvividhāhāra mārgaṇe
gaḷuṁ, dvādaśa vidhōpayōgamuṁ embippattu prarūpaṇegaḷumaṁ,
matta mūla pratyayōttara pratyayaṅgaḷumaṁ, mūlōttara prakr̥
tiyu(gaḷumaṁ) caturvidha bandhamumaṁ pēḻdu :
vr̥॥

lg.l: udayipa karmamuṁ saphala niṣphala yugmada mandatīvrayu
gmada bhavabhāva yugmada nija(dā)nya mukhadvaya tannimittayu

div.p:
endivu modalāgellamaṁ saprapañcamaṟipe, sabhāsadarellaṁ, abhayu
paṇḍitanendu pesaraṁ kuḍe, mattondu divasaṁ, śrēṇikaṁ prathama
gaṇiniyarappa candanāryikeyara janmasambandhamaṁ besagoḷe, gautama
svāmigaḷintendu besasidar.

sindhu(ha)viṣayada, vaiśālī nagaramanāḷva, paramārhatanappa
cēṭaka pr̥thivīpatigaṁ, subhadregaṁ puṭṭida, dhanadattanuṁ, dhanabhadranuṁ,
upēndranuṁ, sudattanuṁ, siṁhabhadranuṁ, kāmbhōjanuṁ, akampanuṁ
pataṅganuṁ, prabhañjananuṁ, prabhāsanumemba padimbartaneyaruṁ,
priyakāriṇiyuṁ, mr̥gāvatiyuṁ, suprabheyuṁ, prabhāvatiyuṁ,

cēḷiniyuṁ, jyēṣṭheyuṁ, candaneyuṁ, embareḻbalbar magaḷdir āge,
vidēha viṣayuyada, kuṇḍini puramanāḷva, nāthānvayada, siddhārthaṅge
priyakāriṇiyuṁ kūḍe, vatsa viṣayuyada, kauśambī nagaravanāḷva, candrā
nvayuyada śatānīkaṅge mr̥gāvatiyuṁ kūḍe, daśārṇava viṣayuyada, hēmuma
kaccha nagaramanāḷva sūrya vaṁśada daśarathaṅge suprabheyuṁ kūḍe,
kaccha viṣayuyada, rōru(vasthāri)ka nagaramanāḷva, uda(ddhāddā)yanaṅge
prabhāvatiyuṁ koṭṭoḍāke, śīlamuṁ tāḷdiḷda, śīlavatiyemba jagatprasi
ddhiyuṁ paḍedaḷ, gāndhāra viṣayuyada, mahīpuramanāḷva, satyakaṁ
jyēṣṭheyuṁ bēḍi paḍeyude bandu, kādibhaṅgavāgi pōgi, damavara
gurugaḷa samīpadoḷ. dīkṣitanādaṁ itta, cēṭaka mahārājaṁ, tanna
magaḷdiroḷappa snēhadiṁ avara rūpaṁ paṭadoḷbareyise, cēḷiniya
rūpina nuṇpoḍeyoḷ silkida binduvaṁ kaṇḍu citrakaṅge muḷi
doḍātaṁ, alli silkida binduvaṁ palavu sūḻkilkiḷedoḍaṁ pogadirdoḍī
pradēśadoḷīlakṣaṇaṁ uṇṭakkumendu anumānadiṁ aṟidu.
kaḷedenillembuduṁ, arasanātaṅge meccugoṭṭu, niccamāpaṭṭakamaṁ
dēvārcana samayuyadoḷ, jinabimba samīpadoḷ iṭṭu, gandha
puṣpādigaḷinarcisuttirpinaṁ, ondu divasaṁsaṁmagadhaviṣayadarājagr̥hanagarōdyānadoḷcēṭakamahārājaṁsnānapūrvakañjinapūjānantaramāpaṭṭakamanarcisuvuduṁśrēṇikamahārājaṅkaṇḍidēnenduparicārakarambesagoḷeemmaarasanamagaḷdirelbaraviddhaṁavaroḷnālvaravivāhaṁāduducēḷiniyuñjyēṣṭheyuṁvivāhakkeyōgyeyarāgirdarcandaneinnumbāḷakiendaṟipuvuduṁśrēṇikaṁanuraktacittanāgimantrigaḷgaṟipemantrigaḷabhayapaṇḍitanalligevanducēṭakamahārājatannamagaḷdiraṁnimmeyyaṅgepariṇatavayanendukuḍanātanavargāsaktanāgirdaṁadakkupāyamāvudenenīmidakkeniścintamirināneballenendukumāraṁśrēṇikanarūpamampaṭṭakadoḷbaredukatipayabhaṭaparivr̥tañjōdrukanembaparadanāgivividhōpāyadiñcēṭakamahīpatiyamanamaṁrañjisejōdrukanakaiyoḷirdapaṭṭakadoḷbaredaśrēṇikanarūpañcēḷiniyuñjyēṣṭheyuṅkaṇḍanurakteyarādudanaṟidutannikkidasuraṅgadinavaraṅkoṇḍupōpāgaḷcēḷini.

cēḷiniyuñjyēṣṭheyuñcandaneyuṁembarelbarmagaḷdirāgevidēhaviṣayadakuṇḍinipuramanāḷvanāthānvayadasiddhārthaṅgepriyakāriṇiyuṅkūḍevatsaviṣayadakauśambīnagaravanāḷvacandrānvayadaśatānīkaṅgemr̥gāvatiyuṅkūḍedaśārṇavaviṣayadahēmakacchanagaramanāḷvasūryavaṁśadadaśarathaṅgesuprabheyuṅkūḍekacchaviṣayadarōru(vasthāri)kanagaramanāḷvauda(ddā)yanaṅgeprabhāvatiyuṅkoṭṭoḍākeśīlamuntāḷdaśīlavatiyembajagatprasiddhiyumpaḍedaḷgāndhāraviṣayadamahīpuramanāḷvasatyakañjyēṣṭheyumbēḍipaḍeyudebandukādibhaṅgavāgipōgidamavaragurugaḷasamīpadoḷdīkṣitanādaṁittacēṭakamahārājantannamagaḷdiroḷappasnēhadiṁavararūpampaṭadoḷbareyisecēḷiniyarūpinanuṇpoḍeyoḷsilkidabinduvaṅkaṇḍucitrakaṅgemuḷidoḍātaṁallisilkidabinduvampalavusūlkiḷedoḍampogadirdoḍīpradēśadoḷīlakṣaṇaṁuṇṭakkumenduanumānadiṁaṟidukaḷedenillembuduṁarasanātaṅgemeccugoṭṭuniccamāpaṭṭakamandēvārcanasamayadoḷjinabimbasamīpadoḷiṭṭugandhapuṣpādigaḷinarcisuttirpinaṁondudivasaṁmagadha viṣayuyada, rājagr̥ha nagarōdyānadoḷ, cēṭaka mahā
rājaṁ snānapūrvakaṁ jinapūjānantaramāpaṭṭakamanarcisuvuduṁ, śrēṇika
mahārājaṁ kaṇḍidēnendu paricārakaraṁ besagoḷe emma arasana
magaḷdireḻbalbar aviddhaṁ, avaroḷ nālvaravivāhaṁ ādudu.
cēḷiniyuṁ, jyēṣṭheyuṁ vivāhakke yōgyeyar āgirdar. candane
innuṁ bāḷaki endaṟipuvuduṁ. śrēṇikaṁ anuraktacittanāgi mantri
gaḷgaṟipe, mantrigaḷ abhayuya paṇḍitanalligevandu, cēṭaka mahārāja.
tanna magaḷdiraṁ nimmammeyyaṅge pariṇiṇata payuvayanendu kuḍanātanavargāsakta
nāgirdaṁ, adakkupāyuya māpuvudene, nīmidakke niścintamiri nāne balle
nendu, kumāraṁ śrēṇikana rūpamaṁ paṭṭakadoḷbaredu, katipayabhaṭa
parivr̥taṁ, jōdradrukanemba paradanāgi, vividhōpāyadiṁ, cēṭaka
mahīpatiya manamaṁ rañjise, jōdradrukana kaiyyoyoḷirda paṭṭaka
doḷbareda, śrēṇikana rūpaṁ cēḷiniyuṁ, jyēṣṭheyuṁ kaṇḍanurakteya
rādudanaṟidu, tannikkida suraṅgadinavaraṁ koṇḍupōpāgaḷ, cēḷini

jyēṣṭheyu baravaṁ sairisade, enna ābharaṇamuṁ maṟidu bandeṁ, avaṁ
tappudendākeyuṁ pusivesadoḷguḻciḷbaguṟci, kumāranosoḍane pōdaḷ.
itta, jyēṣṭheyuṁ ābharaṇamuṁ koṇḍubandu, cēḷiniyuya kāṇade,
mānabhaṅgadoḷ tamrammettevirappa yaśasvati kantiyurapakkade, dharmamuṁ
kēḷdu, dīkṣegoṇḍaḷitta; śrēṇikaṁ cēḷiniyuṁ parigrahisi, mahādēvi
paṭṭaṅgaṭṭidanittaṁ; candaneyuṁ yaśasvati kantiyura pakkade, samyaktva
muṁmumaṁ, śrāvakabratamuṁmumaṁ kaikoṇḍu, ondu divasaṁ, aśōkavana
doḷkrīḍisuttirpinaṁ. rajatagiriya dakṣiṇaśrēṇiya, suvarṇābha nagaramuma
nāḷva, manōvēganemboṁ, tanna peṇḍati manōvēgeverasu vihāri
suttuṁ bandu, ā candaneyuṁ kaṇḍu, kusumaśara vaśīkr̥ta mati
yāgi, manōvēgeyuṁ poḻilgeydililglaydasi, svarūpiṇī vidyeyiṁ, tanna
rūpaṁ siṁhāsanadoḷirpantu māḍi, mattamaśōkavanakke bandu,
candaneyuṁ piḍidoyye, manōvēgeyumātanaṁ bañcisipōpudana
aṟidu, svarūpiṇī vidyeyuṁ māmuyuṁvāmapādadoḷodavuduṁ, adu aṭṭa
hāsaṅgeydu pōpuduṁ. ā bhōginī vidyeyinātanirdeḍeyanaṟidu,
baṟiyuṁ taguḻdiydu, nīniṟdaydunīnivavaḷaṁ bisuḍendu bhayaṅgoḷisi baggise,
bhūtaramaṇavemmemba araṇyadoḷaiḷairāvatiyemba tōṟiyuteṅkaṇataḍiyoḷ,
parṇalaghu vidyeyiṁ bisuṭuṭuṁ pōge, candaneyuṁ pañcanamaskāramumanu
ccarisuttumiruḷaṁ kaḷapi, nēsamūrdirmūḍidāgaḷākeyuṁ kāḷakanemba vanē
caraṁ kaṇḍā candaneyuya toṭṭamūlyamappa tuḍugegaḷaṁ koṇḍu, santu
ṣṭanāgi, dharmatatvattvamanākeyulliye kēḷdu, bhīmumakūṭa parvatada tappilpvila,
bhayuṅyaṅkaramappa bēḍavaḷḷiyoḷippa, siṁhakanemba śabaranāyuyakaṅgoydu
kuḍuvuduṁ. ākeya saundaryakke sōltu, tanage māḍalendu
nigrahaṅgeyvuduṁ, avarabbe bandu, nīnīkeyuṁ pratyakṣadēvateyuṁ
nigrahaṅgeyyadirīke muḷidaḍe, śāpaṁ guḍal samarthe endu māṇisi,
snāna, śayana, bhōjanādigaḷanoḷḷittāgi naḍeyise kelavukālamulli
rpinaṁ.
vatsa viṣayuyada, kauśambīnagarada, vr̥ṣabhasēna seṭṭiyumanege mukhya,
mitravīranembaṅge candaneyuṁ byādarājaṁ koṭṭoḍātaṁ, svāmibhakta
nāgi tandu, tanna seṭṭige koṭṭoḍamupaḍadirpinaṁ. ā(vr̥ttāntamuṁ)
vr̥ṣabhasēnana seṭṭiti subhadreyondudivasaṁ, candane nīrguḍivalli, nela

doḷokka nīroḷaleva praḷamba kēśakaḷāpamuṁ, seṭṭimumuṇḍiyisuvudaṁ
kaṇḍu, seṭṭiti muḷidu, nīnīkeyuṁ pāpabuddhiyiṁ samparkaṁ māḍa
lbagedeyukkumendu kaḍumuḷidu, candaneyuṁ saṅkaleyoḷikki,
durāhārapradāna kaṭukavacana tarjanādigaḷiṁ bārise, pūrvakr̥ta duḥkr̥ta
vipākadiṁ, enaginitādudidarke seṭṭitiyēgeyvaḷendu, tannantāne
nindisi, tatpuramanāḷva, tannabhāva śatānīkaṅgaṁ, tammakkaṁ mr̥ga
yāvatigamamuppaḍaṁ, tanna duḥkhamanaṟipade kṣameye meyyāgirpinaṁ,
chadmasthakāladoḷ, trailōkyasvāmi carigevandoḍidireddu niṟise,
saṅkale tanage tāne paṟiye, sarvābharaṇabhūṣiteyāgi, bhājana bhōjanādi
gaḷāge yathāvidhiyiṁ niṟise, negaḻda āścaryapañldcāścaryacakamaṁmuṁ kaṇḍu, tanna
maganudayanuṁ berasu, mr̥gāvati bandu, tanna taṅgeyuṁ arcanā
praśaṁsanapūrvakaṁ, aramaneguyye, seṭṭiyuṁ, seṭṭitiyuṁ bandu
śaraṇokku canbkacandadaneyu kālgerage, tadvārtākarṇanadiṁ, santōṣaṁ
baṭṭu, bandhugaḷellaṁ tammayyanalliguyvuduṁ. vandanārthaṁ banda
bandhugaḷaṁ visarjisi, dīkṣegoṇḍu, gaṇini padadoḷ nindaḷembuduṁ.
cēṭaka mahārājaṁ pūrvabhavadoḷēgeydu bandu candaneyādaḷendu
besagoḷe——

jambūdvīpada, magadhaviṣayuyada, vatsanagaramuṁ, praśēnikanembanāḷva
kāladoḷ, agnibhūtiyemba pārvaṅgōrva pārvantiyumorvaḷ
paraditiyuṁ peṇḍatiyarāge, pārvantige śivabhūtiyemba maganādoṁ;
paraditige citrasēne emba mamaṅgaḷādoḍā śivabhūtige sōmiḷeyemba
bhāryeyādaḷā citrasēneyaṁ sōmaśarmadvijana maganappa dēva
śarmaṅge koṭṭa agnibhūti lōkāntarakke sale; śivabhūti pitr̥sthānadoḷnile,
citrasēneyuṁ vidhaveyāgi tanna makkaḷverasu śivabhūtiya maneyoḷa
rpuduṁprduṁsō. sōmiḷe citrasēnegamākeyuya makkaḷgaḷgemappa bīyumaṁyavaṁ
sairisade, śivabhūtiyoḷ citrasēne pōpaḷemba sadvārteyaṁyuṁ māḍido
ḍanyajanmadoḷīkeyuya nigrahaṅgeyvanakkendu, citrasēne nidānaṁ geyye,
mattondu divasaṁ; śivabhūtiyuya maneyoḷautaṇamāge, śivagupta
muniyuṁ sōmiḷe munna muḷida śivabhūtiyuṁ mā r̥ṣiyu mahā
tmaimatmyavanaṟipi tiḷipe, taddānamanoḍambaṭṭu, kālāntaradoḷ, lōkāṁ

tarakke sandu, aṅgaviṣayuyada, kāntāpuramanāḷva, suvarṇavarmaṅgaṁ,
vidyullēkhegaṁ, mahābaḷanemba maganādoṁdoṁaṅgaviṣayadacampāpuradaśrīṣēṇanr̥patigaṁsuvarṇavarmanataṅgeyappadhanaśrīgaṁsōmiḷebandukanakalateembamagaḷādoḷākepuṭṭidandemahābaḷaṅgekuḍuvudendutāyuntandeyuṁoḍambaḍisicampāpurakkekumārananaṭṭiyauvanaṁneṟiduvivāhamuppannagamuvaramaneyumpugadepōṟagirpudendamāvanabesadoḷirduparasparasnēhadoḷādadiṭṭiyoḷamparijanaprayōgadoḷaṁmahābaḷaṅgaṅkanakalategaṁsaṅgamāgekāntāpurakkevaretāyuntandeyumavarageydanabhimutācārakkenīmulliradirendukaḷeyemattondupolilgepōgirdondudivasaṁvanavihāradoḷkāntāracarigevokkamuniguptarembamunigetamugendutandalaḍḍukāpūpādigaḷiñcarigemāḍisenavavidhapuṇyadoḷūḍimattorvevanavihāradoḷkumāraṁvasantamāsōgraviṣaviṣadharadaṣṭanāgilōkāntarakkepōprudumātanasurigiyoḷtannantāneyiṟidukoṇḍukanakalateyuṁsattaḷāmahābaḷaṁavantiviṣayadujjeniyumprajāpatimahārājanāḷuttiretannagaradadhanadēvaśrēṣṭhigandhanamitregaṁśrīnāgadattanemboṁmaganādonātaniṅkiṟiyoḷarthasvāminiyemboḷorvaḷmagaḷādoḷākanakalateyumpaḷāśadvīpadapaḷāśapuramanāḷvamahābaḷanr̥patigaṅkāñcanalategampadmalateyembamagaḷāgedhanadēvaśrēṣṭhipeṟaḷorvaḷaṁmaduveniltudhanamitreyunaṭṭikaḷeyedēśāntarakkepōgiśīladattagurugaḷapakkadeśrāvakabrataṅgaḷaṅkaikoṇḍuśāstrābhyāsakkendumagananappayisekelavudivasadinātaṁsakaḷaśāstrapāraganuṅkaviyumāgirūpakōpamānārthāntaranyāsasañjñā(dhānā)tiśayādyaḷaṅkārakāvyaṅgaḷiṁśiṣṭajanamanōrañjanamuṁmāḍenandigrāmadataḷaṟinamaṅgandr̥ḍharakṣanoḷkeḷeyāgetannagaravāsigaḷellamabhimatavidyākhyānamuṅgeyyuttamupādhyāyapadaviyoḷnindutannapaḍadoḍameyoḷtāyuntaṅgeyumumporedalliyakuḷavaṇijanembontammatteyamagaṅgetannataṅgeyanarthasvāminiyuṅkoṭṭumattondudivasaṁupa(mahā)ślōkapūrvakaṁarasanaṅkaṇḍusanmānadānaṅgaḷampaḍedumattorvenijajananitanagaṟipetammayya.

tarakkesanduaṅgaviṣayuyadakāntāpuramanāḷvasuvarṇavarmaṅgaṁvidyullēkhegaṁmahābaḷanembamaganādoṁaṅgaviṣayada, campāpurada, śrīṣēṇa nr̥patigaṁ, suvarṇavarmana
taṅgeyappa dhanaśrīgaṁ, sōmileḷe bandu, kanakalate emba magaḷādoḷāke
puṭṭidande, mahābaḷaṅge kuḍuvudendu tāyuṁ, tandeyuṁ oḍaṁ
baḍisi, campāpurakke kumārananaṭṭi, yauvanaṁ neṟidu, vivāhamamuppa
nnagamuvaramaneyuṁ pugade, pōṟiṟagirpudenda māvana besadoḷirdu, para
spara snēhadoḷādadiṭṭiyoḷaṁ, parijana prayōgadoḷaṁ, mahābaḷaṅgaṁ
kanakalategaṁ saṅgamāge, kāntāpurakkevare, tāyuṁ, tandeyuṁyumavara
geyda nabhimamutācārakke nīmulliradirimenrendu kaḷeye, mattondu poḻililge
pōgirdondu divasaṁ, vanavihāradoḷ, kāntāracarigevokka muni
guptaremba munige tamugendu tanda laḍḍukāpūpādigaḷiṁ carige māḍise,
navavidha puṇyadoḷkūḷūḍi, mattormerve vanavihāradoḷ, kumāraṁ vasanta
māsōgra viṣa viṣadhara daṣṭanāgi,lōkāntarakke pōpraprudumātana surigi
yoḷtannaṁ tāneyiṟidukoṇḍu kanakalateyuṁ sattaḷā mahābaḷaṁ
avantiviṣayuyadujjijjeniyuṁ prajāpati mahārājanāḷuttire, tannagarada
dhanadēva śrēṣṭhigaṁ, dhanamitregaṁ, śrīnāgadattanemboṁ maganādo
nātaniṁ, kiṟiyoḷ arthasvāminiyemboḷorvaḷ magaḷādoḷ.ḷākanakalateyumpaḷāśadvīpadapaḷāśapuramanāḷvamahābaḷanr̥patigaṅkāñcanalategampadmalateyembamagaḷāgedhanadēvaśrēṣṭhipeṟaḷorvaḷaṁmaduveniltudhanamitreyunaṭṭikaḷeyedēśāntarakkepōgiśīladattagurugaḷapakkadeśrāvakabrataṅgaḷaṅkaikoṇḍuśāstrābhyāsakkendumagananappayisekelavudivasadinātaṁsakaḷaśāstrapāraganuṅkaviyumāgirūpakōpamānārthāntaranyāsasañjñā(dhānā)tiśayādyaḷaṅkārakāvyaṅgaḷiṁśiṣṭajanamanōrañjanamuṁmāḍenandigrāmadataḷaṟinamaṅgandr̥ḍharakṣanoḷkeḷeyāgetannagaravāsigaḷellamabhimatavidyākhyānamuṅgeyyuttamupādhyāyapadaviyoḷnindutannapaḍadoḍameyoḷtāyuntaṅgeyumumporedalliyakuḷavaṇijanembontammatteyamagaṅgetannataṅgeyanarthasvāminiyuṅkoṭṭumattondudivasaṁupa(mahā)ślōkapūrvakaṁarasanaṅkaṇḍusanmānadānaṅgaḷampaḍedumattorvenijajananitanagaṟipetammayya

ā kanakalateyuṁ, paḷāśadvīpada, paḷāśapuramanāḷva, mahābaḷa
nr̥patigaṁ, kāñcana lategaṁ, padmalateyemba magaḷāge, dhanadēva śrēṣṭhi,
peṟaḷorvaḷaṁ maduve niltu, dhanamitreyu naṭṭi kaḷeye, dēśāntarakke
pōgi, śīladatta gurugaḷa pakkade śrāvaka brataṅgaḷaṁ kaikoṇḍu, śāstrā
bhyāsakkendu magananappayise, kelavu divasadinātaṁ, sakaḷaśāstra pāra
ganuṁ, kaviyuṁmāgi, rūpakōpamānārthantaranyāsa sañjñā(dhānā)ti
śayādyaḷaṅkārakāvyaṅgaḷiṁ, śiṣṭajana manōrañjanamaṁ māḍe, nandi
grāmada, taḷāṟinamagaṁ dr̥ḍharakṣanoḷkeḷeyāge, tannagaravāsigaḷellamabhi
matavidyākhyānamaṁ geyvuttu mupādhyāyu padaviyoḷnindu, tanna
paḍadoḍameyoḷ, tāyuṁ, taṅgeyumaṁ poredalliya kuḷavaṇija
nemboṁ, tammatteyu magaṅge tanna taṅgeyunarthasvāminiyuṁ koṭṭu,
mattondu divasaṁ, upa(mahā)ślōkapūrvakaṁ arasanaṁ kaṇḍu,
sanmāna dānaṅgaḷaṁ paḍedu, mattorme, nijajanani tanagaṟipe, tammayya

nallipe pōgi, poḍevaḍuvanduṁ, dhanadēvaseṭṭi śrī nāgadattanaṁ parisi
kuḷḷirisi, magane, palakāladiṁ bandeyendu sanmānaṅgeydu, parārdhartha
mappa suvarṇaratnādi vastugaḷoḷainagappa bhāgamaṁ kuḍuvudendu
śrīnāgadattaṁ bēḍe, dhanadēvaseṭṭiyendanenna dhanaṁ paḷāśadvīpada, paḷāśa
puradoḷirdudaṁ tandukoḷḷindeḍevēḷvuduṁ, tanna dāyigaruṁ,
oḍavuṭṭidarumappa nakuḷa, sahadēvarsahitaṁ, sārthadoḍanepōgi, kārya
siddhiyādoḍe, jinapati pūjeyuṁ māṟpenendu parasi, jinapatiyuṁ
bandisi, gurucaraṇakkeṟagi, nāvegaḷanēṟi, samundramaṁ pāydu,
palāśapuramaṁseydu, nirmānuṣyarvāṇampyamappudaṁ kaṇḍalli nimircida niḍiya
nēṟbiṇbiḍidu taṭamamaṁneydiydu, poḻililaṁ pokkirdēkākiniyāgirda kannikeya
norvaḷaṁ kaṇḍu, ī poḻililaṁ pāḻmāṟmāḍidarārene kanyakiyendaḷ—
ī poḻilanāḷvarasana dāyiganorvaṁ, kōpadindaṁ rākṣasa
vidyeyuṁ sādhisi, rākṣasanemba pesaraṁ paḍedu, poḻilumaṁ, arasa
numaṁ kiḍise, tadanvayadoḷpuṭṭidātanorvaṁ mantramaṁ sādhisi,
nisita khaḍgavidyeyiṁ, mattaṁ nagaramaṁ niṟisidoḍī poḻalanāḷvaṁ,
īgaḷ mahābalanembaṁ, ātana peṇḍati kāñcalateyemboḷ avarge
puṭṭide nāṁ padmalateyembeṁ, ennaṁ ōrvaḷumaṁ tanna makkaḷa
samanendu kollade rākṣasaṁ kādaṁ emmayyanuṁ ennaṁ inde koṇḍo
yyal bakkuṁ. orme mantrasādhitamappa bāḷaṁ tanna keyge māḍal
maṟidu, rakkasanindemmayyaṁ bañcisalpaṭṭanembuduṁ, śrīnāgadattanā
bāḷaṁ koṇḍu, gōpuradoḷage meygeredirdu pugutappa rākṣasanaṁ
baggisi, bāḷoḷiṟiye, pañcanamaskārapadamanuccarisuttuṁ keḍada rākṣa
sanaṁ kaṇḍu, tatsamiccāviyendu bāḷanīḍāḍi, nīnārgēnembi
yendu besagoḷe, vidyādharanendaṁ- āṁ śrāvakaputranene, enna muḷisu
kāraṇavāginitu duścaritradoḷ negaṟdenendu, tannaṁ tāne nindisi,
nīnārgēnembi endu besagoḷe, śrīnāgadattanendaṁ- āṁ āgantukane
nīkanyakiyuṁ ninagaṟkirdaḷaṁ kāvenendu garvadinirdu, ninna saddharma
vatsaḷatvamanaṟiyade ninna niṟidenantuṁ,
ārye|| indriya darpapraśamasantōṣōnigrahaḥ kaṣāyāṇāṁ
vātsalyaṁ ca sudharma saṁsāraṁ jinaśāsanaścēdaṁ
emba jinaśāsanakramamanullaṅghisi negaṟdenennageyda parādhamaṁ kṣami
yisuvudene, khēcaranendanidakke, nīnēgeyve, enna muṅgeydu karva

paripākadinintādudendu, śrīnāgadattaṁ pēḻduḷdu, pañcanamaskāraphalamaṁ
kēḻuḷduttaṁ, upaśama bhāvaneyiṁ muyiṁmaṇḍipi, dēvalōkadoḷpuṭṭidoṁ.
itta, padmalateyumaṁ, pitr̥sañcita dhanamumaṁmaṁ ākarṣaṇarajjuviṁ poḻiṟage
tegedu, mattapānēṟoḷ, śrīnāgadattanaṁ tegeṁlollade, nakuḷa saha
dēvarirvaruṁ poḻaṟalge vare. narapatiyuṁ, nagara janamuṁ, śrīnāgadattana
vārteyuyanēnendaṟiyade, sandēhadiṁ, dāyigarirvarumaṁ berumbisagoṇḍo
ḍāvumuvuṁmanondumanaṟiyavendu marasirpuduṁ. dhanamitre vyākuḷa
citteyāgi, śīladatta gurugaḷalligevōgi besagoḷe, nīvēnuṁmuñnuṁmañjadiri,
nimmamagaṁ nirvighnadiṁ barkuṁvendu bhayamaṁ piṅgisidaritta, śrīnāga
dattanumalliyondu jinabhavanamuṁmaṁmaṁ kaṇḍu, adaṁ pradakṣiṇaṁ geydu,
niṣisidiyindoḷagaṁ pokku, dēvaraṁ stutiyiyiṁsi kuḷḷirpuduṁ. allirda
nōrvaṁ vidyādharaṁ arhanmatāvalambigaḷappa guṇastutigaḷaṁ pēḻduḷdu,
śrīnāgadattanaṁ piṟidumoḍavemoverasuydātana taṅgiyirpa poḻiṟila
bahirudyānavanadoḷiḷipi, dharmamahātmyamanaṟipi, jinadharmavatsaḷaṁ
pōdaṁ.
itta, śrīnāgadattaṁ tanna paḍadoḍaveyellamuṁ udyānavanado
ḷpuḻdu, tanna taṅge modalāge bandhugaḷellaṁ idirgoḷe, poḻalampokki
rpuduṁ. bandhugaḷendar, seṭṭi tannamaganappa nakuḷaṅge posatorvaḷ
kannikeyuṁ tandu maduve māḍvalligemage baṟiyunaṭṭidoḍe, baṟu
gayyalentu pōpevendu beṟagāgirdevene, tanna tanda ratnaṅgaḷoḷ
sāramappavanavarge koṭṭu, nīmivanoydu śeṭṭitige koṭṭennabarava
naṟipi, kanyakegī ratnamudrikeyuṁ kuḍivendu pēḻdu, peṟiraṟiya
dantorvane pōgi, śīladatta gurugaḷaṁ bandisi, tanna munnina keḷeya
nappa taḷāṟina magaṅgēkāntadoḷ kāryamellamaṁ ādyantamanaṟipi,
tānuṁ ātanuṁ sāravastugaḷanuydarasanaṁ kāṇbuduṁ; arasaṁ śrīnāga
dattananentānuṁ kaṇḍeṁ, ītanillade poḻilellaṁ śūnyavāgirpudendu,
mūṟulōkamunondeḍegevandantāgi tōṟittendātana baraviṅge
santōṣambaṭṭu, nīninnegaṁ etta pōdeyene, seṭṭiyalli tānoḍavemaṁ
vēḍi, seṭṭiyuṁ besadoḷ pōda, banda vr̥ttāntamunaṟipidoḍarasanava
dhārisi, munidu, seṭṭige(yu)nigrahaṁ geyvāgaḷ śrīnāgadattaṁ bārise,
seṭṭi(yu) padamumaṁ, sāradravyamumanātaṅge koṭṭu, padmalatepēḻva

vāhamaṁ māḍe, rākṣasādyantarāyaṅgaḷaṁ pariharisi, piridumoḍave
vaḍedu poḻaṟilge vanbandanītanantu puṇyavantarillendarasaṁ tannaṁ pogaḻciṟdi,
śrīnāgadattaṁ munnaṁ parasi pōdanappudaṟiṁ, jinapūjeyuṁ māḍi,
nīnemmageyda parādhamaṁ kṣamiyisuvudendu kālgeṟagida seṭṭiyunēḷa
lvēḻdu ṟi nuḍiye, seṭṭimoḷdaṟinuḍiyeseṭṭimodadalāge palabaruṁ śrāvakarāge, paraspara
nibandha snēhadiṁ, dāna śīlōpavāsādigaḷiṁ negaḻuṟtuttaṁ kālaṁ sale,
jīvitāntadoḷ, sanyasana maraṇadiṁ śrīnāgadattaṁ saudharmakalpa
doḷpuṭṭi bandu—
jambūdvīpada, bharatada, vijayārdhada, śivaṅkara nagaramunāḷva
pavanavēgaṅgaṁ, suvēgegaṁ manōvēganemboṁ maganādoṁ; śrīnāga
dattana kiṟiyubbe suralōkadiṁ bandu, manōvēgeyādaḷ. palāśa
puradoḷ śrīnāgadattaṁ kole, satta vidyādharaṁ, pañcanamaskāraphaladiṁ,
upasa(śa)ma bhāvaneyiṁ, suralōkadoḷpuṭṭibandu, jambūdvīpada,
bharatada, kuruvaṁśadoḷ, cēṭaka mahārājanādoṁ. śrīnāgadattana
tāyi dhanamitre nōntu, dēvalōkadoḷpuṭṭi bandu, cēṭaka mahā
rājaṅge subhadrādēviyādoḷ. ā padmalateyuṁ upavāsaphaladiṁ,
svargadoḷ puṭṭibandu, candaneyādaḷ. manōvēgaṁ andina snēha
sambandhadiṁ, candaneyunoydātanuṁ, ī bhavadoḷe jinarūpamaṁ
tāḷdu muktige salvoṁ. nakuḷa, sahadēvarīrvaruṁ, saṁsāradoḷtiridu
nakuḷaṁ, siṁhaka vanadoḷ, vanēcaranāgi pūrvabhava snēhadoḷaṁ, vaira
doḷaṁ candanegupadravamaṁ māḍidanāsahadēvanuṁ, kauśambī nagara
doḷ paradara maganāgi, vr̥ṣabhasēna seṭṭiya manege tāne pramukhyanāgi,
bēḍavaṭṭinoḷirda candaneyaṁ tandu, seṭṭige koṭṭaṁ. ā śrīnāgadattana
tande dhanadēvanupaśama bhāvaneyiṁ, suralōkadoḷpuṭṭi bandu, kauśambī
nagaradoḷ vr̥ṣabhasēna seṭṭiyādaṁ. citrasēneyuṁ sōmileyoḷappa
vairasambandhadiṁ, saṁsāragahanadoḷ tiridinisānuṁ upaśamambaḍedu,
kauśambīnagarada, vaiśyaṅge subhadreyemba magaḷāgi, vr̥ṣabhasēnaṅge
bhāryeyāge, tanna nidāna vairasambandhadiṁ, candanege nigrahaṅgeyda ḷ.
ī candaneyuṁ, innaṁ acyutakalpadoḷpuṭṭibandu muktige salvaḷ.
intu mithyātva saṁyama kaṣāya pravādāśubhayōga sañcitamappa
duḥkarma phaladiṁ, munisuvratapurāṇadoḷ, saprapañcamuṁ pēḻdu

pañcavidha saṁsāradoḷ, bahuvidha duḥkhamumanuṇbar. samyagdarśana
cāritrānuṣṭhāna puṇyaphaladiṁ, bhōgōpabhōga bhāgigaḷāgi, kramadiṁ
muktige salvar.
endaṟipe, mattondu divasaṁ, śrēṇikaṁ bandu, bhaṭṭārakaraṁ
bandhisi, jambūdvīpada bharatada, avasarpiṇīkāla sambandhiyappa
vyavahāramumaṁ, kuladharādipurāṇamumanutsarpiṇikāla vyavahāra
mumaṁ, purāṇamumaṁ besagoḷe, dakṣiṇa bharatada madhyama khaṇḍa
doḷ, ṣaḍvidhavāgi pravartisuvākālamumaṁ, kuladharāvatāra
mumanādi mahāpurāṇada pīṭhikeyoḷ pēḻdandadoḷ besasi,
nālvattīrthāsiravarṣaṁ kundidondu kōṭi kōṭi sāgarōpamasthiti

nēmi, pārśva, vardhamānarembippattu nālvar tīrthakarararavarakāla
doḷ, anukramadiṁ, bharatanuṁ, satyabhāmanuṁ, satyavīryanuṁ,
mitrabhāvanuṁ, mitravīryanuṁ, dharmavīryanuṁ, dānavīryanuṁ,

jaghanyadiṁ saptaratni pramāṇōtsēdharumappar; aidaneya duṣṣama
kālaṁ ippattorchāchāsira varṣamakkuṁ; tatkālada manuṣyar śatavarṣa
jīvigaḷuṁ, saptaratni pramāṇōtsēdharuṁ, rūkṣōpavarṇaruṁ,
vēḷatrayu bhōji(vāsi)gaḷuṁ appar; paścimatīrthakarara kaḍeyoḷ
śalākā puruṣarillade, varṇasaṅkarādi duścaritaṅgaḷ perci, duḥṣamakālaṁ
sahasra varṣaṁ pōdandu, pāṭalīputra(ra)doḷ, śiśupāḷanembarasaṅgaṁ
pr̥thvīsundarigaṁ, caturmukhanappa kalkirājaṁ, mahāsaṁvatsara yōga
sanni(ṁvi)dhānadoḷ puṭṭi, saptati varṣaṁ paramāyuṣyanuṁ, nālvattu
varṣaṁ rājyaṅgeyyuttirduddu, tombhattāṟu bhēdada pāṣaṇḍigaḷumaṁ
ājñāvaśīkr̥taṁ pātaṁmāḍi, sukhamirdondu divasaṁ, samumayigaḷoḷ
ennājñeyaṁ mīṟuvaroḷarilleṁ(reyeṁ)du mantrigaḷaṁ besagoḷe,
nirgrantharumaṇagāraliṅgigaḷkoḷareṁ(rilleṁ)buduṁ, avara negaṟteḻtiga
ḷentendu besagoḷe mattaṁ avar intendar.

pāṇipātrapuṭāhārigaḷuṁ i(vā)ḷāgramātramamuppaḍaṁ dhanamuṁ
icchayisadaruṁ, ahiṁsābrata rakṣaṇārthaṁ vasana, varṇa, valkaḷādi
pracchādana parivarjitaruṁ, jñānamuṁ, tapamumuṁ sādhisalendu dēha
sthiti nimittaṁ, caturthaṣaṣṭhāṣṭamu māsādyupavāsa pūrvakaṁ, dēhi
vacanamilladaṅga darśanamātradoḷ, tamuge yōgyamappa āhāramuṁ
koḷvaruṁ; tīkṣṇavātīkṣṇadoḷaṁ, sītasurabhi, candanānu lēpanadoḷaṁ
samānadarśanaruṁ, kṣutpipāsāpraśamana hētugaḷumappa, phalamūla
salilādigaḷoḷ, yōgyakāladoḷ sārirdoḍaṁ, peṟaṟkuḍakurḍadudumamu
prāsukamumuṁ, pāṣaṇḍigaḷante koḷḷadaruṁ, pakkigaḷante aniyayutā
vāsaruṁ, anavarataṁ jñāna, dhyāna parāyayuṇaruṁ, giri, guhā, kanda
rādi vāsigaḷuṁ, jaṅgamamu siddha pratimegaḷumappa digambarar ninagājñā
vidhēyarallar embuduṁ. kalkirājaṁ muḷidu avara pāṇipātragatamappa
āhāradagrapiṇḍamamu neḷedukoḷḷimembuduṁ, arasanājñegaḷki, paricāra
kapōrge, tapōdhanar(kēḷa)kuḍadirpuduṁ, krōduṅkrodhāruṇīkr̥ta viḷō

cananuṁ, sañcaḷaddraśaddarśanavasananuṁ, viracita bhrukuṭi puṭanuṁ, ativikaṭa
nāsāpuṭanuṁ, atiprakampitānanuyugaḷanu māgi, tāne piṇḍamamuneḷedu
koḷaleṁ(diṁ)du pōpāgaḷadhigamamu samyagdr̥ṣṭiyappa surēndranada
naṟidu bandu, kalkirājanaṁ vajradiniṟidukolvuduṁ, prathamamu narakakke
pōgi, sāgarōpamaṁmuṁ duḥkhamanamunantucaturmukhanubhavisuṇutirdaṁ.
pūrvācāryara vr̥ttaṁ:
kaviparamēśvara racitaṁ jinadharmadīpikāṣṭakadoḷagaṇa vr̥ttaṁ;

āgaḷ kalkirājana maganajītañjayaṁ, cēlakādēviverasubandu
surēndraṅge śaraṇpoṇbokku, samyagdarśana ratnamuṁ kaikoḷe, jinēndra
dharma mahātmyamuṁ kaṇḍandiṁ baṟiyuṁyaṁ, sarvapāṣaṇḍi vijr̥mbhaṇaṁ
upaśamise, jinadharmame kelavukālaṁ nirantarāyamāgi naḍeye,
sāyira varṣakkorvaṁ kalkirājanāgi, duṣṣamadoḷippattorvar
kalkirājaratikrāntarappuduṁ, ellariṁ kaḍeya kṣatriyuṁyaṁ jalamanthana
nomboṁ, ellariṁ kaḍeyuya r̥ṣiyar indrāṅgada śiṣyavīrāṅgada
remborellariṁ kaḍeyarjiyar sarvaśrīyemboḷellariṁ kaḍeya śrāvakana
ggaggiḷanemboṁ, ellariṁ kaḍeya śrāvaki phalguṇasēneyemboḷivarellamamu
yōdhyāganara vāstavyar. duṣṣamakāla nūṟuvarṣameṇṭutiṅgaḷuṁ
padinaydu divasaṁ uṇṭene, kārtikadamāvāsyeyu pūrvāhṇahnadoḷ,
svāti nakṣatradoḷ, mumpēḻdigāraruṁ, ajjiyaruṁ, śrāvakaruṁ,

śrāvakiyaruṁ, sanyasana maraṇadiṁ saudharma kalpadoḷ puṭṭuvar,
andina pūrvāhṇadoḷ dharmakathāvasānamakkuṁ; madhyāhnadoḷ
rājyāvasānamakkuṁ, aparāhṇadoḷ pacana bhōjana, ṣaṭkarmaṅgaḷuṁ,
kuladharma, dēśadharma, nigrranrgranthadhathadharmaṅgaḷuṁ kiḍuguṁ.

atiduṣṣamada modaḷoḷ manuṣyarge viṁśati varṣāyuṣya
mumatibhayamumakkuṁ, mūṟuvare moḷaninaniḍiyaruṁ satatāhāri
gaḷumḷumappar, narakatiryggatiyiṁ bandu, mattaṁ āgatige salvar.
kārpāsa pavasanābhāvadoḷ kelavu kālaṁ pōge, pavarṇavalkalādi vasana
rāgi, kālada kaḍeyoḷ nagnarāgi, śākhāmr̥gadante phalādigaḷanāhāraṁ
goḷvarippattorthāchāsira varṣambaramalpavr̥ṣṭiyāgi, tatkāladoḷ,
kramadiṁ śarīrōtsēdhāyuṣyabuddhyādigaḷkunduguṁ, kālada kaḍe
yoḷaṁ ṣōḍaśa varṣāyuṣyaruṁ, ēkaratni pramāṇōtsēdharuṁ,
asthirādyaśubhasāmunāma karmōdayadiṁ, kr̥ṣṇarūkṣavarṇaruṁ, durbhagaruṁ
dussvasvararuṁ, vikr̥tarūparuṁ, viraḷadantaruṁ, nimagna kapōḷanayanaruṁ,
kṣutpipāsādi bādhitaruṁ, sarāgigaḷāgiyuṁ niḥpratīkāradiṁ maṟugu
varuṁ, ēkavarṇaruṁ appar, ākālada kaḍeyoḷ, nīrellaṁ batti kiḍe,
nelanellaṁ bīḍeviḍuguṁ, maraṅgaḷellaṁ parimāṇaṅgaḷakkuṁ, intīteṟadiṁ
palapuṁ prāṇigaḷ sāyeyeṁ, tatkāladoḷ, vijayārdha parvatada vēdike
yumpaṁyuṁmuṁ, gaṅgā sindhu tīramumpaṁmumuṁ, āśrayisi, mīna, kacchapa,
maṇḍuka, karkaṭakādigaḷanāhāraṁ goṇḍumuḷḷi(mirppar(goḷvaruṁ)bila prava
ṣṭaṣṭharāgi, dvāsaptatihīna kulasambhavaravara śiṣyarapparalliṁ baḻiṟiyuṁ, rasa
mēghamēlaṟaṟu divasaṁ, virasamēghamēlaṟaṟu divasaṁ, kaṭuka mēghamēlaṟaṟu
divasaṁ, rūkṣamēgha mēlaṟaṟudivasaṁ, uṣṇamēgha mēlaṟaṟudivasaṁ, viṣa
mēgha mēlaṟaṟudivasaṁ, kṣāramēgha mēḷaṟaḷudivasaṁ kaḻeḷedu, māṇbuduṁ,
citrettreyemba neladuddadagdhaddhamappeḍeyellaṁ samataḷamakkuṁ.

antappavasarpiṇikālaṁ pōge, kṣīrarasamēghamēlaṟaṟu divasaṁ
kaḻeḷeye neladarūkṣa svabhāvaṁ pattuviḍuguṁ, tannibandhanavarṇa, gandha,
rasa, sparśa, snigdhatvaṁ nelakakkuṁ, baḻiṟiyuṁ amr̥tamēgha mēlaṟaṟu
divasaṁ kaḻeḷedauṣadha, vr̥kṣa, tr̥ṇa, gulmādigaḷutpattiyayukkuṁ, rasamēgha
mēlaṟaṟu divasaṁ kaḻeḷeye, sasyānyādi niṣpatiyāge prāṇigaḷ biladiṁ
poramaṭṭu, tadrasōpayōgadoḷ bāḷvantati duṣṣamaṁmuṁ pōge,

kramadindamāyuṣyamuṁ, śarīrōcchrāyaracchādigaḷuṁ, śubhapariṇāmamu sādhu
vr̥ttigaḷuṁ, pratidinaṁ vr̥ddhige salguṁ, mattaṁ duṣṣamamu prasava(vēśa)
doḷaṁ, viṁśati varṣāyuṣyaruṁ, mūṟuvare moḷaniḍiyarumappa
rallindatta yippattorthāchāsira varṣaṁ pōge, padinaṟuvarkuḷadhararapparava
roḷ,prathamamu kuladharaṁ kiñcidūna caturaratni pramāṇōtsēdhananakkuṁ
kaḍeyayukuḷadharaṁ saptaratni pramāṇōtsēdhanamakkuṁ, avarārendoḍe
kanakanuṁ, kanakaprabhanuṁ, kanakarājanuṁ, kanakadhvajanuṁ, kanakapuṅga
vanuṁ, naḷinanuṁ, naḷinaprabhanuṁ, naḷinarājanuṁ, naḷinadhvajanuṁ,
naḷinapuṅgavanuṁ, padmaprabhanuṁ, padmarājanuṁ, padmadhvajanuṁ, padma
puṅgavanuṁ, mahāpadmanumembarapparavara kāladoḷ, jala, bhūmi,
kālaṅgaḷge sukhānubhōga vr̥ddhiyuṁ, dhānyādigaḷge rasādisvāda
prakarṣavuṁmuṁ, manuṣyarganācāra jugupseyuṁ, lajjeyuṁ, mr̥ga
cāritra viramaṇadiṁ, prakr̥ti, manuṣya saccāritra praśaṁsanamuṁ,
pracchāthadhana pacana bhōjanakriyegaḷuṁ, kṣamā, mārdava, santōṣa
dayādānaṅgaḷuḷuṁḷḷuduṁ, dvēṣamōhādigaḷ tīvramalladudumintivu
modalāge sādhuvr̥ttaṅgaḷuṁ duṣṣamaṅmakāla parisamāptiyoḷaḷukkuṁ.

duṣṣamamusuṣamamu pravēśadoḷ, saptaratni pramāṇōtsēdharuṁ,
viṁśatyuttara śatavarṣāyuṣyarumapparākāladoḷ tīrthakara prādu
rbhāva makkuṁ. tīrthakarappa prāṇigaḷārendoḍe, śrēṇikanuṁ
supārśvanuṁ, aṭaṅkanuṁ, prōṣṭhilanuṁ, kaṭapuvuṁpruvu(ccacchuvuṁ),
kṣatriyanuṁ śrēṣṭhiḷanuṁ, śaṅkhanuṁ, nandananuṁ sunandananuṁ,
śaśāṅkanuṁ, sē(dē)vakanuṁ, prēmuka(ra)nuṁ, rō(rāpa)ṇanuṁ,
raivatanuṁ, nārāyaṇanuṁ, baladēvanuṁ, bhagaḷiyuṁ, (vi)vāgaḷiyuṁ,
dvaipāyananuṁ, kanakapādanuṁ, nāradapādanuṁ, cārupādanuṁ,
satyakaputranumembippattunālvaranukramadoḷ tīrthakararapparavapara
nāmaṅgaḷ.

mahāpadmanuṁ, suradēvanuṁ, supārśvanuṁ, svayumyamprabhanuṁ,
sarvāṅgarvātma(tma)bhūtanuṁ, dēvaputranuṁ, kulaputranuṁ, udaṅkanuṁ,
prōṣṭhiḷanuṁ, jayakīrtiyuṁ, munisuvratanuṁ, aranuṁ, aniḥpāpa
nuṁ, niṣkaṣāyanuṁ, vipuḷanuṁ, nirmalanuṁ, citraguptanuṁ, samādhi
guptanuṁ, svayambhuvu(baranuṁ), anivartiyuṁ, (vi)jayanuṁ.

vimaḷanuṁ, dēvapāḷanuṁ, anantavīryyanumendapparalli, modala
tīrthaṅkaraṁ, saptaratni pramāṇōtsēdhanuṁ, ṣōḍaśōttara śatavarṣā
yuṣyanumakkuṁ, antya tīrthaṅkaraṁ pañcaśata cāpōtsēdhanuṁ, pūrva
kōṭi paramā(varṣā)yuṣyanu makkuṁ. ā kāladoḷ, bharatanuṁ,
dīrghadantanuṁ, ardha(labdha) (mukta)dantanuṁ, gūḍhadantanuṁ,
śrīkṣīṇanuṁ, śrībhūtiyuṁ, śrīkāntanuṁ, padmanuṁ, mahāpadmanuṁ
citravāhananuṁ, vimaḷavāhananuṁ, ariṣṭasēnanumendu pannirvarcakra
vartigaḷappar
candranuṁ, mahācandranuṁ, cakra(candra)dharanuṁ, haricandranuṁ
siṁhacandranuṁ, varacandranuṁ, pūrṇacandranuṁ, su(śubha)candranuṁ,
śrīcandranembombadimbarbaladēvarappar, nandiyuṁ, nandimitranuṁ,
nandiṣēṇanuṁ, nandibhūtiyuṁ, baḷanuṁ, mahābaḷanuṁ, atibaḷanuṁ,
tripr̥ṣṭanuṁ, dvipr̥ṣṭanumendombadimbarkēśavarappar, anibaretadvairi
gaḷappar śrīkaṇṭhanuṁ, harikaṇṭhanuṁ, nīlakaṇṭhanuṁ, aśvakaṇṭhanuṁ,
sukaṇṭhanuṁ, śikhikaṇṭhanuṁ, aśvagrīvanuṁ, hayagrīvanuṁ, mayūra
grīvanuṁ, uttarapurāṇaṁ, antu duṣṣama-suṣamaṁmuṁ pōge, suṣama
duṣṣama prārambhadoḷ, pañcaśatacāpōtsēdhararuṁ pūrvakōṭi
paramāyuṣyaru māge katipayavarṣātikramadoḷ, jaghanyabhōga
bhūmi nirviśēṣamumappalli, modaloḷ padinālvar, manugaḷapparalliyayu
kaḍeyumanu nābhirājanappamāvāge, suṣamumakāladoḷ, madhyamabhōga
bhūmi nirviśēṣamāge, suṣamumasuṣamamembā jiṟaneya kālamuttama
bhōgabhūmi niyōga samānamakkuṁ. intu utsarpiṇiyuṁ pattu
kōṭikōṭi sāgarōpamakālāvasānadoḷ avasarpiṇikālaṁ toḍagu
valli, munna suṣama-duṣṣamamembuttama bhōgabhūmiyukālaṁ moda
lāge, atiduṣṣama prativartanakkekkappattu kōṭi kōṭi sāgarōpama
kālaṁ vartisuguṁ, interaḍīkalpamemba interaḍupavare dvīpada daśavidha
bharatadairāvatadoḷ, anavasthita karmabhūmigaḷaṁ sāmānyadinda
maṟipi.
anādinidhanamappa utsarpiṇi kālada suṣamādi ṣaḍvidha pravartana
mumpēṟdu, vidēhaṅgaḷavasthita karmabhūmigaḷappudaṟindalliyu
manuṣyarge, pañcaśata cāpōtsēdhamuṁ, pūrvakōṭi paramā
yuṣyamuṁ, vyavasthitamakkuṁ. alli tīrthaṅkara, cakravarti, rāma,

kēśavaruṁ, bahutvadiṁ nūṟuvadiṁ baralpadindirpadimbarapparavaḷor
caturgatiyiṁ bandu, pañcamagati(paramapada)bhāgigaḷappa, jīvaṅgaḷpu
ṭṭuguṁ, bhōgabhūmigaḷoḷagatidvayadiṁ bandu puṭṭuvar. sarva
bhōga bhūminivāsigaḷaṁḷuṁ, saudharmīśāna kalpadvayakkaṁ bhavanādi
dēvagatigaṁ salvaruṁ. vidēhadoḷ nirviśēṣa niyōga muḷḷuda
ṟindalliyuvaruttama manuṣyar, anavasthita karmabhūmi nivāsigaḷuṁ,
prakr̥ti manuṣyaruṁ, śalākā puruṣaruṁ, r̥ddhiprāpta muniyaruṁ,
vidyādhara cakravartigaḷuṁ, kāmadēvaruṁ, divyamanuṣyaruṁ, ati
duṣṣamakālavartigaḷumappa karmabhūmi nivāsigaḷ nīcamanuṣyar
avarārendoḍe :
ēkārukaṁ, abhāṣakaṁ, śaṅkhākarṇṇaṁrṇaṁ, karṇaprāvaraṇaṁ, lambakarṇṇaṁrṇaṁ,
śaśakarṇṇaṁrṇaṁ, aśvamukhaṁ, siṁhamukhaṁ, mahiṣimukhaṁ, varāhamukhaṁ,
vyāghramukhaṁ, ulūkamukhaṁ, kapimukhaṁ, matsyamukhaṁ, kāḷa
mukhaṁ, gōmukhaṁ, mēghamukhaṁ, vidyunmukhaṁ, ādarśamukhaṁ,
hastimukhaṁ, lāṅgūlaviṣādigaḷantara dvīpanivāsigaḷ, nīcamanuṣyar,
endintu bharatāvasarpiṇikālavyavahāramuṁmumaṁ, kuladharādipurāṇa
muṁmumaṁmanuttamutsarpiṇikāla vyavahāramuṁmuṁmumaṁ, bhaṭṭārakar bisase kēḷdu,
śrēṇika mahārāja prabhr̥tigaḷ bandisi, nijanivāsakke pōdar.
mattaṁ, ondu divasaṁ, śrēṇikaṁ munnādi mahāpurāṇadoḷ
pēṟdante, tatprayōgyamappa samavasaraṇamaṇḍaḷamaṁ nōḍuttaṁ,
bandaśōkavanadoḷa śōkataru mūladoḷ dhyāna praviṣṭarāgirda,
jīvandhara munigaḷaṁ kaṇḍu, tadrūpa yauvana śubhalakṣaṇādigaḷoḷ,
saṁsaktacittanāgi, sudharmaremba gaṇadhararaṁ, śrutaskandha pāragaraṁ,
vinayadiṁ, ivarārendu besagoḷe, gaṇadhara svāmigaḷintendu besasidar.
jambūdvīpada, bharatada, hēmāṅga viṣayada, rājapuramanāḷvoṁ
satyandharanemboṁ maṇḍaḷikaṁ, ātana mahādēvi vijayeyemboḷ.
mantri, kāṣṭhāṅgārikanemboṁ, purōhitaṁ rudradattanemboṁ āge,
mattondu divasaṁ, arasi garbhagr̥hadoḷ, śayyātaḷagateyāgirdu,
kanakaghaṇṭāṣṭa śōbhitamappa maṇimakuṭamanarasaṁ tanagittudumaṁ,
tannaṁ āśrayisi aśōkataruvaṁ pēṟinōrvaṁ koḍaligoṇḍu
kaḍeye(taṟiye,) piccanna mūlamāgi, mattaṁ kisalayita bāḷa

viṭapiyāgirdudumaṁ, kanasugaṇḍadara phalamēnendarasanaṁ besagoṇḍo
ḍadennaparōkṣadoḷaṣṭalābhabhāgiyumāgiyuṁ, alliṁ baṟiyaṁ, sakaḷa
bhuvana rājyārhanumappa maganaṁ paḍeveyembuduṁ. adaṁ kēḷdu,
harṣaviṣādaṅgaḷoḍanoḍane negaṟduḻdapha phalavuṁ teṟadiṁ, arasanarasiyuṁ
śōkamaṁmanāṟisi, kelavu divasadiṁ, dēvalōkada dēvakumāraṁ,
vijayādēviya garbhakkavatarisirpinaṁ.
mattondu divasaṁ, ā poṟila gandhōtkaṭasemba paradaṁ manō
harōdyānadoḷirda, śīlaguptarembavadhi jñānigaḷaṁ kaṇḍu bandisi,
bhaṭṭārakar besasimenage puṭṭida makkaḷellaṁ alpāyuṣyaṅgaḷāduvinnappa
makkaḷentapparene, śīlaguptarendar, innappa makkaḷ cirañjīvigaḷappa
radakke vinnāṇamāvudendu besagoḷe, ninage puṭṭi satta śiśuvaṁ bisuḍa
ludyānakke nīṁ pōdalli, mattondu śiśuvaṁ kāṇbe yātaṁ sakaḷabhuvana
rājyārhanāgi, kālāntyadoḷ, tapōvidhānapūrvakaṁ muktige salva
nembuduṁ. adanorvaḷ samyagdr̥ṣṭiyuppa yakṣi kēḷuttumirdumī
bhaṭṭārakar besasuvātaṁ, vijayādēviya garbhasthitanakkuṁ, endaṟi
dātaṅgupakāraṅgeyvenendu pōgi, nr̥pabhavanadoḷ rudapantra sannihite
yāgirpraduṁ; basanta kāladoḷondu divasaṁ, purōhitaṁ prabhāta
samayadoḷ, vigatāḷaṅkāreyāgirdarasiyuṁ kaṇḍarasanellirdanendo
ḍarasaṁ pavaḍisirdanendu, kāṇalpaḍeyembuduṁ, iduṁ durnimittaṁ
endaṟidu, purōhitaṁ kāṣṭhāṅgārikana manege dinakarōdayadoḷ
pōgi, pāpabuddhiyiṁ, ēkāntasthaḷakke karedu, ninage bhuvanarājyamāda
pudu, arasanaṁ maraṇapūrvakaṁ hānige salisembuduṁ, adaṁ kēḷdu,
mantriyendaṁ, puḷiyaṁ pullumanaḍaki bāḷvātanaṁ, tannoḷsavāna
māgi naḍapidāḷdaṅgentu polladaṁ bageveṁ, ele rudradatta, nīsappoḍe
buddhiyoḍeyene, ninagī nuḍivudayuktaṁ, endu tanneraḍu kiviyumpu
neraḍukaiyoḷmucci koḷvuduṁ, arasaṅge puṭṭida magaṁ, ninagavaśyaṁ
maraṇahētuvakkuṁ, adaṟiṁ ninage śrēyumappantu negaṟindu pōgi,
purōhitaṁ mūṟaneya divasadoḷ, mahāvyādhi pīḍitanāgi sattu
narakaṁ bokkaṁ.
itta, kāṣṭhāṅgārikanaṁ, nijamaraṇabhayadiṁ, arasanaṁ kolva
kajjamuṁ ettikoṇḍirchāsirvar arasumakkaḷaṁ, gaja, turaga, kaṭaka,

kaṭisūtra, jīvanādigaḷinoḍambaḍisi kūḍikoṇḍu, rājabhavanābhimukha
nāgi barprarpudaṁ, adanaṟidarasaṁ, garuḍayantra nihiteyāgirda mahā
dēviyaṁ kaḷipi, tannaṁ kāṇaloḍaṁ mantriyaṁ pattuviṭṭu, tannoḷkū
ḍidirchāsirvararasugaḷverasu, idiraṁ naḍedu, tumuḷa yuddhadoḷ,
sacivanaṁ beṅkoḷvuduṁ, ātanamagaṁ, kāḷāṅgārikaṁ, tanna tande bhaṅgaṁ
baṭṭupaṁdaṁ kēḷdanēka balasahitanāgi tammayyanaṁ kūḍikoṇḍubandara
sanaṁ kādi, kondu, tammayyanaṁ rājyadoḷ iṟisuvuduṁ.
ittaṁ, vijayādēviyuṁ, garuḍayantramanēṟi, pitr̥vanakkiruḷu
pōgi, yakṣiprabhāvadiṁ vigata śarīra bādheyāgi, maganambaḍadu, rājya
vibhavamuṁmaṁ, arasanuṁmuṁ nenedu, śōkaṅgeyvuduṁ; yakṣi bārisi,
ninna magaṁ pageyaṁ nirmūlanaṁ geyva, ninna śōkamuṁ piṅgisuguṁ.
adaṟiṁ snāna bhōjanādigaḷoḷ negalvudu, buddhikṣayamuṁmaṁ,
śarīrakṣayamuṁmaṁ mālpa śōkamuṁmaṁ pattuviḍuvudendanēka yukti
gaḷiṁ arasiyu duḥkhamanāṟisirpannegaṁ; mumpēṟda gandhōtkaṭaṁ,
tanna śiśumr̥takamaṁ tandu, parētavanadoḷ bisuṭuṁ pōguttaṁ aḷva
kūsina svaramaṁ kēṟdu, jīyyjīyuyendu bhāvisi, jīvandharanāmu
hētuvacana prayōgapūrvakaṁ, munnādēśaṅgeyda munivacanaṁ satya
vendu nambi, tatsamīpakkevarpraduṁ; ātana svaradiṁ arasi gandhō
tkaṭanappudanaṟidu, tannanaṟipi, nīnī maganaṁ pēṟaraṟiyadantu naḍa
pendu kuḍuvuduvāta(na)nettikoṇḍu bandu, tanna peṇḍati nandege
puniyune muḷidante geyda, bāḷevāḷe maganaṁ sattanendenna kaiyoḷi
ttendu maganaṁ koṭṭu, maṅgaḷakriyeyaṁ māḍi, jīvandhara
nendu pesaraniṭṭu naḍavuttirpinaṁ. ittaṁ, vijayādēvi garuḍayantra
doḷ, daṇḍakāraṇyada tāpasāśramadoḷ meygeredire, yakṣi vividha
prakāradinākeya manamanāṟisuttirpinaṁ.
ittaṁ, satyandhara mahārājana kiṟiyarasiyappa, bhāmāratigaṁ
anaṅga(tra)patākegaṁ, puṭṭida madhuranuṁ, nakuḷanumembirvartaneya
rumuṁ, gandhōtkaṭaṁ naḍape, beḷedu, parigr̥hīta śrāvakabratarāgi,
seṭṭiyu maneyoḷirpinaṁ; ā poṟiloḷ. jinapatimatāvalambigaḷappa
sēnāpati vijayaṅgaṁ, vijayāvatigaṁ, dēvasēnanemba maganādoṁ;
purōhitanappa sāgaraṅgaṁ, śrīmatigaṁ, buddhiṣēṇanemboṁ maga

nādoṁ; seṭṭi dhanapāḷaṅgaṁ, śrīdattegaṁ, paradattanemboṁenda maganādoṁ;
mantripatisāgaragaṁ, anupamegaṁ, madhumukhanemba maganādoṁ;
nandeyemboḷgaṁ, nandāḍhyanemba maganāge, jīvandharanoḍane madhura,
nakuḷādigaḷaṟuvaruṁ sahapāṁśukrīḍitarāge, mattondu divasaṁ,
udyānavanadoḷ, gō(bā)ḷakādi krīḍeyoḷirda kumāraranorvaṁ
tāpasa vēṣadharaṁ kaṇḍu, polililligenitu(ge)ṇṭendu besagoḷe, bahiru
dyānadoḷirdu, polilenituṁ(sugeṁ)ṭendēke besagoḷvirnimage vr̥ddhatva
dina jñānate pōgadembuduṁ; jīvandharana śubhalakṣaṇāṅgōpāṅgagaḷaṁ
kaṇḍu, gambhīradhvaniyuṁ kēḷduṁ, ītaṁ mahāprabhāvaṁ, rāja kula
sambhavanakkumendu, tadvaṁśa parīkṣegeyvanenduṁ, enage uṇalkiḍa
vēṟpudene, kumāranātanoḍagoṇḍu seṭṭiyallige pōgi, bhōjanā
rthitvadindītaṁ bandenna bēḍidoḍe, koṭṭenidakke, nīmē pramāṇa
membuduṁ, kumārana vinaya vr̥ttige santōṣambaṭṭappikoṇḍā
pumindimbaṭiyumabhyāgatareppa pakkadubbarannigaṁ, magane, nīnuṇba
dembuduṁ. bāḷasvabhāvadindaṁ, kūḷ bisiyendattu tāyuṁ
kadarthisuvaduṁ, tāpasavēṣadharaṁ, kumāranaranendaṁ, nīṁ prāyudoḷ
kiṟiyeṁ, prajñāguṇadoḷadharīkr̥ta, sakaḷa vipvajjana dhīyuṁ, adaṟi
naṟilvēḍene, kumāraṁ rōdana guṇavaṁlleṁ nīmaṟiyude nuḍidireṁ
dintendaṁ:

enda magana nuḍiyaṁ kēḷdu janani santōṣambaṭṭu, sahāyasahita
mūḍuvudupāgaḷ, seṭṭiyumpuṇḍubandu, sukhōpaviṣṭanāgire,
tāpasavēṣadharanendaṁ; ninna maganakṣaragrahaṇapūrvakaṁ, sakaḷaśāstrapāragaṁ
māṟisviṁ, enagappayisimene, seṭṭiyendanāṁ paramuśrāpakanēnanyaliṅgi
gaḷge namaskāraṁ geyvunalleṁ, nīvuṁ paraliṅgigaḷ, namaskāraṁ geyya
dandu, nimage vaimanasyamakkumembuduṁ; ātanātmāsadbhāvamaṁ
intendaṟipidoṁ:
āṁ siṁhapuramanāḷveṁ, āryumurṇembeṁ arasaneṁ, vīra
nandigaḷemba yativarara samīpadoḷ dharmamuṁ kēḷdu, samyagdarśa

namuṁ kaikoṇḍu, dhr̥tiṣēṇaṅge rājyamuṁ koṭṭu, sarvasaṅga parityā
gadiṁ saṁyamamuṁ kaikoṇḍu, jaṭharāgni vijr̥mbhita mahādāhabhagna
parīṣaha jayunenīvēṣadoḷirdenāṁ, samyagdr̥ṣṭiyeṁ, ninna sahadharmi
yenemyembuduṁ; ātana treṟinanaṟidu vātsalyadiṁ kumāranibandhana rahasya
manātaṅgaṟipi, palaru kumārarberasappaysiyese, sakaḷaśāstra pāraga
rmāmāḍe, kālāntyadoḷ tāpasavēṣadaraṁ saṁyamadharanāgi, śivapadakke
sandaṁ. ittaṁ, kumāranuṁ jauvanaṁ neṟeyeṁṟiye, kāḷakūṭanemba byāda
nāyukaṁ anēka kirātabalamberasu bandu, poliṟala tuṟuvepellamuṁmaṁ
koṇḍu pōge, tadvārteyuṁ kēḷdu, kāṣṭhāṅgārika nr̥pati turuvaṁ
maguḷcidaṅge, gōpēndraṅge, gōpaśrīgaṁ puṭṭida gōdāvariyuṁ
kuḍuvenendu gōsanegaḷeyise, kāḷāṅgārikanoḍane jīvandharaṁ sahāya
sahitaṁ pōgi, bēḍavaḍeyuṁ geldu, tuṟuvaṁ nuguḷci, mahōtsāhadiṁ
poliṟilaṁ puge, vaiśyaputrana sāhasakke mecci nandāḍhyaṅge gōdāvariyuṁ
kuḍe sukhamirdar.

ittaṁ, jambūdvīpada, bharatakṣētrada, vijayārdhada, dakṣiṇa
śrēṇiyu, gaganavallabhapuramanāḷva, garuḍavēga vidyādharaṁ dāyigara
deseyiṁ mānabhaṅgamāge, ratnadvīpada manujōdayamemba giri
yoḷ, ramaṇīyamemba poṟilaṁ paḍedu sukhamirpinaṁ, ātaṅgaṁ,
dhāriṇīdēvigaṁ puṭṭida, gandharvadatte mattondu divasamupavāsaṁ
geydu parimlānagātreyāgi jinapatiyaṁ bandisi, sēseyuṁ koṇḍu
bandu tanage koṭṭaḷaṁ kaṇḍu, garuḍavēgaṁ ī kanyakiyunārge kuṇḍuva
mendu matisāgaranemba mantriyuṁyaṁ besagoḷe mandarada, nandanavanada
pūrvadigbhāgada jinagr̥hamuṁmaṁ pradakṣiṇaṅgeydu bandisi, vipuḷamatiyemba
cāraṇaranāṅkaṇḍu namaskāraṅgeydu, dharmamuṁmaṁ kēḷdu, bhaṭṭārakaraṁ
besasimenduṁ, arasanamagaḷ gāndharvadattegāvoṁ patiyukkumendāṁ
besagoḷe—

jambūdvīpada, bharatada, hēmāṅga viṣayada, rājapuramanāḷva,
satyandhara nr̥patigaṁ, vijayādēvigaṁ puṭṭida jīvandharaṅge, vīṇāsvayaṁ
baradoḷ gāndharvadatte bhāryeyuyakkumendarendu, matisāgaraṁ
binnapaṅgeyke, bhūmigōcararoḷ vaivāhikasambandhamemupemagapūrvaṁ,
adentakkumendu garuḍavēgaṁ besagoḷe, mantri tanna munne kēḷdudaṁ

intendaṟipidaṁ— ā poṟiloḷe vr̥ṣabhadattaśrēṣṭhigaṁ, padmāvatigaṁ
puṭṭida jinadattanindamamumemage kāryasiddhiyakkumumadentene— tatpura
doḷ, prītivardhana vanadoḷirda, sāgarasēna kēvaḷigaḷige kēvalī
pūjeyaṁ māḍalendu, bhuvanatrayaṁ nereye, nimmayyanoḍane nīnuṁ
tadarcanārthadiṁ pōgi, jinadatta seṭṭiyaṁyuṁ kaṇḍu, dharmavātsalyadiṁ,
vr̥ṣabhadattanoḷ, snēhasambandhamāge, ninagaṁ vr̥ṣabhadattaṅgaṁ nānā
tratvarahitamamuppatiprītiyāge, seṭṭi tanna padaviyoḷ, jinadattanaṁ nilisi,
guṇapāḷamuniyarapakkade dīkṣegoṇḍaṁ; padmāvatiyuṁ subrateyaralli
tapambaṭṭaḷ.

ittaṁ, jinadattanuṁ seṭṭiyapadadoḷnindu, manōrame moda
lāge bhāryeyurveyarberasu sukhadiṁ kālaṁ sale, kelavudivasakkaṁ, ī
dvīpakke barkumātanaṁ, nimmāptajanamumanaṭṭi tarisikoḷvamātaniṁ
kāryasiddhiyakkumembuduṁ; baḷādhikanemba vidyādharanaṁ, garuḍavēga
naṭṭidoḍātaṁ bandu māyadiṁ yānapātraṅgaḷ maḷahōtpāta pavanabhinnaṁ
gaḷādante māḍe, jinadattaṁ pramādavalageyuṁ piḍidu, jaḷadhitīramamu
neydu bare, baḷādhikaṁ kaṇḍu, nīnārgettaṇiṁ bandeyene, tanna poṟilu
manalliyu jinabhavanaṅgaḷaṁ baṇṇise, jinadattaṁ nīnennanalligoyveṁyvudeṁ
buduṁ, baḷādhikanaḷagavāhanamumanēṟisi, gaganamārgadiṁ tanna poṟilelge
vandu, māyāprapañcadiṁ maḍagida, yāna pātragatamappa tatparijana
ratna suvarṇādigaḷaṁ tōṟi, manakṣatamuṁ piṅgisi, majjana bhōjanādi
gaḷiṁ sanḷiṁsatōṣaṁ baḍisi, gandharvadatteyuṁ svayambaravivāhakke jīvandha
rana poṟilgeyvenlguyvudendu garuḍavēgaṁ pēṟi, jinadattanākeyuṁ svayaṁ
bara ghōṣaṇāpūrvakaṁ, manōharōdyānakkoyduyye, sakaḷakaḷākōvida
rappaviyujcaccara, bhūmigōcara janaṁ nereye, jinapūjāpūrvakaṁ,
svayamyumbaragr̥hamuṁmaṁ pokku, svara, grāma, mūrchanā, layādi ghaṭi
tamuṁ, śuddha dēśi janita lakṣaṇa gīta miśramumumumppa vādyamuṁmumaṁ,
palaruṁ tōṟi, jīvandhara kumāraṁ gāndharvadatteyuṁ mahābhimā
niyunadhaḥkarisalendu, sabhāgr̥hamuṁmaṁ pokku, sabhāsadarellaṁ śrōtr̥gaḷā
gire, nirdōṣamappa bīṇeyaṁyuṁ tappudene, gāndharvadatte nālkalkuydu
bīṇeyaṁyuṁ tandu mundikke, tantri prabhr̥tigaḷoḷ kēśa lōmalavāpādi
darśanadiṁ nirākarise, sughōṣeyemba bīṇeyaṁyuṁ tannimene, tānadaṟi

nirdōṣateyumumanadara(banda) sambandhamumanaṟi vaḷappadaṟiṁ taṟisi
kuḍe, sughōṣeyuṁ koṇḍu, śāstrānusāriyuyappa gītamiśravādyadinati
madhuramāge bājise, mr̥gaṅgaḷellaṁ gōregoṇḍubandu sabhāmuṇmaṇḍa(la)
pamuṁ puge, viśiṣṭa janamevellaṁ mecci biccaṟise, tanna sōlamumanaṟipi,
gāndharvadatte jīvandhara kumāraṅge māleyunikke, kāṣṭhāṅgārika sutā
digaḷappa duṣṭarellamondāgi kanneyunebidukoḷalbare, jīvandharaṁ baḷā
dhikamberasu, tanna sahāyarellaruṁ kūḍikoṇḍu, jayuyagiriyemba gandha
kariyunēṟi ripubalakkidiraṁ naḍeye, garuḍavēga vidyādharaṁ madhyastha
nāgirdu, kāṣṭhāṅgārikaṁ kṣubhita bala praśamumanaṅgeyye, vivāha parisamā
ptiyoḷ, iṣṭaviṣayuya kāmabhōgaṅgaḷananubhavisuttaṁttuṁ, jīvandharanuṁ
gāndharvadatteyuṁyumire—

basanta kāladoḷ, suranagarōdyāna krīḍānimittamarasambera
sellaruṁ pōge, tatpurada paradaṁ vaiśravaṇadattaṅgaṁ, cūtamañjarigaṁ
puṭṭida, suramañjariyemboḷa cēṭaki śyāmalateyemboḷ candrō
dayuyamembutkaṭa gandhamappa cūrṇārṇavāsamuṁmaṁ koṇḍadaṟindaggaḷaṁ pēḷampeṟi
villenllindā nesevadoḷ tannarasiyuṁ pogaḷuttuṁ bare, kumā(bē)radatte
vaiśyaṅgaṁ, vimumaḷegaṁ puṭṭida guṇamāleyu cēṭaki vidyurlateyeṁ
boḷ, sūryōdayuyamemba cūrṇārṇavāsamumanidarindaggaḷaṁ prakr̥ṣṭa
gandhamillendu, tanno(nnā)ḷoḷa guṇamuṁmaṁ prakaṭise, maccaramāge, paṇḍita
sabhege vare, gandhadvayada guṇaviśēṣamuṁmaṁ parīkṣisalārumaṟiyadire,
jīvandhara kumāranivaṟoṟioḷ candrōdayuyame viśiṣṭagandhamumadanenta
ṟiyalakkumenderaḍu kayyoḷameraḍumuṁmaṁ pūse, candrōdayuyamuṁ
tumbigaḷ musuṟi, kaṇḍellarumumadaṁ praśaṁśe geydoḍaṁ(raṁ)diṁ
baṟiyaṁ, suramañjarigaṁ, guṇamālilegaṁ atyanta vātsalyamuppina
morme, nagara janaṅgaḷ vanavihāradoḷirdudondu śunakanaṁ kaṇḍu,
bāḷaviṭa janaṅgaḷ baṟiyaṁ taguḷeḷi, bhayuyadiṁ pariyuttumondu
maḍuvinoḷ birduddu, kaṇṭhagataprāṇanāgirdudaṁ, tanna paricārakariṁ
tarisi, jīvandhara kumāranadakke pañcanamaskāra padaṅgaḷaṁ pēṟi,
candrōdayuya giriyoḷ, sudarśananemba yakṣanāgi puṭṭi, tanna pūrva
bhavamuṁ nenedu bandu, ninna prasādadindinitaneydedenendu jīvandhara
kumāranaṁ pūjise, janaṅgaḷellaṁ vismayaṁ baḍe, ninagondu kāraṇamāvā
dāgaḷennaṁ nenevudendu nija nivāsakke pōdaṁ.

itta, vanavihāradoḷ nagarajanaṅgaḷellaṁ maguḻdu bare, kāṣṭhāṁ
gārikana koṇḍāṭadaśanivēgavemba gandhagajaṁ, masagi suramañjari
yēṟi barpa rathakkabhimukhamāvāgi pariye, jīvandharaṁ dvātriṁśatkrīḍe
gaḷoḷā gajamaṁ gelvuduṁ; nagarajanamellaṁ praśaṁsegeyye, suramañjari
yuṁ mayumpananyapuruṣasādhāraṇamappa jīvandharana yauvanādi guṇaṅgaḷge
sōlvuduṁ. adanaṟidākeyayu tāyuṁ tandeyuṁ gandhōtkaṭa
śeṭṭiyanoḍambaḍisi, jīvandharaṅge suramañjariyoḷvaḷvivāhamaṁ māḍe,
kāṣṭhāṅgārika nr̥panadellamaṁ kēḷdu, tanna gandhagajamanatikramisida
nendu, jīvandharaṅge muḷidu, vaiśyasutaṅge śuṇṭhi, hippaliyaṁ māṟi
bāḷvudallade, rājavr̥ttamumatigarvamumeydidavanaṁ kollendu, caṇḍa
daṇḍanemba taḷāṟanaṁ mēle vēḷvuduṁ. jīvandharaṁ nijasahāya sahita
mātaṅgidiraṁ naḍedu, tadbalakke bhaṅgamaṁ māḍe, mattaputramarasaṁ muḷi
danēka balamanaṭṭiṭṭe, kāṣṭhāṅgārikaṁ tāne bare, balamenituṁ bandirpu
dendu, jīvandharaṁ mumpēṟduḻdaya yakṣanaṁ nenevuduṁ, ātaṁ bandu,
vijayagiriyemba gandhakariyayunēṟisi, tanna nelege koṇḍu pōge,
nandādya prabhr̥tigaḷappa sahāyaruṁ, bandhugaḷaṁ kumāranetta pōda
nendaṟiyayude beṟagāgirpuduṁ. gāndharvadatte tānadellamanaṟidu,
nīvidakkēnumañjadiri, kumāraṅge bhayamillendaṟipe, sudarśana
yakṣaṁ kelavudivasamirisi, kumārana gamanābhiprāyamaṁ aṟidu,
kāmarūpiṇiyemba mudrikeyaṁ koṭṭondu parvatamanēṟisi, kumā
raṅge bhayamonvondumillendu pōdaṁ.

itta, jīvandharaṁ kiṟideḍeyuṁ pōgi, candrābha nagaramaneydi,
tatpurādhipaṁ dhanapati nr̥patigaṁ, tiḷōttamegaṁ puṭṭida padmōttameyaṁyuṁ
pāvukoḷe, nirviṣaṁ māṟpōṟpātaṅgenna magaḷumanardharājyamumaṁ
koḍuvenendu gōsane gaḷeye, munnamādityamunivararādēśaṅgeydayduda
dariṁ, kanyālōbhadiṁ bandu, palarumettalāṟadire, paricārakar vaidyara
narasuttaṁttuṁ bandu, jīvandharanaṁ kaṇḍu, ninage vaidyajñānamuṇṭilleṁ
buduṁ, emmaṟivanitu kiṟiduṇṭillendu pōgi, yakṣanaṁ nenedu,
viṣadhara mantradinabhimantrisi, rājakannikeyanettetti, kumārana śubhalakṣa
ṇādigaḷiṁ rājaputranendu paricchēdisi, tanna magaḷumanardharājyamumaṁ
kuḍe, koṇḍu, kanyakigoḍavuṭṭida lōkapāḷa prabhr̥tigaḷappa mūvattettī

rvaroḷanumati snēhamāge, kelavudivasamallidāddārggaṁ pēṟiḻide pōgi,
kṣēmaviṣayada, kṣēmapurada manōharōdyānada sahasrakūṭa jinā
layamaṁ balagoṇḍu bandisuvuduṁ alliya campakavr̥kṣamāvāgaḷe kusu
mitamāvāge, munna mūguvaṭṭirda kōgilegaḷāgaḷe madhuradhvanigeyye,
jinabhavanasamīpadoḷāgaḷe tīvida koḷadoḷkamala kuvaḷayādi kusu
maṅgaḷalare, mattamadhukaraṅgaḷ jhēṅkārita mukharitaṅgaḷāge, jina
bhavana gōpuradvāraṅgaḷtamage tāme teṟeye, kumāranā koḷado
ḷprenḷḷindu, jalakusumaṅgaḷaṁ tandu, jinapatiyunarcisi namaskāraṁ
geyyuttirpinaṁ.

ā pōṟipoḻala subhadraseṭṭigaṁ, nivr̥ttigaṁ puṭṭida kṣēmasaundarige
patiyuppādēśa puruṣana baravaṁ, munna vinayandhara muniyarādēśadi
nāḍa kuṟiṟupugaḷanalli parīkṣisuttirdavar bandaṟipe, seṭṭi tānēnepōgi,
kumārananoḍagoṇḍu bandu, tannamagaḷaṁ koṭṭu, munna rājapura
doḷirpandenage, satyandhara mahārājanitta billumambugaḷumivu ninageye
takkuvumendu, kuḍe, koṇḍu, sukhamirpinavondudivasaṁ—

gāndharvadatte vidyābaladiṁ bandu, jīvandharana kuśalavārteyuṁ
koṇḍu peṟaraṟiyayudantu rājapurakke pōgire, kelavudivasaṁ jīvaṁ
dharaṁ bāṇāśanahastrasāstanāgi pōgi, sujanamemba viṣayada, hēmābha nagara
maneydi, tatpuramanāḷva dr̥ḍhamitra narapatigaṁ, naḷinādēvigaṁ puṭṭida
hēmābheyemboḷa jaḷjanmadinadoḷōrvanādēśaṅgeyduṁydaṁ, manōharō
dyānadoḷ janaṁ neradalli kha(ba)ḷūrikācchēdanavyāyāmadoḷāvanorva
neccambu guṟiyaṁ muṭṭade maguḻdu keḍegumātane hēmābhege pati
yakkumene, tatkanyakā grahaṇalōbhadinalli dhanurbryārbyāyāmaṅgeyvutti
rdaraṁ kaṇḍu, kelakke pōge, dhanurvidyeyoḷninagabhyāsamuḷḷoḍeccaccu
tōṟembuduṁ; apara śarāsanadoḷ śāstrapramāṇadiṁ dōṣōdbhavaṁ
geydondu, madhyamalakṣaṇamappa billumambumaṁ koṇḍese, guṟiyaṁ
muṭṭade maguḻdu keḍuvumumadaṁdamaṁ kaṇḍu, keyvaṟiguṭṭi keladoḷi
rdarellaṁ nage, nāṇci, jīvandharaṁ tanna billumambumaṁ koṇḍu,
guṟiyaṁ koḷeyesevudumudaṁdamaṁ kādirdavaraṟisuva baḷḷiye kāldoḍa
rdantādudendu, paridarasaṅgaṟipe, tatsuteyuṁ muyaṁmaduve nilttu, guṇa
mitra, bahumitra, sumitra, dhanamitrādigaḷappa tanna mamuydunarkaḷaṁ,

vividha(vi)jñānadoḷ dr̥ḍhaṁ māḍi, pūrvakr̥ta puṇyaphalamananubhavisu
ttirpinaṁ.

gandharvadatte, jīvandharanallige pōpa barpa teṟananaṟiyade,
nandāḍhyanondu divasaṁ, puṁścaḷiyante nīnellige pōgi barpeyeṁ
buduṁ, gandharvadatte maṅmuṅguḷnage nakku, nīnumenna pōdeḍeyune
yduva bageyuḷḷaḍe, nimmammiṇṇandirupaṁ nenedu, smarataraṅgiṇiyemba
śayanadoḷirdoḍāgaḷe kāṇbeyembuduṁ, andiniruḷoḷāśayanataḷa
doḷirdona nabhōgāminī vidyeyiṁ śayanasahitaṁ jīvandharana samīpa
doḷikkuvuduṁ(ḷoydu kūḍuvuduṁ), jīvandharanuṁ nandāḍhyanuṁ
ōrōrvaraṁ kaṇḍappikoṇḍu sukhaparipraśnapūrvakamirdar.

ittaṁ, sujana viṣayada, śōbhānagaramanāḷva, dr̥ḍhamitra narapati
gaḷaṇṇaṁ sumitraṅgaṁ, vasundharādēvigaṁ puṭṭida, śrīcandreyemboḷ
navayauvanōdayadoḷ, tanna gr̥hāṅgaṇadoḷāḍupava, kapōtamithu
namaṁ kaṇḍu, jātismareyāgi, mūrchege salvuduṁ. adaṁ kaṇḍu,
parijanaṁ vyākuḷarāgi, śītaḷakriyeyiṁyi neccaṟisi, tāyuṁ tandeyu
mirdur, tiḷakacandrikeya magaḷappa ḷakasundariyemba, śrīcandrikeya
cēṭakiyuṁ karedu(kaṇḍu), kapōtamithuna darśanadināda mūrchākāraṇa
manāraydu barpudendaṭṭuvuduṁ. ākebandu vinayōpacāra, priyuya,
madhura vacanadiṁ kanyakiyuṁ besagoṇḍaṟidu bandu, tadīya mātā
pitr̥gaḷigintendu cēṭaki pēḷdaḻdaḷ. nimma magaḷībhavakke mūṟaneya
bhavadoḷ, hēmāṅgada viṣayada, rājapurada, ratnatējanemba paradaṅgaṁ,
ratnamāḷigaṁ, anupameyemba magaḷāgi, kanakatējaṅgaṁ, suvarṇatēja
nemba maganādoḍanupameyaṁ suvarṇatējaṅge kuḍuvevenvamendu, munne
tāyuṁ, tandeyuṁ, ātanaṁmeccade, māṇika vaiśyaputranappa guṇa
mitraṅge kuḍe, mattondu divasaṁ, ambōnidhi nadi vistaraṇadoḷ
guṇamitraṁ, viṣamāvarta pradēśanimagnanāgi sāvuduṁ. anupameyuṁ
alliye pāydu sattu, rājapurada, gandhōtkaṭa seṭṭiya saudhavanado
ḷirvaruṁ, pavanavēganuṁ, rativēgeyumbemyumemba kapōtamithunamāgi,
bāḷakākṣara grahaṇadoḷ, akṣarābhyāsaṅgeydu, śrāvaka niyōgadoḷ
upaśamabhāvamaṁ pordi, munninabhavada paraspara snēhadiṁ, nivartanā
vartana nētraṁ, ghūrṇamaṇḍaḷīkaraṇa, kaṇṭhapūraṇa, gaṇḍādvāpana, pakṣa

paṭi paṭīkaraṇa, madhurakūkuharaṇa, samutthita pakṣa mūḷa kaṇḍūyana,
tvarita padavikṣēpaṇa, viyullaṅghana, dharaṇī patanādi kriyāpariṇata viśēṣa
pariṇataṅgaḷāgi sukhamirpinaṁ. suvarṇatējaṁ, pūrvabhava vairadiṁ,
mārjāranāgi, kapōtiyaṁ pāydu piḍiye, kapōtanuṁ, pakṣa, nakha,
tuṇḍa, tāḍana, hanana, vidhiyiṁ adaṁ baḍise, mattondudivasaṁ, nagara
pratyāsanna parvatada biladoḷoḍdiḍḍida(ṅgaḷoḷirda) baleyoḷ kapōtaṁ
silki, tanna patiya vr̥ttāntamaṁ gr̥hajanakke nijatuṇḍadoḷbaredu
tōṟi, kapōti tadviyōgadiṁ sattu, bandu nimage magaḷ śrīcandre
yādaḷembuduṁ, nijātmajeya patiyunaṟiyalavara sambandhamellamaṁ
paṭadoḷbaredu tāyuṁ, tandeyuṁ, raṅgatējanuṁ, madanalēkhe
(madhulate)yumemba naṭanaṭiyu kayyoḷ sanmānapūrvakaṁ kuḍu
vuduṁ, avarīrvaruṁ puṣpakavanadoḷ paṭavaṁ pasarisi nr̥tyavidhāna
doḷirpuduṁ.

itaṁ, sumitranarapatiyuṁ, vanavihārakke pōgi, samādhigupta
muniyuraṁ kaṇḍu bandisi, dharmaśravaṇānantaramennamagaḷa pūrvabhavada
patiyullirdapanembuduvāmātaṁ, hēmā nagaradoḷirdanene, naṭanaṭi pari
vārasahitaṁ sumitraṁ hēmābha nagarakke pōgi, nāṭakamaṁ māḍe, nereda
janaroḍane nandāḍhyaṁ bandadaṁ kaṇḍu, jātismaranāgi mūrchevōge,
śītaḷakriyegaḷineccarise, jīvandharanidēnendu besagoḷe, paṭadoḷbareda
nijacarita sambandhamanaṟipe, pavanavēganemba kapōtanēnenīmaneyoḷ
beḷedu, ninagīgaḷtammanāgi puṭṭidenembuduṁ, tatprapañcamanaṟidu
vivāha sambandhakke, jinamahāmahimeyunoḍarci, jīvandhara sumitra
nirpinamākṣaṇadoḷ, harivikramanemboṁ, kirātapati tanna dāyigargaḷki
pōgi, kapitthavanada diśāgiriyoḷ tanage nagaraṁ māḍi, harivikramaṅgaṁ,
vanagiri sundarigaṁ vanarājanemba maganādo nātaṅgatibaḷanuṁ, vaṭa(jra)
vr̥kṣanuṁ, mr̥tyuvuṁ, citrasēnanuṁ, saindhavanuṁ, ariñjayanuṁ,
śatruvardhananumemba sāmantāgraṇigaḷāge, vanarājana sahāyarappa lōha
jaṅghanuṁ, śrīṣēṇanuṁ nagara śōbhākaradudyānadoḷaṁ krīḍisuttaṁttuṁ,
śrīcandreyaṁyuṁ kaṇḍu, tadīyarūpa guṇānurañjitarāgi pōguttaṁttuṁ,
arasara kudure nīruṇa barpudaṁ(lpōllōpudaṁ) kaṇḍadara kāpinavaranabhibha
visi, kudureyuṁ koṇḍoydu harivikramaṅge koṭṭu, meccuvaḍedu,

vanarājaṅge śrīcandreyu rūpusaundaryamunaṟipe, munnina janma
doḷ tāṁ suvarṇa tējanappadanaṟidu atyāsaktanāgi, nimma ballanda
doḷākeyuṁyaṁ tanni venmendu, piridumoḍavemeyunittu, palarumuṁmaṁ neraṁ
bēḷddi kaḷipe, kannamikki niśāvasānasamumayadoḷ, śrīcandreyuṁ
pavaḍisuva maneyuṁ pokkkukku, lōhajaṅghanuṁ, śrīṣēṇanuṁ, pauruṣa
kāradiṁ śrīcandreyanuydda rendu bareda lēkhapatramumanallikki kanyakiyuṁ
vanarājanalligoyvvāgaḷ.

ittaṁ nēsar mūḍuvuduṁ, arasanōleyuṁ bājisi nōḍi,
kanyakiyu vopoḍavuṭṭidarappa kinnaramitranuṁ, yakṣamitranumemnumba makkaḷaṁ
mundaṭṭi, tānuṁ hēmābhinagaradiṁ poravamaṭṭṭuṭṭu, pe(po)ṟaṟige barutuṁ
tumuḷa yuddhamuṁ vanarājanoḷ poṇarce, tannoḍavuṭṭidarirvaruṁ
kāduvudaṁ kaṇḍandiṁ modalāgenna jinabhavanamuṁ kāṇbannegaṁ, āhāra
(śarīra)nivr̥ttiyendu, maunavratadiṁ śrīcandre irpuduṁ, lōha
jaṅghanuṁ, śrīṣēṇanuṁ, nr̥pabaḷamunabhibhavisi, kanyakiyunuydda
vanarājaṅge kuḍe, viraktacitteyāgirda kanyakiyuṁ nimma ballandadoḷ
oḍambaḍisimendu parijana vaniteyuyaraṁ karedu vanarājaṁ pēṟi, naya
doḷaṁ, bhayadoḷamākegaḷentuṁ noḍambaḍisalāṟadirpinamudaṁ hari
vikramuṁ kēḷdda, pollakeydda rendu baggisi, kanyakiyuṁ tanna magaḷddiḷdda
roḍanirisipaṁ.

ittaṁ, dr̥ḍhamitra prabhr̥tigaḷappa puradvaya bandhugaḷ sannaddha
baḷarāgi bandu, poṟilaṁ muttinile, harivikramuṁ kādalu pōṟapoṟimaḍe,
jīvandharakumāraṁ ī yuddhamembudu bahujana kṣayanimittaṁ,
idaroḷēnendu sudarśana yakṣanaṁ nenedubarisi, kanyakiyuṁ tarisikuḍe,
purajanarellaruṁ maguṟddaḷdda barpāgaḷ, vanarājaṁ matte kādalendubare,
yakṣanātanaṁ piḍidu tandoppise, sēnāramaṇīyavemyumba koḷadoḷātanaṁ
jīvadharaṁ seṟeyoḷikki, tadvanadoḷ carigevokka cāraṇa r̥ṣiyara
nidirgoṇḍu niṟiri, navavidha puṇyadoḷkūḍi, yōgyamuppāhāramaṁ
koṭṭāścarya pañcakamuṁ paḍeyeṁye, jīvandharana dānamuṁ kaṇḍu,
vanarājaṁ tanna bhavasambandhamunaṟidirpinaṁ. harivikramunuṁ baḷasahita
nāgi mēlivarpanaṁ yakṣaṁ piḍidu tandu kumāraṅgoppise, vanarājaṁ

tanna supavarṇatējanāda janmamuṁmuṁmuṁmaṁ, biḍāla janmadoḷ kapōtiyuṁ
piḍida baṟiyuṁ munivara caturgati(vi)varṇanādhyayanamuṁ kēḷdda,
vairasambandhamunuḷidupaśamana bhāvaneyiṁ vanarājanāgi puṭṭidudu
munellargaṁ aṟipuvuduṁ; śrīcandreyunītaṁ pūrvabhava snēhasambandha
dinuyddanallade, garvadindoyddanallendu vanarājanumuṁnuṁmaṁ, harivikramamu
numuṁmaṁ biṭṭu kaḷedu, nagara śōbhānagaramuṁmaṁ pokkkukku, nandāḍhyaṅgaṁ,
śrīcandregaṁ vivāhamuṁmaṁ māḍi, bandhugaḷverasu hēmābhava nagarakke
mumaguṟiḷibi barpāgaḷondu koḷada taḍiyoḷ jīvandharaṁ bīḍaṁ
biṭṭirpuduṁ, nīrdaralendu pōda parijanamuṁmaṁ gandhiḷemākṣikegaḷ
bādhise, jīvandhara kumāraṁ gaṟipuvuduṁ, idaroḷēnānumondu
kāraṇa māgalvēṟkuṁ endu yakṣanaṁ nenedu barise, vidyābaḷanirākaraṇaṁ
geydda vidyādharanaṁ munde tandikke, nīnēnukāraṇadiṁ koḷanaṁ
kādirdeyendu kumāraṁ besagoḷe, khēcaranendaṁ āṁ munne,
rājapurada puṣpadantanemba māḷakāra śrēṣṭhigaṁ, kusumaśrīgaṁ, jāti
bhaṭanemba maganādeṁ, ā pōṟaṟiloḷe, dhanadattaṅgaṁ, nandinigaṁ
puṭṭida, candrābhanembanenanna keḷeyuyanātaṅge, nīnorme dharmatamartatvamu
naṟiputtirdoḍānumalliyeyaṁ kēḷdda, dharmānurakta matiyenāgi,
madyapāṁsa nivr̥ttigeyddaraphaladiṁ, vidyādharanāgi puṭṭi, siddhakūṭa
doḷorvacāraṇaraṁ kaṇḍu vinayayudiṁ bandisi, ninnabhavasambandhamunava
ralli kēḷdda ninagaṟipal bandenendintendaṁ——

dhātakīṣaṇḍada, mūḍaṇa mandarada, pūrvavidēhada, puṣkaḷāvatī
vatī viṣayayuda, puṇḍarīkiṇiyunāḷva, jayandhara mahārājaṅgaṁ,
jayayuvatigaṁ, nījayuyadrathanemba maganāgi vanavihārakke pōgi,
koḷadoḷ, haṁsa śiśuvaṁmaṁ kaṇḍu, cēṭakarindadantarisi, naḍaputtirpina
manmadaṟi mātāpitr̥gaḷākāśadoḷirdu, svarandōṟi, cēṭakanesuvuduṁ,
ambukoḷe, haṁsaṁ nelakkuruḷvuduṁ, ādaṁ kaṇḍu, nimmabbe karuṇisi,
magane, pēṟidēnene, paricārakaraṟipidoḍadaneccātaṅge muḷidu,
baggisi, ninagintu negaṟil takkudaltu, haṁsaśiśuvanadara jananī
saṁyōgaṁ māṟpemṟpudembudumevenna jñānateyinintugeydda nendātmagarha
ṇaṅgeydda haṁsaśiśuvambiṭṭu rājyaṅgeytirdu kelavu divasadu,
pari gr̥hatyāgaṅgeydda, saṁyumuṁmamaṁ kaikoṇḍu, jīvitāntadoḷ,
sahasrāra kalpadoḷpuṭṭi, nīṁ sukhamumananubhavisuttirdaṣṭa daśasāgarōpa

māntadoḷalliṁ bandu, rājapuravanāḷva, satyandhararaṅgaṁ, vijayādēvigaṁ
jīvandharanāgi puṭṭidai; ninna cēṭakaṁ kole satta rājahaṁsaṁ kāṣṭhāṅgā
rikanādoṁ; ā haṁsaśiśuvaṁ adara tāyiyindagalcida phaladiṁ padināru
varṣambaraṁ ninage bandhu viyōgamādudendu vidyādharanaṟipe, nīnenage
kalyāṇabandhuvendātanaṁ pūjisi, hēmābha nagaramuṁ pokkkukku, svajanane
parijana parivr̥taṁ, sukhamumananubhavisuttuṁttaṁ, jīvandhara nirdaṁ.

ittaṁ, rājapuradiṁ, nandāḍhyaṁ pōdiṁ baṟiyumellaṁ, vakuḷa,
madhurādigaḷaṟuvaruṁ. viṣapaṇṇarāgi, gāndharvadatteyunemmagrajarirvaru
mellirdarene, sujana viṣayuda, hēmābhava nagaradoḷirdarembuduṁ,
avaraṁ pōgi kāṇbevenmendu bandhugaḷa nōḍambaḍisi pōguttuṁttaṁ,
daṇḍakāraṇyapada tāpasāśramamuneydda viśramisi allirpuduṁ. posa
mānasaraṁ kaṇḍu, kutūhaḷadiṁ tāpasāṅganeyaroḍane jīvandharana
tāyuppa vijayādēviyuṁyumaṁ bandu, nīmārgēnembiretta vōpōdapirendu
besagoḷe, tamma banda vr̥ttāntamunaṟipuvuduṁ, enna magana parijana
pendaṟidindu viśramisi pōpupruduṁ; nimma taralvōlpōpātanumumanīmillige
tappu(tandu pōpu)dembudumantegeyvenyvemendu, jīvandharaṅgamī
kāntegaṁ pōlveyundettānuṁ kumārana jananiyukkendu
sandēhadinalliṁ pōguttuṁttaṁ, tammaṁ bēḍavartuttemurtte, puruṣakāradinavaranabhibha
bhavisi pōge, hēmābhanagarada sārthadoḍavemeyuṁ koḷalendu pōpa
bēḍaroḍane tāpuṁ kūḍi pōgikoḷvuduṁ paradarapuyyalgeyklejī jīvandharaṁ
bandu, vanēcarabalamunōḍisi koḷpakōḷvaṭṭa paradaroḍavemeyallamunoppise
madhura vakuḷādigaḷ nijanāmāṅkita śaraṅgaḷinesuvuvruduṁ; jīvandhara
kumāranaṟidanibarumuṁvuṁ mahōtsāhadiṁ kaṇḍu, rājapurada vārte
yellamuṁ besagoṇḍu, tānuṁ panumuvaruvamullige payayuṇaṁ
bōguttuṁttaṁ, daṇḍakāraṇyadoḷ payayuṇaṅgeyya, tāyytāpasiyaroḍane
vijayādēvi bandu nōḍuttire, bāṣpāmbugaḷogeye, molegaḷotta
reye, śōkākuḷiyāgirpuduṁ kumāraṁ kaṇḍaḍigeṟage, yakṣanā
prastāvadoḷ bandu, tadvr̥ttāntamunaṟipi kāḷāgaru karpūra
kuṅkumu vastrādigaḷinavaraṁ muraṁmannisi, dharmavātsalyadinavara śōkamu
nāṟisi pōdaṁ.

ittaṁ, vijayādēvi jīvandharaṅgēkāntadoḷintedaḷ. nimmayyaṁ
satyandhara mahārājanaṁ kāṣṭhāṅgārikaṁ kondu, rājapuradoḷ rājyaṁ
geydiyddirpanadaṟiṁ, tējasviyappa ninage pitr̥sthānamuṁ pattuviṭṭirpudu
yuktamallene, nīmentendirante negaṟvenendu, tanna manadoḷāda
kōpamuṁ paraprakāśyamāgadantu pracchādisi, kāryasamāptiyoḷḷiḷnimage
nandāḍhyaṁ modalāge nāyuyakaraṁ baṟiyuyanaṭṭuvenannegaṁ, śōkamuṁ
pattuviṭṭu, nīmirpudendu, nijajananiyunirisi, ghr̥tataṇḍulādi parikara
sahitaṁ, parijanamunappaysi, rājapuramuneydda, nīmenna banda barava
nārgamuṟipadirimendellarumuṁ mundiṭṭu, kāmarūpa mudrikeyiṁ,
vaiśyavēṣadharanāgi, jīvandharaṁ pōrampoṟilaṁ pokkaṅgaḍiyoḷkuḷḷirda
pūrvaratna supavarṇādigaḷaṁ koṭṭuṁ koṇḍuṁ pasaraṅgeytuyyuttire,
sāgaradattanemba seṭṭi, tannaṅgaḍiyulirdupasaraṅgeyvōnaṁ kaṇḍu,
tanagamuḷegaṁ puṭṭida, vimuḷeyemba magaḷanītanādēśa puruṣanendaṟidu
kuḍe, koṇḍu, kelavu divasa mallirdu, kāṣṭhāṅgārikana sabheyuṁ
jīvandharaṁ sthavira parivrājaka vēṣadiṁ pokkānatithiyenuṇalbēḍi
bandenene, kāṣṭhāṅgārikaṁ sanmānadinittenembudumamennabhyudayaphaḷakkikke
vacanave nimittakusumamuṁmendagrāsanadoḷkuḷḷirdu, arasana pakkade
uṇḍu, tadanantaraṁ rājaputrādi viśiṣṭa sabheyuṁyaṁ pokku, vaśīkaraṇa
cūrṇañjanādigaḷenna kayyoyyoḷoḷapilli nimma meccidudaṁ koḷḷimene,
tānappaḍe mundupaṁ(kaṁ), tanna kayyoḷ vaśīkaraṇa dravyaṅgaḷoḷoḷa
vupugaḍavenmendellaruṁ nakkipōpoṟiloḷ guṇamāleliyemba kanni(lambi)ke,
munna jīvandhara mahārājakumāraṁ tanna cūrṇavāsamuṁ pogalddaldi
nillendu puruṣadvēṣiyāgirdārdaḷākeyuṁ auṣadha prabhāvadiṁ vaśyaṁ
māḍidoḍe, ninna kayyoḷkalpavemene, jīvandharaṁ varākanettaṟivanenna
kāladhūḷiyu samānamallendu kr̥takaparivrājakaṁ nuḍiyeyeṁ, nīnintu
puruṣākāramunaṟiyade, yathēṣṭa nuḍiyuyalāgadātmaguṇastavamuṁ
paranindanavuṁvamuṁ maraṇasamumembuduṁ kēḷdaṟiyeyuyakkumendanibaru
mākṣēpaṅgeyya, niyynimmandirgar praśaṁsakaremmalliyuvomoḷarendu ucca
dhvaniyiṁ nuḍidu, guṇamāleyunondu muhūrtadoḷe pōgi
vaśyaṁmāṟveṟpenendu kr̥tapratijñanāgi bandu——

ākeyuṁ saudhavanamaneydi, guṇamāleyuṁ cēṭakiyuṁ karedu,
ōrvaṁrvaraṁ atithi bāgiloḷ bandirdanendu niprāḷdoḷga aṟavrpāḷdōḷgaṟipendu tadanu
matadiṁ pōgi, nīvāvamārgēnembirettaṇiṁ bandirendu guṇamāle besa
goḷe, vr̥ddha vēṣadharanendaṁ—peṟa—pēṟigaṇiṁ bandeṁ, mundaṇgeṇga pōdappenene,
parijanavellaṁ nage, nīvāvapātanaṁ nagalvēḍa, muppinoḷmatibhraṁśamu
makkumene, nimugaṁ muppāgadantiradendavaraṁ bārise, mundaṇgetta
pōdapirendu besagoḷevumagaṁ, kanyā(tī)’srtha prāptiyukkupannegaṁ
pōdapesendoḍe, ītaṁ vr̥ddhanāgiyuṁ capaḷādi guṇadiṁ(doḷ)
manadoḷpari pūrṇa yauvvananāgirkurpumendātanaṁ nagenuḍiverasagrāsana
doḷūḍi, nimugettalarthiyattale pōgivembudumunpantegeyvenendaḍa
puttaṁ pōgi, guṇamāleya śayanataḷamamunēṟuvuduṁ. ivaṁ nirlajja
nendu cēṭakiyarellaṁ kayyaṁ piḍideḷeyayulbageye, kr̥takavr̥ddhanendaṁ
lajjeyembudu strīviṣayamudu puruṣaviṣayamaltu; strīgappalajje
puruṣaṅgādandu saṁyōgamillenda vr̥ddhana nuḍiyuṁ kēḷdu, namugiva
rabhyāgatar nīmusiradirivendu cēṭakiyuraṁ bārise, guṇamāleyuya
maneyoḷpaṭṭu, niśāvasāna samayadoḷ, śuddhākhya, dēśākhya, svaravibhā
gadinati madhura māvāge vr̥ddhaṁ pāḍe, gāndharvadatteyu vivāha
kāladoḷeseva jīvandhara kumārana gītadantītanagītamati madhura
mādudendu mecci, nēsamūrḍimarpiḍidāgaḷ vinayōpacāradiṁ kaṇḍu,
nimugāva śāstraṅgaḷoḷ abhyāsamuṇṭene, dharmārthakāmuma śāstraṅgaḷaṁ
niravaśēṣaṁ ballemumadaṟtoṟiḷ, dharmārtha phala prarūpaṇamappa kāmuma
śāstra mentendoḍe sparśana, rasana, ghrāṇa, cakṣukṣuṁ, śrōtraṁ
gaḷgeḷe viṣayamamuppa mr̥du-karkaśa, snigdha-rūkṣa, guru-laghu, śītōṣṇa
lakṣaṇamamuppaṣṭavidha sparśanamuṁ, tikta, kaṭuka, kaṣāyāmbla, madhura,
lavaṇavemba ṣaḍvidharasamuṁ, prāyōgika, vaiśēṣikavemba gandha
dvayamuṁ, cētanamuṁmumacētanamuṁ, cētanācētanamuṁ, svābhāvi
kamuṁ, vaikriyukamuṁmemba pañcavidharūpamuṁ, ṣaḍja, r̥ṣabha,
gāndhāra, madhyamu, pañcamu, dhaivata, niṣādabhēdada saptasvaramuṁ,
intippatteṇṭu miṣṭāniṣṭa vikalpadinayvattāṟu teṟanakkuṁ. avanoḷḷi
ttāgaṟivaraṁ chappannarembavaroḷ, pratikūla kāvyavastu parihāradinanu
kūla kāvyavastugaḷananubhavisuvavaṁ kāmaśāstra kuśalanī matte pēḻda va
ṟoḷ, ninnananubhavisuva śayanāhāra, gandha citrakarma, gandharva

kaḷāguṇaṅgaḷoḷagirdarkēḻuṁ guṇadōṣaṅgaḷindaṟipe, guṇamāle
viṣayuṅgaḷa nirdōṣa prakāraṅgaḷaṁ ninnoḷ kalvelvinene, kalisuttirpina
mondudivasa mellaruṁ vanavihārakke pōge, guṇamālegēkāntadoḷ,
tanna sahaja svarūpaṁ tōṟi, kanyakinājñaṇca nuḍiyudirpudumumadanava
dhārisi, munnenegaldi cūrṇārṇavāsa prapañcadinākeyuṁ nambisi, mattaṁ
vr̥ddhavēṣamuṁvuṁ kaikoṇḍu puṣpaśayanadoḷirdennakālanottembuduṁ,
snēhadiṁ viśrambhadiṁ āke kālanottuvuduṁ kaṇḍu, vr̥ddhana manvuntrau
ṣapadhi śaktiyu nellaruṁ pogaḷe vanadiṁ maguḻibare, guṇamāle tanna
tāygaṁ, tandegaṁ, jīvandharaṁ banda vr̥ttāntamanēkāntadoḷaṟipe,
vivāha vidhiyuṁ māḍe, kelavu divasaṁ sukhamananubhavisuttirdondu
divasaṁ.

pūrvasvarūpamuṁ kaikoṇḍu, vijayayugiriyemba gandhakariyu
nēṟi, caturaṅga balasahitanāgi jīvandhara kumāraṁ, gandhōtkaṭana
maneyuṁ puge, kāṣṭhāṅgārikaṁ kēḷdu, vaiśyaputranāgiyuṁ sokki
dantāruṁrumuṁ bageyanenda prakāśadiṁ muḷidunuḍiye mantrigaḷendar
jīvandharanappoḍe mahānubhāvanātaṅge gandharvadatteyu sudarśana
yakṣana madhuravakuḷādigaḷa doreyu sahāyaroḷaradaṟiṁ, ātanoḷe
mage vigrahaṅgeyyalāgadendu māṇisi pōdar.

ittaṁ, vidēhanagaramunāḷva gōpēndranarapatigaṁ, prathvisundarigaṁ
puṭṭida ratnavati candrakavyathana kuśalaprātaṅge mālesūḍuvenendu kr̥ta
pratijñeyādaḷā candrakavyathanaventendoḍe——

emondudivasaṁsuramuḷayōdyānadoḷvihārisalpōgivaradharmayutigaḷapakkadedharmatattvamuṅkēḷdunandāḍhyaprabhr̥tigaḷverasusamyaktvamuṁmundānaśīlōpavāsajinapūjādigaḷuvuṅkaikoṇḍukelavukālaṁsalemattondudivasamuśōkavanadoḷparasparayuddhaṅgeyvamarkaṭayūthavuṅkaṇḍunirvēgavāgitadvanadoḷpraśastavaṅkaremba candrakamuṁ palaruṁ rājakumārakaresalāṟadirecāraṇamuniyurallimunnapēḻdindadoḷtannapūrvabhavasambandhavuṅkēḷdujīvaṁ, jīvandhara
kumāraṁ siddhanamaskāra pūrvakaṁ, tanna śāstraguruvappāryavarmaṅge
kr̥tavinayanāgi, candrakamanecca siṁhanādaṅgeyye, ratnavati ratna
māleyuṁ jīvandharaṅgikke, samayayusa samāyōga mādudendu
palaruṁ mecci, kāṣṭhāṅgārika pramukha nīcar munne tamagāda
paribhavamuṁ nenedu, kanneyuneḷedukoḷalendu bandu, tumuḷayuddha
kkoḍarci, jīvandhara sāmādyupāyu kuśalanappudaṟiṁ, satyandhara
mahārājanaparōkṣadoḷ, kāṣṭhāṅgārikaṅgāgirda sāmantayōdha
mahāmātādigaḷallige, tanna vr̥ttāntamanaṟipalke pūtaranaṭṭidoḍava
rellamanaṟidu, kumāranē paramasvāmiyendu bandu kūḍe, sannaddha
baḷanāgi, vijayagiri gandhagajamanēṟibare, kāṣṭhāṅgārikanumaśanivēga
vemba gandhagajamunēri tanagidirambare, cakradinavana taleyuṁ paṟiyiḍu
puduṁ, ātana balavellamudaṁ kaṇḍu, bhaṅgaṁ baṭṭu nilvuduṁ. abhaya
ghōṣaṇeyuṁ māḍi, bandhugaḷellamumbarisi, vinayadiṁ kaṇḍu,
jinapūjādi maṅgabhidhānadoḷirdumattormesuramuḷakriyānantaraṁ, sudarśayōdyānadoḷtrailōkyapūjitana(jyara)ppavardhamāna yakṣanindaṁ, kr̥tarājyābhi
ṣēkanāgi, ratnapatiyuṁyimpōgisamuvaśaraṇavumpokkudēvarambandisisaṁvēgaviśuddhapariṇā muduveniltu gāndiṅgandhadharvadatteyumagaṁvasundharakumāraṅge rājyavuṅkoṭṭunandāḍhyamadhuravakuḷādisahāyaruṁmātuḷādimahāhībhujarumberasusarvasaṅgaparityāgaṅgeydusaṁyumavuṅkaikoṇḍarvijayādēvi
paṭṭaṅgaṭṭi, duṣṭanigraha śiṣṭapratipāḷanadiṁ rājyaṅgeyyuttirdoṁyuṅgandharvadattemodalā.

ondudivasaṁ, suramuḷayōdyānadoḷ vihārisalpōgi, vara
dharmayutigaḷa pakkade, dharmatattvamuṁ kēḷdu, nandāḍhya prabhr̥tigaḷverasu
samyaktvamuṁ, dānaśīlōpavāsa jinapūjādigaḷuṁ kaikoṇḍu,
kelavukālaṁ sale, mattondu divasamuśōkavanadoḷ paraspara yuddhaṁ
geyva markaṭayūthamuṁ kaṇḍu, nirvēgamāgi, tadvanadoḷ praśasta
vaṅkaremba cāraṇa muniyuralli munna pēḻdindadoḷ tanna pūrvabhava
sambandhamuṁ kēḷdu, jīvandhara kumāraṁ jina pūjābhidhānadoḷirdu,
mattorvarme, suramuḷayōdyānadoḷ, trailōkyapūjitana(jyara)ppa
vardhamāna bhaṭṭārakara samavasaraṇa maṇḍaḷaṁ bandirpudaṁ kēḷdu,
mahāvibhūtiyiṁ pōgi samavaśaraṇamuṁ pokku, dēvaraṁ bandisi,
saṁvēgaviśuddha pariṇāmadiṁ, gandharvadatteyu magaṁ vasundhara kumā
raṅge rājyamuṁ koṭṭu, nandāḍhya, madhura, vakuḷādi sahāyaruṁ,
mātuḷādi mahībhujaruṁ berasu, sarvasaṅga parityāgaṅgeydu
