saṁyamamuṁ kaikoṇḍar. vijayādēviyuṁ, gandharvadatte modalā

gebbaṇbar soseyurumuvara tāyvaruṁ berasu, candanāyirkeyura
pakkade dīkṣiteyurādar. nīṁ besagoṇḍa jīvandhara muniyuṁ tapa
dindaṁ śr̥ta kēvaḷiyāgi, ghātikṣayānantaramamuṇagāra kēvaḷiyāgi,
vihārisi, vardhamāna bhaṭṭārakara nirvāṇagamunāvasānadoḷ, vipuḷagiri
yoḷ, ghāti karmanirmūḷanaṅgeydu, siddhatvadoḷ paramusukha
yapparendu, sudharma gaṇadharar jīvandharasvāmigaḷa caritamaṁmuṁ besase,
kēḷdu, śrēṇika mahārājaṁ bandisi pōge, vardhamāna bhaṭṭārakar,
dēśa vihāraṅgeydu, mattallige bare, vandanārthadiṁ śrēṇikaṁ pōgi,
vr̥kṣamūḷa śilāḷātaḷadoḷ, niḥprakamparāgi dhyānisuttirda, dharmaruci
muniyuraṁ kaṇḍu bandisi, bhaṭṭārakarallige bandu, namamuskārapūrvakaṁ
besagoḷe, dharmarucibhaṭṭārakara kathāsambandhamuṁvuṁ intendu besasidar—

jambūdvīpada, aṅgaviṣayada, campāpuramunāḷva, svētavāhana
nembarasaṁ, bhaṭṭārakara samīpadoḷ, dharmamuṅkēḷdu, vimuḷavāhana
nemba maganaṁ rājyadoḷniṟisi, palabaruṁ berasu, saṁyamamaṁsaṁyumuṁ
kaikoṇḍarinitukālaṁ munijanadoḍane vihārisuttaṁttuṁ, māsōpavāsada
pāraṇeyoḷ poṟilgelga carigevandaraṁ, mūvappurpuruṣarondeḍeyoḷirdu,
kaṇḍu, avaroḷorvaṁ puruṣalakṣaṇa śāstrakuśalanendaṁ–daṁ— ī tapōdhanara
śarīralakṣaṇaṁ pr̥thvīrājya sampādana kāraṇamudaṟinivar, bhikṣāhāri
gaḷentādar; śāstrōktaṁ pusi embuduṁ; mattōrvanendaṁ,
śāstrārthaṁ, pusiyallivar, munnaṁ rājyaṅgeydīnānumonvondu kāra
ṇadiṁ, nirvēgamāvāgi, śiśuviṅge rājyamuṅkoṭṭu tapaṁ baṭṭarene,
mattōrvanendanīdurātmaṅge, ī tapadoḷappa phaḷamāvudu, bāḷakanasa
marthanaṁ rājyadoḷniṟisi tapakke bare, mantri, sēnāpati, taḷavara
prabhr̥tigaḷābāḷakanaṁ, saṅkaleyoḷikki, tāmārājyamamunanubhavisidarembu
dumudaṁ kēḷdu, cittakṣōbhamāvāge bandu, vr̥kṣamūladoḷirdu, bāhya
kāraṇa sannipātadinabhyantara krōdhakaṣāyuya tīvrānubhāga spardhakō
dayudoḷ saṅklēśadoḷ, aśubha pariṇāmamuyōga pravardhamāna
kapōta, nīḷalēśyāpariṇāmuṁ, śiśu pratikūla(pāḷa)rappa janamuṁ,
hiṁsana, bandhana, śūḷārōhaṇa, jaḷadhi nikṣēpaṇa, bhūmikhanana, niśā(pāta)
dhvaṁsa nirmūḷa karaṇādi smaraṇadinaśubha pravr̥ttilakṣaṇa caturvidhārtha
raudra dhyānadoḷ, saṁrakṣaṇānandamemvemba raudradhyānadoḷirdarīyondaṁ

tavarmuhūrtadiṁ mithyā pariṇateyiṁ narakagāmigaḷādapparadariṁ, ava
rallige nīṁ pōgi, durgati hētuvappa raudradhyāna pariṇāmamuvaṁ pattu
viṭṭu krōdhavaṁ piṅgisuvudu; mōhaka vacanavaṁ kaḷevuduṁ; mukti
sādhanavappa saṁyamavaṁ porduvudu. putra mitra bhāryādi sambandha
manityaṁ, saṁsāra vardhanamumadantoṟavudendu nīṁ tiḷipaloḍaṁ,
prasannarāgi, śukladhyānadiṁ ghātigaḷaṁ kiḍisi, kēvaḷigaḷapparendu bhaṭṭā
rakararbasarbese, dharmarucimuniyaṁyuṁ śrēṇikaṁ bandu, kaṇḍu, yukti
yukta vacanaṅgaḷiṁ pratibōdhise, samummupalabdha bāhyasādhanaruṁ,
kaṣāyayu kṣayōpaśama bhāvadiṁ, mandarānubhāga spardhakōdaya viśuddha
pariṇāma yōga pravardhamāna tēja padmaśukla lēśyāpariṇāmaruṁ, ātma
garhaṇa parāyaṇaruṁ, apramatta saṁyuktaruṁ, parigr̥hīta dharma
dhyānaruṁ, antarmuhūrtadiṁ, śuklalēśyāpariṇāmaruṁ, śukladhyāna
pravēśadoḷadhaḥpravr̥ttikaraṇaṁ, apūrvakaraṇa, anivr̥ttikaraṇa praviṣṭaru
māgi, pr̥thaktva vitarkavicāra prathamaśukladhyānadiṁ, sūkṣma sāmparā
yika śuddhi saṁyama carama samayadoḷ nirmūḷikr̥ta mōha
karmanuṁ, samprāpta kṣīṇa kaṣāyayu guṇasthānanuṁ, ēkatva vitarkavicāra
dvitīyayu śukladhyāna vihita ghātitrikanuṁ, samutpanna kēvala jñānādi
guṇanumāge, dharmaruci kēvaḷiyuṁ śrēṇikanindrādigaḷverasu pūjisi,
samavasaraṇa maṇḍaḷavaṁ pokku, jambūdvīpada bharatakṣētradoḷallinditta
lārge kēvalajñānōtpattiyukkumendu gautamasvāmigaḷaṁ besagoḷva
prastāvadoḷ.

brahmēndrakalpada, brahma hr̥dayādhipati vidyunmāḷiḷeyemba
brahmēndraṁ, priyadarśaneyuṁ, sudarśaneyuṁ, vidyutprabheyuṁ,
vidyudvēgeyumbemba tanna nālvaruṁ dēviyarverasu bandu, jinēṁ
dranaṁ bandisi kuḷḷirdurpuduṁ, ī vidyunmāḷiḷeyiṁ kēvalajñānavyucchinna
mukkumamedentene bhaṭṭārakarintendu besasidar- indigēḻaḷayu divasa
doḷītaṁ svargadiṁ bandu, rājagr̥hanagaradarhaddāsanemba vibhugaṁ jina
dāsigaṁ, gaja, śāḷiḷevana, sarassu, vidhūmāgni, dēvakumāra dēyuvāmāna
jambūphala, svapnadarśana pūrvakaṁ, jambūnāmadhēyaṁyuṁ tanayayunāgi,
pūjārhanuṁ, rūpa, vinayu, vijñānādi sahitanuṁ, paripūrṇa yauvana
numenisi, kālaṁ sale, pāvānagaradoḷ, vardhamāna svāmi nirvāṇakke

sandiṁ baḻiyaṁyuṁ, emugavāgaḷe kēvalajñānaṁ puṭṭe, sudharma gaṇa
dhararverasu dharmāmr̥tavaṁ kaḻiṟeyuttaṁ, rājapurada vipuḷa giriśikhara
doḷāvuṁ bandirpudumomme baravaṁ kēḷdu, jēḷiniyayu magaṁ, kuṇika
narhaddāsa jinadatta jambukumārādi parivārasahitaṁ bandu, bandisi,
dāna śīlōpavāsa pūjādigaḷaṁ kaikoṇḍu pōge, jambunāmaṁ,
mātāpitr̥ bandhugaḷaṁ visarjisi tapambaḍal bageye, kelavudivasamuni
dārvuṁdarpāvuṁ nimmoḍane tapaṁ baḍuvamenvendu bandhugaḷ nuḍiye, mārkoḷa
lāṟade, poṟlvareṟalgeva, kālaharaṇaṁ geyyal bagedu, bandhugaḷ vivāha
vidhiyunoḍarci, sāgaradattaṅgaṁ, padmāvatigaṁ puṭṭida padmaśrīyumaṁ,
kubēradattaṅgaṁ, kanakamāvālegaṁ puṭṭida kanakaśrīyumaṁ, vaiśravaṇa
dattaṅgaṁ, vinayuvatigaṁ puṭṭida vinayaśrīyumaṁ, dhanadattaṅgaṁ,
dhanaśrīgaṁ puṭṭida rūpaśrīyumananmaṁantu nālvarumaṁ tandu,
pāṇigrahaṇaṁ geyseyye, saudha bhavanadoḷirpudumennamagaṁ sarāga pariṇāmu
nappanallanendu jinadāsi meygreygaṟedirdu, darahāsa, kaṭākṣapāta, karasparśa
nādigaḷumanavaroḷappanurāgavumuṁmaṁ tanna maganoḷkāṇade, cintākrānte
yāgirpuduṁ.

suramya viṣayada, paudanapuramanāḷva, vidyudrājanuṅddāmaṅgaṁ, vimaḷa
matigaṁ puṭṭida vidyutprabhaṁ, tammaṇṇaṅge muḷidu, aynūrvar mānasa
daḷanāyakanāgi pōgi, vidyuccōjjōranemba pesaroḷcōḷjōra mukhyanāgirda
dr̥śyakāraṇatāḷasōdghāṭana, nidrāsamutpādigaḷappa cōjōra śāstraṅga
ḷoḷ pēḻduḻda mantrāñjanādi kuśalanāgi bandarhaddāsana maneyuṁ kaḷa
lpokku, nidregeṭṭirdarpa jinadāsiyuṁ kaṇḍu, nīrmēmēke nindirdirembudu
menagorvane maganātanuṁ, pratyūṣasamayadoḷ, tapakke pōgalirdapa
nātanaṁ māṇisalārpaḍe, ninage bēḍidudellamamunīvenese, tadvacanavaṁmaṁ
kēḷdu, niśśaṅkitanāgi, saudhabhavanavaṁmaṁ pokku, nālvar kanyakiyara
naḍuve lōhapañjaragatavamappa siṁhamirpante, samummupalabdhi nirvēganāgi,
dvādaśānuprēkṣā smaraṇa pariṇatanāgirda jambukumāranaṁ, vidyu
ccōjjōraṁ kaṇḍintendaṁ—

ninna paḍadada bhōgamananubhavisade, patte paḻipeṟitakkutsukanāgirpu
doṭṭiyu katheyuṁ pōlkuyampēḻkumadentendoḍondoṭṭe, parvatōttuṅga
pradēśadiṁ suriva madhurasōnmiśritavamappa pullaṁ meddu, mattavumadanē

bayasi, paḻipeṟatu pullanollade, madhu rasa pātamane pārdalliye sattu
dembante, nīṁ negaḷvaḻvagadeyembuduṁ.

jambukumāranendaṁ- āvanānumorvaṁ, dāhajvara paripīḍita
nāgi, nadī sarastaṭāstādigaḷa nīraṁ kuḍidu taṇiyadātaṁ, panipullaṁ nakki
taṇiyadante, suralōka sukhamananubhavisi bandenage gaja kaḷabha karṇa
caṁ(saṁ)caḷamappa manuṣya sukhadoḷ tr̥ptiyentakkumembuduṁ.

vidyuccōjjōranendaṁ— ondaraṇyadoḷōrvaṁ kirātaṁ, ondu
maradoḷ meygreygaṟedirdu, niśita śaradineccāneyaṁyuṁ kondu, taru
koṭaradoḷirda pāvutannaṁ koḷe, tānumāpāvumaṁ kondu sāvudu
mantu satta kariyuṁ, kirātanuṁ, pāvumondu śr̥gāḷaṁ kaṇḍati
lōbhadinivaṁ baḻikke timbenendērisida billa pedeyuṁ tinuttuṁttaṁ, pede
paḻiṟiye, siḍildu pāṟidabilla poyyoyloḷ sattudembantatilōbhadoḷ
nīṁ negaṟuvēḻvēḍene—

muguḷnage nakku kumāranendaṁ- nālkuṁ baṭṭeyu naḍuve ratna
rāsiyu keladoḷ baṭṭevōguttumorvaṁ rujāpahāramappa maṇiyuṁ
kaṇḍu koṇḍu pōgi, nūliṅgoḍedu(lgalgemaṇivoḍu) mattuttamuḷḷillirda
ratnaṅgaḷumaṁ koḷalendu bandu, kāṇade pōdanembante, paḍeyalbārada
manuṣyajanmamuṁmaṁ paḍadu, guṇavemmembanarghya māṇikyavaṁmaṁ koḷḷade pōgi,
saṁsāra jaladhiyoḷaṁḷeṁ(ḷḷaṁ)tu kāṇbenene;

kaḷḷanendaṁ- ondu nari tanna kaccijjirda māṁsakhaṇḍavaṁmaṁ bisuṭu,
maḍuvinoḷ poḷeva mīṅge pāydu, pariva ponaloḷ pōgi, tānuṁ
sattudu. mīnaṁ poḷadu pōdudembantati lubdhanappātaṁ tāne
kiḍugumene;

kumāranendaṁ- ōrvaparadaṁ parārdhya ratnaṅgaḷoḷ tīpida kacca
guḍapuṁmaṁ kaḷḷareḷedukoḷe, duḥkhadoḷ sattanembante, samyagdarśana
jñānacāritraṅgaḷemba ratnaṅgaḷaṁ, kaṣāyayu, rāga cōrarge kōḷpaṭṭapa
bhōganiratanappa paradanante kiḍalvēḍene;
vidyuccōjjōranendaṁ—

emba katheyuṁyaṁ takkuṁ. adentendoḍōrvaṁ sarvābharaṇabhūṣite tamma
trettiyu paruṣavacanakke(yumyuparōdhakke) bēsattu, sāyuyalendu pōgi,
maradaḍiyoḷ ni(nē)ldu sāvupāyamumanaṟiyadirpudumōdōrvaṁ,
suvarṇadārukanembaṁ mārdaṅgikanāke sattiṁ baḻiyaṁyuṁ, tuḍugeyuṁ
koḷva bageyinākege nēldu sāvupāyamuṁ tōṟalendu, maddaḷeyuṁ
veṭṭi nindirdu, mēgaṇa kombanilki tegedu nēṇaṁ tanna koralo
ḷkaṭṭe, maddaḷe poraḷdu pōge, nēṇ koralaṁ bigidu nēldu sattudaṁ
kaṇḍemttemmattiyu nuḍiyindintappa sāvu beṭṭitendu manege muguṟaṟta,
sose bandaḷembante, puruṣanati lōbhadoḷ negaṟiḻalāgadene;

kumāranendaṁ- lalitāṅganemba mahā dhūrtaviṭanarasana mahā
dēvi tannaṁ kaṇḍu kaṇsēṇbēṭaṅgoṇḍudanaṟidarasiyuya besadinākeyuya dādi
yobbonuḍikeyoḷiṭṭu tanna(nda) rasiyoḷ nerapuvudumantaḥpurada
kāpinavaradanaṟidu ārasaṅgaṟipe, śōdhisalbarpudumarasalileḍeyillade,
paricārakiyar pādariganaṁ pāvu koḷada kuḷiyoḷikke puḷuḷuṅgaḷ tine,
narakaduḥkhamunanubhavisuttirdanavanantalpa sukhābhilāṣeyiṁ narayiṁnaṅka
duḥkhamunumba kāraṇaṁ ēnendu mattondu katheyuyanintendu pēḷdaṁḻdaṁ—

ōrva naḍaviyoḷ baṭṭevōguttamirdu madagajamaṭṭe bhayasthanāgi
pōgi, maranaṁ muṟagoṇnaṁmaṟgoṇḍoḍā marana modaloḷ, baḷḷigaḷoḷ
pudidirda purāṇakūpadoḷ kāṇade bīḷuttuṁttaṁ, daṟiyaṁ baḷḷiyaṁ
piḍidunile, tannanuṅgalendaḍiyoḷ bāyuṁ teṟadēliṟdēḻupeḍeyujagaraṅga
ḷire, tannapiḍida baḷḷiyu neraḍiligaḷkaḍiye, vanagajaṁ kapōḷakaṇḍūti
yindā maranaṁ ghaṭṭise, maradallāṭadinallirda jēnapuḷuḷuṅgaḷ maḷmaṁsagi
(mumuṁsuḷi) bandu kaḍiye, duḥkhamuṁ maṟidu, panipa jēnatuppakke
bāyunāntunāntuṁ savidu, pattaṁ bappa panige bāyunāntirpa(na)nte manu
ṣyagarbharāneyanyunte mittutta, bennaṭṭenaṭṭi, saṁsārakūpadoḷ biddārdāyuṣyamemṣyemba
baḷḷiyoḷtodaḷtirdardiruḷuṁ pagalumbembiligaḷā baḷḷiyaṁ kaḍiye, perbāvu
gaḷantirda narakaṅgaḷoḷ bīḷalendirdu, jēnapuḷuḷuṅgaḷkaḍivante, śārīra
(sāsira) mānasāgantuka sahaja rujādigaḷ bādhise, madhu binduvapanā
svādisuvantindriyuya sukhakke mūḍharbayasuvarendu kumāraṁ
nuḍiye;

vidyuccōranuṁ, jinadāsiyuṁ, nālvar kannikeyaruṁ saṁsāra
bhōga nirvēgadoḷire, nēsamuḻiṟmūḍidāgaḷuṁ, bandhugaḷuṁ, kuṇika mahā
rājanunuṁmaṣṭādaśaśrēṇigaḷumāśriḷmādritanembōrvadēvaṁ niṣkramaṇābhiṣēkaṁ
geyduyye, maṅgaḷavasadanaṅnagoṇḍu, suragaṇa nirmitamappa maṇiśibigeyu
nēṟi, vipuḷagiri śikharakke, bandindrabhūti pramukharaṁ pradakṣiṇaṁ geydu
bandise, brāhmaṇa, kṣatriya, vaiśya sūnugaḷuṁ, vidyuccōranumātana
bhr̥tyaraynūrvaruṁ berasu, sudharmagaṇadharara samīpadoḷ bāhyā
bhyantara parigrahaparityāgaṁ geydu, jambūkumāraṁ, saṁyamamuṁsaṁyumaṁ
kaikoṇḍu, vardhamāna bhaṭṭārakara parinirvāṇānantaramappuṁmāpuṁ panneraḍu
varṣaṁ kēvaḷi vihāraṁ geydu, muktige sandaṁ baṟiyamādivasame,
sudharmamuni kēvaḷiyāge, jambumuni śrutakēvaḷiyukkuṁ; allindatta
panneraḍu varṣaṁ pōge sudharmarmumuktige salvar.

ā divasame jambūyatige kēvalajñānaṁ puṭṭugumamevara śiṣyarbhava
nāmadhēyargaṇadharar nālvattu varṣaṁ dharmōpadēśaṁ geyduyyuttuṁ
vihārisuvarendu bhaṭṭārakar besasuvudumanāśridrita dēvanadaṁ kēḷdinna
vaṁśada mahātmyamidōrentendānanda nāṭakamanāḍidoḍītanārgendu
(aḍadaṁ kaṇḍītanārendu) śrēṇikaṁ besagoḷe, gautamasvāmigaḷiṁ
tendar—jambūnāmadhēyuravaṁśadoḷmannedharmapriyuseṭṭigaṅguṇadēvigampuṭṭidarhaddāsanembanītantandeyunuḍiyuṅkēḷadejūdumodalāgisaptavyasanaṅgaḷoḷavāsaktanāgemattondudivasamatibaḷarapparakaraprahāradimbiddannabasanadabesadiṅgurupacanamaṅkēḷadeajñānadindenaginitāḍudendupaśamabhāvadimpuṇyakarmamanupārjisivyantaralōkadoḷpuṭṭisamyagdarśanamaṅkaikoṇḍanītanādritadēvanembudumanaṟidubaṟiyaṁśrēṇikanendanībrahmēndranappavidyunmāḷipūrvajanmadoḷāvapuṇyamaṁnerapidanelliddubandanītaṅgantyakāladoḷamaṅgaprabhepiṅguvudallidambesasimene—

jambūdvīpadapūrvavidēhadapuṣkaḷāvatīviṣayadavītaśōkanagaramanāmadhēyara vaṁśadoḷmunne, dharmapriyu seṭṭigaṁ, guṇaḷvamahāpadmanembanarapatigaṁvanamāḷā
dēvigaṁ puṭṭidarhaddāsagaṁśivakumāranembanītaṁ, tandeya nuḍiyuṁ kēḷade, jūdu
modalāgi saptavyasanaṅgaḷoḷavāsaktanāge, mattonvanavihārakkepōgibarutumondu divasamatibaḷa
rappara karaprahāradiṁ biddenna basanada besadiṁ guruvacanamaṁ kēḷade,
ajñānadindenaginitādudendupaśamabhāvadiṁ, puṇyakarmamanupārjisi,
vyantaralōkadoḷpuṭṭi, samyagdarśanamaṁ kaikoṇḍanītanāśrita dēva
nembudumanaṟidu baṟiyaṁ śrēṇikanendanī, brahmēndranappa vidyu
nmāli, pūrvajanmadoḷāva puṇyamaṁ nerapidanellidurbandanītaṅgantyakāla
doḷamaṅgaprabhe piṅguvudallidaṁ besasimene—

jambūdvīpada, pūrvavidēhada, puṣkaḷāvatīviṣayada, vītaśōka
nagaramanāḷva, mahāpadmanemba narapatigaṁ, vanamāḷādēvigaṁ, śiva
kumāranemba maganāgi, vanavihārakke pōgi barutumondudivasaṁ,
gandha puṣpādi maṅgaḷadravyasahitaṁ sambhramadiṁ pōpa nagara janamaṁ

kaṇḍidellige pōdapapirendu buddhisāgara mantriya maganaṁ besagoḷe,
dīptataparuṁ, śruta kēvaḷigaḷumappa sāgaradatta munigaḷ, māsōpa
vāsada pāraṇeyoḷ sā(kā)masamr̥ddha(sambandha)nemba seṭṭi vidhi
pūrvakamāhāradānamuṁmaṁ koṭṭu, pañcāścaryamaṁ paḍeḍadu, manōha
rōdyānadoḷirda tanmunimmanipaparaṁ bandisalendu pōdapparembuduṁ, śiva
kumāranendaṁ sāgaradattaremba pesaruṁ, vividhardhigaḷemapurgentādudene,
puṣkaḷāvatīviṣayada. puṇḍarīkiṇiṇīyanāḷva, vajradanta cakravartiyarasi
yaśōdharādēvi garbhiṇiyāgi, jaladhi jalakrīḍeyaṁyuṁ bayase, mahā
vibhūtiyiṁyinarasaṁ pōgi, sāgaradoḷ jalakrīḍeyaṁyuṁ māḍe, gaṅgā
dvāradiṁ bandu, maganaṁ paḍadu, sāgaradattanendu pesaraniḍe(ṭṭuṭṭa),
jauvanaṁ neṟiye, mattondudivasaṁ; harmyataḷadoḷ parijana sahita
nāgi, nāṭakamaṁ nōḍuttirpinamavanukūlanemba cēṭakanendanele
kumāra, nōḍa, mandarākāradindījaḷadharamirdudembudumadu nōḍa
loḍamaṁ(ḍe nōḍe) karage, dēhigaḷa jauvana, vibhavāyurādigaḷ, jaḷa
dharasvabhāvaṅgaḷante karagumamukkiduve dr̥ṣṭāntamendu, nirvēgadini
rdondu divasaṁ, tandeyoḍane pōgi, manōharōdyānadoḷirda
sāgaradatta tīrthaṅkara rapakkade dharmamaṁ kēḷdu bandu, visarjanaṅgeydu,
palaruṁ berasu saṁyamamuṁmaṁ kaikoṇḍu, manaḥparyayi jñānigaḷ,
vividhardhigaḷaneyduydi vihārisuttumillige bandarembuduṁ; śivakumāraṁ
tānuṁ pōgi, bandisi, dharmaśravaṇānantaramintendaṁ. bhaṭṭāraka,
nimmaṁ kaṇḍenagati snēhamādapudidarakāraṇamēnadaṁ besasimembuduṁ.

jambūdvīpada, bharatada, magadhaviṣayada, vr̥ddhagrāmadhodoḷ, nagara
janma rāṣṭrakūṭaṅgaṁ(kāḷaṅgaṁ), rēvatigaṁ, bhagadattanuṁ, bhavadēvanu
memvemba tanayarāge, piriyātaṁ susthiraremba gurugaḷa samīpadoḷ
saṁyamamuṁmaṁ kaikoṇḍu, nānādēśa viharaṇaṅgeydu, vr̥ddhagrāmakke
vare, bandhugaḷellarivaraṅkaṇḍu, balagoṇḍu, bandisuvudumāprastāva
doḷ—

tadgrāmadoḷ, dharmaṣēṇanemba gr̥hapatigaṁ, nāgavasuvembaḷgaṁ
puṭṭida nāgaśrīyuṁ bhavadēvaṅge bandhugaḷ pāṇigrahaṇaṁ geyye, bhava
dēvanuṁ bandu, nijāgraja muniyuṁyaṁ vinayavinamitanāgi kāṇbuduṁ.
karmakṣayamakkendu parasi kayyaṁ piḍidēkāntakke vaydu, dharmatatvattva

manaṟipi, nīṁ tapambaḍaluvēḷkumendāgrahaṅgeyduyye, nāgaśrīyuṁ
biḍisi barperpanembuduṁ; bhavadattamuniyendaṁ— anēkabhava śatasahasra
saṅka(pra)ṭamappa saṁsāradoḷ, putra kaḷatrādigaḷaṁ bagedoḍātmahita
doḷintesagalbarkumembuduṁ; niruttaranāgi dīkṣābhimukhanādabhava
dēvanaṁ, nijaguru samīpakkoydu, dīkṣeyaṁ koḷise, bhavadēvaṁ
dravyasaṁyutanāgi, panneraḍu varṣambaraṁ, sampūtikatvadiṁ vihārisi,
mattondudivasamēkākiyāgi vr̥ddhagrāmakke pōgi, suvra(prī)teyayu
remba kantiyayuraṁ kaṇḍu, nāgaśrī nimmūmmoroḷirdaḷiraḷembudumavaravara
cēṣṭitamanaṟidu, kantiyayurāpudanaṟiyemendudāsīnaṅgeydu, bhava
dēvaṁ kēḷdantu. guṇanutiyayurembarjiyarge, vātsalyanibandha sthitikaraṇa
madhikaraṇaṅgeydārthāyduthākhyānamanintendaṟipidar—

sarvasamr̥ddhanemba paradana sūḷe(dāsi) tannamagaṁ, peṟaṟereñjalama
nuṇḍukāṟuvudumadaṁ, kāṁsabhājanadoḷāntu, mattamātaṁ pasida
nendadane kuḍe, kiṟiyuyanollanillante, sādhujanaṅgaḷmuḷmanne pattuviṭṭuvaṁ,
baṟikaḷipi kaikoḷvaralladalladeyuṁ, narapāḷanembarasanendu nāyige,
kanakābharaṇamaṁ kaṭṭi, mr̥vr̥ṣṭānnamanūḍi, ratnasivigeyunēṟisi, vana
vihārakke pōgi bare, sivigeyindiḷipe, bāḷakaviṣṭhāṣṭāpradēśakke parivudaṁ
kaṇḍarasaṁ muḷidu, lakuṭatāṭa(ḍa)na pūrvakamāśunakanaṁ kaḷadanante,
sādhujana sanmāna bhāgiyappa muniyuṁ, tanagayōgyamappācaraṇadoḷ
negaldanldindu, paribhavakke guriyayukkumadalladeyuṁ, ōrvaṁ pathikaṁ, rasa
nādindriya vaśagataṁ, baṭṭevōguttuṁ, phala kusumādyādyapēkṣeyiṁ, vana
gahanamaṁ pokku, pasida puli tannaneḷbaṭṭe(ya) bhayadindōḍuttu
mondu, pāḷbāḷvāviyoḷ bīḻduḷdu, sītādi kriyegaḷiṁ, vāta pitta ślēṣma
sannipātadēhaṁ, saṅkōcamāge, paṅguḷanuṁ, śravaṇaśaktirahitanappappu
daṟiṁ badhiranuṁ, darśana(śuddha)śakti vimukhanappudaṟinandhakanuṁ,
jihvāsaṁharaṇanumādudaṟiṁ mūkanumāgi, sarpavr̥ścikādigaḷ bādhi
(pōri)se, nirgamanōpāyanaṟiyayudirpinavōrmōrva vaidyaṁ yādr̥
cchikaṁ bandu, kāruṇyadinātanumanupāyāntaradiṁ poṟamaḍise,
mantrauṣadhaprayōgadoḷ, pādaprasāraṇamuṁ, nētra nirmaḷateyuṁ,
śravaṇapāṭavamuṁ, jihvāpravr̥ttiyumuṁmaṁ māḍe, sarvaramaṇīyamemba
polibilabaṭṭeyuṁ tōṟi, matta, viṣaya sukhavaśagata(khāsakta)nāgi dese

geṭṭubandu, tanna munnina(nna)birda bāviyoḷ birdanante, mithyātva
saṁyama pramāda kaṣāyayōgavembī badhiratvādigaḷaneyduydi, caturga
tiya vividha sukhaduḥkhaṅgaḷanuṇutamirdanaṁ, guruvemba vaidyaṁ kaṇḍu,
dharmōpadēśamembupāyadi(geyyal upāyadi)nalliṁ poṟamaḍisi,
jinamārga mantrauṣadhigaḷaṁ prayōgisi, samyagdarśana lābhanōnmīḷana
muṁ, samyakjñāna karṇayugōdghāṭanamuṁ, samyakcāritra pāda
prasāraṇamuṁ, samyaktvōktapōrasana pravr̥ttiyumuṁmaṁ māḍi, pañcavidha
svādhyāyavacanaṅgaḷaṁ nuḍiyisi, sanmārgadarśanadinde mukti nagaramamu
neydisuvaradaṁ, kelabar kaikoḷvar, kelarkēr viṣayāndharāge kaiko
ḷḷade, sugandha campaka samīpavartiyāgiyuṁ, tatsaurabhavaṁmaṁ madhukara
naṟiyudantī samyagdarśana cāritraṅgaḷa samīpadoḷirduṁ, viṣayuya
kaṣāya ajñāna laukikavēda vittajihvārambha sambandhāṣṭavidha kuliṅgi
gaḷ, tapōdhanargayōgyamappadravyabhāvaviṣasaktaruṁ, hēyuyamāna samya
gdarśanādi guṇaruṁ, duḥkhigaḷumavidita samācāra kramaruṁ, mr̥ga
caritarumāgi maguḻduḷdu bandu, saṁsārakūpadoḷbīḷvarendu, kantiya
rga(ra)ṟipe, kēḷdu paśāntacittanāgi, bhavadēvanirpudumadanaṟidu,
kantiyayur daridrabhāvōtpanna duḥsthitiyuṁ, kujjaijaiḷādi vibhatsavēṣadhare
yumappa nāgaśrīyu nātaṅge tandu tōṟi, saṁvēga nirvēgaparanāgi
maguḻdu banḷduondu, bhāvasaṁyamumanāgi(tarāge), nijāgraja muniverasu,
jīvitāntadoḷārādhanāvidhiyiṁ, mahēndrakalpada, balabhadra vimāna
doḷ, sāmānika dēvarāgi, saptasāgarōpamāntadoḷalliṁ bandu,
bhavadattaneyāṁ sāgaradattanādeṁ; nīṁ bhavadēvannene, śivakumāranādeṁ
buduṁ; viraktacittanuṁ dīkṣābhimukhanumāgi, mātāpitr̥gaḷ tapaṁ
baḍalīyade purakkoḍagoṇḍu pōdoḍandiṁ baṟiyamamāprāsukamappā
hāramanuṇṇendirpuduṁ; śivakumārananūḍidātaṅge bēḍidudellamaṁ
kuḍuvenendarasaṁ nuḍiye, dr̥ḍhava(dha)rmanemboṁ saptasthānōpagata
śrāvakaṁ, kumāranallige vandu, mātā pitr̥gaḷanulōma śatrugaḷ;
svapara vināśigaḷadaṟiṁ, bhāvasaṁyamamuṁ ninagentuṁ kiḍadante,
ninagāṁ prāsukavayyāvr̥tyaṁ geyvenanukūladravya, kṣētra, kāla,
bhāva, sannidhiyindallade, saṁyamamuṁ naḍayisuvuda(denaga)śakyameṁ
budumātana nuḍiyanoḍambaṭṭu, śivakumāranācāmlavardhamāna

muṁ, nirvr̥tikriyeyuṁ, rasaparityāgalakṣaṇamumppa parigrahaṅgaḷaṁ
koṇḍiruḷuṁḷaṁ pagaluṁ strīyara samīpadoḷeyuṁmayumuvaraṁ pulliṁ kaṣṭa
māge bagedu, bāḷabāyoḷ naḍevantasidhārātapadoḷpanneraḍuvarṣaṁ
negaḻdu, jīvitāntyadoḷārādhanāvidhiyiṁ, vidyunmāḷeyāgi puṭṭi,
samutkr̥ṣṭa dēhadīptiyādudendu gautamasvāmigaḷ besasi, mattaṁ
śrēṇikaṅgintendar—

vidyunmāḷeyu nālvardēviyarumī nagaradoḷī bhūnandaneyu
rāgi, jambūnāmadhēyara parityāgakāladoḷ, tāmuṁ sarvasaṅgapari
tyāgaṁ geydāraṇācyutadoḷ dēva(viyu)rāgi puṭṭibandu, muktige
salvar. sāgaradatta muniyumuṁ svargadoḷ puṭṭibandu, jambū
nāmadhēyara parityāgakāladoḷ nirvāṇakke salvar. jambūnāmaruṁ,
sudharmara pakkade, tamma janmāntaramuṁ kēḷvarendu bhaṭṭārakar besase,
santuṣṭanāgi bandisi, poṟaḻalge bandu, mattondudivasaṁ; śrēṇikaṁ—

tārāgaṇada naḍuve candranippante, munigaṇada naḍuve rūpādi
guṇaṅgaḷiṁ beḷaguttirda, prītiṅkara muniyuyaraṁ kaṇḍu, pūrvajanma
doḷivarēgeyumda bandinitu mahātmatmyamuṁ paḍadorene, gautamasvāmi
gaḷintendar. jambū dvīpada, bharatada, magadhaviṣayada, supratiṣṭha
nagaramuṁ, jayasēnanembanāḷdoḷdanākāladoḷ sāgadadatta seṭṭigaṁ,
prabhaṅkarigaṁ, nāgadattanumuṁ, kummuṅkubēradattanumba tanayarāge, nāgadatta
nōrvanuṁ poṟagāge, maneyuvarellaruṁ śrāvakadharmasahitarāgi
kālaṁ sale, mattondu divasaṁ, priyuṅyaṅkarōdyānada, dharaṇībhūṣaṇa
giriyoḷ bandirda, sāgarasēna muniyuyarallige, narapati prabhr̥tigaḷoḍane
pōgi, dharmamuṁmaṁ besagoḷe, bhaṭṭārakarintendu besasidar. parigr̥hīta
samyagdarśanaratarappavar, vratōpavāsadānapūjādyanubandha sambandhi
gaḷappa kuśalakarmadinupārjisida mahāpuṇyadiṁ, bhavyarabhyudayuya
niśrēyasa sukhabhāgigaḷappar; mithyādr̥ṣṭigaḷumīpēḻda karmabhūmi
nibandhanalpa puṇyadinalpabhōgaṅgaḷaṁ paḍadupaśama pariprāptiyoḷ,
saddharmalābhayōgyarappar. bhōgaśaktiyiṁ kelabar mūḍhar,
hiṁsānr̥tacaurya mr̥ṣāvādādyanubandhita pāpakriyā niratar,
saṁsāra kūpadoḷāḷvarembudumudaṁ kēḷdu, palaruṁ saddharmamuṁmaṁ
kaikoṇḍar. sāgaradatta seṭṭiyuṁ nijāyuḥ pramāṇamuṁmaṁ besa

goṇḍondu tiṅgaḷuṇṭene, poṟaḻalge vandaṣṭāhnika jinapūjeyuṁ māḍi
nāgadattaṅge tannoḍameveyellamanappayisi bandu, visarjanaṅgeydu,
ippatteraḍu divasaṁ nōntu, samādhiyiṁ svargakke pōdaṁ.

itta, mithyātvānantānubandhi lōbhōdayadiṁ tībra parigraha
sañjñatvasañjñvadiṁ, nāgadattaṁ kubēradattanaṁ besagoṇḍaṁ—namma tande
ninage sāravastugaḷēnaṁ tōṟidaṁ, enagēnuvanittaṁ, illendoḍātaṁ
tībra lōbhadiṁ viparyāsakta cittanādudanaṟidu, kubēradattanendaṁ
āṁ īrvaru maṟiyadoḍemeyuṇṭe, suralōka prāptanāda tandege
kemmane dūṣaṇeyaṁ māḷpuḻpudayuktamidaṁ nuḍida ninagaṁ nuḍiyu
kēḷdinagaṁ pāpamakkumembuduṁ, cittakāluṣyadinoḍameveyuṁ pacci
koṇḍu, jinabhavana nirvāṇa pūjādi pravartanapararāgi sukhadi kelavu
kālavuṁmuṁ kaḷiputtirdondudivasaṁ, sāgarasēna gurugaḷāhāra dānavuṁmuṁ
koṭṭu, kubēradattanuṁ, dhanamitreyuṁ, emamaṅge makkaḷ akkumāga
vendu besagoḷe, nimage caramadēhadharaṁ tanayanakkumembuduṁ;
santuṣṭacittanāgi seṭṭiyendanemamaṅge puṭṭidamamaṅgaṁ, nimmaḍine guḍḍaḍdanakku
mātanaṁ, nimmaḍigaḷgappaysuvenendu, kelavu divasadiṁ, prītiṅkara
nemba maganaṁ paḍedayduneneṅgu varṣaṁ pōdiṁ baḻiyuṁ, dhyānapuradiṁ
banda sāgarasēna muniyurge magananappaysi, gurugaḷātananoḍa
goṇḍu, dhyānapurakke pōgi, padināṟu varṣambaraṁ śāstrābhyāsaṁ
geysi, saṁyumu gr̥hajōtsakatskanādudanaṟidu, ninage dīkṣākāla
mallendu gurugaḷ bārise, māṇduḻdu, bandhugaḷaṁ nōḍalendu, tanna
kalta dharmārtha, kāmaśāstraṅgaḷaṁ, granthārtha prayōjanadiṁ śiṣyajana
kkupadēśaṅgeyyuttaṁ, chātravēṣadharanāgi bandu, mātāpitr̥ pramukha
bandhugaḷaṁ kaṇḍu, rājapūjitanuṁnaṁ, paṇḍitābhimāniyu māgirdu,
piridu pooḍamebaḍadoḍallade, maduvenillenendaṁ.

ondu divasaṁ, jalayātrege pōpa sārthadoḍane, pōgalbagedu,
bandhugaḷaṁ visarjisi, gurugaḷge namaskāraṅgeysi, pilikhitābhiprētavāda
arthāntaramappa patraṁ kuḍe, vinayadiṁ koṇḍu, kiviyoḷiṭṭu, śaku
nādigaḷanukūla māge, bahitramanēṟi, samudramaṁ pāydu,
valayākāragiri parivr̥tamappa bhūmitiḷaka nagaramaneydi, śaṅkha, paṭaha,
kahaḷā dhvanigaḷaṁ kēḷdalli suḷiva janamuṁmaṁ kāṇade, paradarellarumirdu

mmamommunibaroḷaṁ, idanāraydubaral āvaṁ samarthanembuduṁ prītiṁ
kara kumāraṁ ānirdenembuduṁ, avara piriyayyaṁ sāgadattaṁ,
ballitappanārikēḷa dīrgha rajjugaḷaṁ māḷpuḻpudumānēṇpiḻdiḍidu pōgi,
jinabhavanamuṁmaṁ kaṇḍu, dēvaraṁ bandisi, nobbinnegaṁḻpannegamba, baḷasiyuṁyumuṁ bāḷa
poyloḷeraḍeraḍu khaṇḍavāmāge palaruṁ keḍadirdaraṁ kaṇḍu, vismayuṁ
baṭṭirpannegaṁ, ōrvaḷ kanyaki koḷadoḷ nīraṁmogedukoṇḍu
pōpaḷa baṟiḻiyuṁ pōpudumāke kaṇḍiralikke, kuḷḷirdu, poṟaḻala
nintāvarmāḍidarembuduṁ, nimage pēḻuttiral pottillanīmillirade
bēgaṁ pōgimembuduṁ, ā kanyakiyu nañjadir, sahasrabāhu
bandoḍaṁ, ninnaṁ kāvenene, niḥśaṅkeyuṁ pēḻal taguḷdaḷ.

vijayārdhaduttaraśrēṇiyoḷaḷakāpuramanāḷva, haribaḷanuṁ, mahā
sēnanuṁ, bhūtiḷakanumba, tamma mūvaralli haribaḷaṅgaṁ, dhāriṇigaṁ,
bhīmakanemba maganātanakakiṟiyarasi śrīmatige, hiraṇyavarmanemba
magaṁ; mahāsēnaṅgaṁ, sundarigaṁ ugrasēnanuṁ, varasēnanumba
tanayuyaravariṁ kariṅkiṟiyoḷāṁ vasundhariyenemmmammammanorme bhaumavihā
rakke pōguttattu mīpoṟaḻalaṁ kaṇḍu mecci, tānilliralbagedu, pura
nivāsigaḷappa vyantaradēvateyuraṁ saṅgrāmadoḷ pauruṣyadinda
mugrasēnanuṁ varasēnarumembaranabhibhavise, tanna tammaṁ bhūtiḷakaṁ
berasalliyu viṣayuya narapatigaḷ besakeysayye, palavukālamirpinaṁ; haribaḷa
narapati bhīmakaṅge rājyamuṁmaṁ koṭṭu, hiraṇyavarmaṅge vidyamuṁmaṁ koṭṭu
vipuḷamaticāraṇarapakkade, dīkṣeyuṁ koṇḍu muktige sandanitta
bhīmakanuṁ upāyāntaradiṁ, hiraṇyavarmana vidyegaḷaṁ koṇḍu,
tannanonnoḷagumāḍalippurpudumudanaṟidu, hiraṇyavarmaṁ sammēdagiriyu
nāśrayisi, tīrthasthānavamappudaṟiṁ, tānallige pōgalasamarthanāgi
bhīmakaṁ maguḻdubaḻdirbare, hiraṇyavarmaṁ tamma kakiṟiyuyammana pakkave
bandirdoḍātanu noppisugumendōliyu naṭṭidoḍe, mahāsēna
mahārājaṁ muḷidu kāḷagadoḷ, bhīmakanaṁ piḍidu saṅkaleyoḷikki,
hiraṇyavarmaṅgavātaṅgaṁ sandhānaṁ māḍi, rājyamuṁmaṁ koṭṭu,
visarjise, hiraṇyavarmanoḷ baddhavairanāgi, palakāladiṁ, tanna sādhisida
kutsita rākṣasavidyeyiyunemmayyanaṁ koṇḍu, poṟaḻalanellamaṁ kiḍisida
(nettise) bhīmakanindilligebarpanadaṟi nī millirade bēga pōgi

emmembuduṁ; prītiṅkara kumāraṁ śayyātaḷadoḷirda bāḷaṁ koṇḍu,
nimmayyanībāḷaṅkoṇḍu, bhīmakanoḷkādiyaṟivaneyene, kanyaki
yendaḷ, kanasinoḷappaḍameṁmayya nāyyātanoḷkādiyaṟiya ninībāḷaṁ
piḍidirpudumembudumudampiḍidu gōpuradoḷaḍaṅgirpuduṁ, bhīmakaṁ
bandu, baḷasiyuṁyumuṁ tanna vidyegaḷaṁ besasuvuduṁ, paramu samyagdarśagdr̥
ṣṭiyuṁ, saptavidhajayavimuktanuṁ, caramadēhadharanuṁ, mahāśūranu
mappa, prītiṅkaranunabhibhavisalasamarthanendu, vidyegaḷu muguḻdu
bandu, tanage pēḻdu adr̥śyavāgi pōpuduṁ, bhīmakaṁ tāne bandu,
gajaṟi garjisi, nija praharaṇadiniṟivudumumadambañcisi, nisitāsiyiṁ
prītiṅkara navananeraḷkhaṇḍavāge poydu, tannalligevare, kanne siṁhā
sanamanēṟisi, kanakakaḷaśadoḷabhiṣēkaṅgeydu, viḷāsinī virāyumāna
cāmaranāgirda kumāraṅge, ratnamāleyunikkuvuduṁ. idēnendu
besagoḷe, kanneyendaḷ—

ā nīpoṟaḻalgarasiyaṁ, ninage paṭṭabaddha pūrvakaṁ rājyamanittenna
noḷ koḷvuḷvadene, kumāranendaṁ—tāyuṁyumuṁ, tandeyuṁyumuṁ irdu,
kuḍadakanneyumanenage kūkoḷa(ḍa)lāgadadaṟinavaraṁ kaṇḍu, oḷḷiḷḷattāgi
negaḻvenenḻvendoḍavarbandoḍambaḍisi kanyakiyaṁ piridu pooḍaveyu
nittoḍe, nāgadattanu nīḍidanēṇpiḻdiḍidu pōgi, kanyakiyaṁyuṁ piridarthamuni
rise, vasundhare ratnābharaṇavaṁmaṁ maṟidu bandenene, kumāraṁ taralpōda
nitta nāgadattaṁ, kanyakiyumamunoḍameveyumaṁmuṁ kaikoṇḍī kasavaramena
gāmuraṇāntambaraṁ sālvuduṁ, kumāraṁ tanna vidhivihitamananubhavisu
gendu, sārthadoḍane pōpa nāgadattanabhiprāyamunaṟidu, kumāranaṁ
kāṇbannegaṁ, pērarārāroḷ nuḍiyenendu kanyaki mōnabratadoḷirpuduṁ;
ākeyuṁ mūgiyendubagedu, bhaṇḍārada kāpanappaysi, sanneyoḷ
nuḍiyisuttaṁ poṟaḻalaneydi, kubēradattanuṁ, dhanamitreyuṁyumuṁ,
prītiṅkaranellirdanendu besagoḷe, nāgadattanānaṟiyenendu pala
raṟiye nuḍidirpuduṁ.

itta kumāranondu jinabhavanavaṁmaṁ kaṇḍu, puṣpādigaḷinarcisi,
dēvaraṁ bandisi, abhiṣēkamaṇṭapadoḷnidregeydirpuduṁ; vāraṇāsī
purada, dhanadēvaseṭṭigaṁ, jinadattegaṁ, puṭṭida śāntavarmanuṁ, śānta
madananumbembanumba tanayar, sarvaśāstra pāragaruṁ, jōraśāstranirataru

māgi, kaḷaltaguḷe, tande bārise, tannimbugeyyadire, sarvasaṅga
parityāṅgageydu, dhānyapurada śikhigiriyoḷirpudurpamāmuvuniyu tapō
mahātmyadiṁ, śārdūlādi mahāduṣṭa mr̥gaṅgaḷonduṁ bādhegeyyadire
kēḷdu, tāmirvarumallige pōgirduddu sāgarasēnagurugaḷapakkade, dharma
tattvatvamuṁ kēḷdu, madhu māṁsa nivr̥ttigeyduyda, dondu divasaṁ, tamma
gurugaḷu supratiṣṭhanagarakke pōge, śāntavarmanaṁ, śāntamadananaṁ
pulitine, sattirvaruṁ, bratada phaladiṁ dēvarāgi guruvandanege pōgi,
besanēnene, kelavudivasaṁ pōdimbaḷiyuṁṟiyaṁ besananuḍidaṁ. nīmirvaru
maṟidu negaḻvudene, guruḷvadenegurugagaḷājñeyuṁ kaikoṇḍu, vandanārthadināta
nirda basadigebandu, nanda, mahānandaremba guhyakadēvaruṁ kumārana
kiviyulidōrliyuṁyaṁ bājisi, tamma sahadharmiyendaṟidu, gurugaḷa
besananidakkumendaṟidu piridumoḍameveverasu kumāranaṁ vimāvānā
rūḍhaṁ māḍi, supratiṣṭhanagarada dharaṇībhūṣaṇagiriyoḷiḷipipa(risi) pōpu
duṁ; arasanuṁ, bandhugaḷuṁ, purajanamuvumirdidirvare, mahāvibhūtiyuṁ,
prītiṅkaraṁ poḻaṟalampuge, mattondu divasaṁ—

prītiṅkarana piriyubbeyappa, priyamitreyu maganamumaduveyoḷā
taṅge tappakanyakiyuṁ, prītiṅkarana baḻiṭikke tanda vasundhareyu ratnā
bharaṇamuṁmaṁ tuḍisi mahāratnadarśanakriyeyoḷ, rathamumanēṟisi, rathō
mārgadoḷ koṇḍubare, nōḍalendu banda, kr̥taka mūkikaṇḍu,
tannābharaṇamendaṅguli sañjñeyoḷottīḷtōṟi, rathavaṁmaṁ pōgalīyade
tannābharaṇamanittu pōgimendaḍḍambandu, nilvudumīke dēvateyendu,
mantra tantrajñar nōḍi, bhūta spr̥ṣṭamallendirpudumudaṁ kēḷdu,
tānēnumañmuñjadarasanallige pakkānumallirdapenendu prītiṅkaraṁ gūḍha
patramamu naṭṭuvuduṁ, kanyakirāgisi, peṟiraṟaṟivarakkumendu, patramuṁmaṁ
sīḷdu bisuṭu, rājagr̥hakkevandu, tadābharaṇa vr̥ttāntamuṁmaṁ pēḻvuṟvudu
marasaṁ, dharmādhyakṣaraṁ barisi, vicārisimene, kumāraṁ tannaṟidudaṁ
pēḻdiḷidudu nīdēṟdaḷidudunīdēvavateyaṟigumene, paṭṭāntariteyāgirda mūkiyaṁyuṁ
gandha, puṣpa dhūpādigaḷiṁ arcisi besagoḷe, nāgadattanēgeydu kr̥tya
mellamanaṟipe, svāmidrōhamuṁ, putravadhamuṁ geydanendātaṅge
muḷidarasaṁ, sarvasva haraṇaṅgeyyalirdudaṁ kumāraṁ bārise,
māṇdātana saujanyakke mecci, tannamagaḷ pr̥thvīsundariyuṁyu manā

sundariyumaṁ, mūvattirvar vaiśyaputri(kumāri)yarumaṁ vivāha
vidhiyiṁ koṭṭaṭṭirdharājyamumaṁ, pūrvajara dhanamumaṁ kaṇmaṅkuṇḍe,
kumāraniṣṭavipiṣayayu kāmabhōgaṅgaḷananubhavisuttirpinaṁ. ondudivasaṁ,
sāgarasēna muniyaruṁ sanyāsanaṅgeydu, paralōkakkesale, r̥khuju
mati, vimaḷamatigaḷemba cāraṇaraṁ manōharōdyānadoḷ kaṇḍu
bandisi, prītiṅkarakumāraṁ dharmamaṁ besagoḷe, cāraṇarintendu
besasidar——

sāgāramunāgāramendu dharmameṟaḍuṟidu teṟanakkumalli sāgāra
membudu, darśanika, bratika, sāmāyika, prōṣadhōpavāsibhēdadiṁ
yēkādaśa vidha(śuddha)makkuṁ; anāgāramembuduttama kṣamāmārda
vārjavādibhēdadiṁ daśavidhamakkumendu besase, tanna pūrvabhavamaṁ besa
goḷvuduṁ. avarintendu besasidarī poḻaṟaloḷe, sāgarasēna munigaḷā
tapayōgadoḷirpuduṁ, arasaṁ modalāgellaruṁ pōgi, gandhamālyādi
gaḷinarcisi, poḍavaḍuvāgaḷeḷiseva, śaṅkhapaṭahādi dhvanigaḷaṁ kēḷdondu
jambukaṁ, indī poḻaṟaloḷāvanānuṁ lōkāntakke sandanakkumātanaṁ
bisuṭṭu pōdaḍe timbetimbinendu, tamma sārevappuduvāmāsanna bhavyanendaṟidu
jambukaṅgintendar— ninna munnegeyda pāpaphaḷadiṁ tiryuggaggātiyoḷ
puṭṭide; īgaḷ sādhudarśanadiṁ, pāpakriyeṅgoḍarcalāga, pāpapariṇā
mamuṁ pattuviḍuvudu. nīṁ bratamaṁ kaikoṇḍu śubha pariṇāma
nappudembuduṁ, tamma vacanadinadu kaikoṇḍudanaṟidu, mattaminteṁ
dar—r nīṁ rātribhōjana viramaṇa bratamaṁ kaikoḷvudade ninage pari
ṇāmakke pōpallige (nīnapara lōkakke) sambaḷamembuduṁ. adaṁ
kaikoṇḍu, gurugaḷaṁ balagoṇḍu bandisi, māṁsādigaḷumaṁ toṟeṟi
dandiṁ baḻiyuṁṭiyaṁ, balige tanda kūḻibinaṟisi tindu, kālamaṁ kaḻilipu
ttirdondu divasaṁ, śuṣkāhāramumanuṇḍu, tr̥ṣābhibhūtanāgi, baigina
pottaṟoḷ nīrguḍiyalendu bāviya sōpānamārgadindiḷiyuttutta
malli beḷagaṁ kāṇade, nēsar paṭṭudendu bagedu, onderaḍumūṟu
sūḷpottaṁ nōḍalendu pugutuṁ, poḻamaṟavuḍutuṁ, irpannegaṁ
nēsar paḍe, tr̥ṣāparīṣahamuṁ sairisi, pariṇāmaśuddhiyiṁ sattu,
kubēradattaṅgaṁ, dhana(priya)mitregaṁ, vratada phaladiṁ prītiṅkaranāgi
puṭṭi, nīnī vividhaiśvaryamaneydide.

embudumavaraṁ bandisi, nirvēgadiṁ poḻaṟalge bandu, vasundhariyu
magaṁ priyaṅkaraṅge rājyamaṁ koṭṭu, rājagr̥hakkevandu, dīkṣeyaṁ
koṇḍarentivar, ghātigaḷaṁ kiḍisi kēvaḷiyāgi, baḻiṭiyumaghātikṣaya
doḷ nirvāṇakke salvarendu prītiṅkaracaritamaṁ gautatumasvāmigaḷ
besase, śrēṇikamahārājaṁ santuṣṭacittanāgi poḻaṟalge pōdaṁ.
itta, vardhamānasvāmigaḷ, nānādēśaviharaṇaṁ geydu bandu,
pāpāpura(nagara)da, manōharōdyānada, palavuṁ koḷaṅgaḷa naḍuvaṇa
maṇiśilātaḷadoḷ, eraḍu divasaṁ viharaṇa vidhiyuṁ māṇdu, kārtika
bahuḷa caturdaśiyu beḷagappajāvadoḷ, svāti nakṣatradoḷ, sāsirvar
munigaḷverasu, pratimāyōgadoḷirdārta, raudra, dharma, śukla
vemba caturvidha dhyānaṅgaḷoḷ, śukladhyānadiṁ karmaṅrmamaṅgaḷaṁ kiḍisidar.
ā dhyānalakṣaṇamentendoḍe— apraśastaṁ, praśastamendu dhyānamitte
ṟanakkumavaroḷ, praśastamumārta, raudravendu dvividhamakkuṁ.
ārtamuṁ, bāhyamadhyātmikavendu, dviprakāramakkuṁ; alli bāhya
vembudu, krandana, vilāpa(sa)na, paridēvana śauca(śōbha)na, paribhavana,
vismaya, viṣayasaṅgādigaḷparānumēyamappudariṁ bāhyaṁ svasaṁvēda
mappādhyātmikārtadhyānaṁ caturvidamakkuṁ; avāvuyendoḍe— ama
nōjña samprayōgānutpatti saṅkalpādhyavasānamuṁ, utpanna vināśa
saṅkalpādhyavasānamuṁ, manōjña viprayōgānutpattisaṅkalpādhyava
sānamuṁ, utpanna vināsaṅkalpādhyavasānamumendakkumalli amanō
jñavembudu, duḥkhasādhanamudupraṁ, bāhyamadhyātmikamenderaḍu teṟa
nakkuṁ; allibāhyaṁ cētanakr̥tamenduṁ, acētanakr̥tamendudviprakāra
makkuṁ; avaroḷ cētanakr̥tamembudu, mānuṣa, paśu, mr̥ga, pakṣi,
sarīsr̥pādi sampāditāsādhitaṁ(raṁ), acētana kr̥tamembudu, viṣa,
kaṇṭaka, va(śa)stra, kṣāra, śītōṣṇādi janitaṁ; ādhyātmikamuṁ, śārīra
mānasavendu dvividhamakkuṁ; alli śārīravembudu vāta, pitta,
ślēṣma, vaiṣamya, samutthitamappakṣi, danta, kukṣi, śūlādi janitaṁ;

mānasavembudu, rati, śōka, bhaya, viṣāda, jugupsā, daurmanahā
syādi janitaṁ; manōjñada samprayōgamemavemugāgadikkemba cintā
prabandhalakṣaṇamappa saṅkalpada tībrakaṣāyānugaṁ, janamadhyavasānamuḷi
davu sugamamumintu caturvidhamappārtadhyānaṁ.

kr̥ṣṇa, nīla kapōta lēśyābaḷādhyānamuṁ, pramādādhiṣṭhānamuva
pramatta ninditaṣaḍguṇapaḍuginasthānabhūmikamuṁ, parōkṣajñānamappudaṟiṁ,
kṣayōpaśamika bhāvamumuṁmantarmuhūrtakāla parivartanamuṁ, tiryur
ggati phaḷa saṁvartanīyamumuṁmappudu. raudramuṁ, bāhyamadhyātmika
vendu dvadvi(vidha)bhēdamakkuṁ; alli parānumēyamappa bāhyameṁ
budu, puruṣaniṣṭhuravacanākrōśa nirbhartsana, tāḍaṇa, pīḍana, paradārā
tikramaṇāti svasaṁvēdyamappādhyātmikamemvembudu, caturvidha vikalpa
makkumavāvuvendoḍe— hiṁsānandamuṁ, mr̥ṣānandamuṁ, stēyā
nandamuṁ, saṁrakṣaṇānandamumendakkumavaroḷ, saṁrambha, samā
rambha lakṣaṇavāgi parapīḍāsvarūpamumappa hiṁseyoḷatyartha saṅkalpā
dhyavasānaṁ, hiṁsānandamemba prathamaraudraṁ, svayambuddha vikalpita
yuktigaḷiṁ peṟaṟarnambuvantavaraṁ bañcisalvēḍīnuḍiva mr̥ṣāvacana
doḷappa saṅkalpādhyavasānaṁ mr̥ṣānandamemba dvitīya raudradhyānaṁ,
stēyānandamemba tr̥tīyaraudraṁ, cētanācētanavappa svaparigraha
doḷānidakkoḍeyane, idennoḍavemeyembāgrahadiṁ, adaṅkoḷvarge
pīḍeyuṁ māḍalendu kāpinoḷappa saṅkalpādhyāvasānaṁ, saṁrakṣaṇānanda
memba caturtharaudraṁ. ī pēḻdaṟda raudradhyānamumati kr̥ṣṇanīla kapōta
lēśyābalādānamuṁ pramādādhiṣṭhānamumamupramattanindatta pañcaguṇa
sthāna bhūmikamuṁ parōkṣa jñānamappudaṟiṁ, kṣāyōpasamikamuṁ,
kaṣāyapradhānamappudaṟinaunodayika bhāvamumuṁmantarmuhūrtakālapari
vartanamuṁ, narakagati phaḷasaṁvartanīyamumappudu.

ī mumpēḻdiṟdinnapraśastadhyānamaṁ pattuviṭṭapavargārgarthigaḷappa bhikṣuṁ
gaḷ parīṣahabādhāsahiṣṇu śaktimantamapputtama saṁvahananarappar,
praśastadhyānamaṁ dhyānisuvāgaḷ parvata, guhā, kandara, dari, druma,
kōṭīra, nadī, puḷiṇa, pitr̥vana, jīrṇōdyāna, śūnyāgārādigaḷoḷā
vudānumondeḍeyoḷ, vyāḷa, mr̥gapaśupakṣi manuṣyādigaḷagō(ḷo್gīḷgō)
caramuṁ, tappavamumāvāgantukamumappa sūkṣma jantugaḷiṁ, parivarjita

mumpumuṁmutyuṣṇaśītavāta varṣātapa rahitamumuṁmindriyaṁ manōvikṣēpahētu
nirākaraṇabhūtamuṁ, śuciyuyuṁmanuṅnaṅkūḷa sparśamumamumppa bhūtaḷadoḷ,
yathāsukhamumumumpaviṣṭanāgi, nijāṅkadoḷ, vāmapāda(ṇi)taḷada mēlu
ttaḷamāvāge, dakṣiṇapāṇi taḷamunimuṁsiṭṭu, baddhapalyaṅkāsanadoḷirdu, bhujavu
mastabdhamuṁ, samumavāge, śarīrayaṣṭiyuṁ niṟisi, lōcanaṅgaḷanatyutya
nmīḷitamuṁmati nimīḷitamumuṁmāgalīyade, dantāgraṅgaḷoḷondondaṁ
muṭṭi nile, prāṇāpāna pracārātyanta nigrahadiṁ, tīvramamuppa duḥkha
santapyamānākuḷa cittanappoṅppōṅgēkākāra pariṇāmamumaṁ puṭṭadadaṟiṁ,
munda mumpamunda prāṇāpāna pracāranāgi dravya, kṣētra, kāla, bhāvaśuddhiyo
ḷkūḍi, kr̥ta saṁskāranāgi, nābhiyiṁ mēle hr̥daya, lalāṭa, mastakaṅga
ḷoḷakke, peṟatondeḍeyoḷakke manōvr̥ttiyuṁ, kr̥taparicayamamumppalli
niṟise, mumuṁmukṣuṅgaḷ, dhyānisuva saṁsārōcchēdahētu bhūta praśasta
dhyāna dharmuṁrmma, śuklamenditteranakkuṁ.

alli dharmurmmadhyānaṁ, bāhyamadhyātmikamendu dviprakāramakkumalli
bāhyamembudu– sūtrārthagavēṣapaṇamuṁ, dr̥ḍhabrataśīlaguṇānurā
gamuṁ, karacaraṇapadanakāya parispandaparipirahitamuṁ, vāg vyāpārajaṁ
bhajrambhōdāravarjita mukhataru prāṇāpānōdrēkādi rahitamumāgi,
parānumēyaṁ appudaṟiṁ bāhyaṁ. svasaṁvēdyamappādhyātmikamuṁ,
daśavidhamakkumavāmāvuvendaḍe—apāya vicayamuṁ, upāya vicaya
muṁ, jīva vicayamumamañjīva vicayamuṁ, vipāka vicayamuṁ, virāga
vicayamuṁ, bhavavicayamuṁ, saṁsthāna vicayamuṁ, ājñā vicayamuṁ,
hētu vicayamumendakkumupāyavicayadoḷappa vicāramāvudondu
dhyānadoḷādapāya vicayamembudenduḷidavarkaminrkkinteyōjisugīpēḻda
daśavidhamuṁ dr̥ṣṭaśrutānubhūta dōṣavarjitanuṁ, mandatara kaṣāyā
nurañjitanumappātaṅgakkumavaṟoḷapāyavicayamembudanādisaṁsāra
doḷ svairapracārōjitanappa jīvana manōvākkāya pravr̥tti viśēṣadiṁ
nerapida pāpamuṁmaṁ bēkrkaiyyalerkkeyyanagentakkumemba cintāprabandha lakṣaṇamappa
saṅkalpaṁ prathamadharmuṁrmmaṁ; upāyavicayamembudīpēḻda kuśalamappa
manōvākkāya pravr̥ttiviśēṣamumanenagavaśyaṁ māḻpupāyamāvudemba
saṅkalpaṁ dvitīyadharmuṁrmmaṁ; jīvavicayamembudu jīvaṁ sākāranākā
rōpayōga lakṣaṇamuṁ, dravyārthadiṁ dānadi nidhanamumasaṅkhyēya
pradēśatva kr̥takarmarmmaphaḷapratyatyupabhōgiyuṁ, śarīrādyupacētanōpa

karaṇamuṁ, nāmādi nirdēśādi sadasadādigatyādi pramāṇa naya nikṣēpa
mārgaṇā viṣayamumbemmumembivu modalāge cētana svabhāvānu cintanaṁ
tr̥tīyadharmmaṁ; ajīva vicayamembudu, jīvalakṣaṇamumappa pudgala
dharmādharmarmma kālākāśa dravyaṅgaḷanantavikalpa paryāyaṅgaḷemba nija
svabhāvānucintanaṁ caturthadharmmaṁ; vipākavicayamembudu dravya
bhāva lakṣaṇamuṁ, madhura kaṭuka vipākamuṁ, caturvidha bandhamuṁ,
mūlōttara prakr̥ti vikalpa vistr̥tamumappaṣṭavidhakarmmaṅgaḷāvāvagati
yoḷ, yōniyoḷavastheyoḷsatva nikāyaṅgaḷige viṣayamakkumemba
vipākaviśēṣānucintanaṁ pañcamadharmmaṁ, virāgavicayamembudu
śarīramanityamaparitrāṇamaśuci tryamaḷa tr̥ṣōda saptadhātumayaṁ majajja
sranispandita śrōtōbaḷaṁ kr̥trima śaucamidaṟoḷ kamanīyamoṁ
dumilla, kāmasukhaṅgaḷe pramukha rasikaṅgaḷuṁ, kimpāka pākavipāki
gaḷuṁ, parādhīnaṅgaḷumasthāna pracura bhaṅguraṅgaḷemagappuppaventivararā
maṇīyaka prakarṣamesagumunvuntante bhōgigaḷge tr̥ṣṇāviśēṣamanastha
makkumagni mindhanaṅgaḷindupaśāntiyilladantivarinda mārgaṁ tr̥pti
yumupaśāntiyumillaihikāmutrikavīvinipātahētugaḷavaṁ prāṇigaḷ
sukhamendu bagevuvavu mahāduḥkha kāraṇaṅgaḷanātyantikamappudaṟi niṣṭa
māgiyumaniṣṭamemba vairāgyahētu viśēṣānu cintanaṁṣṭamaṁnaṁṣaṣṭhamuṁ
dharmmaṁ; bhavavicayamembudu jīvaṅge saṁsāradoḷacētanamacētana
makkavinābhāvi sahāyanilla, jīvanorvane tannageyda phaḷamuṁ pratikūla
makkanukūlamappanubhavisugumanādi saṁsāradoḷ tiriva jīvakke guṇa
viśēṣamaṁ kāṇalāradadaṟiṁ, bhavasaṅkramaṇaṁ nirarthakamendivu modalāge
bhavasaṅkrānti dōṣacintanaṁ saptamaṁ dharmmaṁ; saṁsthānavicayameṁ
budu svātmapratiṣṭhamākāśa ākāśapratiṣṭhaṁ, tanughanavātōdadhivaḷayaṁ
tatpratiṣṭhitaṁ bhūmi tatsthitaṁ lōkanāḷi(ḍi)kābhyantaraṁ, saritsamudra
parvatabhavana vimāna siddhālayādigaḷuttamumananta jīvanikāyaṅgaḷiṁ,
bharitamāgirda lōkada svabhāva pariṇāma santāna nāmacintanamaṣṭamaṁ
dharmmaṁ; ājñā vicayamembudatīndriya viṣayamanaṟiyalke caturava
bōdhadoḷaṁ buddhiśaktiyilladudañjiṁdaṁṟiṁ, paralōka bandhamōkṣa lōkā
lōka sadasadvivēka jīvājīvādi padārthaṅgaḷoḷ sarvajña prāmāṇya
dindamāvāgamaviṣayaṁ tattvatvamāgamadoḷ pēḻdudamallade, peṟadallenllindu
samyagdarśana svabhāvadinappa niścaya cintanaṁ navamaṁ dharmmaṁ; hētu

vicayamembudāgamaṁma vipratipattiyoḷ nayaviśēṣa guṇa pradhāna bhāvō
panayadarśanamappa syādvāda prakriyeyanavalambisirdu tarkānusāri
ruciyappa puruṣaṅge svasamayaṁ parasamayaṁ guṇadōṣa viśēṣa pari
cchēdadiṁ, apudondu guṇabahuḷamappudaṟoḷ, abhinivēśaṁ śrēyu
vendu syādvāda tīrtharthaṅkara pravacanadoḷ pūrvāpara virōdhahētu
parigrahaṇa sāmarthyadiṁ samuvamasthāna guṇānucintanaṁ daśamaṁ dharmmaṁ.

ī pēḻda dharmmadhyānaṁ, pītapadma lēśyābalāḷādānamuṁ pramādā
dhiṣṭhānamumaviratādi caturguṇasthāna bhūmikamāgiyuṁ, utkr̥ṣṭāṣṭa
pēkṣeyinda pramattaguṇasthānabhūmikanuṁ, antarmuhūrtakāla pari
vartanamuṁ, parōkṣajñānatvadiṁ kṣayōpaśamika bhāvamuṁ, svargāpa
vargagati phaḷasaṁvartaniyumappudu.

śukladhyānamuṁ, śuklaṁ, paramaṁmuṁśuklamendu dvividhamakkumalli,
śuklamembudu pr̥thaktva vitarka vicāramuṁ, ēkatva vitarka vicāra
mendu dviprakāramakkuṁ; paramamuśuklamembudu sūkṣmakriyā praprāti
pātiyuṁyumuṁ, samucchinna kriyānivr̥ttiyumendu dvibhēdamakkuṁmumakku
mīpēḻda śukladhyānamuṁ, bāhyamādhyātmikamenditteranakkuṁ.
alli bāhyamembudu gātra dr̥ṣṭiparispandanā bhāvamuṁ, jambha
jr̥mbhōdgārakhapatu virahitamuṁ manabhivyaktaprāṇāpānaṁ pracāra
tvamuṁ, vinā(nika)sita prāṇāpānaṁ pravicāratvamuṁ peṟa(ri)resana
jēyatvamumāgi, padā(rānmēsmē)numēyamappudaṟiṁ, bāhyasvasaṁvē
dyamappādhyātmikadoḷmodala pr̥thaktva vitarka vicāramembadhyānadoḷaṁ,
pr̥thaktvamembudu, nānārtha(thva) vitarkamembudu, dvādaśāṅga śruta
jñānaṁ vicāramembudadu arthavyaṁ(rthadabyābyyaṁ)janada yōga saṅkrānti
a(pada)vaṟoḷ vyañjanamembudu śabdaṁ, arthamembudu tadviṣayuṁ;
yōgamembudu manōvākkāyalakṣaṇaṁ; saṅkrāntiyemba anyōnōnya
parivartanaṁ mumukṣuṅgaḷ svabhāva vijr̥mbhita puruṣākāra sāma
rthyadiṁ dravya paramāṇuvanakke, bhāvaparamāṇuvanakkavaṟoḷondanava
lambisi saṁśrutā(hr̥tavi)śēṣa cintāvikṣēpamuṁnuṁ, mahā saṁvara saṁvr̥tanu
māgi, karmmaprakr̥tigaḷa sthitiyuṁ mayuṁanubhāgamumaṁ kiḍisuttuṁ,
upasamisuttuṁ, kṣapiyisuttuṁ, paramubahukarmma nirjaranāgi
yormorme, dravyaparyāyayumunarthadoḷapaṟoḷeḷa, (vyañjana
mamu(muṁ)vyañjanadoḷarthamuṁ, yōgadiṁ yōgāntaramuṁ, vyañja

nadiṁ, vyañjanāntaramuṁ, paryāyadiṁ paryāyāntaramuṁ saṅkra
misuvudu prathama śukladhyānamadapūrvakaraṇadiṁ toṭṭupaśamaka,
kṣapaka, śrēṇyātmakōpaśānta kṣīṇaguṇasthānabhūmikamuṁ, śukla(dhyāna)
taralēśyāba(la)ḷā)ādānamumantarmuhūrta kālaparivarta(ka)namuṁ,
kṣāyikōpaśamikabhāvamuṁ, u(mu)pātārthavyañjanayōga saṅkrama
mumuṁ, śrutakēvaḷi yativr̥ṣabha niṣēvyamuṁ, upaśamaka, kṣapakaśrēṇi
bhēdadiṁ, svargāpavargagatiphaḷa saṁvartanīyayumumappuduveraḍane yēyō
katva vitarkavicāramemba dhyānadoḷēkatvadindaṁ, vitarka māvudonda
ṟoḷanēkatvavitarkamapa(ga)ratārtha vyañjanayōga saṅkramaṇatvadinda
mavicāramamuṁadaṟinēkatva vitarka vicāraṁ mumpēḻda paramāṇuvinoḷ
paryāyuya paramāṇumuvaṁnondane kāṁ(koṁ)ḍaniyatraitvaikayōga balā
dānamuṁ, munninante pūrvadhara yativr̥ṣabha niṣēvyamumaśē
ṣārtha vyañjanayōga saṅkramamu(viṣayayu)ditrayayu cintāvikṣēparahi
tatvadiṁ, bahutarā(srava)trida saṁvarakarmmanirjaramuṁ, aśēṣamōha
vikalpakṣayā nantaramormodaloḷaśēṣa ghātikarmmakṣayayurajaḥpajjvaripātana
samarthamuṁ, uttama tapātiśayarūpamuṁ, akaṣāya chadmastha
vītarāga guṇasthānaṁ bhūmikamumappudu, dvitīya śukladhyānadoḷ,
ghātigaḷavasānamāgaloḍaṁ, kṣāyika jñānadarśana samyaktvacāritra
vīryātiśayaśakti (gasti)bhasma prajvaḷitakēvaḷi jinabhāskarōdayamyavyati
krānta cittaṁ, chadmastha jñāna darśana śarīrabhāṣāntaḥkaraṇa prakr̥ti
yayukkumākēvaḷi jinakuñjara tīrthakaranakke mēṇitaranakke kr̥takr̥tyanuṁ
siddhasādhyanuṁ, buddhabōdhyanumatyantanu punarbhava lakṣmīpariṣkāntaṣvakta
nuṁ acintyajñānavairāgyaiśvarya mahātmyanuṁ lōkēśvarariṁ(reṁ)da
bhi(gamamu)nīyanumarccanīyanumāge utkr̥ṣṭadindaṁ dēśōnu
pūrvakōṭikālaṁ vihārisi, antarmuhūrtaśēṣāyuṣkanāge, samupamava
sthita vaidyanāmagōtranakkumāgaḷ, sarvavāṅmanassaṁyōganuṁ,
bādarakāyayōgamaṁ pattuviṭṭu, sūkṣmayōgaṅgaḷañjananāgi, sūkṣma
kriyā pratipātidhyānaṁ, śuklasāmānyadiṁ, tr̥tīya paramamu śuklā
pēkṣeyiṁ, prathamamu śukladhyānamavaneydalarhanakkumantarmuhūrta
śē(vē)ṣāyuṣkanādāgaḷ, tadadhikasthitaṁ śēṣakarmmatrayamāge,
sayōgi bhaṭṭārakanātmōpa yōgātiśayamuṁ, samāyika sahā

yayunuṁ, viśiṣṭakaraṇanuṁ, mahā saṁvaratanuṁ, laghukarma paripākanu
vāgi, śēṣakarmavēṇuṟu(mēṇ) pariśātana śakti svabhāvadiṁ(da,) nālku
samayadoḷ, daṇḍakavāṭa prataralōka pūraṇegaḷiṁ, svātma pradēśa
visarpaṇavāge, mattamanite samaya-dinumnupasaṁhr̥ta pradēśa(vitaraṇa)nuṁ,
samīkr̥ta sthitikarma catuṣṭayanunuṁ, pūrvaśarīra (pariṇāmanavāgi)
pramāṇanuṁ, pathama paramaśukladhyānavuṁ, kaḍeyeydise, tatsamaya
doḷ, dvitīya paramaśukladhyāna prārambhamakkuṁ prāṇāpāna
pracāra sarvakāyavāṅmanō yōga sarva pradēśa parispanda kriyā
vyāpāraṅgaḷ samucchinnamādudaṟiṁ, samucchinnakriyā nivr̥tti
yembudā dhyānadoḷ, sarvabandhāsrava nirōdhavāge, samāśēṣa
karmaparisātana sāmarthyōtpattiyanuḷḷa (a)yōgi kēvaḷige
sampūrṇa yathākhyāta cāritravuṁmuṁ, jñānadarśanavuṁmuṁ, sarvasaṁsāra
duḥkhajvālā parīriṣvaṅgacchēdava(ja)navuṁmuṁ, sākṣānmōkṣa kāraṇavumumakkuṁ,
ayōga kēvaḷiyuṁ āgaḷ dhyānātīśayanāgirdarddu sarvamamu kaḷaṅka
bandhananuṁ, nira(stāṣṭa)pariṣṭadhātu pāṣāṇa jācātyakanakadante labdhātma
svabhāvanuṁ, tadanantara mūrdhvakke salguṁ, ālōkāntavaraṁ adē
kendoḍe-pūrvaprayōgadinasaṅgatvadiṁ, bandha(cchē)kṣēdhadiṁ tathā(dā)
gati pariṇāmadināpividdha kuḷāḷala cakradantēraṇḍa bījadante, vyāvyapagatalē
pāḷābhuvantagni śikhiyunyantūrdhvake salguṁ, gatyupagrahakāraṇamappa
dharmasti kāyābhāvadinālōkāntarakke salluṁ.

ī peḻdildi caturvidha dhyānaṅgaḷ śukladhyānaṅgaḷ, śukladhyānadiṁ
sakaḷa karma nimūrḷarmūḷanaṅgeydu, śrīvardhamāna bhaṭṭārakamōrmōkṣa
lakṣmīvallabharuṁ, trilōkacūḍāmaṇigaḷu mūmādar itta, dēvēndra
rellarumādi bhaṭṭārakarge māḍidandadoḷe parinirvāṇa mahākalyāṇa
pūjeyuṁ māḍi, tadanantaramānanda nr̥tyamanāḍi pōdar.
div.trailer:
idu sakaḷabhuvanajana vandyamāna saṁyuma samādhānavijitaduritā
rātisēna śrīmadajitasēna bhaṭṭāraka śrīpāda padma prasādāsādhita
ratnatrayālaṅkr̥ta dharmavijayi, śrīmaccāvuṇḍarāja viracitamappa
triṣaṣṭi lakṣaṇa mahā purāṇadoḷ vardhamāna bhaṭṭāraka purāṇaṁ.

div.head: praśasti
div.p:
śrī vardhamāna bhaṭṭārakaruṁ muktige sanda divasame gautama
svāmigaḷkēvaḷigaḷāgi vipuḷagiriyoḷ, muktige sandande, sudharmaruṁ
kēvaḷigaḷāgi nirvāṇakke sandarā divasame, jambūnāmaruṁ kēvaḷiga
ḷāgiyuṁ, mumpēḷdaḻda varṣambaraṁ vihārisi, muktige sandar.

lg.l: ka sūtramuṁmaṁ baredu tamma kavitā guṇamuṁmaṁ

div.p:
tadanantaramēḷācāryadēvaruṁ, vīrasēnabhaṭṭārakaruṁ, vijita
yaśarāge, jinadēvarācārya padaviyuṁ kaikoṇḍar.

lg.l: vr̥॥ suraśailaṁ piridaltu vārdhipiridaltā mērugaṁ vārdhigaṁ

div.p:
gadya:— intenisi negaḻda cāvuṇḍarājaṁ munne manne(ḷa) khēṭa
(ḍa)dava kāḷagadoḷāḷdona besadiṁ vajjaḷajjḷadēvanajagarumpeyemba
ca(la)kkaḷikkeyu taleyanari(naḷiṟa) taleyunāne meṭṭidante tannāne
pariye gelda sāhasadiṁ samamura dhurandharanuṁ, gōnūra bayalo
ḷoḍḍi banda(bandoḍḍida)noṇambara kāḷegadoḷ jagadēkavīranavuṁ
(vē)tēṟaṟi tanna vīra(bala)vuṁ meṟedudadaṟiṁ vīramārtāṇḍanuṁ,
u(mu)ccaṅgiya kōṭeyoḷ rājayyayka(jāyta)noḷekkatuḷa miṟivaṁ
tōrpane peḍeṟediṟidu raṇajayavuṁ meṟedudaṟiṁ raṇaraṅgasiṅganuṁ,
bāgehaḷi(yūra) kōṭeyoḷ tribhuvanavīraṁ modalāge palarumuṁ
kondu gōvindaranaṁ(dēvanaṁ)girikandaramuṁ(doḷ) pugisidudaṟiṁ
vairi kuḷa kāḷadaṇḍanuṁ, nr̥pakāmanakōṭeyoḷ rājanembadhaṭa(daḷa)
nuvuṁnuṁ, bāsanembaṅkacē(ca)yanuvuṁnuṁ, siva(dha)ranembaṁ jeṭṭiganuvuṁnuṁ
kuṇika(ḷbanda)nemba kaṭṭuṅgoḍanuvuṁnuṁ, poyiṁsaḷanemba birudanuvuṁnuṁ
pr̥thuvanemba bīranuvuṁnuṁ, bihanemba pūṇiganuvuṁnuṁ, bikkiganemba muṅgā(dha)
(pūrgā)yiganu(ḷu)vuṁmuṁ peṟaruṁ kaligaḷuṁ, ballāḷaḷumanonde
meyyoḷ peḍeṟediṟidu gelda bhujavikramadinasahāyavikramanuṁ, tanna
tammanaṁ nāgavarmanaṁ konda pagege caladaṅkadaṇḍa(gaṅga)nuṁ
(gaṁ)raṅgana(ra)bhaṇṭanuṭṭanu baḷdhōḷo್dīnavenisida ma(mu)dhurācajayanuṁ
dāḷiṭṭu(yiṭṭo)kondu, ba(da)lavuṁ neṟaṟipidudaṟiṁ samarapuruṣa
(paraśu)rāmanuṁ, matta mārgamittuṁ tettuṁ maṟiyudoṭṭayisi

bāḷva jeṭṭigaranaṭṭida daṇḍinoḷe sādhyaṁ māḍi niṣkaṇṭakaṁ māḍidudaṟiṁ
pratipakṣarākṣasanuṁ, kelada nelada malayumaṇḍaladudāra vīrabhaṭakōṭi
yantave kondudaṟiṁ bhaṭamāṟiyuṁ, niśśaṅkādi guṇa samunvita
nappudaṟiṁ samyaktvaratnākaranuṁ, parāṅganā paradravya parāṅmukhanappu
daṟiṁ śaucāca(bha)raṇanuṁ, parihāsadoḷaṁ vismaraṇadoḷaṁ sūnr̥tavacana
nappudaṟiṁ(ṟiduṁ) satyayudhiṣṭhiranuṁ, svaparaguṇa parirakṣaṇaika kāraṇa
nappudaṟiṁ guṇamuṁ kāvonuṁ, satyatyāgādi guṇaṅgaḷoḷukṣūṇamilla
dudaṟinentumoḷḷidanuṁ, ari(ti)pracaṇḍa vīramuṇḍa(ḷa)ḷa śikhaṇḍi
muṇḍana maṇiyappudaṟiṁ subhaṭa cūḍāmaṇiyumembaṅkadaṁ(ḷaṁ)ka
māligaḷ(ḷda), diggaja ghaṭāghaṭegaḷoḷaṁ sakaḷa kuḷācaḷa kūṭaṅgaḷoḷaṁ
nelase,

lg.l: vr̥॥ navaśata saṅkhyeyāge śakakāla samuṁ negaḻdīśvarā(saumyā)
tsava karamāge phālguṇa sitāṣṭami rōhiṇi sōmavārameṁveṁ
padamuḷe koḷvudakke pusi pōgade percurca(ḷca)ḷasakke jainadha
bhyudayu sukhāvahaṁ nelasi nilke dinēśa śaśāṅkaruḷḷinaṁ
straṅgaḷanellamuṁ neṟeṟiyu nōḍi vicārisi kēḷdu tirdi pē
piṅgisi muttavoḷḷitene sōdhisi koḷge purāṇa kōvidar
muktiṁ vakti satāṁ mahā sukhakarīṁ śr̥ṇvantu
